name: O7GTEXCH2
body:
create Function O7GTEXCH2 (  @sCurr     nvarchar(4)
                                      ,@sVorg     nvarchar(15)
                                      ,@dExchdate datetime ) 
returns numeric(24,12)
as
begin
	declare @sBasecurr			nvarchar(3)--r5organization.org_curr%type;
	declare @sDualcurr			nvarchar(200)--r5install.ins_desc%type;
	declare @nVdual				numeric(24,12)
	declare @nBasecurr_dual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nActcurr_dual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nBasevalue			numeric(24,4)
	declare @nValue				int --= 1000;
	declare @nOrdorgcurr		nvarchar(3)--r5exchrates.crr_orgcurr%type;
	declare @nExch				numeric(24,12)
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @dTempDate			datetime
	declare @nReturn			int

	/* Set all out parameters to null. */
	set @nExch = null
	set @nValue = 1000

	/* if no currency supplied  return without doing anything */
	if @sCurr IS NULL OR @sVorg IS NULL 
		return 1 
	
	/* Get the base currency for the order organization. if no organization */
	/* supplied  return without doing anything. */
	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5organization
	WHERE  org_code = @sVorg
	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @sBasecurr = org_curr
		FROM   r5organization
		WHERE  org_code = @sVorg
	else
		return 1

	/* Get the dual currency */
	SELECT @sDualcurr = ins_desc
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'DUALCURR'

	/* if the currency equals the base currency,  rate should always be 1. */
	if @sBasecurr = @sCurr 
		return 1

	/* Check whether base currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nBasecurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sBasecurr

    /* Check whether given currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nActcurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sCurr

	/* if given currency = dual currency and base currency belongs to Euro  */
	/* return reciproke of above retrieved rate.                                */
	if @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sCurr = @sDualcurr 
		return ( ROUND( 1 / @nBasecurr_dual, 6 ) )

	/* if base currency = dual currency and given currency belongs to Euro  */
	/* return above retrieved rate.                                             */
	if @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sBasecurr = @sDualcurr 
		return  @nActcurr_dual 

	if @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
		begin
			/* Normal exchange rate. */
			set @dTempDate = dbo.O7GTTIME2(@sVorg)

			select @nExch = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCurr
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( Coalesce ( @dExchdate, @dTempDate), N'DD'  ) BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_start, N'DD') AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD')
		end
	else
		begin
			if @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					set @dTempDate = dbo.O7GTTIME2(@sVorg)

					select @nVdual = crr_exch
					FROM   r5exchrates
					WHERE  crr_curr    = @sDualcurr
					AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
					AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( Coalesce ( @dExchdate, @dTempDate), N'DD'  ) BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_start, N'DD') AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD')

					set @nBasevalue = round( @nValue / @nActcurr_dual / @nVdual, 4 )
					set @nExch      = round( @nValue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
				end
			else
				begin
					if @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
						begin
							set @dTempDate = dbo.O7GTTIME2(@sVorg)

							select @nVdual = crr_exch
							FROM   r5exchrates
							WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCurr
							AND    crr_orgcurr = @sDualcurr
							AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( Coalesce ( @dExchdate, @dTempDate), N'DD' ) BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_start, N'DD') AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD')
			
							set @nBasevalue = round( @nValue / @nVdual * @nBasecurr_dual, 4 )
							set @nExch      = round( @nValue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
						end
					else
						begin
							/* Triangular!! */
							set @nBasevalue = round( @nValue / @nActcurr_dual * @nBasecurr_dual, 4 )
							set @nExch      = round( @nValue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
						end
				end
		end

     return  @nExch 
end

create Function O7GTEXCH_FOR_INVLINE ( @sInv     nvarchar(45)
                                      ,@sInvorg     nvarchar(15)
                                      ,@sCurr     nvarchar(4)
                                      ,@nOrl_exch numeric(24,12)) 
returns numeric(24,12)
as
begin
    declare @sINVLCURR nvarchar(50)
    declare @nExch numeric(24,12)
    declare @dInvdate datetime

    if @sInv IS NULL OR @sInvorg IS NULL 
        return 1 

    set @nExch = null

    select @sINVLCURR = ISNULL(ins_desc, 'PO') from r5install where ins_code = N'INVLCURR'

    select @dInvdate = inv_date from r5invoices where inv_code = @sInv and inv_org = @sInvorg

    if @sINVLCURR = 'INVOICE'
    begin
        set @nExch = dbo.o7gtexch2 (@sCurr, @sInvorg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dInvdate, N'DD' ))
    end
    else if @sINVLCURR = 'ACTIVE'
    begin
        set @nExch = dbo.o7gtexch2 (@sCurr, @sInvorg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2(@sInvorg), N'DD' ))
    end
    else
    begin
        set @nExch = @nOrl_exch
    end	

    return  @nExch 
end

CREATE FUNCTION O7GTFREQ 
	(@nFreq	NUMERIC(8), 
	 @sUom	NVARCHAR(1),
	 @dDue	DATETIME)
RETURNS NUMERIC(8)
AS
BEGIN
	RETURN	CASE COALESCE(@sUom, 'D')
				WHEN 'D' THEN @nFreq
				WHEN 'W' THEN @nFreq * 7
				WHEN 'M' THEN DATEDIFF(d , @dDue , dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDue, @nFreq ))
				WHEN 'Q' THEN DATEDIFF(d , @dDue , dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDue, @nFreq * 3))
				ELSE DATEDIFF(d , @dDue , dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDue, @nFreq * 12 ))
			END
END

create function O7GTHOUR(@sEvtcode nvarchar(30), @nAct numeric(8))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
	declare @nResult		numeric(30,6)

	set  @nResult = 0

	select @nResult = COALESCE(SUM(boo_hours), 0)
	FROM   r5bookedhours
	LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities ON act_event = boo_event AND act_act = boo_act
	WHERE  boo_event = @sEvtcode
	AND    boo_act   = @nAct
	AND    COALESCE(act_ordrtype, N'-') <> N'SF';

	return (@nResult)
	
end

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GTLASTREAD(
  @sObject         NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sOrganization   NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sUom            NVARCHAR( 30 ) )
  RETURNS NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @nLastreading NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  SELECT @nLastreading = rea_reading
  FROM   r5readings
  WHERE  rea_object     = @sObject
  AND    rea_object_org = @sOrganization
  AND    rea_calcuom    = @sUom
  ORDER BY rea_date ASC
  
  RETURN( @nLastreading )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GTLEAD 
    @sCpart        nvarchar(30),
    @sCpartorg     nvarchar(15),
    @sCsupplier    nvarchar(30),
    @sCsupplierorg nvarchar(15),
    @sCstore       nvarchar(15),
    @nNleadtime    numeric(4,1) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    if @sCsupplier is null
        begin
            SELECT @nNleadtime = sto_leadtime
   	       	FROM   r5stock
            WHERE  sto_part     = @sCpart
            AND    sto_part_org = @sCpartorg
            AND    sto_store    = @sCstore
            if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                set @nNleadtime = 0
        end
    else
        begin
            SELECT @nNleadtime = cat_leadtime
            FROM   r5catalogue
            WHERE  cat_part     = @sCpart
            AND    cat_part_org = @sCpartorg
            AND    cat_supplier = @sCsupplier
            AND    cat_supplier_org = @sCsupplierorg
            if @@ROWCOUNT =  0
                begin
                    SELECT @nNleadtime = com_leadtime
                    FROM   r5companies
                    WHERE  com_code = @sCsupplier
                    AND    com_org  = @sCsupplierorg
                    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                        begin
                            SELECT @nNleadtime = sto_leadtime
   	       	                FROM   r5stock
                            WHERE  sto_part     = @sCpart
                            AND    sto_part_org = @sCpartorg
                            AND    sto_store    = @sCstore
                            if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                                set @nNleadtime = 0
                        end
        
                end
        end

name: O7GTLPFC

create function O7GTLPFC(	@sOrg			nvarchar(15),
							@sSupplier		nvarchar(30),
							@sSupplierorg	nvarchar(15),
							@sPart			nvarchar(30),
							@sPartorg		nvarchar(15)  )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
	declare @nTodual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nFromdual		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nExchangerate	numeric(24,12)
	declare @nTemp			int
	declare @nCatprice		numeric(24,6)	--r5catalogue.cat_purprice%TYPE
	declare @sCatcurrency	nvarchar(3)		--r5catalogue.cat_curr%TYPE
	declare @sCatuom		nvarchar(30)	--r5catalogue.cat_puruom%TYPE
	declare @nLocalprice	numeric(24,6)
	declare @sVorg			nvarchar(15)	--r5organization.org_code%TYPE
	declare @sCommon		nvarchar(1)		--r5organization.org_common%TYPE
	declare @sCheck			nvarchar(10)

	--o7gtdual declarations
	declare @dExchdate		datetime
	declare @sBasecurr		nvarchar(3)		--r5organization.org_curr%TYPE
	declare @sDualcurr		nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nBasecurr_dual	int
	declare @nActcurr_dual	int
	declare @nBasevalue		int
	declare @nNvalue		NUMERIC(24,12)
	declare @sOrdorgcurr	nvarchar(3)		-- r5exchrates.crr_orgcurr%TYPE

	set @nTodual = 0
	set @nFromdual = 0
	set @nExchangerate = 0
	set @nTemp = 0
	set @nCatprice = 0
	set @sCatcurrency = null
	set @sCatuom = null
	set @nLocalprice = 0
	set @sVorg = null
	set @sCommon = null
	set @sCheck = null

	if @sOrg is null or @sSupplier is null or @sSupplierorg is null or @sPart is null or @sPartorg is null
		return null

	SELECT @nCatprice = cat_purprice, 
			@sCatcurrency = cat_curr, 
			@sCatuom = cat_puruom
	FROM r5catalogue
	WHERE cat_part = @sPart AND cat_part_org = @sPartorg AND cat_supplier = @sSupplier AND cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg

	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		return 0

	if @sCatcurrency is null
		begin
			SELECT @sCatcurrency = com_curr FROM r5companies WHERE com_code = @sSupplier AND com_org = @sSupplierorg
			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				return null
		end

	if @nCatprice is null or @nCatprice = 0
		return 0

	SELECT @nTemp = 1 FROM r5parts WHERE par_code = @sPart AND par_org = @sPartorg AND par_uom = @sCatuom
	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		return 0

	SELECT @sCommon = org_common FROM r5organization WHERE org_code = @sOrg
	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		return null

	if @sCommon = N'+'
		begin
			set @sVorg = dbo.o7dflt2( N'DEFORG')
			if @sVorg is null
				return null
		end
	else
		set @sVorg = @sOrg

	--o7gtdual absorption starts here
	set @dExchdate = dbo.o7gttime2( @sVorg )

	/* Set all out parameters to null. */
	SET @nTodual = null
	SET @nFromdual = null
	SET @nExchangerate = null

	SET @nNvalue = 1

	/* Get the base currency for the order organization. If no organization */
	/* supplied  return without doing anything. */
	SELECT @sBasecurr = org_curr
	FROM   r5organization
	WHERE  org_code = @sVorg

	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		GOTO O7GTDUAL_END

	/* If the currency equals the base currency,  rate should always be 1. */
	SELECT @sDualcurr = ins_desc
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'DUALCURR'

	IF @sBasecurr = @sCatcurrency 
		BEGIN
			SET @nExchangerate = 1
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	/* Check whether base currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nBasecurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sBasecurr


	/* Check whether given currency belongs to Euro. */
	SELECT @nActcurr_dual = cur_dual
	FROM   r5currencies
	WHERE  cur_code = @sCatcurrency

	/* If given currency = dual currency and base currency belongs to Euro  */
	/* return reciproke of above retrieved rate.                                */
	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sCatcurrency = @sDualcurr 
		BEGIN
			SET @nExchangerate = ROUND( 1 / @nBasecurr_dual, 6 )
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	/* If base currency = dual currency and given currency belongs to Euro  */
	/* return above retrieved rate.                                             */
	IF @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @sBasecurr = @sDualcurr 
		BEGIN
			SET @nExchangerate = @nActcurr_dual
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END 

	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
		/* Normal exchange rate. */
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nExchangerate = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCatcurrency
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dExchdate, N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( crr_start, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD' )
			
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NOT NULL 
		/* Triangular!! */
		BEGIN
			SET @nTodual = @nActcurr_dual
			
			SELECT @nFromdual = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sDualcurr
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sBasecurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dExchdate, N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( crr_start, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD' )
			
			SET @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nTodual / @nFromdual, 4 )
			SET @nExchangerate = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
			
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	IF @nBasecurr_dual IS NOT NULL AND @nActcurr_dual IS NULL 
		/* Triangular!! */
		BEGIN
			SET @nFromdual = @nBasecurr_dual

			SELECT @nTodual = crr_exch
			FROM   r5exchrates
			WHERE  crr_curr    = @sCatcurrency
			AND    crr_orgcurr = @sDualcurr
			AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dExchdate, N'DD') BETWEEN dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE ( crr_start, N'DD' ) AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(crr_end, N'DD' )

			SET @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nTodual * @nFromdual, 4 )
			SET @nExchangerate = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
			
			GOTO O7GTDUAL_END
		END

	--if you get this far tehn none of the above conditions were met
	/* Triangular!! */
	SET @nFromdual = @nBasecurr_dual
	SET @nTodual = @nActcurr_dual
	SET @nBasevalue = round( @nNvalue / @nTodual * @nFromdual, 4 )
	SET @nExchangerate = round( @nNvalue / @nBasevalue, 6 )
	--end o7gtdual
	
O7GTDUAL_END:
	if @nExchangerate is null or @nExchangerate <= 0
		return 0

	set @nLocalprice = @nCatprice / @nExchangerate

	return @nLocalprice
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7GTPARAMS_GETVALUE @sReturn nvarchar(2000) OUTPUT, 
										@sP_code nvarchar(20)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sVariable		nvarchar(32)

	set @sVariable = CASE @sP_code	WHEN N'BARURL'		THEN N'V_BARURL'
									WHEN N'EXPURL'		THEN N'V_EXPURL'
									WHEN N'ONLMAN'		THEN N'V_ONLMAN'
									WHEN N'REPSURL'		THEN N'V_REPSURL'
									WHEN N'IPSRVVND'	THEN N'V_IPVNDR'
									WHEN N'IPSRVUPD'	THEN N'V_IPUPDPRC'
									WHEN N'IPSRVTPO'	THEN N'V_TRANSPO'
									WHEN N'IPSRVADD'	THEN N'V_IPADD'
									WHEN N'IPSRVGET'	THEN N'V_IPGET'
									WHEN N'IPSRVITM'	THEN N'V_IPITEM'
									WHEN N'DISCVURL'	THEN N'V_DISCVURL'
									WHEN N'DOCURL'		THEN N'V_DOCURL'
									WHEN N'LINKIMG'		THEN N'V_LINKIMG'
									WHEN N'WFLOWURL'	THEN N'V_WFLOWURL'
									WHEN N'IPSRVAVL'	THEN N'V_IPSRVAVL'
									WHEN N'IPSRVBIC'	THEN N'V_IPSRVBIC'
									WHEN N'IPSRVBIR'	THEN N'V_IPSRVBIR'
									WHEN N'IPSRVBPO'	THEN N'V_IPSRVBPO'
									WHEN N'IPSRVCPO'	THEN N'V_IPSRVCPO'
									WHEN N'IPSRVRTN'	THEN N'V_IPSRVRTN'
									WHEN N'BARPURL'		THEN N'V_BARPURL'
									WHEN N'BARLPSIP'	THEN N'V_BARLPSIP'
									WHEN N'REPSERV'		THEN N'V_REPSERV'
									ELSE N'@@ERROR@@' END

	if @sVariable = N'@@ERROR@@'
		set @sReturn = null
	else
		begin    
			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7GTPARAMS', @sVariable, @sReturn OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end

create procedure O7GTPARAMS_PACKAGE_INIT
as
	--This procedure will be called from all procs and funcs within
	--this package.  This is to simulate package initialization scripts in Oracle
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sInitHasRun	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn		int

begin
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7GTPARAMS', N'InitHasRun', @sInitHasRun OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sInitHasRun = N'false'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7GTPARAMS', N'V_BARURL', null
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7GTPARAMS', N'V_EXPURL', null

CREATE FUNCTION O7GTPMAN( @sPartCode 	nvarchar(30),
			  @sPartOrg  	nvarchar(15),
			  @sStore    	nvarchar(15),
			  @sControlOrg 	nvarchar(15),
			  @sUserId 	nvarchar(255),
			  @sRole 		nvarchar(30) = '*' )
returns nvarchar(24)
AS
BEGIN

    Declare 	@sManufacturer nvarchar(24)
    set @sManufacturer = null


   if @sStore is not null
   	begin
         SELECT @sManufacturer = sto_prefmanufacturer
            FROM r5stock, r5manufacturers, r5userorganization
            WHERE mfg_code = sto_prefmanufacturer
            AND   uog_user = @sUserId
            AND   uog_role = @sRole
            AND   uog_org = mfg_org
            AND   ( @sControlOrg IS NULL OR uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @sControlOrg )
            AND   sto_part = @sPartCode
            AND   sto_part_org = @sPartOrg
            AND   sto_store = @sStore

   		if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	          set @sManufacturer = null
   	end

   IF( @sManufacturer IS NULL )
      begin
         SELECT @sManufacturer = mfp_manufacturer
            FROM r5partmfgs, r5manufacturers, r5userorganization
            WHERE COALESCE( mfp_primary, N'-' ) = N'+'
            AND   mfp_part = @sPartCode
            AND   mfp_part_org = @sPartOrg
            AND   mfg_code = mfp_manufacturer
            AND   uog_user = @sUserId
            AND   uog_role = @sRole
            AND   uog_org = mfg_org
            AND   ( @sControlOrg IS NULL OR uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @sControlOrg )


   		if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
	          set @sManufacturer = null
   	end

   RETURN @sManufacturer

END

create function O7GTPNTF(	@sObject		nvarchar(30), 
										@sObjectorg		nvarchar(15), 
										@sObjectCategory	nvarchar(15))
returns nvarchar(1)
as
begin

	declare @sPointflag		nvarchar(1)
	set @sPointflag = '-'

	If not exists (SELECT 1	FROM   r5aspectpoints)
		set @sPointflag = N'-'
	else
		begin
			If not exists (SELECT 1
			FROM   r5aspectpoints
			WHERE  apo_object       = @sObject
			AND    apo_object_org   = @sObjectorg)
				begin
					IF @sObjectCategory IS NOT NULL 
						begin
							/* check if aspect point record is created for any equipemnt of same Category */
							if exists (SELECT 1
							FROM   r5aspectpoints
							WHERE  apo_object IN
													(SELECT obj_code
													FROM   r5objects
													WHERE  obj_category = @sObjectCategory )
							AND    apo_object_org = @sObjectorg )
								set @sPointflag = N'+'
						end
					else
						set @sPointflag = N'-'
				end
			else
				set @sPointflag = N'+'
		end

	return @sPointflag
end

create function O7GTPREC( @sNumericvalue    nvarchar(64),
                          @nPrecision       int,
                          @sSeparator       nvarchar(64) )
returns nvarchar(64)
as
	begin
        declare @nSeparatorposition int
        declare @nDecimalsused      int

        if @sNumericvalue is not null
            begin
                if coalesce( @nPrecision, 0 ) > 0
                    begin
                        set @nSeparatorposition = charindex( @sSeparator, @sNumericvalue )
                        set @nDecimalsused = len( @sNumericvalue ) - @nSeparatorposition
                        if @nDecimalsused < @nPrecision or @nSeparatorposition = 0
                            begin
                                if @nSeparatorposition = 0
                                    return ( @sNumericvalue + @sSeparator + dbo.F_RPAD( '0', @nPrecision, '0' ) )
                                else
                                    return( @sNumericvalue + dbo.F_RPAD( '0', @nPrecision - @nDecimalsused, '0') )
                            end
                    end
            end
        return @sNumericvalue
	end

create function O7GTREAD (  @sObject    nvarchar(30),

                            @dDatecomp  datetime )
returns numeric(30,6)

begin

	declare @nObjorgtz		numeric(4,1)
	declare @nWoorgtz		numeric(4,1)
	
  	SELECT @nObjorgtz = org_timezone
  	FROM   r5organization
  	WHERE  org_code = @sOrg;

  	FROM   r5organization

    FROM   r5readings
    WHERE  rea_object     = @sObject
    AND    rea_object_org = @sOrg

	return coalesce( @nResult, 0 )

create function O7GTRPQY(	 @sStore   nvarchar(15),
      @sPart    nvarchar(30),
      @sPartOrg nvarchar(15),
      @sBin     nvarchar(15),
      @sLot     nvarchar(12),
      @sEvent   nvarchar(30),
      @sReq     nvarchar(30),
      @nReqLine numeric(8,0) )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
    declare @nQty               numeric(24,6)
    declare @nOtherWOQty        numeric(24,6)
    declare @nOtherReqQty       numeric(24,6)


    -- Get the current repair quantity
    SELECT @nQty = coalesce(bis_repairqty, 0)
    FROM r5binstock
    WHERE bis_store = @sStore
    AND   bis_part = @sPart
    AND   bis_part_org = @sPartOrg
    AND   bis_bin = @sBin
    AND   bis_lot = @sLot
	IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
		set @nQty = 0

    IF( @nQty <= 0 )
        RETURN 0

    -- Now remove quantities that are assigned to other WOs
    SELECT @nOtherWOQty = SUM(rpb_qty)
    FROM r5repairbins, r5joblines, r5events
    WHERE rpb_store = @sStore
        AND   rpb_part = @sPart
        AND   rpb_part_org = @sPartOrg
        AND   rpb_bin = @sBin
        AND   rpb_lot = @sLot
        AND   coalesce(rpb_event, N'!@#$%') <> coalesce(@sEvent, N'%$#@!')
        AND   (coalesce(rpb_req, N'!@#$%') <> coalesce(@sReq, N'%$#@!')
        AND   coalesce(rpb_reqline, -1) <> coalesce(@nReqLine, -2))
        AND   jbl_event = rpb_event
        AND   jbl_part = rpb_part
        AND   jbl_part_org = rpb_part_org
        AND   coalesce(jbl_recvqty, 0) + coalesce(jbl_scrapqty, 0) < coalesce(jbl_qty, 0)
        AND   coalesce(jbl_active, N'-') = N'-'
        AND   evt_code = jbl_event
        AND   evt_rstatus <> N'C'

    set @nQty = @nQty - coalesce(@nOtherWOQty, 0)

    IF( @nQty <= 0 )
        RETURN 0

    -- Now remove quantities that are assigned to other Requisitions
    SELECT @nOtherReqQty = SUM(rpb_qty)
    FROM r5repairbins,
        r5orderlines left outer join r5orders on (ord_code = orl_order)
                     right outer join  r5requislines on (orl_req = rql_req AND   orl_reqline = rql_reqline)
    WHERE rpb_store = @sStore
        AND   rpb_part = @sPart
        AND   rpb_part_org = @sPartOrg
        AND   rpb_bin = @sBin
        AND   rpb_lot = @sLot
        AND   coalesce(rpb_event, N'!@#$%') <> coalesce(@sEvent, N'%$#@!')
        AND   (coalesce(rpb_req, N'!@#$%') <> coalesce(@sReq, N'%$#@!')
        OR    coalesce(rpb_reqline, -1) <> coalesce(@nReqLine, -2))
        AND   rql_req = rpb_req
        AND   rql_reqline = rpb_reqline
        AND   coalesce(rql_active, N'-') = N'+'
        AND   rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' )
        AND   coalesce(rql_recvqty, 0) + coalesce(rql_scrapqty, 0) < coalesce(rql_qty, 0)
        AND   coalesce(orl_rstatus, N'U') NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' )
        AND   coalesce(ord_rstatus, N'U') <> N'A'

    set @nQty = @nQty - coalesce(@nOtherReqQty, 0)

    IF( @nQty <= 0 )
        RETURN 0


    RETURN (@nQty)
end

create function O7GTTIME2(	 @sOrganization	nvarchar(15) )

as
begin
 	declare @sOrg		nvarchar(15) --r5organization.org_code%TYPE
 	declare @nTz		numeric(24,6)
 	declare @nCount		int
 	declare @sCode		nvarchar(6)
 	declare @dReturn	datetime
 	declare @dCurrDate	datetime
	
	if @sOrganization is null 
		begin
			set @sCode = N'DEFORG'
			set @sOrg = null

			select	@nCount = count(*)
			FROM	r5install  i
			WHERE	i.ins_code = @sCode

			if @nCount = 1
				select	@sOrg = i.ins_desc
				FROM	r5install  i
				WHERE	i.ins_code = @sCode
		end
	else
		set @sOrg = @sOrganization
	
	SELECT	@nTz = coalesce( org_timezone, 0 )
	FROM	r5organization
	WHERE	org_code = @sOrg

	select @dCurrDate = CurrDate from V_GETDATE

	set @dReturn = DATEADD( minute, coalesce( @nTz, 0) * 60, @dCurrDate )
	return  @dReturn
end

body:
CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7GTTXAM(   @sInvoice   nvarchar(45),
                                @sInvorg    nvarchar(15),
                                @nInvline   numeric(8,0),
                                @sInvorder  nvarchar(30),
                                @sInvrtype  nvarchar(4),
                                @nInvprice  numeric(24,6),
                                @nInvqty    numeric(24,6),
                                @sTaxcode1  nvarchar(20),
                                @sTaxcode2  nvarchar(20) )
returns numeric(24,6)
as 
    begin
        declare @dTaxdate           datetime
        declare @nTaxpercentage     numeric(24,6)
        declare @nTaxpercentage1    numeric(24,6)
        declare @nTaxpercentage2    numeric(24,6)
        declare @nTaxamount         numeric(24,6)
        declare @nGross             numeric(24,6)
        declare @nBase              numeric(24,6)
        declare @nTmp               numeric(24,6)

        declare @nEchDiscount       numeric(24,6)
        declare @nEchDiscPerc       numeric(5,2)
        declare @sEchRtype          nvarchar(4)
        declare @sEchCumulative     nvarchar(1)

        if @sTaxcode1 is not null
            begin
                SELECT @dTaxdate = ord_date
                FROM   r5orders
                WHERE  ord_code = @sInvorder
                AND    ord_org  = @sInvorg

                if @sInvrtype = N'SF'
                    set @nBase = coalesce(@nInvprice, 0)
                else
                    set @nBase = coalesce( @nInvqty, 0) * coalesce(@nInvprice, 0)

                set @nGross = @nBase

                declare c_ech cursor local for SELECT ech_discount,
                                                      ech_discperc,
                                                      ech_rtype,
                                                      ech_cumulative
                                               FROM   r5extcharges a
                                               WHERE  a.ech_invord_code = @sInvoice
                                               AND    a.ech_invord_org  = @sInvorg
                                               AND    a.ech_invord_line = @nInvline
                                               AND    a.ech_invord      = N'I'
                                               AND    a.ech_parprice    = N'+'
                                               AND    a.ech_rtype       = N'PRT'
                                               ORDER BY a.ech_code
                open c_ech
                fetch next from c_ech into @nEchDiscount, @nEchDiscPerc, @sEchRtype, @sEchCumulative
                while @@fetch_status = 0
                    begin
                        if @nEchDiscount is not null
                            set @nTmp = @nEchDiscount
                        else
                            begin
                                if @nEchDiscperc is not null 
                                    begin
                                        if @sEchCumulative = N'+'
                                            set @nTmp = round( @nGross * @nEchDiscperc / 100, 2)
                                        else
                                            set @nTmp = round( @nBase * @nEchDiscperc / 100, 2)
                                    end
                                else
                                    set @nTmp = 0
                            end

                        set @nGross = @nGross + @nTmp

                        fetch next from c_ech into @nEchDiscount, @nEchDiscPerc, @sEchRtype, @sEchCumulative
                    end
                close c_ech
                deallocate c_ech 

                SELECT @nTaxpercentage1 = SUM( d.txv_percent )
                FROM   r5taxes a, r5taxcoderates b, r5taxrates c, r5taxratevalues d
                WHERE  a.tax_code   =  b.tcr_tax
                AND    b.tcr_rate   =  c.txr_code
                AND    c.txr_code   =  d.txv_rate
                AND    a.tax_code   =  @sTaxcode1
                AND    d.txv_start <= @dTaxdate
                AND    d.txv_end   >= @dTaxdate
                AND    CASE SUBSTRING( @sInvrtype, 1, 1 ) WHEN N'S' THEN c.txr_includeservicetax ELSE c.txr_invcalc END <> N'-'
            end
        else
            return 0

        if @sTaxCode2 is not null
            SELECT @nTaxpercentage2 = SUM( d.txv_percent )
            FROM   r5taxes a, r5taxcoderates b, r5taxrates c, r5taxratevalues d
            WHERE  a.tax_code   =  b.tcr_tax
            AND    b.tcr_rate   =  c.txr_code
            AND    c.txr_code   =  d.txv_rate
            AND    a.tax_code   =  @sTaxCode2
            AND    d.txv_start <= @dTaxdate
            AND    d.txv_end   >= @dTaxdate
            AND    CASE SUBSTRING( @sInvrtype, 1, 1 ) WHEN N'S' THEN c.txr_includeservicetax ELSE c.txr_invcalc END <> N'-'

        set @nTaxpercentage = coalesce( @nTaxpercentage1, 0) + coalesce( @nTaxpercentage2, 0)

        set @nTaxamount = round( @nGross * @nTaxpercentage / 100, 2)

        return coalesce( @nTaxamount, 0 )
    end

create function O7HASH(	@sStr	nvarchar(MAX), @sUserID nvarchar(255) )
returns nvarchar(200)
as
begin
	declare @nCount			NUMERIC
	declare @nSum   		NUMERIC
	declare @nASCII  		NUMERIC
	declare @sHash			nvarchar(200)
	declare @nCounter		NUMERIC

	set @nSum = 0
	SELECT @nCounter = 1
	WHILE (@nCounter < LEN(@sStr) + 1)
		begin
			set @nASCII = ASCII(SUBSTRING(@sStr, @nCounter, 1))
			set @nSum = @nSum + (@nASCII * @nCounter )
			SELECT @nCounter = @nCounter +1
		end
		set @sHash = dbo.o7enrhas(@sUserID, cast(@nSum as nvarchar ))

	return ( @sHash )
end

create procedure O7IBCALC	@sLocation	nvarchar(30),
							@sMrc		nvarchar(15),
							@sClass		nvarchar(8),
							@sCategory	nvarchar(30),
							@sObject	nvarchar(30),
							@sOrg		nvarchar(15),
							@sUser		nvarchar(255),
							@sAllobj	nvarchar(1),
							@nSessionid	int
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sFormula		nvarchar(8)		--r5minmaxformparam.fop_formula%TYPE
	declare @sValue			nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sParam			nvarchar(100)
	declare @nFirst			int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sStatement		nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sFormu			nvarchar(2000)
	declare @sFopuom		nvarchar(30)	--r5minmaxformparam.fop_uom%TYPE
	declare @sMmpuom		nvarchar(30)	--r5minmaxparameters.mmp_uom%TYPE
	declare @nResult		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nConv			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPos			int
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nTabptr		int

	declare @sObjcode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjorg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sObjaspect		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjpoint		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjpointtype	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjminformula	nvarchar(8)
	declare @sObjmaxformula	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nObjmin		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nObjmax		numeric(24,6)

	declare @nJ				int
	declare @nError			int
	declare @nRowcount		int
	declare @sSql			nvarchar(2000)

	declare c_obj cursor local for SELECT	obj_code,
											obj_org,
											apo_aspect,
											apo_point,
											apo_pointtype,
											apo_minformula,
											apo_maxformula,
											apo_min,
											apo_max
									FROM	r5aspectpoints,
											r5objects
									WHERE  apo_object     = obj_code
									AND    apo_object_org = obj_org
									AND    obj_code LIKE @sObject
									AND    obj_org  LIKE @sOrg
									AND    obj_mrc  LIKE @sMrc
									AND    isnull( obj_class, N'%' )    LIKE @sClass
									AND    isnull( obj_category, N'%' ) LIKE @sCategory
									AND    isnull( obj_location, N'%' ) LIKE @sLocation
									AND    obj_obrtype <> N'C'
									AND  ( apo_minformula IS NOT NULL or apo_maxformula IS NOT NULL )
									UNION
									SELECT	obj_code,
											obj_org,
											apo_aspect,
											apo_point,
											apo_pointtype,
											apo_minformula,
											apo_maxformula,
											apo_min,
											apo_max
									FROM	r5aspectpoints,
									        r5objects
									WHERE  apo_object     = obj_code
									AND    apo_object_org = obj_org
									AND    obj_code LIKE @sCategory
									AND    obj_org  LIKE @sOrg
									AND    isnull( obj_class, N'%' ) LIKE @sClass
									AND    obj_obrtype = N'C'
									AND  ( apo_minformula IS NOT NULL OR apo_maxformula IS NOT NULL )
									UNION
									SELECT	apo_object,
											apo_object_org,
											apo_aspect,
											apo_point,
											apo_pointtype,
											apo_minformula,
											apo_maxformula,
											apo_min,
											apo_max
									FROM	r5aspectpoints,
											r5inspectequipdata
									WHERE  @sAllobj         = N'+'
									AND    apo_object     = ied_object
									AND    apo_object_org = ied_object_org
									AND    ied_changed    = N'+' 
	open c_obj
	fetch next from c_obj into @sObjcode, @sObjorg, @sObjaspect, @sObjpoint, @sObjpointtype, 
								@sObjminformula, @sObjmaxformula, @nObjmin, @nObjmax
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			set @sChk = null
			set @nJ = 1
			while @nJ < 3
				begin
					if @nJ = 1
						set @sFormula = @sObjminformula
					else
						set @sFormula = @sObjmaxformula

					if @sFormula is not null
						begin
							SELECT @sFormu = mmf_formula
							FROM   r5minmaxformulas
							WHERE  mmf_code = @sFormula

							set @sValue = @sFormu

							while charindex( N'$', @sValue ) > 0
								begin
									set @nPos = charindex( N'$', @sValue )
									set @sValue = substring( @sValue, @nPos + 1, len(@sValue) )
									if len( @sValue ) > 0
										begin
											set	@nFirst = 
													dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( CASE charindex( N' ', @sValue ) WHEN 0 THEN 1000 ELSE charindex( N' ', @sValue ) END,													
													dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( CASE charindex( N')', @sValue ) WHEN 0 THEN 1000 ELSE charindex( N')', @sValue ) END,													
													dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( CASE charindex( N'+', @sValue ) WHEN 0 THEN 1000 ELSE charindex( N'+', @sValue ) END,													
													dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( CASE charindex( N'-', @sValue ) WHEN 0 THEN 1000 ELSE charindex( N'-', @sValue ) END,													
													dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( CASE charindex( N'/', @sValue ) WHEN 0 THEN 1000 ELSE charindex( N'/', @sValue ) END,
																		CASE charindex( N'*', @sValue ) WHEN 0 THEN 1000 ELSE charindex( N'*', @sValue ) END ) ) ) ) )
											set @sParam = substring( @sValue, 1, @nFirst - 1 )
											set @sStatement = null
											set @nResult = null

											SELECT @sFopuom = fop_uom, @sMmpuom = mmp_uom, @sStatement = mmp_statement
											FROM   r5minmaxparameters,
												   r5minmaxformparam
											WHERE  fop_parameter = mmp_code
											AND    fop_parameter = @sParam
											AND    fop_formula   = @sFormula
											if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
												set @sChk = N'1'

											if @sStatement is not null 
												begin
													set @sStatement = replace( @sStatement, N':OBJECTORG', @sObjorg )
													set @sStatement = replace( @sStatement, N':OBJECT', @sObjcode )
													set @sStatement = replace( @sStatement, N':ASPECT', @sObjaspect )
													set @sStatement = replace( @sStatement, N':POINT', @sObjpoint )
													set @sStatement = replace( @sStatement, N':POINTTYPE', @sObjpointtype )
													
													--dbms function call here
													set @sStatement = stuff( @sStatement, 1, 7, N'select @nResult = ')
													execute sp_executesql @sStatement, N'@nResult numeric(24,6) OUTPUT', @nResult OUTPUT
													select @nError = @@ERROR, @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
													if @nError <> 0
														set @sChk = N'4'
													else
														begin
															if @nRowcount = 0
																set @sChk = N'3'
														end

													if @sFopuom <> @sMmpuom
														begin
															set @nConv = null
															SELECT @nConv = isnull( uoc_confact, 1 )
															FROM   r5uomconversion
															WHERE  uoc_baseuom = @sFopuom
															AND    uoc_siteuom = @sMmpuom

															if @nConv is not null
																set @nResult = @nResult * @nConv
														end
													set @sFormu = replace( @sFormu, N'$' + @sParam, cast(@nResult as nvarchar) )
												end
											else
												set @sChk = N'2'
										end
								end
							--dbms function call here
							set @sSql = N'select @nResult = ' + @sFormu
							execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nResult numeric(24,6) OUTPUT', @nResult OUTPUT
							select @nError = @@ERROR, @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT
							if @nError <> 0
								set @sChk = N'4'
							else
								begin
									if @nRowcount = 0
										set @sChk = N'3'
								end

							if @nResult is not null
								begin
									UPDATE r5aspectpoints
									SET    apo_min        = CASE @nJ WHEN 1 THEN @nResult ELSE apo_min END,
										   apo_max        = CASE @nJ WHEN 2 THEN @nResult ELSE apo_max END
									WHERE  apo_object     = @sObjcode
									AND    apo_object_org = @sObjorg
									AND    apo_aspect     = @sObjaspect
									AND    apo_point      = @sObjpoint
									AND    apo_pointtype  = @sObjpointtype
									if @@ERROR <> 0
										set @sChk = N'5'

									UPDATE r5eventpoints
									SET    epo_min        = CASE @nJ WHEN 1 THEN @nResult ELSE epo_min END,
										   epo_max        = CASE @nJ WHEN 2 THEN @nResult ELSE epo_max END
									WHERE  epo_object     = @sObjcode
									AND    epo_object_org = @sObjorg
									AND    epo_aspect     = @sObjaspect
									AND    epo_point      = @sObjpoin

name: O7INMLP1
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7INMLP1
    @sCreflist       nvarchar(20),
    @nCreflistrev    int,
    @sCtmplist       nvarchar(20),
    @nCtmplistrev    int,
    @sCobject        nvarchar(30),
    @sCobjectorg     nvarchar(15),
    @sCobrtype       nvarchar(4),
    @sCeventno       nvarchar(30),
    @nNactno         int,
    @sChk            nvarchar(5)  OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sIo_cobtype       nvarchar(4)     /*  r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE;  */
    declare @sIo_cobrtype      nvarchar(4)     /*  r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE; */
    declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
    declare @nNmlpline         int
	declare @nReturn		   int
	/*  cursor  variable  */
	declare @nMlp_line 		int
    declare @sMlp_part 		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlp_part_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nMlp_qty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sMlp_uom		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlp_crit		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMlp_reserv	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMlp_code		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlp_code_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sMlp_obrtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sMlp_obtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sMlp_equipfilter nvarchar(500)

	declare @sEntcode nvarchar(40)

	/* Initialize */
    set @sCheckresult       = N'0'
    set @sIo_cobrtype       = @sCobrtype
    set @sIo_cobtype        = NULL
	/* Check mandatory parameters: lists */
    IF @sCreflist    IS NULL
    OR @nCreflistrev IS NULL
    OR @sCtmplist    IS NULL
    OR @nCtmplistrev IS NULL
    OR @sCeventno    IS NULL
    OR @nNactno      IS NULL
	begin
      set @sChk = N'1'
      RETURN
    end
	/* Check mandatory parameters: object and type must be both filled or both null */
    IF ( @sCobrtype IS NOT NULL  AND @sCobject IS     NULL ) OR
       ( @sCobrtype IS     NULL  AND @sCobject IS NOT NULL )
    begin
     	set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
	/*  Object type must exist; check  by  getting type */
    IF  @sCobrtype IS NOT NULL
    begin
    	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE  @sIo_cobrtype OUTPUT, @sIo_cobtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    	IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
    	begin
      		set @sChk = N'2'
      		RETURN
    	end
   	end
	/* insert */

	DECLARE cCmlp CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT m.mlp_line,
	       m.mlp_part,
	       m.mlp_part_org,
	       m.mlp_qty,
	       m.mlp_uom,
	       m.mlp_crit,
	       m.mlp_reserv,
	       m.mlp_code,
	       m.mlp_code_org,
	       m.mlp_obrtype,
	       m.mlp_obtype,
	       m.mlp_equipfilter
	FROM   r5matlparts m, r5objects
	WHERE  m.mlp_matlist  = @sCreflist
	AND    m.mlp_matlrev  = @nCreflistrev
	AND    obj_code    = @sCobject
	AND    obj_org     = @sCobjectorg
	AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, obj_checklistfilter ) = N'+'
	AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
	                    FROM   r5matlparts s
	                    WHERE  s.mlp_matlist  = @sCtmplist
	                    AND    s.mlp_matlrev  = @nCtmplistrev
	                    AND    s.mlp_part     = m.mlp_part
	                    AND    s.mlp_part_org = m.mlp_part_org )
	AND   (        m.mlp_code    IS NULL
	       OR (    m.mlp_code     = @sCobject
	           AND m.mlp_code_org = @sCobjectorg
	           AND m.mlp_obrtype  = @sCobrtype
	          )
	       OR (      m.mlp_code    = (      SELECT o.obj_category
	                                        FROM   r5objects o
	                                        WHERE  o.obj_code    = @sCobject
	                                        AND    o.obj_org     = @sCobjectorg
	                                        AND    o.obj_obrtype = @sCobrtype
	                                  )
	            AND  m.mlp_obrtype = N'C'
	           )
	       )

	OPEN cCmlp
	FETCH NEXT FROM cCmlp INTO @nMlp_line, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org, @nMlp_qty, @sMlp_uom, @sMlp_crit,
								@sMlp_reserv, @sMlp_code, @sMlp_code_org, @sMlp_obrtype, @sMlp_obtype, @sMlp_equipfilter
	/* get highest line number */
      -- #6002 Use install parameter INCRLINO for line number step size
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
		set @sEntcode = @sCtmplist + N'#' + cast( @nCtmplistrev as nvarchar(38) )
        execute @nReturn =   O7NEWLINE 
					          N'MATL',
					          @sEntcode,
					          N'1',
					          NULL,
					          NULL,
					          @sCheckresult OUTPUT,
					          @nNmlpline OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			BEGIN
			    CLOSE cCmlp
			    DEALLOCATE cCmlp
			    return -1
			END
        IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
		begin
        	set @sChk = N'3'
			CLOSE cCmlp
			DEALLOCATE cCmlp
        	RETURN
      	end

     	INSERT INTO r5matlparts
     	(  mlp_matlist,
        mlp_matlrev,
        mlp_line,
        mlp_part,
        mlp_part_org,
        mlp_qty,
        mlp_uom,
        mlp_crit,
        mlp_reserv,
        mlp_code,
        mlp_code_org,
        mlp_obrtype,
        mlp_obtype,
        mlp_equipfilter
        )
     	VALUES
        (
        @sCtmplist,
        @nCtmplistrev,
        @nNmlpline,
        @sMlp_part,
        @sMlp_part_org,
        @nMlp_qty,
        @sMlp_uom,
        @sMlp_crit,
        @sMlp_reserv,
        @sMlp_code,
        @sMlp_code_org,
        @sMlp_obrtype,
        @sMlp_obtype,
        @sMlp_equipfilter
        )
        IF @sMlp_reserv = N'+'     /* make reservation */
	 	begin
			IF (substring(@sCtmplist,1,2) != N'V-') 
				begin
        			execute @nReturn = O7INSRES 	@sCeventno, @nNactno, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org,
                   									@nMlp_qty, 0, @sMlp_crit, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							CLOSE cCmlp
							DEALLOCATE cCmlp
							return -1
						end
        			set @sChk = N'0'
				end
     	end 
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCmlp INTO @nMlp_line, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org, @nMlp_qty, @sMlp_uom, @sMlp_crit,
								   @sMlp_reserv, @sMlp_code, @sMlp_code_org, @sMlp_obrtype, @sMlp_obtype, @sMlp_equipfilter   
	end 
	CLOSE cCmlp
	DEALLOCATE cCmlp


-- ========================================

CREATE PROCEDURE O7INMLP2

	/* Check mandatory parameters: lists */

    	IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'

	DECLARE cCmlp CURSOR LOCAL FOR

	                    AND    s.mlp_part     = m.mlp_part
	                    AND    s.mlp_part_org = m.mlp_part_org )
	AND   (        m.mlp_code    IS NULL
	       OR (    m.mlp_code     = @sCobject
	           AND m.mlp_code_org = @sCobjectorg
	           AND m.mlp_obrtype  = @sCobrtype
	          )
	       OR (      m.mlp_code    = (      SELECT o.obj_category
	                                        FROM   r5objects o
	                                        WHERE  o.obj_code    = @sCobject
	                                        AND    o.obj_org     = @sCobjectorg
	                                        AND    o.obj_obrtype = @sCobrtype
	                                  )
	            AND  m.mlp_obrtype = N'C'
	           )
	       )

	/* insert */
	OPEN cCmlp
	FETCH NEXT FROM cCmlp INTO @nMlp_line, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org, @nMlp_qty, @sMlp_uom, @sMlp_crit,
								@sMlp_reserv, @sMlp_code, @sMlp_code_org, @sMlp_obrtype, @sMlp_obtype, @sMlp_equipfilter   
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
     	INSERT INTO r5matlparts
     	(  mlp_matlist,
        mlp_matlrev,
        mlp_line,
        mlp_part,
        mlp_part_org,
        mlp_qty,
        mlp_uom,
        mlp_crit,
        mlp_reserv,
        mlp_code,
        mlp_code_org,
        mlp_obrtype,
        mlp_obtype,
        mlp_equipfilter
        )
     	VALUES
        (
        @sCtmplist,
        @nCtmplistrev,
        @nMlp_line,
        @sMlp_part,
        @sMlp_part_org,
        @nMlp_qty,
        @sMlp_uom,
        @sMlp_crit,
        @sMlp_reserv,
        @sMlp_code,
        @sMlp_code_org,
        @sMlp_obrtype,
        @sMlp_obtype,
        @sMlp_equipfilter
        )
        IF @sMlp_reserv = N'+'     /* make reservation */
	 	begin
			IF substring(@sCtmplist,1,2) != N'V-'
				begin
        			execute @nReturn = O7INSRES 	@sCeventno, @nNactno, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org,
                   									@nMlp_qty, 0, @sMlp_crit, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										BEGIN
										CLOSE cCmlp
										DEALLOCATE cCmlp
						return -1
										END
        			set @sChk = N'0'
				end
     	end 
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCmlp INTO @nMlp_line, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org, @nMlp_qty, @sMlp_uom, @sMlp_crit,
								   @sMlp_reserv, @sMlp_code, @sMlp_code_org, @sMlp_obrtype, @sMlp_obtype, @sMlp_equipfilter   
	end 
	CLOSE cCmlp
	DEALLOCATE cCmlp
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7INMLP3
    @sCreflist       nvarchar(20),
    @nCreflistrev    int,
    @sCtmplist       nvarchar(20),
    @nCtmplistrev    int,
    @sCobject        nvarchar(30),
    @sCobjectorg     nvarchar(15),
    @sCobrtype       nvarchar(4),
    @sChk            nvarchar(5)  OUTPUT 
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sIo_cobtype       nvarchar(4)     /*  r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE;  */
    declare @sIo_cobrtype      nvarchar(4)     /*  r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE; */
    declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		   int
	/*  cursor  variable  */
	declare @nMlp_line 		int
    declare @sMlp_part 		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlp_part_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nMlp_qty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sMlp_uom		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlp_crit		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMlp_reserv	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMlp_code		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sMlp_code_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sMlp_obrtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sMlp_obtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sMlp_direct	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMlp_equipfilter nvarchar(500)
	/* Initialize */
    set @sCheckresult       = N'0'
    set @sIo_cobrtype       = @sCobrtype
    set @sIo_cobtype        = NULL
	/* Check mandatory parameters: lists */
    IF @sCreflist    IS NULL
    OR @nCreflistrev IS NULL
    OR @sCtmplist    IS NULL
    OR @nCtmplistrev IS NULL
	begin
      	set @sChk = N'1'
      	RETURN
    end
	/* Check mandatory parameters: object and type must be both filled or both null */
    IF ( @sCobrtype IS NOT NULL  AND @sCobject IS     NULL ) OR
       ( @sCobrtype IS     NULL  AND @sCobject IS NOT NULL )
    begin
     	set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    end
	/*  Object type must exist; check  by  getting type */
    IF  @sCobrtype IS NOT NULL
    begin
    	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE  @sIo_cobrtype OUTPUT, @sIo_cobtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
    	IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
    	begin
      		set @sChk = N'2'
      		RETURN
    	end
   	end

	DECLARE cCmlp CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT m.mlp_line,
	       m.mlp_part,
	       m.mlp_part_org,
	       m.mlp_qty,
	       m.mlp_uom,
	       m.mlp_crit,
	       m.mlp_reserv,
	       m.mlp_code,
	       m.mlp_code_org,
	       m.mlp_obrtype,
	       m.mlp_obtype,
	       m.mlp_direct,
	       m.mlp_equipfilter
	       
	FROM   r5matlparts m, r5objects
	WHERE  m.mlp_matlist  = @sCreflist
	AND    m.mlp_matlrev  = @nCreflistrev
	AND    obj_code    = @sCobject
	AND    obj_org     = @sCobjectorg
	AND    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, obj_checklistfilter ) = N'+'
	AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
	                    FROM   r5matlparts s
	                    WHERE  s.mlp_matlist  = @sCtmplist
	                    AND    s.mlp_matlrev  = @nCtmplistrev
	                    AND    s.mlp_part     = m.mlp_part
	                    AND    s.mlp_part_org = m.mlp_part_org )
	AND   (        m.mlp_code    IS NULL
	       OR (    m.mlp_code     = @sCobject
	           AND m.mlp_code_org = @sCobjectorg
	           AND m.mlp_obrtype  = @sCobrtype
	          )
	       OR (      m.mlp_code    = (      SELECT o.obj_category
	                                        FROM   r5objects o
	                                        WHERE  o.obj_code    = @sCobject
	                                        AND    o.obj_org     = @sCobjectorg
	                                        AND    o.obj_obrtype = @sCobrtype
	                                  )
	            AND  m.mlp_obrtype = N'C'
	           )
	       )

	/* insert */
	OPEN cCmlp
	FETCH NEXT FROM cCmlp INTO @nMlp_line, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org, @nMlp_qty, @sMlp_uom, @sMlp_crit,
								@sMlp_reserv, @sMlp_code, @sMlp_code_org, @sMlp_obrtype, @sMlp_obtype, @sMlp_direct, @sMlp_equipfilter   
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin
     	INSERT INTO r5matlparts
     	(  mlp_matlist,
        mlp_matlrev,
        mlp_line,
        mlp_part,
        mlp_part_org,
        mlp_qty,
        mlp_uom,
        mlp_crit,
        mlp_reserv,
        mlp_code,
        mlp_code_org,
        mlp_obrtype,
        mlp_obtype,
		mlp_direct,
		mlp_equipfilter
        )
     	VALUES
        (
        @sCtmplist,
        @nCtmplistrev,
        @nMlp_line,
        @sMlp_part,
        @sMlp_part_org,
        @nMlp_qty,
        @sMlp_uom,
        @sMlp_crit,
        @sMlp_reserv,
        @sMlp_code,
        @sMlp_code_org,
        @sMlp_obrtype,
        @sMlp_obtype,
		@sMlp_direct,
		@sMlp_equipfilter
        )
		FETCH NEXT FROM cCmlp INTO @nMlp_line, @sMlp_part, @sMlp_part_org, @nMlp_qty, @sMlp_uom, @sMlp_crit,
								   @sMlp_reserv, @sMlp_code, @sMlp_code_org, @sMlp_obrtype, @sMlp_obtype, @sMlp_direct, @sMlp_equipfilter   
	end 
	CLOSE cCmlp
	DEALLOCATE cCmlp
END

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7INMTL1
	@sTmplist		nvarchar(30),
	@sEvent			nvarchar(30),
	@nAct			numeric(8),
	@sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
	declare @nMtl			integer
	declare @sUstat			nvarchar(8)		
	declare @sEvntorg		nvarchar(15)	
	declare @sChk2			nvarchar(3)
	declare @nReturn		integer
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @nMtl = NULL

	IF   @sTmplist   IS NULL
	OR   @nAct       IS NULL
	OR   @sEvent     IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	if dbo.o7getmos( N'EVNT' ) = N'+' AND dbo.o7getmos( N'MATL' ) = N'-' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sEvntorg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk2 OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end
	ELSE
		SELECT @sEvntorg = evt_org
		FROM   r5events
		WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent


	SELECT @nMtl = COUNT(*)
	FROM   r5matlists
	WHERE  mtl_code = @sTmplist
	if @@ERROR <> 0 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

	if @nMtl = 0 
		begin

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUstat OUTPUT, N'A', N'RCST', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			INSERT INTO r5matlists ( mtl_act,
				mtl_event,
				mtl_revrstatus,
				mtl_revstatus,
				mtl_code,
				mtl_org,
				mtl_desc,
				mtl_class )
			VALUES(      @nAct,
				@sEvent,
				N'A',
				@sUstat,
				@sTmplist,
				@sEvntorg,
				N'-',
				NULL )
		end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7INQR @sRfqcode   nvarchar(30),
                            @sRfqorg    nvarchar(15),
                            @nQuotfrom  int OUTPUT,
                            @nQuotto    int OUTPUT,
                            @sChk       nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sQuotid        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sQuotstatus    nvarchar(4)
    declare @sLinestatus    nvarchar(4)
    declare @sTchk          nvarchar(3)
    declare @nQuotline      numeric(8)

    declare @nRfqline       numeric(8)
    declare @sPart          nvarchar(30)
    declare @sPartorg       nvarchar(15)
    declare @dDuedate       datetime
    declare @nReqqty        numeric(24,6)
    declare @nTaskqty       numeric(24,6)
    declare @sRfqtype       nvarchar(4)
    declare @sRtype         nvarchar(4)
    declare @sUom           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTask          nvarchar(20)
    declare @sTrade         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sQuotdesc      nvarchar(200)

    declare @nPurqty        numeric(24,6)
    declare @nConfact       numeric(10,4)
    declare @sTax           nvarchar(20)
    declare @sSupcatref     nvarchar(50)
    declare @nLeadtime      numeric(4,1)
    declare @sPuruom        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSummarized    nvarchar(1)

    declare @nQuotcount     int
    declare @nPdcount       int
    declare @nPscount       int
    declare @nSumrowcount   int
    declare @nIncr          int

    declare @sCurRfqCode            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCurRfqOrg             nvarchar(15)
    declare @sCurRfqDesc            nvarchar(80)
    declare @sCurRfqStatus          nvarchar(4)
    declare @sCurRfqRequestedby     nvarchar(15)
    declare @dCurRfqResponsedue     datetime
    declare @sCurRfqResponseopt     nvarchar(1)
    declare @sCurRfqSupplier        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCurRfqSupplier_org    nvarchar(15)
    declare @sCurComCurr            nvarchar(3)
    declare @nCurExchrate           numeric(24,12)
    declare @sCurNotUsed            nvarchar(1)

    declare @nPartlinecount         int
    declare @nServicelinecount      int

    declare @nReturn                int

    set @nQuotline = 0
    set @nQuotcount = 0
    set @nPdcount = 0
    set @nPscount = 0
    set @nSumrowcount = 0

    if @sRfqcode is null or @sRfqorg is null
        begin
            set @sChk = N'1'
            return
        end

    set @sChk = N'0'

    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @sQuotstatus OUTPUT, N'U', N'RRST', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    set @nIncr = coalesce( cast( dbo.o7dflt2( N'INCRLINO') as int ), 10 )
    if @nIncr = 0
        begin
            set @nIncr = 10
        end

    declare c_rfq cursor local for SELECT  rfq_code,
                                           rfq_org,
                                           rfq_desc,
                                           rfq_status,
                                           rfq_requestedby,
                                           rfq_responsedue,
                                           rfq_responseopt,
                                           rfs_supplier,
                                           rfs_supplier_org,
                                           com_curr,
                                           dbo.o7gtexch2(com_curr, rfq_org, dbo.o7gttime2(rfq_org)) as exchrate,
                                           cur_notused currnotused
                                    FROM   r5rfquotations, r5rfqsuppliers, r5companies,  r5currencies
                                    WHERE  rfq_code = @sRfqcode
                                       AND rfq_org = @sRfqorg
                                       AND rfq_code = rfs_code
                                       AND rfq_org = rfs_org
                                       AND rfs_supplier = com_code
                                       AND rfs_supplier_org = com_org
                                       AND com_curr = cur_code
                                    ORDER BY rfs_supplier, rfs_supplier_org
        
    open c_rfq
    fetch next from c_rfq into @sCurRfqCode, @sCurRfqOrg, @sQuotdesc, @sCurRfqStatus, @sCurRfqRequestedby, 
                               @dCurRfqResponsedue, @sCurRfqResponseopt, @sCurRfqSupplier, 
                               @sCurRfqSupplier_org, @sCurComCurr, @nCurExchrate, @sCurNotUsed
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        begin

            if @nCurExchrate is null OR @sCurNotUsed = '+'
                begin
                    set @sChk = N'2'
                    return
                end

            execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sQuotid OUTPUT, N'RFR', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_rfq
                    deallocate c_rfq
                    return -1
                end

            set @nPartlinecount = 0
            set @nServicelinecount = 0

            if @nQuotcount = 0
                begin
                    set @nQuotfrom = @sQuotid
                end

            INSERT INTO r5rfqresponses (    rfr_quotid,
                                            rfr_code,
                                            rfr_org,
                                            rfr_supplier,
                                            rfr_supplier_org,
                                            rfr_desc,
                                            rfr_status,
                                            rfr_rstatus,
                                            rfr_curr )
                            VALUES      (   @sQuotid,
                                            @sCurRfqCode,
                                            @sCurRfqOrg,
                                            @sCurRfqSupplier,
                                            @sCurRfqSupplier_org,
                                            @sQuotdesc,
                                            @sQuotstatus,
                                            N'U',
                                            @sCurComCurr ) 

            set @nQuotline = 0

            execute r5o7_o7ucode @sLinestatus OUTPUT, N'U', N'REST', @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                begin
                    close c_rfq
                    deallocate c_rfq
                    return -1
                end

            if @sCurRfqResponseopt = N'I'
                begin
                    set @sSummarized = N'-'
                    declare c_parts cursor local for SELECT rli_part,
                                                            rli_part_org,
                                                            rli_rfqline,
                                                            rli_qty,
                                                            rli_type,
                                                            rli_rtype,
                                                            rli_uom,
                                                            coalesce(cat_tax, par_tax),
                                                            cat_ref,
                                                            cat_leadtime,
                                                            coalesce(cat_multiply, 1),
                                                            coalesce(cat_puruom, rli_uom)
                                                      FROM   r5parts, r5rfqlines LEFT OUTER JOIN r5catalogue ON (rli_part = cat_part 
                                                                                                             AND rli_part_org = cat_part_org 
                                                                                                             AND cat_supplier = @sCurRfqSupplier

CREATE PROCEDURE O7INSACP(
    @sCyear        nvarchar(8),
    @sCcal         nvarchar(2),
    @dDstart       datetime,
    @dDend         datetime,
    @sChk          nvarchar(5)  OUTPUT)
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @dDperstart    datetime
    declare @dDperend      datetime
    declare @nNperiods     numeric(2,0) 
    declare @nNperlen      numeric(38,12) 
    declare @sCheckresult  nvarchar( 4 )
    declare @nCountit      int
    declare @sX            nvarchar( 100 )
	declare @ni			   int

	/* Initialise */
    set @sChk          = N'0' 
    set @sCheckresult  = N'0' 
    set @nCountit      = 0
	set @ni			   = 1
	/* check mandatory parameters */
    IF  @sCyear  IS NULL OR
        @dDstart IS NULL OR
        @dDend   IS NULL
	BEGIN
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
    END
	/* Get number of periods of calendar. */
    BEGIN
        SELECT @nNperiods = isnull( cal_periods, 1 )
        FROM   r5calendars
        WHERE  cal_code = @sCcal
		if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
			set @nNperiods = 1
    END
    set @nNperlen   =  ( DATEDIFF( mi, @dDstart, @dDend )/1440 + 1 ) / @nNperiods
    set @dDperstart = @dDstart
	WHILE ((@ni>= 1  AND @ni<= @nNperiods))
	BEGIN
        IF @ni= @nNperiods 
            set @dDperend = @dDend
        ELSE
		BEGIN
            IF @nNperlen BETWEEN  29 AND  31 
                set @dDperend = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDstart, @ni ) - 1
            ELSE IF @nNperlen BETWEEN  89 AND  93 
				set @dDperend = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDstart, @ni* 3 ) - 1
          	ELSE IF @nNperlen BETWEEN 363 AND 367 
				set @dDperend = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dDstart, @ni* 12 ) - 1
          	ELSE
				set @dDperend = cast(ROUND( cast(@dDstart as numeric(38,12))  + ( @ni * ( DATEDIFF( mi, @dDstart, @dDend )/1440 + 1 ) / @nNperiods )  - 1 ,0) as datetime)

        END


        INSERT INTO r5periods ( acp_year,
                               acp_period,
                               acp_seqno,
                               acp_start,
                               acp_end )
        VALUES ( @sCyear,
                cast( @ni as nvarchar(8) ),
                @ni,
               @dDperstart,
                @dDperend )
        set @dDperstart = @dDperend + 1
		set @ni = @ni + 1 
	END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE  O7INSINT
	@sAction				nvarchar(30),
	@sTable					nvarchar(32),
	@sKeyfld1				nvarchar(80),
	@sKeyfld2				nvarchar(80),
	@sKeyfld3				nvarchar(80),
	@nTransorgid			bigint,
	@nGroup					integer,
	@sKeyflddate1			datetime,
	@sKeyflddate2			datetime,
	@sChk					nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nQueue			integer
	declare @nMaxqueues		integer
	declare @nTransid		bigint
	declare @sMsg			nvarchar(240) 
	declare @dTempDate		datetime
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @nReturn		integer
    declare @sTemp          nvarchar(64)

	set @sChk = N'0'

	select @sTemp = ins_desc
	FROM r5install
	WHERE ins_code = N'~QUEUES~'

	if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 or ( @sTemp is not null and isnumeric(@sTemp) = 0 ) 
		set @nMaxqueues = 1
    else
        set @nMaxqueues = cast( convert( numeric, @sTemp ) as int )

	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM r5interface
	WHERE int_transorgid = @nTransorgid

	if @nCount > 0 		
		SELECT @nQueue =int_queue
		FROM r5interface
		WHERE int_transorgid = @nTransorgid
	else
		set @nQueue = null

  IF @nQueue IS NULL  
	begin
		IF @nMaxqueues > 1  AND
			@sTable     in (N'R5TRACKINGDATA'
							,N'R5OBJECTSINTERFACE'
							,N'R5TRANSINTERFACE'
							,N'R5BOOKEDHOURSINTERFACE'
							,N'R5EVENTSINTERFACE')  
			begin
				while @nQueue > @nMaxqueues 
					begin
						execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nQueue OUTPUT, N'QUEUE', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
					end
			end
		ELSE
			begin
				IF @sTable in (N'R5TRACKINGDATA'
								,N'R5OBJECTSINTERFACE'
								,N'R5TRANSINTERFACE'
								,N'R5BOOKEDHOURSINTERFACE'
								,N'R5EVENTSINTERFACE')  
					set @nQueue = 1

				ELSE
					set @nQueue = null
			end
	end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nTransid OUTPUT, N'INTERFACE', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = o7gttime @dTempDate OUTPUT, null
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1  

	INSERT INTO r5interface
		( int_transid,
		int_queue,
		int_action,
		int_table,
		int_keyfld1,
		int_keyfld2,
		int_keyfld3,
		int_keyfld4,
		int_keyfld5,
		int_keyflddate1,
		int_keyflddate2,
		int_status,
		int_create,
		int_retries )
	VALUES
		( @nTransid,
		@nQueue,
		@sAction,
		@sTable,
		@sKeyfld1,
		@sKeyfld2,
		@sKeyfld3,
		@nTransorgid,
		@nGroup,
		@sKeyflddate1,
		@sKeyflddate2,
		null,
		@dTempDate,
		0 )

	if @@ERROR <> 0 
		set @sChk = N'999'

create procedure O7INSKRF
	@pObject		nvarchar(30),
	@pObjectOrg		nvarchar(15),
	@pMrc			nvarchar(15),
	@pSupplier		nvarchar(30),
	@pSupplierOrg		nvarchar(15),
	@pServiceCategory	nvarchar(30),
	@pServiceCategoryOrg	nvarchar(15),
	@pServiceProblem	nvarchar(30),
	@pServiceProblemOrg	nvarchar(15),
	@pMrcCheck		nvarchar(1),
	@pSupplierCheck		nvarchar(1),
	@pServiceCategoryCheck	nvarchar(1),
	@pServiceProblemCheck	nvarchar(1)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	DECLARE @vObject		nvarchar(30)  
	DECLARE @vObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)  
	DECLARE @vKba			nvarchar(30)  
	DECLARE @vKbaOrg		nvarchar(15)  
	DECLARE @vMrc			nvarchar(15)  
	DECLARE @vSupplier		nvarchar(30)  
	DECLARE @vSupplierOrg		nvarchar(15)  
	DECLARE @vServiceCategory	nvarchar(30)  
	DECLARE @vServiceCategoryOrg	nvarchar(15) 
	DECLARE @vServiceProblem	nvarchar(30)  
	DECLARE @vServiceProblemOrg	nvarchar(15)
	DECLARE @vStatus		nvarchar(4)

	DECLARE c_kbarticles CURSOR LOCAL FOR
		SELECT  @pObject, @pObjectOrg, kba_code,
				kba_org, kba_supplier, kba_supplier_org,
				kba_mrc, kba_servicecategory, kba_servicecategory_org,
				kba_serviceproblem, kba_serviceproblem_org, kba_status
		FROM   r5organization o1, r5organization o2, r5kbarticles
		WHERE  o1.org_code = @pObjectOrg
		AND    o2.org_code = kba_org
		AND    NOT ( o1.org_common = '-' AND o2.org_common = '-' AND o1.org_code <> o2.org_code )
		AND    kba_rstatus <> N'O'
		AND    (((coalesce(@pMrc, N'#') = coalesce(kba_mrc, N'#') or kba_mrc is null) and @pMrcCheck = N'-')
					or (@pMrcCheck = N'+' and kba_mrc is not null))
		AND    (((coalesce(@pSupplier, N'#') = coalesce(kba_supplier, N'#') and coalesce(@pSupplierOrg, N'#') = coalesce(kba_supplier_org, N'#')
					or kba_supplier is null)
				and @pSupplierCheck = N'-') or (@pSupplierCheck = N'+' and kba_supplier is not null))
		AND    (((coalesce(@pServiceCategory, N'#') = coalesce(kba_servicecategory, N'#') and coalesce(@pServiceCategoryOrg, N'#') = coalesce(kba_servicecategory_org, N'#')
					or kba_servicecategory is null)
				and @pServiceCategoryCheck = N'-') or (@pServiceCategoryCheck = N'+' and kba_servicecategory is not null))
		AND    (((coalesce(@pServiceProblem, N'#') = coalesce(kba_serviceproblem, N'#') and coalesce(@pServiceProblemOrg, N'#') = coalesce(kba_serviceproblem_org, N'#')
					or kba_serviceproblem is null)
				and @pServiceProblemCheck = N'-') or (@pServiceProblemCheck = N'+' and kba_serviceproblem is not null))

	OPEN c_kbarticles
	FETCH next FROM c_kbarticles INTO @vObject, @vObjectOrg, @vKba,
					@vKbaOrg, @vSupplier, @vSupplierOrg,
					@vMrc, @vServiceCategory, @vServiceCategoryOrg,
					@vServiceProblem, @vServiceProblemOrg, @vStatus
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5kbacrossreference
				WHERE krf_object = @vObject
				AND krf_object_org = @pObjectOrg
				AND krf_kbarticle = @vKba
				AND krf_kbarticle_org = @vKbaOrg
				AND coalesce(krf_mrc, N'#') = coalesce(@vMrc, N'#')
				AND coalesce(krf_supplier, N'#') = coalesce(@vSupplier, N'#')
				AND coalesce(krf_supplier_org, N'#') = coalesce(@vSupplierOrg, N'#')
				AND coalesce(krf_servicecategory, N'#') = coalesce(@vServiceCategory, N'#')
				AND coalesce(krf_servicecategory_org, N'#') = coalesce(@vServiceCategoryOrg, N'#')
				AND coalesce(krf_serviceproblem, N'#') = coalesce(@vServiceProblem, N'#')
				AND coalesce(krf_serviceproblem_org, N'#') = coalesce(@vServiceProblemOrg, N'#'))
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO r5kbacrossreference
				(krf_object, krf_object_org, krf_kbarticle,
				krf_kbarticle_org, krf_supplier, krf_supplier_org,
				krf_mrc, krf_servicecategory, krf_servicecategory_org,
				krf_serviceproblem, krf_serviceproblem_org, krf_kbastatus)
			VALUES (@vObject, @vObjectOrg, @vKba,
				@vKbaOrg, @vSupplier, @vSupplierOrg,
				@vMrc, @vServiceCategory, @vServiceCategoryOrg,
				@vServiceProblem, @vServiceProblemOrg, @vStatus)
		END
		FETCH next FROM c_kbarticles INTO @vObject, @vObjectOrg, @vKba,
						@vKbaOrg, @vSupplier, @vSupplierOrg,
						@vMrc, @vServiceCategory, @vServiceCategoryOrg,
						@vServiceProblem, @vServiceProblemOrg, @vStatus
	END
	CLOSE c_kbarticles
	DEALLOCATE c_kbarticles

create procedure O7INSKRF1
	@pKbarticle		nvarchar(30),
	@pKbarticleOrg		nvarchar(15),

	@pSupplier		nvarchar(30),
	@pSupplierOrg		nvarchar(15),
	@pServiceCategory	nvarchar(30),
	@pServiceCategoryOrg	nvarchar(15),
	@pServiceProblem	nvarchar(30),
	@pServiceProblemOrg	nvarchar(15),
	@pSstatus		nvarchar(4)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
		   INSERT INTO r5kbacrossreference
		   (krf_object, krf_object_org, krf_kbarticle,
		    krf_kbarticle_org, krf_supplier, krf_supplier_org,
		    krf_mrc, krf_servicecategory, krf_servicecategory_org,
			krf_serviceproblem, krf_serviceproblem_org, krf_kbastatus)
           SELECT DISTINCT sdm_object, sdm_object_org, @pKbarticle,
                  @pKbarticleOrg, @pSupplier, @pSupplierOrg,
                  @pMrc, @pServiceCategory, @pServiceCategoryOrg,
                  @pServiceProblem, @pServiceProblemOrg,@pSstatus
           FROM   r5organization o1, r5organization o2, r5objectsdm
           WHERE  o1.org_code = sdm_object_org
           AND    o2.org_code = @pKbarticleOrg
           AND    NOT ( o1.org_common = '-' AND o2.org_common = '-' AND o1.org_code <> o2.org_code )
           AND    (((coalesce(@pMrc, N'#') = coalesce(sdm_mrc, N'#') or @pMrc is null) and sdm_mrc_check = N'-')
                    or (sdm_mrc_check = N'+' and @pMrc is not null))
           AND    ((((coalesce(@pSupplier, N'#') = coalesce(sdm_supplier, N'#') and coalesce(@pSupplierOrg, N'#') = coalesce(sdm_supplier_org, N'#'))
                    or @pSupplier is null )
                    and sdm_supplier_check = N'-') or (sdm_supplier_check = N'+' and @pSupplier is not null))
           AND    ((((coalesce(@pServiceCategory, N'#') = coalesce(sdm_servicecategory, N'#') and coalesce(@pServiceCategoryOrg, N'#') = coalesce(sdm_servicecategory_org, N'#'))
                    or @pServiceCategory is null )
                    and sdm_servicecategory_check = N'-') or (sdm_servicecategory_check = N'+' and @pServiceCategory is not null))
           AND    ((((coalesce(@pServiceProblem, N'#') = coalesce(sdm_serviceproblem, N'#') and coalesce(@pServiceProblemOrg, N'#') = coalesce(sdm_serviceproblem_org, N'#'))
                    or @pServiceProblem is null )
                    and sdm_serviceproblem_check = N'-') or (sdm_serviceproblem_check = N'+' and @pServiceProblem is not null))
		   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5kbacrossreference
						WHERE krf_object = sdm_object
						AND krf_object_org = sdm_object_org
						AND krf_kbarticle = @pKbarticle
						AND krf_kbarticle_org = @pKbarticleOrg
						AND coalesce(krf_mrc, N'#') = coalesce(@pMrc, N'#')
						AND coalesce(krf_supplier, N'#') = coalesce(@pSupplier, N'#')
						AND coalesce(krf_supplier_org, N'#') = coalesce(@pSupplierOrg, N'#')
						AND coalesce(krf_servicecategory, N'#') = coalesce(@pServiceCategory, N'#')
						AND coalesce(krf_servicecategory_org, N'#') = coalesce(@pServiceCategoryOrg, N'#')
						AND coalesce(krf_serviceproblem, N'#') = coalesce(@pServiceProblem, N'#')
						AND coalesce(krf_serviceproblem_org, N'#') = coalesce(@pServiceProblemOrg, N'#'))

create procedure  O7INSPAR 	@sCpart          nvarchar(30) Output, 
							@sCorg           nvarchar(15),
							@sCdesc          nvarchar(255),
							@sCbyasset       nvarchar(1),
							@sCuom           nvarchar(30),
							@sChk            nvarchar(4) Output

	
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCpcode        nvarchar(30)	--r5parts.par_code%TYPE   /* Code returned by o7maxseq ('PART') */
	declare @sCutype        nvarchar(8)	--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE  /* Holds the U code */
	declare @sCmos          nvarchar(1)	--r5entitytables.ett_cmos%TYPE
	declare @sClasorg       nvarchar(15)	--r5classes.cls_org%TYPE
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @nReturn		int

	/* Initialise */
	Set @sChk          = N'0'
	Set @sCheckresult  = N'0'
	
	/* Check that description must be filled in */
	IF @sCdesc    IS NULL OR @sCbyasset IS NULL OR @sCuom     IS NULL
		BEGIN 
			Set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		END

	/* S11221 : if part is null  generate part code as ('N...') */
	IF @sCpart IS NULL 
	BEGIN
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCpcode OUTPUT, N'PART', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

		IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
			BEGIN
				Set @sChk = N'3'
				RETURN
			END
		ELSE
			Set @sCpart = N'N' + @sCpcode
	END
	
	-- Get the U code for the R code TRPQ
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sCutype OUTPUT, N'TRPQ', N'PTRK', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

-- Check @sCmos for class, if off,  use default organization.
	SELECT @sCmos = ett_mos
	FROM   r5entitytables
	WHERE  ett_rentity = N'CLAS'

	IF @sCmos = N'-' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sClasorg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end
	ELSE
		Set @sClasorg = @sCorg


/* S1123 : If part is generated,  insert associated data into r5parts */
   	Select @nCount = count(*) from r5parts where par_code = @sCpart AND par_org = @sCorg
	If @nCount = 0 
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO r5parts (
				 par_code,
				 par_desc,
				 par_org,
				 par_byasset,
				 par_class,
				 par_class_org,
				 par_uom,
				 par_notused,
				 par_tracktype,
				 par_trackrtype )
			VALUES (
				 @sCpart,
				 @sCdesc,
				 @sCorg,
				 @sCbyasset,
				 N'N',
				 @sClasorg,
				 @sCuom,
				 N'-',
				 @sCutype,
				 N'TRPQ' )
		END

create procedure O7INSRES
    @sCevent         nvarchar(30),
    @nNact           int,
    @sCpart          nvarchar(30),
    @sCpartorg       nvarchar(15),
    @nNqty           numeric(24,6),
    @nNoldqty        numeric(24,6),
    @sCcrit          nvarchar(1),
    @sChk            nvarchar(5)	OUTPUT 
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare  @nCountit  int
    declare  @sCheckresult    nvarchar(4)
    declare  @sX              nvarchar(100)
    declare  @sCresstore      nvarchar(15)	/* r5stores.str_code%TYPE;          Store Code for r5reservations      */
    declare  @sCmrc           nvarchar(15)	/* r5mrcs.mrc_code%TYPE;            Mrc Code obtained from r5events    */
    declare  @sCproject       nvarchar(20)	/* r5projects.prj_code%TYPE;        Project code of r5events           */
    declare  @sCprojbud       nvarchar(20)	/* r5projbudcodes.pbc_code%TYPE;    Projbud code of r5events           */
	declare  @nReturn		  int
	declare  @sAct			  nvarchar(6)
BEGIN
	/* Initialise */
    set @sChk         = N'0' 
    set @nCountit     =  0 
    set @sCheckresult = N'0' 
    set @sX           = NULL
    set @sCresstore   = NULL
    set @sCmrc        = NULL
    set @sCproject    = NULL
    set @sCprojbud    = NULL
	/* check mandatory parameters */
    IF @sCevent   IS NULL
    OR @nNact     IS NULL
    OR @sCpart    IS NULL
    OR @sCpartorg IS NULL
    OR @nNqty     IS NULL 
	begin
      set @sChk = N'1'
      return
	end
	/* Event rstatus should be > 'C'  */
    execute @nReturn = o7exists  N'EVNT', N'*', @sCevent, N'C', N'>', @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    IF  @nCountit = 0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'5'  /* Event rstatus not > 'C' */
        return
	end
    ELSE
		IF  @nCountit < 0
	begin
        IF  @sCheckresult = N'2'
            set @sChk = N'4'
        ELSE
            set @sChk = @sCheckresult
        return
    end
	/* Getting mrc from r5events */
    execute @nReturn = o7gmores N'EVNT', 1, @sCevent, @sX,@sX,@sX,@sX OUTPUT,@sX OUTPUT,@sX OUTPUT, @sCmrc OUTPUT,
              @sCproject OUTPUT, @sCprojbud OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT,@sX OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
	begin
        set @sChk = N'6'
        return
    end
	/* Getting store from r5mrcs */
    IF @sCmrc IS NOT NULL
	begin
        execute @nReturn = o7gmores  N'MRC', 1, @sCmrc, @sX,@sX,@sX,@sX OUTPUT,@sX OUTPUT,@sX OUTPUT, @sCresstore OUTPUT,
                 @sX OUTPUT,@sX OUTPUT,@sX OUTPUT,@sX OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	
        IF @sCheckresult <> N'0'
	    begin
            set @sChk = N'7'
            return
        end
    end
	/* Store code should not be null for reservations */
    IF @sCresstore IS NOT NULL
	/* part must be in store */
	begin
		execute @nReturn = o7exists  N'STOR', N'*', @sCresstore, @sCpart, @sCpartorg, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
    	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        IF @nCountit < 1 
		begin
            set @sChk = N'0'
            return
        end
		set @sAct = CAST(@nNact as nvarchar(6))
		/* Reservation record should not exist */
        execute @nReturn = o7exists  N'RESV',  N'*', @sCevent, @sAct, @sCpart,
                                    @sCresstore, @sCpartorg, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        IF @nCountit = 0 
		/* insert into r5reservations */
        begin
            INSERT INTO r5reservations (
               res_event,   res_act,   res_part, res_part_org, res_project,
               res_projbud, res_store, res_qty,  res_allqty,   res_crit )
            VALUES  (
               @sCevent,   @nNact,      @sCpart, @sCpartorg, @sCproject,
               @sCprojbud, @sCresstore, @nNqty,  0, N'-' )
        end
      	ELSE IF  @nCountit > 0 
		/* update r5reservations, because record already exists */
        begin
            UPDATE r5reservations
            SET    res_qty = res_qty - isnull( @nNoldqty, 0 ) + @nNqty,
                   res_allqty = dbo.F_LEAST_NUMBER( res_allqty,
                                       res_qty - isnull( @nNoldqty, 0 ) + @nNqty )
            WHERE  res_event    = @sCevent
            AND    res_act      = @nNact
            AND    res_part     = @sCpart
            AND    res_part_org = @sCpartorg
            AND    res_store    = @sCresstore

            DELETE FROM r5reservations
            WHERE res_event    = @sCevent
            AND   res_act      = @nNact
            AND   res_part     = @sCpart
            AND   res_part_org = @sCpartorg
            AND   res_store    = @sCresstore
            AND   res_qty     <= 0
        end 
        ELSE
		begin
            IF @sCheckresult = N'2' 
            	set @sChk = N'3'      /* 'RESV' does not exist  */
            ELSE
            	set @sChk = @sCheckresult
         	return
        end
	end
END
