create procedure O7INSSTO	@sPart		nvarchar(30),
							@sPartorg	nvarchar(15),
							@sStore		nvarchar(15),
							@sRentity	nvarchar(4),
							@sNo		nvarchar(30),
							@sChk		nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sNorentity		nvarchar(4)		--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(100)
	declare @sNostore		nvarchar(15)	--r5stores.str_code%TYPE
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(15)	--r5stores.str_code%TYPE
	declare @nMinlev		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOrdlev		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOrdqty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @sPrefstore		nvarchar(15)	--r5stores.str_code%TYPE
	declare @sPrefsup		nvarchar(30)	--r5companies.com_code%TYPE
	declare @sPrefsuporg	nvarchar(15)	--r5companies.com_org%TYPE
	declare @sPricetype		nvarchar(1)		--r5partprices.ppr_pricetype%TYPE
	declare @sDflt			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int

	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @nCountit = 0
	set @sX = null
	set @sNorentity = null
	set @sNostore = @sStore

	if @sNostore is null and ( @sNo is null or @sRentity is null )
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	set @sNorentity = @sRentity
	execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'PART', N'1', @sPart, @sPartorg, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @nCountit = 0
		return

	if @sNostore is null and @sNorentity = N'REQ'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GMORES N'REQ', 1, @sNo, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sNorentity OUTPUT, @sNostore OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					return
				end
		end

	if @sNorentity = N'STOR'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'STOR', N'*', @sNostore, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDflt OUTPUT, N'DEFSTOCK', @sChk OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1

							if upper(@sDflt) in ( N'+', N'YES', N'Y', N'ON' )
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7CPSTOR @sParent OUTPUT, @sNostore
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										return -1

									SELECT	@nMinlev		= sto_minlev,
											@nOrdlev		= sto_ordlev,
											@nOrdqty		= sto_ordqty,
											@sPrefstore		= sto_prefstore,
											@sPrefsup		= sto_prefsup,
											@sPrefsuporg	= sto_prefsup_org
									  FROM  r5stock
									 WHERE  sto_store    = @sParent
									 AND    sto_part     = @sPart
									 AND    sto_part_org = @sPartorg
								end

							INSERT INTO r5stock
								  ( sto_part, sto_part_org, sto_store, sto_leadtime,
									sto_minlev, sto_ordlev, sto_ordqty, sto_prefstore,
									sto_prefsup, sto_prefsup_org, sto_pricetype, sto_partcondition  )
							SELECT	@sPart, @sPartorg, @sNostore, 0, @nMinlev, @nOrdlev,
									@nOrdqty, @sPrefstore, @sPrefsup, @sPrefsuporg, str_pricetype, par_condition
							FROM	r5stores, r5parts
							WHERE	str_code = @sNostore
							AND		par_code = @sPart
							AND		par_org  = @sPartorg
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = @sCheckresult
							return
						end
				end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7INTERFACE_ADTERR
                 @sBatchName    NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sObject       NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@sObjectOrg    NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sErrorSource  NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sErrorType    NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sErrorParm1   NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sErrorParm2   NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sErrorParm3   NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sErrorMessage NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT
                ,@sErrorCheck   NVARCHAR(30)  OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	DECLARE @sDefOrg NVARCHAR(2000)
		   ,@nReturn INT
		   ,@nCheck int

	EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INIT
	IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
	   RETURN -1

	EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7INTERFACE', N'DEFORG', @sDefOrg OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
	   RETURN -1

	if @sErrorType = N'ORACLE'
		set @sErrorType = N'MSSQL'

	if (@sErrorType != N'MSSQL')
		begin
            --prevent conversion error batch abort
            if @sErrorCheck is not null and isnumeric( @sErrorCheck ) = 0
                return

			set @nCheck = cast( convert( numeric, @sErrorCheck) as int )
			execute @nReturn = O7INTGEM @sErrorMessage OUTPUT, @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, @nCheck
	        IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
	           RETURN -1
			
			--set these to empty string if they are null so that replace will work
			set @sErrorParm1	= coalesce( @sErrorParm1, N'')
			set @sErrorParm2	= coalesce( @sErrorParm2, N'')
			set @sErrorParm3	= coalesce( @sErrorParm3, N'')
			
			set @sErrorMessage	= REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(@sErrorMessage, N':PARM1', @sErrorParm1), N':PARM2', @sErrorParm2), N':PARM3', @sErrorParm3)
		end

	--set these to empty string if they are null so that concatenation will work
	set @sErrorSource	= coalesce( @sErrorSource, N'')
	set @sErrorType		= coalesce( @sErrorType, N'')
	set @sErrorCheck	= coalesce( @sErrorCheck, N'')

	SET @sErrorMessage = @sErrorSource + N'-' + @sErrorType + N'-' + @sErrorCheck + N'-' + @sErrorMessage

	if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		rollback

	INSERT INTO r5objectauditerrors
			   (oae_batchname
			   ,oae_object
			   ,oae_object_org
			   ,oae_errormessage)
		VALUES (@sBatchName
			   ,@sObject
			   ,ISNULL(@sObjectOrg, @sDefOrg)
			   ,@sErrorMessage)
	commit

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7INTERFACE_ARCUP1
                 @nTranId bigint
                ,@sTran   NVARCHAR(4)
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @sArcrColumn   NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@nPromptSeq    int
       ,@sUploadColumn NVARCHAR(45)
       ,@sDataType     NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sSQLString    NVARCHAR(4000)
       ,@nReturn       INT

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INIT
IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1

DECLARE GetTrackingPrompts CURSOR LOCAL FOR
SELECT tkd_arcrcolumn = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(4), (CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING(tkp_arcrcolumn, 2, 4)) - 160))
      ,tkp_promptseq
      ,tkp_uploadcolumn
      ,tkp_datatype
  FROM r5trackingprompts
 WHERE tkp_arcrcolumn != N'*'
   AND tkp_trans = @sTran
   AND tkp_promptseq IS NOT NULL

OPEN GetTrackingPrompts
WHILE 1=1
      BEGIN
      FETCH GetTrackingPrompts INTO @sArcrColumn
                                   ,@nPromptSeq
                                   ,@sUploadColumn
                                   ,@sDataType
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
         BREAK

      IF @sUploadColumn = N'ADI_COMMENT' OR @sDataType = N'FFT'
         BEGIN 
         UPDATE r5arctrackdata
            SET atd_data51 = tkd_promptdata51
          FROM r5trackingdata, r5arctrackdata
         WHERE atd_transorgid = @nTranId
           AND tkd_transid = atd_transorgid
         END
      ELSE
         BEGIN
         SET @sSQLString = N'UPDATE r5arctrackdata '
                         + N'   SET atd_data' + @sArcrColumn + N' = TKD.tkd_promptdata' + CONVERT(nvarchar(38), @nPromptSeq)
                         + N'  FROM r5arctrackdata ATD, r5trackingdata TKD'
                         + N' WHERE ATD.atd_transorgid = TKD.tkd_transid'
                         + N'   AND ATD.atd_transorgid = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nTranId)
                         + N'   AND TKD.tkd_transid = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nTranId)
         EXECUTE(@sSQLString)
         END
      END
CLOSE GetTrackingPrompts
DEALLOCATE GetTrackingPrompts
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7INTERFACE_ARCUPD
                 @nTranId        bigint
                ,@nTranOrgId     bigint
                ,@nTranGroup     int
                ,@sTran          NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sInterfaceType NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sTableName     NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sPrefix        NVARCHAR(40)
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @sErrorSource   NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrorType     NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrorFunc     NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrorParm1    NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrorParm2    NVARCHAR(40)
       ,@sErrorMsg      NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@sArchiveColumn NVARCHAR(45)
       ,@sUploadColumn  NVARCHAR(45)
       ,@nCounter       INT
       ,@sSQLString     NVARCHAR(4000)
       ,@nReturn        INT

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INIT
IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1

DECLARE GetTrackingPrompt CURSOR LOCAL FOR
SELECT tkp_archivecolumn
      ,tkp_uploadcolumn
  FROM r5trackingprompts
 WHERE tkp_arccolumn IS NOT NULL
   AND tkp_interfacertype = @sInterfaceType
   AND tkp_transgroup = @nTranGroup
   AND tkp_trans = @sTran

SET @sSQLString = N'UPDATE r5arctrackdata'
                + N'   SET r5arctrackdata.atd_trans = ' + @sTableName + N'.' + @sTran

OPEN GetTrackingPrompt
SET @nCounter = 0
WHILE 1=1
      BEGIN
      FETCH GetTrackingPrompt INTO @sArchiveColumn, @sUploadColumn
      IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
         BREAK
      SET @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
      SET @sSQLString = @sSQLString + N'      ,r5arctrackdata.' + @sArchiveColumn + N' = ' + @sTableName + N'.' + @sUploadColumn
      END
CLOSE GetTrackingPrompt
DEALLOCATE GetTrackingPrompt

IF @nCounter > 0
   BEGIN
   SET @sSQLString = @sSQLString + N'  FROM ' + @sTableName
                                 + N' WHERE r5arctrackdata.atd_transorgid = ' + cast( @nTranOrgId as nvarchar(38) )
                                 + N'   AND ' + @sTableName + N'.' + @sPrefix + N'_transid = ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(38), @nTranId)
   EXECUTE(@sSQLString) 
   END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7INTERFACE_ASTINT
                 @sAction        NVARCHAR(30)
                ,@nSessionId     int
                ,@sTran          NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sTable         NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sKeyCharField1 NVARCHAR(80)
                ,@sKeyCharField2 NVARCHAR(80)
                ,@sKeyCharField3 NVARCHAR(80)
                ,@nTranOrgId     bigint
                ,@nGroup         int
                ,@dKeyDateField1 DATETIME
                ,@dKeyDateField2 DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON

DECLARE @nTranId      bigint
       ,@nQueue       int
       ,@nMaxQueues   int
       ,@nCounter     INT
       ,@nCounter1    INT
       ,@nCounter2    INT
       ,@nCounter3    INT
       ,@sMessage     NVARCHAR(255)
       ,@sSessionId   NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sQueue       NVARCHAR(30)
       ,@sPackageVar1 NVARCHAR(2000)
       ,@sPackageVar2 NVARCHAR(2000)
       ,@sCheck       NVARCHAR(2000)
       ,@nReturn      INT
	   ,@sTemp        nvarchar(512)

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INIT
IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1
EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7INTERFACE', N'T1', @sPackageVar1
IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1
EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7INTERFACE', N'T2', @sPackageVar2
IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1

IF @nSessionId = CONVERT(int, @sPackageVar1)
   SET @nQueue = CONVERT(int, @sPackageVar2)
ELSE
   BEGIN
   SET @sSessionId = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2000), @nSessionId)
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7INTERFACE', N'T1', @sSessionId
   IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
      RETURN -1
   SET @nQueue = NULL

   SET ROWCOUNT 1
   SELECT @nQueue = int_queue
     FROM r5interface
    WHERE int_sessionid = @nSessionId
      AND int_queue IN (1, 2, 3)
      AND ((@sTable  = N'R5TRACKINGDATA' AND int_table = @sTable) OR
          (@sTable != N'R5TRACKINGDATA' AND int_table IN (N'R5BOOKEDHOURSINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5EVENTSINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5MANUFACTURERINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5OBJECTSINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5READINGSINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5TOOLUSAGEINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5TRANSINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5REQUISINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5PARTSINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5PURCHASEINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5ADDETAILSINTERFACE'
                                                         ,N'R5ACCOUNTDETAILINTERFACE')))
   SET ROWCOUNT 0

   IF @nQueue IS NULL
      BEGIN
      SET @nMaxQueues = 1

      --make sure conversion to int will be successful and rowcount is one
      --otherwise the exception block takes over and @nMaxQueues stays at 1
      SELECT @sTemp = ins_desc
        FROM r5install
       WHERE ins_code = N'~QUEUES~';
      
      if ( @sTemp is null or isnumeric( @sTemp ) = 1 ) and @@ROWCOUNT = 1
          SELECT @nMaxQueues = CONVERT(int, convert( numeric, ins_desc))
            FROM r5install
           WHERE ins_code = N'~QUEUES~'

      IF @nMaxQueues > 1
         BEGIN
         SELECT @nCounter1 = SUM(CASE int_queue WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               ,@nCounter2 = SUM(CASE int_queue WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
               ,@nCounter3 = SUM(CASE int_queue WHEN 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
           FROM r5interface
          WHERE (@sTable  = N'R5TRACKINGDATA' AND int_table = @sTable) OR
                (@sTable != N'R5TRACKINGDATA' AND int_table IN (N'R5BOOKEDHOURSINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5EVENTSINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5MANUFACTURERINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5OBJECTSINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5READINGSINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5TOOLUSAGEINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5TRANSINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5REQUISINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5PARTSINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5PURCHASEINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5ADDETAILSINTERFACE'
                                                               ,N'R5ACCOUNTDETAILINTERFACE'))
         SET @nCounter = 0;
         IF @nCounter2 < @nCounter1
            BEGIN
            SET @nQueue = 2
            SET @nCounter = @nCounter2
            END
         ELSE
            BEGIN
            SET @nQueue = 1
            SET @nCounter = @nCounter1
            END
         IF @nCounter3 < @nCounter AND @nMaxQueues = 3
            SET @nQueue = 3
         END
      ELSE
         SET @nQueue = 1
      END
   SET @sQueue = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(2000), @nQueue)
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7INTERFACE', N'T2', @sQueue
   IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
      RETURN -1
   END

IF @sTable = N'R5OBJECTAUDITS'
   BEGIN
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7INTERFACE', N'CHECK', @sCheck OUTPUT
   IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
      RETURN -1
   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nTranId, N'INTERFACE', N'1', @sCheck
   IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
      RETURN -1
   END
ELSE
   SET @nTranId = CONVERT(bigint, @sKeyCharField1)

INSERT INTO r5interface
           (int_transid
           ,int_sessionid
           ,int_trans
           ,int_queue
           ,int_action
           ,int_table
           ,int_keyfld1
           ,int_keyfld2
           ,int_keyfld3
           ,int_transorgid
           ,int_group
           ,int_keyflddate1
           ,int_keyflddate2
           ,int_status
           ,int_create
           ,int_retries)
     VALUES(@nTranId
           ,@nSessionId
           ,@sTran
           ,@nQueue
           ,@sAction
           ,@sTable
           ,@sKeyCharField1
           ,@sKeyCharField2
           ,@sKeyCharField3
           ,ISNULL(@nTranOrgId, @nTranId)
           ,ISNULL(@nGroup, 0)
           ,@dKeyDateField1
           ,@dKeyDateField2
           ,N'-'
           ,dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
           ,0);
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7INTERFACE_GRPERR
                 @nTranOrgId bigint
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	DECLARE @sArcRec      NVARCHAR(200)
		   ,@sCheck       NVARCHAR(3)
		   ,@nTranId      bigint
		   ,@sError       NVARCHAR(240)
		   ,@sErrorSource NVARCHAR(32)
		   ,@sErrorType   NVARCHAR(10)
		   ,@sErrorNumber NVARCHAR(10)
		   ,@nHoldId      bigint
		   ,@nReturn      INT
		   ,@sErrmsg      nvarchar(200)
		   ,@nCursorID    bigint		

	EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INIT
	IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
	   RETURN -1

	DECLARE @tErrorTable TABLE (tran_id      bigint NULL
							   ,error        NVARCHAR(240)  NULL
							   ,error_source NVARCHAR(32)   NULL
							   ,error_type   NVARCHAR(10)   NULL
							   ,error_number NVARCHAR(10)   NULL)

	EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7DFLT @sArcRec OUTPUT, N'ARCREC', @sCheck
	IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
	   RETURN -1
	IF @sCheck != N'0'
	   SET @sArcRec = N'NO'

	INSERT INTO @tErrorTable
	SELECT ine_transid
		  ,ine_error
		  ,ine_errsource
		  ,ine_errtype
		  ,ine_errnumber
	  FROM r5interfaceerrors
	 WHERE ine_transorgid = @nTranOrgId

	if @@TRANCOUNT > 0
		rollback


    --TNT 07-15-2004: This section of code is not in Oracle and is a workaround
    --                for a SQL Server-ism in which errors in triggers abort 
    --                processing without allowing for an @@ERROR check.  
    --
    --                This code block removes the pre-marked error rows from the
    --                errors table so that they don't show unnecessarily.  See
    --                the note in o7bdrv for more details.

    delete from r5interfaceerrors
        where ine_transorgid = @nTranOrgId
          and ine_errsource  = 'O7BDRV'
          and ine_errtype    = 'PROC'
          and ine_errnumber  = '1'

    -- a new trigger will remove the corresponding grouped row as well
    -- end workaround 

	SET @nHoldId = -1

	DECLARE GetErrorTran CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	SELECT tran_id
		  ,error
		  ,error_source
		  ,error_type
		  ,error_number
	  FROM @tErrorTable
	ORDER BY tran_id

	OPEN GetErrorTran
	WHILE 1=1
		  BEGIN
		  FETCH GetErrorTran INTO @nTranId
								 ,@sError
								 ,@sErrorSource
								 ,@sErrorType
								 ,@sErrorNumber
		  IF @@FETCH_STATUS != 0
			 BREAK

		  INSERT INTO r5interfaceerrors
					 (ine_transid
					 ,ine_transorgid
					 ,ine_create
					 ,ine_error
					 ,ine_errsource
					 ,ine_errtype
					 ,ine_errnumber)
			  VALUES (@nTranId
					 ,@nTranOrgId
					 ,dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
					 ,@sError
					 ,@sErrorSource
					 ,@sErrorType
					 ,@sErrorNumber)

		  IF @sArcRec = N'YES' AND @sErrorSource != N'GROUP'
			 BEGIN
			 INSERT INTO r5arcinterrors
						(ate_transorgid
						,ate_transgroup
						,ate_sessionid
						,ate_trans
						,ate_create
						,ate_errsource
						,ate_errtype
						,ate_errnumber
						,ate_errmesg)
			 SELECT @nTranOrgId
				   ,int_group
				   ,int_sessionid
				   ,int_trans
				   ,dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
				   ,@sErrorSource
				   ,@sErrorType
				   ,@sErrorNumber
				   ,@sError
			   FROM r5interface
			  WHERE int_transid = @nTranId
				AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
								  FROM r5arcinterrors
								 WHERE ate_transorgid = @nTranOrgId
								   AND ate_transgroup = r5interface.int_group
								   AND ate_trans = r5interface.int_trans
								   AND ate_errsource = @sErrorSource
								   AND ate_errtype = @sErrorType
								   AND ate_errnumber = @sErrorNumber)
			 END
		  IF @nTranId != @nHoldId
			 BEGIN
				set @sErrmsg = 'Transaction on HOLD, errors found in - ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), @nTranId)
				declare c_clrec cursor local for   SELECT prev.int_transid
												   FROM   r5interface curr
														 ,r5interface prev
												   WHERE  not exists (SELECT null
																	  FROM r5interfaceerrors
																	  WHERE ine_transid = prev.int_transid)
												   AND    prev.int_group      < curr.int_group
												   AND    prev.int_transorgid = curr.int_transorgid
												   AND    curr.int_transid    = @nTranId
				open c_clrec
				fetch next from c_clrec into @nCursorID
				while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					begin
						 INSERT INTO r5interfaceerrors
									(ine_transid
									,ine_transorgid
									,ine_create
									,ine_error
									,ine_errsource
									,ine_errtype
									,ine_errnumber)
						 VALUES ( @nCursorID
								   ,@nTranOrgId
								   ,dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
								   ,@sErrmsg
								   ,N'GROUP'
								   ,N'HOLD'
								   ,N'1' )

						 UPDATE r5interface
							SET int_status = N'+'
							   ,int_retries = ISNULL(int_retries, 0) + 1
							   ,int_process = dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
							   ,int_queue = 0
						  WHERE int_transid = @nCursorID

						fetch next from c_clrec into @nCursorID
					end
				close c_clrec
				deallocate c_clrec

				UPDATE r5interface
					SET int_status = N'+'
					   ,int_retries = ISNULL(int_retries, 0) + 1
					   ,int_process = dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
					   ,int_queue = 0
				  WHERE int_transid = @nTranId
				 SET @nHoldId = @nTranId         
			 END
		  END
	CLOSE GetErrorTran
	DEALLOCATE GetErrorTran

	SET ROWCOUNT 1
	UPDATE r5arctrackdata
	   SET atd_errorstatus = N'E'
	  FROM r5interface
	 WHERE atd_transorgid = @nTranOrgId
	   AND atd_errorstatus != N'E'
	   AND atd_trans = int_trans
	   AND int_transid = @nTranId
	SET ROWCOUNT 0

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR
                 @nTranId       bigint
                ,@sErrorCheck   NVARCHAR(10)
                ,@sErrorSource  NVARCHAR(32)
                ,@sErrorType    NVARCHAR(10)
                ,@sErrorFunc    NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sErrorParm1   NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sErrorParm2   NVARCHAR(40)
                ,@sErrorMsg     NVARCHAR(240)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

IF @sErrorCheck = N'0' or ( @sErrorCheck is not null and isnumeric( @sErrorCheck ) = 0 )
   RETURN

DECLARE @sErrorMessageText NVARCHAR(512)
       ,@sErrorTemp        nvarchar(255)
       ,@nTranOrgId        bigint
       ,@nReturn           INT
       ,@nCheckTemp        int

EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INIT
IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
   RETURN -1

SET @sErrorMessageText = @sErrorMsg

if @sErrorType = N'ORACLE'
	set @sErrorType = N'MSSQL'

IF (@sErrorType != N'MSSQL')
   BEGIN
   set @nCheckTemp = convert(int, convert( numeric, @sErrorCheck))
   execute @nReturn = O7INTGEM @sErrorTemp OUTPUT, @sErrorSource, @sErrorType, @nCheckTemp
   IF @@ERROR != 0 AND @nReturn != 0
       RETURN -1

   SET @sErrorMessageText = REPLACE(REPLACE(@sErrorTemp, N':PARM1', isnull(@sErrorParm1, N'')), N':PARM2', isnull(@sErrorParm2, N''))
   END

SET @sErrorMessageText = isnull(@sErrorSource,N'') + N'-' +
							isnull(@sErrorType,N'') + N'-' + isnull(@sErrorCheck,N'') + N'-' +
							isnull(@sErrorFunc,N'') + N'-' + isnull(@sErrorMessageText,N'')

SELECT @nTranOrgId = int_transorgid
  FROM r5interface
 WHERE int_transid = @nTranId

INSERT INTO r5interfaceerrors
           (ine_transid
           ,ine_transorgid
           ,ine_create
           ,ine_error
           ,ine_errsource
           ,ine_errtype
           ,ine_errnumber)
    VALUES (@nTranId
           ,@nTranOrgId
           ,dbo.O7GTTIME2(NULL)
           ,left(@sErrorMessageText, 240)
           ,@sErrorSource
           ,@sErrorType
           ,@sErrorCheck)

CREATE PROCEDURE O7INTGEM @sReturn nvarchar(255) OUTPUT, 
                          @sSource NVARCHAR(32),
                          @sType   NVARCHAR(4),
                          @nNumber INT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nReturn    int
    declare @sLang      nvarchar(200)
	declare @sCuruser	nvarchar(255)

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'R5USER', @sCuruser OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        begin
            set @sReturn = null
		    return --Oracle error block returns null
        end

    SELECT @sLang = usr_lang
    FROM   r5users
    WHERE  usr_code = @sCuruser

    SET @sReturn = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(255), NULL)

    SELECT @sReturn=TXT.ert_text
      FROM r5errsource ERS
          ,r5errtexts  TXT
          ,r5install   INS
     WHERE ERS.ers_source = @sSource
       AND ERS.ers_type = @sType
       AND ERS.ers_number = @nNumber
       AND ERS.ers_code = TXT.ert_code
       AND TXT.ert_lang = coalesce( @sLang, INS.ins_desc )
       AND INS.ins_code = N'DEFLANG'

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7IPADD
                 @sP_user      NVARCHAR(255)          /* Current user                           */
                ,@sP_rorg      NVARCHAR(15)          /* requisition/purchase order org         */
                ,@sP_part      NVARCHAR(30)          /* part number, null in, new N number out */
                ,@sP_porg      NVARCHAR(15)          /* part org                               */
                ,@sP_supplier  NVARCHAR(30)          /* MP5i supplier code, if know            */
                ,@sP_sorg      NVARCHAR(15)          /* MP5i supplier org code, if know        */
                ,@sP_vendor    NVARCHAR(30)          /* iProcure vendor number                 */
                ,@sP_ref       NVARCHAR(50)          /* iProcure reference number              */
                ,@sP_desc      NVARCHAR(2000)        /* iProcure vendor part description       */
                ,@sP_price     NVARCHAR(30)          /* iProcure price                         */
                ,@sP_minordqty NVARCHAR(30)          /* iProcure minimum order quantity        */
                ,@sP_lead      NVARCHAR(10)          /* iProcure lead time                     */
                ,@sP_uom       NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT  /* iProcure unit of purchase              */
                ,@sP_chk       NVARCHAR(5)   OUTPUT  /* procedure error code                   */
                ,@sP_rowid     INT           OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sV_chk           NVARCHAR(4)
       ,@sV_cutype        NVARCHAR(8)  /* r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE; Holds the U code */
       ,@sV_mos           NVARCHAR(1)  /* r5entitytables.ett_mos%TYPE;             */
       ,@sV_clasorg       NVARCHAR(15) /*  r5organization.org_code%TYPE;           */
       ,@sV_porg          NVARCHAR(15) /*  r5organization.org_code%TYPE;           */
       ,@sV_Supplier      NVARCHAR(30) /*  r5companies.com_code%TYPE;              */
       ,@sV_Supplier_org  NVARCHAR(15) /*  r5companies.com_org%TYPE;               */
       ,@sV_Uom           NVARCHAR(30) /*  r5uoms.uom_code%TYPE;                   */
       ,@nCount           INT
       ,@nReturn          INT
       ,@nError           INT
  declare @nPosc integer
  declare @nPosn integer
  declare @nCounter integer
  declare @sV_desc  nvarchar(255)

/* Initialize */
SET @sP_chk = N'0' 

/* Check for null values on required parameters */
IF (@sP_desc IS NULL OR @sP_uom IS NULL or @sP_user IS NULL) 
   BEGIN
   SET @sP_chk = N'1'  /*  invalid parameters */
   RETURN
   END

/*  locate MP5i supplier with matching iProcure code of CVENDOR */
IF @sP_supplier IS NULL
   BEGIN
   SET ROWCOUNT 1
   SELECT @sV_Supplier=c.com_code
         ,@sV_Supplier_org=c.com_org
     FROM r5userorganization u, r5companies c, r5organization o
    WHERE c.com_notused = N'-'
      AND c.com_purchasesite = N'+'
      AND c.com_org = u.uog_org
      AND u.uog_user = @sP_user
      AND u.uog_org = o.org_code
      AND (o.org_common = N'+' OR u.uog_org = @sP_rorg)
      AND c.com_ipvendor = cast(@sP_vendor as numeric(8,0))
   ORDER BY o.org_common DESC, o.org_code ASC, com_ipvendor
   SET @nCount = @@ROWCOUNT
   SET ROWCOUNT 0

   IF @nCount = 0
      BEGIN
      SET @sP_chk = N'2'  /*  no valid MP5i supplier to associate new item */
      RETURN
      END
   END
ELSE
   BEGIN
   SET @sV_Supplier = @sP_supplier
   SET @sV_Supplier_org = @sP_sorg
   END

/*  validate unit of measure */
EXECUTE @nReturn = O7IPUOM  @sP_uom OUTPUT, @sV_chk OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   RETURN -1

/*  If a record exists in the MP5 catalog for the iProcure Vendor/Supplier Reference Number,  */
/*  Then that MP5 part code is used */

SET ROWCOUNT 1
SELECT @sP_rowid = c.cat_sqlidentity
  FROM r5catalogue c
 WHERE c.cat_ref = @sP_ref
   AND c.cat_supplier = @sV_Supplier
   AND c.cat_supplier_org = @sV_Supplier_org
   AND (c.cat_part_org = @sP_rorg OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5organization WHERE org_code = c.cat_part_org AND org_common = N'+'))
SET ROWCOUNT 0
IF @@ROWCOUNT = 1
   RETURN

/* get default org */
EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sV_porg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sP_chk OUTPUT
IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
   RETURN -1

/* Get the U code for the R code TRPQ */
EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.R5O7_O7UCODE @sV_cutype OUTPUT, N'TRPQ', N'PTRK', @sP_chk
IF @@ERROR <>0  OR @nReturn  <>0
   RETURN -1

/* Check MOS for class, if off, then use default organization. */
SELECT @sV_mos = ett_mos
  FROM r5entitytables
 WHERE ett_rentity = N'CLAS'

IF @sV_mos = N'-'
   SET @sV_clasorg = @sV_porg
ELSE
   SET @sV_clasorg = @sP_rorg

/* S1123 : If part is generated, then insert associated data into r5parts */

set @nPosc = 1  /* Current position*/
set @nPosn = 0  /* Last :: position */
set @nCounter = 3
IF charindex( N'::SupplierSessionID=', @sP_desc ) > 0 
    begin
        /* remove Supplier Session ID if it exists */
        set @nPosn = charindex( N'::', @sP_desc,  2 )
        While ( @nCounter < len( @sP_desc ) and @nPosc > 0 )  
            begin
                set @nPosc = charindex( N'::', @sP_desc,  @nCounter )
                IF @nPosc > 0 AND @nPosc <= @nPosn + 1 
                    set @nPosn = @nPosc
                ELSE
                    break
                set @nCounter = @nCounter +1
            end
        IF @nPosn > 0 
            set @sV_desc =  SUBSTRING( @sP_desc, @nPosn +2, 255 )
    end
ELSE
    set @sV_desc =  SUBSTRING(@sP_desc,1,255)



INSERT INTO r5parts
           (par_code
           ,par_desc
           ,par_org
           ,par_byasset
           ,par_class
           ,par_class_org
           ,par_uom
           ,par_notused
           ,par_tracktype
           ,par_trackrtype)
    VALUES (@sP_part
           ,@sV_desc
           ,@sV_Supplier_org
           ,N'-'
           ,N'N'
           ,@sV_clasorg
           ,@sP_uom
           ,N'-'
           ,@sV_cutype
           ,N'TRPQ')
SET @nError = @@ERROR
IF @nError != 0
   GOTO DB_ERROR


--prevent conversion error
if @sP_minordqty is not null and isnumeric( @sP_minordqty ) = 0
    begin
        set @sP_chk = N'999'
        return
    end

INSERT INTO r5catalogue
           (cat_part
           ,cat_part_org
           ,cat_supplier
           ,cat_supplier_org
           ,cat_ref
           ,cat_desc
           ,cat_curr
           ,cat_minordqty
           ,cat_leadtime
           ,cat_gross
           ,cat_puruom)
    VALUES (@sP_part
           ,@sV_Supplier_org
           ,@sV_Supplier
           ,@sV_Supplier_org
           ,@sP_ref
           ,@sP_desc
           ,N'USD'
           ,cast( @sP_minordqty as numeric(24,6))
           ,@sP_lead
           ,@sP_price
           ,@sP_uom)
SET @nError = @@ERROR
IF @nError = 0
    begin
        /* The newly generated identity number needs to be returned */
        SELECT @sP_rowid = MAX(cat_sqlidentity) FROM r5catalogue
        RETURN
    end

DB_ERROR:
/* skip  dup_val_on_index check  */
IF @nError IN (2601, 2627) /* Duplicate value on index*/
   SET @sP_chk = N'5'
ELSE
   SET @sP_chk = N'999'

END

create PROCEDURE O7IPASSOC
  @sUser          nvarchar(255),  -- Current user
  @sRorg          nvarchar(15),  -- requisition/purchase order org
  @sPart          nvarchar(30),  -- part number, null in, new N number out
  @sPorg          nvarchar(15),  -- part org
  @sVendor        nvarchar(38),  -- iProcure vendor number
  @sRef           nvarchar(50),  -- iProcure reference number
  @sDesc          nvarchar(2000),  -- iProcure vendor part description
  @sPrice         nvarchar(31),  -- iProcure price
  @sCurrency	  nvarchar(3),  -- currency
  @sMinordqty     nvarchar(31),  -- iProcure minimum order quantity
  @sLead          nvarchar(6),  -- iProcure lead time
  @sUom           nvarchar(30)
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nSQLID         integer
	declare @sChk           nvarchar(4)
	declare @sSupplier      nvarchar(30)	--r5companies.com_code%TYPE
	declare @sSupplier_org  nvarchar(15)	--r5companies.com_org%TYPE
	declare @sVuom           nvarchar(30)	--r5uoms.uom_code%TYPE
	declare @nReturn	integer

    SELECT @sSupplier = c.com_code, @sSupplier_org = c.com_org
      FROM r5userorganization u, r5companies c, r5organization o
     WHERE c.com_notused = N'-'
       AND c.com_purchasesite = N'+'
       AND c.com_org = u.uog_org
       AND u.uog_user = @sUser
       AND u.uog_org = o.org_code
       AND ( o.org_common = N'+' OR
             u.uog_org = @sRorg )
       AND c.com_ipvendor = convert(numeric(38,0),@sVendor)
     ORDER BY o.org_common DESC, o.org_code ASC, com_ipvendor

	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
	    RETURN

	set @sVuom = @sUom
	EXECUTE @nReturn = O7IPUOM  @sVuom OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
	   RETURN -1

    --prevent conversion error;  all when others blocks return out
    if ( @sMinordqty is not null and isnumeric( @sMinordqty ) = 0 ) or
        ( @sLead is not null and isnumeric( @sLead ) = 0 ) or
        ( @sPrice is not null and isnumeric( @sPrice ) = 0 )
        return

    SELECT @nSQLID = cat_sqlidentity
    FROM   r5catalogue c
    WHERE  c.cat_supplier = @sSupplier
    AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sSupplier_org
    AND    c.cat_part_org = @sRorg
	AND	   c.cat_part = @sPart 
	
	If @@ROWCOUNT > 0 --@nSQLID will not be null if a row came back
		UPDATE r5catalogue
		SET cat_part = @sPart, cat_part_org = @sPorg, cat_supplier = @sSupplier,
	 		cat_supplier_org = @sSupplier_org, cat_ref = @sRef,
			cat_desc = @sDesc, cat_curr = @sCurrency, cat_minordqty = convert(numeric(24,6), @sMinordqty),
			cat_leadtime = convert(numeric(4,1), @sLead), cat_gross = convert(numeric(24,6), @sPrice), cat_puruom = @sVuom
		WHERE cat_sqlidentity = @nSQLID
	else
		INSERT INTO r5catalogue (	cat_part, cat_part_org, cat_supplier, cat_supplier_org,
									cat_ref, cat_desc, cat_curr, cat_minordqty, cat_leadtime, cat_gross, cat_puruom )
		VALUES ( @sPart, @sPorg, @sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @sRef, @sDesc, @sCurrency, convert(numeric(24,6), @sMinordqty ), @sLead, @sPrice, @sVuom )

O7IPERCK

create PROCEDURE O7IPERCK
   @sType          nvarchar(15),
   @sCode          nvarchar(30),
   @sOrg           nvarchar(15),
   @sLine          nvarchar(8),
   @sRev           nvarchar(4),
   @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

declare    @sResult nvarchar(1)
begin
	set @sResult  = NULL

	set @sChk          = N'0'

	if @sCode      IS NULL OR @sOrg       IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	if @sType = N'POSUBMIT'
		begin
			/* Check the order status */
			set @sResult = NULL

			SELECT @sResult = N'X'
			FROM   r5orders ord
			WHERE  ord.ord_code = @sCode
			AND    ord.ord_org  = @sOrg
			AND    ord.ord_rstatus = N'A'


			if @sResult IS NULL
				begin
					set @sChk = N'12'
					RETURN
				end

			/* Check if there are external repair parts */
			set @sResult = NULL
			SELECT @sResult = N'X'
			FROM   r5orderlines orl
			WHERE  orl.orl_order = @sCode
			AND    orl.orl_order_org = @sOrg
			AND    orl.orl_rtype = N'RE'
			AND    orl.orl_rstatus = N'A'

			if @sResult IS NOT NULL
				begin
					set @sChk = N'13'
					RETURN
				end

			/* Check the order supplier is associated to an iProcure Vendor */
			set @sResult = NULL

			SELECT @sResult = N'X'
			FROM   r5orders ord, r5companies com, r5ipvendors ipv
			WHERE  ord.ord_code = @sCode
			AND    ord.ord_org  = @sOrg
			AND    ord.ord_supplier = com.com_code
			AND    ord.ord_supplier_org = com.com_org
			AND    com.com_ipvendor = ipv.ipv_code
			AND    ord.ord_rstatus = N'A'


			if @sResult IS NULL
				begin
					set @sChk = N'2'
					RETURN
				end

			/* Check for the existence of confirmation address*/
			set @sResult = NULL
			SELECT @sResult = N'X'
			FROM r5address mail right outer join r5companies com on ( mail.adr_code = N'*#' + com.com_org and mail.adr_rentity = N'COMP' and mail.adr_rtype = N'M'),
				 r5address poem right outer join r5entities ent on ( poem.adr_code = ent.ent_rentity and poem.adr_rentity = N'ENT' and poem.adr_rtype = N'M' ),
				 r5orders ord left outer join r5address strm  on (strm.adr_code = ord.ord_store and strm.adr_rentity = N'STOR' and strm.adr_rtype = N'M')
				              left outer join r5address porm on (porm.adr_code = ord.ord_code + N'#' + ord.ord_org and porm.adr_rentity = N'PORD' and porm.adr_rtype = N'M')
			WHERE  ord.ord_code = @sCode
			AND    ord.ord_org  = @sOrg
			AND    ord.ord_supplier = com.com_code
			AND    ord.ord_supplier_org = com.com_org
			AND    ent.ent_table = N'R5ORDERS'
			AND    NOT (mail.adr_address1 IS NULL AND poem.adr_address1 IS NULL AND strm.adr_address1 IS NULL AND porm.adr_address1 IS NULL)

			if @sResult IS NULL
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					RETURN
				end

			/* Check for the existence of billing address*/
			set @sResult = NULL

			SELECT @sResult = N'X'
			FROM r5address bill right outer join r5companies com on (bill.adr_code = N'*#' + com.com_org AND bill.adr_rentity = N'COMP' AND bill.adr_rtype = N'I'),
				 r5address poei right outer join r5entities ent on (poei.adr_code = ent.ent_rentity AND poei.adr_rentity = N'ENT' AND poei.adr_rtype = N'I'),
				 r5orders ord left outer join r5address stri on (stri.adr_code = ord.ord_store AND stri.adr_rentity  = N'STOR'  AND stri.adr_rtype = N'I')

create FUNCTION O7IPGTCL (
 @sOrder          nvarchar(30),
 @sOrderorg       nvarchar(15))
returns nvarchar(3)
as
begin

	declare @sClause	nvarchar(2000)
	declare @nCnt		integer
	declare @sText		nvarchar(80)
	set @nCnt = 1

	declare c_Localcur cursor local for SELECT d.des_text 
									FROM   r5ordclauses o, r5descriptions d
									WHERE  o.orc_order = @sOrder
									AND    o.orc_order_org = @sOrderorg
									AND    o.orc_clause = d.des_code
									AND    d.des_rentity = N'CLAU'
									AND    d.des_lang    = N'EN'
	open c_Localcur
	fetch next from c_Localcur into	@sText

	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
			set @sClause = @sClause + cast(@nCnt as nvarchar(38) ) + N') N' + @sText + N' N'
			set @nCnt = @nCnt + 1
			fetch next from c_Localcur into	@sText
		end
	close c_Localcur
	deallocate c_Localcur

	RETURN (@sClause)
END

create function O7IPGTXT(   @sType      nvarchar(4),
                            @sOrder     nvarchar(100),
                            @sOrderorg  nvarchar(100),
                            @nOrdline   int = null      ) 
returns nvarchar(4000)
as
begin
    declare @sText              nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sLang              nvarchar(10)
    declare @nCommentscnt       int
    declare @nTotalCommentscnt  int
    declare @nChkMaxlength      int
    declare @nIPMaxlength       int
    declare @sActualtext        nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sTemptext          nvarchar(4000)

    set @sText             = null
    set @nCommentscnt      = 1
    set @nTotalCommentscnt = 1
    set @nIPMaxlength      = 4000



    if @sType = 'PORL' 
      set @nipmaxlength = 2000

    if @sType in ( 'PORD', 'PORL' )
      SELECT  @nTotalCommentscnt = count(*)
      FROM    r5addetails addt
      WHERE   addt.add_rentity = @sType
      AND     addt.add_rtype = N'*'
      AND     addt.add_code = CASE @sType WHEN N'PORD' THEN @sOrder + N'#' + @sOrderorg ELSE @sOrder + N'#' + @sOrderorg + N'#' + isnull( cast( @nOrdline as nvarchar(38)), N'') END

      declare cComments cursor local for
        SELECT  add_text, add_lang
        FROM    r5addetails addt
        WHERE   addt.add_rentity = @sType
        AND     addt.add_rtype = N'*'
        AND     addt.add_code = CASE @sType WHEN N'PORD' THEN @sOrder + N'#' + @sOrderorg ELSE @sOrder + N'#' + @sOrderorg + N'#' + isnull( cast( @nOrdline as nvarchar(38)), N'') END

        open cComments
        fetch next from cComments into @sActualtext,@sLang
        while @@fetch_status = 0
        begin
          if @nTotalCommentscnt = 1
            set @sText = substring( @sActualtext, 1, @nIPMaxlength )
          else
            begin
              set @sTemptext = 'C'+ cast(@nCommentscnt as varchar(10))  + '_'+ @sLang +': ' + @sActualtext;
              if @nCommentscnt = 1 
                begin
                  set @sText = substring( @sTemptext, 1, @nIPMaxlength )
                  set @nChkMaxlength = len( @sText );
                end
              else
                begin
                  set @sText =  substring( @sText +' '+ @sTemptext, 1, @nIPMaxlength ) 
                  set @nChkMaxlength = len( @sText );
                end
                set @nCommentscnt = @nCommentscnt + 1
                if ( @nChkMaxlength = @nIPMaxlength ) 
                  break 
            end
          fetch next from cComments into @sActualtext, @sLang
        end
        close cComments
        deallocate cComments

    if @sType = N'PORLC'
        SELECT  @sText = substring( add_text, 1, 2000 )
        FROM    r5addetails addt
        WHERE   addt.add_rentity = N'PORL'
        AND     addt.add_rtype = N'*'
        AND     addt.add_code = @sOrder + N'#' + @sOrderorg + N'#' + isnull( cast( @nOrdline as nvarchar(38)), N'')
        AND     addt.add_lang = N'EN'
        AND     addt.add_line = ( SELECT  MAX(add_line)
                                  FROM    r5addetails addt
                                  WHERE   addt.add_rentity = N'PORL'
                                  AND     addt.add_rtype = N'*'
                                  AND     addt.add_code = @sOrder + N'#' + @sOrderorg + N'#' + isnull( cast( @nOrdline as nvarchar(38)), N'')
                                  AND     addt.add_lang = N'EN' );

    return @sText
end

declare    @sResult nvarchar(1)

				 r5address strm right outer join r5orders ord on (strm.adr_code = ord.ord_store and strm.adr_rentity = N'STOR' and strm.adr_rtype = N'M')
			WHERE  ord.ord_code = @sCode

			AND    ord.ord_supplier = com.com_code

			AND    ent.ent_table = N'R5ORDERS'
			AND    NOT (mail.adr_address1 IS NULL AND poem.adr_address1 IS NULL AND strm.adr_address1 IS NULL)

			if @sResult IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					RETURN
				end

			/* Check for the existence of billing address*/
			set @sResult = NULL

			SELECT @sResult = N'X'
			FROM r5address bill right outer join r5companies com on (bill.adr_code = N'*#' + com.com_org AND bill.adr_rentity = N'COMP' AND bill.adr_rtype = N'I'),
				 r5address poei right outer join r5entities ent on (poei.adr_code = ent.ent_rentity AND poei.adr_rentity = N'ENT' AND poei.adr_rtype = N'I'),

			if @sResult IS NULL

			/* Check if account or credit card information has been specified*/

			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0

			/* Check if the order is an iporder */

			SELECT @sResult = N'X'
			FROM   r5iporders
			WHERE  ponum = @sCode

			IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0

	ELSE

create procedure O7IPROCURE_O7SETLINESPOST	@sWhere nvarchar(4000), @sView nvarchar(100), @nStatus numeric(38,0)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

    declare @sSqlstmt       nvarchar(4000)
    declare @sVwhere        nvarchar(2000)
    declare @nPos           integer
    declare @sAfter         nvarchar(1000)
    declare @nNos           integer


    set @nPos = charindex( N' AND UOG_USER =', @sWhere,  0 )        /* Position of user clause*/
    set @sAfter = SUBSTRING( @sWhere, @nPos, len(@sWhere) )         /* Conditions after user clause */
    set @sVwhere = SUBSTRING( @sWhere, 1, @nPos )                   /* where clause upto user clause */
    set @nPos = charindex( '''', @sAfter,  1 )                      /* Position of end quote of user clause*/
    set @nPos = charindex( '''', @sAfter,  @nPos + 1 )                      /* Position of end quote of user clause*/
    set @sAfter = SUBSTRING( @sAfter, @nPos + 1 , len(@sAfter))
    set @sVwhere = @sVwhere + @sAfter                               /* where clause after removing user clause */

    IF lower( @sView ) = 'r5iporderpriceupdates' 
        begin
            /* #5 Lines not received from 7iBuy
            #6 Commnunication error */
            set @sSqlstmt = N'UPDATE r5orderlines '+
                N'SET orl_ipupdatestatus = '+ cast(@nStatus as nvarchar(38)) +
                N' WHERE  ( orl_order, orl_order_org, orl_ordline ) IN '+
                  N'( SELECT  b.ord_code, b.ord_org, b.orl_ordline '+
                    N'FROM r5iporderpriceupdates b '+
                     @sVwhere + ')' +
                N'AND orl_ipupdatestatus = 4'
            EXEC(@sSqlstmt)
        end

    ELSE
        begin
            IF lower( @sView ) = 'r5iprequisitionpriceupdates' 
                begin
                    /* #5 Lines not received from 7iBuy
                     #6 Commnunication error */
                    set @sSqlstmt = N'UPDATE r5requislines '+

                            N'AND rql_ipupdatestatus = 4 '
                    EXEC(@sSqlstmt)
                end
        end

     IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 
        COMMIT

    set @sAfter = SUBSTRING( @sWhere, @nPos, len(@sWhere) )         /* Conditions after user clause */

    set @sVwhere = SUBSTRING( @sWhere, 1, @nPos ) /* where clause upto user clause */
    set @nPos = charindex( '''', @sAfter, 1 )  --FIND The 1st occurance.
    set @nPos = charindex( '''', @sAfter, @nPos + 1 )  --FIND THE 2nd occurance.
    /* Position of end quote of user clause*/

    set @sAfter = SUBSTRING( @sAfter, @nPos + 1, len(@sAfter) )

            set @sSqlstmt = N'UPDATE r5orderlines a '+
                    N'SET orl_ipupdatestatus = 1 '+
                    N'WHERE  ( a.orl_order, a.orl_order_org, a.orl_ordline ) IN '+
                      N'( SELECT  b.orl_order, b.orl_order_org, b.orl_ordline '+
                        N'FROM r5orderlines b, r5orders, r5userorganization '+
                         @sWhere +
                        N'AND  ord_code = orl_order '+
                        N'AND  ord_org  = orl_order_org '+
                        N'AND  uog_org  = ord_org '+
                        N'AND  orl_supplier NOT IN ( SELECT com_code FROM r5companies WHERE com_ipvendor IS NOT NULL AND com_code = orl_supplier AND com_org = orl_supplier_org ))'+
                    N'AND orl_rstatus = ''U''    AND orl_rtype IN ( ''PS'', ''PD'' )'+
                    N'AND ( a.orl_order, a.orl_order_org ) IN '+
                      N'( SELECT  c.orl_order, c.orl_order_org '+
                        N'FROM r5orderlines c, r5orders, r5userorganization '+
                         @sWhere +
                        N'AND  ord_code = orl_order '+
                        N'AND  ord_org  = orl_order_org '+
                        N'AND  uog_org = ord_org '+
                        N'AND  orl_supplier IN ( SELECT com_code FROM r5companies WHERE com_ipvendor IS NOT NULL AND com_code = orl_supplier AND com_org = orl_supplier_org ))'
            EXEC(@sSqlstmt)

            /* #2, Reference is null for a 7ibuy supplier */
            set @sSqlstmt = N'UPDATE r5orderlines a '+
                    N'SET orl_ipupdatestatus = 2 '+
                    N'WHERE  ( orl_order, orl_order_org, orl_ordline ) IN '+
                      N'( SELECT  b.orl_order, b.orl_order_org, b.orl_ordline '+
                        N'FROM r5orderlines b, r5orders, r5userorganization '+
                         @sWhere +
                        N'AND  ord_code = orl_order '+
                        N'AND  ord_org  = orl_order_org '+
                        N'AND  uog_org = ord_org '+
                        N'AND  orl_supplier IN ( SELECT com_code FROM r5companies WHERE com_ipvendor IS NOT NULL AND com_code = orl_supplier AND com_org = orl_supplier_org )) '+
                    N'AND a.orl_rstatus = ''U''    AND a.orl_rtype IN ( ''PS'', ''PD'' ) '+
                    N'AND a.orl_ref IS NULL '
            EXEC(@sSqlstmt)

            /* #3, Reference is inconsistent for a 7ibuy supplier */
            set @sSqlstmt = N'UPDATE r5orderlines a '+
                    N'SET orl_ipupdatestatus = 3 '+
                    N'WHERE  ( orl_order, orl_order_org, orl_ordline ) IN '+
                      N'( SELECT  b.orl_order, b.orl_order_org, b.orl_ordline '+
                        N'FROM r5orderlines b, r5orders, r5userorganization '+
                         @sWhere +
                        N'AND  ord_code = orl_order '+
                        N'AND  ord_org  = orl_order_org '+
                        N'AND  uog_org = ord_org '+
                        N'AND  orl_supplier IN ( SELECT com_code FROM r5companies WHERE com_ipvendor IS NOT NULL AND com_code = orl_supplier AND com_org = orl_supplier_org )) '+
                    N'AND a.orl_rstatus = ''U''    AND a.orl_rtype IN ( ''PS'', ''PD'' ) '+
                    N'AND a.orl_ref  IS NOT NULL '+
                    N'AND NOT EXISTS ' +
                      N'( SELECT cat_ref ' +
                        N'FROM r5catalogue '+
                        N'WHERE cat_ref          = orl_ref ' +
                        N'AND   cat_supplier     = orl_supplier '+
                        N'AND   cat_supplier_org = orl_supplier_org )'
            EXEC(@sSqlstmt)

            /* #4, Lines to be sent to 7iBuy */
            set @sSqlstmt = N'UPDATE r5orderlines a '+
                    N'SET orl_ipupdatestatus = 4 '+
                    N'WHERE  ( orl_order, orl_order_org, orl_ordline ) IN '+
                      N'( SELECT  b.ord_code, b.ord_org, b.orl_ordline '+
                        N'FROM r5iporderpriceupdates b '+
                         @sVwhere + N')'
            EXEC(@sSqlstmt)

        end
    ELSE
        begin
            IF @sFunc = N'SMREQS' 
                begin
                    /* #1, Supplier not a 7iBuy supplier when one of the lines contain a buy supplier */
                    set @sSqlstmt = N'UPDATE r5requislines a '+
                            N'SET rql_ipupdatestatus = 1 '+
                            N'WHERE  ( rql_req, rql_reqline ) IN '+
                              N'( SELECT  b.rql_req, b.rql_reqline '+
                                N'FROM r5requisitions, r5requislines b, r5userorganization '+
                                 @sWhere +
                                N'AND  b.rql_req = req_code '+
                                N'AND  uog_org = req_org ) '+
                            N'AND rql_supplier NOT IN ( SELECT com_code FROM r5companies WHERE com_ipvendor IS NOT NULL AND com_code = rql_supplier AND com_org = rql_supplier_org ) '+
                            N'AND rql_rstatus = ''U'' AND rql_rtype IN ( ''PS'', ''PD'' )' +
                            N'AND rql_req IN ( SELECT  rql_req '+
                                N'FROM r5requisitions, r5requislines, r5userorganization '+
                                 @sWhere +
                                N'AND  rql_req = req_code '+
                                N'AND  uog_org = req_org  '+
                                N'AND  rql_supplier IN ( SELECT com_code FROM r5companies WHERE com_ipvendor IS NOT NULL AND com_code = rql_supplier AND com_org = rql_supplier_org )) '
                    EXEC(@sSqlstmt)

                    /* #2, Reference is null for a 7ibuy supplier */
                    set @sSqlstmt = N'UPDATE r5requislines a '+
                            N'SET rql_ipupdatestatus = 2 '+
                            N'WHERE  ( rql_req, rql_reqline ) IN '+
                              N'( SELECT  b.rql_req, b.rql_reqline '+
                                N'FROM r5requisitions, r5requislines b, r5userorganization '+
                                 @sWhere +
                                N'AND  rql_req = req_code '+
                                N'AND  uog_org = req_org ) '+
                            N'AND rql_supplier IN ( SELECT com_code FROM r5companies WHERE com_ipvendor IS NOT NULL AND com_code = rql_supplier AND com_org = rql_supplier_org ) '+
                            N'AND rql_rstatus = ''U'' AND rql_rtype IN ( ''PS'', ''PD'' ) ' +
                            N'AND rql_ref IS NULL '
                    EXEC(@sSqlstmt)

                    /* #3, Reference is inconsistent for a 7ibuy supplier */
                    set @sSqlstmt = N'UPDATE r5requislines a '+
                            N'SET rql_ipupdatestatus = 3 '+

CREATE PROCEDURE O7IPUOM    @sUom   nvarchar(255)   OUTPUT,
                            @sChk   nvarchar(6)     OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nUomlen    int
    declare @nDeslen    int

    set @sChk = N'0'

    if @sUom is null
        begin
            set @sChk = N'1'
            return
        end

    select @nUomlen = data_length
      from user_tab_columns
     where table_name = N'R5UOMS' and column_name = N'UOM_CODE'

    select @nDeslen = data_length
      from user_tab_columns
     where table_name = N'R5UOMS' and column_name = N'UOM_DESC'

    set @sUom = upper( substring( @sUom, 1, isnull( @nUomlen, 30) ) )

    --prevent dup_val_on_index error that we can't trap in SQL Server
    if not exists ( select 1 from r5uoms where uom_code = @sUom )
        begin
            insert into r5uoms ( uom_code, uom_desc, uom_notused )
                values ( @sUom, substring( N'iProcure: ' + @sUom, 1, isnull( @nDeslen, 80) ), N'-' )

            if @@ERROR <> 0
                set @sChk = N'999'
        end

CREATE FUNCTION O7ISASSETONPORECEIPTLINE (
    @sAsset		     nvarchar(30),
    @sAssetorg       nvarchar(15),
    @sDockCode       nvarchar(30),
    @sDockLine       nvarchar(8)
  )
  returns nvarchar
as
begin
    declare @sReturn		nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCount			integer


	set @sReturn = N'-'

	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM r5docklines
	WHERE dkl_object = @sAsset
	AND   dkl_object_org = @sAssetorg
	AND   (dkl_dckcode <> @sDockCode
	OR    dkl_line <> @sDockLine)
	AND   dkl_linerstatus NOT IN ( N'A', N'C' )

	IF @nCount = 0
		set @sReturn = N'-'
	ELSE
		set @sReturn = N'+'

	return @sReturn
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7ISCHILDROUTESEGMENT(
  @parentcode           NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @parentorg            NVARCHAR( 15 ),  
  @childcode            NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @childorg             NVARCHAR( 15 ))
  RETURNS               NVARCHAR( 1 ) AS
BEGIN
  IF @parentcode = @childcode AND @parentorg = @childorg 
    RETURN '-'

  DECLARE @ischild  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  SET @ischild = '-'
  DECLARE routesegment CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
  SELECT '+' FROM  r5objlinearref
  WHERE lrf_objcode = @parentcode 
  AND   lrf_objorg = @parentorg
  AND   lrf_linear_reftype  IN ('S', 'R')
  AND   lrf_re_objcode = @childcode
  AND   lrf_re_objorg  = @childorg
  UNION
  SELECT '+'
  FROM   r5objlinearref ref1
  WHERE  ref1.lrf_linear_reftype ='S' 
  AND    ref1.lrf_re_objcode = @childcode
  AND    ref1.lrf_re_objorg = @childorg
  AND    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5objlinearref ref2 
                 WHERE ref2.lrf_re_objcode = ref1.lrf_objcode 
                 AND   ref2.lrf_objcode = @parentcode
                 AND   ref2.lrf_objorg  = @parentorg 
                 AND   ref2.lrf_linear_reftype ='R')
                 
  OPEN routesegment
  FETCH NEXT FROM routesegment INTO @ischild
  CLOSE routesegment
  DEALLOCATE routesegment
  
  RETURN @ischild
END

create function O7ISSQTY(  @sEvent   nvarchar(30),
							@nAct     numeric(8),
							@sPart    nvarchar(30),
							@sPartorg nvarchar(15),
							@sStore   nvarchar(15),
							@sDirect  nvarchar(1) = null)
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
	declare @nResult		numeric(24,6)


	--MUST WRAP THE SELECT SINCE YOU CAN NOT HAVE A GOUP BY WITH A COALESCE IN SQLSERVER

	SELECT	@nResult = SUM( coalesce( z.trl_qty, 0 ) ) - CASE @sDirect WHEN '-' THEN 0 ELSE dbo.o7retqty ( z.code, z.trl_act, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sStore ) END
	from
		(select l.trl_qty, coalesce(e.evt_routeparent, t.tra_tocode) code, l.trl_act
		FROM	r5translines    l,
				r5transactions  t,
				r5events e
		WHERE  t.tra_rstatus     = N'A'
		AND    l.trl_trans       = t.tra_code
		AND    t.tra_torentity   = N'EVNT'
	    AND    t.tra_tocode IN (select evt_code from r5events WHERE evt_routeparent = @sEvent UNION select @sEvent from dual)
		AND    l.trl_act         = @nAct
		AND    coalesce(l.trl_issuedpart, l.trl_part) = @sPart
		AND    l.trl_part_org    = @sPartorg
		AND   (l.trl_store       = @sStore OR ( trl_io = 0 AND @sStore IS NULL ) )
		AND    t.tra_fromrentity = CASE l.trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN N'COMP' ELSE t.tra_fromrentity END
		AND    l.trl_rtype IN ( N'I', N'RECV' )
		AND     e.evt_code = t.tra_tocode
		AND ((  @sDirect IS NULL )
		     OR  (   l.trl_io =  0 AND     @sDirect = N'+' )
		     OR  (   l.trl_io <> 0 AND     @sDirect = N'-' ))) z
	GROUP BY z.code, z.trl_act

	return (@nResult)

end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ISSUEPACKAGE
  @package   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @issuedto  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @reference NVARCHAR( 45 ),
  @costcode  NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @tdate     DATETIME,
  @eamuser   NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @action    NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @chk       NVARCHAR( 4 ) OUTPUT
AS  
BEGIN
  DECLARE @cnt             NUMERIC
  DECLARE @chk2            NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @pk              NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @line            NUMERIC
  DECLARE @ustatus         NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @pkgorg          NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @pkgdesc         NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @tststore        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tsttocode       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @evtcostcode     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @evtproject      NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @evtprojbud      NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @tstpkey         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tstpart         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tstpartorg      NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tstbin          NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tstlot          NVARCHAR( 12 )
  DECLARE @tstact          NUMERIC
  DECLARE @tstreq          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tstreqline      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @tstorder        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tstorderorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tstordline      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @tstobject       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tstobjectorg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tstmanufacturer NVARCHAR( 24 )
  DECLARE @tstmanufactpart NVARCHAR( 50 )
  DECLARE @tstsupplier     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @tstsupplierorg  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @tstprice        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @pklqty          NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  SET @chk = N'0'

  SELECT @cnt = COUNT( * )
  FROM   r5package
  WHERE  pkg_code = @package
  AND    pkg_rstatus = CASE @action WHEN N'I' THEN N'A' ELSE N'I' END

  IF @cnt = 0 
    BEGIN
      /* The package provided is not valid. */
      SET @chk = N'1'
      RETURN
    END

  DECLARE tst CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT DISTINCT pkg_org, pkg_desc, tst_store, tst_tocode, evt_costcode, evt_project, evt_projbud
    FROM   r5events, r5transtock, r5package, r5packagelines
    WHERE  evt_code    = tst_tocode
    AND    pkg_code    = pkl_package
    AND    tst_pkey    = pkl_helditem
    AND    pkl_package = @package
    AND    @action     = N'I'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT pkg_org, pkg_desc, trl_store, pkl_event, evt_costcode, evt_project, evt_projbud
    FROM   r5events, r5translines, r5package, r5packagelines
    WHERE  evt_code      = pkl_event
    AND    pkg_code      = pkl_package
    AND    trl_helditem  = pkl_helditem
    AND    trl_package   = pkg_code
    AND    pkl_package   = @package
    AND    pkl_returnqty > 0
    AND    @action       = N'R'
  OPEN tst
  FETCH NEXT FROM tst INTO @pkgorg, @pkgdesc, @tststore, @tsttocode, @evtcostcode, @evtproject, @evtprojbud
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Loop through distinct Store/WO combinations, so the Transaction Header can be created first. */
      EXECUTE r5o7_o7maxseq @pk OUTPUT, N'TRAN', N'1', @chk2 OUTPUT
      INSERT INTO r5transactions( tra_code, tra_org, tra_desc, tra_auth, tra_rtype, tra_date, tra_rstatus, tra_printed, 
             tra_fromcode, tra_fromrentity, tra_fromrtype, tra_tocode, tra_torentity, tra_tortype, tra_pers, tra_advice )
      VALUES( @pk, @pkgorg, @pkgdesc, @eamuser, N'I', @tdate, N'A', N'-',
              @tststore, N'STOR', N'*', @tsttocode, N'EVNT', N'*', @issuedto, @reference )
      SET @line = 0

      DECLARE tst2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT tst_pkey, tst_part, tst_part_org, tst_bin, tst_lot, CAST( tst_act AS NUMERIC ), tst_req, tst_reqline, tst_order, tst_order_org, tst_ordline, 
               tst_object, tst_object_org, tst_manufacturer, tst_manufactpart, tst_supplier, tst_supplier_org, tst_price, pkl_qty
        FROM   r5transtock, r5packagelines
        WHERE  tst_pkey    = pkl_helditem 
        AND    pkl_package = @package
        AND    tst_store   = @tststore
        AND    tst_tocode  = @tsttocode
        AND    @action     = N'I'
        UNION
        SELECT trl_helditem, trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_bin, trl_lot, pkl_act, trl_req, trl_reqline, trl_order, trl_order_org, trl_ordline, 
               trl_object, trl_object_org, trl_manufacturer, trl_manufactpart, trl_supplier, trl_supplier_org, trl_price, -pkl_returnqty
        FROM   r5translines, r5packagelines
        WHERE  trl_helditem  = pkl_helditem
        AND    trl_package   = pkl_package
        AND    pkl_package   = @package
        AND    pkl_event     = @tsttocode
        AND    pkl_returnqty > 0
        AND    trl_store     = @tststore
        AND    @action       = N'R'
      OPEN tst2
      FETCH NEXT FROM tst2 INTO @tstpkey, @tstpart, @tstpartorg, @tstbin, @tstlot, @tstact, @tstreq, @tstreqline, @tstorder, @tstorderorg, @tstordline, 
            @tstobject, @tstobjectorg, @tstmanufacturer, @tstmanufactpart, @tstsupplier, @tstsupplierorg, @tstprice, @pklqty
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          /* Loop trhough all lines belonging to the current header. */
          SET @line = @line + 10
          INSERT INTO r5translines( trl_trans, trl_rtype, trl_line, trl_date, trl_costcode, trl_project, trl_projbud, trl_event, trl_act,
                 trl_part, trl_part_org, trl_order, trl_order_org, trl_ordline, trl_req, trl_reqline, trl_object, trl_object_org,
                 trl_manufacturer, trl_manufactpart, trl_supplier, trl_supplier_org, trl_package, trl_helditem, 
                 trl_bin, trl_lot, trl_qty, trl_price, trl_io )
          VALUES ( @pk, N'I', @line, @tdate, COALESCE( @costcode, @evtcostcode ), @evtproject, @evtprojbud, @tsttocode, @tstact,
                   @tstpart, @tstpartorg, @tstorder, @tstorderorg, @tstordline, @tstreq, @tstreqline, @tstobject, @tstobjectorg,
                   @tstmanufacturer, @tstmanufactpart, @tstsupplier, @tstsupplierorg, @package, @tstpkey,
                   @tstbin, @tstlot, @pklqty, @tstprice, 0 )
          IF @action = N'R'
            /* When returning, reset return qty, and add to retruned qty. */
           UPDATE r5packagelines
           SET    pkl_returnqty = NULL,
                  pkl_returnedqty = COALESCE( pkl_returnedqty, 0 ) - @pklqty
           WHERE  pkl_package  = @package
           AND    pkl_helditem = @tstpkey
          FETCH NEXT FROM tst2 INTO @tstpkey, @tstpart, @tstpartorg, @tstbin, @tstlot, @tstact, @tstreq, @tstreqline, @tstorder, @tstorderorg, @tstordline, 
                @tstobject, @tstobjectorg, @tstmanufacturer, @tstmanufactpart, @tstsupplier, @tstsupplierorg, @tstprice, @pklqty
        END
      CLOSE tst2
      DEALLOCATE tst2
      FETCH NEXT FROM tst INTO @pkgorg, @pkgdesc, @tststore, @tsttocode, @evtcostcode, @evtproject, @evtprojbud
    END
  CLOSE tst
  DEALLOCATE tst

  /* Set the Package Status to Issued. */
  EXECUTE dbo.r5o7_o7ucode @ustatus OUTPUT, N'I', N'PGST', @chk OUTPUT
  UPDATE r5package
  SET    pkg_rstatus = N'I',
         pkg_status  = @ustatus
  WHERE  pkg_code = @package
  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7JOBCNT  @sSource		 nvarchar(8),
                           @sOrg         nvarchar(15),
                           @sR5user      nvarchar(255),
                           @sMrc         nvarchar(15),
                           @sPpm         nvarchar(20),
                           @sProject     nvarchar(20),
                           @sObjtp       nvarchar(4),
                           @sObject      nvarchar(30),
                           @sObjectorg   nvarchar(15),
                           @sLocation    nvarchar(30),
                           @sLocationorg nvarchar(15),
                           @sJobtype     nvarchar(8),
                           @sPriority    nvarchar(8),
                           @sTrade       nvarchar(15),
                           @sStatus      nvarchar(4),
                           @sOrigin      nvarchar(15),
                           @sRouter      nvarchar(255),
                           @sJob         nvarchar(30),
                           @dDatefrom    datetime,
                           @dDateto      datetime,
                           @sStatement   nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT,
                           @nObjcount    integer OUTPUT  

AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sExtra      nvarchar(2000)  /* extra part of select clause.          */
	declare @sFromstat   nvarchar(2000)  /* from @sStatement                        */
	declare @sNostclause nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause to exclude 'ST' jobtype    */
	declare @sSelclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* select @sStatement it self              */
	declare @sOrg2clause nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for multi org              */
	declare @sOrgclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for org                    */
	declare @sMrcclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for mrc                    */
	declare @sPpmclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for ppm                    */
	declare @sPrjclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for projects               */
	declare @sOtpclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for object type            */
	declare @sObjclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for objects                */
	declare @sLocclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for location               */
	declare @sJtpclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for job type               */
	declare @sPriclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for @sPriority               */
	declare @sTrdclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for trades                 */
	declare @sStaclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for default @sStatus         */
	declare @sStatclause nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for selected @sStatus        */
	declare @sOriclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for originator             */
	declare @sRouclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for routers                */
	declare @sJobclause  nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for job                    */
	declare @nJob_cnt    integer         /* job count                             */
	declare @sCharfrom   nvarchar(10)
	declare @sCharto     nvarchar(10)


	declare @sSQL				nvarchar(4000)  

	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N''), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'')

	set @sFromstat = ' from r5events e where '

	set @sSelclause = N'select @nObjcount = count(evt_code) '

	set @sExtra =  N' evt_target BETWEEN cast( ''' + @sCharfrom + N''' as datetime ) and ' + 
					N' cast( ''' + @sCharto + N''' as datetime )'

	set @sStatclause = N' AND EVT_RSTATUS NOT IN ( N''C'', N''Q'' ) '

	set @sNostclause = N' and evt_jobtype not in
			  ( select u.uco_code from r5ucodes u
				where  u.uco_rentity = N''JBTP''
				and    u.uco_rcode   = N''ST'' ) '

	IF @sOrg IS NULL 
		set @sOrgclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sOrgclause =  N' AND EVT_ORG LIKE N''' + @sOrg + ''''


	IF dbo.o7getmos( N'EVNT' ) = N'-' 
		set @sOrg2clause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sOrg2clause =  N' AND EVT_ORG IN ( SELECT uog_org ' +
								  N' FROM   r5userorganization ' +
								  N' WHERE  uog_user = N''' + @sR5user + ''' )'

	IF @sMrc IS NULL 
		set @sMrcclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sMrcclause =  N' AND EVT_MRC LIKE N''' + @sMrc + ''''

	IF @sPpm IS NULL 
		set @sPpmclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sPpmclause =  N' AND EVT_PPM LIKE N''' + @sPpm + ''''

	IF @sProject IS NULL 
		set @sPrjclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sPrjclause = N' AND EVT_project IN	( select prj_code from dbo.O7JOBCNT_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( ''' + @sProject + N''' ))'

	IF @sObjtp IS NULL 
		set @sOtpclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sOtpclause =  N' AND EVT_OBTYPE LIKE N''' + @sObjtp + ''''

	IF @sObject IS NULL 
		set @sObjclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sObjclause = N' AND EVT_CODE IN
		   ( SELECT EOB_EVENT
			 FROM   R5EVENTOBJECTS
			 WHERE  EOB_OBJECT = N''' + @sObject +  '''
			 AND    EOB_OBJECT_ORG = N''' + @sObjectorg + ''' )'

	IF @sLocation IS NULL 
		set @sLocclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sLocclause = N' AND ( EVT_LOCATION + N''#''+ EVT_LOCATION_ORG ) IN
			   ( SELECT STC_CHILD + N''#'' + STC_CHILD_ORG
				 from dbo.O7JOBCNT_GET_STC_HIERARCHY( ''' + @sLocation + N''', ' + @sLocationorg + N''' ))
				 UNION
				 SELECT N''' +  @sLocation + 'N''#''' +  @sLocationorg 


	IF @sJobtype IS NULL 
		set @sJtpclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sJtpclause =  N' AND EVT_JOBTYPE LIKE N''' + @sJobtype + ''''

	IF @sPriority IS NULL 
		set @sPriclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sPriclause =  N' AND EVT_PRIORITY LIKE N''' + @sPriority + ''''

	IF @sTrade IS NULL 
		set @sTrdclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sTrdclause =  N' AND EVT_CODE IN
				( SELECT ACT_EVENT
				  FROM   R5ACTIVITIES
				  WHERE  ACT_EVENT  = EVT_CODE
				  AND    ACT_TRADE  LIKE N''' +  @sTrade +  ''' )'

	IF @sStatus IS NULL 
		set @sStaclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sStatclause =  N' AND EVT_STATUS LIKE N''' + @sStatus + ''''

	IF @sOrigin IS NULL 
		set @sOriclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sOriclause =  N' AND EVT_ORIGIN LIKE N''' + @sOrigin + ''''

	IF @sRouter IS NULL 
		set @sRouclause = N''
	ELSE
		set @sRouclause =  ' AND EVT_SCREENER LIKE N''' + @sRouter + ''''

	IF @sJob IS NULL 
		set @sJobclause = N''
	ELSE
		set	@sJobclause =  ' AND EVT_CODE LIKE N''' + @sJob + ''''

	set @sStatement =  @sExtra     +
		 @sStaclause +
		 @sNostclause +
		 @sOrgclause +
		 @sOrg2clause +
		 @sMrcclause +
		 @sPpmclause +
		 @sPrjclause +
		 @sOtpclause +
		 @sObjclause +
		 @sLocclause +
		 @sJtpclause +
		 @sPriclause +
		 @sTrdclause +
		 @sStaclause +
		 @sStatclause +
		 @sOriclause +
		 @sRouclause +
		 @sJobclause 

	IF @sSource = N'STAT'  
		RETURN
	ELSE
		begin
			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sFromstat + @sStatement
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nObjcount int OUTPUT', @nObjcount OUTPUT
		end

create function O7JOBCNT_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(20))
returns @tReturn table( prj_code nvarchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(20)
		
	declare @tStack table ( prj_code nvarchar(20), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select prj_code, 1 from r5projects where prj_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = prj_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select PRJ_CODE, @nLevel + 1
										  from R5PROJECTS
										 where PRJ_PARENT = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7JOBCNT_GET_STC_HIERARCHY (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
												@sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( stc_child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15), 
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
				stc_child_org, 
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
				stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
												stc_child_org, 
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
												stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end
