body:
CREATE FUNCTION O7KBAQUERY(
  @eamuser        NVARCHAR( 255 ),              -- EAM User
  @lang           NVARCHAR( 2 ),                -- Language
  @org            NVARCHAR( 15 ),               -- Service Request Organization
  @searchcrit     NVARCHAR( 1000 ),             -- Search Criteria
  @searchtype     NVARCHAR( 1 ),                -- Search Type, K for Keyword or F for Full Text
  @obj            NVARCHAR( 30 ),               -- Service Request Equipment
  @objorg         NVARCHAR( 15 ),               -- Service Request Equipment Organization
  @pvalfilter     NVARCHAR( 1 ),                -- Validation Filter
  @department     NVARCHAR( 15 ),               -- Department
  @supplier       NVARCHAR( 30 ),               -- Supplier
  @supplierorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ),               -- Supplier Organization
  @servicecode    NVARCHAR( 30 ),               -- Service Problem 
  @servicecodeorg NVARCHAR( 15 ),               -- Service Problem Organization
  @servicecat     NVARCHAR( 30 ),               -- Service Category
  @servicecatorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ),               -- Service Category Organization
  @eamrole        NVARCHAR( 30 ) = '*' )        -- Role
RETURNS NVARCHAR( MAX ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @statement          NVARCHAR( MAX )   -- Select @statement
  DECLARE @validation         NVARCHAR( 1 )     -- Validation Method ( Department structure, simplified sdM, Service delivery matrix )
  DECLARE @srcommon           NVARCHAR( 1 )     -- Is the Organization of the Service Request common?
  DECLARE @objcommon          NVARCHAR( 1 )     -- Is the Organization of the Equipment common?
  DECLARE @objsdmpath         NVARCHAR( 1 )     -- Is the Equipment flagged as SDM?
  DECLARE @objsdmpresent      NVARCHAR( 1 )     -- Does the Equipment have SDM records?
  DECLARE @sdmobj             NVARCHAR( 30 )    -- The Equipment to use for SDM (could be a parent of the Service Request Equipment )
  DECLARE @sdmobjorg          NVARCHAR( 15 )    -- The Equipment Organization to use fr SDM
  DECLARE @searchcolumn       NVARCHAR( 30 )    -- Column to search on, depends on serach type.
  DECLARE @controlorg         NVARCHAR( 15 )    -- Controlling Org.
  DECLARE @kbavalrv           NVARCHAR( 100 )   -- Install parameter to check if the validation parameter should be reverted.
  DECLARE @valfilter          NVARCHAR( 1 )     -- Validation Filter, '-' or '+'

  SET @srcommon  = N'+'
  SET @objcommon = N'+'
  SET @statement = N''

  SET @valfilter = @pvalfilter
  SET @kbavalrv  = dbo.o7dflt2( N'KBAVALRV' )
  IF SUBSTRING( UPPER( ISNULL( @kbavalrv, N'N' ) ), 1, 1 ) = N'Y'
    BEGIN
      /* Revert the validation filter. */
      IF @valfilter = N'-'
        SET @valfilter = N'+'
      ELSE
        SET @valfilter = N'-'
    END

  IF @valfilter = N'+' AND @org IS NOT NULL 
    BEGIN
      /* If validation in necessary, retrieve the method. */
      SELECT @validation = cop_spcvalidation
      FROM   r5contactcenteroptions
      WHERE  cop_org = @org
    END

  IF @validation = N'M'
    BEGIN
      SET @statement = @statement + '
WITH objtree ( stc_parent, stc_parent_org ) AS (
  SELECT stc_parent, stc_parent_org
  FROM   r5structures
  WHERE  stc_child = ''' + COALESCE( @obj, '' ) + '''
  AND    stc_child_org = ''' + COALESCE( @objorg, '' ) + ''' 
  UNION ALL
  SELECT s.stc_parent, s.stc_parent_org
  FROM   r5structures s 
         JOIN objtree ON ( objtree.stc_parent = s.stc_child AND objtree.stc_parent_org = s.stc_child_org ) ) '
    END  

  /* Determine the column to search on. */
  IF @searchtype = N'K'
    /* Key words. */
    SET @searchcolumn = N'kbd_keywords'
  ELSE
    SET @searchcolumn = N'kbd_text'

  SET @statement = @statement + '
SELECT kba_code, kba_org, kba_desc, kba_status, kba_serviceproblem, kba_serviceproblem_org, kba_mrc, 
kba_supplier, kba_supplier_org, kba_servicecategory, kba_servicecategory_org, 
dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( N''' + @lang + ''', N''UCOD'', kba_status, N''KBST'', NULL ) statusdesc, 
dbo.o7getsearchscore( ' + @searchcolumn + ', ''' + @searchcrit + ''' , NULL ) searchscore
FROM r5kbarticles
     LEFT OUTER JOIN r5mrcs LEFT OUTER JOIN r5organization om ON ( om.org_code = mrc_org ) ON ( mrc_code = kba_mrc )
     LEFT OUTER JOIN r5organization op ON ( op.org_code = kba_serviceproblem_org )
     LEFT OUTER JOIN r5organization os ON ( os.org_code = kba_supplier_org )
     LEFT OUTER JOIN r5organization oc ON ( oc.org_code = kba_servicecategory_org ),
     r5kbarticledetails, 
     r5userorganization 
WHERE kba_rstatus <> N''O''
AND uog_user = ''' + @eamuser + ''' 
AND uog_role = ''' + @eamrole + ''' 
AND kba_org = uog_org '

  SELECT @srcommon = org_common
  FROM   r5organization
  WHERE  org_code = @org
  IF @srcommon = N'-'
    BEGIN
      /* Make sure no two different specific orgs are used. */
      SET @controlorg = @org
      SET @statement = @statement + '
AND NOT ( uog_common = N''-'' AND kba_org <> N''' + @org + ''' ) '
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @objorg IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          SELECT @objcommon = org_common
          FROM   r5organization
          WHERE  org_code = @objorg
          IF @objcommon = N'-'
            BEGIN
              /* Make sure no two different specific orgs are used. */
              SET @controlorg = @objorg
              SET @statement = @statement + '
AND NOT ( uog_common = N''-'' AND kba_org <> N''' + @objorg + ''' ) '
            END
        END
    END    

  /* Append extra org clauses. */
  IF @controlorg IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      SET @statement = @statement + '
AND NOT ( COALESCE( om.org_common, N''+'' ) = N''-'' AND mrc_org <> N''' + @controlorg + ''' )
AND NOT ( COALESCE( op.org_common, N''+'' ) = N''-'' AND kba_serviceproblem_org <> N''' + @controlorg + ''' )
AND NOT ( COALESCE( os.org_common, N''+'' ) = N''-'' AND kba_supplier_org <> N''' + @controlorg + ''' )
AND NOT ( COALESCE( oc.org_common, N''+'' ) = N''-'' AND kba_servicecategory_org <> N''' + @controlorg + ''' ) '
    END

  /* Append the always necessary AND clauses. */
  SET @statement = @statement + '
AND kba_code = kbd_kbarticle 
AND kba_org = kbd_kbarticle_org 
AND kbd_lang = N''' + @lang + '''
AND dbo.o7getsearchscore( ' + @searchcolumn + ', ''' + @searchcrit + ''', NULL ) > 0 '

  IF @department IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Append the Department AND clause. */
      SET @statement = @statement + '
AND kba_mrc = N''' + @department + ''' '
    END

  IF @supplier IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Append the Supplier AND clause. */
      SET @statement = @statement + '
AND kba_supplier = N''' + @supplier + ''' 
AND kba_supplier_org = N''' + @supplierorg + ''' '
    END

  IF @servicecode IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Append the Service Code AND clause. */
      SET @statement = @statement + '
AND kba_serviceproblem = N''' + @servicecode + '''
AND kba_serviceproblem_org = N''' + @servicecodeorg + ''' '
    END

  IF @servicecat IS NOT NULL 
    BEGIN
      /* Append the Service Category AND clause. */
      SET @statement = @statement + '
AND kba_servicecategory = N''' + @servicecat + ''' 
AND kba_servicecategory_org = N''' + @servicecatorg + ''' '
    END

  IF @validation = N'D' 
    BEGIN
      /* Append the Department Structure validation AND clause. */
      SET @statement = @statement + '
AND EXISTS( SELECT N''x'' 
            FROM r5departmentstructure
            WHERE dps_mrc = COALESCE( kba_mrc, dps_mrc )
            AND COALESCE( dps_servicecategory, N''x'' ) = COALESCE( kba_servicecategory, dps_servicecategory, N''x'' )
            AND COALESCE( dps_servicecategory_org, N''x'' ) = COALESCE( kba_servicecategory_org, dps_servicecategory_org, N''x'' )
            AND COALESCE( dps_supplier, N''x'' ) = COALESCE( kba_supplier, dps_supplier, N''x'' )
            AND COALESCE( dps_supplier_org, N''x'' ) = COALESCE( kba_supplier_org, dps_supplier_org, N''x'' )
            AND COA

   set @nParentSum = 0

   set @nTotalWeight = 0


   /* retrieve parameters. */

   IF @sPuser IS NOT NULL

                                    AND    hom_parent = N'-'

                                                AND    hmu_homcode = hom_code AND (@sManurefresh <>  N'A' OR (@sManurefresh = N'A' AND hmu_autofresh = N'+')))
                                          OR EXISTS ( select 'x'

                                    ORDER BY 1
   open c_updateablekpi

   while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
         set @bHasRows = 1

         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

name: O7KPISCORES_GET_HIERARCHY

create function O7KPISCORES_GET_HIERARCHY( )
returns @tReturn table( kpt_parent     nvarchar(24)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                  kpt_parenttype nvarchar(1)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                  nLevel         int )
as
begin
   DECLARE @nLevel         int
   DECLARE @sCurrentChild  nvarchar(24)
   DECLARE @sCurrentParent nvarchar(24)
   DECLARE @sCurrentType   nvarchar(1)

   declare @tStack table ( kpt_parent     nvarchar(24),
                     kpt_parenttype nvarchar(1),
                     kpt_child      nvarchar(24),
                     LevelID int )

   INSERT INTO @tStack
      select   kpt_parent, kpt_parenttype, kpt_child, 1
        from   r5kpistructure
       where   kpt_parent in ( select a.kpt_parent
                        from r5kpistructure a
                        where not exists ( select 'x'
                                    from r5kpistructure b
                                    where b.kpt_child = a.kpt_parent ) )
   SET @nLevel = 1

   WHILE @nLevel > 0
      BEGIN
         IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
            BEGIN
               select   @sCurrentParent   = kpt_parent,
                     @sCurrentType  = kpt_parenttype,
                     @sCurrentChild = kpt_child
                 from   @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
               insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentParent, @sCurrentType, @nLevel )
               delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND kpt_parent = @sCurrentParent and kpt_parenttype = @sCurrentType and kpt_child = @sCurrentChild
               insert into @tStack  select   kpt_parent, kpt_parenttype, kpt_child, @nLevel + 1
                                from   r5kpistructure
                               where   kpt_parent = @sCurrentChild
               IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                  SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
            END
         ELSE
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
      END
   return
end

create function O7KPISCORES_GET_HIERARCHY2( @sUser nvarchar(255), @sManurefresh nvarchar(1) )
returns @tReturn table( kpt_child      nvarchar(24)  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
   DECLARE @nLevel         int
   DECLARE @sCurrentChild  nvarchar(24)

   declare @tStack table ( kpt_child      nvarchar(24),
                     LevelID int )

   INSERT INTO @tStack
      select   kpt_child, 1
        from   r5kpistructure
       where   kpt_parent in ( select hmu_homcode
                        from r5homeusers
                        where hmu_user = @sUser and hmu_homtype = N'+' AND (@sManurefresh <>  N'A' OR (@sManurefresh = N'A' AND hmu_autofresh = N'+')))
   SET @nLevel = 1

   WHILE @nLevel > 0
      BEGIN
         IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
            BEGIN
               select   @sCurrentChild = kpt_child
                 from   @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
               insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentChild )
               delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND kpt_child = @sCurrentChild
               insert into @tStack  select   kpt_child, @nLevel + 1
                                from   r5kpistructure
                               where   kpt_parent = @sCurrentChild
               IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                  SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
            END
         ELSE
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
      END
   return
end

create function O7KPISCORES_NORMALSCORE(  @sKpicode   nvarchar(24),
                                 @sKpitype   nvarchar(1),
                                 @nValue     float )
returns float
as
begin
   declare @nPrevscore  float
   declare @sParent  nvarchar(1) --r5home.hom_parent%TYPE
   declare @nNormscore  float       --r5home.hom_normscore%TYPE
   declare @nCount      int
   declare @nMaxvalue   float       --r5kpiscores.kps_highvalue%TYPE
   declare @nMinvalue   float       --r5kpiscores.kps_lowvalue%TYPE

   declare @nLowvalue   float
   declare @nHighvalue  float
   declare @nScore      int

   select @sParent = hom_parent, @nNormscore = hom_normscore
   from r5home
   where hom_code = @sKpicode and hom_type = @sKpitype

     begin
      select @nCount = count(*)
      FROM r5kpiscores
      WHERE kps_homcode = @sKpicode
      AND kps_homtype      = @sKpitype
      AND kps_highvalue >= @nValue
      AND kps_lowvalue  <= @nValue

      if @nCount = 0
         return 0

      declare c_scores cursor local for select kps_lowvalue,kps_highvalue,kps_score
                                FROM   r5kpiscores
                                WHERE  kps_homcode = @sKpicode AND kps_homtype=@sKpitype
                                ORDER BY isnull(kps_lowvalue,0)
      open c_scores
      fetch next from c_scores into @nLowvalue, @nHighvalue, @nScore
      while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
         begin
            if @nValue between isnull( @nLowvalue, 0 ) and isnull( @nHighvalue, @nValue )
               begin
                  close c_scores
                  deallocate c_scores
                  return ( @nScore )
               end
            else
               begin
                  if @nValue < isnull( @nLowvalue, 0 )
                     begin
                        if @nLowvalue = abs( @nLowvalue )
                           break
                        else
                           begin
                              close c_scores
                              deallocate c_scores
                              return ( @nScore )
                           end
                     end
               end

            set @nPrevscore = @nScore

            fetch next from c_scores into @nLowvalue, @nHighvalue, @nScore
         end
      close c_scores
      deallocate c_scores
   end

   --SQL Server requires that the last line of a function be a return statement.
   --Therefore I picked one of the returns from above and just did a BREAK so that
   --the function could just fall out of the loop and return that value to satisify
   --Server.  However, the Oracle code has a bug in it where the function could finish
   --without returning a value which would produce an error in Oracle.  This workaround
   --does not mimic that functionality.  I am making an assumption that the developers
   --do not expect that the data stored in the tables in practice are going to cause
   --this bug to come to light.

   return ( @nPrevscore )
end

create procedure O7KPISCORES_UPDATEKPI @sKpicode   nvarchar(24),
                              @sKpitype   nvarchar(1),
                              @nCurvalue  float,
                              @nNormscore float,
                              @sErr    nvarchar(255),
                              @sManurefresh  nvarchar(1)= N'-'
as
   SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @sHistory nvarchar(1) --r5home.hom_history%type
   declare @nValue   float       --r5home.hom_curvalue%type
   declare @dGttime  datetime
   declare @nReturn  int

   select @sHistory = hom_history,
          @nValue   = isnull(hom_curvalue,0)
   FROM   r5home
   WHERE  hom_code = @sKpicode
   AND    hom_type = @sKpitype

   if @sManurefresh = N'+' OR @sManurefresh = N'A'
      begin
         if @nValue <> COALESCE(@nCurvalue, 0)
            begin
               UPDATE r5home
               SET      hom_curvalue = @nCurvalue,
                     hom_normscore = @nNormscore,
                     hom_error = @sErr
               WHERE  hom_code = @sKpicode
               AND    hom_type = @sKpitype
            end
      end
   else
      begin
         execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGttime OUTPUT, null
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1

         UPDATE r5home
         SET    hom_update = @dGttime,
               hom_nxtupdate = case when hom_updfreq is null then null else case when coalesce( hom_nxtupdate, @dGttime) + hom_updfreq > @dGttime then coalesce( hom_nxtupdate, @dGttime) + hom_updfreq else @dGttime end end,
               hom_curvalue = @nCurvalue,
               hom_normscore = @nNormscore,
               hom_error = @sErr
         WHERE  hom_code = @sKpicode
         AND    hom_type = @sKpitype

         if @sHistory = N'+'
            INSERT INTO r5kpihistory(kph_homcode, kph_homtype, kph_upddate, kph_value,kph_normscore)
            VALUES(@sKpicode, @sKpitype, @dGttime, @nCurvalue, @nNormscore)
      end

CREATE PROCEDURE o7laborrequistionpreview( 
  @org             NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @supplier        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @supplierorg     NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @cuser           NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @clanguage       NVARCHAR( 2 ),
  @store           NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @mrc             NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @event           NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @costcode        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @requestedby     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @defaultapprover NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @sessionid       NVARCHAR( 30 ) OUTPUT,
  @chk             NVARCHAR( 4 ) OUTPUT,
  @sAutoSelPrvRecs NVARCHAR( 1 ))
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @sessionnumber      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @today              DATETIME          -- = TRUNC(o7gttime( org ))
  DECLARE @check1             NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @reqdesc            NVARCHAR( 80 )    --r5install.ins_desc%type := o7dflt( 'REQDESC', check2 )
  DECLARE @error              NVARCHAR( 255 )   --r5errtexts.ert_text%type
  DECLARE @nReturn            INT
  
  DECLARE @workorder          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @multiequip         NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @reworkorder        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @reobject           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @reobjectorg        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @act                NUMERIC(8, 0)
  DECLARE @trade              NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @ordtype            NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @ordrtype           NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @task               NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @taskrev            NUMERIC( 4, 0 )
  DECLARE @patask             NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @actsupplier        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @actsupplierorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @actmrc             NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @startdatetime      DATETIME
  DECLARE @exchange           NUMERIC(24,12)
  DECLARE @currency           NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @price              NUMERIC(24,6)
  
  SET @today = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7GTTIME2( @org ), N'DD')
  SET @check1 = N'0'
  SET @reqdesc = dbo.o7dflt2( N'REQDESC' )
  SET @chk = N'0'
  
  SELECT @error = t.ert_text
  FROM   r5errtexts t, r5users u
  WHERE  t.ert_lang = u.usr_lang
  AND    t.ert_code = '35668'
  AND    u.usr_code = @cuser
  
  /*  get session id */
  IF @sessionid is not null
    BEGIN
      DELETE FROM r5templaborrequisitions WHERE tlr_sessionid = @sessionid
      SET @sessionnumber =  @sessionid
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      DELETE FROM r5templaborrequisitions WHERE tlr_date < @today - 5
      EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sessionnumber OUTPUT, N'BREP', 1, @check1 OUTPUT
        IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        RETURN -1
    END

  DECLARE chl CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT e.evt_code,
           e.evt_multiequip,
           re.evt_code,
           re.evt_object,
           re.evt_object_org,
           a.act_act,
           a.act_trade,
           a.act_ordtype,
           a.act_ordrtype,
           a.act_task,
           a.act_taskrev,
           pa.act_task,
           a.act_supplier,
           a.act_supplier_org,
           a.act_mrc,
           a.act_start,
           dbo.o7gtexch2(c.com_curr, @org, @today)
    FROM   r5activities a
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5events re ON ( a.act_relatedwo = re.evt_code )
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5activities pa ON ( a.act_event = pa.act_event AND a.act_parent = pa.act_act ) 
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5companies c ON ( c.com_code = a.act_supplier AND c.com_org  = a.act_supplier_org ) 
           LEFT OUTER JOIN r5tasks t
           ON ( COALESCE( a.act_task, pa.act_task ) = t.tsk_code AND
                COALESCE( a.act_taskrev, pa.act_taskrev ) = t.tsk_revision ),
           r5events e
    WHERE  a.act_event = e.evt_code
    AND    e.evt_org = @org
    AND    e.evt_rtype IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
    AND    ( e.evt_rstatus = N'R' OR ( e.evt_rstatus = N'C' AND
           ( ( SELECT dbo.f_trunc_date( getdate() + ISNULL( o.org_timezone/24, 0 ), N'DD' ) 
               FROM   r5organization o
               WHERE  o.org_code = e.evt_org ) <=
                    dbo.f_trunc_date( e.evt_completed + CAST(ISNULL( ( SELECT ins_desc FROM r5install 
                                                               WHERE  ins_code = 'REQDAYS' ), '0' ) as numeric), N'DD' ) ) 
            AND ( dbo.f_trunc_date( e.evt_completed, N'DD' ) >
                ( SELECT dbo.f_trunc_date(ISNULL( MAX( c.clp_closed ), CAST( '01-01-1900' AS DATETIME ) ), N'DD' ) 
                  FROM   r5closedperiods c ) ) ) ) 
    AND    a.act_hire = N'+'
    AND    a.act_defermaintenance = N'-'
    AND    a.act_order IS NULL
    AND    a.act_trade IS NOT NULL
    AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                        FROM   r5ucodes u
                        WHERE  u.uco_rentity = N'JBTP'
                        AND    u.uco_rcode IN ( N'MEC', N'IS' ) 
                        AND    e.evt_jobtype = u.uco_code ) 
    AND    a.act_ordtype IN ( SELECT uco_code
                              FROM   r5ucodes
                              WHERE  uco_rentity = N'PLTP'
                              AND    uco_rcode IN ( N'SF', N'ST' ) ) 
    AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                        FROM   r5requislines r
                        WHERE  r.rql_event = a.act_event
                        AND    r.rql_act = a.act_act
                        AND    r.rql_rtype LIKE N'S%'
                        AND    r.rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' ) )
    AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                        FROM   r5campaigns
                        WHERE  cam_code = e.evt_campaign
                        AND    cam_org = e.evt_campaign_org
                        AND    cam_rstatus = N'H' )
    AND    ( 'ON' != ISNULL( ( SELECT UPPER( ins_desc )
                            FROM   r5install
                            WHERE  ins_code = N'DEPTSEC' ), N'OFF' ) OR
             e.evt_mrc IN ( SELECT dse_mrc
                            FROM   r5departmentsecurity
                            WHERE  dse_user = @cuser
                            AND    dse_mrc = e.evt_mrc
                            AND    COALESCE( dse_readonly, N'-' ) = N'-' ) )
    AND    ( ( e.evt_project IS NOT NULL AND 'x' IN
             ( SELECT 'x'
               FROM   r5projauthuser
               WHERE  pau_project = e.evt_project
               AND    pau_user = @cuser
               UNION
               SELECT 'x'
               FROM   dual
               WHERE  NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                                   FROM   r5projauthuser
                                   WHERE  pau_project = e.evt_project ) ) ) OR e.evt_project IS NULL )
    AND    ( ( @supplier IS NULL AND @supplierorg IS NULL ) 
             OR ( a.act_supplier = @supplier AND a.act_supplier_org = @supplierorg ) )
    AND    ( @event IS NULL OR a.act_event = @event )
    AND    ( @mrc IS NULL OR a.act_mrc = @mrc )
  OPEN chl
  FETCH NEXT FROM chl INTO @workorder, @multiequip, @reworkorder, @reobject, @reobjectorg, @act, @trade, @ordtype, @ordrtype, @task, 
                           @taskrev, @patask, @actsupplier, @actsupplierorg, @actmrc, @startdatetime, @exchange
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
        set @currency  =   dbo.o7getservcur( @org, COALESCE( @task, @patask ), @actsupplier, @actsupplierorg )
        set @price  =   dbo.o7getservprc2( @org, @actmrc, @trade, @startdatetime, @ordrtype, 
                                    COALESCE( @task, @patask ), @actsupplier, @actsupplierorg )
        INSERT INTO r5templaborrequisitions ( 
                  tlr_sessionid,
                  tlr_event,
                  tlr_act,
                  tlr_org,
                  tlr_mrc,
                  tlr_desc, 
                  tlr_store,
                  tlr_requestedby,
                  tlr_ordtype,
                  tlr_ordrtype,
                  tlr_price,
                  tlr_currency,
                  tlr_trade,
                  tlr_task,
                  tlr_taskrev,
                  tlr_supplier,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7LDW_PACKAGE_INIT
as
	--This procedure will be called from all procs and funcs within
	--this package.  This is to simulate package initialization scripts in Oracle
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sInitHasRun	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn		int

begin
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7SESS', N'InitHasRun', @sInitHasRun OUTPUT

	if @sInitHasRun = N'false'

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'COMMIT_FREQ', N'15000'

CREATE PROCEDURE O7LDW_P_ACTIVEEQUIPMENTVALUE
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

	declare @nCommit_counter int
	declare @nLoop_counter int
    declare @nNumber_processed    numeric(38, 0)
	declare @sElp_string nchar(20)
	declare @sCnt_string nchar(20)
	declare @sPad_string nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sRunlog_string	nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nReturn int
	declare @dBeg_process_date datetime
	declare @sBeg_process_date nvarchar(50)
	declare @dEnd_process_date datetime
	declare @sEnd_process_date nvarchar(50)
	declare @dStart_time datetime
	declare @sStart_time nvarchar(50)
	declare @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval   nvarchar(40)
	declare @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval   numeric(38,0)
	declare @dEnd_date_range datetime
	declare @sEnd_date_range nvarchar(50)
	declare @dBeg_date_range datetime
	declare @sBeg_date_range nvarchar(50)
	declare @sCommit_freq nvarchar(50)
	/* cursor variable */
	declare @nActiveequipmentvalue numeric(24,6)
	declare @nDatekey			   numeric(38,0)
	declare @nOrgkey			   numeric(38,0)
begin
	set @nNumber_processed = 0
	set @nCommit_counter = 0
	set @dStart_time = getdate()
	set @sStart_time = cast(@dStart_time as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'START_TIME', @sStart_time
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @nCommit_counter = 0
   /*
   || do updates.
   */
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_PROCESS_DATE', @sBeg_process_date OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dBeg_process_date = cast(@sBeg_process_date as datetime)
    set @dEnd_date_range = @dBeg_process_date
	set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_RUNCTRLINTERVAL', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval as numeric(38,0))
	While ((@nLoop_counter>= 1  AND @nLoop_counter<= @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval))
	begin
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_date_range = cast(@sEnd_date_range as datetime)
        set @dBeg_date_range = @dEnd_date_range
		set @sBeg_date_range = cast(@dBeg_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_DATE_RANGE', @sBeg_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @dEnd_date_range = @dEnd_date_range + 1
		set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_PROCESS_DATE', @sEnd_process_date OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_process_date = cast(@sEnd_process_date as datetime)
		DECLARE cUpdate_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	        select  activeequipmentvalue,
	                d.dwd_datekey datekey,
	                o.dwo_orgkey  orgkey
	        from   (select  sum(isnull(o1.obj_value,0))  activeequipmentvalue,
	                        @sEnd_process_date    end_process_date,
	                        o1.obj_org            orgvalue
	                from    r5objects   o1
	                where   o1.obj_rstatus = N'I'
	                and     o1.obj_production = N'+'
	                and     o1.obj_obrtype = N'A'
	                and     o1.obj_commiss between
	                  		@sBeg_date_range and @sEnd_date_range
	                group by o1.obj_org
	                having sum(isnull(o1.obj_value,0)) > 0) dummy,
	                r5dworg  o,

		end 
		close cUpdate_cur
		deallocate cUpdate_cur
	if @@TRANCOUNT >0
        commit

		DECLARE cInsert_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR

CREATE PROCEDURE O7LDW_P_MAX_R5DWDATE
  /*
  || this procedure finds the max date in the r5dwdate table.
  */
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @dR5dwdate_max datetime
	declare @sR5dwdate_max nvarchar(50)
	declare @nReturn int
begin
	select @dR5dwdate_max = max(dwd_datevalue)+1
    from r5dwdate
	set @sR5dwdate_max = cast(@dR5dwdate_max as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'R5DWDATE_MAX', @sR5dwdate_max
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7LDW_P_OPENPMS
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
	
	declare @nCommit_counter int
	declare @nLoop_counter int
    declare @nNumber_processed    numeric(38, 0)
	declare @sElp_string nchar(20)
	declare @sCnt_string nchar(20)
	declare @sPad_string nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sRunlog_string	nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nReturn int
	declare @dBeg_process_date datetime
	declare @sBeg_process_date nvarchar(50)
	declare @dEnd_process_date datetime
	declare @sEnd_process_date nvarchar(50)
	declare @dStart_time datetime
	declare @sStart_time nvarchar(50)
	declare @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval   nvarchar(40)
	declare @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval   numeric(38,0)
	declare @dEnd_date_range datetime
	declare @sEnd_date_range nvarchar(50)
	declare @dBeg_date_range datetime
	declare @sBeg_date_range nvarchar(50)
	declare @sCommit_freq nvarchar(50)
	/* cursor variable */
	declare @nOpenpms   		   integer
	declare @nDatekey			   numeric(38,0)
	declare @nOrgkey			   numeric(38,0)      
begin
	set @nNumber_processed = 0
	set @nCommit_counter = 0
	set @dStart_time = getdate()
	set @sStart_time = cast(@dStart_time as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'START_TIME', @sStart_time
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @nCommit_counter = 0
    /*
    || do updates.
    */
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_PROCESS_DATE', @sBeg_process_date OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dBeg_process_date = cast(@sBeg_process_date as datetime)
    set @dEnd_date_range = @dBeg_process_date
	set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_RUNCTRLINTERVAL', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval as numeric(38,0))
	While ((@nLoop_counter>= 1  AND @nLoop_counter<= @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval))
	begin
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_date_range = cast(@sEnd_date_range as datetime)
        set @dBeg_date_range = @dEnd_date_range
		set @sBeg_date_range = cast(@dBeg_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_DATE_RANGE', @sBeg_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @dEnd_date_range = @dEnd_date_range + 1
		set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_PROCESS_DATE', @sEnd_process_date OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_process_date = cast(@sEnd_process_date as datetime)
		DECLARE cUpdate_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	        select  dummy.openpms,
              		d.dwd_datekey datekey,
              		o.dwo_orgkey  orgkey
        	from  (select  count(*)          openpms ,
                           @dEnd_process_date end_process_date,
                           e.evt_org         dwo_orgvalue
              	   from    r5events   e
              	   where   e.evt_rstatus = N'R'
                	and     e.evt_rtype = N'PPM'
        			and   e.evt_start between
              		@dBeg_date_range and @dEnd_date_range
              		group by e.evt_org) dummy,
              		r5dworg  o,
              		r5dwdate d
        	where   dummy.dwo_orgvalue = o.dwo_orgvalue
        	and    dummy.end_process_date = d.dwd_datevalue
        	and    (cast(o.dwo_orgkey as nvarchar(40))+ '#' + cast(d.dwd_datekey as nvarchar(40))) in (  select  cast(x.dwf_orgkey as nvarchar(40)) + '#' + cast(x.dwf_datekey as nvarchar(40))
	                                         															 from  r5dworgfact x )
		open cUpdate_cur
		fetch next from cUpdate_cur into @nOpenpms, @nDatekey, @nOrgkey
		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
            update r5dworgfact
            set dwf_openpms = @nOpenpms
            where dwf_orgkey = @nOrgkey
            and   dwf_datekey = @nDatekey
			set @nCommit_counter = @nCommit_counter + 1
			set @nNumber_processed = @nNumber_processed + 1
			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'COMMIT_FREQ', @sCommit_freq OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cUpdate_cur
				deallocate cUpdate_cur
				return -1
			end
       	 	if @nCommit_counter % cast(@sCommit_freq as int) = 0
        	begin
		if @@TRANCOUNT >0
            	commit
        	end
			fetch next from cUpdate_cur into @nOpenpms, @nDatekey, @nOrgkey
		end 
		close cUpdate_cur
		deallocate cUpdate_cur
	if @@TRANCOUNT >0
        commit
	end /* end of date_loop_update */
     /*
     -- do the inserts.
     */
    set @nCommit_counter = 0
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_PROCESS_DATE', @sBeg_process_date OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dBeg_process_date = cast(@sBeg_process_date as datetime)
    set @dEnd_date_range = @dBeg_process_date
	set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_RUNCTRLINTERVAL', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval as numeric(38,0))
	While ((@nLoop_counter>= 1  AND @nLoop_counter<= @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval))
	begin
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_date_range = cast(@sEnd_date_range as datetime)
        set @dBeg_date_range = @dEnd_date_range
		set @sBeg_date_range = cast(@dBeg_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_DATE_RANGE', @sBeg_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @dEnd_date_range = @dEnd_date_range + 1
		set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_PROCESS_DATE', @sEnd_process_date OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_process_date = cast(@sEnd_process_date as datetime)
		DECLARE cInsert_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
	        select  dummy.openpms,
              		d.dwd_datekey datekey,
              		o.dwo_orgkey  orgkey
        	from  (select   count(*)          openpms ,
                       		@dEnd_process_date end_process_date,
                      		e.evt_org         dwo_orgvalue
              	   from     r5events   e
              	   where    e.evt_rstatus = N'R'
                   and      e.evt_rtype = N'PPM'
        		   and      e.evt_start between
              			    @dBeg_date_range and @dEnd_date_range
              	   group by e.evt_org) dummy,
              	   r5dworg  o,
              	   r5dwdate d
        	where  dummy.dwo_orgvalue = o.dwo_orgvalue
        	and    dummy.end_process_date = d.dwd_datevalue
        	and    (cast(o.dwo_orgkey as nvarchar(40))+ '#' + cast(d.dwd_datekey as nvarchar(40))) not in (  select  cast(x.dwf_orgkey as nvarchar(40)) + '#' + cast(x.dwf_datekey as nvarchar(40))
	                                         															 	 from  r5dworgfact x )
		open cInsert_cur
		f

	/* cursor variable */
	declare @nPlanwoactuallaborhours	    numeric(30,6)
	declare @nDatekey			   			numeric(38,0)
	declare @nOrgkey			  			numeric(38,0)      
begin
	set @nNumber_processed = 0
	set @nCommit_counter = 0
	set @dStart_time = getdate()
	set @sStart_time = cast(@dStart_time as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'START_TIME', @sStart_time

		return -1

    set @dEnd_date_range = @dBeg_process_date
	set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_RUNCTRLINTERVAL', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval as numeric(38,0))
	While ((@nLoop_counter>= 1  AND @nLoop_counter<= @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval))
	begin
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_date_range = cast(@sEnd_date_range as datetime)
        set @dBeg_date_range = @dEnd_date_range
		set @sBeg_date_range = cast(@dBeg_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_DATE_RANGE', @sBeg_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @dEnd_date_range = @dEnd_date_range + 1
		set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		DECLARE cUpdate_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	        select  sum (isnull(a.act_nt,0) + isnull(a.act_ot,0))
                    planwoactuallaborhours,
            		d.dwd_datekey         datekey,
            		o.dwo_orgkey          orgkey
    		from    r5events        e,
            		r5activities    a,
        			r5dwdate        d,
            		r5dworg         o

    		and     ( e.evt_rtype = N'PPM' or e.evt_project is not null )
    		and     e.evt_code = a.act_event
    		and     a.act_start  between
         			@dBeg_date_range and @dEnd_date_range
    		and     e.evt_completed  between
         			@dBeg_date_range and @dEnd_date_range
    		and     e.evt_completed = d.dwd_datevalue
    		and     e.evt_org = o.dwo_orgvalue
    		and     (cast(o.dwo_orgkey as nvarchar(40))+ '#' + cast(d.dwd_datekey as nvarchar(40))) in (  select  cast(x.dwf_orgkey as nvarchar(40)) + '#' + cast(x.dwf_datekey as nvarchar(40))
                          																				  from  r5dworgfact x )
    		group by d.dwd_datekey,o.dwo_orgkey
    		having sum (isnull(a.act_nt,0) + isnull(a.act_ot,0)) > 0
		open cUpdate_cur
		fetch next from cUpdate_cur into @nPlanwoactuallaborhours, @nDatekey, @nOrgkey

            update r5dworgfact

        	begin
		if @@TRANCOUNT >0
            	commit
        	end
			fetch next from cUpdate_cur into @nPlanwoactuallaborhours, @nDatekey, @nOrgkey
		end 
		close cUpdate_cur
		deallocate cUpdate_cur
	if @@TRANCOUNT >0
        commit
	end /* end of date_loop_update */
     /*
     -- do the inserts.
     */
    set @nCommit_counter = 0

		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_RUNCTRLINTERVAL', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval as numeric(38,0))

CREATE PROCEDURE O7LDW_P_SET_RUNCTRL_VALUES
/*
|| this procedure puts values in beg_process_date and
|| end_process_date.
*/
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlop  		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sRunlog_string			     		nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sPad_string				 		nchar(80)
	declare @sRun_operation				 		nchar(1)
	declare @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval   nvarchar(40)
	declare @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval   numeric(38,0)
	declare @dBeg_process_date					datetime
	declare @sBeg_process_date					nvarchar(50)
	declare @dEnd_process_date					datetime
	declare @sEnd_process_date					nvarchar(50)
	declare @dRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgeenddate		datetime
	declare @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgeenddate		nvarchar(50)
	declare @dRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgebegdate		datetime
	declare @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgebegdate		nvarchar(50)
	declare @nReturn							int
begin
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_RUNCTRLOP', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlop OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @sRun_operation = @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlop
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUN_OPERATION', @sRun_operation
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    if @sRun_operation = N'U'
    begin
        set @sPad_string = N'Updates...Run Operation = U'
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'PAD_STRING', @sPad_string
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNLOG_STRING', @sRunlog_string OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @sRunlog_string = @sRunlog_string + @sPad_string
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNLOG_STRING', @sRunlog_string 
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_RUNCTRLINTERVAL', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		set @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval as numeric(38,0))
        set @dBeg_process_date = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate() - @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval, N'dd' )
		set @sBeg_process_date = CAST(@dBeg_process_date as nvarchar(30))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_PROCESS_DATE', @sBeg_process_date
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		set @dEnd_process_date = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'dd' )
		set @sEnd_process_date = CAST(@dEnd_process_date as nvarchar(30))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_PROCESS_DATE', @sEnd_process_date
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	END
    else if @sRun_operation = N'P'
    begin
        set @sPad_string = N'Purge...Run Operation = P'
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'PAD_STRING', @sPad_string
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNLOG_STRING', @sRunlog_string OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @sRunlog_string = @sRunlog_string + @sPad_string
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_PURGEBEGDATE', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgebegdate
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		set @dRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgebegdate = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgebegdate as datetime)
        set @dBeg_process_date = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgebegdate, 'dd' )
		set @sBeg_process_date = cast(@dBeg_process_date as nvarchar(30))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_PROCESS_DATE', @sBeg_process_date
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_PURGEENDDATE', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgeenddate
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		set @dRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgeenddate = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgeenddate as datetime)
        set @dEnd_process_date = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dRunctrl_rec_dwc_purgeenddate, 'dd')
		set @sEnd_process_date = cast(@dEnd_process_date as nvarchar(30))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_PROCESS_DATE', @sEnd_process_date
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
	end
    else if @sRun_operation = N'N'
    begin
        set @sPad_string = N'Nothing Processed...Run Operation = N'
        execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'PAD_STRING', @sPad_string
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNLOG_STRING', @sRunlog_string OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @sRunlog_string = @sRunlog_string + @sPad_string
    end 
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7LDW_P_STOCKVALUE
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
	declare @nCommit_counter int
	declare @nLoop_counter int
    declare @nNumber_processed    numeric(38, 0)
	declare @sElp_string nchar(20)
	declare @sCnt_string nchar(20)
	declare @sPad_string nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sRunlog_string	nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nReturn int
	declare @dBeg_process_date datetime
	declare @sBeg_process_date nvarchar(50)
	declare @dEnd_process_date datetime
	declare @sEnd_process_date nvarchar(50)
	declare @dStart_time datetime
	declare @sStart_time nvarchar(50)
	declare @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval   nvarchar(40)
	declare @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval   numeric(38,0)
	declare @dEnd_date_range datetime
	declare @sEnd_date_range nvarchar(50)
	declare @dBeg_date_range datetime
	declare @sBeg_date_range nvarchar(50)
	declare @sCommit_freq nvarchar(50)
	/* cursor variable */
	declare @nStockvalue		        	float
	declare @nDatekey			   			numeric(38,0)
	declare @nOrgkey			  			numeric(38,0)      
begin
	set @nNumber_processed = 0
	set @nCommit_counter = 0
	set @dStart_time = getdate()
	set @sStart_time = cast(@dStart_time as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'START_TIME', @sStart_time
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @nCommit_counter = 0
    /*
    || do updates.
    */
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_PROCESS_DATE', @sBeg_process_date OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dBeg_process_date = cast(@sBeg_process_date as datetime)
    set @dEnd_date_range = @dBeg_process_date
	set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_RUNCTRLINTERVAL', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval as numeric(38,0))
	While ((@nLoop_counter>= 1  AND @nLoop_counter<= @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval))
	begin
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_date_range = cast(@sEnd_date_range as datetime)
        set @dBeg_date_range = @dEnd_date_range
		set @sBeg_date_range = cast(@dBeg_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_DATE_RANGE', @sBeg_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @dEnd_date_range = @dEnd_date_range + 1
		set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_PROCESS_DATE', @sEnd_process_date OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_process_date = cast(@sEnd_process_date as datetime)
		DECLARE cUpdate_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR
	        select  dummy.stockvalue,
	                d.dwd_datekey datekey,
	                o.dwo_orgkey  orgkey
	        from    (select  isnull(sum(isnull(s.sto_qty,0) *
	                         dbo.O7GETPRC(s.sto_store,s.sto_part,s.sto_part_org,
	                         t.str_org,N'B',null,null)),0)    stockvalue,
	                         @dEnd_process_date  end_process_date,
	                         t.str_org         dwo_orgvalue
	                 from    r5stores    t,
	                    	 r5stock     s
	            	 where   t.str_code = s.sto_store
	        		 and     s.sto_stocktake between
	              			 @dBeg_date_range and @dEnd_date_range
	            	 group by t.str_org) dummy,
	                 r5dworg  o,
	                 r5dwdate d
	        where   dummy.dwo_orgvalue = o.dwo_orgvalue
	        and     dummy.end_process_date = d.dwd_datevalue
	        and     (cast(o.dwo_orgkey as nvarchar(40))+ '#' + cast(d.dwd_datekey as nvarchar(40))) in (  select  cast(x.dwf_orgkey as nvarchar(40)) + '#' + cast(x.dwf_datekey as nvarchar(40))
	                                   																	  from r5dworgfact x )
		open cUpdate_cur
		fetch next from cUpdate_cur into @nStockvalue, @nDatekey, @nOrgkey
		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
            update r5dworgfact
            set dwf_stockvalue = @nStockvalue
            where dwf_orgkey = @nOrgkey
            and   dwf_datekey = @nDatekey
			set @nCommit_counter = @nCommit_counter + 1
			set @nNumber_processed = @nNumber_processed + 1
			execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'COMMIT_FREQ', @sCommit_freq OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				close cUpdate_cur
				deallocate cUpdate_cur
				return -1
			end
       	 	if @nCommit_counter % cast(@sCommit_freq as int) = 0
        	begin
		if @@TRANCOUNT >0
            	commit
        	end
			fetch next from cUpdate_cur into @nStockvalue, @nDatekey, @nOrgkey
		end 
		close cUpdate_cur
		deallocate cUpdate_cur
	if @@TRANCOUNT >0
        commit
	end /* end of date_loop_update */
     /*
     -- do the inserts.
     */
    set @nCommit_counter = 0
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_PROCESS_DATE', @sBeg_process_date OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dBeg_process_date = cast(@sBeg_process_date as datetime)
    set @dEnd_date_range = @dBeg_process_date
	set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNCTRL_REC_DWC_RUNCTRLINTERVAL', @sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval = cast(@sRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval as numeric(38,0))
	While ((@nLoop_counter>= 1  AND @nLoop_counter<= @nRunctrl_rec_dwc_runctrlinterval))
	begin
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_date_range = cast(@sEnd_date_range as datetime)
        set @dBeg_date_range = @dEnd_date_range
		set @sBeg_date_range = cast(@dBeg_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_DATE_RANGE', @sBeg_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        set @dEnd_date_range = @dEnd_date_range + 1
		set @sEnd_date_range = cast(@dEnd_date_range as nvarchar(50))
		execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_DATE_RANGE', @sEnd_date_range
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_PROCESS_DATE', @sEnd_process_date OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1	
		set @dEnd_process_date = cast(@sEnd_process_date as datetime)
		DECLARE cInsert_cur CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
	        select  dummy.stockvalue,
              		d.dwd_datekey datekey,
              		o.dwo_orgkey  orgkey
	        from  	(select isnull(sum(isnull(s.sto_qty,0) *
	                        dbo.O7GETPRC(s.sto_store,s.sto_part,s.sto_part_org,
	                        t.str_org,N'B',null,null)),0)    stockvalue,
	                      	@dEnd_process_date  end_process_date,
	                      	t.str_org         dwo_orgvalue
	            	from    r5stores    t,
	                    	r5stock     s
	            	where   t.str_code = s.sto_store
	        		and     s.sto_stocktake between
	              			@dBeg_date_range and @dEnd_date_range
	            	group by t.str_org) dummy,
	              	r5dworg  o,
	              	r5dwdate d
	        where   dummy.dwo_orgvalue = o.dwo_orgvalue
	        and     dummy.end_process_date

CREATE PROCEDURE O7LDW_P_TODAYSLABORHOURCAPACITY
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
	declare @nCommit_counter int
    declare @nNumber_processed    numeric(38, 0)
	declare @sElp_string nchar(20)
	declare @sCnt_string nchar(20)
	declare @sPad_string nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sRunlog_string	nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nReturn int
	declare @dBeg_process_date datetime
	declare @sBeg_process_date nvarchar(50)
	declare @dEnd_process_date datetime
	declare @sEnd_process_date nvarchar(50)
	declare @dStart_time datetime
	declare @sStart_time nvarchar(50)
	declare @sCommit_freq nvarchar(50)
	declare @dCalc_date datetime
begin
	set @nNumber_processed = 0
	set @dStart_time = getdate()
	set @sStart_time = cast(@dStart_time as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'START_TIME', @sStart_time
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @nCommit_counter = 0
     /*
     -- do updates
     */
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_PROCESS_DATE', @sBeg_process_date OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dBeg_process_date = cast(@sBeg_process_date as datetime)
    set @dCalc_date = @dBeg_process_date
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_PROCESS_DATE', @sEnd_process_date OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dEnd_process_date = cast(@sEnd_process_date as datetime)
    while @dCalc_date between @dBeg_process_date and @dEnd_process_date
	begin
        update r5dworgfact
        set dwf_todayslaborhourcapacity =
        (
            select  isnull(sum(isnull(x.exc_hours, sd.shd_hours)), 0)
            from    r5shifts      sh,
	                r5shfdays     sd,
	          		r5dwdate      d,
	          		r5dworg       o,
	                r5shfpers     sp 
						LEFT OUTER JOIN r5exceptions  x
						ON x.exc_person = sp.shp_person AND
						   x.exc_date = @dCalc_date
						RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5personnel p 
						ON p.per_code = sp.shp_person
			where   sp.shp_shift = sh.shf_code
	       	and     sp.shp_start <= @dCalc_date
	       	and     isnull(sh.shf_start, @dCalc_date) <= @dCalc_date
	       	and     sp.shp_end >= @dCalc_date
	       	and     sd.shd_shift = sh.shf_code
	       	and     sd.shd_day = (DATEDIFF(Day, sh.shf_start, @dCalc_date) % cast(sh.shf_length as int)) + 1
	       	and     p.per_notused = N'-'
	      	and   	d.dwd_datevalue = @dCalc_date
	      	and  	o.dwo_orgvalue = p.per_org
	      	and   	o.dwo_orgkey = dwf_orgkey
	      	and   	d.dwd_datekey = dwf_datekey
	      )
    	set @nCommit_counter = @nCommit_counter + 1
		set @dCalc_date = @dCalc_date + 1
		set @nNumber_processed = @nNumber_processed + 1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'COMMIT_FREQ', @sCommit_freq OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
   	 	if @nCommit_counter % cast(@sCommit_freq as int) = 0
    	begin
		if @@TRANCOUNT >0
        	commit
    	end
	end --end of while
    if @@TRANCOUNT >0
    commit
     /*
     -- do the inserts.
     */
    set @nCommit_counter = 0
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'BEG_PROCESS_DATE', @sBeg_process_date OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dBeg_process_date = cast(@sBeg_process_date as datetime)
    set @dCalc_date = @dBeg_process_date
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'END_PROCESS_DATE', @sEnd_process_date OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dEnd_process_date = cast(@sEnd_process_date as datetime)
    while @dCalc_date between @dBeg_process_date and @dEnd_process_date
	begin
        insert into r5dworgfact( dwf_todayslaborhourcapacity,
                                 dwf_orgkey,
                                 dwf_datekey )
            select  isnull(sum(isnull(x.exc_hours, sd.shd_hours)), 0),
          			o.dwo_orgkey,
          			d.dwd_datekey
	       	from    r5shifts      sh,
	                r5shfdays     sd,
	          		r5dwdate      d,
	          		r5dworg       o,
	                r5shfpers     sp 
						LEFT OUTER JOIN r5exceptions  x
						ON x.exc_person = sp.shp_person AND
						   x.exc_date = @dCalc_date
						RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5personnel p 
						ON p.per_code = sp.shp_person
	        where   sp.shp_shift = sh.shf_code
	        and     sp.shp_start <= @dCalc_date
	        and     isnull(sh.shf_start, @dCalc_date) <= @dCalc_date
	        and     sp.shp_end >= @dCalc_date
	        and     sd.shd_shift = sh.shf_code
	        and     sd.shd_day = (DATEDIFF(Day, sh.shf_start, @dCalc_date) % cast(sh.shf_length as int)) + 1
	        and     p.per_notused = '-'
	        and     d.dwd_datevalue = @dCalc_date
	        and     o.dwo_orgvalue = p.per_org
	        and    (cast(o.dwo_orgkey as nvarchar(40))+ '#' + cast(d.dwd_datekey as nvarchar(40))) not in (  select  cast(x.dwf_orgkey as nvarchar(40)) + '#' + cast(x.dwf_datekey as nvarchar(40))
	                                         															 	 from  r5dworgfact x )
	        group by o.dwo_orgkey, d.dwd_datekey
    	set @dCalc_date = @dCalc_date + 1
        set @nCommit_counter = @nCommit_counter + 1
		set @nNumber_processed = @nNumber_processed + 1
		execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'COMMIT_FREQ', @sCommit_freq OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
   	 	if @nCommit_counter % cast(@sCommit_freq as int) = 0
    	begin
		if @@TRANCOUNT >0
        	commit
    	end
	end -- end of while
    if @@TRANCOUNT >0
    commit
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'START_TIME', @sStart_time OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	set @dStart_time = cast(@sStart_time as datetime)
	--check here for format
    set @sElp_string = N'et secs=>' + cast((DATEDIFF(Day, @dStart_time, getdate())*86400) as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'ELP_STRING', @sElp_string
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @sCnt_string = N'rows=>' + CAST(@nNumber_processed as nvarchar(50))
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'CNT_STRING', @sCnt_string
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    set @sPad_string = @sElp_string  + ' ' + @sCnt_string + ' for todayslaborhourcapacity'
	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'PAD_STRING', @sPad_string
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7LDW', N'RUNLOG_STRING', @sRunlog_string OUTPUT

create 
procedure O7LOCWLS	@nSessionid	integer, @sWolocked nvarchar(4) OUTPUT, @sChk nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nLockedCount		integer
	declare @nProcessCount		integer
	declare @nReturn 			integer

	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sWolocked = N'0'


	If Exists (SELECT '1'
		FROM   r5tempworkloadworkorders t1
		WHERE  t1.wlw_sessionid =  @nSessionid
		AND    t1.wlw_select    = N'+'
		AND    EXISTS (SELECT NULL
						FROM   r5tempworkloadworkorders t2
						WHERE  t2.wlw_sessionid <> @nSessionid
						AND    t2.wlw_event = t1.wlw_event
						AND    t2.wlw_locked = N'+'))
		set @sWolocked = N'1'


	IF Exists (SELECT '1'
			FROM   r5tempworkloadworkorders t1
			WHERE  t1.wlw_sessionid =  @nSessionid
			AND    t1.wlw_select    = N'+'
			AND    NOT EXISTS (SELECT NULL
                       FROM   r5tempworkloadworkorders t2
				       WHERE  t2.wlw_sessionid <> @nSessionid
				       AND    t2.wlw_event = t1.wlw_event
				       AND    t2.wlw_locked = N'+'))
		set @sChk = N'0' 
	else
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1' 
			return
		end
  
	delete from  r5tempworkloadworkorders 
	WHERE  wlw_sessionid = @nSessionid
	AND    (wlw_select    = N'-' OR wlw_event IN (SELECT t2.wlw_event
						FROM   r5tempworkloadworkorders t2
						WHERE  t2.wlw_sessionid <> @nSessionid
						AND    t2.wlw_locked = N'+') )


	UPDATE r5tempworkloadparameters
	SET    wlp_locked = N'+'
	WHERE  wlp_sessionid = @nSessionid

	UPDATE r5tempworkloadworkorders
	SET    wlw_locked = N'+'
	WHERE  wlw_sessionid = @nSessionid

	execute @nReturn = O7CRTWLA @nSessionid
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7CRTWLD @nSessionid
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	UPDATE r5events SET evt_mpproj = cast(@nSessionid*-1 as nvarchar(20)),
	                    evt_mpprojtype = N'WOLB'
	WHERE  COALESCE(evt_mpproj,N'-') = N'-'
	AND    evt_code IN ( SELECT  wlw_event
					   FROM    R5TEMPWORKLOADWORKORDERS
					   WHERE   wlw_sessionid = @nSessionid )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7LOGRESPONSE
                 @nCresponse1    numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
                 @sCsrq          nvarchar(80), 
                 @sCsrqorg       nvarchar(15) 
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @nCresponse    numeric(18,0)      /* r5servicelogs.log_responsetime%TYPE := 0; */
declare @nCmaxseq      numeric(18,0)      /* r5servicelogs.log_sequence%TYPE; */
declare @dLogtime      datetime	  	  /* r5servicelogs.log_time%TYPE; */
declare @sCloserespond nvarchar(1)
declare @nError_var int, @nRowcount_var int
declare @nTime numeric(18, 6)

SELECT @nCmaxseq = max(log_sequence)
  FROM r5servicelogs
 WHERE log_entity     = N'SERQ'
   AND log_rentity    = N'SERQ'
   AND log_entitycode = @sCsrq
   AND log_entityorg  = @sCsrqorg

SELECT @nError_var = @@ERROR, @nRowcount_var = @@ROWCOUNT
if @nError_var <> 0 OR @nRowcount_var <> 1
   RETURN
	
SELECT @nCresponse = log_responsetime,@dLogtime = log_time
  FROM r5servicelogs
 WHERE log_entity     = N'SERQ'
   AND log_rentity    = N'SERQ'
   AND log_entitycode = @sCsrq
   AND log_entityorg  = @sCsrqorg
   AND log_sequence   = @nCmaxseq

SELECT @nError_var = @@ERROR, @nRowcount_var = @@ROWCOUNT
if @nError_var <> 0 OR @nRowcount_var <> 1
   begin
   set @nCresponse1 = @nCresponse
   RETURN 
   end

SET ROWCOUNT 1 
SELECT @sCloserespond = N'x'
  FROM r5servicelogs
 WHERE log_entity     = N'SERQ'
   AND log_rentity    = N'SERQ'
   AND log_entitycode = @sCsrq
   AND log_entityorg  = @sCsrqorg
   AND (log_closed = N'+' or log_responded = N'+')
SET ROWCOUNT 0 

IF @sCloserespond = N'x'
   IF @nCresponse = 0
      RETURN 1
   ELSE
      begin
      set @nCresponse1 = @nCresponse
      RETURN
      end
set @nCresponse1 = isnull(@nCresponse, 0) + round(DATEDIFF(Day, @dLogtime, dbo.o7gttime2(@sCsrqorg))*24*60, 0)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7LONGDESCS
  @dowhat NVARCHAR(    3 ),
  @entity NVARCHAR(    4 ),
  @code   NVARCHAR(  100 ),
  @text   NVARCHAR( 2000 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE  @deflang  NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE  @chk      NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE  @r        INT

  EXECUTE @r = O7DFLT  @deflang OUTPUT, N'DEFLANG', @chk OUTPUT
  
  /* Return if no text */
  IF @text IS NULL AND @dowhat <> N'DEL'
		return	
  
  IF @dowhat = N'INS'
    /* New record has been inserted, so insert long descriptions for each installed language. */
    INSERT INTO r5longdescriptions( lds_entity,	lds_code, lds_lang, lds_trans, lds_text )
    SELECT @entity, @code, lin_code, CASE lin_code WHEN @deflang THEN N'+' ELSE N'-' END, @text
    FROM   r5langinst
  ELSE IF @dowhat = N'UPD'
    /* Record has been updated, so update long descriptions as well, except when the old text was translated. */
    UPDATE r5longdescriptions
    SET    lds_text   = @text
    WHERE  lds_entity = @entity
    AND    lds_code   = @code
    AND    ( lds_trans = N'-' OR lds_lang = @deflang )
  ELSE IF @dowhat = N'DEL'
    /* Record has been deleted, so delete all long descriptions. */
    DELETE FROM r5longdescriptions
    WHERE  lds_entity = @entity
    AND    lds_code   = @code
END

create function O7LRF_GETCHILD ( @sV_objcode           nvarchar(30),
								  @sV_objorg            nvarchar(15),
								  @nV_startingpoint     numeric(24,6),
								  @sV_startingpoint_uom nvarchar(10),
								  @nV_sessionid         numeric(38,0),
								  @nV_range			numeric(24,6),
								  @sV_range_uom		nvarchar(10))		  		   
returns @tReturn table( ObjCode            nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ,
						ObjOrg             nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ,
						ReObjCode          nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ,
						ReObjOrg           nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ,
						Frompoint          numeric(24,6),
						Topoint            numeric(24,6),   
						Pointreference     numeric(24,6),    
						Startingpoint      numeric(24,6),    
						Srange             numeric(24,6),
						Linearrefuom       nvarchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						Linearrefprecision numeric(2,0),
						SessionId          numeric(24,6),
						LRFId              numeric(38,0) )

as
begin


insert into @tReturn SELECT LRF_OBJCODE,
           LRF_OBJORG,
           LRF_RE_OBJCODE,
           LRF_RE_OBJORG,
           LRF_FROMPOINT,
           LRF_TOPOINT,
           LRF_TOPOINT - LRF_FROMPOINT ,
           dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_startingpoint,
                                 @sV_startingpoint_uom,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFUOM,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION) ,
           @nV_range ,
           OBJ_LINEARREFUOM, -- we dont need this. Eliminate this
           OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION, -- useful here
           @nV_sessionid ,
           LRF_ID
      FROM r5objlinearref l, r5objects o
     WHERE o.OBJ_CODE = l.LRF_OBJCODE
	   AND   o.OBJ_ORG  = l.LRF_OBJORG
       AND l.LRF_OBJCODE = @sV_objcode
       AND l.LRF_OBJORG = @sV_objorg
       AND LRF_FROMPOINT <=
           dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_startingpoint, 
                                 @sV_startingpoint_uom,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFUOM,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION) +
           dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_range,
                                 @sV_range_uom,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFUOM,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION)
       AND LRF_TOPOINT >=
           dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_startingpoint,
                                 @sV_startingpoint_uom,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFUOM,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION) -
           dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_range,
                                 @sV_range_uom,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFUOM,
                                 OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION)

RETURN
end

create function O7LRF_GETPARENTS (	          @sV_objcode           nvarchar(30),
          @sV_objorg            nvarchar(15),
          @nV_startingpoint 	numeric(24,6), 
		  @sV_startingpoint_uom nvarchar(10),
          @nV_sessionid         numeric(38,0),
          @nV_range				numeric(24,6),
		  @sV_range_uom			nvarchar(10) )
returns @tReturn table( ObjCode            nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						ObjOrg             nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						ReObjCode          nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						ReObjOrg           nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						Frompoint          numeric(24,6),
						Topoint            numeric(24,6),    
						Pointreference     numeric(24,6),    
						Startingpoint      numeric(24,6),    
						Srange             numeric(24,6),
						Linearrefuom       nvarchar(10) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						Linearrefprecision numeric(2,0),
						SessionId          numeric(24,6), 
						LRFId              numeric(38,0))
as
begin

insert into @tReturn SELECT     
		  L.LRF_OBJCODE,
           L.LRF_OBJORG,
           L.LRF_RE_OBJCODE,
           L.LRF_RE_OBJORG,
           L.LRF_FROMPOINT,
           L.LRF_TOPOINT,
           L.LRF_TOPOINT - LRF_FROMPOINT ,
           (CASE
             WHEN L.LRF_FROMPOINT = L.LRF_TOPOINT THEN
              L.LRF_FROMPOINT
             ELSE
              L.LRF_FROMPOINT +
              dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_startingpoint,
                                    @sV_startingpoint_uom,
                                    o.OBJ_LINEARREFUOM,
                                    o.OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION)
           END) ,
           (CASE
             WHEN L.LRF_FROMPOINT = L.LRF_TOPOINT THEN
              @nV_range - dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_startingpoint,
                                              @sV_startingpoint_uom,
                                              @sV_range_uom,
                                              7)
             ELSE
              @nV_range
           END) ,
           o.OBJ_LINEARREFUOM,
           o.OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION,
           @nV_sessionid ,
           LRF_ID
      FROM R5OBJLINEARREF L, R5OBJECTS o
     WHERE o.OBJ_CODE = l.LRF_OBJCODE
		AND o.OBJ_ORG = l.LRF_OBJORG
       AND l.LRF_RE_OBJCODE = @sV_objcode
       AND l.LRF_RE_OBJORG = @sV_objorg
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT L2.LRF_OBJCODE
                        FROM R5OBJLINEARREF L2
                        WHERE L2.LRF_OBJCODE = @sV_objcode
                        AND L2.LRF_OBJORG = @sV_objorg
                        AND L.LRF_OBJCODE = L2.LRF_RE_OBJCODE 
                        AND L.LRF_OBJORG = L2.LRF_RE_OBJORG)
       AND CASE WHEN
     dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_range,
                                 @sV_range_uom,
                                 o.OBJ_LINEARREFUOM,
                                 o.OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION) -
           dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_startingpoint,
                                 @sV_startingpoint_uom,
                                 o.OBJ_LINEARREFUOM,
                                 o.OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION) >= 0 THEN - 1 ELSE L.LRF_FROMPOINT END <> CASE WHEN dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_range, @sV_range_uom, o.OBJ_LINEARREFUOM, o.OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION) - dbo.O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARREFLENGTH(@nV_startingpoint, @sV_startingpoint_uom, o.OBJ_LINEARREFUOM, o.OBJ_LINEARREFPRECISION) >= 0 THEN - 2 ELSE L.LRF_TOPOINT END
return
end

create PROCEDURE O7LRF_O7CALC_OBJECTCOST    @dDate		datetime OUTPUT, 
                                            @sObject	nvarchar(30),
                                            @sObjectOrg  nvarchar(15)
                                            

AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sX nvarchar(1)
    declare @sEvt_code      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sEvt_org       nvarchar(15)
    declare @nEvt_frompoint numeric(24,6)
    declare @nEvt_topoint   numeric(24,6)


    declare @nLabor    numeric(24,6)
    declare @nMaterial numeric(24,6)
    declare @nTool     numeric(24,6)
    declare @nTotal    numeric(24,6)
    declare @nHours    numeric(24,6)
    declare @sOrg      nvarchar(15) 
    declare @nCost     numeric(30,6)

    set  @dDate = getdate()

    DELETE r5eventcosts
    WHERE ect_object      = @sObject
    AND   ect_object_org  = @sObjectOrg


    declare c_wo cursor local for   SELECT evt_code, evt_org, evt_frompoint, evt_topoint
                                    FROM r5events, r5eventobjects
                                    WHERE eob_object     = @sObject
                                    AND   eob_object_org = @sObjectOrg
                                    AND   evt_rtype     IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
                                    AND   evt_code       = eob_event
                                    ORDER BY evt_org, evt_code 

    open c_wo
    fetch next from c_wo into  @sEvt_code, @sEvt_org, @nEvt_frompoint, @nEvt_topoint

    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
      begin
        set @nCost = 0
        set @nLabor = 0
        set @nMaterial = 0
        set @nTool = 0
        set @nTotal = 0

	    execute o7cost_labourandhours2 @sEvt_code, @nLabor OUTPUT, @nHours OUTPUT
	    execute o7actmat 'OSVCST', @sEvt_code, null, null, null, @nCost OUTPUT, null
	    set @nMaterial = coalesce(@nMaterial, 0) + coalesce(@nCost, 0)
	    set @nCost = 0
	    execute o7actdma 'OSVCST', @sEvt_code, null, null, null, @nCost OUTPUT, null
	    set @nMaterial = @nMaterial + coalesce(@nCost, 0)
	    set @nCost = 0
	    execute o7piddma 'OSVCST', @sEvt_code, null, null, null, @nCost OUTPUT, null
	    set @nMaterial = @nMaterial + coalesce(@nCost, 0)
        
            execute o7acttool 'OSVCST', @sEvt_code, null, null, null, @nTool OUTPUT, null
            
            set @nLabor = coalesce(@nLabor, 0)
            set @nTool = coalesce(@nTool, 0)
            
            set @nTotal = @nLabor + @nMaterial + @nTool

            INSERT INTO r5eventcosts( ect_event,      ect_org,        ect_updated,
                                  ect_object,     ect_object_org, ect_total,
                                  ect_topoint,    ect_frompoint,  ect_hours,
                                  ect_labor,      ect_material,   ect_tool )
            VALUES ( @sEvt_code,    @sEvt_org,       @dDate, 
                 @sObject,         @sObjectOrg,        @nTotal, 
                 @nEvt_topoint, @nEvt_frompoint, @nHours,
                 @nLabor,       @nMaterial,      @nTool)


            fetch next from c_wo into  @sEvt_code, @sEvt_org, @nEvt_frompoint, @nEvt_topoint
        end  

    close c_wo
    deallocate c_wo

                                else 1  end

    return @nReturn

create function O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARCOEFFICIENT (	@nEquipmentFromPoint   numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEquipmentToPoint     numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEventFromPoint       numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEventToPoint         numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEvalFromPoint        numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEvalToPoint          numeric(24,6))
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
    declare @nPercentage numeric(24,6) 
    declare @sX nvarchar(1)
    declare @nFromPoint  numeric(24,6)
    declare @nToPoint    numeric(24,6)

    set @nPercentage = 1.000000
    set @nFromPoint = coalesce(@nEventFromPoint, @nEquipmentFromPoint)
    set @nToPoint = coalesce(@nEventToPoint, @nEquipmentToPoint) 


    IF @nEquipmentToPoint IS NOT NULL  AND (@nToPoint- @nFromPoint) <> 0 
        set @nPercentage = ( @nEvalToPoint + @nToPoint - ABS( @nEvalToPoint - @nToPoint) - @nEvalFromPoint - @nFromPoint- ABS( @nEvalFromPoint - @nFromPoint )) / ( 2 * ( @nToPoint - @nFromPoint ) )

    return @nPercentage
end

create function O7LRF_O7GET_LINEARCOST (	@nEquipmentFromPoint   numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEquipmentToPoint     numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEventFromPoint       numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEventToPoint         numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEvalFromPoint        numeric(24,6),
                                            @nEvalToPoint          numeric(24,6),
                                            @sEventCode            nvarchar(30),
                                            @nCostType             numeric(38,0))
returns numeric(20,2)
as
begin
    declare @nPercentage numeric(24,6) 
    declare @nRetValue   numeric(20,2)  
    declare @sX nvarchar(1)
    declare @nFromPoint  numeric(24,6)
    declare @nToPoint    numeric(24,6)

    set @nPercentage = 1.000000
    set @nRetValue = 0.00
    set @nFromPoint = coalesce(@nEventFromPoint, @nEquipmentFromPoint)
    set @nToPoint = coalesce(@nEventToPoint, @nEquipmentToPoint) 

	 if @nEquipmentToPoint IS NULL 
	  	set @sX = NULL
	 else
        begin
            IF (@nToPoint- @nFromPoint) = 0   	 
                set @sX = NULL
            else
                set @nPercentage =  (@nEvalToPoint + @nToPoint -ABS(@nEvalToPoint - @nToPoint)  - @nEvalFromPoint-@nFromPoint- ABS(@nEvalFromPoint-@nFromPoint) ) / (2*(@nToPoint -@nFromPoint))
        end


  		IF @nCostType=1 
		   set @nRetValue = round(@nPercentage*dbo.o7cost_labour2(@sEventCode),2)

		IF @nCostType=2 
		   set @nRetValue = round(@nPercentage*dbo.o7cost_tools2(@sEventCode),2)

		IF @nCostType=3 
		   set @nRetValue = round(@nPercentage*dbo.o7cost_material2(@sEventCode),2)

		IF @nCostType=4 
		   set @nRetValue = round(@nPercentage*(dbo.o7cost_labour2(@sEventCode)+dbo.o7cost_material2(@sEventCode)+dbo.o7cost_tools2(@sEventCode)),2)

	 return @nRetValue
end
