CREATE PROCEDURE O7MAIL_O7CREATERECIPIENTS
	@sText          nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT,
	@sPK            nvarchar(30),
    @sMail          nvarchar(4000),
	@sParam1        nvarchar(80),
	@sParam2        nvarchar(80),
	@sParam3        nvarchar(80),
	@sParam4        nvarchar(80),
	@sParam5        nvarchar(80),
	@sParam6        nvarchar(80),
	@sParam7        nvarchar(80),
	@sParam8        nvarchar(80),
	@sParam9        nvarchar(80),
	@sParam10       nvarchar(80),
	@sParam11       nvarchar(80),
	@sParam12       nvarchar(80),
	@sParam13       nvarchar(80),
	@sParam14       nvarchar(80),
	@sParam15       nvarchar(80)  
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sEa    nvarchar(255)
    declare @nLen   int

    declare @sTemp  nvarchar(16)
    declare @nID    int
    declare @sParm  nvarchar(80)

    declare @sTable     nvarchar(128)
    declare @sColumn    nvarchar(128)

    set @sText = @sMail

	CREATE TABLE #tparamdata (Param NVARCHAR(80), ParmId integer)
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam1, 1
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam2, 2
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam3, 3
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam4, 4
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam5, 5
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam6, 6
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam7, 7
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam8, 8
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam9, 9
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam10, 10
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam11, 11
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam12, 12
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam13, 13
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam14, 14
	INSERT INTO #tparamdata SELECT @sParam15, 15

	declare c_par cursor local for select Param, ParmId FROM #tparamdata order by ParmId desc
	open c_par
	fetch next from c_par into @sParm, @nID
	while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		begin
            set @sTemp = N'%' + cast( @nID as nvarchar(38))
            if charindex( @sTemp, @sText ) > 0
                begin
                    set @nLen = 0
                    --workaround for SQL Server-stupidism.  Get the column and table values first to avoid collation conflict
                    select @sTable = map_table, @sColumn = map_column 
                      from r5mailparameters
                     where map_attribpk = @sPK
                     AND   map_parameter = @nID 

                    --SQL Server user_tab_columns equivalent doesn't have char_length.  Use data_length
                    SELECT @nLen = data_length
                     FROM   user_tab_columns
                     WHERE  column_name = @sColumn
                     AND    table_name = @sTable

                    set @sEa = null
                    if @nLen = 30
                        SELECT @sEa = usr_emailaddress
                         FROM   r5users
                         WHERE  usr_code = @sParm
                    
                    if @nLen = 15
                        SELECT @sEa = per_emailaddress
                        FROM   r5personnel
                        WHERE  per_code = @sParm

                    if @sEa is not null
                        set @sText = replace( @sText, @sTemp, @sEa )
                end

			fetch next from c_par into @sParm, @nID
  		end
	close c_par
	deallocate c_par
	drop table #tparamdata

CREATE PROCEDURE O7MARKPAGELAYOUTCHANGE
AS
 
BEGIN

  ALTER TABLE r5pagelayout DISABLE TRIGGER PREUPD2_PLO


  /* first reset the pagelayout record as not changed */
  UPDATE r5pagelayout 
  SET    plo_changed = '-' 
  WHERE  plo_changed = '+'
  
  /* for cloned screens, set the parent page */
  UPDATE t
  SET    plo_parentpage = f.fun_application
  FROM   r5pagelayout t, r5functions f
  WHERE  t.plo_pagename = f.fun_code
  AND    f.fun_application IS NOT NULL
  AND    f.fun_application <> 'BSUGRD' 

  UPDATE t
  SET    plo_parentpage = f.fun_application
  FROM   r5pagelayout t, r5functions f
  WHERE  t.plo_pagename LIKE f.fun_code+'%'
  AND    SUBSTRING( plo_pagename, 1, CHARINDEX( '_', plo_pagename ) - 1 ) = fun_code 
  AND    CHARINDEX( '_', plo_pagename ) > 0
  AND    f.fun_application IS NOT NULL
  AND    f.fun_application <> 'BSUGRD' 
  
  /* mark the records that have been changed by screen designer */
  UPDATE t
  SET    plo_changed = '+'
  FROM   r5pagelayout t, r5defaultpagelayout d
  WHERE  d.pld_pagename = ISNULL( t.plo_parentpage, t.plo_pagename ) 
  AND    d.pld_elementid = t.plo_elementid
  AND    ( t.plo_presentinjsp                  <> pld_presentinjsp OR 
           ISNULL( t.plo_attribute, '#' )      <> ISNULL( d.pld_attribute, '#' ) OR 
           ISNULL( t.plo_fieldcontainer, '#' ) <> ISNULL( d.pld_fieldcontainer, '#' ) OR 
           ISNULL( t.plo_fieldgroup, -999 )    <> ISNULL( d.pld_fieldgroup, -999 ) OR 
           ISNULL( t.plo_tabindex, -999 )      <> ISNULL( d.pld_tabindex, -999 ) OR
           t.plo_defaultvalue  IS NOT NULL )

  ALTER TABLE r5pagelayout ENABLE TRIGGER PREUPD2_PLO


END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7MATAVAILDATE(
  @sEvent      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @nActivity   NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @pPart       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @pPartorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @pStore      NVARCHAR( 15 ))
  RETURNS DATETIME AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @nQty      NUMERIC   -- Qty still to find on req./order lines
  DECLARE @nStockqty NUMERIC   -- Qty in stock
  DECLARE @nAllocqty NUMERIC   -- Qty allocated to other WOs
  DECLARE @dAdate    DATETIME  -- Date qty available

  DECLARE @sMatlist  NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @nMatrev   NUMERIC( 4 )
  DECLARE @sStore    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sPart     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sPartorg  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sDirect   NVARCHAR( 1 )

  DECLARE @nRqlqty   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @dDue      DATETIME

  /* Retrieve material list and store. */
  SELECT @sMatlist = act_matlist, 
         @nMatrev  = act_matlrev, 
         @sStore   = CASE WHEN @pPart IS NOT NULL THEN @pStore ELSE mrc_store END
  FROM   r5mrcs, r5events, r5activities
  WHERE  evt_code  = act_event
  AND    mrc_code  = evt_mrc
  AND    act_event = @sEvent
  AND    act_act   = @nActivity

  IF @sMatlist IS NULL OR @sStore IS NULL
    RETURN NULL

  SET @dAdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), 'DD' )

  /* Cursor to retrieve all parts on material list. */
  DECLARE c_mlp CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
  SELECT mlp_part, mlp_part_org, mlp_qty, mlp_direct
  FROM   r5matlparts
  WHERE  mlp_matlist  = @sMatlist
  AND    mlp_matlrev  = @nMatrev
  AND    mlp_part     = COALESCE( @pPart, mlp_part )
  AND    mlp_part_org = COALESCE( @pPartorg, mlp_part_org )
 
  OPEN c_mlp
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_mlp INTO @sPart, @sPartorg, @nQty, @sDirect  
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    /* Loop through all parts on the material list. */
    BEGIN

      /* Initialize quantities. */
      SET @nStockqty = 0
      SET @nAllocqty = 0

      IF @sDirect = '-'
        BEGIN
          SELECT @nStockqty = sto_qty
          FROM   r5stock
          WHERE  sto_store    = @sStore
          AND    sto_part     = @sPart
          AND    sto_part_org = @sPartorg

          SELECT @nAllocqty = SUM( res_allqty )
          FROM   r5reservations
          WHERE  res_store    = @sStore
          AND    res_part     = @sPart
          AND    res_part_org = @sPartorg
          AND  ( res_event <> @sEvent OR res_act <> @nActivity )
        END

      SET @nQty = @nQty - dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( COALESCE( @nStockqty, 0 ) - COALESCE( @nAllocqty, 0 ), 0 )

      IF @nQty > 0 
        BEGIN
          /* Cursor to retrieve all req./order lines until needed qty reached. */ 
          DECLARE c_rql CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
          SELECT rql_qty - COALESCE( rql_recvqty, 0 ), rql_due
          FROM   r5requisitions, r5requislines
          WHERE  req_code      = rql_req
          AND    rql_part      = @sPart
          AND    rql_part_org  = @sPartorg
          AND    req_tocode    = @sStore
          AND    req_torentity = N'STOR' 
          AND    req_rtype    <> N'STST' 
          AND    rql_active    = N'+'
          AND    rql_due IS NOT NULL
          AND    rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'R', N'J' )
          AND  ( ( rql_rtype <> N'PD' AND @sDirect = N'-' ) OR
                 ( rql_rtype  = N'PD' AND @sDirect = N'+' AND rql_event = @sEvent AND rql_act = @nActivity ) )
          AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                          FROM   r5orderlines
                          WHERE  orl_req     = rql_req
                          AND    orl_reqline = rql_reqline )
          UNION ALL
          SELECT rql_qty - COALESCE( rql_recvqty, 0 ), rql_due
          FROM   r5requisitions, r5requislines
          WHERE  req_code     = rql_req
          AND    rql_part     = @sPart
          AND    rql_part_org = @sPartorg
          AND    req_tocode   = @sStore
          AND    req_rtype    = N'STST' 
          AND    rql_active   = N'+'
          AND    rql_due IS NOT NULL
          AND    rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N'R', N'J' )
          AND    @sDirect = N'-'
          UNION ALL
          SELECT orl_ordqty - COALESCE( orl_recvqty, 0 ), orl_due
          FROM   r5orderlines
          WHERE  orl_part     = @sPart
          AND    orl_part_org = @sPartorg
          AND    orl_store    = @sStore
          AND    orl_active   = N'+'
          AND    orl_due IS NOT NULL
          AND    orl_rstatus NOT IN ( N'R', N'J' )
          AND  ( ( orl_rtype <> N'PD' AND @sDirect = N'-' ) OR
                 ( orl_rtype  = N'PD' AND @sDirect = N'+' AND orl_event = @sEvent AND orl_act = @nActivity ) )
          ORDER BY 2

          OPEN c_rql
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_rql INTO @nRqlqty, @dDue  
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            /* Loop through all req./order lines until needed qty reached. */ 
            BEGIN
              SET @nQty = @nQty - @nRqlqty 
              IF @nQty <= 0 
                BEGIN
                  /* Qty reached, so reset the date, if necessary. */
                  SET @dAdate = dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( @dAdate, @dDue )
                  BREAK
                END
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_rql INTO @nRqlqty, @dDue  
            END
          CLOSE c_rql
          DEALLOCATE c_rql   
        END  
     
      IF @nQty > 0
        /* Not enough qty, so return without date. */
        RETURN NULL

      FETCH NEXT FROM c_mlp INTO @sPart, @sPartorg, @nQty, @sDirect 
    END
  CLOSE c_mlp
  DEALLOCATE c_mlp   

  RETURN @dAdate
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7MATRET
               (@sOrder   NVARCHAR(30)
               ,@sEvent   NVARCHAR(30)
               ,@sType    NVARCHAR(10)
               ,@sPart    NVARCHAR(30)
               ,@sPartOrg NVARCHAR(15)
               ,@sLot     NVARCHAR(12)
			   ,@sRelatedwo NVARCHAR(30) = NULL
			   ,@sAdvice NVARCHAR(45) = NULL) RETURNS NUMERIC(30, 6)

AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @nQty NUMERIC(30, 6)
DECLARE @sOrdernr  NVARCHAR( 100 )
DECLARE @sOrderorg NVARCHAR( 100 )
DECLARE @nOrdline  numeric(8)
DECLARE @sMultiequip NVARCHAR(1) 
declare @sProducts  nvarchar(200)

SET @sMultiequip = N'-'
SET @nQty = 0
set @sProducts = dbo.o7dflt2( N'PRODUCTS')

	set @sOrdernr = @sOrder
	IF charindex( N'#', @sOrdernr ) > 0 
		begin
			/* corder also hold, org and line number, so get them. */
			set @sOrderorg = SUBSTRING( @sOrdernr, charindex( N'#', @sOrdernr ) + 1, len(@sOrdernr) )
			set @sOrdernr  = SUBSTRING( @sOrdernr, 1, charindex( N'#' , @sOrdernr  ) - 1 )
			IF charindex( N'#' , @sOrderorg  ) > 0 
				begin
					set @nOrdline  = cast( SUBSTRING( @sOrderorg, charindex( N'#', @sOrderorg  ) + 1, len(@sOrderorg) ) as numeric(8))
					set @sOrderorg = SUBSTRING( @sOrderorg, 1, charindex( N'#', @sOrderorg  ) - 1 )
				end
		end



IF @sType NOT IN (N'EVNT', N'STOR')
   RETURN @nQty


SELECT @sMultiequip = evt_multiequip
FROM   r5events
WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent

IF @sType = N'EVNT'
	begin
		IF @sMultiequip = N'+' and upper( @sProducts ) <> N'D7I'
			begin
				IF @sRelatedwo IS NULL 
						SELECT   @nQty = SUM(CASE t.tra_torentity WHEN N'COMP' THEN -tl.trl_qty ELSE tl.trl_qty END)
						FROM     r5translines tl, r5transactions t
						WHERE    t.tra_rstatus   = N'A'
                        AND      isnull( t.tra_advice, N'%' ) LIKE isnull( @sAdvice, N'%' )
						AND      tl.trl_order     = @sOrdernr
						AND      tl.trl_order_org = coalesce( @sOrderorg, tl.trl_order_org )
						AND      tl.trl_trans    = t.tra_code
						AND      coalesce( tl.trl_ordline, 0 )  = coalesce( coalesce( @nOrdline, tl.trl_ordline ), 0 )
						AND      tl.trl_part     = @sPart
						AND      tl.trl_part_org = @sPartOrg
						AND      ( ( t.tra_torentity = N'COMP'
									AND  t.tra_fromrentity = N'EVNT' )
									OR  t.tra_torentity = N'EVNT' )
						AND      EXISTS (SELECT NULL FROM  r5events e, r5orderlines o
										WHERE  e.evt_routeparent = @sEvent
										AND    e.evt_code = tl.trl_event
										AND    o.orl_order = tl.trl_order
										AND    o.orl_ordline =tl.trl_ordline
										AND    o.orl_relatedwo IS NULL)
				ELSE
					SELECT   @nQty = SUM(CASE t.tra_torentity WHEN N'COMP' THEN -tl.trl_qty ELSE tl.trl_qty END)
					FROM     r5translines tl, r5transactions t
					WHERE    t.tra_rstatus   = N'A'
                    AND      isnull( t.tra_advice, N'%' ) LIKE isnull( @sAdvice, N'%' )
					AND      tl.trl_order     = @sOrdernr
					AND      tl.trl_order_org = coalesce( @sOrderorg, tl.trl_order_org )
					AND      tl.trl_trans    = t.tra_code
					AND      coalesce( tl.trl_ordline, 0 )  = coalesce( coalesce( @nOrdline, tl.trl_ordline ), 0 )
					AND      tl.trl_part     = @sPart
					AND      tl.trl_part_org = @sPartOrg
					AND      ( ( t.tra_torentity = N'COMP'
								AND  t.tra_fromrentity = N'EVNT')
								OR  t.tra_torentity = N'EVNT' )
					AND     ( EXISTS ( SELECT  null FROM r5orderlines ol WHERE ol.orl_order = tl.trl_order and ol.orl_order_org = tl.trl_order_org and ol.orl_ordline 
					=  coalesce( @nOrdline, tl.trl_ordline) and ol.orl_relatedwo =@sRelatedwo and ol.orl_event = @sEvent))
			end
		ELSE
		   SELECT @nQty = SUM(CASE TRA.tra_torentity WHEN N'COMP' THEN -TRL.trl_qty ELSE TRL.trl_qty END)
			 FROM r5translines   TRL
				 ,r5transactions TRA
			WHERE TRA.tra_rstatus = N'A'
              AND isnull( TRA.tra_advice, N'%' ) LIKE isnull( @sAdvice, N'%' )
			  AND TRL.trl_order = @sOrdernr
			  AND TRL.trl_order_org = coalesce( @sOrderorg, TRL.trl_order_org )
			  AND TRL.trl_trans = TRA.tra_code
			  AND coalesce( TRL.trl_ordline, 0 )  = coalesce( coalesce( @nOrdline, TRL.trl_ordline ), 0 )
			  AND TRL.trl_event = @sEvent
			  AND TRL.trl_part = @sPart
			  AND TRL.trl_part_org = @sPartOrg
			  AND ((TRA.tra_torentity = N'COMP' AND TRA.tra_fromrentity = N'EVNT') OR TRA.tra_torentity = N'EVNT')
	end
ELSE
   SELECT @nQty = SUM(tst_qty)
     FROM r5transtock
    WHERE tst_torentity = N'EVNT'
      AND tst_order = @sOrdernr
      AND tst_tocode = coalesce(@sRelatedwo, @sEvent)
      AND tst_part = @sPart
      AND tst_part_org = @sPartOrg
      AND tst_lot = @sLot
	  AND    tst_ordline = COALESCE(@nOrdline,tst_ordline)

RETURN @nQty
END

create function O7MATRIX_GET_HIERARCHY1 (	@sParent nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15),
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
				stc_child_org, 
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent = @sParent

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sParent = stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sParent )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sParent and stc_child_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
												stc_child_org,
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_parent = @sParent and 
												stc_parent_org = @sOrg
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create procedure O7MCOSTS   @sEvent     nvarchar(30),
                            @nAct       numeric(8),
                            @sRtype     nvarchar(4),
                            @sDescr     nvarchar(80),
                            @nQty       numeric(24,6),
                            @nPrice     numeric(24,6),
                            @dDate      datetime, 
                            @sSplit     nvarchar(1),
                            @sR5user    nvarchar(255),
                            @sChk       nvarchar(4)     OUTPUT,
                            @sInv       nvarchar(45) = NULL,
                            @sInvorg    nvarchar(15) = NULL,
                            @nInvline   numeric = NULL
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    declare @sUtype     nvarchar(4)
    declare @sCode      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sMrc       nvarchar(15)
    declare @sOrg       nvarchar(15)
    declare @sProject   nvarchar(20)
    declare @sProjbud   nvarchar(20)
    declare @sCostcode  nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTrade     nvarchar(15)
    declare @nReturn    int

    set @sChk = N'0'

    if @sEvent is null or
       @nAct is null or
       @sRtype is null or
       @sDescr is null or
       @nQty is null or
       @nPrice is null or
       @dDate is null or
       @sR5user is null
        begin
            set @sChk = N'1'
            return
        end
    
    SELECT @sMrc = evt_mrc, @sOrg = evt_org, @sProject = evt_project, @sProjbud = evt_projbud, @sCostcode = evt_costcode
    FROM   r5events
    WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent

    if @sRtype in ( N'N', N'O', N'X')
        begin   
            SELECT @sTrade = act_trade
            FROM   r5activities
            WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
            AND    act_act   = @nAct


            execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @sUtype OUTPUT, @sRtype, N'OCTP', @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1

            INSERT INTO r5bookedhours( boo_event, boo_act, boo_date, boo_trade, boo_mrc,
                                       boo_octype, boo_ocrtype, boo_hours, boo_rate, boo_cost, boo_entered,
                                       boo_correction, boo_splithours, boo_desc, boo_misc,
                                       boo_unmatchedinvoice, boo_unmatchedinvoice_org, boo_unmatchedinvoiceline )
                VALUES( @sEvent, @nAct, @dDate, @sTrade, @sMrc,
                        @sUtype, @sRtype, @nQty, @nPrice, @nQty * @nPrice, dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ),
                        N'-', @sSplit, @sDescr, N'+',
                        @sInv, @sInvorg, @nInvline )
        end
    else
        begin
            if @sRtype = N'TOOL' 
                begin
                    /* for tools insert into r5toolusage table. */
                    INSERT INTO r5toolusage( tou_tool, tou_desc,  tou_mrc, tou_event, tou_act, tou_datebooked,
                            tou_dateused, tou_hours, tou_tariff, tou_cost, tou_qty,tou_misc,tou_splitusage)
                    VALUES  ('*', @sDescr, @sMrc, @sEvent, @nAct,
                            dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), 1,@nPrice, @nQty * @nPrice, @nQty,N'+', @sSplit)
                end
            else
                begin
                    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sCode OUTPUT, N'TRAN', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1

                    INSERT INTO r5transactions( tra_code, tra_org, tra_desc, tra_auth, tra_rtype,
                                            tra_date, tra_fromcode, tra_fromcode_org, tra_fromrentity, tra_fromrtype,
                                            tra_tocode, tra_torentity, tra_tortype, tra_rstatus, tra_printed )
                    SELECT @sCode, @sOrg, @sDescr, @sR5user, N'MISC',
                        @dDate, N'*', ins_desc, N'COMP', N'*',
                        @sEvent, N'EVNT', N'*', N'A', N'-'
                    FROM   r5install
                    WHERE  ins_code = N'DEFORG'

                    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @sUtype OUTPUT, N'N', N'TRTP', @sChk OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1

                    INSERT INTO r5translines( trl_line, trl_type, trl_rtype, trl_trans, trl_date,
                                            trl_qty, trl_price, trl_io, trl_event, trl_act, trl_desc,
                                            trl_project, trl_projbud, trl_costcode, trl_splittrans )
                    VALUES( 10, @sUtype, N'MISC', @sCode, @dDate,
                            @nQty, @nPrice, 0, @sEvent, @nAct, @sDescr,
                            @sProject, @sProjbud, @sCostcode, @sSplit )
                end
        end

body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7MERGENONCONFORMITIES
  @code    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @code2   NVARCHAR( 30 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @ncopk        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @ncorecorded  DATETIME
  DECLARE @cstatus      NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @o            NUMERIC
  DECLARE @chk          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @r            INT

  IF @code IS NULL OR @code2 IS NULL OR @code = @code2
    /* The two nonconformities cannot null or be the same. If so, exit. */
    RETURN

  /* Store the original non conformity code on all observations to be merged. */
  UPDATE r5nonconformobservations
  SET    nco_codebeforemerge = @code
  WHERE  nco_code = @code
  AND    nco_codebeforemerge IS NULL

  /* Store the original non conformity code and set the status to Closed (of the nonconformity that will merge into another). */
  EXECUTE @r = r5o7_o7ucode @cstatus OUTPUT, N'C', N'NCST', @chk OUTPUT
  UPDATE r5nonconformities
  SET    ncf_mergedinto = @code2,
         ncf_rstatus    = N'C',
         ncf_status     = @cstatus
  WHERE  ncf_code       = @code
  
  /* Update all sequence numbers, so they can be renumbered later (without causing unique key errors). */
  UPDATE r5nonconformobservations
  SET    nco_observation = nco_observation + 90000000
  WHERE  nco_code = @code

  UPDATE r5nonconformobservations
  SET    nco_observation = -(nco_observation + 90000000)
  WHERE  nco_code = @code2

  SET @o = 0

  /* Loop through all combined observations, to set the new observation. */ 
  DECLARE nco CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
    SELECT nco_pk, COALESCE( nco_recorded, nco_created )
    FROM   r5nonconformobservations
    WHERE  nco_code = @code
    UNION
    SELECT nco_pk, COALESCE( nco_recorded, nco_created )
    FROM   r5nonconformobservations
    WHERE  nco_code = @code2
    ORDER BY 2
  OPEN nco
  FETCH NEXT FROM nco INTO @ncopk, @ncorecorded
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @o = @o + 1
      /* Set the new obseration. */
      UPDATE r5nonconformobservations
      SET    nco_code        = @code2,
             nco_observation = @o
      WHERE  nco_pk          = @ncopk
      FETCH NEXT FROM nco INTO @ncopk, @ncorecorded
    END
  CLOSE nco
  DEALLOCATE nco
END

create function O7MLPQTY (  @sEvent		nvarchar(30),

							@sStore		nvarchar(15) )

returns numeric(24,6)
as

		SELECT @nResult = SUM( mlp_qty )
		FROM   r5matlparts m,
			 r5events e,
			 r5mrcs d,
			 r5activities a
		WHERE  a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist

		AND    a.act_event    = e.evt_code

CREATE PROCEDURE O7MODUDSTABLE  @sScreenName    NVARCHAR(6),
                                @sFieldName     NVARCHAR(60),
                                @sFieldType     NVARCHAR(15),
                                @sIsNullabl     NVARCHAR(1),
                                @sNewField      NVARCHAR(1),
                                @nMaxLength     NUMERIC(4),
                                @nPrecision     NUMERIC(2),
                                @nScale         NUMERIC(1)
AS
BEGIN

    declare @sAlterTableSql        NVARCHAR(4000)
    declare @sTableName            NVARCHAR(20)
    declare @sIsNull               NVARCHAR(10)
    
    SET @sAlterTableSql = 'ALTER TABLE '
    
    DECLARE cursor_udsscreen CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT  usc_tablename
    FROM    r5udfscreens
    WHERE   usc_screenname = @sScreenName 
    AND     coalesce(usc_notused, '-') = '-'
    
    OPEN cursor_udsscreen
    FETCH NEXT FROM cursor_udsscreen INTO @sTableName
    CLOSE cursor_udsscreen

    IF @sIsNullabl = '-'
        SET @sIsNull = 'NOT NULL '
    ELSE
        SET @sIsNull = 'NULL '

    IF @sNewField = '-'
        SET @sAlterTableSql =  @sAlterTableSql + 'u5'+ @sTableName  + ' ALTER COLUMN ' +  @sFieldName
    ELSE
        SET @sAlterTableSql =  @sAlterTableSql + 'u5'+ @sTableName  + ' ADD ' +  @sFieldName
        
    IF @sFieldType = 'NUMERICFIELD' 
        BEGIN
            IF @nScale IS NOT NULL AND @nScale  != 0
                SET @sAlterTableSql = @sAlterTableSql + ' NUMERIC(' + cast(@nPrecision as NVARCHAR(2)) + ',' + cast(@nScale as NVARCHAR(1)) + ') ' + @sIsNull
            ELSE
                SET @sAlterTableSql = @sAlterTableSql + ' NUMERIC(' +  cast(@nPrecision as NVARCHAR(2)) +') ' + @sIsNull
        END
    
    ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF @sFieldType = 'TIME' 
                SET @sAlterTableSql = @sAlterTableSql +  ' NUMERIC(24,6) ' + @sIsNull
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    IF  @sFieldType = 'TEXTFIELD'
                        SET @sAlterTableSql = @sAlterTableSql + ' NVARCHAR(' +  cast(@nMaxlength as NVARCHAR(4)) + ') COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ' + @sIsNull
                    ELSE
                        BEGIN
                            IF @sFieldType = 'CHECKBOX'
                                SET @sAlterTableSql = @sAlterTableSql + ' NVARCHAR(1) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ' + @sIsNull
                            ELSE 
                                BEGIN
                                    IF @sFieldType = 'TEXTAREAFIELD'
                                        SET @sAlterTableSql = @sAlterTableSql + ' NTEXT COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN ' + @sIsNull
                                    ELSE
                                        BEGIN
                                            IF @sFieldType = 'DATETIMEFIELD'
                                                SET @sAlterTableSql = @sAlterTableSql + ' DATETIME ' + @sIsNull
                                            ELSE
                                                BEGIN
                                                    IF @sFieldType = 'DATEFIELD'
                                                        SET @sAlterTableSql = @sAlterTableSql + ' DATETIME ' + @sIsNull
                                                END
                                        END
                                END
                        END
                END
        END

    SET @sAlterTableSql = @sAlterTableSql + CHAR(13)
    
    -- now modify the table
    EXEC (@sAlterTableSql)
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7MPAVAIL 
  @sUser nvarchar(255), 
  @sRole nvarchar(30) = '*'
as 
    declare @dStartdate datetime
    declare @dEnddate   datetime
    declare @dCalc_date datetime
    declare @dSys_date  datetime
    declare @nDSCHAVAI  numeric(24,6)
    declare @sChk       nvarchar(5)

    SET NOCOUNT ON
    
    set @dSys_date = dbo.o7gttime2( null )

    DELETE FROM r5mpavailabilities

    set @dStartdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dSys_date, N'DD' )
    set @nDSCHAVAI = dbo.o7dflt2( N'DSCHAVAI' )
    set @dEnddate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dSys_date + @nDSCHAVAI, N'DD' )
    set @dCalc_date = @dStartdate

    while @dCalc_date between @dStartdate and @dEnddate
        begin
            INSERT INTO r5mpavailabilities
                 (
                     mpv_date,
                     mpv_resource,
                     mpv_resinitial,
                     mpv_trade,
                     mpv_mrc,
                     mpv_hours
                 )
                SELECT @dCalc_date,
                       p.per_desc,
                       p.per_code,
                       p.per_trade,
                       p.per_mrc,
                       isnull( SUM( isnull( x.exc_hours, sd.shd_hours)), 0 )
                 FROM  r5shifts sh,
                       r5shfdays_view sd,
                       r5personnel  p left outer join r5shfpers sp   on ( p.per_code = sp.shp_person )
                                      left outer join r5exceptions x on ( x.exc_person = sp.shp_person
                                                                          AND    x.exc_date = @dCalc_date )
                WHERE  sp.shp_shift = sh.shf_code
                AND    sp.shp_start <= @dCalc_date
                AND    isnull(sh.shf_start, @dCalc_date) <= @dCalc_date
                AND    sp.shp_end   >= @dCalc_date
                AND    sd.shd_shift  = sh.shf_code
                AND    sd.shd_day    = (datediff( dd, sh.shf_start, @dCalc_date) % cast(sh.shf_length as int)) + 1
                AND    p.per_notused = N'-'
                AND    EXISTS (SELECT NULL FROM r5userorganization WHERE uog_user = @sUser and uog_role = @sRole and uog_org= p.per_org)
                GROUP BY p.per_code,
                           p.per_desc,
                           p.per_trade,
                           p.per_mrc

            set @dCalc_date = @dCalc_date + 1
            
        end

    UPDATE r5mpavailabilities SET mpv_hours =  (SELECT isnull(mpv_hours, 0)- isnull(SUM(acs_hours), 0)
                                                FROM   r5actschedules
                                                WHERE  acs_responsible = mpv_resinitial
                                                AND    acs_shiftschedulesession IS NULL
                                                AND    acs_sched = mpv_date)

    IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

    /* this cursor to retrieve WOs with Maintenance Pattern sequence data */

                                        AND    peq_revision   = evt_mp_rev

                                        AND    psq_mp         = evt_mp

create procedure O7MPEXISTS	@sTabname			nvarchar(200),
							@sFuncname			nvarchar(6),
							@sKeyfield1			nvarchar(2000),
							@sKeyfield2			nvarchar(2000),
							@sKeyfield3			nvarchar(2000),
							@sKeyfield4			nvarchar(2000),
							@sKeyfield5			nvarchar(2000),
							@sKeyfield6			nvarchar(2000),
							@sKeyfield7			nvarchar(2000),
							@sKeyfield8			nvarchar(2000),
							@sKeyfield9			nvarchar(2000),
							@sDatatabnames		nvarchar(2000)	OUTPUT,
							@sNosqltabnames		nvarchar(2000)	OUTPUT,
							@sNodatatabnames	nvarchar(2000)	OUTPUT,
							@sChk				nvarchar(6)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
 	declare @sTabs		nvarchar(200)
 	declare @sTab		nvarchar(100)
 	declare @sX			nvarchar(1)
 	declare @sStatement	nvarchar(4000)
 	declare @nComma		int
 	declare @nCount		int

	set @sChk = N'0'
	
	SELECT @sX = 'x'
	FROM   r5functions
	WHERE  fun_code = @sFuncname

	if @sX is null
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	set @sTabs = REPLACE( @sTabname, N' ', null)

	while @sTabs is not null
		begin
			set @nComma = CHARINDEX( @sTabs, N',' )
			if @nComma = 0
				begin
					set @sTab = @sTabs
					set @sTabs = null
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sTab = SUBSTRING( @sTabs, 1, @nComma - 1 )
					set @sTabs = SUBSTRING( @sTabs, @nComma + 1, len(@sTabs) )
				end

			SELECT @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5functiontabs
			WHERE  ftb_function = @sFuncname
			AND    ftb_tab      = @sTab

			if @nCount = 0
				begin
					set @sChk = N'2'
					return
				end

			SELECT @sStatement = REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE(
								  REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( ftb_sqlexist,
									N'keyfield1', @sKeyfield1 ),
									N'keyfield2', @sKeyfield2 ),
									N'keyfield3', @sKeyfield3 ),
									N'keyfield4', @sKeyfield4 ),
									N'keyfield5', @sKeyfield5 ),
									N'keyfield6', @sKeyfield6 ),
									N'keyfield7', @sKeyfield7 ),
									N'keyfield8', @sKeyfield8 ),
									N'keyfield9', @sKeyfield9 )
			FROM   r5functiontabs
			WHERE  ftb_function = @sFuncname
			AND    ftb_tab      = @sTab

			if @sStatement is null
				begin
					if @sNosqltabnames is null 
						set @sNosqltabnames = @sTab
					else
						set @sNosqltabnames = @sNosqltabnames + N',' + @sTab
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sStatement = N'SELECT @nCount = count(*) ' + @sStatement
					EXEC sp_executesql @sStatement, N'@nCount int OUTPUT', @nCount OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR = 0
						begin
							if @nCount = 0
								begin
									if @sDatatabnames is null
										set @sDatatabnames = @sTab
									else
										set @sDatatabnames = @sDatatabnames + N',' + @sTab
								end
							else
								begin
									if @sNodatatabnames is null
										set @sNodatatabnames = @sTab
									else
										set @sNodatatabnames = @sNodatatabnames + N',' + @sTab
								end
						end
					else
						begin
							if @sNosqltabnames is null 
								set @sNosqltabnames = @sTab
							else
								set @sNosqltabnames = @sNosqltabnames + N',' + @sTab
						end
				end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7MPSEQPREDELETE
    @nMPRev         numeric(4),
    @nMPPK          numeric(8),
    @nRStatusCount  numeric(8) OUTPUT,
    @nAStatusCount  numeric(8) OUTPUT,
    @nMPSeq         numeric(8) OUTPUT,
    @schk           nvarchar(3) OUTPUT
as

    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sEvtCode   nvarchar(30)
    declare @sObject    nvarchar(30)
    declare @sObjectOrg nvarchar(15)
    declare @sMP        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sMPOrg     nvarchar(15)
    declare @nSeq     numeric(8)

    /* set some initial values */
    set @schk = N'0'
    set @nRStatusCount = 0
    set @nAStatusCount = 0

    IF @nMPRev IS NULL OR @nMPPK IS NULL
    BEGIN
       set @schk = N'1'
       RETURN -1
    END
    
    /* this cursor to retrieve Awaiting status WOs with Maintenance Pattern data */
    declare c_header cursor local for   SELECT evt_code, evt_object, evt_object_org, evt_mp, evt_mp_org, evt_mp_seq
                                        FROM   r5events
                                        WHERE  evt_mp_rev = @nMPRev
                                        AND    evt_psqpk  = @nMPPK
                                        AND    evt_rstatus = N'A'
    open c_header
    fetch next from c_header into @sEvtCode, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sMP, @sMPOrg, @nSeq
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    begin 
       /* update pattern equipment with status Inactive */
       update r5patternequipment set peq_status = N'I'
       where peq_mp          = @sMP
       AND   peq_mp_org      = @sMPOrg
       AND   peq_revision    = @nMPRev
       AND   peq_object      = @sObject
       AND   peq_object_org  = @sObjectOrg

       /* increment count for Awaiting status WOs */
       set @nAStatusCount = @nAStatusCount + 1
       /* delete WOs with awaiting status */
       delete from r5events where evt_code = @sEvtCode
       /* fetch next row in cursor */
       fetch next from c_header into @sEvtCode, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sMP, @sMPOrg, @nSeq
    end
    close c_header
    deallocate c_header
    
    set @nMPSeq = @nSeq

    /* this cursor to retrieve Relase status WOs with Maintenance Pattern data */
    declare c_header cursor local for   SELECT evt_code, evt_object, evt_object_org, evt_mp_seq
                                        FROM   r5events
                                        WHERE  evt_mp_rev = @nMPRev
                                        AND    evt_psqpk  = @nMPPK
                                        AND    evt_rstatus IN (N'R', N'C')

    open c_header
    fetch next from c_header into @sEvtCode, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @nSeq
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    begin
       /* make the sequence notused */
       UPDATE r5patternsequences SET psq_notused = N'+'
       WHERE psq_pk = @nMPPK
       AND   psq_revision = @nMPRev;
       /* increment count for Release status WOs */
       set @nRStatusCount = @nRStatusCount + 1
       fetch next from c_header into @sEvtCode, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @nSeq
    end
    close c_header
    deallocate c_header
    
    set @nMPSeq = @nSeq

create procedure O7MULTISELECT_HOLDVALUE	@nIndex			int,
											@nValueNumber	int,
											@sValue			nvarchar(80)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL	nvarchar(500)
	declare @sTable	nvarchar(32)
	declare @nCount	int

	SET @sTable = dbo.GET_O7MULTISELECT_TEMP_TBLNAME()

	set @sSQL = N'select @nCount = count(*) from ' + @sTable
	set @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where nIndex = ' + cast( @nIndex as nvarchar(64) ) + N' and'
	set @sSQL = @sSQL + N'		 nValueNumber = ' + cast( @nValueNumber as nvarchar(64) )
	
	EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCount int OUTPUT', @nCount OUTPUT

	if @nCount = 0 
		begin
			set @sSQL = N'insert into ' + @sTable 
			set @sSQL = @sSQL + N' values ( ' + cast( @nIndex as nvarchar(64) )
			set @sSQL = @sSQL + N', ' + cast( @nValueNumber as nvarchar(64) ) + N', ''' + @sValue + N''' )'
			EXEC (@sSQL)
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sSQL = N'update ' + @sTable + N' set tValue = ''' + @sValue + N''''
			set @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where nIndex = ' + cast( @nIndex as nvarchar(64) ) + N' and'
			set @sSQL = @sSQL + N'		 nValueNumber = ' + cast( @nValueNumber as nvarchar(64) )
			EXEC (@sSQL)
		end

create procedure O7MULTIS_SAVPARTVAL @sPart	nvarchar(45)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @sParts  nvarchar(45)
    declare @sPartFromTempTable nvarchar(45)
    declare @sNextPartFromTempTable nvarchar(45)
	declare @sPartstotal  nvarchar(45)
    declare @nParts  int
	declare @nPartstotal int
    declare @nCounter int
    declare @nCounter2 int
	declare @nTempcount int
begin
	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7MULTIS_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
    --to do
	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7MULTIS', N'N_PARTS', @sParts OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7MULTIS', N'N_PARTSTOTAL', @sPartstotal OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @nParts = convert( int, @sParts )
	set @nPartstotal = convert( int, @sPartstotal )

    set @nCounter = 1
    WHILE @nCounter <= @nParts
    begin
        execute  @nReturn = O7MULTIS_GET_PART @nCounter, @sPartFromTempTable OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1
        IF @sPartFromTempTable  = @sPart
        begin
            SET @nCounter2 = @nCounter 
            WHILE @nCounter2 < @nParts
            begin
				set @nTempcount = @nCounter2 + 1
				execute @nReturn = O7MULTIS_GET_PART @nTempcount, @sNextPartFromTempTable OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
                execute @nReturn = O7MULTIS_SET_PART @nCounter2, @sNextPartFromTempTable
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1
                set @nCounter2 = @nCounter2 + 1
            end
        end
        set @nParts = @nParts  - 1
        set @nPartstotal = @nPartstotal - 1
        set @nCounter = @nCounter + 1
    end
end

	set @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where nValueNumber = ' + cast( @nRowId as nvarchar(64) )
	
	EXEC sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCount int OUTPUT', @nCount OUTPUT

	if @nCount = 0 
		begin
			set @sSQL = N'insert into ' + @sTable 
			set @sSQL = @sSQL + N' values ( ' 
			set @sSQL = @sSQL + cast( @nRowId as nvarchar(64) ) + N', ''' + @sValue + N''' )'
			EXEC (@sSQL)
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sSQL = N'update ' + @sTable + N' set tValue = ''' + @sValue + N''''
			set @sSQL = @sSQL + N' where '
			set @sSQL = @sSQL + N' nValueNumber = ' + cast( @nRowId as nvarchar(64) )
			EXEC (@sSQL)
		end
end

create procedure O7NEWLANG
  @sLanguage    nvarchar(2),
  @sLanginst    nvarchar(10),
  @sBoilertexts nvarchar(10),
  @sErrtexts    nvarchar(10),
  @sExtmenus    nvarchar(10),
  @sCodedescs   nvarchar(10),
  @dFromdate    datetime,
  @sOutput      nvarchar(3)  OUTPUT
as
  SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
  SET NOCOUNT ON

  declare @sLocked        nvarchar(1)
  declare @nCountit       int
  declare @sDeflang       nvarchar(200)
  declare @sEntity        nvarchar(8)
  declare @sInstalled     nvarchar(1)
  declare @nReturn        int
  declare @nSQLIdentity   bigint
  declare @sText          nvarchar(80)
  declare @sEmlextmenu    nvarchar(30)
  declare @sEmltext       nvarchar(80)
  declare @sEmngroup      nvarchar(12)
  declare @sEmnfunction   nvarchar(6)
  declare @sFuntxtcode    nvarchar(12)
  declare @sErrm          nvarchar(1000)

  set @nCountit = 0
  set @sOutput = N'0'

  if @sLanguage is null
    begin
      set @sOutput = N'1'
      return
    end

  if exists ( SELECT 'x'
              FROM   r5languages
              WHERE  lan_rstatus IN ( 'RI', 'RR' )
              AND    lan_processstart IS NOT NULL
              AND    datediff( mi, coalesce( lan_lastcreated, GetDate() ), GetDate() ) <= 30 )
    begin
      set @sOutput = N'2'
      return
    end

  SELECT @sInstalled = lan_installed
  FROM   r5languages
  WHERE  lan_code = @sLanguage
  AND EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
              FROM   r5alltexts
              WHERE  atx_lang = lan_code )
  if @sInstalled is null
    begin
      set @sOutput = N'3'
      return
    end

  if @sInstalled = N'+' and UPPER( @sLanginst ) = N'TRUE'
    begin
      set @sOutput = N'4'
      return
    end

  BEGIN TRY

    UPDATE r5languages
    SET    lan_rstatus = CASE WHEN UPPER( @sLanginst ) = N'TRUE' THEN N'RI' ELSE N'RR' END,
           lan_processstart = GetDate(),
           lan_processend = null,
           lan_errormessage = null
    WHERE  lan_code = @sLanguage

    COMMIT TRANSACTION

    SELECT @sDeflang = ins_desc
    FROM   r5install
    WHERE  ins_code = N'DEFLANG'

    SELECT @sEntity = ent_entity
    FROM   r5entities
    WHERE  ent_rentity = N'FUNC'

    if UPPER( @sLanginst ) = N'TRUE'
      begin
        INSERT INTO r5langinst( lin_code )
        SELECT @sLanguage
        WHERE NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                          FROM   r5langinst
                          WHERE  lin_code = @sLanguage )

        COMMIT TRANSACTION

        INSERT INTO r5descriptions(
               des_rentity,   des_entity,   des_type,
               des_rtype,     des_code,     des_text,
               des_trans,     des_lang,     des_org )
        SELECT d.des_rentity, d.des_entity, d.des_type,
               d.des_rtype,   d.des_code,   des_text,
               '+',           @sLanguage,   des_org
        FROM   r5descriptions d,
               r5install i,
               r5classes c
        WHERE  d.des_rentity = N'CLAS'
        AND    d.des_lang    = i.ins_desc
        AND    i.ins_code    = N'DEFLANG'
        AND    d.des_rtype   = c.cls_rentity
        AND    c.cls_code    = d.des_code
        AND    c.cls_org     = d.des_org
        AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                        FROM   r5descriptions d2
                        WHERE  d2.des_rentity = N'CLAS'
                        AND    d2.des_rtype   = d.des_rtype                      
                        AND    d2.des_code    = d.des_code
                        AND    d2.des_org     = d.des_org
                        AND    d2.des_lang    = @sLanguage )

        execute @nReturn = o7newlang_resetlastcreated @sLanguage
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
          return -1
  
        declare c_des cursor local for SELECT d.des_sqlidentity
                                     FROM   r5install i,
                                            r5entities e,
                                            r5descriptions d
                                     WHERE  d.des_lang      = i.ins_desc
                                     AND    d.des_rentity   = e.ent_rentity
                                     AND    e.ent_multilang = N'+'
                                     AND    i.ins_code      = N'DEFLANG'
                                     AND    d.des_rentity NOT IN( N'FUNC', N'CLAS' )
                                     AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                                                     FROM   r5descriptions d2
                                                     WHERE  d2.des_rentity = d.des_rentity
                                                     AND    d2.des_code    = d.des_code
                                                     AND    d2.des_rtype   = d.des_rtype                                                     
                                                     AND    d2.des_org     = d.des_org
                                                     AND    d2.des_lang    = @sLanguage )
        open c_des
        fetch next from c_des into @nSQLIdentity
        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
          begin
            begin try
              INSERT INTO r5descriptions ( des_entity,   des_rentity,   des_type,
                                           des_rtype,    des_code,      des_lang,
                                           des_text,     des_trans,     des_org )
              select d.des_entity, d.des_rentity, d.des_type,
                     d.des_rtype,  d.des_code,    @sLanguage,
                     d.des_text,   d.des_trans,   d.des_org
              from r5descriptions d
              where d.des_sqlidentity = @nSQLIdentity
            end try
            begin catch
              --do nothing
                set @nReturn = 0
            end catch

            set @nCountit = @nCountit + 1
            if @nCountit >= 1000
              begin
                set @nCountit = 0
                execute @nReturn = o7newlang_resetlastcreated @sLanguage
                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                  return -1
              end
           
              fetch next from c_des into @nSQLIdentity
          end
        close c_des
        deallocate c_des

      /* Insert into r5longdescriptions. */
      INSERT INTO r5longdescriptions( lds_entity, lds_code, lds_lang, lds_trans, lds_text )
      SELECT lds_entity, lds_code, @sLanguage, N'-', lds_text
      FROM   r5longdescriptions l
      WHERE  lds_lang = @sDeflang
      AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                         FROM   r5longdescriptions l2
                         WHERE  l2.lds_entity = l.lds_entity
                         AND    l2.lds_code   = l.lds_code
                         AND    l2.lds_lang   = @sLanguage )
    
      /* Insert into r5reliabilityrankingquests. */
      INSERT INTO r5reliabilityrankingquests( rrq_levelpk, rrq_lang, rrq_question, rrq_trans )
      SELECT rrq_levelpk, @sLanguage, rrq_question, N'-'
      FROM   r5reliabilityrankingquests r
      WHERE  rrq_lang = @sDeflang
      AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x'
                         FROM   r5reliabilityrankingquests r2
                         WHERE  r2.rrq_levelpk = r.rrq_levelpk
                         AND    r2.rrq_lang    = @sLanguage )    

      end

    if UPPER( @sBoilertexts ) = N'TRUE'
      begin

        if @sLanguage <> @sDeflang
          begin
            /* Add missing boiler texts. */
            INSERT INTO r5boilertexts (
                   bot_function, bot_number, bot_length, bot_xpos,
                   bot_ypos,     bot_lang,   bot_text,   bot_dest,
                   bot_page,     bot_fld1,   bot_fld2,   bot_prtp,
                   bot_lvcr,     bot_adlen,  bot_pool,   bot_changed,
                   bot_display,  bot_cloned )
            SELECT bot_function, bot_number, bot_length, bot_xpos,
                   bot_ypos,     @sLanguage, bot_text,   bot_dest,

create procedure O7NEWLINE 
	@sRentity		nvarchar(4),
    @sEntcode		nvarchar(51),
    @sVar1			nvarchar(4),
    @nVar2			int,
    @nVar3			int,
    @sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
    @sNextValue		int   OUTPUT 

as

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON

 	declare			@nLine_no_var		numeric(12)
 	declare			@nDiff_var		numeric(12)
 	declare			@nCheck_var		numeric(12)
 	declare			@nCurr_line_no_var	numeric(12)
 	declare			@nIncrlino		numeric(12)
 	declare			@sQuotation		nvarchar(30) --r5quotlines.qul_quotation%type
 	declare			@sCode			nvarchar(24)
 	declare			@nSeqno			numeric(4)   --r5ppmacts.ppa_revision%type
 	declare			@sOrderno		nvarchar(30) --r5orderlines.orl_order%type
 	declare			@sOrg			nvarchar(15) --r5orderlines.orl_order_org%type
 	declare			@sInvoiceno		nvarchar(45) --r5invoicelines.ivl_invoice%type
 	declare			@nCount			int
 	declare			@nContinue		int
	declare			@sObj			nvarchar(30)
	declare			@sTestset		nvarchar(4)
	declare			@sCampaign		nvarchar(30)
	declare			@sCampaignOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare                 @sMP                    nvarchar(30)
	declare                 @sMPOrg                 nvarchar(15)
	declare                 @sMPOrgRev              nvarchar(20)
	declare                 @nMPRev                 int
	
	/* @sVar1 contains the line type to be generated */	
	/*    Options:  1 - For new records or after a commit. */
	/*                  First record.  (Value equals value of incrline ).  */
	/*                - For new records or after a commit. */
	/*                  Last record. Value is always trunc(MAX(line ),-1) + @nIncrlino  */
	/*              2 - Between records. Always middle value of two records     */
	/*              3 - Next record without committing                          */
	/* Initialize */
	SET   @sChk = N'0'
	SET @nContinue = 1

	/* Reading value from r5install table. */
	Select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM 	 r5install
	WHERE	 ins_code = N'INCRLINO'

	If @nCount = 1 
		BEGIN
			SELECT @nIncrlino = isnull( CASE ins_desc WHEN 0 THEN  10 ELSE ins_desc	END, 10 )
			FROM 	 r5install
			WHERE	 ins_code = N'INCRLINO'
		END
	Else
		SET @nIncrlino = 10


	/* Check input parameters are passed. */
	IF ( @sRentity IS NULL ) OR
		( @sEntcode IS NULL ) OR
		( @sVar1    IS NULL ) OR
		( @sVar1    NOT IN ( N'1', N'2', N'3' ) ) OR
		( @sVar1 = N'2' AND @nVar2 IS NULL ) OR
		( @sVar1 = N'2' AND @nVar3 IS NULL ) OR
		( @sVar1 = N'3' AND @nVar2 IS NULL ) 

		BEGIN
			SET @sNextValue = @nIncrlino
			RETURN
		END

	IF ( @sVar1 = N'1' ) 
		BEGIN
			/* Check the current value. If NULL  this is the first record, */
			/* Else this is the last value.                                    */
			IF (     @sRentity = N'QUOL' )         -- @sQuotation line.
				BEGIN
					SET @sQuotation = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode  ) - 1 )
					SET @nSeqno     = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode) + 1, 2 )
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( q.qul_line )
					FROM   r5quotlines q
					WHERE  q.qul_quotation = @sQuotation
					AND    q.qul_seqno     = @nSeqno
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'REQL' )       -- requisition line.
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( r.rql_reqline )
					FROM   r5requislines r
					WHERE  r.rql_req = @sEntcode
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'TRAN' )       -- transaction line.
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( t.trl_line )
					FROM   r5translines t
					WHERE  t.trl_trans   = @sEntcode
				END
			IF (  @sRentity = N'EVNT' )       -- activities.
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( a.act_act )
					FROM   r5activities a
					WHERE  a.act_event     = @sEntcode
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'AGR' )       -- Fixed Payments line.
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( a.fpa_line )
					FROM   r5fixedpayments a
					WHERE  a.fpa_agreement = @sEntcode
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'STWO' )       -- standard WO activities.
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( a.wac_act )
					FROM   r5standwacts a
					WHERE  a.wac_standwork = @sEntcode
				END

			IF ( @sRentity = N'PPM' )        -- PPM Activities.
				BEGIN
					SET @sCode  = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) - 1 )
					SET @nSeqno = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) + 1, 4 )
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( a.ppa_act )
					FROM   r5ppmacts a
					WHERE  a.ppa_ppm      = @sCode
					AND    a.ppa_revision = @nSeqno
				END
			IF (  @sRentity = N'PORL' )       -- orderlines
				BEGIN
					SET @sOrderno = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) - 1 )
					SET @sOrg     = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) + 1 , LEN(@sEntcode) )
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( o.orl_ordline )
					FROM   r5orderlines o
					WHERE  o.orl_order     = @sOrderno
					AND    o.orl_order_org = @sOrg
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'CAMP' )       -- CampaignEvent line.
				BEGIN
					SET @sCampaign 		= SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) - 1 )
					SET @sCampaignOrg	= SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) + 1 , LEN(@sEntcode) )
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( c.cge_line )
					FROM   r5campaignevents c
					WHERE  c.cge_campaign = @sCampaign
					AND    c.cge_campaign_org = @sCampaignOrg
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'RFQL' )       -- rfqlines
				BEGIN
					SET @sOrderno = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) - 1 )
					SET @sOrg     = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) + 1 , LEN(@sEntcode) )
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( r.rli_rfqline )
					FROM   r5rfqlines r
					WHERE  r.rli_rfq     = @sOrderno
					AND    r.rli_org = @sOrg
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'MATL' )       -- parts on mat list
				BEGIN
					SET @sCode  = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode) - 1 )
					SET @nSeqno = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) + 1, 4 )
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( m.mlp_line )
					FROM   r5matlparts m
					WHERE  m.mlp_matlist = @sCode
					AND    m.mlp_matlrev = @nSeqno
				END
			IF (  @sRentity = N'BORL' )       -- blanket orderlines
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( b.bll_blanketline )
					FROM   r5blanketordlines b
					WHERE  b.bll_blanketorder   = @sEntcode
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'ROUT' )       -- route points
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( r.rop_line )
					FROM   r5routepoints r
					WHERE  r.rop_route = @sEntcode
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'ROUO' )       -- route objects
				BEGIN
					SET @sCode  = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) - 1 )
					SET @nSeqno = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, charindex( N'#', @sEntcode ) + 1, 4 )
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( r.rob_line )
					FROM   r5routobjects r
					WHERE  r.rob_route    = @sCode
					AND    r.rob_revision = @nSeqno
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'EVPO' )       -- event points
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX( e.epo_line )
					FROM   r5eventpoints e
					WHERE  e.epo_event = @sEntcode
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'ADDD' )       -- additinal details
				BEGIN
					SET @sEntcode = RTRIM( SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 1, 4 ))
					SELECT @nCurr_line_no_var = MAX(  a.add_line )
					FROM   r5addetails a
					WHERE  a.add_rentity = RTRIM( SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 1, 4 ))
					AND    a.add_rtype   = CASE  @sEntcode
											WHEN N'EVNT'	THEN  a.add_rtype
											ELSE @sEntcode
											END
					AND    a.add_code    = SUBSTRING( @sEntcode, 9, LEN(@sEntcode)  )
				END

			IF (  @sRentity = N'EVCD' )       -- additinal details
				BEGIN

			IF (  @sRentity = N'EIV' )       -- external invoice lines

create PROCEDURE O7NEWREV 
    @sRentity nvarchar(4),
    @sPcode   nvarchar(50),
    @sOldrev  nvarchar(4),
    @sRev     nvarchar(4),
    @sR5user  nvarchar(255)  
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nPk            integer
    declare @nOldpk         integer
    declare @sChk           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)    --r5organization.org_code%TYPE = N''
    declare @sUstat         nvarchar(8)     --r5ucodes.uco_code%type = r5o7.o7ucode( N'U', N'RCST', @sChk )
    declare @nReturn        integer
    declare @sEntCode       nvarchar(30)
    declare @nPos           integer
    declare @tch_code       nvarchar(30)  
    declare @tcode          nvarchar(30)  
    declare @esfpk          nvarchar(30)
    declare @newesfpk       nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCode          nvarchar(50)
    declare @sNewtask       nvarchar(50)
    declare @tpj_jobplan    nvarchar(30)
    declare @tpj_seq        integer
    declare @ncspk          nvarchar(30)
    declare @newncspk       nvarchar(30)
begin

set @sCode = @sPcode 

set @sOrg = null

execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUstat OUTPUT, N'U', N'RCST', @sChk OUTPUT
if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    return -1


if @sCode IS NULL 
    RETURN

if @sRentity = N'MATL' 
    begin
        INSERT INTO r5matlists ( mtl_code, mtl_desc, mtl_class, mtl_class_org,
        mtl_revrstatus, mtl_revstatus, mtl_revision, mtl_org )
        SELECT mtl_code, mtl_desc, mtl_class, mtl_class_org,
            N'U', @sUstat, @sRev, mtl_org
        FROM   r5matlists
        WHERE  mtl_code     = @sCode
        AND    mtl_revision = @sOldrev
        SELECT @sOrg = mtl_org
        FROM   r5matlists
        WHERE  mtl_code     = @sCode
        AND    mtl_revision = @sOldrev
    
        INSERT INTO r5matlparts (
        mlp_matlist, mlp_line, mlp_part, mlp_part_org, mlp_qty, mlp_uom,
        mlp_reserv, mlp_optional, mlp_crit, mlp_obtype, mlp_obrtype, mlp_code, mlp_code_org,
        mlp_direct, mlp_matlrev, mlp_equipfilter )
        SELECT m.mlp_matlist, m.mlp_line, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, m.mlp_qty,
            m.mlp_uom, m.mlp_reserv, m.mlp_optional, m.mlp_crit, m.mlp_obtype, m.mlp_obrtype,
            m.mlp_code, m.mlp_code_org, m.mlp_direct, @sRev, m.mlp_equipfilter
        FROM   r5matlparts m
        WHERE  m.mlp_matlist = @sCode
        AND    m.mlp_matlrev = @sOldrev
     
        INSERT INTO r5addetails ( add_entity, add_rentity,
        add_type, add_rtype, add_code, add_lang,
        add_line, add_print, add_text, add_created, add_user   )
        SELECT   a.add_entity,
               a.add_rentity,
               a.add_type,
               a.add_rtype,
               @sCode + N'#' + @sRev add_code, 
               a.add_lang,
               a.add_line,
               a.add_print,
               a.add_text,
               dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ),
               @sR5user 
        FROM     r5addetails   a
        WHERE    a.add_code = @sCode + N'#' + @sOldrev
        AND      a.add_rentity = N'MATL'

     
        INSERT INTO r5propertyvalues ( prv_property, prv_rentity, prv_class,prv_class_org,
            prv_code, prv_seqno, prv_value, prv_nvalue, prv_dvalue )
        SELECT prv_property, prv_rentity, prv_class, prv_class_org,
            REPLACE( prv_code, N'#' + @sOldrev, N'#' + @sRev ),
            prv_seqno, prv_value, prv_nvalue, prv_dvalue
        FROM   r5propertyvalues
        WHERE  prv_rentity = N'MATL'
        AND    prv_code    = @sCode + N'#' + @sOldrev

        /* Copy documents. */
        execute @nReturn = O7NEWREV_COPYDOCS @sRentity, @sCode, @sCode , @sOldrev , @sRev 
        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1

    end
if @sRentity in ( N'TASK', N'JBPL' )
    begin
        if charindex( N'#', @sCode ) > 0 
            begin
                /* Copy data from one task to another, first determine old and new task. */
                set @sNewtask = substring( @sCode, charindex( N'#', @sCode ) + 1, 100 )
                set @sCode    = substring( @sCode, 1, charindex( N'#', @sCode ) - 1 )
            end
        else
            begin
                /* Normal functionality. */
                set @sNewtask = @sCode
                INSERT INTO r5tasks ( tsk_code, tsk_desc, tsk_class, tsk_class_org,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7NEWREVCCT
  @contract      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @rev           NUMERIC,
  @org           NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @r5user        NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @newrev        NUMERIC  OUTPUT
AS 
BEGIN
  DECLARE @ucode          NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @newdoccode     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @filename       NVARCHAR( 150 )
  DECLARE @chk            NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @doc_filename   NVARCHAR( 150 )
  DECLARE @doc_rtype      NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @doc_type       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @doc_filetype   NVARCHAR( 50 )
  DECLARE @doc_filesize   NUMERIC( 12 )
  DECLARE @doc_org        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @dae_type       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @dae_rtype      NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @dae_copytowo   NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @dae_printonwo  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @dae_copytopo   NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @dae_printonpo  NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @dae_document   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @return         INTEGER
  DECLARE @pk             NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @newpk          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  
  /* All parameters required. */
  IF @contract IS NULL OR @rev IS NULL OR @org IS NULL OR @r5user IS NULL
    RETURN
  
  /* Fetching the System Ucode for Unfinished. */
  SELECT @ucode = uco_code 
  FROM   r5ucodes 
  WHERE  uco_rcode   = N'U' 
  AND    uco_rentity = N'CCST' 
  AND    uco_system  = N'+'
  
  /* Fetching the maximum Sequence. */
  SELECT @newrev = MAX( cct_revision ) + 1 
  FROM   r5customercontracts 
  WHERE  cct_code = @contract 
  AND    cct_org  = @org
 
   /* Inserting a new Revision. */
  INSERT INTO r5customercontracts( cct_code, cct_revision, cct_org, cct_desc, cct_customer,
         cct_customer_org, cct_status, cct_rstatus, cct_contracttemplate, cct_contracttemplate_org,
         cct_class, cct_class_org, cct_tax, cct_startdate, cct_enddate,
         cct_revisitdate, cct_contact, cct_phone, cct_email, cct_emailinvoice,
         cct_period, cct_perioduom, cct_nextinvoicedate, cct_offsetinvgeneration, cct_defaultinvstatus,
         cct_defaultinvorg, cct_invoicingcurrency, cct_lastinvociedate, cct_lastinvoice, cct_amountinvoiced,
         cct_fixedexchrate, cct_synxfixedexchrates, cct_closedwoonly, cct_roundinghours, cct_roundingdays,
         cct_starttimehours, cct_starttimeminutes, cct_endtimehours, cct_endtimeminutes, cct_requestedby,
         cct_daterequested, cct_approvedby, cct_dateapproved, cct_revisionreason, 
         cct_udfchar01, cct_udfchar02, cct_udfchar03, cct_udfchar04, cct_udfchar05, 
         cct_udfchar06, cct_udfchar07, cct_udfchar08, cct_udfchar09, cct_udfchar10, 
         cct_udfchar11, cct_udfchar12, cct_udfchar13, cct_udfchar14, cct_udfchar15, 
         cct_udfchar16, cct_udfchar17, cct_udfchar18, cct_udfchar19, cct_udfchar20, 
         cct_udfchar21, cct_udfchar22, cct_udfchar23, cct_udfchar24, cct_udfchar25, 
         cct_udfchar26, cct_udfchar27, cct_udfchar28, cct_udfchar29, cct_udfchar30, 
         cct_udfnum01, cct_udfnum02, cct_udfnum03, cct_udfnum04, cct_udfnum05, 
         cct_udfdate01, cct_udfdate02, cct_udfdate03, cct_udfdate04, cct_udfdate05, 
         cct_udfchkbox01, cct_udfchkbox02, cct_udfchkbox03, cct_udfchkbox04, cct_udfchkbox05 )
  SELECT cct_code, @newrev, cct_org, cct_desc, cct_customer,
         cct_customer_org, @ucode, 'U', cct_contracttemplate, cct_contracttemplate_org,
         cct_class, cct_class_org, cct_tax, cct_startdate, cct_enddate,
         cct_revisitdate, cct_contact, cct_phone, cct_email, cct_emailinvoice,
         cct_period, cct_perioduom, cct_nextinvoicedate, cct_offsetinvgeneration, cct_defaultinvstatus,
         cct_defaultinvorg, cct_invoicingcurrency, cct_lastinvociedate, cct_lastinvoice, cct_amountinvoiced,
         cct_fixedexchrate, cct_synxfixedexchrates, cct_closedwoonly, cct_roundinghours, cct_roundingdays,
         cct_starttimehours, cct_starttimeminutes, cct_endtimehours, cct_endtimeminutes, NULL,
         NULL, NULL, NULL, cct_revisionreason, 
         cct_udfchar01, cct_udfchar02, cct_udfchar03, cct_udfchar04, cct_udfchar05, 
         cct_udfchar06, cct_udfchar07, cct_udfchar08, cct_udfchar09, cct_udfchar10, 
         cct_udfchar11, cct_udfchar12, cct_udfchar13, cct_udfchar14, cct_udfchar15, 
         cct_udfchar16, cct_udfchar17, cct_udfchar18, cct_udfchar19, cct_udfchar20,
         cct_udfchar21, cct_udfchar22, cct_udfchar23, cct_udfchar24, cct_udfchar25, 
         cct_udfchar26, cct_udfchar27, cct_udfchar28, cct_udfchar29, cct_udfchar30, 
         cct_udfnum01, cct_udfnum02, cct_udfnum03, cct_udfnum04, cct_udfnum05, 
         cct_udfdate01, cct_udfdate02, cct_udfdate03, cct_udfdate04, cct_udfdate05, 
         cct_udfchkbox01, cct_udfchkbox02, cct_udfchkbox03, cct_udfchkbox04, cct_udfchkbox05
  FROM   r5customercontracts      
  WHERE  cct_code     = @contract  
  AND    cct_revision = @rev
  AND    cct_org      = @org
  
  /* Copy Custom Field values. */  
  INSERT INTO r5propertyvalues( prv_property, prv_rentity, prv_class,prv_class_org,
         prv_code, prv_seqno, prv_value, prv_nvalue, prv_dvalue )
  SELECT prv_property, prv_rentity, prv_class, prv_class_org,
         @contract + N'#' + @org + N'#' + CAST( @newrev AS NVARCHAR ), prv_seqno, prv_value, prv_nvalue, prv_dvalue
  FROM   r5propertyvalues
  WHERE  prv_rentity = N'CCON'
  AND    prv_code    = @contract + N'#' + @org + N'#' + CAST( @rev AS NVARCHAR )
     
  /*Copying the Comments for the New Revsion. */
  INSERT INTO r5addetails( 
         add_entity, add_rentity, add_type, add_rtype, add_code, add_lang,
         add_line, add_print, add_text, add_created, add_user ) 
  SELECT add_entity, add_rentity, add_type, add_rtype, @contract+N'#'+@org+N'#'+CAST(@newrev AS VARCHAR), add_lang,
         add_line, add_print, add_text, add_created, add_user
  FROM   r5addetails
  WHERE  add_code    = @contract+N'#'+@org+N'#'+CAST(@rev AS VARCHAR)                                                           
  AND    add_rentity = N'CCON'
  
  /* Copy non-dynamic documents. */
  INSERT INTO r5docentities( dae_document, dae_entity, dae_rentity, dae_type, 
         dae_rtype, dae_code, dae_copytowo, dae_printonwo, dae_copytopo, dae_printonpo )
  SELECT d.dae_document, d.dae_entity, d.dae_rentity, d.dae_type, d.dae_rtype, 
         @contract+N'#'+@org+N'#'+CAST(@newrev AS VARCHAR), d.dae_copytowo, d.dae_printonwo, d.dae_copytopo, d.dae_printonpo
  FROM   r5docentities d, r5documents e
  WHERE  d.dae_code     = @contract+N'#'+@org+N'#'+CAST(@rev AS VARCHAR)
  AND    d.dae_rentity  = N'CCON' 
  AND    d.dae_document = e.doc_code
  AND    e.doc_notused  = N'-'
  AND    e.doc_rtype IN ( N'F', N'S', N'U' )
  
  /* Copy dynamic documents. */
  DECLARE c_doc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT e.doc_filename, e.doc_rtype, e.doc_type, e.doc_filetype, e.doc_filesize, e.doc_org, d.dae_type,
           d.dae_rtype, d.dae_copytowo, d.dae_printonwo, d.dae_copytopo, d.dae_printonpo, d.dae_document
    FROM   r5docentities d, r5documents e
    WHERE  d.dae_code     = @contract+N'#'+@org+N'#'+CAST(@rev AS VARCHAR) 
    AND    d.dae_rentity  = N'CCON' 
    AND    d.dae_document = e.doc_code 
    AND    e.doc_rtype    = N'D'
    AND    e.doc_notused  = N'-'
  OPEN c_doc
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_doc INTO @doc_filename, @doc_rtype, @doc_type, @doc_filetype, @doc_filesize, @doc_org, @dae_type,
                             @dae_rtype, @dae_copytowo, @dae_printonwo, @dae_copytopo, @dae_printonpo, @dae_document
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newdoccode OUTPUT, N'DOCS', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
      SET @filename = @newdoccode + '-' + @doc_filename
    
      INSERT INTO r5documents( doc_code, doc_desc, doc_rtype, doc_type, doc_filetype, 
             doc_filename, doc_filesize, doc_org)
      VALUES ( @newdoccode, N'CCON '+@contract+N'#'+@org+N'#'+CAST(@rev AS VARCHAR), @doc_rtype, @doc_type, 
               @doc_filetype, @filename, @doc_filesize, @doc_org )
    
      EXECUTE @return = o7dupbody @d

CREATE PROCEDURE O7NEWREVCUSTOMERINVOICE
  @invoice        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @invorg         NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @invrev         NUMERIC,
  @newrev         NUMERIC   OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN  
  DECLARE @chk       NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @status    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @newciipk  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @oldciipk  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @return    INT

  /* Get new revision number. */
  SELECT @newrev = MAX( civ_revision ) + 1
  FROM   r5customerinvoices
  WHERE  civ_code = @invoice
  AND    civ_org  = @invorg
  
  IF @newrev IS NULL
    /* No new revision number found, so return. */
    RETURN
      
  /* Create customer invoice header record. */
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @status OUTPUT, N'U', N'CIST', @chk OUTPUT
  INSERT INTO r5customerinvoices( civ_code, civ_org, civ_revision, civ_desc, civ_curr, civ_status, civ_rstatus, 
         civ_class, civ_class_org, civ_customer, civ_customer_org, civ_contract, civ_contract_org, 
         civ_contract_revision, civ_whereused, civ_fromdate, civ_todate, civ_created, civ_regenerated, 
         civ_approved, civ_paid, civ_generalledger, civ_contact, civ_phone, civ_email, civ_emailinvoice, 
         civ_emailed, civ_tax, civ_netamount, civ_adjustments, civ_taxamount, civ_grossamount,
         civ_udfchar01, civ_udfchar02, civ_udfchar03, civ_udfchar04, civ_udfchar05,
         civ_udfchar06, civ_udfchar07, civ_udfchar08, civ_udfchar09, civ_udfchar10,
         civ_udfchar11, civ_udfchar12, civ_udfchar13, civ_udfchar14, civ_udfchar15, 
         civ_udfchar16, civ_udfchar17, civ_udfchar18, civ_udfchar19, civ_udfchar20, 
         civ_udfchar21, civ_udfchar22, civ_udfchar23, civ_udfchar24, civ_udfchar25,
         civ_udfchar26, civ_udfchar27, civ_udfchar28, civ_udfchar29, civ_udfchar30,
         civ_udfnum01, civ_udfnum02, civ_udfnum03, civ_udfnum04, civ_udfnum05,
         civ_udfdate01, civ_udfdate02, civ_udfdate03, civ_udfdate04, civ_udfdate05, 
         civ_udfchkbox01, civ_udfchkbox02, civ_udfchkbox03, civ_udfchkbox04, civ_udfchkbox05 )
  SELECT civ_code, civ_org, @newrev, civ_desc, civ_curr, @status, N'U', 
         civ_class, civ_class_org, civ_customer, civ_customer_org, civ_contract, civ_contract_org, 
         civ_contract_revision, civ_whereused, civ_fromdate, civ_todate, dbo.o7gttime2( civ_org ), NULL, 
         NULL, civ_paid, civ_generalledger, civ_contact, civ_phone, civ_email, civ_emailinvoice, 
         NULL, civ_tax, civ_netamount, civ_adjustments, civ_taxamount, civ_grossamount,
         civ_udfchar01, civ_udfchar02, civ_udfchar03, civ_udfchar04, civ_udfchar05,
         civ_udfchar06, civ_udfchar07, civ_udfchar08, civ_udfchar09, civ_udfchar10,
         civ_udfchar11, civ_udfchar12, civ_udfchar13, civ_udfchar14, civ_udfchar15, 
         civ_udfchar16, civ_udfchar17, civ_udfchar18, civ_udfchar19, civ_udfchar20, 
         civ_udfchar21, civ_udfchar22, civ_udfchar23, civ_udfchar24, civ_udfchar25,
         civ_udfchar26, civ_udfchar27, civ_udfchar28, civ_udfchar29, civ_udfchar30,
         civ_udfnum01, civ_udfnum02, civ_udfnum03, civ_udfnum04, civ_udfnum05,
         civ_udfdate01, civ_udfdate02, civ_udfdate03, civ_udfdate04, civ_udfdate05, 
         civ_udfchkbox01, civ_udfchkbox02, civ_udfchkbox03, civ_udfchkbox04, civ_udfchkbox05
  FROM   r5customerinvoices
  WHERE  civ_code     = @invoice
  AND    civ_org      = @invorg
  AND    civ_revision = @invrev

  /* Copy customer invoice items. */
  DECLARE c_cii CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT cii_pk
    FROM   r5customerinvoiceitems
    WHERE  cii_invoice          = @invoice
    AND    cii_invoice_org      = @invorg
    AND    cii_invoice_revision = @invrev
  OPEN c_cii 
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_cii INTO @oldciipk
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7maxseq @newciipk OUTPUT, N'CII', N'1', @chk OUTPUT
      INSERT INTO r5customerinvoiceitems( cii_pk, cii_invoice, cii_invoice_org, cii_invoice_revision,
             cii_contractitem, cii_origcontractitem, cii_object, cii_object_org, cii_project, cii_projbud, cii_event,
             cii_customer, cii_customer_org, cii_invoicingorg, cii_invoicingdescription, cii_tax,
             cii_currency, cii_exch, cii_errorfound, cii_netamount, cii_adjustednet, cii_adjustments,
             cii_taxpercentage, cii_taxamount, cii_grossamount )
      SELECT @newciipk, cii_invoice, cii_invoice_org, @newrev,
             cii_contractitem, cii_origcontractitem, cii_object, cii_object_org, cii_project, cii_projbud, cii_event,
             cii_customer, cii_customer_org, cii_invoicingorg, cii_invoicingdescription, cii_tax,
             cii_currency, cii_exch, cii_errorfound, cii_netamount, cii_adjustednet, cii_adjustments,
             cii_taxpercentage, cii_taxamount, cii_grossamount
      FROM   r5customerinvoiceitems
      WHERE  cii_pk = @oldciipk

      /* Copy customer invoice details, related to invoice item. */
      INSERT INTO r5customerinvoicedetails( cid_invoice, cid_invoice_org, cid_invoice_revision, cid_invoiceline,
             cid_invoiceitem, cid_contractchargedef, cid_origcontractchargedef, cid_currency, cid_category, cid_subcategory, 
             cid_level, cid_adjustment, cid_adjustment_org, cid_adjustmenttype, cid_grouping, cid_error, cid_rentity,
             cid_code, cid_code_org, cid_event, cid_act, cid_invoiceqty, cid_adjustedqty, cid_invoiceuom,
             cid_invoiceperiods, cid_adjustedperiods, cid_invoiceprice, cid_adjustedprice, cid_fromdate,
             cid_todate, cid_invoicerollup, cid_adjustedrollup, cid_transactionamount, cid_adjustments, 
             cid_transactiontotal, cid_correctedtotal, cid_taxbase, cid_taxpercentage, cid_taxamount,cid_exch,
             cid_invoiceamount, cid_invoicetaxamount, cid_commodity, cid_estimatecredit, cid_estimateddailyusage,
             cid_estimatedusage, cid_rolloverbuffer, cid_actualsubcategory, cid_taxrollup,
             cid_udfchar01, cid_udfchar02, cid_udfchar03, cid_udfchar04, cid_udfchar05,
             cid_udfchar06, cid_udfchar07, cid_udfchar08, cid_udfchar09, cid_udfchar10, 
             cid_udfchar11, cid_udfchar12, cid_udfchar13, cid_udfchar14, cid_udfchar15, 
             cid_udfchar16, cid_udfchar17, cid_udfchar18, cid_udfchar19, cid_udfchar20,

             cid_udfnum01, cid_udfnum02, cid_udfnum03, cid_udfnum04, cid_udfnum05,
             cid_udfdate01, cid_udfdate02, cid_udfdate03, cid_udfdate04, cid_udfdate05,
             cid_udfchkbox01, cid_udfchkbox02, cid_udfchkbox03, cid_udfchkbox04, cid_udfchkbox05 )
      SELECT cid_invoice, cid_invoice_org, @newrev, cid_invoiceline,
             @newciipk, cid_contractchargedef, cid_origcontractchargedef, cid_currency, cid_category, cid_subcategory,

create PROCEDURE O7NEWREV_COPYDOCS @sRentity nvarchar(4), 
                                    @sCode    nvarchar(30), 
                                    @sNewcode nvarchar(30), 
                                    @sOldrev  nvarchar(4), 
                                    @sRev     nvarchar(4) 
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @sDoc_filename      nvarchar(150)
    declare @sDoc_rtype         nvarchar(4)
    declare @sDoc_type          nvarchar(4)
    declare @sDoc_filetype      nvarchar(50)
    declare @nDoc_filesize      nvarchar(12)
    declare @sDoc_org           nvarchar(15)
    declare @sDae_type          nvarchar(4) 
    declare @sDae_rtype         nvarchar(4)
    declare @sDae_copytowo      nvarchar(1)
    declare @sDae_printonwo     nvarchar(1)
    declare @sDae_copytopo      nvarchar(1)
    declare @sDae_printonpo     nvarchar(1)
    declare @sDae_document      nvarchar(30)
    declare @nReturn            integer
    declare @sFileName          nvarchar(150)   --r5documents.doc_filename%TYPE
    declare @nPk                integer
    declare @sChk               nvarchar(4)
    declare @sNewDocCode        nvarchar(30)
    

     INSERT INTO r5docentities ( dae_document, dae_entity, dae_rentity, dae_type, 
       dae_rtype, dae_code, dae_copytowo, dae_printonwo, dae_copytopo, dae_printonpo )
     SELECT d.dae_document, d.dae_entity, d.dae_rentity, d.dae_type, d.dae_rtype, 
            @sNewcode + N'#'  + @sRev, d.dae_copytowo, d.dae_printonwo, d.dae_copytopo, d.dae_printonpo
     FROM   r5docentities d, r5documents e
     WHERE  d.dae_code     = @sCode + '#' + @sOldrev
     AND    d.dae_rentity  = @sRentity 
     AND    d.dae_document = e.doc_code
     AND    e.doc_notused  = N'-'
     AND    e.doc_rtype IN ( N'F', N'S', N'U' )

    declare c_docs cursor local for  SELECT e.doc_filename,
                                                            e.doc_rtype,
                                                            e.doc_type,
                                                            e.doc_filetype,
                                                            e.doc_filesize,
                                                            e.doc_org,
                                                            d.dae_type,
                                                            d.dae_rtype,
                                                            d.dae_copytowo,
                                                            d.dae_printonwo,
                                                            d.dae_copytopo,
                                                            d.dae_printonpo,
                                                            d.dae_document
                                                        FROM   r5docentities d,
                                                            r5documents e
                                                        WHERE  d.dae_code     = @sCode + N'#' + @sOldrev
                                                            AND    d.dae_rentity  = @sRentity
                                                            AND    d.dae_document = e.doc_code
                                                            AND    e.doc_rtype    = N'D'
                                                            AND    e.doc_notused  = N'-'
        open c_docs
        fetch next from c_docs into @sDoc_filename, @sDoc_rtype, @sDoc_type, @sDoc_filetype, @nDoc_filesize, @sDoc_org, @sDae_type, @sDae_rtype, 
                                                @sDae_copytowo, @sDae_printonwo, @sDae_copytopo, @sDae_printonpo, @sDae_document        

        while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
                execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sNewDocCode OUTPUT, N'DOCS', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                    begin
                        close c_docs
                        deallocate c_docs
                        return -1
                    end

                set @sFileName = cast(@sNewDocCode as nvarchar(38)) + N'-' + @sDoc_filename

                INSERT INTO r5documents ( doc_code, doc_desc, doc_rtype, doc_type, doc_filetype,
                            doc_filename, doc_filesize, doc_org)
                VALUES ( @sNewDocCode, @sRentity + @sNewcode + N'#' + @sRev, @sDoc_rtype, @sDoc_type,
                            @sDoc_filetype, @sFileName, @nDoc_filesize, @sDoc_org )


                execute @nReturn = O7DUPBODY @sDae_document, @sNewDocCode
                if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
                    begin
                        close c_docs
                        deallocate c_docs
                        return -1
                    end


                INSERT INTO r5docentities ( dae_document, dae_entity, dae_rentity, dae_type,
                    dae_rtype, dae_code, dae_copytowo, dae_printonwo, dae_copytopo, dae_printonpo )
                SELECT @sNewDocCode, ent_entity, @sRentity, @sDae_type, @sDae_rtype,
                    @sNewcode + N'#' + @sRev, @sDae_copytowo, @sDae_printonwo, @sDae_copytopo, @sDae_printonpo
                FROM   r5entities
                WHERE  ent_rentity = @sRentity

                fetch next from c_docs into @sDoc_filename, @sDoc_rtype, @sDoc_type, @sDoc_filetype, @nDoc_filesize, @sDoc_org, @sDae_type, @sDae_rtype, 
                                            @sDae_copytowo, @sDae_printonwo, @sDae_copytopo, @sDae_printonpo, @sDae_document        
            end

        close c_docs
        deallocate c_docs


-- ========================================

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7OBJCAT
               (@sObject    NVARCHAR(30)
               ,@sObjectOrg NVARCHAR(15)) RETURNS NVARCHAR(30)
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @sCategory NVARCHAR(30)
SET @sCategory = NULL /* This is what will be returned if next SELECT statement fails */
SELECT @sCategory = obj_category
  FROM r5objects
 WHERE obj_code = @sObject
   AND obj_org  = @sObjectOrg
RETURN @sCategory 
END
