CREATE PROCEDURE O7OBJDEP 
  @sObject   nvarchar(30),
  @sOrg      nvarchar(15),
  @sDeptype  nvarchar(4),
  @dEnddate  datetime,
  @nDepexp   numeric(38,12) OUTPUT,
  @nBookval  numeric(38,12) OUTPUT
AS
  SET NOCOUNT ON

  declare @nOrigvalue  numeric        -- Original value.
  declare @dOrigdate   datetime       -- Original start date.
  declare @dNextsdate  datetime       -- Next start date.
  declare @dDdate      datetime       -- Date of death of object.
  declare @dMindate    datetime       -- Minimum of ddate, solddate, enddate and period end date.
  declare @dSolddate   datetime       -- Date sold/scrapped.
  declare @nSyd        numeric(38,12) -- Sum of years digits.
  declare @nN          numeric(38,12) -- Variable to calculate the syd.
  declare @nEstlifey   numeric(38,12) -- Estimated useful life expressed in years.
  declare @dYears      datetime       -- Start date of a year, used in SYD method.
  declare @dYeare      datetime       -- End date of a year, used in SYD method.
  declare @nDdb        numeric(38,12) -- Double declining balance percentage.
  declare @nDdbvalue   numeric(38,12) -- Value still to depreciate in ddb method.
  declare @nUoopast    numeric(24, 6) -- Units of output before current period.
  declare @nUoocurrent numeric(24, 6) -- Units of output during current period.
  declare @dMaxdate    datetime       -- Max date of units produced.
  declare @nExp        numeric(38,12) -- Expenditure.
  declare @nDayval     numeric(38,12) -- Dayly value
  declare @dCompdate   datetime       -- Compare date
  declare @sSold       nvarchar(1)    -- Has object been sold
  /* declare cursor variable */
  declare @nObd_pk           numeric
  declare @sObd_depcategory  nvarchar(4)
  declare @dObd_startdate    datetime
  declare @dObj_commiss      datetime
  declare @nObd_origvalue    numeric(24, 6)
  declare @nObd_estlife      numeric(8, 2)
  declare @sObd_estlifeuom   nvarchar(1)
  declare @dObj_solddate     datetime
  declare @nObd_residual     numeric(24, 6)
  declare @sObd_deprmethod   nvarchar(4)
  declare @nObd_estoutput    numeric(24, 0)


  IF @sObject IS NULL OR
    @sOrg     IS NULL OR
    @sDeptype IS NULL OR
    @dEnddate IS NULL 
    /* Return when one of the input parameter doesn't have a value. */
    RETURN

  /* Retrieve sold date. */
  SELECT @dSolddate = obj_solddate
  FROM   r5objects
  WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
  AND    obj_org  = @sOrg
  IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
    RETURN

  /* Retrieve original value and start date. */
  SELECT TOP 1 
         @nOrigvalue = obd_origvalue, 
         @dOrigdate  = obd_startdate
  FROM   r5objdeptypes
  WHERE  obd_object     = @sObject
  AND    obd_object_org = @sOrg
  AND    obd_deptype    = @sDeptype
  AND    obd_origvalue  IS NOT NULL
  AND    obd_estlife    IS NOT NULL
  AND    obd_estlifeuom IS NOT NULL
  AND    obd_deprmethod IS NOT NULL
  AND  ( obd_deprmethod <> N'UOO' OR obd_estoutput IS NOT NULL )
  ORDER BY obd_pk
  IF @nOrigvalue IS NULL
    /* No depreciation records found, return. */
    RETURN;

  IF @dEnddate < @dOrigdate
    BEGIN
      /* The object is not yet 'commissioned', book value is still the original value. */
      SET @nBookval = @nOrigvalue
      SET @nDepexp  = 0
      RETURN
    END
  
  SET @nDepexp = 0

  DECLARE cObd CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
    SELECT obd_pk,
           obd_depcategory,
           obd_origvalue,
           obd_estlife,
           obd_estlifeuom,
           obd_startdate,
           isnull( obd_residual, 0 ),
           obd_deprmethod,
           obd_estoutput
    FROM   r5objdeptypes t1
    WHERE  obd_object     = @sObject
    AND    obd_object_org = @sOrg
    AND    obd_deptype    = @sDeptype
    AND    obd_origvalue  IS NOT NULL
    AND    obd_estlife    IS NOT NULL
    AND    obd_estlifeuom IS NOT NULL
    AND    obd_deprmethod IS NOT NULL
    AND  ( obd_deprmethod <> N'UOO' OR obd_estoutput IS NOT NULL )
    AND    obd_depcategory NOT IN ( 'S', 'ED', 'PPEA' )
    AND    NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x'
                        FROM   r5objdeptypes t2
                        WHERE  t2.obd_object     = t1.obd_object
                        AND    t2.obd_object_org = t1.obd_object_org
                        AND    t2.obd_deptype    = t1.obd_deptype
                        AND    t2.obd_startdate  = t1.obd_startdate
                        AND    t2.obd_pk         > t1.obd_pk )
    AND    obd_startdate <= @dEnddate 
    ORDER BY obd_pk;

  OPEN cObd
  FETCH NEXT FROM cObd INTO @nObd_pk, @sObd_depcategory, @nObd_origvalue, @nObd_estlife, @sObd_estlifeuom, @dObd_startdate, 
                            @nObd_residual, @sObd_deprmethod, @nObd_estoutput
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS  = 0
    BEGIN 
      SET @nBookval = NULL
      /* Calculate date of death, ddate. */
      IF @sObd_estlifeuom = N'D' 
        begin                
          set @dDdate = @dObd_startdate + CEILING(@nObd_estlife) - 1
          set @nN    = ( DATEDIFF(Day, @dObd_startdate, @dDdate) + 1 ) / 365.2
        end
      ELSE IF @sObd_estlifeuom = N'W' 
        begin
          set @dDdate = @dObd_startdate + CEILING( @nObd_estlife * 7 ) - 1
          set @nN    = ( DATEDIFF(Day, @dObd_startdate, @dDdate) + 1 ) / 365.2
        end
      ELSE IF @sObd_estlifeuom = N'M' 
        begin        
          set @dDdate = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dObd_startdate, CEILING(@nObd_estlife) ) - 1
          set @nN    = @nObd_estlife / 12
        end
      ELSE IF @sObd_estlifeuom = N'Q' 
        begin
          set @dDdate = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dObd_startdate, CEILING(@nObd_estlife * 3) ) - 1
          set @nN    = @nObd_estlife / 4
        end
      ELSE IF @sObd_estlifeuom = N'Y'
        begin
          set @dDdate = dbo.O7ADD_MONTHS( @dObd_startdate, CEILING(@nObd_estlife * 12) ) - 1
          set @nN    = @nObd_estlife
        end
      set @nEstlifey = @nN

      /* Retrieve next start date. */
      SET @dNextsdate = NULL
      SELECT TOP 1 @dNextsdate = obd_startdate 
      FROM   r5objdeptypes
      WHERE  obd_object     = @sObject
      AND    obd_object_org = @sOrg
      AND    obd_deptype    = @sDeptype
      AND    obd_startdate  > @dObd_startdate
      ORDER BY obd_pk
      SET @dNextsdate = @dNextsdate - 1
    
      SET @sSold = N'-'
      IF @dSolddate IS NULL
        begin
          IF @dDdate < @denddate AND @sObd_deprmethod <> N'UOO' AND @dNextsdate IS NULL 
            /* End date lies beyond date of death, so totally depreciated. */
            begin
              set @nExp = @nObd_origvalue - @nObd_residual
              set @nBookval = @nObd_residual
              set @nDepexp = @nDepexp + @nExp
              CLOSE cObd
              DEALLOCATE cObd
              RETURN
            end
        end
      ELSE
        begin
          IF @denddate > @dSolddate
            begin
              set @nBookval = 0
              set @sSold = N'+'
            end
        end
    
      SET @dMindate = dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( @dDdate, dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( ISNULL( @dSolddate, @dDdate ), 
                                        dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( @dEnddate, ISNULL( @dNextsdate, @dDdate ) ) ) )
      SET @nExp = NULL
    
      IF @sObd_deprmethod = N'SL' 
        /* Straight line. */
        begin
          SET @nDayval = ( @nObd_origvalue - ISNULL( @nObd_residual, 0 ) ) / ( DATEDIFF( day, @dObd_startdate, @dDdate ) + 1 )
          SET @nExp = ROUND( @nDayval * dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( DATEDIFF( day, @dObd_startdate, @dMindate ) + 1, 0 ), 2 )
          IF @sSold = N'-'
            SET @nBookval = ROUND( @nObd_origvalue - @nExp, 2 )
        end
      ELSE IF @sObd_deprmethod = N'SYD'
        /* Sum of Years Digits. */
        begin
          set @nSyd = 0
          WHILE @nN> 0 
            /* Calculate sum of years digits. */
            begin
                  set @nSyd = @nSyd + @nN
                  set @nN  = @nN- 1
            end


-- ========================================

create procedure O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVENT	@sRetCode		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
										@sEvent			NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT,
										@sOrg			NVARCHAR(15),
										@sObject		NVARCHAR(30),
										@sObjectorg		NVARCHAR(15),
										@sObtype		NVARCHAR(4),
										@sParent		NVARCHAR(30),
										@sParentorg		NVARCHAR(15),
										@sPartype		NVARCHAR(4),
										@sEvtrtype		NVARCHAR(4),
										@sNewvalue		NVARCHAR(100),
										@sElocation		NVARCHAR(30),
										@sElocationorg	NVARCHAR(15),
										@sEmrc			NVARCHAR(15),
										@sLang			NVARCHAR(200)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @dDatework	datetime
	declare @sLangwork	nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%type
	declare @sDumm		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTemplate	nvarchar(250)
	declare @sEvtmrc	nvarchar(15)	--r5mrcs.mrc_code%TYPE
	declare @sChk		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @sLangTemp	nvarchar(200)
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sErtype        nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_rtype%TYPE;
	declare @sEtype         nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_type%TYPE;
	declare @sErstat        nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_rstatus%TYPE;
	declare @sEstat         nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_status%TYPE;
	declare @nAcd		bigint
    declare @sAcdSeqno	    nvarchar(30)

	set @sDumm = null
	set @sEvtmrc = @sEmrc

	set @sErtype = @sEvtrtype
	execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @sErtype OUTPUT, @sEtype OUTPUT, N'EVTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sErstat = N'C'
	execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @sErstat OUTPUT, @sEstat OUTPUT, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sObject is null or @sObjectorg is null or @sObtype is null
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'1'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7LANG @sLangTemp OUTPUT, @sDumm OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'999'
			return -1
		end

	set @sLangwork = isnull( @sLang, @sLangTemp )

	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDatework OUTPUT, @sOrg
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'999'
			return -1
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7DESC @sTemplate OUTPUT, @sEvtrtype, null, N'EVTP', N'UCOD', @sLangwork, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'999'
			return -1
		end

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'0'
			select @nCount = count(*)
			 FROM   r5ucodes u
			 WHERE  u.uco_rcode   = @sEvtrtype
			 AND    u.uco_rentity = N'EVTP'

			if @nCount = 1
				select @sTemplate = u.uco_desc
				 FROM   r5ucodes u
				 WHERE  u.uco_rcode   = @sEvtrtype
				 AND    u.uco_rentity = N'EVTP'
			else
				set @sTemplate = N'?'
		end

	if charindex( N'$TP', @sTemplate ) <> 0
		begin
			if @sPartype is null or @sParent is null
				begin
					set @sRetCode = N'7'
					return
				end
		end

	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$TC', isnull(@sObtype, N'') )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$CH', isnull(@sObject, N'') )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$TP', isnull(@sPartype, N'') )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$PA', isnull(@sParent, N'') )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$ST', isnull(@sNewvalue, N'') )
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$MR', isnull(@sNewvalue, N'') )
	if charindex( N'$SR', @sTemplate ) <> 0
		set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$SR', isnull(@sNewvalue, N'') )


	if isnumeric( @sNewvalue ) = 1
		begin
			set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$EV', isnull(@sNewvalue, N'') )
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$EV', N'' )

		end
	set @sTemplate = REPLACE( @sTemplate, N'$LO', isnull(@sNewvalue, N'') )

	if @sEvent is null
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sEvent OUTPUT, N'EVENT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					set @sRetCode = N'999'
					return -1
				end

			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					set @sRetCode = N'11'
					return
				end
		end

	if @sEvtmrc is null
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5objects
			WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
			AND    obj_org  = @sObjectorg

			if @nCount = 1
				select @sEvtmrc = obj_mrc
				FROM   r5objects
				WHERE  obj_code = @sObject
				AND    obj_org  = @sObjectorg
			else
				begin
					set @sRetCode = N'17'
					return
				end
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sAcdSeqno OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		   return -1
    set @nAcd = cast( @sAcdSeqno as bigint )

	INSERT INTO r5events
			(	evt_code,
				evt_org,
				evt_rtype,
				evt_type,
				evt_desc,
				evt_obtype,
				evt_object,
				evt_object_org,
				evt_completed,
				evt_rstatus,
				evt_status,
				evt_location,
				evt_location_org,
				evt_mrc,
				evt_date,
				evt_duration,
				evt_fixed,
				evt_warranty,
				evt_reported,
				evt_acd
			)
		VALUES
			(   @sEvent,
				isnull( @sOrg, @sObjectorg ),
				@sErtype,
				@sEtype,
				SUBSTRING( isnull(@sTemplate, N'?'), 1, 80 ),
				@sObtype,
				@sObject,
				@sObjectorg,
				@dDatework,
				@sErstat,
				@sEstat,
				@sElocation,
				@sElocationorg,
				@sEvtmrc,
				@dDatework,
				1,
				N'F',
				N'-',
				@dDatework,
				@nAcd
			)
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'12'
			return -1
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVTOBJ @sChk OUTPUT, @sEvent, @sEvtrtype, @sObject, @sObjectorg, @sObtype
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'14'
			return -1
		end

	if @sParent is not null
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVTOBJ @sChk OUTPUT, @sEvent, @sEvtrtype, @sParent, @sParentorg, @sPartype
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					set @sRetCode = N'14'
					return -1
				end
		end

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'2' + substring( @sChk, 1, 1 )
			return
		end

	set @sRetCode = N'0'


-- ========================================

name: O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVTOBJ

create procedure O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVTOBJ 	@sRetCode	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
											@sEvent		NVARCHAR(30),
											@sEvtrtype	NVARCHAR(4),
											@sObject	NVARCHAR(30),
											@sObjectorg	NVARCHAR(15),
											@sObjtype	NVARCHAR(4)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	if @sEvent is null or @sEvtrtype is null or @sObject is null
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'1'
			return
		end

	if @sEvtrtype in ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
		begin
			INSERT INTO r5eventobjects
					 (   eob_event,
						 eob_obtype,
						 eob_obrtype,
						 eob_object,
						 eob_object_org,
						 eob_rollup,
						 eob_level,
						 eob_downtime
					 )
				SELECT	@sEvent,
						stc_objecttype,
						stc_objectrtype,
						stc_object,
						stc_object_org,
						N'+',
						MAX( nLevel ),
						N'+'
				from dbo.O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVTOBJ_HIER( @sObject, @sObjectorg, N'+')
				group by stc_objecttype, stc_objectrtype, stc_object, stc_object_org
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				begin
					set @sRetCode = N'2'
					return -1
				end
		end

	if @sEvtrtype in ( N'MRC', N'RR' )	
		begin
			INSERT INTO r5eventobjects
					 (   eob_event,
						 eob_obtype,
						 eob_obrtype,
						 eob_object,
						 eob_object_org,
						 eob_rollup,
						 eob_level,
						 eob_downtime
					 )
				SELECT	@sEvent,
						stc_objecttype,
						stc_objectrtype,
						stc_object,
						stc_object_org,
						N'-',
						0,
						N'-'
				from dbo.O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVTOBJ_HIER( @sObject, @sObjectorg, N'-')
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				begin
					set @sRetCode = N'2'
					return -1
				end
		end

	if @sEvtrtype = N'STAT'
		begin
			INSERT INTO r5eventobjects
					 (   eob_event,
						 eob_obtype,
						 eob_obrtype,
						 eob_object,
						 eob_object_org,
						 eob_rollup,
						 eob_level,
						 eob_downtime
					 )
				SELECT	@sEvent,
						stc_objecttype,
						stc_objectrtype,
						stc_object,
						stc_object_org,
						N'-',
						0,
						N'-'
				from dbo.O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVTOBJ_HIER( @sObject, @sObjectorg, N'A')
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				begin
					set @sRetCode = N'2'
					return -1
				end
		end

	INSERT INTO r5eventobjects
			(   eob_event,
				eob_obtype,
				eob_object,
				eob_object_org,
				eob_rollup,
				eob_level,
				eob_downtime
			)
		VALUES
			(   @sEvent,
				@sObjtype,
				@sObject,
				@sObjectorg,
				CASE @sEvtrtype WHEN N'STO' THEN N'-' ELSE N'+' END,
				0,
				N'+'
			)
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'3'
			return -1
		end


-- ========================================

name: O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVTOBJ_HIER

create function O7OBJECTS_INSERT_EVTOBJ_HIER (@sObject nvarchar(30), @sOrg nvarchar(15), @sMode nvarchar(1))
returns @tReturn table( stc_object		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_object_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_objecttype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_objectrtype	nvarchar(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						nLevel			int )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel	int
	declare @sType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRtype	nvarchar(4)

	declare @tStack table ( stc_object		nvarchar(30),
							stc_object_org	nvarchar(15),
							stc_objecttype	nvarchar(4),
							stc_objectrtype	nvarchar(4),
							LevelID int )

	if @sMode in (N'+', N'-')
		begin
			if @sMode = N'+'
				INSERT INTO @tStack
					select	stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_parenttype, stc_parentrtype, 1
					  from	r5structures
					 where	stc_child		= @sObject	and
							stc_child_org	= @sOrg		and
							stc_rollup		= N'+'
			else
				INSERT INTO @tStack
					select	stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, stc_childrtype, 1
					  from	r5structures
					 where	stc_parent		= @sObject	and
							stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		and
							stc_rolldown		= N'+'
		end
	else --Assume all child objects mode
		INSERT INTO @tStack
			select	stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, stc_childrtype, 1
			  from	r5structures
			 where	stc_parent		= @sObject and
					stc_parent_org	= @sOrg

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sObject	= stc_object,
							@sOrg		= stc_object_org,
							@sType		= stc_objecttype,
							@sRtype		= stc_objectrtype
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sObject, @sOrg, @sType, @sRtype, @nLevel )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_object = @sObject and stc_object_org = @sOrg
					if @sMode in (N'+', N'-')
						begin
							if @sMode = N'+'
								INSERT INTO @tStack
									select	stc_parent, stc_parent_org, stc_parenttype, stc_parentrtype, @nLevel + 1
									  from	r5structures
									 where	stc_child		= @sObject	and
											stc_child_org	= @sOrg		and
											stc_rollup		= N'+'
							else
								INSERT INTO @tStack
									select	stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, stc_childrtype, @nLevel + 1
									  from	r5structures
									 where	stc_parent		= @sObject	and
											stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		and
											stc_rolldown		= N'+'
						end
					else --Assume all child objects mode
						INSERT INTO @tStack
							select	stc_child, stc_child_org, stc_childtype, stc_childrtype, @nLevel + 1
							  from	r5structures
							 where	stc_parent		= @sObject and
									stc_parent_org	= @sOrg

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create procedure O7OBJECTS_INSERT_MORE_EVENTS	@sRetCode		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
												@sErtype_in		NVARCHAR(1),
												@sChild			NVARCHAR(30),
												@sChildorg		NVARCHAR(15),
												@sChildrtype	NVARCHAR(4),
												@sChildtype		NVARCHAR(4),
												@sParent		NVARCHAR(30),
												@sParentorg		NVARCHAR(15),
												@sParentrtype	NVARCHAR(4),
												@sParenttype	NVARCHAR(4)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sEventno			nvarchar(30)	--r5events.evt_code%type
	declare @sEtype				nvarchar(4)		--r5events.evt_type%type
	declare @sErtype			nvarchar(4)		--r5events.evt_rtype%type
	declare @sEstat				nvarchar(4)		--r5events.evt_status%type
	declare @sErstat			nvarchar(4)		--r5events.evt_rstatus%type
	declare @sMrc				nvarchar(15)	--r5events.evt_mrc%type
	declare @sLocation			nvarchar(30)	--r5events.evt_location%type
	declare @sLocationorg		nvarchar(15)	--r5events.evt_location_org%type
	declare @sStore				nvarchar(15)	--r5stores.str_code%type
	declare @sObcode			nvarchar(30)	--r5events.evt_object%type
	declare @sOborg				nvarchar(15)	--r5events.evt_object_org%type
	declare @sObtype			nvarchar(4)		--r5events.evt_obtype%type
	declare @sObrtype			nvarchar(4)		--r5events.evt_obrtype%type
	declare @sObstat			nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_status%type
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDumm				nvarchar(80)

	declare @sTmpparent			nvarchar(30)	--r5objects.obj_code%TYPE
	declare @sTmpparentorg		nvarchar(15)	--r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
	declare @sTmpparentrtype	nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE
	declare @sTmpparenttype		nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE
	declare @sTmpchild			nvarchar(30)	--r5objects.obj_code%TYPE
	declare @sTmpchildorg		nvarchar(15)	--r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
	declare @sTmpchildrtype		nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE
	declare @sTmpchildtype		nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE

	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @dGttime			datetime
	declare @sLang				nvarchar(200)
	declare @sCurrUser			nvarchar(255)
	declare @nCast				int
	declare @nCount				int

	set @sEventno = null
	set @sEtype = null
	set @sEstat = null
	set @sErstat = N'C'
	set @sObstat = null
	set @sMrc = N'*'
	set @sLocation = null
	set @sLocationorg = null
	set @sStore = null

	if @sParentrtype = N'L'
		begin
			if @sChildrtype = N'L'
				begin
					if @sErtype_in = N'X'
						set @sErtype = N'RL'
					else
						set @sErtype = N'LL'
				end
			else
				begin
					if @sErtype_in = N'A'
						set @sErtype = N'PL'
					else
						set @sErtype = N'RL'
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sErtype_in = N'A'
				set @sErtype = N'AO'
			else
				set @sErtype = N'DO'
		end

	set @sChk = N'0'

	set @sTmpparent = @sParent
	set @sTmpparentorg = @sParentorg
	set @sTmpparentrtype = @sParentrtype
	set @sTmpparenttype = @sParenttype
	set @sTmpchild = @sChild
	set @sTmpchildorg = @sChildorg
	set @sTmpchildrtype = @sChildrtype
	set @sTmpchildtype = @sChildtype

	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGttime OUTPUT, @sTmpchildorg
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sCurrUser OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7LANG @sLang OUTPUT, @sDumm OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7CREVT1 @sEventno OUTPUT, @dGttime, @sCurrUser, @sEtype OUTPUT, @sErtype OUTPUT, @sEstat OUTPUT,
								@sErstat OUTPUT, @sObstat, @sMrc, @sLocation, @sLocationorg, @sStore,
								@sLang, @sTmpparent OUTPUT, @sTmpparentorg OUTPUT, @sTmpparenttype OUTPUT, @sTmpparentrtype OUTPUT, @sTmpchild OUTPUT,
								@sTmpchildorg OUTPUT, @sTmpchildtype OUTPUT, @sTmpchildrtype OUTPUT, 1, N'+', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @nCast = cast( @sChk as int )
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7CREVT1', N'PROC', @nCast
			return -1
		end

	set @nCount = 1
	while @nCount < 3
		begin
			if @sChk = N'0'
				begin
					if @nCount = 1
						begin
							set @sErtype = @sErtype_in + @sChildrtype
							set @sObcode = @sChild
							set @sOborg = @sChildorg
							set @sObtype = @sChildtype
							set @sObrtype = @sChildrtype
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sErtype = @sErtype_in + @sParentrtype
							set @sObcode = @sParent
							set @sOborg = @sParentorg
							set @sObtype = @sParenttype
							set @sObrtype = @sParentrtype
						end

					execute @nReturn = O7CREOB1 @sEventno, @sErtype, @sObcode, @sOborg, @sObtype OUTPUT, @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @sChk <> N'0'
						begin
							set @nCast = cast( @sChk as int )
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7CREOB1', N'PROC', @nCast
							return -1
						end
				end
			set @nCount = @nCount + 1
		end

	set @sRetCode = N'0'


-- ========================================

create procedure O7OBJECTS_UPDATE_CHILDREN	@sRetCode		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
											@sObject		NVARCHAR(30),
											@sObjectorg		NVARCHAR(15),
											@sEvtrtype		NVARCHAR(4),
											@sNewvalue		NVARCHAR(100),
											@sTrlevent		NVARCHAR(30),
											@sOtherstore	NVARCHAR(30),
											@sTrlbin		NVARCHAR(15),
											@sTrllot		NVARCHAR(12),
											@sObjstatus		NVARCHAR(8),
											@sPartorg		NVARCHAR(15),
                                            @sAttach        nvarchar(1),
                                            @sAttachto      nvarchar(30),
                                            @sAttachtoorg   nvarchar(15),
											@sToolcheck		NVARCHAR(1) OUTPUT,
											@ctracode		NVARCHAR(30),
											@ntrlline		NUMERIC
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sLocation		nvarchar(30)	--r5objects.obj_location%TYPE
	declare @sLocationorg	nvarchar(15)	--r5objects.obj_location_org%TYPE
	declare @sLtype			nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_ltype%TYPE
	declare @sStore			nvarchar(15)	--r5objects.obj_store%TYPE
	declare @sRstatus		nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_rstatus%TYPE
	declare @sParent		nvarchar(30)	--r5objects.obj_code%TYPE
	declare @sParentorg		nvarchar(15)	--r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
	declare @sParentrtype	nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE
	declare @sParenttype	nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE
	declare @sBin			nvarchar(15)	--r5objects.obj_bin%TYPE
	declare @sLot			nvarchar(12)	--r5objects.obj_lot%TYPE
	declare @sObjectstatus	nvarchar(4)		--r5objects.obj_status%TYPE
	declare @sObjrstatus	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sTag			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%type
	declare @sChildtxn      	nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%type
	declare @nChildren		int
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCount			int

	declare @sIobj_code		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sIobj_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sIobj_obrtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sIobj_obtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sIobj_rstatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sIobj_store		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sIobj_part		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sIobj_part_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nIsublevel		int

	declare @sJparent		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sJparent_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sJparentrtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sJparenttype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sJchild		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sJchild_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sJchildrtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sJchildtype	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nStcSequence	numeric
	declare @nTrlqty	numeric( 24, 6 )
	declare @nTrlscrapqty	numeric( 24, 6 )
	declare @sManualposrr   nvarchar(1)

	set @sBin = @sTrlbin
	set @sLot = @sTrllot
	set @sManualposrr = N'-'
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sTag OUTPUT, N'OPT_TAGS', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sObject is null
		begin
			set @sRetCode = N'1'
			return
		end

	execute O7DFLT @sChildtxn OUTPUT, N'CHILDTXN', @sChk OUTPUT

	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5parts p, r5objects o
	WHERE  p.par_code     = o.obj_part
	AND    p.par_org      = @sPartorg
	AND    p.par_tool     IS NOT NULL
	AND    o.obj_part_org = p.par_org
	AND    o.obj_code     = @sObject
	AND    o.obj_org      = @sObjectorg

	if @nCount = 0
		set @sToolcheck = N'-'
	else
		set @sToolcheck = N'+'

	if @sEvtrtype = N'MRC'
		begin
			UPDATE r5objects
			SET    obj_mrc      = @sNewvalue
			WHERE  ( obj_code + N'#' +  obj_org ) IN (
					SELECT      stc_object + N'#' + stc_object_org
					FROM        dbo.O7OBJECTS_UPDATE_CHILDREN_HIER( @sObject, @sObjectorg, N'+' )
					)
			OR  ( obj_code = @sObject AND  obj_org = @sObjectorg)

			if @@ERROR <> 0
				begin
					set @sRetCode = N'2'
					return -1
				end
		end



	if @sEvtrtype in ( N'STO', N'XSTO', N'RECV', N'RR', N'IR' )
		begin
			if @sEvtrtype = N'XSTO'
				begin
					set @sStore = null
					set @sBin = null
					if @sOtherstore is not null
						set @sRstatus = null
					else
						begin
							set @sRstatus = N'I'
							set @sLocation = null
							set @sLocationorg = null

							DELETE FROM r5structures
							WHERE stc_child       = @sObject
							AND   stc_child_org   = @sObjectorg
							AND   stc_parentrtype = N'L'

							if @sToolcheck = N'-'
								begin
                                    if coalesce( @sAttach, N'-' ) = N'-'
                                        SELECT @sParent = evt_object,
										       @sParentorg = evt_object_org,
										       @sParentrtype = evt_obrtype,
										       @sParenttype = evt_obtype,
										       @sLocation = evt_location,
										       @sLocationorg = evt_location_org,
										       @sLtype = evt_ltype
									    FROM   r5events
									    WHERE  evt_code = @sTrlevent
									    AND    (evt_object + N'#' + evt_object_org) NOT IN (
											      SELECT      @sObject + N'#' + @sObjectorg
											      UNION ALL
											      SELECT      stc_object + N'#' + stc_object_org
											      FROM        dbo.O7OBJECTS_UPDATE_CHILDREN_HIER( @sObject, @sObjectorg, N'A' )
											      )
                                        AND NOT EXISTS (
                                                         SELECT 1 
                                                         FROM r5objects 
                                                         WHERE obj_code = evt_object 
                                                         AND obj_org = evt_object_org
                                                         AND obj_part is not null 
                                                         AND obj_part + N'#' + obj_part_org = (
                                                             SELECT obj_part + N'#' + obj_part_org 
                                                             FROM r5objects 
                                                             WHERE obj_code = @sObject 
                                                             AND obj_org = @sObjectorg )
                                                        )                                       										
									     AND    N'I' = (
											      SELECT obj_rstatus
											      FROM   r5objects
											      WHERE  obj_code = evt_object
											      AND    obj_org = evt_object_org)
                                    else
                                        begin
                                            if coalesce( @sAttach, N'-' ) = N'+' and @sAttachto is not null
                                                SELECT @sParent = obj_code,
                                                       @sParentorg = obj_org,
                                                       @sParentrtype = obj_obrtype,
                                                       @sParenttype = obj_obtype,
                                                       @sLocation = obj_location,
                                                       @sLocationorg = obj_location_org,
                                                       @sLtype = obj_ltype,
                                                       @sRstatus = obj_rstatus,
                                                       @sStore = obj_store,
                                                       @sBin = obj_bin
                                                FROM   r5objects
                                                WHERE  obj_code = @sAttachto
                                                AND    obj_org = @sAttachtoorg
                                                AND    obj_rstatus IN ( N'I', N'CIR' )
									            AND    (obj_code + N'#' + obj_org) NOT IN (
											              SELECT      @sObject + N'#' + @sObjectorg
											              UNION ALL
											              SELECT      stc_object + N'#' + stc_object_org
											              FROM        dbo.O7OBJECTS_UPDATE_CHILDREN_HIER( @sObject, @sObjectorg, N'A' )
	  								                      )
                                        e


-- ========================================

name: O7OBJECTS_UPDATE_CHILDREN_HIER

create function O7OBJECTS_UPDATE_CHILDREN_HIER (@sObject nvarchar(30), @sOrg nvarchar(15), @sMode nvarchar(1))
returns @tReturn table( stc_object		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_object_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
as
begin
	declare @nLevel	int

	declare @tStack table ( stc_object		nvarchar(30),
							stc_object_org	nvarchar(15),
							LevelID int )

	if @sMode = N'+'
		INSERT INTO @tStack
			select	stc_child, stc_child_org, 1
			  from	r5structures
			 where	stc_parent		= @sObject	and
					stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		and
					stc_rolldown		= N'+'
	else --Assume all child objects mode
		INSERT INTO @tStack
			select	stc_child, stc_child_org, 1
			  from	r5structures
			 where	stc_parent		= @sObject and
					stc_parent_org	= @sOrg

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sObject	= stc_object,
							@sOrg		= stc_object_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sObject, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_object = @sObject and stc_object_org = @sOrg
					if @sMode = N'+'
						INSERT INTO @tStack
							select	stc_child, stc_child_org, @nLevel + 1
							  from	r5structures
							 where	stc_parent		= @sObject	and
									stc_parent_org	= @sOrg		and
									stc_rolldown		= N'+'
					else --Assume all child objects mode
						INSERT INTO @tStack
							select	stc_child, stc_child_org, @nLevel + 1
							  from	r5structures
							 where	stc_parent		= @sObject and
									stc_parent_org	= @sOrg

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END
	return
end

					INSERT INTO @tStack

CREATE FUNCTION O7OBJEVALUATION_CO2EMISSION(
  @sObj       NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @sObjOrg    NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @sCommodity NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @dFromDate  DATETIME,     
  @dToDate    DATETIME )
RETURNS NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
AS
BEGIN 
  DECLARE @nCo2 NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  SELECT @nCo2 = SUM( COALESCE( cee_actualconsumption, 0 ) * COALESCE( cce_co2emission, 0 ) )
  FROM   r5commodityco2emission, r5commodityenergyeff
  WHERE  cce_date       = cee_date
  AND    cce_object     = COALESCE( cee_parentutlbillobject, cee_object )
  AND    cce_object_org = COALESCE( cee_parentutlbillobject_org, cee_object_org )
  AND    cce_commodity  = cee_commodity
  AND    cee_object     = @sObj
  AND    cee_object_org = @sObjOrg
  AND    cee_commodity LIKE @sCommodity
  AND    cee_date BETWEEN @dFromDate AND @dToDate;

  RETURN ISNULL( @nCo2, 0 )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7OBJEVALUATION_DESIGNCONS(
  @sEvalCode     NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @sObj          NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @sObjOrg       NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @sMisMatch     NVARCHAR( 1 )    OUTPUT,
  @nEnergyCost   NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @nCo2Cost      NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT )
AS
BEGIN 

  DECLARE @dTodate        DATETIME
  DECLARE @dFromdate      DATETIME
  DECLARE @sUom           NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @nRate          NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nConv          NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nEcost         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nCcost         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nRatio         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nCo2cst        NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @sOdc_commodity NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sOdc_uom       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @nOdc_rate      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  /* Initialize. */
  SET @dTodate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.F_GetSysDateTime(), N'DD' )
  SET @dFromdate = @dTodate - 365
  SET @sMisMatch   = N'-'
  SET @nEnergyCost = 0
  SET @nCo2Cost    = 0

  /* Check whether there is a commodity mismatch between old and new equipment ( design consumption wise ). */
  SELECT @sMisMatch = N'+'
  FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
  WHERE  odc_object     = @sObj
  AND    odc_object_org = @sObjOrg
  AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.F_GetSysDateTime(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN @dFromdate AND @dTodate
  AND 0 = ( SELECT CHARINDEX( N'#' + odc_commodity + N'#', N'#' + eev_commodity1 + N'#' + eev_commodity2 + N'#' + 
                              eev_commodity3 + N'#' + eev_commodity4 + N'#' + eev_commodity5 + N'#' )
            FROM   r5equipevaluations
            WHERE  eev_code = @sEvalCode )
  
  if @sMisMatch = N'-'
	begin
	  SELECT @sMisMatch = N'+'
	  FROM   r5equipevaluations
	  WHERE  eev_code = @sEvalCode 
	  AND  ( ( eev_commodity1 IS NOT NULL AND 
			   NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x' 
						   FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
						   WHERE  odc_object     = @sObj
						   AND    odc_object_org = @sObjOrg
						   AND    odc_commodity  = eev_commodity1
						   AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.F_GetSysDateTime(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN odc_fromdate AND odc_todate ) ) OR
			 ( eev_commodity2 IS NOT NULL AND 
			   NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x' 
						   FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
						   WHERE  odc_object     = @sObj
						   AND    odc_object_org = @sObjOrg
						   AND    odc_commodity  = eev_commodity2
						   AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.F_GetSysDateTime(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN odc_fromdate AND odc_todate ) ) OR
			( eev_commodity3 IS NOT NULL AND 
			   NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x' 
						   FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
						   WHERE  odc_object     = @sObj
						   AND    odc_object_org = @sObjOrg
						   AND    odc_commodity  = eev_commodity3
						   AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.F_GetSysDateTime(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN odc_fromdate AND odc_todate ) ) OR
			 ( eev_commodity4 IS NOT NULL AND 
			   NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x' 
						   FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
						   WHERE  odc_object     = @sObj
						   AND    odc_object_org = @sObjOrg
						   AND    odc_commodity  = eev_commodity4
						   AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.F_GetSysDateTime(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN odc_fromdate AND odc_todate ) ) OR
			 ( eev_commodity5 IS NOT NULL AND 
			   NOT EXISTS( SELECT N'x' 
						   FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
						   WHERE  odc_object     = @sObj
						   AND    odc_object_org = @sObjOrg
						   AND    odc_commodity  = eev_commodity5
						   AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.F_GetSysDateTime(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN odc_fromdate AND odc_todate ) ) )
	end
  DECLARE c_odc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT odc_commodity, odc_designusageuom, 
           CASE 100 WHEN odc_rangehigh   THEN odc_designconsumptionrate
                    WHEN odc_rangehigh2  THEN odc_designconsumptionrate2
                    WHEN odc_rangehigh3  THEN odc_designconsumptionrate3
                    WHEN odc_rangehigh4  THEN odc_designconsumptionrate4
                    WHEN odc_rangehigh5  THEN odc_designconsumptionrate5
                    WHEN odc_rangehigh6  THEN odc_designconsumptionrate6
                    WHEN odc_rangehigh7  THEN odc_designconsumptionrate7
                    WHEN odc_rangehigh8  THEN odc_designconsumptionrate8
                    WHEN odc_rangehigh9  THEN odc_designconsumptionrate9
                    WHEN odc_rangehigh10 THEN odc_designconsumptionrate10 END 
    FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
    WHERE  odc_object     = @sObj
    AND    odc_object_org = @sObjOrg
    AND    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.F_GetSysDateTime(), N'DD' ) BETWEEN odc_fromdate AND odc_todate;

  OPEN c_odc
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_odc INTO @sOdc_commodity, @sOdc_uom, @nOdc_rate
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

    
    /* Loop through the commodities. */
    BEGIN
      SET @sUom    = NULL
      SET @nRate   = NULL
      SET @nCo2cst = NULL
      SET @nConv   = 1
      SET @nRatio  = 1
      SET @nEcost  = 0
      SET @nCcost  = 0
      /* Retrieve evaluation data. */
      SELECT @sUom = CASE @sOdc_commodity  WHEN eev_commodity1 THEN eev_designusageuom1
                                           WHEN eev_commodity2 THEN eev_designusageuom2
                                           WHEN eev_commodity3 THEN eev_designusageuom3
                                           WHEN eev_commodity4 THEN eev_designusageuom4
                                           WHEN eev_commodity5 THEN eev_designusageuom5 END,
             @nRate = CASE @sOdc_commodity WHEN eev_commodity1 THEN eev_designconsumptionrate1
                                           WHEN eev_commodity2 THEN eev_designconsumptionrate2
                                           WHEN eev_commodity3 THEN eev_designconsumptionrate3
                                           WHEN eev_commodity4 THEN eev_designconsumptionrate4
                                           WHEN eev_commodity5 THEN eev_designconsumptionrate5 END,
             @nCo2cst = eev_co2cost
      FROM   r5equipevaluations
      WHERE  eev_code = @sEvalCode

      IF @sUom IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          IF @sUom <> @sOdc_uom
            BEGIN
              /* Retrieve conversion factor between uoms. */
              SELECT @nConv = uoc_confact 
              FROM   r5uomconversion
              WHERE  uoc_siteuom = @sOdc_uom
              AND    uoc_baseuom = @sUom 
            END

          SET @nRatio = ( @nRate * @nConv ) / @nOdc_rate

          /* Retrieve energy cost per commodity. */  
          SET @nEcost = dbo.o7objevaluation_energycost( 
                        @sObj, @sObjOrg, @sOdc_commodity, @dFromdate, @dTodate ) * COALESCE( @nRatio, 1 )
          SET @nEnergycost = @nEnergycost + COALESCE( @nEcost, 0 )
  
          /* Retrieve energy cost per commodity. */  
          SET @nCcost = dbo.o7objevaluation_co2emission( 
                        @sObj, @sObjOrg, @sOdc_commodity, @dFromdate, @dTodate ) * 
                        COALESCE( @nRatio, 1 ) * @nCo2cst;
          SET @nCo2cost = @nCo2cost + COALESCE( @nCcost, 0 )

        END

      FETCH NEXT FROM c_odc INTO @sOdc_commodity, @sOdc_uom, @nOdc_rate
    END
  CLOSE c_odc
  DEALLOCATE c_odc
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7OBJEVALUATION_ENERGYCOST(
  @sObj       NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @sObjOrg    NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @sCommodity NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @dFromDate  DATETIME,     
  @dToDate    DATETIME )
RETURNS NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
AS
BEGIN 
  DECLARE @nCost NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  SELECT @nCost = SUM( COALESCE( cee_actualconsumption, 0 ) * COALESCE( utr_rate, 0 ) )
  FROM   r5utilityrates, r5commodityenergyeff
  WHERE  utr_date       = cee_date
  AND    utr_object     = COALESCE( cee_parentutlbillobject, cee_object )
  AND    utr_object_org = COALESCE( cee_parentutlbillobject_org, cee_object_org )
  AND    utr_commodity  = cee_commodity
  AND    cee_object     = @sObj
  AND    cee_object_org = @sObjOrg
  AND    cee_commodity LIKE @sCommodity
  AND    cee_date BETWEEN @dFromDate AND @dToDate
  AND    utr_calculatedaverage = N'+'

  RETURN ISNULL( @nCost, 0 )
END

CREATE FUNCTION O7OBJEVALUATION_JOBPMCOSTPEROBJ(
  @sOrg       NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @sObjCode   NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @sObjOrg    NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sRtype     NVARCHAR(  3 ),
  @dFromDate  DATETIME,     
  @dToDate    DATETIME )
RETURNS NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
AS
BEGIN 
  DECLARE @nReturn       INT
  DECLARE @sAlljob       NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @sAllpm        NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @sRangejob     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @sRangepm      NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @nAlljobcost   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nAllpmcost    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nRangejobcost NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nRangepmcost  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @sMissingcurr  NVARCHAR( 40 )

  SET @sAlljob   = N'-'
  SET @sAllpm    = N'-'
  SET @sRangejob = N'-'
  SET @sRangepm  = N'-'

  IF @dFromDate IS NULL
    BEGIN
      IF @sRtype = N'JOB'
        SET @sAlljob = N'+'
      ELSE
        SET @sAllpm = N'+'
    END   
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @sRtype = N'JOB'
        SET @sRangejob = N'+'
      ELSE
        SET @sRangepm = N'+'
    END

  /* retrieve all costs. */
  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7objevaluation_wocost 
                     @sOrg, @sObjCode, @sObjOrg, NULL, NULL, @dFromdate, @dTodate, 
                     @sAlljob, @sAllpm, @sRangejob, @sRangepm,
                     @nAlljobcost OUTPUT, @nAllpmcost OUTPUT, @nRangejobcost OUTPUT, 
                     @nRangepmcost OUTPUT, @sMissingcurr OUTPUT

  RETURN COALESCE( COALESCE( @nAlljobcost, @nAllpmcost, @nRangejobcost ), @nRangepmcost )
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7OBJEVALUATION_REFRESH(
  @sEvalCode  NVARCHAR( 30 ) )
AS
BEGIN 
  DECLARE @nReturn  INT
  DECLARE @sObjcode NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sObjorg  NVARCHAR( 15 )

  DECLARE c_eel CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT eel_object, eel_object_org
    FROM   r5equipevaluationlist
    WHERE  eel_evalcode = @sEvalCode
    AND    eel_rstatus = N'E'

  /* Retrieve all objects. */
  OPEN c_eel
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_eel INTO @sObjcode, @sObjorg
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7objevaluation_refreshobj @sEvalCode, @sObjcode, @sObjorg
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_eel
          DEALLOCATE c_eel
          RETURN -1
        END
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_eel INTO @sObjcode, @sObjorg
    END
  CLOSE c_eel
  DEALLOCATE c_eel
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7OBJEVALUATION_REFRESHOBJ(
  @sEvalCode NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @sObjCode  NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @sObjOrg   NVARCHAR( 15 ) )
AS
BEGIN 
  DECLARE @nReturn       INT
  DECLARE @nCo2rate      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nAnnpmcost    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nAnnnonpmcost NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nEstmatcost   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nEstlabcost   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nEstsalvage   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @sEevcurr      NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @sEevorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @nAge          NUMERIC( 7, 3 )
  DECLARE @sObjcurr      NVARCHAR( 3 ) 
  DECLARE @dTodate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @dFromdate     DATETIME
  DECLARE @nEnergycost   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nCo2cost      NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nB_Energycost NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nB_Co2cost    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nAlljobcost   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nAllpmcost    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nRangejobcost NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nRangepmcost  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nExrt         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @sMissingcurr  NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @sMismatch     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @sGasindex     NVARCHAR( 1 )
  DECLARE @sWarning      NVARCHAR( 500 )
  DECLARE @sGenericmes   NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @sCurrencymes  NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @sUtlratemes   NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @nDaysinYear   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )

  EXECUTE dbo.o7intgem @sGenericmes  OUTPUT, 'O7OBJEVALUATION', 'PROC', 1
  EXECUTE dbo.o7intgem @sCurrencymes OUTPUT, 'O7OBJEVALUATION', 'PROC', 2
  EXECUTE dbo.o7intgem @sUtlratemes  OUTPUT, 'O7OBJEVALUATION', 'PROC', 3

  SET @dTodate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.F_GetSysDateTime(), N'DD' )
  SET @dFromdate = @dTodate - 365
  SET @nDaysinYear = 365

  /* Get evaluation header data. */
  SELECT @nAnnpmcost    = eev_annualpmcost, 
         @nAnnnonpmcost = eev_annualnonpmcost,
         @nEstmatcost   = eev_estmatcost,  
         @nEstlabcost   = eev_estlabcost, 
         @nEstsalvage   = eev_estsalvage,
         @nCo2rate      = eev_co2cost, 
         @sEevcurr      = org_curr, 
         @sEevOrg       = org_code
  FROM   r5organization, r5equipevaluations
  WHERE  eev_org  = org_code
  AND    eev_code = @sEvalCode

  /* Get object data. */
  SELECT @nAge = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( 1, ROUND( ( DATEDIFF( DAY, obj_commiss, dbo.F_GetSysDateTime() ) ) / 
                                           @nDaysinYear, 3 ) ), 
         @sObjcurr = org_curr,
         @sGasindex = obj_gasindex
  FROM   r5organization, r5objects
  WHERE  obj_org  = org_code
  AND    obj_code = @sObjCode
  AND    obj_org  = @sObjOrg

  /* Get energy cost. */
  SET @nEnergycost = dbo.o7objevaluation_energycost( @sObjCode, @sObjOrg, N'%', @dFromdate, @dTodate )
  /* Convert to currency of header. */
  IF @sObjcurr <> @sEevcurr
    EXECUTE dbo.o7gtexch @nExrt OUTPUT, @sObjcurr, @sEevOrg, @dTodate
  ELSE
    SET @nExrt = 1      

  IF @nExrt IS NULL
    /* Something wrong, no exchange rate found. */
    BEGIN
      SET @sMissingcurr = @sObjcurr
      SET @nExrt = 1
    END
  SET @nEnergycost = ROUND( @nEnergycost / @nExrt, 6 ) 
        
  IF @sGasindex = N'+' AND ISNULL( @nEnergycost, 0 ) = 0 
    /* Set warning if gas indexed, but no energy costs. */
    SET @sWarning = @sGenericmes + N' ' + @sUtlratemes

  /* Get CO2 cost. */
  SET @nCo2cost = dbo.o7objevaluation_co2emission( @sObjCode, @sObjOrg, N'%', @dFromdate, @dTodate ) * @nCo2rate

  /* Get energy and CO2 cost of new equipment. */
  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7objevaluation_designcons
                     @sEvalCode, @sObjCode, @sObjOrg, @sMismatch OUTPUT, @nB_energycost OUTPUT, @nB_co2cost OUTPUT

  /* Get work order costs. */
  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7objevaluation_wocost 
                     @sEevorg, @sObjCode, @sObjOrg, NULL, NULL, @dFromdate, @dTodate, N'+', N'+', N'+', N'+',
                     @nAlljobcost OUTPUT, @nAllpmcost OUTPUT, @nRangejobcost OUTPUT, 
                     @nRangepmcost OUTPUT, @sMissingcurr OUTPUT


  IF @sMissingcurr IS NOT NULL
    BEGIN
      /* Set warning column, exchange rate missing. */
      IF @sWarning IS NULL
        SET @sWarning = @sGenericmes + N' ' + @sCurrencymes
      ELSE
        SET @sWarning = @sWarning + N' ' + @sCurrencymes
      SET @sWarning = REPLACE( @sWarning, N'<FROMCURR>', @sMissingcurr )
      SET @sWarning = REPLACE( @sWarning, N'<TOCURR>', @sEevcurr )
    END

  /* Do the actual update. */
  UPDATE r5equipevaluationlist
  SET    eel_age                   = @nAge,
         eel_pmcost                = CASE @nAge WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE @nallpmcost / @nAge END,
         eel_pmcostpreviousyear    = @nrangepmcost,
         eel_nonpmcost             = CASE @nAge WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE @nalljobcost / @nAge END,
         eel_nonpmcostpreviousyear = @nrangejobcost,
         eel_energycost            = @nenergycost,
         eel_co2cost               = @nco2cost,
         eel_b_energycost          = @nB_energycost,
         eel_b_co2cost             = @nB_co2cost,
         eel_warningmessage        = @sWarning,
         eel_commoditymismatch     = @sMismatch,
         eel_lastrefreshed         = dbo.o7gttime2( @sObjOrg )
  WHERE  eel_evalcode   = @sEvalCode
  AND    eel_object     = @sObjCode
  AND    eel_object_org = @sObjOrg

  /* Set total annual savings. */
  UPDATE r5equipevaluationlist
  SET    eel_totalannualsavings = 
     ( ( ROUND( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( eel_pmcost, eel_pmcostpreviousyear ), 2 ) - ROUND( @nAnnpmcost, 2 ) ) +
       ( ROUND( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( eel_nonpmcost, eel_nonpmcostpreviousyear ), 2 ) - ROUND( @nAnnnonpmcost, 2 ) ) +
       ( ROUND( eel_energycost, 2 ) - ROUND( eel_b_energycost, 2 ) ) +
       ( ROUND( eel_co2cost, 2 ) - ROUND( eel_b_co2cost, 2 ) ) )
  WHERE  eel_evalcode   = @sEvalCode
  AND    eel_object     = @sObjCode
  AND    eel_object_org = @sObjOrg

  /* Set ROI. */
  UPDATE r5equipevaluationlist
  SET    eel_roi = CASE COALESCE( eel_totalannualsavings, 0 ) WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE
                        ROUND( ( COALESCE( @nEstmatcost, 0 ) + 
                                 COALESCE( @nEstlabcost, 0 ) - 
                                 COALESCE( @nEstsalvage, 0 ) ) /
                               eel_totalannualsavings, 2 ) END
  WHERE  eel_evalcode   = @sEvalCode
  AND    eel_object     = @sObjCode
  AND    eel_object_org = @sObjOrg

END

name: O7OBJEVALUATION_WOCOST
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7OBJEVALUATION_WOCOST(
  @sOrg          NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @sObj          NVARCHAR( 30 ), 
  @sObjOrg       NVARCHAR( 15 ), 
  @sEvent        NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @nAct          NUMERIC( 8 ),
  @dFromDate     DATETIME,     
  @dToDate       DATETIME,
  @sAllJob       NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @sAllPm        NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @sRangeJob     NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @sRangePm      NVARCHAR( 1 ),
  @nAlljobCost   NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @nAllpmCost    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @nRangejobCost NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @nRangepmCost  NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) OUTPUT,
  @sMissingCurr  NVARCHAR( 40 )   OUTPUT )
AS
BEGIN 

  DECLARE @nReturn       INT
  DECLARE @sEvtcode      NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sEvtrtype     NVARCHAR(  4 )
  DECLARE @dEvtcompleted DATETIME
  DECLARE @sEvtorg       NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sOrgcurr      NVARCHAR(  3 )

  DECLARE @nLab    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Own labor
  DECLARE @nHir    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Hired labor ( hours * price )
  DECLARE @nFix    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Fixed price labor
  DECLARE @nIhr    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Invoice difference hired labor
  DECLARE @nIfx    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Invoice difference fixed price
  DECLARE @nMat    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Material
  DECLARE @nDma    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Direct material
  DECLARE @nIdm    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Invoice difference direct material
  DECLARE @nTls    NUMERIC( 24, 6 ) -- Tools
  DECLARE @nCost   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @nExrt   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @sX      NVARCHAR( 1000 )
  DECLARE @sSource NVARCHAR( 3 )
  DECLARE @sCode   NVARCHAR( 100 )

  SET @nAlljobCost   = 0
  SET @nAllpmCost    = 0
  SET @nRangejobCost = 0
  SET @nRangepmCost  = 0
  SET @sSource       = N'EVT'

  /* Retrieve all work orders. */
  DECLARE c_evt CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT evt_code, evt_rtype, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( evt_completed, N'DD' ), evt_org, org_curr
    FROM   r5organization, r5events, r5eventobjects
    WHERE  evt_org = org_code
    AND    evt_code = eob_event
    AND    eob_object = @sObj
    AND    eob_object_org = @sObjOrg
    AND    evt_rtype IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
    AND    evt_rstatus = N'C'
    AND  (    COALESCE( dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( evt_completed, N'DD' ), @dFromDate ) BETWEEN @dFromDate AND @dToDate 
           OR @sAllJob = N'+'
           OR @sAllPm = N'+' )
    AND  (    evt_rtype = N'JOB'
           OR @sAllPm = N'+'
           OR @sRangePm = N'+' )
    AND  (    evt_rtype = N'PPM'
           OR @sAllJob = N'+'
           OR @sRangeJob = N'+' )
    AND    @sObj IS NOT NULL
    AND    @sObjOrg IS NOT NULL 
    UNION
    SELECT evt_code, evt_rtype, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( evt_completed, N'DD' ), evt_org, org_curr
    FROM   r5organization, r5events
    WHERE  evt_org = org_code
    AND    evt_code = @sEvent
    AND    evt_rtype IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
    AND  (    COALESCE( dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( evt_completed, N'DD' ), @dFromDate ) BETWEEN @dFromDate AND @dToDate
           OR @sAllJob = N'+'
           OR @sAllPm = N'+' )
    AND  (    evt_rtype = N'JOB'
           OR @sAllPm = N'+'
           OR @sRangePm = N'+' )
    AND  (    evt_rtype = N'PPM'
           OR @sAllJob = N'+'
           OR @sRangeJob = N'+' )
    AND    @sEvent IS NOT NULL

  OPEN c_evt
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt INTO @sEvtcode, @sEvtrtype, @dEvtcompleted, @sEvtorg, @sOrgcurr
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Check orgs, if different get exchange rate. */
      IF @sEvent IS NULL
        BEGIN
          SET @nExrt = NULL
          IF @sEvtorg <> @sOrg
            EXECUTE dbo.o7gtexch @nExrt OUTPUT, @sOrgcurr, @sOrg, @dToDate
          ELSE
            SET @nExrt = 1
        END
      ELSE 
        /* Cost of one work order, so exchange rate = 1. */
        SET @nExrt = 1

      IF @nExrt IS NULL
        BEGIN
          /* Something wrong, no exchange rate found. */
          IF @sMissingCurr IS NULL
            SET @sMissingCurr =  @sOrgcurr
          SET @nExrt = 1         
        END  
        
      /* Intialize costs. */ 
      SET @nLab  = 0
      SET @nHir  = 0
      SET @nFix  = 0  
      SET @nIhr  = 0
      SET @nIfx  = 0
      SET @nMat  = 0
      SET @nDma  = 0
      SET @nIdm  = 0
      SET @nTls  = 0

      IF @nAct IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
          SET @sSource = N'ACT'
          SET @sCode   = @sEvtcode + N'#' + @nAct
        END
      ELSE
        SET @sCode = @sEvtcode

      /* Retrieve all costs, using the standard stored procedures. */
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7actlab  @sSource, @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nLab OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_evt
          DEALLOCATE c_evt
          RETURN -1
        END
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7acthir  @sSource, @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nHir OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_evt
          DEALLOCATE c_evt
          RETURN -1
        END
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7actfix  @sSource, @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nFix OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_evt
          DEALLOCATE c_evt
          RETURN -1
        END
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7actmat  @sSource, @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nMat OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_evt
          DEALLOCATE c_evt
          RETURN -1
        END
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7actdma  @sSource, @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nDma OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_evt
          DEALLOCATE c_evt
          RETURN -1
        END
      EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7acttool @sSource, @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nTls OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT
      IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
        BEGIN
          CLOSE c_evt
          DEALLOCATE c_evt
          RETURN -1
        END
      IF @sSource = 'EVT'
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7pidhir  @sSource, @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nIhr OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT
          IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
            BEGIN
              CLOSE c_evt
              DEALLOCATE c_evt
              RETURN -1
            END
          EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7pidfix  @sSource, @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nIfx OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT
          IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
            BEGIN
              CLOSE c_evt
              DEALLOCATE c_evt
              RETURN -1
            END
          EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.o7piddma  @sSource, @sCode, NULL, NULL, NULL, @nIdm OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT
          IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
            BEGIN
              CLOSE c_evt
              DEALLOCATE c_evt
              RETURN -1
            END
        END

      /* Sum all different types of cost to one overall cost. */
      SET @nCost = COALESCE( @nLab, 0 ) + COALESCE( @nHir, 0 ) + COALESCE( @nFix, 0 ) + 
                   COALESCE( @nIhr, 0 ) + COALESCE( @nIfx, 0 ) + COALESCE( @nMat, 0 ) + 
                   COALESCE( @nDma, 0 ) + COALESCE( @nIdm, 0 ) + COALESCE( @nTls, 0 )

      SET @nCost = COALESCE( ROUND( @nCost / @nExrt, 6 ), 0 )

      IF    @sAllJob = N'+' 
        AND @sEvtrtype = N'JOB'
        /* Add cost to 'all' job cost, in case work order type = 'JOB'. */
        SET @nAlljobCost = COALESCE( @nAlljobCost, 0 ) + @nCost

      IF    @sAllPm = N'+' 
        AND @sEvtrtype = N'PPM'
        /* Add cost to 'all' pm cost, in case work order type = 'PPM'. */
        SET @nAllpmCost = COALESCE( @nAllpmCost, 0 ) + @nCost

      IF    @sRangeJob = N'+'

        AND COALESCE( @dEvtcompleted, @dFromDate ) BETWEEN @dFromDate AND @dToDate
        /* Add cost to 'range' job cost, in case work order type = 'JOB' and comp. date in period. */
        SET @nRangejobCost = COALESCE( @nRangejobCost, 0 ) + @nCost

CREATE PROCEDURE O7ORDDMA	
			@sSource		nvarchar(8),
			@sCode			nvarchar(30),
			@sClass			nvarchar(80),
			@dDatefrom		datetime,
			@dDateto		datetime,
			@nCost			numeric(30,6)		OUTPUT,
			@sStatement		nvarchar(4000)		OUTPUT 
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)		
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(2000)		
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(200)		
	declare @nOrddma		numeric(30,6)		
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(800)		
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRecid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''

	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) *
													coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) /
													coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) /
													coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 )  ), 2 ) costs,
										coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch,1 ) rate, 
										round( sum( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 )	), 2 ) qty,
										a.act_event,
										a.act_act, 
										l.orl_sqlidentity recid 								
								from  r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5activities a, r5ububat u 
								where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
								and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
								and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
								and    l.orl_rtype   = N''PD''
								and   l.orl_event = a.act_event
								and   l.orl_act   = a.act_act
								and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
								and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N'''
								and   a.act_start >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
								and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
								group by coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch,1 ), a.act_event, a.act_act, l.orl_sqlidentity '
			return 
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sSource = N'BUD'
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N'r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5activities a, r5ububat u '
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N'r5orderlines l, r5orders o '
				end

		   set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) *
									coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) /
									coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) /
									coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) '
									+ N'), 2 ) 
								from  ' + @sFromstat +
								N' where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
									and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
									and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
									and    l.orl_rtype   = N''PD'''

		   set @sEvtclause = N' and l.orl_event in
						   ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ORDXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

		   set @sPrjclause = N' and l.orl_project in
						   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ORDXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

		   set @sBudclause = N' and   l.orl_event = a.act_event
								and   l.orl_act   = a.act_act
								and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
								and   u.bub_code  = @sCode 
								and   a.act_start >=
									CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
								and   a.act_start <=
									CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) '

			set	 @sAndclause = N''

			if @sSource = N'EVT' 
			  set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			if  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			if  @sSource = N'BUD' 
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause

			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10)', @nCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sCharfrom, @sCharto
		end

create function O7ORDERQTY (
  @sEvent   nvarchar(30),
  @nAct     numeric(8,0),
  @sPart    nvarchar(30),
  @sPartorg nvarchar(15),
  @sStore   nvarchar(15),
    @sDirect  nvarchar(1)
  )
  returns numeric(32,6)
as
begin

    declare @nOrderqty      numeric(24,6)
    set @nOrderqty = 0 

    SELECT @nOrderqty = coalesce( SUM( orl_ordqty - coalesce( orl_recvqty, 0 ) - coalesce( orl_scrapqty, 0 ) ), 0 )
    FROM   r5orderlines
    WHERE  orl_store    = @sStore
    AND    orl_part     = @sPart 
    AND    orl_part_org = @sPartorg
    AND    orl_rstatus  = 'A'
    AND    orl_active   = '+'
    AND( ( @sDirect = '+' AND orl_rtype='PD' AND orl_event = @sEvent AND orl_act = @nAct ) OR
         ( @sDirect = '-' AND orl_rtype='PS' ) )
  
    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        set  @nOrderqty = null

    RETURN (@nOrderqty) 
end

	else

			end

		set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) /
									coalesce( l.orl_exch,1 ) *
									( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) '
									+ @sExtra + N')), 2 )
								from  ' + @sFromstat +
								N' where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
								and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
								and    l.orl_rtype   = N''ST''
								and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A'''


	   set @sEvtclause = N' and l.orl_event in
					   ( select evt_code from dbo.O7ORDXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

	   set @sPrjclause = N' and l.orl_project in
					   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7ORDXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

	   set @sBudclause = N' and   l.orl_event = a.act_event
							and   l.orl_act   = a.act_act
							and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
							and   u.bub_code  = @sCode 
							and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
							and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) '

		set	 @sAndclause = N''

		if @sSource = N'EVT' 
		  set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
		if  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
			set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
		if  @sSource = N'BUD' 
			set @sAndclause = @sBudclause

		set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
		EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10)', @nCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sCharfrom, @sCharto
	end

create function O7ORDXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( evt_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(30)
		
	declare @tStack table ( evt_code nvarchar(30), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select evt_code, 1 from r5events where evt_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = evt_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND evt_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select evt_code, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events
										 where evt_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

BEGIN

 SET @nLevel = 1  
 
 INSERT INTO @tReturn 
 SELECT ozs_code from R5ORGSTRUCTURE
where OZS_CODE = @coorg

CREATE FUNCTION o7orgstructures_get_level_1 ( @coorg NVARCHAR(15))    
    
RETURNS INTEGER    
AS    
BEGIN    
  DECLARE @nLevel    INTEGER    
  DECLARE @currentorg  NVARCHAR(15)
     
     
    
  DECLARE @tStack TABLE ( ozs_code  NVARCHAR(15),     
  LevelID   INTEGER )    
    
  SET @nLevel = 1    
    
  INSERT INTO @tStack    
  SELECT ozs_code,    
  @nLevel    
  FROM R5ORGSTRUCTURE    
  WHERE    ozs_parent  is NULL    
     
    
  WHILE @nLevel > 0    
    BEGIN    
      IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)    
        BEGIN    
          IF @nLevel >= 1    
            BEGIN    
              SELECT @currentorg  = ozs_code    
              FROM @tStack    
              WHERE LevelID = @nLevel    
              if @currentorg = @coorg
                break       
            END    
    
            DELETE FROM @tStack    
            WHERE LevelID = @nLevel    
            AND ozs_code  = @currentorg    
           
    
          INSERT INTO @tStack    
          SELECT ozs_code,        
          @nLevel + 1    
          FROM R5ORGSTRUCTURE    
          WHERE ozs_parent  = @currentorg    

          IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0     
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1    
        END    
      ELSE     
        SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1    
    END    
  RETURN @nLevel    
END

create PROCEDURE O7OSROTA_CREATEEVENT @sErtype_in   nvarchar(8),
                                      @sParent      nvarchar(30),  --start parent parms here
                                      @sParentorg   nvarchar(15),
                                      @sParenttype  nvarchar(4),
                                      @sParentrtype nvarchar(4),
                                      @sChild       nvarchar(30),
                                      @sChildorg    nvarchar(15),
                                      @sChildtype   nvarchar(4),
                                      @sChildrtype  nvarchar(4),
                                      @sR5user      nvarchar(255),
                                      @sLanguage    nvarchar(2),
                                      @sObstat      nvarchar(4)
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sEventno   nvarchar(30)    --r5events.evt_code%TYPE
    declare @sEtype     nvarchar(4)     --r5events.evt_type%TYPE
    declare @sErtype    nvarchar(4)     --r5events.evt_rtype%TYPE
    declare @sEstat     nvarchar(4)     --r5events.evt_status%TYPE
    declare @sErstat    nvarchar(4)     --r5events.evt_rstatus%TYPE
    declare @sParcode   nvarchar(30)    --r5objects.obj_code%TYPE
    declare @sParorg    nvarchar(15)    --r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
    declare @sPartype   nvarchar(4)     --r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE
    declare @sParrtype  nvarchar(4)     --r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE
    declare @sObcode    nvarchar(30)    --r5objects.obj_code%TYPE
    declare @sOborg     nvarchar(15)    --r5objects.obj_org%TYPE
    declare @sObtype    nvarchar(4)     --r5objects.obj_obtype%TYPE
    declare @sObrtype   nvarchar(4)     --r5objects.obj_obrtype%TYPE
    declare @sEvtstat   nvarchar(4)     --r5events.evt_status%type

    declare @nReturn    int
    declare @sChk       nvarchar(4)
    declare @dTemp      datetime

    set @sErstat = N'C'

    if @sParentrtype = N'L'
        begin
            if @sChildrtype = N'L'
                set @sErtype = N'LL'
            else
                begin
                    if @sErtype_in = N'A'
                        set @sErtype = N'PL'
                    else
                        set @sErtype = N'RL'
                end
        end
    else
        set @sErtype = CASE @sErtype_in WHEN N'A'    THEN N'AO'
                                        WHEN N'STAT' THEN N'STAT'
                                                     ELSE N'DO' END

    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @sErstat OUTPUT, @sEvtstat OUTPUT, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    if @sErtype_in <> N'STAT'
        begin
            set @sParcode = @sParent
            set @sParorg = @sParentorg
            set @sPartype = @sParenttype
            set @sParrtype = @sParentrtype
        end

    set @sObcode = @sChild
    set @sOborg = @sChildorg
    set @sObtype = @sChildtype
    set @sObrtype = @sChildrtype

    set @dTemp = dbo.o7gttime2(@sParentorg)
    execute @nReturn = o7crevt1 @sEventno OUTPUT, @dTemp, @sR5user, @sEtype OUTPUT,
                                @sErtype OUTPUT, @sEstat OUTPUT, @sErstat OUTPUT,
                                @sObstat, N'*', null, null, null, @sLanguage,
                                @sParcode OUTPUT, @sParorg OUTPUT, @sPartype OUTPUT,
                                @sParrtype OUTPUT, @sObcode OUTPUT, @sOborg OUTPUT,
                                @sObtype OUTPUT, @sObrtype OUTPUT, 1, N'+', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    if @sErtype_in <> N'STAT'
        set @sErtype = @sErtype_in + @sChildrtype

    execute @nReturn = o7creob1 @sEventno, @sErtype, @sObcode, @sOborg,
                                @sObtype OUTPUT, @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    if @sErtype_in <> N'STAT'
        begin
            set @sErtype = @sErtype_in + @sParentrtype
            set @sObcode = @sParent
            set @sOborg = @sParentorg
            set @sObtype = @sParenttype
            set @sObrtype = @sParentrtype
            execute @nReturn = o7creob1 @sEventno, @sErtype, @sObcode, @sOborg,
                                        @sObtype OUTPUT, @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                return -1
        end

create PROCEDURE O7OSROTA_CREATESTWOEVENT @sStwowo          nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,  --these are all from the parent proc
                                          @sChild           nvarchar(30),
                                          @sChildorg        nvarchar(15),
                                          @sChildtype       nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT,
                                          @sChildrtype      nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT,
                                          @sStandwork       nvarchar(30),
                                          @sLocation        nvarchar(30),
                                          @sLocationorg     nvarchar(15),
                                          @sMrc             nvarchar(15),
                                          @sForrepair       nvarchar(8),
                                          @sEvtparent       nvarchar(30),
                                          @sEvtproject      nvarchar(20),
                                          @sEvtprojbud      nvarchar(20),
                                          @sWoorg           nvarchar(15),
                                          @sDeforg          nvarchar(15),
                                          @sPerson          nvarchar(15),
                                          @sCostcode	    nvarchar(30) -- r5events.evt_costcode
as
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sEventno       nvarchar(30)  --r5events.evt_code%TYPE;
    declare @sErtype        nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_rtype%TYPE;
    declare @sEtype         nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_type%TYPE;
    declare @sErstat        nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_rstatus%TYPE;
    declare @sEstat         nvarchar(4)   --r5events.evt_status%TYPE;
    declare @sJobtype       nvarchar(8)   --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;
    declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)  --r5userorganization.uog_org%TYPE;
    declare @sCreatedby     nvarchar(255)
    declare @dEvtreported   datetime

    declare @nReturn        int
    declare @sChk           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
    declare @nAcd           bigint

    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7maxseq @sEventno OUTPUT, N'EVENT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    set @sStwowo = @sEventno

    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @sJobtype OUTPUT, N'RP', N'JBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    set @sErtype = N'JOB'
    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @sErtype OUTPUT, @sEtype OUTPUT, N'EVTP', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    set @sErstat = N'R'
    execute @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @sErstat OUTPUT, @sEstat OUTPUT, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    set @dEvtreported = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )

    execute @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sCreatedby OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    set @sCreatedby = isnull( @sCreatedby, N'R5' )

    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nAcd OUTPUT, N'ACCOUNT', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    INSERT INTO r5events( evt_code, evt_desc, evt_type, evt_rtype, evt_obtype, evt_obrtype,
           evt_object, evt_object_org, evt_status, evt_rstatus, evt_standwork, evt_location,
           evt_location_org, evt_mrc, evt_date, evt_duration, evt_fixed, evt_jobtype,
           evt_priority, evt_reqm, evt_target, evt_reported, evt_parent, evt_project,
           evt_projbud, evt_org, evt_person, evt_schedend, evt_warranty, evt_acd, evt_enteredby, evt_costcode )
    SELECT @sEventno, s.stw_desc, @sEtype, @sErtype, @sChildtype, @sChildrtype,
           @sChild, @sChildorg, @sEstat, @sErstat, @sStandwork, @sLocation,
           @sLocationorg, @sMrc, @dEvtreported, s.stw_duration, N'F',
           CASE coalesce( UPPER( @sForrepair ), N'0' ) WHEN N'-1' THEN @sJobtype ELSE s.stw_jobtype END,
           s.stw_priority, s.stw_reqm, @dEvtreported, @dEvtreported, @sEvtparent, @sEvtproject,
           @sEvtprojbud, coalesce( @sWoorg, @sDeforg ), @sPerson, @dEvtreported + s.stw_duration - 1,
           N'-', @nAcd, @sCreatedby, @sCostcode
    FROM   r5standworks s
    WHERE  s.stw_code = @sStandwork

    set @sX = null

    execute @nReturn = o7cract1 @sEventno, @sX, @sStandwork, N'*', N'*', N'0', @dEvtreported,
                                @sErstat, N'-', N'-', null, null, @sMrc, @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

    execute @nReturn = o7creob1 @sEventno, @sErtype, @sChild, @sChildorg,
                                @sChildtype OUTPUT, @sChildrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        return -1

            @dSys_date, N'F', 1, @sJobtype, @sCurorg, N'-', @nAcd, @sCostcode )

    execute @nReturn = o7creob1 @sNewevtcode, @sErtype, @sObcode, @sOborg,
                                @sObjtype OUTPUT, @sObjrtype OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

create function O7OUTSTQTY( @sOrder       nvarchar(30),
                            @sOrderOrg    nvarchar(15), 
                            @nOrderline   numeric(8)  )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
    declare @nOutstqty     numeric(24,6)
    declare @nRequestqty   numeric(24,6)
    declare @nRequestprice numeric(24,6)
    declare @nRecvqty      numeric(24,6)
    declare @nRecvvalue    numeric(24,6)
    declare @nScrapqty     numeric(24,6)
    declare @sOrdertype    nvarchar(4)
    declare @sLinestatus   nvarchar(4)

    SELECT @nRequestqty = COALESCE ( orl_ordqty, 0 ), 
           @nRequestprice = COALESCE ( orl_price, 0 ),
           @nRecvqty = COALESCE ( orl_recvqty, 0 ),
           @nRecvvalue = COALESCE (orl_recvvalue,0),           
           @nScrapqty = COALESCE ( orl_scrapqty, 0), 
           @sOrdertype = orl_rtype, 
           @sLinestatus = orl_rstatus  
    FROM R5ORDERLINES
    WHERE orl_order = @sOrder
    AND orl_order_org = @sOrderOrg
    AND orl_ordline = @nOrderline

    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        return 0

    if @sOrdertype = N'PD'
        set @nOutstqty = @nRequestqty - @nRecvqty - @nScrapqty
    else if @sOrdertype = N'SF' 
        set @nOutstqty = @nRequestprice - @nRecvvalue
    else if @sOrdertype = N'ST'
        set @nOutstqty = @nRequestqty - @nRecvqty
    else    
    	set @nOutstqty = 0

    if @sLinestatus = N'C'
        set @nOutstqty = 0

return( dbo.f_greatest_number(@nOutstqty,0) )

end
