   DECLARE @sChild_org     nvarchar(15)
   DECLARE @sParent_org    nvarchar(15)
   DECLARE @nUpdatecount   numeric(38,0)
   DECLARE @nSqlidentity   integer

   DECLARE @tStack TABLE(
      stc_childtype      nvarchar(4),
      stc_childrtype     nvarchar(4),
      stc_child          nvarchar(30),
      stc_parenttype     nvarchar(4),
      stc_parentrtype    nvarchar(4),
      stc_parent         nvarchar(30),
      stc_rolldown       nvarchar(1),
      stc_rollup         nvarchar(1),
      stc_equivalent     nvarchar(1),
      stc_downtime       nvarchar(1),
      stc_child_org      nvarchar(15),
      stc_parent_org     nvarchar(15),
      stc_updatecount    numeric(38,0),
      stc_sqlidentity    integer,
      LevelID            int )

   INSERT INTO @tStack
   SELECT
      stc_childtype,
      stc_childrtype,
      stc_child,
      stc_parenttype,
      stc_parentrtype,
      stc_parent,
      stc_rolldown,
      stc_rollup,
      stc_equivalent,
      stc_downtime,
      stc_child_org,
      stc_parent_org,
      stc_updatecount,
      stc_sqlidentity,
      1
   FROM  r5structures
   WHERE stc_parent      = @sCode
   AND   stc_parent_org  = @sOrg

   SET @nLevel = 1

   WHILE @nLevel > 0
      BEGIN
         IF EXISTS( SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel )
            BEGIN
               SELECT
                  @sChildtype    = stc_childtype,
                  @sChildrtype   = stc_childrtype,
                  @sChild        = stc_child,
                  @sParenttype   = stc_parenttype,
                  @sParentrtype  = stc_parentrtype,
                  @sParent       = stc_parent,
                  @sRolldown     = stc_rolldown,
                  @sRollup       = stc_rollup,
                  @sEquivalent   = stc_equivalent,
                  @sDowntime     = stc_downtime,
                  @sChild_org    = stc_child_org,
                  @sParent_org   = stc_parent_org,
                  @nUpdatecount  = stc_updatecount,
                  @nSqlidentity  = stc_sqlidentity
               FROM  @tStack
               WHERE LevelID = @nLevel

               INSERT INTO @tReturn 
               VALUES(
                  @sChildtype,
                  @sChildrtype,
                  @sChild,
                  @sParenttype,
                  @sParentrtype,
                  @sParent,
                  @sRolldown,
                  @sRollup,
                  @sEquivalent,
                  @sDowntime,
                  @sChild_org,
                  @sParent_org,
                  @sChild,
                  @sChild_org,
                  @nUpdatecount,
                  @nSqlidentity  )

               DELETE 
               FROM  @tStack 
               WHERE LevelID       = @nLevel 
               AND   stc_child     = @sChild 
               AND   stc_child_org = @sChild_org

               INSERT INTO @tStack 
               SELECT
                  stc_childtype,
                  stc_childrtype,
                  stc_child,
                  stc_parenttype,
                  stc_parentrtype,
                  stc_parent,
                  stc_rolldown,
                  stc_rollup,
                  stc_equivalent,
                  stc_downtime,
                  stc_child_org,
                  stc_parent_org,
                  stc_updatecount,
                  stc_sqlidentity,
                  @nLevel + 1
               FROM  r5structures
               WHERE stc_parent     = @sChild
               AND  	stc_parent_org = @sChild_org

               IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
                  SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
            END
         ELSE
            SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
      END

   RETURN
END

	@dStartdate      datetime,
	@sR5user         nvarchar(255)  
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare  @nRecords integer
	declare @nReturn integer
begin
	if @sNewwarranty <> N'%' AND @sWarranty = N'%'

			INSERT INTO r5warcoverages ( wcv_warranty, wcv_object, wcv_object_org,
				wcv_obtype, wcv_obrtype, wcv_duration, wcv_startdate, wcv_expirationdate,
				wcv_recorded, wcv_user, wcv_active )
			SELECT @sNewwarranty, obj_code, obj_org, obj_obtype, obj_obrtype,
				doc_duration, @dStartdate, @dStartdate + doc_duration,
				dbo.o7gttime2(obj_org), @sR5user, N'+'
			FROM   r5documents d,
				r5objects o
			WHERE  doc_code = @sNewwarranty
				AND    obj_obrtype IN ( N'A', N'S', N'P' )
				AND    obj_rstatus = N'I'
				AND  ( obj_code + N'#' +  obj_org ) IN
						( SELECT  child + N'#' + child_org FROM dbo.o7oxwaru_get_hierarchy1 (@sParent)
						UNION
						SELECT obj_code + N'#' + obj_org
						FROM   r5objects
						WHERE  obj_code = @sParent  )
				AND  ( obj_manufact = @sManufacturer OR @sManufacturer = N'%' )
				AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
				FROM   r5warcoverages w2
				WHERE  w2.wcv_object     = o.obj_code
				AND    w2.wcv_object_org = o.obj_org
				AND    w2.wcv_warranty   = @sNewwarranty
				AND    w2.wcv_active     = N'+'
				AND    w2.wcv_uom IS NULL )

			INSERT INTO r5warcoverages ( wcv_warranty, wcv_object, wcv_object_org,
				wcv_obtype, wcv_obrtype, wcv_duration, wcv_startdate, wcv_expirationdate,
				wcv_recorded, wcv_user, wcv_active )
			SELECT @sNewwarranty, obj_code, obj_org, obj_obtype, obj_obrtype,
				doc_duration, @dStartdate, @dStartdate + doc_duration,
				dbo.o7gttime2(obj_org), @sR5user, N'+'
			FROM   r5documents d,
				r5objects o
			WHERE  doc_code = @sNewwarranty
				AND    obj_obrtype IN ( N'A', N'S', N'P' )
				AND    obj_rstatus IN ( N'B', N'C' )
				AND  ( obj_location + N'#' +  obj_location_org ) IN
					(SELECT  parent + N'#' + parent_org FROM dbo.o7oxwaru_get_hierarchy2 (@sParent))
				AND  ( obj_manufact = @sManufacturer OR @sManufacturer = N'%' )
				AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
					FROM   r5warcoverages w2
					WHERE  w2.wcv_object     = o.obj_code
					AND    w2.wcv_object_org = o.obj_org
					AND    w2.wcv_warranty   = @sNewwarranty
					AND    w2.wcv_active     = N'+'
					AND    w2.wcv_uom IS NULL )
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			if @sNewwarranty <> N'%' AND @sWarranty <> N'%' 
				begin
					INSERT INTO r5warcoverages ( wcv_warranty, wcv_object, wcv_object_org,
						wcv_obtype, wcv_obrtype, wcv_duration, wcv_startdate, wcv_expirationdate,

						FROM   r5objects,
							r5documents,
							r5warcoverages

							AND  ( wcv_object + N'#' +wcv_object_org ) IN
								(SELECT  child + N'#' + child_org FROM dbo.o7oxwaru_get_hierarchy1 (@sParent)
								UNION

								FROM   r5objects

							AND  ( obj_manufact = @sManufacturer OR
							@sManufacturer = N'%' )
							AND    wcv_active = N'+'
							AND    wcv_uom IS NULL

							AND  ( obj_location + N'#' + obj_location_org ) IN
								(SELECT  parent + N'#' + parent_org FROM dbo.o7oxwaru_get_hierarchy2 (@sParent))
							AND  ( obj_manufact = @sManufacturer OR

							AND    wcv_active = N'+'

						AND    wcv_active = N'+'
						AND    wcv_uom IS NULL
						AND  ( wcv_object + N'#' + wcv_object_org ) IN
							(SELECT  child + N'#' + child_org FROM dbo.o7oxwaru_get_hierarchy1 (@sParent)
							UNION
							SELECT obj_code + N'#' + obj_org
							FROM   r5objects
							WHERE  obj_code = @sParent )

									AND    o.obj_rstatus = N'I'
									AND  ( obj_manufact  = @sManufacturer OR

								AND  ( obj_manufact  = @sManufacturer OR @sManufacturer  = N'%' ) )
				end
			else
				begin

					WHERE  ( wcv_object + N'#' +  wcv_object_org + N'#' + wcv_warranty ) IN

create function O7OXWARU_GET_HIERARCHY1 (	@sParent nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15), 
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
				stc_child_org, 
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent = @sParent					and 
				stc_childrtype IN ( N'A', N'S', N'P' )

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sParent = stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sParent, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sParent and stc_child_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
												stc_child_org, 
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_parent = @sParent					and 
												stc_parent_org = @sOrg					and
												stc_childrtype IN ( N'A', N'S', N'P' )
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7OZCHLL ( @sCode nvarchar(30),
                           @sOrg  nvarchar(15),
                           @sType nvarchar(4) )
returns @tReturn table( stc_parent     nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_parent_org nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_child      nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_child_org  nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_childtype  nvarchar(4) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        stc_node       nvarchar(3000) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
                        child_level    int  )
as
begin
    declare @nLevel     int
    declare @sParent    nvarchar(30)
    declare @sParentorg nvarchar(15)
    declare @sChildtype nvarchar(4)
    declare @sNode      nvarchar(3000)
            
    declare @tStack table ( stc_parent     nvarchar(30),
                            stc_parent_org nvarchar(15),
                            stc_child      nvarchar(30),
                            stc_child_org  nvarchar(15),
                            stc_childtype  nvarchar(4),
                            stc_node       nvarchar(3000),
                            LevelID        int )

/*NOTE:  SQL Server does not have an equivilant to SIBLING SORT.  So we need to keep
a string that has the hierarchy nodes.  This will allow us to sort on this string.
Only limitation is that the sort could fail if the heirarchy is extremely 
deep due to the limit on the string. */

    INSERT INTO @tStack 
    select  stc_parent,
            stc_parent_org,
            stc_child,
            stc_child_org,
            stc_childtype,
            '1/' + stc_parent ,
            1 
     from  r5structures
     where  stc_parent     = @sCode and
            stc_parent_org = @sOrg  and
            (
               (@sType =  N'%' AND stc_parentrtype IN ( N'A', N'P', N'S' )) or 
               (@sType <> N'%' AND stc_parenttype = @sType)
            )

    SET @nLevel = 1

    WHILE @nLevel > 0
        BEGIN
            IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                BEGIN
                    select  @sCode      = stc_child,
                            @sOrg       = stc_child_org,
                            @sParent    = stc_parent,
                            @sParentorg = stc_parent_org,
                            @sChildtype = stc_childtype,
                            @sNode = stc_node
                    from  @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
                    insert into @tReturn values ( @sParent, @sParentorg, @sCode, @sOrg, @sChildtype,  @sNode + '/' + cast(@nLevel + 1 as nvarchar(38)) + '/' + @sCode , @nLevel )
                    delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg AND stc_parent = @sParent and stc_parent_org = @sParentorg
                    insert into @tStack select stc_parent,
                                               stc_parent_org,
                                               stc_child,
                                               stc_child_org,
                                               stc_childtype,
                                               @sNode + '/' + cast(@nLevel + 1 as nvarchar(38)) + '/' + @sCode,
                                               @nLevel + 1
                                        from  r5structures
                                        where  stc_parent     = @sCode and
                                               stc_parent_org = @sOrg 
                    IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                        SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                END
            ELSE
                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
        end

    return
end

               WHERE csr_rentity = N'ACT'

               AND des_lang      = @sLang

               AND csr_strlevel1 = @sSystemcode

    if @sSource = N'ASS'

          SELECT @sText = des_text 
          FROM r5codestructure , r5descriptions
               where csr_rentity = N'ACT'

               AND des_lang      = @sLang
               AND des_code      = csr_code
               AND csr_strlevel2 = @sAsscode
       end

    if @sSource = N'COMP'
       begin
          SELECT @sText = des_text
          FROM r5codestructure, r5descriptions
               where csr_rentity = N'ACT'
               AND des_rentity   = N'CLVL'

RETURN ( '[ ' + RTRIM(@sText) + ' ]' )

CREATE function O7OZCSTL (        @sCtype        nvarchar(16),
                                @sIncode        nvarchar(30) )
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin

        declare @nLcost numeric(30,6)
        declare @sLhours NVARCHAR(4000)
        declare @nOutlhours numeric(30,6)

        declare @nHcost numeric(30,6)
        declare @sHhours NVARCHAR(4000)
        declare @nOuthhours numeric(30,6)

        declare @nMcost numeric(30,6)
        declare @sMhours NVARCHAR(4000)

        declare @nDcost numeric(30,6)
        declare @sDhours NVARCHAR(4000)

        declare @nPcost numeric(30,6)
        declare @sPhours NVARCHAR(4000)

        declare @nReturn        int
        declare @sDatabase        varchar(128)

        set @sDatabase = cast( DB_NAME() as varchar(128) )

        if @sCtype = N'LHRS' 
            begin
                    set @nLcost = 0.0
                    set @nHcost = 0.0
                    
                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7OZCSTL_O7ACTLAB', 'ORCSTL2', @sIncode, @nLcost OUTPUT, @sLhours OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            return -1

                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7OZCSTL_O7ACTHIR', 'ORCSTL2', @sIncode, @nHcost OUTPUT, @sHhours OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            return -1

                    set @nOutlhours = CAST(@sLhours as NUMERIC(30,6))
                    set @nOuthhours = CAST(@sHhours as NUMERIC(30,6))

                    return (isnull( @nOutlhours, 0.0 ) + isnull( @nOuthhours, 0.0 ))
            end

        if @sCtype = N'LCOST'
            begin
                    set @nLcost = 0.0
                    
                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7OZCSTL_O7ACTLAB', 'ORCSTL', @sIncode, @nLcost OUTPUT, @sLhours OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            return -1
                    
                    return @nLcost
            end

        if @sCtype = N'MCOST' 
            begin
                    set @nMcost = 0.0
                    set @nDcost = 0.0
                    set @nPcost = 0.0

                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7OZCSTL_O7ACTMAT', 'ORCSTL', @sIncode, @nMcost OUTPUT, @sMhours OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            return -1
                    
                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7OZCSTL_O7ACTDMA', 'ORCSTL', @sIncode, @nDcost OUTPUT, @sDhours OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            return -1

                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7OZCSTL_O7PIDDMA', 'ORCSTL', @sIncode, @nPcost OUTPUT, @sPhours OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            return -1

                    return ( isnull( @nMcost, 0.0 ) + isnull( @nDcost, 0.0 ) + isnull( @nPcost, 0.0 ) )
            end

        if @sCtype = N'SCOST' 
            begin
                    set @nMcost = 0.0
                    set @nDcost = 0.0

                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7OZCSTL_O7ACTHIR', 'ORCSTL', @sIncode, @nMcost OUTPUT, @sMhours OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            return -1
                    
                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7OZCSTL_O7ACTFIX', 'ORCSTL', @sIncode, @nDcost OUTPUT, @sDhours OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            return -1

                    return ( isnull( @nMcost, 0.0 ) + isnull( @nDcost, 0.0 ) )
            end

        if @sCtype = N'TCOST' 
            begin
                    set @nMcost = 0.0

                    execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7OZCSTL_O7ACTTOOL', 'ORCSTL', @sIncode, @nMcost OUTPUT, @sMhours OUTPUT
                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                            return -1

                    return @nMcost
            end

        return 0.0
end

create function O7OZCSTLTOTAL ( @sR5User             nvarchar(255),
                           @sR5Func             nvarchar(6),
                           @sR5Lang             nvarchar(2),
                           @sR5Org              nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelObjtp           nvarchar(4),
                           @sSelObj             nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelOrg             nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelMrc             nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelClass           nvarchar(8),
                           @sSelCategory        nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelLocation        nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelDateFrom        nvarchar(11),
                           @sSelDateTo          nvarchar(11),
                           @sSelReportingCurr   nvarchar(3),
                           @sSelActualCurrent   nvarchar(1),
                           @sSelGroup           nvarchar(1),
                           @sSelInclwo          nvarchar(1),
                           @sSelWoclass         nvarchar(8),
                           @sSelTrade           nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelStatus          nvarchar(4),
                           @sSelSubobj          nvarchar(1),
                           @sSelCostcode        nvarchar(30),
                           @r5role              nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( OZCSTL_GROUPBY       nvarchar(100) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        OZCSTL_EVTCODE       nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        OZCSTL_ROUTEPARENT   nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        OZCSTL_LABORHOURS    numeric(30,6),
                        OZCSTL_LABORCOST     numeric(30,6),
                        OZCSTL_SERVICECOST   numeric(30,6),
                        OZCSTL_MATERIALCOST  numeric(30,6),
                        OZCSTL_DIRECTCOST    numeric(30,6),
                        OZCSTL_TOOLCOST      numeric(30,6),
                        OZCSTL_TOTALCOST     numeric(30,6),
                        OZCSTL_SHOWERROR     numeric(30,6))

as
begin

    INSERT INTO @tReturn 
    SELECT CASE @sSelGroup 
           WHEN N'D' THEN 
                CASE WHEN OBJ_MRC IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE OBJ_MRC END 
           WHEN N'T' THEN 
                CASE WHEN ACT_TRADE IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE ACT_TRADE END 
           WHEN N'C' THEN 
                CASE WHEN OBJ_COSTCODE IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE OBJ_COSTCODE END 
           WHEN N'L' THEN 
                CASE WHEN OBJ_LOCATION IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE OBJ_LOCATION + '#' + OBJ_LOCATION_ORG END 
           ELSE OBJ_CODE + '#' + OBJ_ORG 
           END GROUPBY,
           E.EVT_CODE,
           E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'LHRS',E.EVT_CODE,E.EVT_ORG,T.ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) LABOR_HOURS,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'LCOST',E.EVT_CODE,E.EVT_ORG,T.ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) LABOR_COST,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'SCOST',E.EVT_CODE,E.EVT_ORG,T.ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) SERVICE_COST,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'MCOST',E.EVT_CODE,E.EVT_ORG,T.ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) MATERIAL_COST,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'DCOST',E.EVT_CODE,E.EVT_ORG,T.ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) DIRECT_COST,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'TCOST',E.EVT_CODE,E.EVT_ORG,T.ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) TOOL_COST ,
	   0 TOTAL_COST,
           SUM(DBO.REPGETVALIDEXCH(@sSelReportingCurr,E.EVT_ORG)) SHOW_ERR
    FROM   R5EVENTS E LEFT OUTER JOIN R5ACTIVITIES T ON E.EVT_CODE = T.ACT_EVENT INNER JOIN 
           R5EVENTOBJECTS A ON A.EOB_EVENT = E.EVT_CODE INNER JOIN 
           R5OBJECTS O ON O.OBJ_CODE = A.EOB_OBJECT AND O.OBJ_ORG = A.EOB_OBJECT_ORG 
           LEFT OUTER JOIN R5EVENTS V ON V.EVT_CODE = E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT
    WHERE  E.EVT_RTYPE IN (N'JOB', N'PPM') 
           AND E.EVT_ORG IN (SELECT UOG_ORG 
                             FROM  R5USERORGANIZATION,R5PERMISSIONS 
                             WHERE UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP 
                                   AND PRM_SELECT = N'?' 
                                   AND PRM_FUNCTION = @sR5Func 
                                   AND UOG_USER = @sR5User
                                   AND UOG_ROLE = @r5role
                            ) 
           AND (@sSelClass    = N'%' OR OBJ_CLASS LIKE @sSelClass) 
           AND (@sSelCategory = N'%' OR OBJ_CATEGORY LIKE @sSelCategory) 
           AND (@sSelCostcode = N'%' OR OBJ_COSTCODE LIKE @sSelCostcode) 
           AND (@sSelLocation = N'%' OR OBJ_LOCATION LIKE @sSelLocation) 
           AND OBJ_OBTYPE LIKE @sSelObjtp
           AND (OBJ_CODE LIKE @sSelObj  AND ((CHARINDEX(N'%',@sSelObj) = 0  AND @sSelSubobj <> N'+') OR EOB_LEVEL = 0)) 
           AND E.EVT_ORG LIKE @sSelOrg 
           AND (E.EVT_MRC LIKE @sSelMrc OR V.EVT_MRC LIKE @sSelMrc)
           AND E.EVT_STATUS LIKE @sSelStatus 
           AND (@sSelTrade    = N'%' OR ACT_TRADE LIKE @sSelTrade) 
           AND (@sSelWoclass  = N'%' OR E.EVT_CLASS LIKE @sSelWoclass) 
           AND ( 
                 @sSelInclwo = N'%'  OR 
                 (@sSelInclwo IN (N'C',N'R')  AND  E.EVT_RSTATUS = @sSelInclwo) OR 
                 (@sSelInclwo NOT IN (N'C',N'R') AND E.EVT_RSTATUS IN (N'R',N'C') ) OR
                 ( (@sSelInclwo IN (N'C',N'R') 
                                 AND V.EVT_RSTATUS = @sSelInclwo) 
                                 OR (@sSelInclwo NOT IN (N'C',N'R') 
                                 AND V.EVT_RSTATUS IN (N'R',N'C')) 
                   ) 
               ) 
           AND (@sSelDateFrom = N'%' OR SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), (CASE WHEN E.EVT_RSTATUS = 'C' THEN E.EVT_COMPLETED ELSE COALESCE(E.EVT_TARGET,E.EVT_REPORTED,E.EVT_DATE) END),120),1,10) >= @sSelDateFrom) 
           AND (@sSelDateTo   = N'%' OR SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), (CASE WHEN E.EVT_RSTATUS = 'C' THEN E.EVT_COMPLETED ELSE COALESCE(E.EVT_TARGET,E.EVT_REPORTED,E.EVT_DATE) END),120),1,10) <= @sSelDateTo ) 
           AND (
                  E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NULL OR 
                  (E.EVT_OBJECT <> V.EVT_OBJECT)  
               )
           AND (@sSelGroup <> N'T' OR  E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NULL)
    GROUP BY CASE @sSelGroup 
             WHEN N'D' THEN 
                  CASE WHEN OBJ_MRC IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE OBJ_MRC END 
             WHEN N'T' THEN 
                  CASE WHEN ACT_TRADE IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE ACT_TRADE END 
             WHEN N'C' THEN 
                  CASE WHEN OBJ_COSTCODE IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE OBJ_COSTCODE END 
             WHEN N'L' THEN 
                  CASE WHEN OBJ_LOCATION IS NULL THEN ' ' ELSE OBJ_LOCATION + '#' + OBJ_LOCATION_ORG END 
             ELSE OBJ_CODE + '#' + OBJ_ORG 
             END,
             E.EVT_CODE,E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT 
    UNION 
    SELECT OBJ_CODE + '#' + OBJ_ORG GROUPBY,
           EV.EVT_CODE,EV.EVT_ROUTEPARENT,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'LHRS',EV.EVT_CODE,EV.EVT_ORG,ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) CH_LABOR_HOURS,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'LCOST',EV.EVT_CODE,EV.EVT_ORG,ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) CH_LABOR_COST,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'SCOST',EV.EVT_CODE,EV.EVT_ORG,ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) CH_SERVICE_COST,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'MCOST',EV.EVT_CODE,EV.EVT_ORG,ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) CH_MATERIAL_COST,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'DCOST',EV.EVT_CODE,EV.EVT_ORG,ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) CH_DIRECT_COST,
           SUM(DBO.O7RPCSTL(N'TCOST',EV.EVT_CODE,EV.EVT_ORG,ACT_ACT,@sSelReportingCurr,@sSelActualCurrent)) CH_TOOL_COST,
	   0 TOTAL_COST ,
           SUM(DBO.REPGETVALIDEXCH(@sSelReportingCurr,EV.EVT_ORG)) SHOW_ERR
    FROM   R5EVENTS EV LEFT OUTER JOIN 
           R5ACTIVITIES T ON EV.EVT_CODE = T.ACT_EVENT INNER

name: O7OZHISL
tables: R5ACTIVITIES, R5ADDETAILS, R5DEPARTMENTSECURITY, R5EVENTOBJECTS, R5EVENTS, R5INSTALL, R5INVOICELINES, R5ORDERLINES, R5PARTS, R5PERMISSIONS, R5TOOLUSAGE, R5TRANSLINES, R5USERORGANIZATION
body:
create procedure O7OZHISL  @sR5User     nvarchar(255),
                           @sR5Func     nvarchar(6),
                           @sR5Lang     nvarchar(2),
                           @sR5Org      nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelObjtp   nvarchar(4),
                           @sSelObj     nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelOrg     nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelReqm    nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelFail    nvarchar(8),
                           @sSelCause   nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelAction  nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelLoc     nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelStart   nvarchar(11),
                           @sSelEnd     nvarchar(11),
                           @sSelEvent   nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelMeccb   nvarchar(1),
                           @sCurrUser   nvarchar(255),
                           @r5role      nvarchar(30)
as

    declare @sSelect        nvarchar( 4000 ) 
    declare @sFrom          nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereClause   nvarchar( 2000 ) 
    declare @sWhereCL1      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL2      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL3      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL4      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL5      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL6      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL7      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL8      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL9      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL10     nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sOrderBy       nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sStatement     nvarchar( MAX )
    declare @sParm          nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nReturn        int
    declare @deptsec        nvarchar(400)

    set  @sSelect        = ' ' 
    set  @sFrom          = ' '  
    set  @sWhereClause   = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL1      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL2      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL3      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL4      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL5      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL6      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL7      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL8      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL9      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL10     = ' ' 
    set  @sOrderBy       = ' ORDER BY EVT_COMPLETED,E.EVT_CODE '
    set  @sStatement     = ' ' 
    
    SELECT @deptsec=INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC'

    set @sFrom = ' R5EVENTS E '
    set @sWhereClause = ' E.EVT_RSTATUS = N''C'' AND E.EVT_JOBTYPE IS NOT NULL AND E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG IN  (SELECT UOG_ORG FROM R5USERORGANIZATION, R5PERMISSIONS WHERE UOG_USER = @sR5User AND UOG_ROLE = @r5role AND UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP AND PRM_FUNCTION = @sR5Func AND PRM_SELECT = N''?'') '
			+' AND ( ( '''+ @deptsec +'''= N''ON'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5DEPARTMENTSECURITY WHERE DSE_USER = @sR5User   AND DSE_MRC = E.EVT_MRC ) ) OR ( '''+ @deptsec  +'''= N''OFF'')) '
            
    IF @sR5User <> UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )
       SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND 1=0 '

    IF @sSelOrg <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL1 =  ' AND E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG like  @sSelOrg '

    IF  @sSelObjtp <> N'%' 
        IF @sSelObj <> N'%' 
           set  @sWhereCL2 = ' AND (E.EVT_CODE IN (SELECT EOB_EVENT FROM R5EVENTOBJECTS WHERE EOB_OBJECT like @sSelObj AND  EOB_OBTYPE like @sSelObjtp )) '
        ELSE
           set  @sWhereCL2 = ' AND E.EVT_OBTYPE like @sSelObjtp '
    ELSE
        IF @sSelObj <> N'%' 
           set  @sWhereCL2 = ' AND (E.EVT_CODE IN (SELECT EOB_EVENT FROM R5EVENTOBJECTS WHERE EOB_OBJECT LIKE @sSelObj )) '

    IF  @sSelLoc <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL3 = ' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DBO.F_GET_REPGETHIERPARENT_LOC_HIER(@sSelLoc, @sSelOrg, @sR5Org ) AS HIER WHERE HIER.LOC_CODE=E.EVT_LOCATION AND HIER.LOC_ORG=E.EVT_LOCATION_ORG)) '

    IF  @sSelMeccb <> N'+' 
        set  @sWhereCL4 = ' AND ( E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NULL  OR (CHARINDEX(''_'', @sSelEvent, 1) = 0 AND CHARINDEX(''%'', @sSelEvent, 1) = 0 ))'

    IF  @sSelReqm <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL5 = ' AND E.EVT_REQM LIKE @sSelReqm '

    IF  @sSelFail <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL6 = ' AND E.EVT_FAILURE LIKE @sSelFail '

    IF  @sSelCause <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL7 = ' AND E.EVT_CAUSE LIKE @sSelCause '

    IF @sSelAction <> N'%' 
       set  @sWhereCL8 = ' AND E.EVT_ACTION LIKE @sSelAction '

    IF @sSelEvent <> N'%' 
       set  @sWhereCL9 = ' AND ( E.EVT_CODE LIKE @sSelEvent OR (E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT = @sSelEvent AND @sSelMeccb = N''+''))'

    IF  @sSelStart <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL10 = @sWhereCL10 + ' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) >= @sSelStart '

    IF  @sSelEnd <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL10 = @sWhereCL10 + ' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) <= @sSelEnd '

    set @sSelect = N'SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) EVT_COMPLETED, ' +
                 N'E.EVT_CODE , ' +
                 N'(E.EVT_CODE + CASE WHEN E.EVT_MULTIEQUIP = N''+'' THEN '' ['' + DBO.REPGETTEXT(@sR5Func, @sR5Lang, 60) + '']'' WHEN E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NOT NULL THEN '' ['' + DBO.REPGETTEXT(@sR5Func, @sR5Lang , 61) + '']'' ELSE '''' END) EVT_DISPCODE , ' +
                 N'DBO.REPGETFMTDATELOCALE(@sR5User, @sR5Org, E.EVT_COMPLETED) EVTCOMPLETED ,' +
                 N'E.EVT_REQM, ' +
                 N'E.EVT_FAILURE ,' +
                 N'E.EVT_CAUSE,' +
                 N'E.EVT_ACTION,' +
                 N'E.EVT_DESC JDESC, ' +
		 N'(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5ACTIVITIES C WHERE  C.ACT_EVENT = E.EVT_CODE ) LABCNT, ' +
                 N'(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5ADDETAILS WHERE ADD_CODE= E.EVT_CODE AND ADD_RENTITY =''EVNT''  AND ADD_TYPE = ''+'' AND ADD_LANG = @sR5Lang) ADDCNTPLUS, ' +
                 N'(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5ADDETAILS WHERE ADD_CODE= E.EVT_CODE AND ADD_RENTITY =''EVNT''  AND ADD_TYPE = ''*'' AND ADD_LANG = @sR5Lang) ADDCNTSTAR, ' +
                 N'(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5TOOLUSAGE WHERE TOU_EVENT = E.EVT_CODE ) TOOLCNT, ' +
                 N'(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM R5TRANSLINES LEFT OUTER  JOIN R5PARTS ON PAR_CODE = TRL_PART  '+
	         N' AND PAR_ORG = TRL_PART_ORG INNER JOIN R5EVENTS A ON TRL_EVENT = A.EVT_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN R5ACTIVITIES ON ACT_EVENT = TRL_EVENT '+
	         N' AND ACT_ACT = TRL_ACT LEFT OUTER JOIN R5ORDERLINES ON ORL_ORDER = TRL_ORDER '+
		 N' AND ORL_ORDER_ORG = TRL_ORDER_ORG AND ORL_ORDLINE = TRL_ORDLINE LEFT OUTER JOIN R5INVOICELINES ON IVL_ORDER = ORL_ORDER '+
		 N' AND IVL_ORDER_ORG = ORL_ORDER_ORG 	AND IVL_ORDLINE = ORL_ORDLINE '+
		 N' WHERE (A.EVT_CODE = E.EVT_CODE OR A.EVT_ROUTEPARENT = E.EVT_CODE )) MATCNT, ' +
                 N'(CASE E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG WHEN @sR5Org THEN E.EVT_OBJECT ELSE E.EVT_OBJECT + '' ('' + E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG + '')'' END) DISP_OBJECT, ' +
                 N'DBO.REPGETDESC(@sR5Lang,N''OBJ'',E.EVT_OBJECT + N''#'' + E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG,NULL,NULL) OBJECT_DESC'

     set @sStatement = 'SELECT ' + @sSelect + ' FROM ' + @sFrom + ' WHERE ' + @sWhereClause + @sWhereCL1 + @sWhereCL2 + @sWhereCL3 + @sWhereCL4 + @sWhereCL5 + @sWhereCL6 + @sWhereCL7 + @sWhereCL8 + @sWhereCL9 + @sWhereCL10 + @sOrderBy
     set @sParm = N'@sR5User nvarchar(255), @sR5Func nvarchar(6), @sR5Lang nvarchar(2),'+
                  N'@sR5Org nvarchar(15), @sSelObjtp nvarchar(4), @sSelObj nvarchar(30),'+
                  N'@sSelOrg nvarchar(15), @sSelReqm nvarchar(15), @sSelFail nvarchar(8),'+
                  N'@sSelCause nvarchar(30), @sSelAction nvarchar(30), @sSelLoc nvarchar(30),'+
                  N'@sSelStart nvarchar(11), @sSelEnd nvarchar(11), @sSelEvent nvarchar(30),'+
                  N'@sSelMeccb nvarchar(1), @r5role nvarchar(30)'

     execute @nReturn =  sp_executesql @sStatement, @sParm, @sR5User, @sR5Func, @sR5Lang, @sR5Org, @sSelObjtp, @sSelObj, @sSelOrg, @sSelReqm, @sSelFail, @sSelCause, @sSelAction, @sSelLoc, @sSelStart, @sSelEnd, @sSelEvent, @sSelMeccb, @r5role
     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
            return

name: O7OZHISL_NOREC

body:
create procedure O7OZHISL_NOREC  @sR5User     nvarchar(255),
                           @sR5Func     nvarchar(6),
                           @sR5Lang     nvarchar(2),
                           @sR5Org      nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelObjtp   nvarchar(4),
                           @sSelObj     nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelOrg     nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelReqm    nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelFail    nvarchar(8),
                           @sSelCause   nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelAction  nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelLoc     nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelStart   nvarchar(11),
                           @sSelEnd     nvarchar(11),
                           @sSelEvent   nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelMeccb   nvarchar(1),
                           @sCurrUser   NVARCHAR( 255 ),
                           @r5role      nvarchar(30)
as

    declare @sFrom          nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereClause   nvarchar( 2000 ) 
    declare @sWhereCL1      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL2      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL3      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL4      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL5      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL6      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL7      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL8      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL9      nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sWhereCL10     nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sOrderBy       nvarchar(500) 
    declare @sStatement     nvarchar( MAX )
    declare @sParm          nvarchar(4000)
    declare @nReturn        int
    declare @deptsec        nvarchar(400)

    SELECT @deptsec=INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC'


    set  @sFrom          = ' '  
    set  @sWhereClause   = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL1      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL2      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL3      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL4      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL5      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL6      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL7      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL8      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL9      = ' ' 
    set  @sWhereCL10     = ' ' 
    set  @sOrderBy       = ' ORDER BY EVT_COMPLETED,E.EVT_CODE '
    set  @sStatement     = ' ' 

    set @sFrom = ' R5EVENTS E '
    set @sWhereClause = ' E.EVT_RSTATUS = N''C'' AND E.EVT_JOBTYPE IS NOT NULL AND E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG IN  (SELECT UOG_ORG FROM R5USERORGANIZATION, R5PERMISSIONS WHERE UOG_USER = @sR5User AND UOG_ROLE = @r5role AND UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP AND PRM_FUNCTION = @sR5Func AND PRM_SELECT = N''?'') '
			+' AND ( ( '''+ @deptsec +'''= N''ON'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM R5DEPARTMENTSECURITY WHERE DSE_USER = @sR5User   AND DSE_MRC = E.EVT_MRC ) ) OR ( '''+ @deptsec  +''' = N''OFF'')) '
            
    IF @sR5User <> UPPER( COALESCE( @sCurrUser, '#' ) )
       SET @sWhereClause = @sWhereClause + ' AND 1=0 '

    IF @sSelOrg <> N'%' 
       set  @sWhereCL1 =  ' AND E.EVT_OBJECT_ORG like  @sSelOrg '

    IF  @sSelObjtp <> N'%' 
        IF @sSelObj <> N'%' 
           set  @sWhereCL2 = ' AND (E.EVT_CODE IN (SELECT EOB_EVENT FROM R5EVENTOBJECTS WHERE EOB_OBJECT like @sSelObj AND  EOB_OBTYPE like @sSelObjtp )) '
        ELSE
           set  @sWhereCL2 = ' AND E.EVT_OBTYPE like @sSelObjtp '
    ELSE
        IF @sSelObj <> N'%' 
           set  @sWhereCL2 = ' AND (E.EVT_CODE IN (SELECT EOB_EVENT FROM R5EVENTOBJECTS WHERE EOB_OBJECT LIKE @sSelObj )) '

    IF  @sSelLoc <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL3 = ' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM DBO.F_GET_REPGETHIERPARENT_LOC_HIER(@sSelLoc, @sSelOrg, @sR5Org ) AS HIER WHERE HIER.LOC_CODE=E.EVT_LOCATION AND HIER.LOC_ORG=E.EVT_LOCATION_ORG)) '

    IF  @sSelMeccb <> N'+' 
        set  @sWhereCL4 = ' AND ( E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NULL  OR (CHARINDEX(''_'', @sSelEvent, 1) = 0 AND CHARINDEX(''%'', @sSelEvent, 1) = 0 ))'

    IF  @sSelReqm <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL5 = ' AND E.EVT_REQM LIKE @sSelReqm '

    IF  @sSelFail <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL6 = ' AND E.EVT_FAILURE LIKE @sSelFail '

    IF  @sSelCause <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL7 = ' AND E.EVT_CAUSE LIKE @sSelCause '

    IF @sSelAction <> N'%' 
       set  @sWhereCL8 = ' AND E.EVT_ACTION LIKE @sSelAction '

    IF @sSelEvent <> N'%' 
       set  @sWhereCL9 = ' AND ( E.EVT_CODE LIKE @sSelEvent OR (E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT = @sSelEvent AND @sSelMeccb = N''+''))'

    IF  @sSelStart <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL10 = @sWhereCL10 + ' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) >= @sSelStart '

    IF  @sSelEnd <> N'%' 
        set  @sWhereCL10 = @sWhereCL10 + ' AND SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) <= @sSelEnd '

     set @sStatement = 'SELECT DUMMY FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ' + @sFrom + ' WHERE ' + @sWhereClause + @sWhereCL1 + @sWhereCL2 + @sWhereCL3 + @sWhereCL4 + @sWhereCL5 + @sWhereCL6 + @sWhereCL7 + @sWhereCL8 + @sWhereCL9 + @sWhereCL10 + ' ) '
     set @sParm = N'@sR5User nvarchar(255), @sR5Func nvarchar(6), @sR5Lang nvarchar(2),'+
                  N'@sR5Org nvarchar(15), @sSelObjtp nvarchar(4), @sSelObj nvarchar(30),'+
                  N'@sSelOrg nvarchar(15), @sSelReqm nvarchar(15), @sSelFail nvarchar(8),'+
                  N'@sSelCause nvarchar(30), @sSelAction nvarchar(30), @sSelLoc nvarchar(30),'+
                  N'@sSelStart nvarchar(11), @sSelEnd nvarchar(11), @sSelEvent nvarchar(30),'+
                  N'@sSelMeccb nvarchar(1), @r5role NVARCHAR(30)'

     execute @nReturn =  sp_executesql @sStatement, @sParm, @sR5User, @sR5Func, @sR5Lang, @sR5Org, @sSelObjtp, @sSelObj, @sSelOrg, @sSelReqm, @sSelFail, @sSelCause, @sSelAction, @sSelLoc, @sSelStart, @sSelEnd, @sSelEvent, @sSelMeccb, @r5role
     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
        begin
            return -1
        end

CREATE FUNCTION O7OZLCOLTOTAL(@sR5User             nvarchar(255),
                           @sR5Func             nvarchar(6),
                           @sSelOrg             nvarchar(15),
                           @sR5Org              nvarchar(15),
                           @sSelLocation        nvarchar(30),
                           @sSelDateFrom        nvarchar(11),
                           @sSelDateTo          nvarchar(11),
                           @sSelLocclass        nvarchar(8),
                           @r5role              nvarchar(30))

returns @tReturn table( OZLCOL_EVTCODE       nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        OZLCOL_ROUTEPARENT   nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        OZLCOL_LABORHOURS    numeric(30,6),
                        OZLCOL_LABORCOST     numeric(30,6),
                        OZLCOL_MATERIALCOST  numeric(30,6),
                        OZLCOL_TOOLCOST      numeric(30,6),
                        OZLCOL_TOTALCOST     numeric(30,6))
                        
as
begin

    INSERT INTO @tReturn 
        SELECT 
        E1.EVT_CODE, 
        E1.EVT_ROUTEPARENT,
        DBO.O7COST_HOURS(E1.EVT_CODE) HOURS,
        DBO.O7COST_LABOUR(E1.EVT_CODE) LABOUR,
        DBO.O7COST_MATERIAL(E1.EVT_CODE) MATERIAL,
        DBO.O7COST_TOOLS(E1.EVT_CODE) TOOLS,
        0 TOTALCOST
        FROM R5EVENTS E1
        WHERE  ( @sSelDateFrom  = N'%' OR SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), E1.EVT_COMPLETED, 120), 1, 10) >= @sSelDateFrom )
        AND   ( @sSelDateTo = N'%' OR SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), E1.EVT_COMPLETED, 120), 1, 10) <= @sSelDateTo )
        AND   E1.EVT_LOCATION IS NOT NULL
        AND   E1.EVT_JOBTYPE IS NOT NULL
        AND   E1.EVT_JOBTYPE NOT IN 
                       (SELECT U.UCO_CODE 
                        FROM R5UCODES U
                        WHERE U.UCO_RCODE IN ( N'IS', N'RP' )
                        AND U.UCO_RENTITY = N'JBTP' )
        AND   E1.EVT_RTYPE IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
        AND   E1.EVT_RSTATUS = N'C'
        AND   ( @sSelLocclass = N'%' OR E1.EVT_LOCATION + '#' + E1.EVT_LOCATION_ORG IN
                                             ( SELECT L.LOC_CODE + '#' + L.LOC_ORG
                                                FROM DBO.REPGET_CLASS_LOC_HIER (@sSelLocclass) L ) 
               )
        AND   ( @sSelLocation = N'%' OR E1.EVT_LOCATION IN  
                                                          ( SELECT L.LOC_CODE 
                                                                FROM DBO.REPGET_LOCORG_HIER (@sSelLocation, @sSelOrg, @sSelOrg) L
                                                           )
               )
        AND ( @sSelOrg = N'%' OR E1.EVT_OBJECT_ORG LIKE @sSelOrg )
        AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 
                            FROM R5USERORGANIZATION, R5PERMISSIONS
                            WHERE UOG_ORG = EVT_OBJECT_ORG
                            AND UOG_GROUP= PRM_GROUP
                            AND UOG_USER = @sR5User
                            AND UOG_ROLE = @r5role
                            AND PRM_FUNCTION = @sR5Func 
                            AND PRM_SELECT = N'?' )
        AND ((E1.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NULL AND E1.EVT_PARENT IS NULL ) 
                        OR (E1.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NOT NULL 
                                AND E1.EVT_LOCATION NOT IN (SELECT 
                        E.EVT_LOCATION 
        FROM R5EVENTS E
        WHERE E.EVT_CODE = E1.EVT_ROUTEPARENT
        )))

        UPDATE @tReturn SET OZLCOL_TOTALCOST = OZLCOL_LABORCOST + OZLCOL_MATERIALCOST + OZLCOL_TOOLCOST

        UPDATE @tReturn SET OZLCOL_LABORHOURS = 0 ,
                        OZLCOL_LABORCOST = 0,
                        OZLCOL_MATERIALCOST = 0,
                        OZLCOL_TOOLCOST = 0,
                        OZLCOL_TOTALCOST = 0
                WHERE OZLCOL_ROUTEPARENT IS NOT NULL AND OZLCOL_ROUTEPARENT IN (SELECT OZLCOL_EVTCODE FROM @tReturn)

RETURN
END

create function O7OZOBJF_OBJ_HIER (        @sCode  nvarchar(30),
                                           @sOrg   nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( obj_parent              nvarchar(30)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        obj_parent_org          nvarchar(15)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        obj_code                nvarchar(50)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
as
begin
        declare @nLevel                 int
        declare @sParentCode            nvarchar(30)
        declare @sParentOrg             nvarchar(15)
        declare @sChildCode             nvarchar(30)
        declare @sChildOrg              nvarchar(15)

        declare @tStack table ( obj_parent              nvarchar(30),
                                obj_parent_org          nvarchar(15),
                                obj_code                nvarchar(30),
                                obj_org                 nvarchar(15),
                                LevelID                 int )
        INSERT INTO @tStack 
                select  obj_parent,
                        obj_parent_org,
                        obj_code,
                        obj_org,
                               1
                  from  r5objects
                  where obj_code        like CASE WHEN @sCode = N'%' THEN N'$' ELSE @sCode END and
                        obj_org         like @sOrg

        SET @nLevel = 1

        WHILE @nLevel > 0
                BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                                BEGIN
                                        select  @sChildCode          = obj_code,
                                                @sChildOrg           = obj_org,
                                                @sParentCode         = obj_parent,
                                                @sParentOrg          = obj_parent_org
                                         from   @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
                                         insert into @tReturn values ( @sParentCode, @sParentOrg, @sChildCode + N'#'+ @sChildOrg)
                                         delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel and obj_code = @sChildCode and obj_org = @sChildOrg and obj_parent = @sParentCode and obj_parent_org = @sParentOrg 
                                         insert into @tStack     select  obj_parent,
                                                                         obj_parent_org,
                                                                         obj_code,
                                                                         obj_org,
                                                                         @nLevel + 1
                                                                  from   r5objects
                                                                  where  obj_parent        = @sChildCode and
                                                                         obj_parent_org    = @sChildOrg
                                        IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                                END
                        ELSE
                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
                END

        return
end

create function O7OZOBJF_STC_HIER (     @sParent       nvarchar(30),
                                        @sParentRtype  nvarchar(4),
                                        @sSelOrg       nvarchar(15),
                                        @sR5Org        nvarchar(15))
returns @tReturn table( stc_child               nvarchar(50)    COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
as
begin
        declare @nLevel                 int
        declare @sCode          nvarchar(30)
        declare @sOrg           nvarchar(15)

        if @sSelOrg <> '%' set @sOrg = @sSelOrg else set @sOrg = @sR5Org

        declare @tStack table ( stc_child               nvarchar(30), 
                                stc_child_org           nvarchar(15),
                                LevelID                  int )

        INSERT INTO @tStack 
                select  stc_child, 
                        stc_child_org,
                                     1
                  from  r5structures
                  where stc_parent       like CASE WHEN @sParent = N'%' THEN N'$' ELSE @sParent END  and
                        stc_parent_org   = @sOrg and
                        stc_parentrtype  = @sParentRtype

        SET @nLevel = 1

        WHILE @nLevel > 0
                BEGIN
                        IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
                                BEGIN
                                        select  @sCode  = stc_child,
                                                @sOrg   = stc_child_org
                                        from    @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
                                        insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode + N'#' + @sOrg )
                                        delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg
                                        insert into @tStack     select  stc_child, 
                                                                        stc_child_org,
                                                                        @nLevel + 1
                                                                from    r5structures
                                                                where   stc_parent      = @sCode and
                                                                        stc_parent_org  = @sOrg 
                                        IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
                                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
                                END
                        ELSE
                                SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
                END

        return
end

Create function O7OZOCOLTOTAL ( @sR5User             nvarchar(255),
                                @sR5Func             nvarchar(6),
                                @sR5Lang             nvarchar(2),
                                @sSelCurrency        nvarchar(3),
                                @sSelDateFrom        nvarchar(11),
                                @sSelDateTo          nvarchar(11),
                                @sSelMrc             nvarchar(15),
                                @sSelObj             nvarchar(30),
                                @sSelObjtp           nvarchar(4),
                                @sSelOrg             nvarchar(15),
                                @r5role              nvarchar(30))

returns @tReturn table( OZOCOL_EVTCODE       nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        OZOCOL_ROUTEPARENT   nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
                        OZOCOL_LABORHOURS    numeric(30,6),
                        OZOCOL_LABORCOST     numeric(30,6),
                        OZOCOL_MATERIALCOST  numeric(30,6),
                        OZOCOL_TOOLCOST      numeric(30,6),
                        OZOCOL_TOTALCOST     numeric(30,6),
                        OZOCOL_SHOWERROR     numeric(30,6))

as
begin

    INSERT INTO @tReturn 
          SELECT 
          EVT_CODE,EVT_ROUTEPARENT,
          DBO.O7COST_HOURS(EVT_CODE) HOURS,
         (DBO.O7COST_LABOUR(EVT_CODE) * (CASE WHEN ( @sSelCurrency = DBO.REPORGDEFCUR(E.EVT_ORG)) THEN 1 ELSE ISNULL(DBO.REPGTEXCH(CASE WHEN  @sSelCurrency = N'%' THEN (Select INS_DESC From R5INSTALL Where INS_CODE = N'DEFCURR') ELSE  @sSelCurrency END, E.EVT_ORG, NULL),1) END)) LABOUR,
         (DBO.O7COST_MATERIAL(EVT_CODE) * (CASE WHEN ( @sSelCurrency = DBO.REPORGDEFCUR(E.EVT_ORG)) THEN 1 ELSE ISNULL(DBO.REPGTEXCH(CASE WHEN  @sSelCurrency = N'%' THEN (Select INS_DESC From R5INSTALL Where INS_CODE = N'DEFCURR') ELSE  @sSelCurrency END, E.EVT_ORG, NULL),1) END)) MATERIAL,
         (DBO.O7COST_TOOLS(EVT_CODE) * (CASE WHEN ( @sSelCurrency = DBO.REPORGDEFCUR(E.EVT_ORG)) THEN 1 ELSE ISNULL(DBO.REPGTEXCH(CASE WHEN  @sSelCurrency = N'%' THEN (Select INS_DESC From R5INSTALL Where INS_CODE = N'DEFCURR') ELSE  @sSelCurrency END, E.EVT_ORG, NULL),1) END)) TOOLS,
         0,
         DBO.REPGETVALIDEXCH( @sSelCurrency, E.EVT_ORG) SHOW_ERROR 
         FROM 
         R5EVENTS E,
         R5EVENTOBJECTS EO 
         WHERE E.EVT_CODE = EO.EOB_EVENT 
               AND E.EVT_RSTATUS = N'C' 
               AND E.EVT_RTYPE IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' ) 
               AND EO.EOB_ROLLUP = N'+' 
               AND ( @sSelCurrency = N'%' 
                     OR (CHARINDEX(N'_', @sSelCurrency, 1) = 0 
                     AND CHARINDEX(N'%', @sSelCurrency, 1) = 0 ) ) 
               AND (EO.EOB_OBTYPE LIKE  @sSelObjtp) 
               AND (EO.EOB_OBJECT LIKE  @sSelObj) 
               AND (E.EVT_ORG LIKE  @sSelOrg)  
               AND (E.EVT_MRC LIKE  @sSelMrc)  
               AND (  @sSelDateFrom = N'%' OR SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), E.EVT_COMPLETED, 120), 1, 10) >=  @sSelDateFrom ) 
               AND ( @sSelDateTo = N'%'    OR SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), E.EVT_COMPLETED, 120), 1, 10) <= @sSelDateTo ) 
               AND EO.EOB_LEVEL = (SELECT 
                                  MAX(EO1.EOB_LEVEL) 
                                  FROM 	R5EVENTOBJECTS EO1 
                                  WHERE EO1.EOB_EVENT = E.EVT_CODE 
                                  AND EO1.EOB_OBJECT LIKE @sSelObj
                                  ) 
               AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 
                          FROM 	R5USERORGANIZATION,R5PERMISSIONS 
                          WHERE UOG_ORG = E.EVT_ORG 
                                AND UOG_GROUP= PRM_GROUP 
                                AND UOG_USER =  @sR5User 
                                AND UOG_ROLE =  @r5role 
                                AND PRM_FUNCTION =  @sR5Func 
                                AND PRM_SELECT = N'?' 
                         ) 
              AND ((E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NULL AND E.EVT_PARENT IS NULL) 
                   OR (E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NOT NULL 
                   AND EO.EOB_OBJECT NOT IN (SELECT E1.EVT_OBJECT 
                                             FROM R5EVENTS E1 
                                             where E1.EVT_CODE = E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT )
                      )
                  )

    UPDATE @tReturn SET  OZOCOL_TOTALCOST     = OZOCOL_LABORCOST+OZOCOL_MATERIALCOST+OZOCOL_TOOLCOST

    UPDATE @tReturn SET  OZOCOL_LABORHOURS    = 0,
                         OZOCOL_LABORCOST     = 0,
                         OZOCOL_MATERIALCOST  = 0,
                         OZOCOL_TOOLCOST      = 0,
                         OZOCOL_TOTALCOST     = 0
    WHERE OZOCOL_ROUTEPARENT IS NOT NULL AND OZOCOL_ROUTEPARENT IN (SELECT OZOCOL_EVTCODE FROM @tReturn)

    return
end

                        OZOCST_NOOFJOBS      numeric(30,6),
                        OZOCST_TOTALCOST     numeric(30,6),
                        OZOCST_ERRORCODE     int)

as
begin

    declare @sObtype        nvarchar(4)
    declare @sObject        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sObjectorg     nvarchar(15)
    declare @sClass         nvarchar(8)
    declare @sCategory      nvarchar(30)
    declare @sManufacture   nvarchar(45)
    declare @nServicecost   numeric(30,6)
    declare @nLaborcost     numeric(30,6)
    declare @nMaterialcost  numeric(30,6)
    declare @nToolcost      numeric(30,6)
    declare @nLaborhours    numeric(30,6)
    declare @nNoofjobs      numeric(30,6)
    declare @nTotalcost     numeric(30,6)
    declare @nTotal1        numeric(30,6)
    declare @nTotal         numeric(30,6)
    declare @nErrorcode     int
    declare @nExchangeRate  numeric(30,6)
    declare @nMinCost       numeric(30,6)
    declare @deptsec        nvarchar(400)

    SELECT @deptsec=INS_DESC FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = 'DEPTSEC'

    declare c_record cursor local for 
    SELECT  EOB_OBTYPE,
            EOB_OBJECT,
            EOB_OBJECT_ORG,
            ISNULL(OBJ_CLASS,' ') OBJ_CLASS,
            ISNULL(OBJ_CATEGORY,' ') OBJ_CATEGORY,
            ISNULL(OBJ_MANUFACT,' ') OBJ_MANUFACT,
            DBO.REPACTFIXCOST(N'EVT',E.EVT_CODE)+DBO.REPACTHIRCOST(N'EVT2',E.EVT_CODE) TMPSVC,
            DBO.REPACTLABCOST(N'EVT2',E.EVT_CODE) TMPLAB,
            DBO.REPMATERIAL(E.EVT_CODE) TMPMAT,
            DBO.REPTOOLS(E.EVT_CODE) TMPTOOL,
            DBO.REPHOURS(E.EVT_CODE) TMPHOURS,
            CASE WHEN @sSelReportingcurr = DBO.REPORGDEFCUR(E.EVT_ORG) THEN 1 
            ELSE DBO.REPGETEXCHANGERATE(@sSelReportingcurr,E.EVT_ORG,
            CASE WHEN @sSelActualCurrent = N'A'  THEN isnull(E.EVT_COMPLETED,E.EVT_DATE) 
            ELSE DBO.REPGTTIME(E.EVT_ORG) END) 
            END EXCHANGERATE,
            CASE WHEN @sSelMincost= N'%' THEN 0 ELSE CAST(@sSelMincost AS numeric(30,6)) END MINCOST
            FROM    R5EVENTS E 
                    INNER JOIN R5EVENTOBJECTS ON E.EVT_CODE = R5EVENTOBJECTS.EOB_EVENT 
                    INNER JOIN R5OBJECTS ON R5OBJECTS.OBJ_CODE = R5EVENTOBJECTS.EOB_OBJECT
                    AND R5OBJECTS.OBJ_ORG= R5EVENTOBJECTS.EOB_OBJECT_ORG 
                    LEFT OUTER JOIN R5EVENTS V ON V.EVT_CODE = E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT 
            WHERE   OBJ_ORG in (SELECT UOG_ORG FROM R5USERORGANIZATION , R5PERMISSIONS  
                                    WHERE UOG_GROUP = PRM_GROUP AND 
                                          PRM_SELECT = N'?' AND 
                                          UOG_USER = @sR5User AND 
                                          UOG_ROLE = @r5role AND
                                          PRM_FUNCTION = @sR5Func) 
		    AND ( ( @deptsec  = N'ON' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 
					FROM R5DEPARTMENTSECURITY
                                        WHERE DSE_USER = @sR5User  AND DSE_MRC = E.EVT_MRC ) ) 
                                             OR
                                     ( @deptsec  = N'OFF'))


                    AND    E.EVT_RSTATUS = N'C' 
                    AND    E.EVT_JOBTYPE IS NOT NULL
                    AND    R5EVENTOBJECTS.EOB_OBRTYPE <> N'I'
                    AND    R5EVENTOBJECTS.EOB_ROLLUP = N'+'
                    AND    (
                              @sSelReportingcurr = N'%' OR 
                              (CHARINDEX(N'_',@sSelReportingcurr, 1) = 0  AND 
                              CHARINDEX(N'%',@sSelReportingcurr, 1) = 0 ) 
                           ) 
                    AND    R5EVENTOBJECTS.EOB_LEVEL = (SELECT MAX(EOL.EOB_LEVEL) 
                                                       FROM R5EVENTOBJECTS EOL
                                                       WHERE EOL.EOB_EVENT= E.EVT_CODE AND  
                                                             EOL.EOB_OBTYPE LIKE @sSelObjtp AND 
                                                             EOL.EOB_OBJECT LIKE @sSelObj   AND 
                                                             EOL.EOB_OBJECT_ORG LIKE @sSelOrg
                                                       )
                    AND E.EVT_MRC LIKE @sSelMrc
                    AND ( @sSelClass    = N'%'  OR OBJ_CLASS LIKE @sSelClass)
                    AND ( @sSelCategory = N'%'  OR OBJ_CATEGORY LIKE @sSelCategory)
                    AND ((@sSelLocation = N'%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 
                                                           FROM DBO.F_GET_REPGETHIERPARENT_LOC_HIER(@sSelLocation, @sSelOrg, @sR5Org ) as HIER 
                                                           WHERE HIER.LOC_CODE = E.EVT_LOCATION and HIER.LOC_ORG = E.EVT_LOCATION_ORG )) 
                    AND OBJ_ORG LIKE @sSelOrg
                    AND (@sSelDateFrom  = N'%' OR SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) >= @sSelDateFrom)
                    AND (@sSelDateTo    = N'%' OR SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),E.EVT_COMPLETED,120),1,10) <= @sSelDateTo)
                    AND (E.EVT_ROUTEPARENT IS NULL AND E.EVT_PARENT IS NULL OR (@sSelObj <> '%' AND EOB_OBJECT <> V.EVT_OBJECT)) 
    open c_record

    fetch next from c_record into @sObtype,@sObject,@sObjectorg,@sClass,@sCategory,@sManufacture,@nServicecost,@nLaborcost,@nMaterialcost,@nToolcost,@nLaborhours,@nExchangeRate,@nMinCost
    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    begin
       set @nTotal1    = isnull(@nServicecost,0)+isnull(@nLaborcost,0)+isnull(@nMaterialcost,0)+isnull(@nToolcost,0)
       set @nTotal     = (isnull(@nServicecost,0)+isnull(@nLaborcost,0)+isnull(@nMaterialcost,0)+isnull(@nToolcost,0))* isnull(@nExchangeRate,0)
       if (@nTotal >= @nMinCost or @nMinCost = 0)
       begin
           if @nTotal1 > 0 AND @nExchangeRate IS NULL 
           begin
              set @nServicecost   = 0
              set @nLaborcost     = 0
              set @nMaterialcost  = 0
              set @nToolcost      = 0
              set @nLaborhours    = 0
              set @nNoofjobs

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PARFND   
	@sPart            nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sPartorg         nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@sErrsource       nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@sErrtype         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sChk              nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sPartfind        nvarchar(30) --r5objects.obj_part%type
	declare @sPartorgfind     nvarchar(15) --r5objects.obj_part_org%type
	declare @nCount           int
   
BEGIN
	set @sErrsource     = N'O7PARFND'
	set @sErrtype       = N'PROC'
	set @sChk            = N'0'
	set @nCount         = 0

	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5parts
	WHERE  par_code = @sPart
	AND    par_org  = @sPartorg

	IF @nCount <> 0 
		RETURN

	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5objects,
   		r5findprofile
	WHERE  obj_code = fpf_profile
	AND    obj_org  = fpf_profile_org
	AND    fpf_code = @sPart


	If @nCount > 0 
		begin

			SELECT	@sPartfind = obj_part,
					@sPartorgfind = obj_part_org
			FROM	r5objects,
   					r5findprofile
			WHERE	obj_code = fpf_profile
				AND	obj_org  = fpf_profile_org
				AND	fpf_code = @sPart

			IF @sPartfind is not null 
				begin
					set @sPart    = @sPartfind
					set @sPartorg = @sPartorgfind
				end
		end
	else
		RETURN
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7PARINT_CHECK_COMMODITY
               (@sUser      NVARCHAR(255)
               ,@sOrg       NVARCHAR(15)
               ,@sCommodity NVARCHAR(15)
               ,@sMultiOrg  NVARCHAR(10)) RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @nReturn BIT
SET @nReturn = 0
IF @sMultiOrg = N'YES'
   BEGIN
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
                FROM r5commodities
                    ,r5userorganization
               WHERE cmd_code = @sCommodity
                 AND cmd_org = uog_org
                 AND uog_user = @sUser
                 AND (uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @sOrg)
				 AND    coalesce( cmd_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')
      SET @nReturn = 1
   END
ELSE
   BEGIN
   IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5commodities WHERE cmd_code = @sCommodity AND    coalesce( cmd_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')
      SET @nReturn = 1
   END
RETURN @nReturn
END

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7PARINT_CHECK_PROFILE_INFO
                 @nINTTransId   NUMERIC(18, 0)
                ,@sUser         NVARCHAR(255)
                ,@sOrg          NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sDefOrg       NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sPAIOrg       NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sPAITransType NVARCHAR(4)
                ,@sPAIProfClass NVARCHAR(8)
                ,@sPAIProfMRC   NVARCHAR(15)
                ,@sPAIProfManu  NVARCHAR(24)
                ,@sErrCheck     NVARCHAR(10) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @sParam1 NVARCHAR(250)
       ,@nReturn INT
SET @sErrCheck = N'0'
IF @sPAIProfManu IS NOT NULL
   IF dbo.O7PARINT_CHECK_MANUFACT(@sUser, ISNULL(@sPAIOrg, @sDefOrg), @sPAIProfManu, dbo.O7GETMOS(N'MANU')) = 0
      BEGIN
		  SET @sErrCheck = N'1'
		  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'27', N'O7PARINT', N'PROC', NULL, @sPAIProfManu, NULL, NULL
		  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
      END
IF @sPAIProfMRC IS NULL AND @sPAITransType = N'A'
   BEGIN
	   SET @sErrCheck = N'2'
	   EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'47', N'O7PARINT', N'PROC', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL
	   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		  return -1
	   RETURN
   END

IF @sPAIProfMRC IS NOT NULL
   BEGIN
   IF dbo.O7GETMOS(N'MRC') = N'+'
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                       FROM r5mrcs
                           ,r5userorganization
                      WHERE mrc_code = @sPAIProfMRC
                        AND mrc_org = ISNULL(@sPAIOrg, @sDefOrg)
                        AND mrc_org = uog_org
                        AND uog_user = @sUser
                        AND (uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @sOrg)
				        AND    coalesce( mrc_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')
         SET @sErrCheck = N'3'
   ELSE
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5mrcs WHERE mrc_code = @sPAIProfMRC AND    coalesce( mrc_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')
         SET @sErrCheck = N'3'
   IF @sErrCheck = N'3'
	  begin
		  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'25', N'O7PARINT', N'PROC', NULL, @sPAIProfMRC, NULL, NULL
		  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
	  end
   END

IF @sPAIProfClass IS NOT NULL
   BEGIN
   IF dbo.O7GETMOS(N'CLAS') = N'+'
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
                       FROM r5classes
                           ,r5userorganization
                      WHERE cls_rentity = N'OBJ'
                        AND cls_code = @sPAIProfClass
                        AND cls_org = ISNULL(@sPAIOrg, @sDefOrg)
                        AND cls_org = uog_org
                        AND uog_user = @sUser
                        AND (uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @sOrg)
						AND coalesce( cls_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')
         SET @sErrCheck = N'4'
   ELSE
      IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5classes WHERE cls_rentity = N'OBJ' AND cls_code = @sPAIProfClass AND coalesce( cls_notused, N'-' ) = N'-')
         SET @sErrCheck = N'4'
   IF @sErrCheck = N'4'
      BEGIN
		  SET @sParam1 = ISNULL(@sPAIOrg,@sDefOrg)
		  EXECUTE @nReturn = dbo.O7INTERFACE_INTERR @nINTTransId, N'26', N'O7PARINT', N'PROC', @sPAIProfClass, @sParam1, NULL, NULL
		  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			  return -1
      END
   END
END

create function O7PENQTY( @sOrder       nvarchar(30),
                          @sOrderOrg    nvarchar(15), 
                          @nOrderline   numeric(8),
                          @sDockCode    nvarchar(30))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
    declare @nPendqty   numeric(30,6)
    declare @nSmrecvqty numeric(30,6)
    declare @nDck_qty   numeric(30,6)
    declare @sRecvauto  nvarchar(5)
    declare @sPartuom   nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrlpuruom nvarchar(30)
    declare @nConfactor numeric(10,4)
    declare @nRecvQty   numeric(30,6)

    set @nPendqty = 0
     
    set @sRecvauto = UPPER( dbo.O7DFLT2( N'RECVAUTO' ) )

    if @sRecvauto = N'YES' OR @sRecvauto = N'ON'
        begin
            SELECT  @nDck_qty = coalesce( SUM(coalesce(dkl_countqty + coalesce(dkl_scrapqty,0), dkl_recvqty)), 0 )
            FROM    r5docklines
            WHERE   dkl_order       = @sOrder
            AND     dkl_order_org   = @sOrderOrg
            AND     dkl_ordline     = @nOrderline
            AND     dkl_linerstatus NOT IN ( N'A', N'C')
            if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                return 0

            SELECT  @nSmrecvqty = coalesce( SUM( coalesce( trl_qty, 0 ) + coalesce( trl_scrapqty, 0 ) ),0)
            FROM    r5translines l,r5transactions t
            WHERE   l.trl_trans     = t.tra_code
            AND     l.trl_order     = @sOrder
            AND     l.trl_order_org = @sOrderOrg
            AND     l.trl_ordline   = @nOrderline
            AND     t.tra_rstatus NOT IN ( N'A', N'C')
            if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                return 0

            SELECT  @nPendqty = (coalesce(orl_ordqty,0) - (coalesce(orl_recvqty,0) + coalesce(@nDck_qty,0) + coalesce(@nSmrecvqty,0)))
            FROM    r5orderlines curr
            WHERE   curr.orl_order  = @sOrder
            AND     curr.orl_order_org = @sOrderOrg
            AND     curr.orl_ordline = @nOrderline
            if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
                return 0
        end

    SELECT  @nConfactor = orl_multiply
    FROM    r5orderlines curr
    WHERE   curr.orl_order  = @sOrder
    AND     curr.orl_order_org = @sOrderOrg
    AND     curr.orl_ordline = @nOrderline
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        return 0

    SELECT  @nRecvQty = psl_recvqty
    FROM    r5packingslip curr
    WHERE   curr.psl_order  = @sOrder
    AND     curr.psl_order_org = @sOrderOrg
    AND     curr.psl_ordline = @nOrderline
    AND     curr.psl_dock = @sDockCode
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        return 0

    if  @nConfactor <> 0
        set @nPendqty = @nRecvQty / @nConfactor;

    return( @nPendqty )

end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PFPREV( 
     @pSessionID numeric(18), 
     @pUserID   nvarchar(255),
     @pRole     nvarchar(30) = '*' ) AS
   BEGIN
      DECLARE @sWoOrg              nvarchar(15) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_event_org
      DECLARE @sEquipment          nvarchar(310) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_objects
      DECLARE @sEquipType          nvarchar(50) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_obtypes
      DECLARE @sEquipClass         nvarchar(90) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_obclasses
      DECLARE @sEquipCategory      nvarchar(310) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_categories
      DECLARE @sEquipCriticality   nvarchar(90) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_criticalities
      DECLARE @sEnableChildTab     nvarchar(1) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_enablechildequiptab
      DECLARE @sParentEquipType    nvarchar(4) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_parenttype
      DECLARE @sIncludeChildren    nvarchar(1) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_inc_children
      DECLARE @sTopLevelParent     nvarchar(30) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_toplevel
      DECLARE @sTopLevelParentOrg  nvarchar(15) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_toplevel_org
      DECLARE @nSessionID          numeric(18) -- r5pmforecastparams.pfp_sessionid
      DECLARE @sParentObj          nvarchar(30) -- r5structures.stc_parent%TYPE := null
      DECLARE @sParentObjOrg       nvarchar(15) -- r5structures.stc_parent_org%TYPE := null
      DECLARE @sChildObj           nvarchar(30) -- r5structures.stc_child%TYPE := null
      DECLARE @sChildObjOrg        nvarchar(15) -- r5structures.stc_child_org%TYPE := null
      DECLARE @sSQL                nvarchar(4000)
      DECLARE @sInstallValue       nvarchar(400) -- r5install.ins_desc
      DECLARE @nPMFSNDEL           numeric(18)
      DECLARE @sDEPTSEC            nvarchar(400) -- r5install.ins_desc
      DECLARE @sObject             nvarchar(30) -- r5objects.obj_code
      DECLARE @sObjectOrg          nvarchar(15) -- r5objects.obj_org
      DECLARE @nSQLErrorNumber     numeric

      /* Get Parameter Information */
      SELECT @sWoOrg = pfp_event_org, @sEquipment = pfp_objects, @sEquipType = pfp_obtypes, @sEquipClass = pfp_obclasses,
             @sEquipCategory = pfp_categories, @sEquipCriticality = pfp_criticalities, @sEnableChildTab = COALESCE( pfp_enablechildequiptab, N'-' ),
             @sParentEquipType = pfp_parenttype, @sIncludeChildren= pfp_inc_children, @sTopLevelParent = pfp_toplevel,
             @sTopLevelParentOrg = pfp_toplevel_org
         FROM r5pmforecastparams
         WHERE pfp_sessionid = @pSessionID

      /* Get the number of days before cleaning up old records */
      SELECT @sInstallValue = ins_desc
         FROM   r5install
         WHERE ins_code = N'PMFSNDEL'

      IF( ISNUMERIC( @sInstallValue ) = 1 )
         SET @nPMFSNDEL = COALESCE( CAST( @sInstallValue AS numeric ), 30 )
      ELSE
         SET @nPMFSNDEL = 30

      IF( @nPMFSNDEL < 1 )
         SET @nPMFSNDEL = 30

      /* Clean up old PM Planning sessions */
      DECLARE cOldPlanningSessions CURSOR LOCAL FOR
         SELECT pfp_sessionid
            FROM r5pmforecastparams
            WHERE dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.o7gttime2(@sWoOrg), N'DD') - dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(pfp_created, N'DD') > ROUND(@nPMFSNDEL, 0)
            AND   COALESCE( pfp_forecasting, N'-' ) = N'-'

      OPEN cOldPlanningSessions
      FETCH NEXT FROM cOldPlanningSessions INTO @nSessionID

      WHILE( @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 )
         BEGIN
            DELETE FROM r5pmforecastequiplist
               WHERE pfl_sessionid = @nSessionID

            DELETE FROM r5pmforecastparentref
               WHERE pfr_sessionid = @nSessionID

            DELETE FROM r5pmforecastpreview
               WHERE pfv_sessionid = @nSessionID

            DELETE FROM r5pmforecastparams
               WHERE pfp_sessionid = @nSessionID

            DELETE FROM r5pmforecastresload
               WHERE pft_sessionid = @nSessionID

            FETCH NEXT FROM cOldPlanningSessions INTO @nSessionID
         END
      CLOSE cOldPlanningSessions
      DEALLOCATE cOldPlanningSessions

      /* Get the Department Security setting */
      SET @sDEPTSEC = N'OFF'

      SELECT @sInstallValue = ins_desc
         FROM   r5install
         WHERE ins_code = N'DEPTSEC'

      IF( UPPER( @sInstallValue ) = N'ON' )
         SET @sDEPTSEC = N'ON'

      SET @sSQL = N'INSERT INTO #tEquipment ' +
                  N'SELECT o.obj_code, o.obj_org ' +
                  N'FROM  r5objects o, r5userorganization u ' +
                  N'WHERE o.obj_obrtype IN ( N''A'', N''S'', N''P'', N''L'' ) ' +
                  N'AND   o.obj_rstatus IN ( N''B'', N''C'', N''CIR'', N''CRR'', N''I'' ) ' +
                  dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND',N'o.obj_code', @sEquipment, N'+', 10 ) +
                  dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND',N'o.obj_obtype', @sEquipType, N'+', 10 ) +
                  dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND',N'o.obj_class', @sEquipClass, N'+', 10 ) +
                  dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND',N'o.obj_category', @sEquipCategory, N'+', 10 ) +
                  dbo.o7gtclau( N'AND',N'o.obj_criticality', @sEquipCriticality, N'+', 10 ) +
                  N'AND   u.uog_user = N''' + @pUserID + ''' ' +
                  N'AND   u.uog_role = N''' + @pRole + ''' ' +
                  N'AND   u.uog_org = o.obj_org ' +
                  N'AND   ( u.uog_org = N''' + @sWoOrg + ''' OR u.uog_common = N''+'')'

      /* Add department security check if DEPTSEC install parameter is turned on */
      IF( @sDEPTSEC = N'ON' )
         SET @sSQL = @sSQL + N'AND (o.obj_mrc IN( SELECT dse_mrc FROM r5departmentsecurity WHERE dse_user = N''' + @pUserID + ''' AND dse_mrc = o.obj_mrc AND coalesce(dse_readonly, N''-'') = N''-''))'

      /* Add the equipment that meet the base criteria */
      CREATE TABLE #tEquipment( obj_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN null,
                                obj_org  nvarchar(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN null )

      EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL

      IF( @@ERROR <> 0 )
         BEGIN
            DROP TABLE #tEquipment
            ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
            RETURN -1
         END

      /* Loop through the temp table containing the equipment records that match the criteria */
      DECLARE cEquipCursor CURSOR LOCAL FOR
         SELECT obj_code, obj_org
            FROM #tEquipment

      OPEN cEquipCursor
      FETCH NEXT FROM cEquipCursor INTO @sObject, @sObjectOrg
      WHILE( @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 )
         BEGIN
            /* Insert equipment record onto Preview tab (could already be there because of Include Children */
            IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5pmforecastpreview
                              WHERE pfv_sessionid = @pSessionID
                              AND pfv_object = @sObject
                              AND pfv_object_org = @sObjectOrg )
               BEGIN
                  /* Find first parent that matches the specified parent type */
                  IF( @sParentEquipType IS NOT NULL )
                     BEGIN
                        SET @sParentObj = null
                        SET @sParentObjOrg = null
                        SELECT @sParentObj = stc_parent, @sParentObjOrg = stc_parent_org
                           FROM   dbo.PREUPD_PFV_GET_PARENT_HIERARCHY( @sObject, @sObjectOrg )
                           WHERE  stc_parenttype = @sParentEquipType
                     END

                  INSERT INTO r5pmforecastpreview
                     ( pfv_sessionid, pfv_select, pfv_object, pfv_object_org, pfv_parent, pfv_parent_org )
                  VALUES
                     ( @pSessionID, N'-', @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sParentObj, @sParentObjOrg )
               END

            /* Add children records if Include Children checkbox on Parameters tab is checked */
            IF( COALESCE( @sIncludeChildren, N'-' ) = N'+' )
               BEGIN
                  DECLARE cChildEquipment CURSOR LOCAL FOR
                     SELECT s.stc_child, s.stc_child_org
