CREATE PROCEDURE O7PIDDMA
						   @sSource    nvarchar(8),
                           @sCode      nvarchar(30),
                           @sClass     nvarchar(80),
                           @dDatefrom  datetime,
                           @dDateto    datetime,
                           @nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
                           @sStatement nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT  /*not used in this procedure - 
																but do not use it as a local variable for 
																sp_execute since it is an output paramater*/
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(400)  /* from @sStatement                        */
	declare @sSelclause1	nvarchar(3000)  /* select @sStatement it self              */
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(3000)  /* select @sStatement it self              */
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for events                 */
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for events (specially for report ORCSTL)   */
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for projects               */
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause to use ( evt, pro or bud ) */
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(400)  /* group by @sStatement                    */
	declare @nPidhir1		numeric(30,6)            /* approved ordered labour costs         */
	declare @nPidhir2		numeric(30,6)            /* approved ordered labour costs         */
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(1000)  /* @sExtra part of select clause.          */
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)  /* date from in character                */
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)  /* date to in character                  */
	declare @nSQLType		integer    
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)  

	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost      numeric(30,6)

	set @nSQLType = 1
	set @sExtra = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''


	
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )


	set @sFromstat = N'r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5events e, r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v '
	set @sExtra    = N''

	set @sSelclause1 = N'select @nCost = ( ROUND( SUM( (((coalesce(i.ivl_invqty, 0 ) * coalesce( i.ivl_price, 0 ) + coalesce(i.ivl_invcalctaxamount,0 )
						+ coalesce(i.ivl_totextra, 0 )) /  coalesce(i.ivl_invqty, 0))
						* (CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN N''I'' THEN 1 WHEN N''C'' THEN -1  WHEN N''D'' THEN -1 END * i.ivl_invqty )) /
						coalesce( i.ivl_exch, 1 )), 2 ))
						from ' + @sFromstat + 
						N'where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
						and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
						and    i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
						and    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
						and    i.ivl_ordline  = l.orl_ordline
						and    i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
						and    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
                        and    l.orl_event = e.evt_code
						and    v.inv_rstatus = N''A''
						and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
						and    l.orl_rtype   = N''PD''
						and    coalesce(i.ivl_invqty, 0) > 0'

	set @sSelclause2 =N'select @nCost = ( ROUND( SUM(((( coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 )*coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 )
						+ coalesce( l.orl_invcalctaxamount, 0 ) + coalesce( l.orl_totextra, 0 ) ) ) /
						coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 )) /
						coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ), 2 ) ) 
						from r5orderlines l, r5events e, r5orders o
						where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
						and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                        and    e.evt_code    = l.orl_event
						and    exists (select N''X''
						from  r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
						where i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
						and   i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
						and   i.ivl_ordline  = l.orl_ordline
						and   i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
						and   i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
						and   v.inv_rstatus = N''A'')
						and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
						and    l.orl_rtype   = N''PD'''

    set @sEvtclause = N' and  l.orl_event = @sEvent and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '
	set @sEvtclause1 = N' and l.orl_event = @sCode '

	set @sPrjclause = N' and l.orl_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'')and l.orl_project in
				   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7PIDXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) )'
 
	IF     @sSource IN (N'OSVCST', N'ORCSTL' )
		set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause1
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF  @sSource = N'EVT' 
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
						set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
					ELSE
						set @sAndclause = N''
				END
		END

    if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
        begin
            set @nCost = 0
            declare c_piddma_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7PIDXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
            open c_piddma_evt
            fetch next from c_piddma_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    if @sRouteParent is not null
                        set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7siddma( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )

                	set @sSQL = @sSelclause1 + @sAndclause
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
                        begin 
                            close c_piddma_evt
                            deallocate c_piddma_evt
				            return -1
                        end

                    set @nPidhir1 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                    set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause
                    
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
                        begin 
                            close c_piddma_evt
                            deallocate c_piddma_evt
				            return -1
                        end

                    set @nPidhir2 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                	set @nCost = coalesce(@nCost, 0) + (@nPidhir1 - @nPidhir2)

                    fetch next from c_piddma_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                end
            close c_piddma_evt
            deallocate c_piddma_evt
        end
    else
        begin
            set @sSQL = @sSelclause1 + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											@nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1
            
            set @nPidhir1 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

            set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											        @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1

            set @nPidhir2 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

        	set @nCost = coalesce(@nCost, 0) + (@nPidhir1 - @nPidhir2)

        end

	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)  /* date from in character                */
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)  /* date to in character                  */

		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	set @sFromstat = N'r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5events e, r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v '
	set @sExtra    = N''

	set @sSelclause1 = N'select @nCost = ROUND( SUM( (coalesce( i.ivl_price, 0 ) + coalesce( i.ivl_totextra, 0) + coalesce(i.ivl_invcalctaxamount,0 ))  *
						CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN N''I'' THEN 1 WHEN N''C'' THEN -1  WHEN N''D'' THEN -1 END /
						coalesce( i.ivl_exch, 1 ) ), 2 )
						from ' + @sFromstat + 
						N'where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
						and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
						and    i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
						and    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org

						and    v.inv_rstatus = N''A''
						and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
						and    l.orl_rtype   = N''SF'''


	set @sSelclause2 = N'select @nCost = ( ROUND( SUM(((coalesce( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) + 
                        case coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) when 0 then 0 else
                                coalesce(l.orl_invcalctaxamount, 0 ) * coalesce( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) / l.orl_price end  ) /
									coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 )) /
									coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ), 2 ) ) 
									from r5orderlines l, r5events e, r5orders o
									where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
									and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                                    and    l.orl_event = e.evt_code
									and    exists (select ''X''
									from  r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
									where i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
									and   i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
									and   i.ivl_ordline  = l.orl_ordline

									and    l.orl_rtype   = N''SF'''


   set @sEvtclause = N' and   l.orl_event = @sEvent and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '
   set @sEvtclause1 = N' and  l.orl_event = @sCode '

   set @sPrjclause = N' and l.orl_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'')and l.orl_project in
                   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7PIDXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) )'

	set @sAndclause =  N''

	if @sSource = N'OSVCST' 
		set @sAndclause =  @sEvtclause1
	if @sSource = N'EVT' 
		set @sAndclause =  @sEvtclause
	if @sSource = N'PRJ' 
		set @sAndclause =  @sPrjclause

    if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
        begin
            set @nCost = 0
            declare c_pidfix_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7PIDXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )

			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)',

			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
                        begin 
                            close c_pidfix_evt
                            deallocate c_pidfix_evt
				            return -1
                        end

                    set @nPidfix1 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                    set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause
                    
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)',

			if @@ERROR <> 0

            set @nPidfix1 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

            set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause

											        @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1

            set @nPidfix2 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PIDHIR

                           @sCode      nvarchar(30),

                           @dDatefrom  datetime,
                           @dDateto    datetime,
                           @nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
                           @sStatement nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT  /*not used in this procedure - but do not use it as a local variable for sp_execute since it is an output paramater*/
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(400)  /* from @sStatement                        */
	declare @sSelclause1	nvarchar(3000)  /* select @sStatement it self              */
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(3000)  /* select @sStatement it self              */
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for events                 */
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for events (specially for report ORCSTL)   */
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for projects               */
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause to use ( evt, pro or bud ) */
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(400)  /* group by @sStatement                    */
	declare @nPidhir1		numeric(30,6)            /* approved ordered labour costs         */
	declare @nPidhir2		numeric(30,6)            /* approved ordered labour costs         */
	declare @nPidhr2		numeric(30,6)            /* approved ordered labour costs         */
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(1000)  /* @sExtra part of select clause.          */
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)  /* date from in character                */
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)  /* date to in character                  */
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)  
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost      numeric(30,6)

	set @sExtra = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
	
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )


	set @sFromstat = N'r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5events e, r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v '
	set @sExtra    = N''


		set @sSelclause1 = N'select @nCost = ( ROUND( SUM( (((coalesce(CASE v.inv_return WHEN N''+'' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END, 0 ) * coalesce(	i.ivl_price, 0 ) + coalesce(i.ivl_invcalctaxamount,0 )
						+ coalesce(i.ivl_totextra, 0 )) /  coalesce(CASE v.inv_return WHEN N''+'' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END, 0))
						* (CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN N''I'' THEN 1 WHEN N''C'' THEN -1  WHEN N''D'' THEN -1 END ) * CASE v.inv_return WHEN N''+'' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END ) /
						coalesce( i.ivl_exch, 1 )), 2 ))
						from ' + @sFromstat + 
						'where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
						and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
						and    i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
						and    i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
						and    i.ivl_ordline  = l.orl_ordline
                        and    l.orl_event = e.evt_code
						and    i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
						and    i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
						and    v.inv_rstatus = N''A''
						and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
						and    l.orl_rtype   = N''ST'''


	set @sSelclause2 =N'select @nCost = ( ROUND( SUM(((( coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 )*coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 )
						+ ( coalesce(l.orl_invcalctaxamount, 0 ) * coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) ) ) ) /
						coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 )) /
						coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ), 2 ) )
						from r5orderlines l, r5events e, r5orders o
						where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
						and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                        and    l.orl_event   = e.evt_code
						and    exists (select N''X''
						                from  r5invoicelines i , r5invoices v
						                where i.ivl_order = l.orl_order
						                and   i.ivl_order_org = l.orl_order_org
						                and   i.ivl_ordline  = l.orl_ordline
						                and   i.ivl_invoice = v.inv_code
						                and   i.ivl_invoice_org = v.inv_org
						                and   v.inv_rstatus = N''A'')
						and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
						and    l.orl_rtype   = N''ST'''


   set @sEvtclause = N' and   l.orl_event = @sEvent and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '
   set @sEvtclause1 = N' and  l.orl_event = @sCode '
   
   set @sPrjclause = N' and l.orl_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'')and l.orl_project in
                   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7PIDXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) )'
 
	set @sAndclause =  N''
    
	if @sSource = N'OSVCST'
		set @sAndclause =  @sEvtclause1
	if @sSource = N'EVT' 
		set @sAndclause =  @sEvtclause
	if @sSource = N'PRJ' 
		set @sAndclause =  @sPrjclause


    if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
        begin
            set @nCost = 0
            declare c_pidhir_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7PIDXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
            open c_pidhir_evt
            fetch next from c_pidhir_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    if @sRouteParent is not null
                        set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7sidhir( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )

                	set @sSQL = @sSelclause1 + @sAndclause
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
                        begin 
                            close c_pidhir_evt
                            deallocate c_pidhir_evt
				            return -1
                        end

                    set @nPidhir1 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                    set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause
                    
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
                        begin 
                            close c_pidhir_evt
                            deallocate c_pidhir_evt
				            return -1
                        end

                    set @nPidhir2 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                	set @nCost = coalesce(@nCost, 0) + (@nPidhir1 - @nPidhir2)

                    fetch next from c_pidhir_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                end
            close c_pidhir_evt
            deallocate c_pidhir_evt
        end
    else
        begin
            set @sSQL = @sSelclause1 + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											@nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1
            
            set @nPidhir1 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

            set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											        @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1

            set @nPidhir2 =  coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

        	set @nCost = coalesce(@nCost, 0) + (@nPidhir1 - @nPidhir2)
        end

	execute @nReturn = o7pidhr2 @sSource, @sCode, @sClass, @dDatefrom, @dDateto, @nPidhr2 OUTPUT, @sSt

name: O7PIDHR2
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7PIDHR2
		   @sSource		nvarchar(8),
           @sCode		nvarchar(30),
           @sClass		nvarchar(80),
           @dDatefrom	datetime,
           @dDateto		datetime,
           @nCostDiff	numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
           @sStatement	nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT  /*not used in this procedure - but do not use it as a local variable for sp_execute since it is an output paramater*/
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(400)  
	declare @nHours			numeric(30,6)      
	declare @nPidtot		numeric(30,6)  
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)  
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)  

	declare @sOrder			nvarchar(30) 
	declare @sOrdorg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nOrdline		numeric(30,6)
	declare @nEvnthours		numeric(30,6)
	declare @nPrice			numeric(30,6)

	set @sFromstat = N''

	CREATE TABLE #tCodes (ord NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,
						 ordline numeric(8),
						 ordorg NVARCHAR(15) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,
						 ordhrs numeric(30,6),
						 ordprice numeric(30,6))


	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

 
    if @sSource = N'OSVCST'
		insert into #tCodes 
		select b.boo_order, b.boo_ordline, b.boo_order_org, SUM(boo_hours),
			( ( coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) + coalesce(l.orl_invcalctaxamount / l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) )
		from r5orderlines l, r5activities a, r5bookedhours b
		where l.orl_order     = b.boo_order
			and   l.orl_order_org = b.boo_order_org
			and   l.orl_ordline   = b.boo_ordline
			and   l.orl_rtype     = N'SH'
			and   a.act_event     = b.boo_event
			and   a.act_act       = b.boo_act
			and   b.boo_event = @sCode
		group by b.boo_order, b.boo_ordline, b.boo_order_org, l.orl_price, l.orl_exch, l.orl_invcalctaxamount, l.orl_ordqty

         
	if @sSource = N'EVT' 
		insert into #tCodes 
		select b.boo_order, b.boo_ordline, b.boo_order_org, SUM(boo_hours),
			( ( coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) + coalesce(l.orl_invcalctaxamount / l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) )
		from r5orderlines l, r5activities a, r5bookedhours b
		where l.orl_order     = b.boo_order
			and   l.orl_order_org = b.boo_order_org
			and   l.orl_ordline   = b.boo_ordline
			and   l.orl_rtype     = N'SH'
			and   a.act_event     = b.boo_event
			and   a.act_act       = b.boo_act
			and   b.boo_event in ( select EVT_code from dbo.O7PIDXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY(@sCode))
		group by b.boo_order, b.boo_ordline, b.boo_order_org, l.orl_price, l.orl_exch, l.orl_invcalctaxamount, l.orl_ordqty

	if @sSource = N'PRJ' 
		insert into #tCodes 
		select b.boo_order, b.boo_ordline, b.boo_order_org, SUM(boo_hours),
			( ( coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) + coalesce(l.orl_invcalctaxamount / l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) )
		from r5orderlines l, r5activities a, r5bookedhours b
		where l.orl_order     = b.boo_order
			and   l.orl_order_org = b.boo_order_org
			and   l.orl_ordline   = b.boo_ordline
			and   l.orl_rtype     = N'SH'
			and   a.act_event     = b.boo_event
			and   a.act_act       = b.boo_act
			and  b.boo_date between
                       	CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) and
                       	CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101)
			and  a.act_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N'%')
			and  a.act_project in
                   	( select prj_code from dbo.O7PIDXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY(@sCode) )
		group by b.boo_order, b.boo_ordline, b.boo_order_org, l.orl_price, l.orl_exch, l.orl_invcalctaxamount, l.orl_ordqty

	-- create a cursor to loop on the temp table records to Get the total hours booked on this 'SF' orderline for all events 
	declare c_invoice cursor local for select	ord,	ordline,	ordorg,	ordhrs ,ordprice
									FROM #tCodes
		open c_invoice
		fetch next from c_invoice into @sOrder, @nOrdline, @sOrdorg,  @nEvnthours,	@nPrice
		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			begin
				SELECT @nHours = SUM(coalesce(boo_hours,0))
				FROM   r5bookedhours
				WHERE  boo_order     =  @sOrder
				AND    boo_ordline   =  @nOrdline
				AND    boo_order_org =  @sOrdorg
				If @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
					set @nHours = 1
				if @nHours = 0
					set @nPidtot = 0
				else
					SELECT @nPidtot = ((@nEvnthours/@nHours) *
													SUM(CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN N'I' THEN i.ivl_invqty ELSE CASE v.inv_return WHEN N'+' THEN i.ivl_returnqty ELSE i.ivl_invqty END END
					* (CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN N'I' THEN 1 WHEN N'C' THEN -1  WHEN N'D' THEN -1 END )
					* (((i.ivl_price + coalesce( i.ivl_invcalctaxamount / i.ivl_invqty, 0 ) ) / coalesce( i.ivl_exch, 1 ) ) - CASE v.inv_rtype WHEN 
					N'I' THEN @nPrice ELSE CASE v.inv_return WHEN N'+' THEN  @nPrice ELSE 0 END END))) 
					FROM   r5invoices v, r5invoicelines i
					WHERE  v.inv_code      = i.ivl_invoice
					AND    v.inv_org       = i.ivl_invoice_org
					AND    v.inv_rstatus   = N'A'
					AND    i.ivl_order     = @sOrder
					AND    i.ivl_ordline   = @nOrdline
					AND    i.ivl_order_org = @sOrdorg
					AND    i.ivl_invqty   <> 0
				If @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
					set @nPidtot = 0

				set @nCostDiff = round(coalesce(@nCostDiff,0) + coalesce(@nPidtot,0),2)

				fetch next from c_invoice into @sOrder, @nOrdline, @sOrdorg, @nEvnthours,	@nPrice
  			end
		close c_invoice
		deallocate c_invoice
		drop table #tCodes

create function O7PIDXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( evt_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
                        evt_routeparent nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sParent    	nvarchar(30)
		
	declare @tStack table ( evt_code nvarchar(30), evt_routeparent nvarchar(30), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, 1 from r5events where evt_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = evt_code, @sParent = evt_routeparent from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode, @sParent )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND evt_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events
										 where evt_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7PIDXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(20))
returns @tReturn table( prj_code nvarchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(20)
		
	declare @tStack table ( prj_code nvarchar(20), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select prj_code, 1 from r5projects where prj_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = prj_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select PRJ_CODE, @nLevel + 1
										  from R5PROJECTS
										 where PRJ_PARENT = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

	declare @nReturn integer

	set @sDatabase = cast( DB_NAME() as varchar(128) )

	if @sUrcode = N'1' 
		SELECT @nEstimatecost = prj_estlab FROM r5projects WHERE prj_code = @sProjectcode
	if @sUrcode= N'5' 
		SELECT @nEstimatecost = prj_estserv FROM r5projects WHERE prj_code = @sProjectcode
	if @sUrcode= N'4' 
		SELECT @nEstimatecost = prj_estdirm FROM r5projects WHERE prj_code = @sProjectcode
	if @sUrcode= N'2' 
		SELECT @nEstimatecost = prj_estmat FROM r5projects WHERE prj_code = @sProjectcode
	if @sUrcode= N'3' 
		SELECT @nEstimatecost = prj_esthirlab FROM r5projects WHERE prj_code = @sProjectcode
	if @sUrcode= N'6' 
   		SELECT @nEstimatecost = prj_esttool FROM r5projects WHERE prj_code = @sProjectcode


	execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Totaled', @sGcaculated OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Ucode', @sGurcode OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'CalculateTotal', @sGtotamount OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1
	
	set @nGtotamount = 0

	execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'ProjectCode', @sGprojcode OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1

	if @sGcaculated = N'TRUE' AND isnull(@sGurcode,N'') = @sUrcode AND  isnull(@sGprojcode,N'') =@sProjectcode  
		begin
			set @nOpenamount = @nEstimatecost  - @nGtotamount

			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Totaled', N'FALSE' 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1
		end
	else
		begin
			set @nTotamount  = dbo.O7PJCOST_TOTCOST(@sProjectcode, @sUrcode)
			set @nOpenamount = @nEstimatecost  - @nTotamount

			set @sGtotamount = '0'
			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'CalculateTotal', @sGtotamount 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Totaled', N'TRUE' 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Ucode', @sUrcode 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'ProjectCode', @sProjectcode 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1
		end
	RETURN isnull(@nOpenamount,0)

 END

		begin
			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7PJCOST_O7REMMAT', N'PRJ', @sProjectcode, @nOutput OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT

				return -1
		end



	if @sUrcode = N'3'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7PJCOST_O7PNOHIR', N'PRJ', @sProjectcode, @nOutput OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1
		end

	if @sUrcode = N'4'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7PJCOST_O7PNODMA', N'PRJ', @sProjectcode, @nOutput OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1
		end

	if @sUrcode = N'5'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7PJCOST_O7PNOFIX', N'PRJ', @sProjectcode, @nOutput OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1
		end

	if @sUrcode = N'6'
		begin
		    SELECT @nEstimatecost = prj_esttool FROM r5projects WHERE prj_code = @sProjectcode

			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'O7PJCOST_O7ACTTOOL', N'PRJ', @sProjectcode, N'%', @nActAmount OUTPUT, @sOutput OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1

			if isnull(@nEstimatecost,0) < isnull(@nActAmount,0) 
				set @nOutput = 0
			else 
				begin
					if isnull(@nEstimatecost,0) >= isnull(@nActAmount,0) 
						set @nOutput = isnull(@nEstimatecost,0) - isnull(@nActAmount,0)
				end
		end



	 return isnull(@nOutput,0)
end

create function O7PJCOST_TOTCOST (	@sProjectcode nvarchar(20), @sUrcode nvarchar(8))
returns numeric(30,6)
as
begin
	declare @nEstimatecost	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOpenamount	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nTotamount		numeric(30,6)
	declare @bTotaled		bit
	declare @sGurcode		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sGprojcode		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sGcaculated	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nGtotamount	numeric(30,6)

  	declare @nActamount		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPidamount		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nPnoamount		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRemamount		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @sGtotamount	nvarchar(36)
	declare @sDatabase	varchar(128)

	set @sDatabase = cast( DB_NAME() as varchar(128) )

	execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Totaled', @sGcaculated OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1
	execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Ucode', @sGurcode OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1
	
	execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'CalculateTotal', @sGtotamount OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1
	set @nGtotamount = cast(@sGtotamount as numeric(30,6))

	execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'ProjectCode', @sGprojcode OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
		return -1

	if @sGcaculated = N'TRUE' AND isnull(@sGurcode,N'') = @sUrcode AND  isnull(@sGprojcode,N'') =@sProjectcode  
		begin
			set @nOpenamount = @nEstimatecost  - @nGtotamount

			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Totaled', N'FALSE' 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			set @nRemamount = isnull( dbo.O7PJCOST_REMCOST(@sProjectcode, @sUrcode), 0 )
			set @nActamount = isnull( dbo.O7PJCOST_ACTCOST(@sProjectcode, @sUrcode), 0 )
			set @nPnoamount = isnull( dbo.O7PJCOST_PNOCOST(@sProjectcode, @sUrcode), 0 )
			set @nPidamount = isnull( dbo.O7PJCOST_PIDCOST(@sProjectcode, @sUrcode), 0 )

			if @sUrcode ='1' 
				begin
					set @nPnoamount = isnull( @nPnoamount, 0 )/*no on order for labor*/
					set @nActamount = isnull( @nActamount, 0 )
					set @nTotamount = @nPnoamount + @nActamount
				end

			if @sUrcode='2' OR @sUrcode ='6' 
				begin
					set @nPnoamount = isnull( @nPnoamount, 0 ) /*no on order for stock or tool*/
					set @nActamount = isnull( @nActamount, 0 )
					set @nTotamount = @nPnoamount + @nActamount
				end

			if  @sUrcode='4' 
				begin
					set @nRemamount = isnull( @nRemamount, 0 )
					set @nActamount = isnull( @nActamount, 0 )
					set @nPnoamount = isnull( @nPnoamount, 0 )
					set @nTotamount = @nRemamount + @nActamount + @nPnoamount
				end

			if  @sUrcode='3' OR @sUrcode='5' 
				begin
					set @nRemamount = isnull( @nRemamount, 0 )
					set @nActamount = isnull( @nActamount, 0 )
					set @nPnoamount = isnull( @nPnoamount, 0 )
					set @nTotamount = @nRemamount + @nActamount + @nPnoamount
				end

			set @nTotamount = @nTotamount + @nPidamount
			set @sGtotamount = cast(@nTotamount as nvarchar(38))
			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'CalculateTotal', @sGtotamount 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Totaled', N'TRUE' 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'Ucode', @sUrcode 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = master..xp_dstm_sql @sDatabase, 'SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE', N'O7PJCOST', N'ProjectCode', @sProjectcode 
			if @@ERROR != 0 OR @nReturn = -1
				return -1


		end
	return isnull(@nTotamount,0)
end

create function O7PLANNEDQTY (
  @sEvent   nvarchar(30),
  @nAct     numeric(8,0),
  @sPart    nvarchar(30),
  @sPartorg nvarchar(15)
  )
  returns numeric(32,6)
as
begin

    declare @nPlannedqty      numeric(24,6)
    set @nPlannedqty = 0 

    SELECT @nPlannedqty =  SUM( mlp_qty )
    FROM   r5matlparts m,
          r5activities a
    WHERE  a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist
    AND    a.act_matlrev  = m.mlp_matlrev
    AND    a.act_event    = @sEvent
    AND    a.act_act      = @nAct
    AND    m.mlp_part     = @sPart
    AND    m.mlp_part_org = @sPartorg
  
    if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
        set  @nPlannedqty = null

    RETURN (@nPlannedqty) 
end

create function O7PLNQTY (
	@sEvent   nvarchar(30),
	@nAct     numeric(8),
	@sPart    nvarchar(30),
	@sPartorg nvarchar(15),
	@sStore   nvarchar(15),
	@nLine    numeric(8) )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @nResult		numeric(24,6)
	select @nCount = count(*)
    FROM   r5matlparts m,
           r5events e,
           r5activities a
    WHERE  a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist
    AND    a.act_matlrev  = m.mlp_matlrev
    AND    a.act_event    = e.evt_code
    AND    a.act_event    = @sEvent
    AND    a.act_act      = @nAct
    AND    m.mlp_part     = @sPart
    AND    m.mlp_part_org = @sPartorg
    AND    m.mlp_line = @nLine


	if @nCount > 0
		SELECT @nResult = mlp_qty
		FROM   r5matlparts m,
			   r5events e,
			   r5activities a
		WHERE  a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist
		AND    a.act_matlrev  = m.mlp_matlrev
		AND    a.act_event    = e.evt_code
		AND    a.act_event    = @sEvent
		AND    a.act_act      = @nAct
		AND    m.mlp_part     = @sPart
		AND    m.mlp_part_org = @sPartorg
		AND    m.mlp_line = @nLine

	else
	  set @nResult = 0
  RETURN (@nResult)
END

create procedure O7PLSREQ	@sOrg				nvarchar(15),

	declare @dReqDate			datetime

	declare @nReqOrdqty			numeric(24,6)

	declare @sRepPart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRepPartorg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRepStore			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRepSup			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRepSuporg			nvarchar(15)

	declare @nQty				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nExcludereservedqty		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nLeadtime			numeric(4,1)
	declare @dDuedate			datetime
	declare @sCheck				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nPurchaseQty			numeric(24,6) --NUMBER := 0;
	declare @sRepairresult			nvarchar(1)

	declare @nReturn			int

	set @nSequencenumber = 0

	set @nPurchaseQty = 0.0
	set @nQty = 0.0
	set @nExcludereservedqty = 0.0
	set @nLeadtime = 0.0
	set @sCheck = N'0'

	set @nChk = 0

    execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sMreorder OUTPUT, N'MREORDER', @sCheck OUTPUT
    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 or @sMreorder is null
        begin       
            set @sMreorder = N'BELOW'
        end
    
	if @nSessionid is not null
		begin
			DELETE FROM r5lowstockrequisitions
			WHERE  lrq_sessionid      = @nSessionid
			set @nVsessionid = @nSessionid
		end
	else
		begin
			DELETE FROM r5lowstockrequisitions
			WHERE  lrq_date < @dToday - 5
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nVsessionid OUTPUT, N'BREP', 1, @sCheck OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end

	set @sVABCclass = coalesce( @sABCclass, N'%' )
	set @sVpartclass = coalesce( @sPartclass, N'%' )

        set @sVBuyer = coalesce( @sBuyer, N'%' )

     AND    t.ert_code ='35668'
     AND    u.usr_code = @sUser


	If (@sPOReqFlag = N'+' OR @sStoreReqFlag = N'+')
        begin
		    If @sIncChildStore <> N'+'
			    BEGIN
				  IF @sConsignflag = 'A' AND @sABCclass IS NULL AND @sSupplier IS NULL AND @sSupplierorg IS NULL AND @sPreferredStore IS NULL
				    declare c_reqs cursor local for SELECT DISTINCT s.sto_store,

							    s.sto_prefsup,
							    s.sto_prefsup_org,
							    s.sto_prefstore,
							    coalesce(s.sto_prefstore, s.sto_prefsup),
							    CASE WHEN s.sto_prefsup is NULL THEN NULL ELSE s.sto_prefsup_org END,
							    CASE WHEN s.sto_prefstore is NULL THEN coalesce( a.cat_curr, c.com_curr ) ELSE z.org_curr END,
							    CASE WHEN s.sto_prefstore is NULL THEN dbo.o7gtexch2( coalesce( a.cat_curr, c.com_curr ), st2.str_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ), N'DD' )) ELSE
																	     dbo.o7gtexch2( z.org_curr, st2.str_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ), N'DD' ) )  END,
							    CASE WHEN s.sto_prefstore is NULL THEN coalesce(dbo.o7gtexch2( coalesce( a.cat_curr, c.com_curr ), @sOrg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ), N'DD' )), 1) ELSE
																	     isnull(dbo.o7gtexch2 ( z.org_curr, @sOrg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ), N'DD' ) ), 1) END,
							    s.sto_part,

							    p.par_uom,

create procedure O7PMINVO_ORL_X5MOREINVLINE	@sInvcode			nvarchar(45),
											@sInvorg			nvarchar(15),
											@sOrlorder			nvarchar(30),
											@sOrlorderorg		nvarchar(15),
											@nOrlordline		int,
											@sIvlexchfromdual	nvarchar(128)	OUTPUT,
											@sOrlexchfromdual	nvarchar(128),
											@sIvlexchtodual		nvarchar(128)	OUTPUT,
											@sOrlexchtodual		nvarchar(128),
											@nIvlprice			numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
											@nIvlinvvalue		numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
											@nIvldiscperc		int				OUTPUT,
											@sIvlcurr			nvarchar(3)		OUTPUT,
											@nIvlexch			numeric(24,12)	OUTPUT,
											@nIvlinvline		int				OUTPUT,
											@nIvlinvqty			numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sInvline	nvarchar(40)
	declare @sInvqty	nvarchar(40)
	declare @sPrice		nvarchar(40)
	declare	@sInvvalue	nvarchar(40)
	declare	@sDiscperc	nvarchar(40)
	declare	@sCurr		nvarchar(40)
	declare	@sExch		nvarchar(40)
	declare	@sX			nvarchar(40)
	declare	@sChk		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nFormatvar	numeric(24,6)
	declare	@sExchdual	nvarchar(40)
	declare @nPos		int

	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @sTemp		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOrdline	nvarchar(64)

	set @sX = null
	set @sChk = N'0'

	set @sTemp = @sInvcode + N'#' + @sInvorg
	set @sOrdline = cast( @nOrlordline as nvarchar(64))
	execute @nReturn = O7GMOREP N'IVL', 1, @sTemp, @sOrlorder, @sOrlorderorg, @sOrdline, 
								@sInvline OUTPUT, @sInvqty OUTPUT, @sPrice OUTPUT, 
								@sInvvalue OUTPUT, @sDiscperc OUTPUT, @sCurr OUTPUT, 
								@sExch OUTPUT, @sExchdual OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk = N'0'
		begin
			set @nPos = charindex( N'#', @sExchdual )
			if @nPos = 1
				begin
					set @sIvlexchfromdual = @sOrlexchfromdual
					set @sIvlexchtodual = @sOrlexchtodual
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sIvlexchfromdual = substring( @sExchdual, 1, @nPos - 1 )
					set @sIvlexchtodual = substring( @sExchdual, @nPos + 1, len( @sExchdual ) )
				end

			set @nIvlinvline = cast( @sInvline as int )
			set @nFormatvar = cast( @sPrice as numeric(24,6) )
			set @nIvlprice = @nFormatvar
			set @nIvlinvvalue = cast( @sInvvalue as numeric(24,6) )
			set @nIvldiscperc = cast( @sDiscperc as int )
			set @sIvlcurr = @sCurr
			set @nIvlexch = cast( @sExch as numeric(24,12) )
			set @nIvlinvqty = cast( @sInvqty as numeric(24,6) )
		end

create procedure O7PMINVO_ORL_X5MORETM	@sInvcode			nvarchar(45),
										@sInvorg			nvarchar(15),
										@sOrlevent			nvarchar(30),
										@nOrlact			int,
										@sOrlorder			nvarchar(30),
										@sOrlorderorg		nvarchar(15),
										@nOrlordline		int,
										@sOrlrtype			nvarchar(4),
										@sOrlcurr			nvarchar(3),
										@nOrlprice			numeric(24,6),
										@nOrlexch			numeric(24,12), 
										@nTimeworked		int				OUTPUT,
										@nMaxqty			numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
										@nOutstanding		numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
										@nIvlinvqty			numeric(24,6),
										@nOutstanding2		numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
										@nIvlinvline		int,
										@nIvlprice			numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
										@sIvlcurr			nvarchar(3)		OUTPUT,
										@nIvlexch			numeric(24,12)	OUTPUT,
										@nIvlexchfromdual	numeric(24,12)	OUTPUT,
										@nIvlexchtodual		numeric(24,12)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sQtyonotherinv		nvarchar(40)
	declare @sPriceonotherinv	nvarchar(40)
	declare @sCurr				nvarchar(40)
	declare @sExch				nvarchar(40)
	declare @sExchfrom			nvarchar(40)
	declare @sExchto			nvarchar(40)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(90)
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nFormatvar			numeric(24,6)

	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sTemp				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOrdline			nvarchar(64)

	if @sOrlrtype = N'ST'
		begin
			SELECT @nTimeworked = isnull( a.act_nt, 0 ) + isnull( a.act_ot, 0 )
			FROM   r5activities a
			WHERE  a.act_event = @sOrlevent
			AND    a.act_act   = @nOrlact

			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				set @nTimeworked = 0
		end
	else
		begin
			SELECT @nTimeworked = SUM( boo_hours )
			FROM   r5bookedhours
			WHERE  boo_order   = @sOrlorder
			AND    boo_order_org = @sOrlorderorg
			AND    boo_ordline = @nOrlordline

			if @@ROWCOUNT = 0
				set @nTimeworked = 0
		end

	set @sTemp = @sInvcode + N'#' + @sInvorg
	set @sOrdline = cast( @nOrlordline as nvarchar(64) )
	execute @nReturn = O7GMOREP N'IVL', 2, @sTemp, @sOrlorder, @sOrlorderorg, @sOrdline, 
								@sQtyonotherinv OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT,
								@sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sQtyonotherinv = isnull( @sQtyonotherinv, N'0' )
	set @nMaxqty = isnull( @nTimeworked, 0 ) - cast( @sQtyonotherinv as numeric(24,6) )

	if @nMaxqty <= 0
		return

	set @nOutstanding = isnull( @nMaxqty, 0 ) - isnull( @nIvlinvqty, 0 )
	if @nIvlinvline is null and @sQtyonotherinv > N'0'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GMOREP N'IVL', 3, @sTemp, @sOrlorder, @sOrlorderorg, @sOrdline, 
										@sPriceonotherinv OUTPUT, @sCurr OUTPUT, @sExch OUTPUT,
										@sExchfrom OUTPUT, @sExchto OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, 
										@sX OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sChk = N'0'
				begin
					set @nFormatvar = cast( @sPriceonotherinv as numeric(24,6) )
					set @nIvlprice = @nFormatvar
					set @sIvlcurr = @sCurr
					set @nIvlexch = cast( @sExch as numeric(24,12) )
					set @nIvlexchfromdual = cast( @sExchfrom as numeric(24,12) )
					set @nIvlexchtodual = cast( @sExchto as numeric(24,12) )
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			if @nIvlinvline is null
				begin
					set @nFormatvar = @nOrlprice
					set @nIvlprice = @nFormatvar
					set @sIvlcurr = @sOrlcurr
					set @nIvlexch = @nOrlexch
				end
		end

create function O7PMINVO_X5CALCDCTOTAL(	@sCode		nvarchar(45), 
										@sOrg		nvarchar(15) )
returns numeric(24,6)
as
begin
	declare @nTotal	numeric(24,6)

	select @nTotal = isnull( sum( CASE inv_rtype WHEN N'C' THEN inv_total WHEN N'D' THEN inv_total ELSE -inv_total END ), 0 )
	FROM    r5invoices
	WHERE   inv_parent     = @sCode
	AND     inv_parent_org = @sOrg
	AND     inv_rstatus   <> N'C'

	return ( @nTotal )

create procedure O7PMINVO_X5CALCPURVALUE	@sCode			nvarchar(45),

											@sItemvalue		nvarchar(64)	OUTPUT,
											@sItemdiscount	nvarchar(64)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @nItemvalue		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nItemdiscount	numeric(24,12)

	SELECT	@nItemvalue = ROUND( SUM( ivl_invvalue / isnull( ivl_exch, 1 ) * isnull( @nExch, 1 ) ), 2 ),
			@nItemdiscount = ROUND( SUM( ivl_discount * isnull( ivl_invqty, 1 ) ), 2 ),
			@nCountit = COUNT( * )
	FROM   r5invoicelines
	WHERE  ivl_invoice     = @sCode
	AND    ivl_invoice_org = @sOrg

	if @nCountit = 0
		begin
			set @sItemvalue = null
			set @sItemdiscount = null
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sItemvalue = cast( @nItemvalue as nvarchar )
			set @sItemdiscount = cast( @nItemdiscount as nvarchar )
		end

create procedure O7PMINVO_X5CHECKDCTOL	@sInvcode			nvarchar(45),
										@sInvorg			nvarchar(15),
										@sDccode			nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
										@sDcorg				nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
										@sChk				nvarchar(6)		OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nTolerance		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nAbsolute		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nItemvalue		numeric(24,12)
	declare @nItemdiscount	numeric(24,12)
	declare @nInvoicevalue	numeric(24,12)

	declare @sCode			nvarchar(45)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nExch			numeric(24,12)
	declare @nTotal			numeric(24,6)


	declare @nReturn		int

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @nTolerance OUTPUT, N'MATCHTOL', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		set @nTolerance = null

	if @nTolerance is not null
		begin
			set @sChk = N'0'

			declare c_notes cursor local for	SELECT inv_code,inv_org,inv_exch,inv_total
												FROM   r5invoices
												WHERE  inv_parent     = @sInvcode
												AND    inv_parent_org = @sInvorg
												AND    inv_rstatus   <> N'C'
			open c_notes
			fetch next from c_notes into @sCode, @sOrg, @nExch, @nTotal
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7PMINVO_X5CALCPURVALUE @sCode, @sOrg, @nExch, @nItemvalue OUTPUT, @nItemdiscount OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_notes
							deallocate c_notes
							return -1
						end
					set @nInvoicevalue = isnull( @nTotal, 0 )
					if isnull( @nItemvalue, 0 ) <> 0
						set @nAbsolute = ABS( ( ( isnull( @nItemvalue, 0 ) - isnull( @nInvoicevalue, 0 ) ) * 100 ) / @nItemvalue )
					else
						set @nAbsolute = ABS( ( isnull( @nItemvalue, 0 ) - isnull( @nInvoicevalue, 0 ) ) * 100 )

					if @nAbsolute > @nTolerance
						begin
							set @sDccode = @sCode
							set @sDcorg = @sOrg
							set @sChk = N'1'
							break
						end

					fetch next from c_notes into @sCode, @sOrg, @nExch, @nTotal
				end
			close c_notes
			deallocate c_notes
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PNODMA  @sSource    nvarchar(8),
                           @sCode      nvarchar(30),
                           @sClass     nvarchar(80),
                           @dDatefrom  datetime,
                           @dDateto    datetime,
                           @nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
                           @sStatement nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCursor1    INTEGER
    declare @nCursor2    INTEGER
    declare @nIgnore     INTEGER
	declare @nPor_dma    numeric(30,6)
    declare @sFromstat   nvarchar(2000 )  /* from statement                        */
	declare @sFromstat2  nvarchar(2000 )
    declare @sSelclause  nvarchar(3000 )  /* select statement it self              */
    declare @sSelclause2 nvarchar(3000 )  /* select statement it self              */
    declare @sEvtclause  nvarchar(3000 )  /* and clause for events                 */
    declare @sBudclause nvarchar(2000 )   /* and clause for events (specially for report ORCSTL)   */
    declare @sPrjclause  nvarchar(3000 )  /* and clause for projects               */
    declare @sAndclause  nvarchar(3000 )  /* and clause to use ( evt, pro or bud ) */
    declare @sGroupby    nvarchar(400 )   /* group by statement                    */
    declare @nPno_dma1   numeric(30,6)     /* approved ordered labour costs         */
    declare @nPno_dma2   numeric(30,6)     /* approved ordered labour costs         */
    declare @sExtra      nvarchar(2000)    /* extra part of select clause.          */
	declare @sExtracol   nvarchar(2000)
    declare @sCharfrom   nvarchar(40)  	   /* date from in character                */
    declare @sCharto     nvarchar(40)  	   /* date to in character                  */
	declare @sCpricelevel nvarchar(100 )  /* Price level ( Part or Stock ) */
	declare @nDma1		 numeric(30, 6)
	declare @nDma2		 numeric(30, 6)
	declare @sEvtloop    nvarchar(1200 )  /*GOE015 PL/SQL loop for events          */
    declare @sDummyloop  nvarchar(1200 )  /*GOE015 PL/SQL loop for events          */
    declare @nCursor0    INTEGER
    declare @sPlndrqpo   nvarchar(200)     /* r5install.ins_desc%TYPE */
    declare @sChk        nvarchar(4)
	declare @sSQL		nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sSQLStatement	nvarchar(4000)
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @sTempCode	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sSqlend	nvarchar(500)

	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost      numeric(30,6)

    /* Set dates in character format. */
    set @sCharfrom = isnull(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900')
    set @sCharto   = isnull(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100')
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sPlndrqpo OUTPUT, N'PLNDRQPO', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    /* This procedure retrieves the planned not ordered direct material costs */
    /* Get price level */
	set @sCpricelevel = N'P'
    SELECT @sCpricelevel = isnull( i.ins_desc, N'P' )
    FROM   r5install  i
    WHERE  i.ins_code = N'PRICELEV'
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
    	set @sCpricelevel = N'P'

	/* NOTE: BAN and BAN2 are special cases and their functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN and BAN2 only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/

	if @sSource in ( N'BAN', N'BAN2' )
		begin
			set @sFromstat = N' r5parts p, r5matlparts m, r5activities a, r5partordered i, r5ububat u,
                                 r5mrcs c RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
                                          LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON e.evt_object = o.obj_code AND e.evt_object_org = o.obj_org '
			set @sFromstat2 = N' r5parts p, r5matlparts m, r5activities a, r5ububat u, 
                                 r5mrcs c RIGHT OUTER JOIN r5events e ON e.evt_mrc = c.mrc_code
                                          LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects o ON e.evt_object = o.obj_code AND e.evt_object_org = o.obj_org '

			if @sSource = N'BAN'
				begin
					set @sSqlend = N'	and   u.bub_event = e.evt_code
										and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
										and   a.act_start >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
										and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
								   group by c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org,
											m.mlp_qty,i.pao_direct,a.act_event,a.act_act,p.par_sqlidentity '
					if @sPlndrqpo IN (N'ON', N'YES', N'+')
						--based on the Oracle code there is not select, from or initial where clause (???)
						set @sStatement = @sSqlend
					else
						set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(isnull( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part,
															m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sCpricelevel + N''', null ), 0  ) *
															( isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) - isnull( i.pao_direct, 0 ) ), 0 ) ), 2) costs, 
													isnull( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org,
															e.evt_org, N''B'', N''S'', null ), 0 ) rate,
													dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) - isnull( i.pao_direct, 0 ), 0 ) qty,
													a.act_event, a.act_act, cast(p.par_sqlidentity as nvarchar(38)) recid 
											 from   ' + @sFromstat +
										   N' where  a.act_event    = e.evt_code
											 and    p.par_code     = m.mlp_part
											 and    p.par_org      = m.mlp_part_org
											 and    m.mlp_direct   = N''+''
											 and    a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist
											 and    a.act_matlrev  = m.mlp_matlrev
											 and    i.pao_part     = m.mlp_part
											 and    i.pao_part_org = m.mlp_part_org
											 and    e.evt_rstatus  <> N''C''
											 and    i.pao_event    = e.evt_code 
											 and    dbo.o7checkmatch( m.mlp_equipfilter, o.obj_checklistfilter ) = N''+''
											 and	case  when m.mlp_code is null then isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,'' '') 
															when m.mlp_code = o.obj_category  then N''C'' 
															when m.mlp_code =  e.evt_object then e.evt_obrtype end	=	
												isnull( m.mlp_obrtype,'' '') ' + @sSqlend
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sSqlend = N'	and   u.bub_event = e.evt_code
										and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
										and   a.act_start >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
										and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
									group by c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org,
												m.mlp_qty, a.act_event, a.act_act, cast(p.par_sqlidentity as nvarchar(38)) '
					if @sPlndrqpo IN (N'ON', N'YES', N'+')
						set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( isnull( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part,
															m.mlp_part_org, e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sCpricelevel + N''', null ), 0 ) *
															isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) ), 2) costs, 
													isnull( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org,
															e.evt_org, N''B'', N''S'', null ), 0 ) rate,
													isnull( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) qty,
													a.act_event, a.act_act, cast( p.par_sqlidentity as nvarchar(38)) recid 
											 from   ' + @sFromstat2 +
										   N' where  a.act_event    = e.evt_code
											 and    p.par_code     = m.mlp_part
											 and    p.par_org      = m.mlp_part_org
											 and    m.mlp_direct   = N''+''
											 and    a.act_matlist  = m.mlp_matlist
											 and    a.act_matlrev  = m.mlp_matlrev
                                             and    e.evt_rstatus  <> N''C''
											 and    not exists ( select ''x''
                                                                   from   r5orderlines l
                                                                   where  l.orl_part     = m.mlp_part

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PNOFIX 
			@sSource    nvarchar(8),
			@sCode      nvarchar(30),
			@sClass     nvarchar(30),
			@dDatefrom  datetime,
			@dDateto    datetime,
			@nCost      numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
			@sStatement nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT 
									   
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON 
	declare	@sExtracol  nvarchar(1000)	/* @sExtra columns in select clause.       */
	declare	@sExtra     nvarchar(1000)	/* @sExtra part of select clause.          */
	declare	@sFromstat  nvarchar(400)	/* from @sStatement                        */
	declare	@sSelclause nvarchar(3000)	/* select @sStatement it self              */
	declare	@sEvtclause nvarchar(3000)	/* and clause for events                 */
	declare	@sPrjclause nvarchar(3000)	/* and clause for projects               */
	declare	@sBudclause nvarchar(3000)	/* and clause for budgets                */
	declare	@sAndclause nvarchar(3000)	/* and clause to use ( evt, pro or bud ) */
	declare	@sGroupby   nvarchar(400)	/* group by @sStatement                    */
	declare	@nPno_fix   numeric(24,6)				/* planned not ordered labour costs      */
	declare	@nPor_fix   numeric(24,6)		/* planned not ordered labour costs      */
	declare	@sCharfrom  nvarchar(10)		/* date from in character                */
	declare	@sCharto    nvarchar(10)		/* date to in character                  */
	declare @nReturn	integer
	declare @sSQL		nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost      numeric(30,6)


    /* Set dates in character format. */
    set @sCharfrom = isnull(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900')
    set @sCharto   = isnull(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100')

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sFromstat = N'r5activities a, r5ububat u, r5events e'

			set @sExtra    = N' * ( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) ),
												dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration ) '
			
			set @sExtracol = N' , coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0 ) rate,
									round( sum( CASE WHEN (a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL) THEN COALESCE( a.act_est, 0 ) ELSE 1 END  ' + @sExtra + N' ), 2 ) qty,
									a.act_event, a.act_act, a.act_sqlidentity recid '
			set @sSelclause = N' select round( sum( CASE WHEN (a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL) THEN COALESCE( a.act_est, 0 ) ELSE 1 END *
										  coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0 ) '
										  + @sExtra + N' ), 2 )  costs' + @sExtracol +  
					   N' from  ' + @sFromstat +
					 N' where  a.act_event = e.evt_code
		               and    e.evt_rstatus <> N''C''
					   and    a.act_hire  = N''+''
					   and    coalesce( a.act_ordrtype, N''ST'' ) = N''SF''
					   and not exists ( select N''x''
										from r5orders
										where ord_rstatus = N''A''
										and ord_code = a.act_order
										and ord_org  = a.act_order_org)
                       and not exists( select N''x'' from r5requislines
									   where  rql_event = a.act_event
									   and    rql_act = a.act_act
									   and    rql_rtype = N''SF''
                                       and    rql_rstatus in ( ''J'', ''C'' )  )
					   and not exists( select N''x'' from r5orderlines
									   where orl_event = a.act_event
									   and   orl_act = a.act_act
									   and   orl_rtype = N''SF'' 
                                       and   orl_rstatus in ( ''J'', ''C'' ) ) '

			set @sStatement = @sSelclause + N' and   u.bub_event = a.act_event 
												and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
												and   u.bub_rstatus <> N''C''
												and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N'''
												and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >=
													CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
												and   a.act_start <=
													CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
										group by a.act_ntrate, a.act_event, a.act_act, a.act_sqlidentity '
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sSource = N'BUD'
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N'r5activities a, r5ububat u, r5events e'

					set @sExtra = N' * ( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) ), 
						dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration ) '	
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N'r5activities a, r5events e '
					set @sExtra    = N''
				end

			set @sSelclause = N' select @nCost = round( sum( CASE WHEN (a.act_order IS NULL AND a.act_req IS NULL) THEN COALESCE( a.act_est, 0 ) ELSE 1 END *
												  coalesce( a.act_ntrate, 0 ) '
												  + @sExtra + N' ), 2 ) 
											from  ' + @sFromstat +
										 N' where  a.act_event = e.evt_code
										   and    a.act_hire  = N''+''
										   and    coalesce( a.act_ordrtype, N''ST'' ) = N''SF''
									       and not exists ( select N''x''
														    from r5orders
														    where ord_rstatus = N''A''
														    and ord_code = a.act_order
														    and ord_org  = a.act_order_org)
										   and not exists( select N''x'' from r5requislines
														   where  rql_event = a.act_event
														   and    rql_act = a.act_act
														   and    rql_rtype = N''SF'' 
                                                           and    rql_rstatus in ( ''J'', ''C'' )  )
										   and not exists( select N''x'' from r5orderlines
														   where orl_event = a.act_event
														   and   orl_act = a.act_act
														   and   orl_rtype = N''SF''
                                                           and   orl_rstatus in ( ''J'', ''C'' )  )'

			set @sEvtclause = N' and   a.act_event = @sEvent and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '
				
			set @sPrjclause = N' and e.evt_projbud like isnull(@sClass, N''%'' )
						 and e.evt_project in
				( select prj_code from dbo.O7PNOXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

			set @sBudclause = N' and   u.bub_event = a.act_event 
				and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
				and   u.bub_rstatus <> N''C''
				and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
				and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101)
				and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) '

		   /* Set actual and clause, depending on variable  @sSource  */
  
			set @sAndclause = ''

			if @sSource = N'EVT' 
				set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			if @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			if @sSource = N'BUD' 
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause

		   /* Prepare a cursor to select from */
			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause

            if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
                begin
                    set @nCost = 0
                    declare c_pnofix_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7PNOXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY2( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
                    open c_pnofix_evt
                    fetch next from c_pnofix_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sRouteParent is not null
                                set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7spnfix( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )
                            
			                EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sChart

			if @sSource = N'PRJ'

			if @sSource = N'BUD'

create function O7PNOXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( evt_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(30)
    DECLARE @sStatus        nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( evt_code nvarchar(30), 
							evt_rstatus nvarchar(4), 
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select evt_code, evt_rstatus, 1 from r5events where evt_code = @sCode
    SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = evt_code, @sStatus = evt_rstatus from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					if @sStatus <> N'C'
						insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND evt_code = @sCurrentCode
                    insert into @tStack select evt_code, evt_rstatus, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events

create function O7PNOXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY2 (@sCode nvarchar(30))

					insert into @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0

				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7POINTUOMCONV(
  @fromuom  NVARCHAR( 10 ),
  @touom    NVARCHAR( 10 ) )
  RETURNS   NUMERIC( 24, 18 ) AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @retvalue NUMERIC( 24, 18 )
  SELECT @retvalue = CASE @fromuom
      WHEN N'FEET' THEN
        CASE @touom 
          WHEN N'FEET'       THEN 1
          WHEN N'METERS'     THEN .3048
          WHEN N'KILOMETERS' THEN .0003048
          WHEN N'MILES'      THEN .000189394
          ELSE 1
        END 
      WHEN 'METERS' THEN
        CASE @touom 
          WHEN N'FEET'       THEN 3.28083989501312
          WHEN N'METERS'     THEN 1
          WHEN N'KILOMETERS' THEN .001
          WHEN N'MILES'      THEN .000621371192
          ELSE 1
        END 
      WHEN 'KILOMETERS' THEN
        CASE @touom 
          WHEN N'FEET'       THEN 3280.83989501312
          WHEN N'METERS'     THEN 1000
          WHEN N'KILOMETERS' THEN 1
          WHEN N'MILES'      THEN .621371192
          ELSE 1
        END
      WHEN 'MILES' THEN
        CASE @touom 
          WHEN N'FEET'       THEN 5280
          WHEN N'METERS'     THEN 1609.344
          WHEN N'KILOMETERS' THEN 1.609344
          WHEN N'MILES'      THEN 1
          ELSE 1
        END
      ELSE
        1
    END 
  RETURN @retvalue  
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7POPULATECHARTDATA_WORKORDERCOST(
  @yearsback NUMERIC = 1 ) 
AS
  DECLARE @defcurr NVARCHAR( 3 )
  SET @defcurr = dbo.o7dflt2( N'DEFCURR' )

  DELETE FROM r5scworkordercost

  INSERT INTO r5scworkordercost( cws_org, cws_jobtype, cws_date, cws_cost )
  SELECT evt_org, evt_jobtype, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(DATEADD( dd, - ( DAY( evt_completed ) -1 ), evt_completed ), N'DD' ), 
         SUM( dbo.o7getwocost( evt_code, N'TOTAL', N'-' )  )
  FROM   r5events 
  WHERE  evt_rtype IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' ) 
  AND    evt_rstatus = N'C'
  AND    evt_completed BETWEEN DATEADD( yy, DATEDIFF( yy, 0, getdate() ) - @yearsback, 0 ) AND getdate()
  GROUP BY evt_org, evt_jobtype, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(DATEADD( dd, - ( DAY( evt_completed ) -1 ), evt_completed ), N'DD' )

  UPDATE r5scworkordercost
  SET    cws_costdefcurr = cws_cost / ISNULL( dbo.o7gtexch2( @defcurr, cws_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( getdate(), N'DD' ) ), 1 )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PORDMA   @sSource    nvarchar(8),
                            @sCode      nvarchar(30),
                            @sClass     nvarchar(80),
                            @dDatefrom  datetime,
                            @dDateto    datetime,
                            @nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT

AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sFromstat			nvarchar(400)  
	declare @sFromstat2			nvarchar(400)  
	declare @sSelclause			nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sSelclause2		nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sEvtclause			nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sPrjclause			nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sBudclause			nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sBudclause2		nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sAndclause			nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sPrjclause2		nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sAndclause2		nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @nCost2				numeric(30,6)  
	declare @sSQL				nvarchar(4000)  
	declare @sEvent			    nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent       nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost          numeric(30,6)
	declare @sCharfrom		    nvarchar(10)  /* date from in character                */
	declare @sCharto		    nvarchar(10)  /* date to in character                  */

	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )
    
    if @sSource = N'BUD'
        begin
            set @sFromstat = N'r5requisitions r, r5events e, r5requislines l, r5activities a, r5ububat u'
            set @sFromstat2 = N'r5orders o, r5events e, r5orderlines l, r5activities a, r5ububat u'
        end
    else
        Begin
            set @sFromstat = N'r5requisitions r, r5events e, r5requislines l'
            set @sFromstat2 = N'r5orders o, r5events e, r5orderlines l'
        end

	set @sSelclause =	N'select @nCost = round( sum( ( coalesce( l.rql_qty, 0 ) - coalesce( l.rql_recvqty, 0 ) -
							coalesce( l.rql_scrapqty, 0 ) ) *
							coalesce( l.rql_price, 0 ) /
							coalesce( l.rql_exch, 1 ) ), 2 )
							from  ' + @sFromstat + N' 
							where r.req_code = l.rql_req
							and   l.rql_event = e.evt_code
							and   r.req_rstatus IN (N''U'', N''R'', N''A'')
							and   coalesce( l.rql_rtype, N''PS'' ) = N''PD''
							and   l.rql_active = N''+''
							and not exists ( select N''x''
										   from r5orderlines
										   where orl_req = l.rql_req
										   and  orl_reqline =l.rql_reqline )'

    set @sSelclause2 = N'select @nCost2 = round( sum( ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER ( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) -
								coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) -
								coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0 ), 0 ) *
								coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) /
								coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) /
								coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ) +
								( ( coalesce( l.orl_totextra, 0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) ) *
								dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) -
								coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) -
								coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0 ), 0 ) /
								l.orl_ordqty ) ), 2 ) 
							from  ' + @sFromstat2 + N' 
							where o.ord_code  = l.orl_order
							and   l.orl_event = e.evt_code
							and   l.orl_active = N''+''
							and   o.ord_rstatus NOT IN ( N''A'', N''C'' )
							and   coalesce( l.orl_rtype, N''PS'' ) = N''PD'''

	set @sEvtclause = N' and e.evt_code = @sEvent and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '

	set @sPrjclause = N'and l.rql_event = e.evt_code
						and e.evt_rstatus <> N''C''
						and e.evt_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'')
						and e.evt_project in
						( select prj_code from dbo.O7PORXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

	set @sPrjclause2 = N'and l.orl_event = e.evt_code
						and e.evt_rstatus <> N''C''
						and e.evt_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'')
						and e.evt_project in
						( select prj_code from dbo.O7PORXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

    set @sBudclause = N'and   u.bub_event = e.evt_code
                        and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
                        and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
                        and   a.act_act   = l.rql_act
                        and   a.act_start >= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dDatefrom, N''DD'' )
                        and   a.act_start <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dDateto, N''DD'' ) '

    set @sBudclause2 = N'and   u.bub_event = e.evt_code
                         and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
                         and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
                         and   a.act_act   = l.orl_act
                         and   a.act_start >= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dDatefrom, N''DD'' )
                         and   a.act_start <= dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dDateto, N''DD'' )'

	if @sSource = N'EVT' 
		begin
			set @sAndclause =  @sEvtclause
			set @sAndclause2 = @sEvtclause
		end

	if @sSource = N'PRJ' 
		begin
			set @sAndclause =  @sPrjclause
			set @sAndclause2 = @sPrjclause2
		end

    if @sSource = N'BUD'
        begin
			set @sAndclause =  @sBudclause
			set @sAndclause2 = @sBudclause2
        end

    if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
        begin
            set @nCost = 0
            declare c_pordma_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7PORXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY2( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
            open c_pordma_evt
            fetch next from c_pordma_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    if @sRouteParent is not null
                        set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7spodma( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )

                	set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
                    
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sEvent nvarchar(30), @dDatefrom datetime, @dDateto datetime', 
											        @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sEvent, @dDatefrom, @dDateto
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
                        begin 
                            close c_pordma_evt
                            deallocate c_pordma_evt
				            return -1
                        end

                    set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                	set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause2
                    
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost2 numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											        @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sEvent
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
                        begin 
                            close c_pordma_evt
                            deallocate c_pordma_evt
				            return -1
                        end

                    set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                    fetch next from c_pordma_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                end
            close c_pordma_evt
            deallocate c_pordma_evt
        end
    else
        begin
            set @nCost = 0

        	set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sEvent nvarchar(30), @dDatefrom datetime, @dDateto datetime', 
											@nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sEvent, @dDatefrom, @dDateto
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1
            set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

        	set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause2
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost2 numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sEvent nvarchar(30), @dDatefrom datetime, @dDateto datetime', 
											@nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sEvent, @dDatefrom, @dDateto
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1
            set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )
        end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PORHIR  
				@sSource    nvarchar(8),
				@sCode      nvarchar(30),
				@sClass     nvarchar(80),
				@nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT

AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sFromstat			nvarchar(400)  
	declare @sSelclause			nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sSelclause2		nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sEvtclause			nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sPrjclause			nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sAndclause			nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sEvtclause2		nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sPrjclause2		nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @sAndclause2		nvarchar(3000)  
	declare @nCost2				numeric(30,6)  
	declare @sSQL				nvarchar(4000)  
	declare @sEvent			    nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent       nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost          numeric(30,6)

	set @sSelclause =	N'select @nCost = round( sum( coalesce( l.rql_qty, 0 ) *
						coalesce( l.rql_price, 0 ) ), 2 ) 
						from  r5requisitions r, r5events e, r5requislines l
						where r.req_code  = l.rql_req
						and   l.rql_event = e.evt_code
						and   r.req_rstatus IN ( N''U'', N''R'', N''A'' )
                        and   l.rql_rstatus NOT IN ( N''C'', N''J'' )
						and   coalesce( l.rql_rtype, N''ST'' ) = N''ST''
						and not exists ( select N''x''
										 from   r5orderlines
										 where  orl_req     = l.rql_req
										 and    orl_reqline = l.rql_reqline )'

	set @sSelclause2 = N'select @nCost2 = round( sum( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) *
					coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) /
					coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) ), 2 ) 
					from  r5orders o, r5orderlines l, r5events e
					where o.ord_code = l.orl_order
					and   o.ord_org  = l.orl_order_org
					and   l.orl_event = e.evt_code
					and   o.ord_rstatus IN  (N''U'', N''R'' )
                    and   l.orl_rstatus NOT IN ( N''C'', N''J'' )
					and   coalesce( l.orl_rtype, N''ST'' ) = N''ST''
					and   l.orl_active = N''+'''

	set @sEvtclause     = N'and e.evt_code = @sEvent and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '


	set @sPrjclause = N'and e.evt_rstatus <> N''C''
						and e.evt_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'')
						and e.evt_project in
						( select prj_code from dbo.O7PORXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

	set @sEvtclause2    = N'and e.evt_code = @sEvent and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '

	set @sPrjclause2 = 'and e.evt_rstatus <> N''C''
						and e.evt_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'')
						and e.evt_project in
						( select prj_code from dbo.O7PORXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

	if @sSource = N'EVT' 
		begin
			set @sAndclause =  @sEvtclause
			set @sAndclause2 = @sEvtclause2
		end
	else
		begin
			set @sAndclause =  @sPrjclause
			set @sAndclause2 = @sPrjclause2
		end


    if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
        begin
            set @nCost = 0
            declare c_porhir_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7PORXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY2( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
            open c_porhir_evt
            fetch next from c_porhir_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                begin
                    if @sRouteParent is not null
                        set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7spohir( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )

                	set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
                    
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											        @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sEvent
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
                        begin 
                            close c_porhir_evt
                            deallocate c_porhir_evt
				            return -1
                        end

                    set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                	set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause2
                    
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost2 numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											        @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sEvent
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
                        begin 
                            close c_porhir_evt
                            deallocate c_porhir_evt
				            return -1
                        end

                    set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                    fetch next from c_porhir_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                end
            close c_porhir_evt
            deallocate c_porhir_evt
        end
    else
        begin
            set @nCost = 0

        	set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											@nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sEvent
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1
            set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

        	set @sSQL = @sSelclause2 + @sAndclause2
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost2 numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											@nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sEvent
			if @@ERROR <> 0 
				return -1
            set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )
        end
