create function O7PORXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( evt_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(30)
		
	declare @tStack table ( evt_code nvarchar(30), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select evt_code, 1 from r5events where evt_code = @sCode  and evt_rstatus <> N'C'
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = evt_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND evt_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select evt_code, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events
										 where evt_parent = @sCurrentCode and evt_rstatus <> N'C'
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7PORXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY2 (@sCode nvarchar(30))

					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND evt_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events
										 where evt_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7POSDPS              @sCcode              nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCmrc               nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCprovider          nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCproviderorg       nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCnewprovider       nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCnewproviderorg    nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCsercat            nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCsercatorg         nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCnewsercat         nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCnewsercatorg      nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCserprob           nvarchar(30),
                                       @sChk                nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sMincode            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sProvider           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sProviderorg        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sServicecategory    nvarchar(30)
    declare @sServicecategoryorg nvarchar(15)
    declare @sServiceproblem     nvarchar(30)
    declare @sServiceproblemorg  nvarchar(15)
    declare @nReturn             numeric(38,0)

    IF @sCprovider IS NULL 
        begin
            IF @sCsercat IS NOT NULL AND @sCnewsercat IS NOT NULL 
                begin
                    IF @sCsercat <> @sCnewsercat OR @sCsercatorg <> @sCnewsercatorg
                        begin
                            IF @sCserprob IS NULL 
                                begin            
                                    /* SCEN#3 MRC SC -- sc was updated, need to cascade update all childen SVPB */
                                    UPDATE r5departmentstructure
                                    SET     dps_servicecategory     = @sCnewsercat, 
                                            dps_servicecategory_org = @sCnewsercatorg
                                    WHERE  dps_mrc   = @sCmrc
                                    AND    dps_servicecategory = @sCsercat
                                    AND    dps_servicecategory_org = @sCsercatorg
                                    AND    dps_supplier IS NULL
                                    AND    dps_serviceproblem IS NOT NULL
                                end
                            ELSE
                                begin
                                    /*SCEN#4 SC was updated, if new node does not exist, create one */
                                    execute @nReturn = o7crdpsp @sCmrc, null, null, @sCnewsercat, @sCnewsercatorg, @sCserprob, @sChk OUTPUT      
                                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                        return -1    
                                end
                        end
                end 
        end
    ELSE  
        begin       
            /*  Combination of  MRC  PD  SVPB, PD always exist */
            IF @sCsercat IS NULL 
                begin
                    /* SCEN#5,6 MRC, PD */
                    IF @sCprovider <> @sCnewprovider OR @sCproviderorg <> @sCnewproviderorg
                        begin
                            IF @sCserprob IS NULL 
                                begin
                                    /* SCEN#5 -- PD was updated, need to PD's child SVPB */
                                    UPDATE r5departmentstructure
                                    SET    dps_supplier     = @sCnewprovider, 
                                      dps_supplier_org = @sCnewproviderorg
                                    WHERE  dps_mrc   = @sCmrc
                                    AND    dps_supplier = @sCprovider
                                    AND    dps_supplier_org = @sCproviderorg
                                end
                            ELSE
                                begin
                                    /* SCEN#6  PD was updated, if the new node does not exist, create one.*/
                                    execute @nReturn = o7crdpsp @sCmrc, @sCnewprovider, @sCnewproviderorg, null, null, @sCserprob, @sChk OUTPUT
                                    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                        return -1 
                                end
                        end 
                end
            ELSE
                begin
                    /* combination of MRC PD SC SVPM, PD, SC always exist */
                    IF @sCserprob IS NULL 
                        begin
                            /* SCEN#7 --- PD  is updated need to cascade update all childen */
                            IF (@sCprovider <> @sCnewprovider OR @sCproviderorg <> @sCnewproviderorg) 
                                    AND @sCsercat = @sCnewsercat AND @sCsercatorg = @sCnewsercatorg
                                begin
                                    UPDATE r5departmentstructure
                                    SET    dps_supplier     = @sCnewprovider, 
                                    dps_supplier_org = @sCnewproviderorg
                                    WHERE  dps_mrc   = @sCmrc
                                    AND    dps_supplier = @sCprovider
                                    AND    dps_supplier_org = @sCproviderorg
                                    AND    dps_servicecategory = @sCsercat
                                    AND    dps_servicecategory_org = @sCsercatorg
                                    AND    dps_serviceproblem IS NOT NULL                             
                                end

                            /* SCEN#7 -- SC IS UPDATED all childen of SVPB need to updated */
                            IF @sCprovider = @sCnewprovider AND @sCproviderorg = @sCnewproviderorg
                                    AND ( @sCsercat <> @sCnewsercat OR @sCsercatorg <> @sCnewsercatorg )
                                begin
                                    UPDATE r5departmentstructure
                                    SET    dps_servicecategory     = @sCnewsercat, 
                                    dps_servicecategory_org = @sCnewsercatorg
                                    WHERE  dps_mrc   = @sCmrc
                                    AND    dps_supplier = @sCprovider
                                    AND    dps_supplier_org = @sCproviderorg
                                    AND    dps_servicecategory = @sCsercat
                                    AND    dps_servicecategory_org = @sCsercatorg              
                                    AND    dps_serviceproblem IS NOT NULL
                                end

                            /* SCEN#7 --- BOTH  PD and SC updated */
                            IF (@sCprovider <> @sCnewprovider OR @sCproviderorg <> @sCnewproviderorg)
                                    AND ( @sCsercat <> @sCnewsercat OR @sCsercatorg <> @sCnewsercatorg )
                                begin
                                    UPDATE r5departmentstructure
                                    SET    dps_supplier     = @sCnewprovider, 
                                    dps_supplier_org = @sCnewproviderorg,
                                    dps_servicecategory     = @sCnewsercat, 
                                    dps_servicecategory_org = @sCnewsercatorg
                                    WHERE  dps_mrc   = @sCmrc
                                    AND    dps_supplier = @sCprovider
                                    AND    dps_supplier_org = @sCproviderorg
                                    AND    dps_servicecategory = @sCsercat
                                    AND    dps_servicecategory_org = @sCsercatorg
                                    AND    dps_serviceproblem IS NOT NULL   
                                end

                            /

create function O7POSEVT_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15) )
returns @tReturn table( parent		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						parent_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_parent		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_parent_org	nvarchar(15),
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_parent, 
				stc_parent_org, 
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_child		= @sCode	and 
				stc_child_org	= @sOrg	and
				stc_parentrtype = N'S'	

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_parent,
							@sOrg	= stc_parent_org
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_parent = @sCode and stc_parent_org = @sOrg
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_parent, 
												stc_parent_org, 
												@nLevel + 1
										  from	r5structures
										 where	stc_child		= @sCode	and 
												stc_child_org	= @sOrg		and
												stc_parentrtype = N'S'

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7POSFUN @sFunCode  NVARCHAR(6)
                             ,@sFunGroup NVARCHAR(12)
                             ,@sDMLType  NVARCHAR(4)
                             ,@sCheck    NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT

AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    SET @sCheck = N'1'
    IF ISNULL(@sDMLType, N'XXX') NOT IN (N'INS', N'DEL')
       RETURN

    SET @sCheck = N'0'

    IF @sDMLType = N'INS'
        begin
           IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5permissions WHERE prm_function = @sFunCode AND prm_group  = @sFunGroup)
              INSERT INTO r5permissions
                         (prm_function
                         ,prm_group)
                  VALUES (@sFunCode
                         ,@sFunGroup)
        end
    ELSE
       DELETE FROM r5permissions
        WHERE prm_group = @sFunGroup
          AND prm_function = @sFunCode

create PROCEDURE O7PREAGR
      @sInsupddel					nvarchar(4),
      @sOld_agr_code 				nvarchar(30) ,
      @sOld_agr_status 				nvarchar(4) ,
      @sOld_agr_rstatus 			nvarchar(4) ,
      @sOld_agr_arrangement 		nvarchar(12) ,
      @sOld_agr_class 				nvarchar(8) ,
      @sOld_agr_clsorg 				nvarchar(15) ,
      @sOld_agr_debtor 				nvarchar(30) ,
      @sOld_agr_desc 				nvarchar(80) ,
      @dOld_agr_end 				datetime,
      @sOld_agr_object 				nvarchar(30) ,
      @sOld_agr_project 			nvarchar(20) ,
      @sOld_agr_event 				nvarchar(30) ,
      @dOld_agr_start 				datetime,
      @sNew_agr_code 				nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
      @sNew_agr_status 				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
      @sNew_agr_rstatus 			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
      @sNew_agr_arrangement 		nvarchar(12) ,
      @sNew_agr_class 				nvarchar(8) ,
      @sNew_agr_clsorg 				nvarchar(15) ,
      @sNew_agr_debtor 				nvarchar(30) ,
      @sNew_agr_desc 				nvarchar(80) ,
      @dNew_agr_end 				datetime,
      @sNew_agr_object 				nvarchar(30) ,
      @sNew_agr_event 				nvarchar(30) ,
      @sNew_agr_project 			nvarchar(20) ,
      @dNew_agr_start 				datetime
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sStatent		nvarchar(4)--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE /* Status entity */
	declare @sTypeent		nvarchar(4)--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE /* Type entity */
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nFPA			int
	declare @nCEV			int
	declare @nReturn		int

BEGIN
	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	if @sInsupddel IS NULL  OR @sInsupddel NOT IN (N'INS', N'UPD', N'DEL') 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end
	
	/* if not deleting  check mandatory fields  */
	if @sInsupddel IN (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			if @sNew_agr_desc IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 21
					return -1
				end

			if @sNew_agr_debtor IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 22
					return -1
				end
			if @sNew_agr_arrangement IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 23
					return -1
				end
		end



	/* if updateing, check non-updateable values */
	if @sInsupddel = N'UPD' 
		begin
			if @sNew_agr_code <> @sOld_agr_code 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 2
					return -1
				end
		end


	/*  if Class exists in r5classes    */
	if @sInsupddel IN (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			if @sNew_agr_class IS NOT NULL 
			begin
				execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'AGR', @sNew_agr_class, @sNew_agr_clsorg,N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCount OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

				if @nCount = 0
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 3
					return -1
				end

			end
		end


	/* if not deleting */
	if @sInsupddel IN (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'AGR', @sStatent OUTPUT, @sTypeent OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			if @sChk <> N'0' 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 4
					return -1
				end

			if @sStatent IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 41
					return -1
				end
			/* Get rstatus or status, if one of them is null AND RETURN IT   */
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sNew_agr_rstatus OUTPUT, @sNew_agr_status OUTPUT, @sStatent, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 5
					return -1
				end
		end


	/* Check status change, checking delete as status C */
	if coalesce (@sNew_agr_rstatus, N'C') <> @sOld_agr_rstatus 
		begin
			SELECT @nFPA = count (*)
			FROM   r5fixedpayments
			WHERE  fpa_agreement = @sOld_agr_code
			AND    fpa_rstatus in ('A', N'I')

			SELECT @nCEV = count (*)
			FROM   r5calcevents
			WHERE  cev_agreement = @sOld_agr_code

			/* if status set to U, no finished payments or calculated jobs */
			if @sNew_agr_rstatus = N'U' 
				if @nFPA > 0 
					begin
						execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 51
						return -1
					end
				if @nCEV > 0 
					begin
						execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 52
						return -1
					end
			else
				begin
					IF @sNew_agr_rstatus = N'A' 
						set @sX = NULL
					ELSE
						begin
							IF @sNew_agr_rstatus = N'F' 
								set @sX = NULL
							/* if deleting or if status set to C, same check as if status set to U */
							ELSE
								begin
									IF coalesce (@sNew_agr_rstatus, N'C') = N'C' 
										begin
											if @nFPA > 0 
												begin
													execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 51
													return -1
												end

											if @nCEV > 0 
												begin
													execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 52
													return -1
												end
										end
								end
						end
				end
		end


	/* Object and project should not both be entered. */
	if @sInsupddel <> 'DEL' 
		begin
			if ( @sNew_agr_object  IS NOT NULL AND @sNew_agr_project IS NOT NULL ) OR
			( @sNew_agr_object  IS NOT NULL AND @sNew_agr_event   IS NOT NULL ) OR
			( @sNew_agr_project IS NOT NULL AND @sNew_agr_event   IS NOT NULL ) OR
			( @sNew_agr_project IS NULL AND @sNew_agr_event   IS NULL AND @sNew_agr_object  IS NULL )
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 7
					return -1
				end
		end
         
	/* Cross-check start and end date */
	if @dNew_agr_start > @dNew_agr_end 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 8
			return -1
		end


	/* if inserting, generate agreement number if still required */
	if @sInsupddel = N'INS' 
		begin
			if  @sNew_agr_code IS NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sNew_agr_code OUTPUT, N'AGR', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1
					
					if @sChk <> N'0'
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAGR', N'PROC', 9
							return -1
						end
				end
		end


END

create PROCEDURE O7PREAJO
      @sInsupddel        	nvarchar(4),
      @sOldajoarrangement 	nvarchar(12) ,

      @sOld_ajo_mrc 		nvarchar(15) ,

      @sNew_ajo_mrc 		nvarchar(15) ,
      @sNew_ajo_objclass 	nvarchar(8) ,
      @sNew_ajo_objclsorg	nvarchar(15) 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sChk       nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @sX         nvarchar( 1 )
	declare @nCount    int
	declare @nReturn	int
BEGIN
	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInsupddel IS NULL OR @sInsupddel NOT IN (N'INS', N'UPD', N'DEL') 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAJO', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	/* If not deleting  check mandatory fields  */
	IF @sInsupddel IN (N'INS', N'UPD') 
	begin
		IF @sNew_ajo_arrangement IS NULL 
			begin
				execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAJO', N'PROC', 21
				return -1
			end
		IF @sNew_ajo_mrc IS NULL 
			begin
				execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAJO', N'PROC', 22
				return -1
			end
		IF @sNew_ajo_jobtype IS NULL 
			begin
				execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAJO', N'PROC', 23
				return -1
			end
		IF @sNew_ajo_objclass IS NULL 
			begin
				execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAJO', N'PROC', 24
				return -1
			end
	end

	/* If updateing, check non-updateable values */
	IF @sInsupddel = N'UPD' 
		begin
			IF @sNew_ajo_arrangement <> @sOldajoarrangement
			OR @sNew_ajo_mrc <> @sOld_ajo_mrc
			OR @sNew_ajo_jobtype <> @sOld_ajo_jobtype
			OR @sNew_ajo_objclass <> @sOld_ajo_objclass 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAJO', N'PROC', 2
					return -1
				end

		end

	If @sInsupddel in (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'JBTP', @sNew_ajo_jobtype, NULL,N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCount OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCount = 0
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAJO', N'PROC', 6
					return -1
				end

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'OBJ', @sNew_ajo_objclass, @sNew_ajo_objclsorg,N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX,@nCount OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCount = 0
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAJO', N'PROC', 7
					return -1
				end
		end
END

					return -1
				end

			IF @sNew_apa_parclass IS NULL 
   				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAPA', N'PROC', 22
					return -1
				end

			IF @sNew_apa_charge IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAPA', N'PROC', 23
					return -1
				end
		end

/* If updateing, check non-updateable values */
	IF @sInsupddel = N'UPD' 
		begin
			IF @sNew_apa_arrangement <> @sOld_apa_arrangement OR @sNew_apa_parclass <> @sOld_apa_parclass 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAPA', N'PROC', 2
					return -1
				end
		end	
	IF @sInsupddel in (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PART', @sNew_apa_parclass, @sNew_apa_parclsorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCount OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			if @nCount = 0
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREAPA', N'PROC', 7
					return -1
				end
		end

END

create PROCEDURE O7PREAUT 	@sInsupd		nvarchar(3),
							@sCautgroup		nvarchar(12),
							@sCautuser		nvarchar(255),
							@sCautentity 	nvarchar(4),
							@sCustatent  	nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sCrstatent  	nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sCautstatus	nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sCautstatusnew	nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCautrentity   nvarchar(4) -- r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE; /* R5 entity                      */
	declare @sCtypeent      nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE; /* the corresponding 'type entity'*/
	declare @sCrautstatus   nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;      /* the corresponding 'r'value for */
	declare @sCrautstatnew  nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;      /* the corresponding 'r'value for */
	declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	
	declare @nReturn		int
/* Initialize */
	set @sChk          = '0'
	set @sCtypeent     = NULL
	set @sCustatent    = NULL
	set @sCrstatent    = NULL
	set @sCrautstatus  = NULL
	set @sCrautstatnew = NULL


/* check for mandatory parameters */
	IF	@sInsupd IS NULL
		OR @sInsupd NOT IN ('INS', 'UPD')
		OR (@sCautgroup IS NULL AND @sCautuser IS NULL)
		OR @sCautentity  IS NULL
		OR @sCautstatus  IS NULL
		OR @sCautstatusnew IS NULL  
		Begin
			Set @sChk = '1' 
			RETURN
		End    

	/* First insert test. */
	IF @sInsupd = 'INS' 
		BEGIN
			/* pre_inserts */
			/* Get the 'R5 status entity' of the passed entity value into @sCrstatent */
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sCautrentity OUTPUT, @sCautentity, 'ENT', @sChk  OUTPUT 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @sCautrentity IS NULL 
				Begin
					/* B11124 - entity does not exist */
					set @sChk = N'4'
					RETURN
				End 
			ELSE
				Begin
					execute @nReturn = o7CKSTTP @sCautrentity, @sCrstatent OUTPUT, @sCtypeent OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					IF @sCheckresult = N'0'  
						set @sX = NULL
					ELSE
						Begin
							SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
							IF @sChk = N'2' 
								Begin
									/* B11124 - entity does not exist */
									Set @sChk = N'4' 
									RETURN
								End 
						END						
					
			END		
			/* the entity does not have a 'status entity' */
			IF @sCrstatent IS NULL 
				Begin
					Set @sChk = N'5' 
					RETURN;
				End

			/* B11124 - Entity, status must exist in r5ucodes   */
			/* Get user code for status entity into @sCustatent   */
			/* entity must exist in table r5ucodes */
			Execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCrstatent OUTPUT, @sCustatent OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT

			IF @sCheckresult = N'0'   
				Set @sX = NULL
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
					IF @sChk = N'4'   
						Set @sChk = N'6' 
					RETURN
				END
			/* status must exist in table r5ucodes */
			IF @sCautstatus NOT IN ( '-', '*' )  
				BEGIN
					Execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCrautstatus OUTPUT, @sCautstatus OUTPUT, @sCrstatent, @sCheckresult OUTPUT	
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					IF @sCheckresult = '0'  
						Set @sX = NULL
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
							IF @sChk = '3'  
									Set @sChk = N'7' 
							RETURN
						END
				END
			/* B11125 - Entity, new status must exist in r5ucodes   */
			/* newstatus must exist in table r5ucodes */
			IF @sCautstatusnew NOT IN ( '-', '*' ) 
				Begin
					Execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCrautstatnew OUTPUT, @sCautstatusnew OUTPUT, @sCrstatent, @sCheckresult OUTPUT	
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					IF @sCheckresult = '0'  
						Set @sX = NULL
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
							IF @sChk = '3'  
								Set @sChk = N'8' 
							RETURN
						END
				END 
			/* ------------------------------------------       Beginning of B11126  */
			/* B11126 - Either Group or User must be filled (not both) */
			/* Group and user are both not filled  */
			IF ISNULL( @sCautgroup,' ' )  <> '*'  AND ISNULL( @sCautuser,' ' ) <> '*' 
				BEGIN
					Set @sChk = N'9' 
					RETURN
				END
			/* Group and user are both filled with '*' */
			ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF ISNULL( @sCautgroup,' ' )  = '*' AND ISNULL( @sCautuser,' ' ) = '*'   
						BEGIN
							Set @sChk = N'10' 
							RETURN
						END
				END
			/* ------------------------------------------       End of B11126        */
		END
	ELSE
		/* Now update test. */
		/* No test (B11211, handled in PRE-UPDATE database trigger ) */
		Set @sX = NULL

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PREBCT 
	@sInsupd			nvarchar(4),
	@sJob				nvarchar(30),
	@sAct				numeric(8),
	@sStore				nvarchar(15),
	@sObject			nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
	@sObjectorg			nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
	@sPart				nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
	@sPartorg			nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
	@sLot				nvarchar(12)	OUTPUT,
	@sBin				nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
	@sByasset			nvarchar(1)		OUTPUT,
	@nQty				numeric(24,6),
	@sChk				nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sParfromobj		nvarchar(30) -- r5parts.par_code%TYPE
	declare @sParorgfromobj		nvarchar(15) -- r5parts.par_org%TYPE
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @nAvlqty			numeric(24,6)

	set @sChk = N'0'

	if @sInsupd IS  NULL
	OR @sInsupd <> N'INS'
	OR @sStore IS  NULL
	OR @nQty   IS  NULL  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	if  @sPart IS NULL AND @sObject IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end


	if (    @sJob IS NULL AND @sAct IS NOT NULL ) 
	OR (    @sJob IS NOT NULL AND @sAct IS NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end


	set @sParfromobj = null
	if @sObject IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			from   r5objects
			where  obj_code = @sObject and    obj_org  = @sObjectorg


			if @nCount = 1 
				begin
					select	@sParfromobj = obj_part,
							@sParorgfromobj = obj_part_org
					from   r5objects
					where  obj_code = @sObject and    obj_org  = @sObjectorg
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = N'5'
					return
				end
		end

	set @sByasset = N'+'
	if @sPart IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			from   r5parts
			where  par_code = @sPart and    par_org  = @sPartorg
			if @nCount = 1 
				begin
					select	@sByasset = coalesce(par_byasset,N'-' )
					from   r5parts
					where  par_code = @sPart and    par_org  = @sPartorg
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = N'7'
					return
				end

		end

	if @sJob IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			SELECT @nCount = COUNT( * )
			FROM   r5activities
			WHERE  act_event = @sJob
			AND    act_act   = @sAct
			if @nCount = 0 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'8'
					return
				end
			if @sPart IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					if @sObject IS NOT NULL 
						begin
							if @sPart    <> coalesce( @sParfromobj, N'!@#$%^&*()' ) OR
								@sPartorg <> coalesce( @sParorgfromobj, N'!@#$%^&*()' ) 
									begin
										set @sChk = N'9'
										return
									end
						end
					else
						begin
							if @sByasset <> N'-' 
								begin
									set @sChk = N'11'
									return
								end
						end
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sPart    = @sParfromobj
					set @sPartorg = @sParorgfromobj
					SELECT @sByasset = coalesce( par_byasset, N'-' )
					FROM   r5parts
					WHERE  par_code = @sPart
					AND    par_org  = @sPartorg
					if @sByasset <> N'+' 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'13'
							return
						end
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sPart IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					if @sObject IS NOT NULL
						begin 
							if  @sByasset = N'+'
							AND ( @sPart    <> @sParfromobj OR
							@sPartorg <> @sParorgfromobj )
								begin
									set @sChk = N'14'
									return
								end
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'16'
							return
						end
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sPart = @sParfromobj
					if @sPart IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'17'
							return
						end
				end
		end
	if @sByasset = N'+' 
		begin
			if ABS( @nQty ) <> 1 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'18'
					return
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sBin IS NULL 
				set @sBin = N'*'
			if @sLot IS NULL 
				set @sLot = N'*'

			SELECT @nCount = COUNT(*),
			 @nAvlqty = SUM( bis_qty )
			FROM   r5binstock
			WHERE  bis_store    = @sStore
			AND    bis_part     = @sPart
			AND    bis_part_org = @sPartorg
			AND    bis_lot      = @sLot
			AND    bis_bin      = @sBin
			if @nCount = 0 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'19'
					return
				end
			if @nQty > @nAvlqty 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'20'
					return
				end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PREBDT 
 @sInsupd      nvarchar(4),
 @sBudget      nvarchar(17),
 @sYear        nvarchar(8),
 @nLevel       numeric(1),
 @sPeriod      nvarchar(4),
 @sMrc         nvarchar(15),
 @sLocation    nvarchar(30),
 @sLocationorg nvarchar(15),
 @sObject      nvarchar(30),
 @sObjectorg   nvarchar(15),
 @sJobtype     nvarchar(8),
 @sCosttype    nvarchar(4),
 @sMrcgr       nvarchar(5),
 @sLocationgr  nvarchar(5),
 @sObjectgr    nvarchar(5),
 @sJobtypegr   nvarchar(5),
 @sCosttypegr  nvarchar(5),
 @sCode        nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
 @sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT  
 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit	numeric(4)
	declare @sX			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn	int

BEGIN
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	set @nCountit = 0
	set @sX       = NULL

	IF @sInsupd IS NULL OR @sBudget IS NULL OR @sYear IS NULL OR @nLevel IS NULL OR @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'UPD', N'INS' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sCode IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCode OUTPUT, N'SEQBUD', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
		end

   IF @sJobtype IS NOT NULL 
	   begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'JBTP', @sJobtype, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0 
				set @sX = NULL
			else
				begin

					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'2'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'999'
							return
						end
						
				end

	   end

   IF @sCosttype IS NOT NULL 
	   begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'CSTP', @sCosttype, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0 
				set @sX = NULL
			else
				begin

					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'3'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'999'
							return
						end
						
				end

	   end
END

create PROCEDURE O7PREBOO
   @sInsupd           nvarchar(4),
   @sBookedevent     nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
   @nBookedact       int			OUTPUT,
   @dBookeddate      datetime,
   @sBookedperson    nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
   @sBookedtrade     nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
   @sBookedmrc       nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
   @sBookeddoctype   nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
   @sBookedocrtype   nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
   @sBookedcorrect   nvarchar(2),  /* PVCS 2495  Paul van Gastel Multiple trade rates */
   @nBookedon        int			OUTPUT, 
   @nBookedoff       int			OUTPUT,
   @nBookedhours     numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
   @nBookedrate      numeric(24,6)  OUTPUT,
   @nBookedcost      numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
   @sUgrcorrbook     nvarchar(15),
   @sMisc            nvarchar(1),
   @sChk             nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
   @sUnmatchedinv    nvarchar(30)
                                          
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @dEvtreport           datetime /* Date when event reported          */
	declare @dEvtstart            datetime /* datetime when event set to/or started */
	declare @dEvtcompleted        datetime /* datetime when event completed         */
	declare @sEvtrstatus          nvarchar(4) --r5events.evt_rstatus%TYPE        /* rStatus of event  */
	declare @sActorder            nvarchar(30)--r5activities.act_order%TYPE      /* Order Number      */
	declare @sActorderorg         nvarchar(30)--r5activities.act_order_org%TYPE  /* Order org.        */
	declare @sActhire             nvarchar(1)--r5activities.act_hire%TYPE = N''
	declare @sEvtorg              nvarchar(15)--r5events.evt_org%TYPE = N''
	declare @nNprdays             int
	declare @nComdays             int
	declare @nTemprate            numeric(30,6)
	declare @sDummy               nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrlordprice         nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrlrecprice         nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrlexch             nvarchar(30)
	declare @sX                   nvarchar(1) 
	declare @sCheckresult         nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOrderlinertype      nvarchar(8)--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @nOrlordprice         numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOrlrecprice         numeric(24,6)
	declare @nOrlexch             numeric(24,12)
	declare @sChkwarning          nvarchar(4)
	declare @dTempdate				datetime
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sTemp					nvarchar(120)
	declare @sBookedact				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sBookdate            nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE := UPPER( NVL(o7dflt( 'BOOKDATE', chk ), 'ON') );
	declare @sRouteparent         nvarchar(30)  --r5events.evt_routeparent%TYPE
	declare @sEvent               nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRCPTCURR            nvarchar(400)
	declare @sCurrency            nvarchar(3)
	declare @sInternalLabor       nvarchar(80)


	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sX = NULL
	set @sChkwarning = null
	set @sBookdate = UPPER( coalesce(dbo.O7DFLT2( N'BOOKDATE'), N'ON') )
	set @sRCPTCURR = UPPER( dbo.O7DFLT2( N'RCPTCURR') )	

	/* Checking for Mandatory fields */
	if @dBookeddate IS NULL OR @sInsupd IS NULL OR @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR (@sBookeddoctype IS NULL AND @sBookedocrtype IS NULL) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	/* W03114  if person null  evt+act mandatory */
	if  @sBookedperson  IS NULL AND ( @sBookedevent IS NULL OR  @nBookedact   IS NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	/* W03125 - Get Occupation rType: has been nullified by trigger */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sBookedocrtype OUTPUT, @sBookeddoctype OUTPUT, N'OCTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'5'
			return
		end

/*  Get event details */
	if @sBookedevent IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*) 
			FROM   r5events e
			WHERE  e.evt_code = @sBookedevent
   
			if @nCount > 0 
				begin
					if @nCount = 1 
						begin
							SELECT @dEvtreport = e.evt_reported,
								@dEvtstart = e.evt_start,
								@dEvtcompleted = CASE e.evt_rstatus WHEN N'C' THEN e.evt_completed ELSE NULL END,
								@sEvtrstatus = e.evt_rstatus,
								@sEvtorg = e.evt_org,
								@sRouteparent = e.evt_routeparent
							FROM   r5events e
							WHERE  e.evt_code = @sBookedevent
							exec o7getorgoption @sInternalLabor OUT,'ACTHINTL', @sEvtorg, @sChk 
						end
					else
						begin 
							set @sChk = N'998'
							return
						end
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = N'12'
					return
				end
		end   
	/* W0312L - Event and activity are mandatory unless occ. type N'@sX' If occ type is 'X' and misc flag ='+' wo/act are required as well*/ 
	if @sBookedocrtype IN ( N'N', N'O', N'CN', N'CO', N'*' )  or (@sBookedocrtype = 'X' AND  @sMisc = '+' )
		begin
			if ( @sBookedevent IS NULL OR   @nBookedact   IS NULL ) 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'11'
					RETURN
				end
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sBookedevent IS NOT NULL OR  @nBookedact IS NOT NULL 
				set @sChk = N'33'  -- warning e.g. in WDBKEV when occ. type ='@sX'.
				-- this is further processed below when all other checks passed,
				-- otherwise event/act set to NULL erroneously (search on 33)
		end

	/* Number of days non-productive hours can be booked in the past */
	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'NPRDAYS'

	if @nCount = 1 
		SELECT @nNprdays = ins_desc
		FROM   r5install
		WHERE  ins_code = N'NPRDAYS'
	else
		set @nNprdays = 0

	/* Number of days hours can be booked after completion of job */
	select @nCount = count(*) 
	FROM   r5install
	WHERE  ins_code = N'COMDAYS'

	if @nCount = 1 
      SELECT @nComdays = ins_desc
      FROM   r5install
      WHERE  ins_code = N'COMDAYS'
	else
		set @nComdays = 0

	/* W0312C - Both BOO_ON and BOO_OFF must be entered or not */
	if ( ( @nBookedon       IS NULL	  AND @nBookedoff  IS NOT NULL ) OR 	( @nBookedoff      IS NULL 		  AND @nBookedon   IS NOT NULL ) ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'6'
			RETURN
		end

	/* W0312E W0322E - if BOO_HOURS is NULL  calculate it.If it is correction, user can not change the hours, so no calculation here.*/
	if  @nBookedon  IS NOT NULL   AND @nBookedoff IS NOT NULL AND coalesce(@sBookedcorrect,N'-') = N'-'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7BOOTIM @nBookedhours OUTPUT, @nBookedon , @nBookedoff, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
				begin
					set @sChk = N'992'
					return
				end
		end

	/* W03125 - Get Occupation rType  */
	if @sBookeddoctype IS NOT NULL 
		set @sBookedocrtype = NULL
	
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sBookedocrtype OUTPUT, @sBookeddoctype OUTPUT, N'OCTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'5'
			return
		end

	IF @sBookdate = N'ON' 
		begin
			/* W03124 - Check whether BOO_DATE <= SYSTEM_DATE */
			if @sInsupd = N'INS' 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sEvtorg 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1

					if @dBookeddate > @dTempdate AND @sBookedocrtype <> N'X' 
						begin

create procedure O7PREBUD
	@sInsupd		nvarchar(4),
	@sCode        	nvarchar(17),
	@sYear         	nvarchar(8),
	@sRstatusnew   	nvarchar(4),
	@sRstatusold   	nvarchar(4),
	@nAmount       	numeric(24,6),
	@nOriginal     	numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sAuth         	nvarchar(255) OUTPUT,
	@dAuthdate     	DATETIME OUTPUT ,
	@sRapuser       nvarchar(255),
	@sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
   
   
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCodecal               nvarchar(2)		--r5calendars.cal_code%TYPE
	declare @sYearcal               nvarchar(2)		--r5calendars.cal_code%TYPE
	declare @sCodeorg               nvarchar(15)	--r5organization.org_code%TYPE
	declare @nCount					int
	declare	@nReturn				int
begin
	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk			= N'0'
	set @nCount			= 0

	/* Check all mandatory parameters are supplied */
	IF @sInsupd     IS NULL OR @sCode      IS NULL OR @sYear      IS NULL OR @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'UPD', N'INS' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	/* Calendar of budget should be equal to calendar of year */
	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5budgetstructure
	WHERE  bus_code = @sCode
	If @nCount = 1 
		SELECT @sCodecal = bus_cal, @sCodeorg = bus_org
		FROM   r5budgetstructure
		WHERE  bus_code = @sCode
	else
		set @sCodecal = N'a'

	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5years
	WHERE  acy_year = @sYear
	If @nCount = 1 
		SELECT @sYearcal = acy_cal
		FROM   r5years
		WHERE  acy_year = @sYear
	else
		set @sYearcal = N'b'

	IF @sCodecal <> @sYearcal 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end


	/* U1010 - On approval original amount, authorizer and approval date should
	be entered. */
	IF @sRstatusnew = N'40' AND @sRstatusold <> N'40' 
		begin
			set @nOriginal = @nAmount
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dAuthdate OUTPUT, @sCodeorg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1

			set @dAuthdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dAuthdate, N'DD' )
			set @sAuth     = coalesce( @sAuth, @sRapuser )
		end
end

create PROCEDURE O7PRECAT 
   @sInspud        nvarchar(4),
   @nGross         numeric(24,6),
   @nPurprice      numeric(24,6)			OUTPUT,
   @dExppurpr      datetime,
   @sPart          nvarchar(30),
   @sPartorg       nvarchar(15),
   @dDate          datetime		OUTPUT,
   @sSupplier      nvarchar(30),
   @sSupplierorg   nvarchar(15),
   @dExpquot       datetime		OUTPUT,
   @nQuotprice     numeric(24,6)			OUTPUT,
   @sQuotuom       nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
   @sNotused       nvarchar(15),
   @sChk           nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT
   
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nDiscperc		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nDiscount		numeric(24,6)
	declare @dTempdate		datetime
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @nCalprice		numeric(24,6)    -- Calculated purchase price
	declare @nRedDiscperc	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRedDiscount	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nReturn		int

	-- Initialize
	set @sChk        = N'0'
	set @sX          = NULL

	-- Check for Mandatory Parameters
	if @sInspud IS NULL OR @sPart IS NULL OR @sSupplier IS NULL OR @sInspud NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	-- S03115 - Date = System Date
	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sSupplierorg
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		RETURN -1
	set @dDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate, N'DD' )


	-- S03124 - Quotation Price, Quotation Expiration Date and
	--          Quotation UOM must be equal to Price, Quotation
	--          Expiration date, UOM of r5quotlines respectively
	-- Initialize
	set @nQuotprice = @sX
	set @dExpquot   = @sX
	set @sQuotuom   = @sX
	
	-- Assign values from r5quotlines
	select @nCount = Count(*)	
	FROM   r5quotlines      q1,
		 r5quotations     q3
	WHERE  q1.qul_quotation    = q3.quo_code
	AND    q1.qul_seqno        = q3.quo_seqno
	AND    q3.quo_supplier     = @sSupplier
	AND    q3.quo_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
	AND    q1.qul_part         = @sPart
	AND    q1.qul_part_org     = @sPartorg
	AND    q1.qul_expir IN ( SELECT MAX( q2.qul_expir )
						   FROM   r5quotlines q2
						   WHERE  q1.qul_quotation = q2.qul_quotation
						   AND    q1.qul_seqno     = q2.qul_seqno
						   AND    q1.qul_part      = q2.qul_part
						   AND    q1.qul_part_org  = q2.qul_part_org  )

	if @nCount = 1 
		SELECT @nQuotprice = q1.qul_price,
			 @dExpquot = q1.qul_expir,
			 @sQuotuom = q1.qul_quotuom
		FROM   r5quotlines      q1,
			 r5quotations     q3
		WHERE  q1.qul_quotation    = q3.quo_code
		AND    q1.qul_seqno        = q3.quo_seqno
		AND    q3.quo_supplier     = @sSupplier
		AND    q3.quo_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
		AND    q1.qul_part         = @sPart
		AND    q1.qul_part_org     = @sPartorg
		AND    q1.qul_expir IN ( SELECT MAX( q2.qul_expir )
							   FROM   r5quotlines q2
							   WHERE  q1.qul_quotation = q2.qul_quotation
							   AND    q1.qul_seqno     = q2.qul_seqno
							   AND    q1.qul_part      = q2.qul_part
							   AND    q1.qul_part_org  = q2.qul_part_org  )
	else
		set @sX = NULL

	-- S03113 - Purchase Price = Gross Price
	if @sInspud = N'INS' 
		set @nPurprice = @nGross

	-- S0323 - Calculating Purchase Price from r5reductions
	if @sInspud = N'UPD' 
		begin
			
			DECLARE cCalcpurprice CURSOR LOCAL FOR SELECT r.red_discperc,
						   r.red_discount
					FROM   r5reductions r
					WHERE  r.red_supplier     = @sSupplier
					AND    r.red_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
					AND    r.red_part         = @sPart
					AND    r.red_part_org     = @sPartorg
					ORDER BY red_line

			set @nCalprice = @nGross
			OPEN cCalcpurprice
			FETCH NEXT FROM cCalcpurprice INTO @nRedDiscperc, @nRedDiscount
			WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				BEGIN
					set @nDiscperc = coalesce( @nRedDiscperc, 0 )
					set @nDiscount = coalesce( @nRedDiscount, 0 )
					set @nCalprice = ROUND( @nCalprice * ( 1 - @nDiscperc / 100 ) - @nDiscount , 2 )
					FETCH NEXT FROM cCalcpurprice INTO @nRedDiscperc, @nRedDiscount
				END
			set @nPurprice = @nCalprice
			CLOSE cCalcpurprice
			DEALLOCATE cCalcpurprice
		end

create PROCEDURE O7PRECDI
	@sInsupd         nvarchar(4),
	@sCditype        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sCdirtype       nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sCdicontract    nvarchar(30),
	@nCdivalue       numeric(24,6),
	@nCdipurqty      numeric(24,6),
	@dCdistartdt     DATETIME,
	@dCdienddt       DATETIME,
	@sCdipart        nvarchar(30),
	@sCdipartorg     nvarchar(15),
	@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @dConstartdt		datetime												-- Contract Start datetime
	declare @dConenddt			datetime												-- Contract End datetime
	declare @sConrstatus		nvarchar(4)		-- r5contracts.con_rstatus%TYPE			-- Contract rstatus
	declare @sConsupplier		nvarchar(30)	-- r5contracts.con_supplier%TYPE		-- Contract Supplier
	declare @sConsupplierorg	nvarchar(15)	-- r5contracts.con_supplier_org%TYPE	-- Contract Supplier org
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nCount				int

	/* Initialise */
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @nCountit     = 0
	set @sX           = NULL

	/* Check for Mandatory Parameters */
	IF @sInsupd       NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		OR @sInsupd       IS  NULL
		OR ( @sCditype   IS  NULL AND @sCdirtype IS  NULL )
		OR @sCdicontract IS  NULL
		OR @dCdistartdt  IS  NULL
		OR @dCdienddt    IS  NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	/* C1322D - If rType = L/P  part code is required */
	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			IF @sCdirtype IN ( N'L', N'P' ) 
				begin
					IF @sCdipart IS NULL OR @sCdipartorg IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'12'
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end

	/* C13227, C13228 get supplier */
	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		SELECT	@sConsupplier = o.con_supplier,
				@sConsupplierorg = o.con_supplier_org
		FROM	r5contracts    o
		WHERE	o.con_code   = @sCdicontract


	/* ------------------- Beginning of Common Conditions for N'INS' and N'UPD' */
	/* C13224 - Contract rstatus should be N'U' */
	execute @nReturn = O7EXISTC N'CONT', N'*', @sCdicontract, N'U', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @nCountit = 0   
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end
	else
		begin 
			if @nCountit = -1 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'2'
					RETURN
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = @sCheckresult
					RETURN
				end
		end

	/* C13229/A - If quantity is NOT NULL  Value should be  */
	/*                         NULL and vice versa.             */
	if @nCdipurqty IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			if @nCdivalue IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'4'
					RETURN
				end
		end 
	else
		begin
			if @nCdivalue IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'5'
					RETURN
				end
		end 

	/* ----------------------------------------------- End of Common Conditions */

	if @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		/* C13223 - Type must exist (r5ucodes) */
		set @sCdirtype = NULL
		execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCdirtype OUTPUT, @sCditype OUTPUT, N'DITP', @sChk OUTPUT
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1

		if @sChk <> N'0' 
			begin
				set @sChk = N'6'
				RETURN
			end 


		/* C1322B/C - start and end datetime for contract discounts should be same as */
		/*            contract start and end datetime                                 */
		select @nCount = count(*) 
		FROM    r5contracts c
		WHERE   c.con_code = @sCdicontract

		if @nCount > 0 
			begin
				SELECT  @dConstartdt = c.con_start,
					 @dConenddt = c.con_end
				FROM    r5contracts c
				WHERE   c.con_code = @sCdicontract

				if dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dConstartdt, N'DD' ) <> dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dCdistartdt, N'DD' ) 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'9'
					RETURN
				end 
				if dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dConenddt, N'DD' ) <> dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dCdienddt, N'DD' ) 
				begin	set @sChk = N'10'
					RETURN
				end 
			end
		else
			begin
				if @nCount = 0 
					begin
						set @sChk = N'11'
						RETURN
					end
				else
					begin
						set @sChk = N'998'
						RETURN 
					end
			end

create procedure O7PRECLP
	@sInsupd	nvarchar(4),
	@dClpclosed	DATETIME,
	@sChk		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sX					nvarchar( 50 )
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @dTempDate			datetime
	declare @sClpclosed			nvarchar(32)

BEGIN
	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0' 
	set @nCountit     =  0  
	set @sCheckresult = NULL
	set @sX           = NULL

	/* check for mandatory parameters */
	IF Coalesce( @sInsupd, N'XXX' ) NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR @dClpclosed IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	/* update not allowed */
	IF @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'900'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			/* P15112 closing date <= system date */
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, null
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					RETURN -1

			IF dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dClpclosed, N'DD' ) > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempDate, N'DD' ) 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					RETURN
				end

			/* P15113 closing date > all existing closing date */
			set @sClpclosed = Cast(@dClpclosed as nvarchar(32))
			execute @nReturn = O7EXISTP N'CLP', N'1', N'*', @sClpclosed, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

				if @nCountit = 0
						SET @sX = null
				else
					begin
						if @nCountit > 0
							begin
								SET @sChk = N'4'
								return
							end 
						else
							begin
								SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end

			/* P15121  Check for non existence of goods received transactions with */
			/*          rstatus = N'U' and conflicting date (r5transactions) */
			set @sClpclosed = Cast(@dClpclosed as nvarchar(32))
			execute @nReturn = O7EXISTP N'CLP', N'2', N'*', N'COMP', N'STOR', N'U', @sClpclosed, N'G', @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

				if @nCountit = 0
					SET @sX = null
				else
					begin
						if @nCountit > 0
							begin
								SET @sChk = N'5'
								return
							end 
						else
							begin
								SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end

			/* P15122  Check for non existence of goods returned transactions with */
			/*          rstatus = N'U' and conflicting date (r5transactions) */
			set @sClpclosed = Cast(@dClpclosed as nvarchar(32))
			execute @nReturn = O7EXISTP N'CLP', N'3', N'*', N'STOR', N'COMP', N'U', @sClpclosed, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

				if @nCountit = 0
					SET @sX = null
				else
					begin
						if @nCountit > 0
							begin
								SET @sChk = N'6'
								return
							end 
						else
							begin
								SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end
		end
END

create PROCEDURE O7PRECON
	@sInsupd      nvarchar(4),
	@sOrg         nvarchar(15),
	@dConcreate   datetime OUTPUT,
	@sConstatus   nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
	@sConrstatus  nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
   
 AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sConstatent		nvarchar(4)  --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE   /* Status Entity for Contract */
	declare @sContypeent		nvarchar(4)  --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE   /* Type Entity for Contract */
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @sX				nvarchar( 1 )
	declare @nReturn	int
	declare @dTempdate datetime

	/* Initialise */
    set @sChk         = N'0'
    set @sCheckresult = N'0'
    set @nCountit     = 0
    set @sX           = NULL
    set @sConstatent = @sX
    set @sContypeent = @sX

	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInsupd IS NULL OR @sInsupd NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR @sConstatus IS NULL 
		begin
		   set @sChk = N'1'
		   RETURN
		end

	/* Retrieve Status Entity from r5entities for CONTRACTS     */
    execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'CONT', @sConstatent OUTPUT, @sContypeent OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	/* Error in N'o7cksttp' routine */
	IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
		Begin
			set @sChk = @sCheckresult
			RETURN
		end

	/* Status Entity was not found in N'r5entities' */
	IF @sConstatent IS NULL 
		begin 
			set @sChk = N'3'
			RETURN
		end

	/* C10225 / C10323 - Status must e@sXists (r5ucodes) */
    set @sConrstatus = @sX
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sConrstatus OUTPUT, @sConstatus OUTPUT, @sConstatent, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	/* Status does not e@sXists in N'r5ucodes' */
	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end

	/* C1021E - Set creation date to system date  */
	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		RETURN -1

	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dConcreate, N'DD' ) <> dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate, N'DD' ) 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
			set @dConcreate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate, N'DD' )
		end

create PROCEDURE O7PRECPA
   @sInsupd       nvarchar(4),
   @sContract     nvarchar(30),
   @sPart         nvarchar(30),
   @sPartorg      nvarchar(15),
   @sChk          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
   
 AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sConrstatus     nvarchar(4) --r5contracts.con_rstatus%TYPE    /* Contract rstatus    */
	declare @nCountit         numeric(4)
	declare @sCheckresult     nvarchar(4 )
	declare @sConsupplier    nvarchar(30) --r5contracts.con_supplier%TYPE
	declare @sConsupplierorg nvarchar(15) --r5contracts.con_supplier_org%TYPE
	declare @dConstart       DATETIME
	declare @dConend       DATETIME
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @nReturn			int

	/* Initialise */
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @nCountit     = 0

	/* Check for Mandatory Parameters */
	IF @sInsupd NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR @sInsupd IS NULL OR @sPart IS NULL OR @sPartorg IS NULL OR @sContract IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	/* Following checks only valid on insert, so return on update. */
	IF @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		RETURN

	/* Get supplier and status of contract. */
	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5contracts o
	WHERE  o.con_code = @sContract

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @sConrstatus=  o.con_rstatus,
			  @sConsupplier = o.con_supplier,
			  @sConsupplierorg = o.con_supplier_org,
			  @dConstart = o.con_start,
			  @dConend = o.con_end
		FROM   r5contracts o
		WHERE  o.con_code = @sContract

	else
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		END

	/* C15224 - Status of contract should be N'U' on insert and update. */
	IF @sConrstatus <> N'U' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3'
			RETURN
		end

create PROCEDURE O7PRECRR 
					@sInsupd	nvarchar(4),
					@sCurr		nvarchar(30),
					@dNewend	datetime OUTPUT,
					@dNewstart	datetime OUTPUT,
					@sOrgcurr	nvarchar(30),
					@sChk		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @dTempdate		datetime
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sStartDate		nvarchar(32)
	declare @sEndDate		nvarchar(32)

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk       = N'0'
	set @sX           = NULL
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'

	/* Check that mandatory parameters are supplied */
	IF @sInsupd IS NULL OR @sCurr IS NULL OR @dNewend IS NULL OR @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	/* S26121 - Only one exchange rate is active for currency */
	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			set @sStartDate = cast(@dNewstart as nvarchar(32))
			set @sEndDate = cast(@dNewend as nvarchar(32))
			execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'CURR', N'*', @sCurr, N'EXCH', @sOrgcurr, @sStartDate , @sEndDate, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

				if @nCountit = 0
					set @sX = null
				else
					begin
						if @nCountit > 0
							begin
								SET @sChk = N'9'
								return
							end
						else
							begin
								SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end

			/* S26218 - End date must be later than or equal to system date, added minus 1 to offset time zone */
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, null
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1

			IF dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dNewend, N'DD'  ) < @dTempdate -1
			begin
				set @sChk = N'4'
				RETURN
			end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PREDCK
	@sInsupd           nvarchar(4),			/*Insert or Update*/
	@sDockorg          nvarchar(15),		/*On-dock receipt organisation*/
	@sRstatusold       nvarchar(4),			/*Old Rstatus code*/
	@sSupp             nvarchar(30),		/*Supplier code*/
	@sSupporg          nvarchar(15),		/*Supplier organisation*/
	@sOrder            nvarchar(30),		/*Purchase order number*/
	@sOrdorg           nvarchar(15),		/*Purchase order organisation code*/
	@dRecvdate         datetime,			/*Received Date*/
	@sNewclass         nvarchar(8),			/*New Dock class*/
	@sNewclassorg      nvarchar(15),		/*New Dock class Organisation*/
	@sOldclass         nvarchar(8),			/*Old dock class*/
	@sOldclassorg      nvarchar(15),		/*Old dock class organisation*/
	@sDockid           nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,	/*On-dock receipt id*/
	@sStatusnew        nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,	/*New Status code*/
	@sRstatusnew       nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,	/*New Rstatus code*/
	@dDckcreated       datetime		OUTPUT	/*Dock created date*/

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @dCloseperiod	datetime
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(2)
	declare @dTempdate		datetime
	declare @nReturn		int

	set @sX = NULL
	set @nCountit = 0

	if @sInsupd NOT IN ('INS','UPD')
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sDockorg
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		RETURN -1

    if dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dRecvdate, N'DD') > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 3
			return -1
		end

	if @sNewclass is NOT NULL
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'DOCK', @sNewclass, @sNewclassorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = NULL
			ELSE
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 10
							return -1
						end
				end
		end

	if @dDckcreated IS NULL
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sDockorg
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1

			set @dDckcreated = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')
		end

	SELECT @dCloseperiod = MAX( c.clp_closed )
	FROM   r5closedperiods c
	if @dRecvdate  <= @dCloseperiod AND @sRstatusnew <> N'C'
		begin
			SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
			FROM   r5docklines
			WHERE  dkl_dckcode = @sDockid
			AND    dkl_linerstatus NOT IN ( N'A', N'C' );
			if @nCountit > 0
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 11
					return -1
				end
		end

	if @sInsupd = N'INS'
		begin
			if @sDockid IS NULL
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sDockid OUTPUT, N'DOCK', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1

					if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 6
							return -1
						end
				end

			if @sStatusnew IS NOT NULL
				begin
					set @sRstatusnew = N'U'
					set @sStatusnew = @sX
				end

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatusnew OUTPUT, @sStatusnew OUTPUT, N'DKST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 2
					return -1
				end
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			IF @sInsupd = N'UPD'
				begin
					if @sRstatusnew = N'C'
						begin
							SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
							FROM   r5docklines d
							WHERE  d.dkl_dckcode = @sDockid
							AND    d.dkl_linerstatus <> N'U'
					        AND    d.dkl_linerstatus <> N'C'


							if @nCountit > 0
								begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 6
									return -1
								end
						end

					/*Status changed from R to U is not allowed*/
					if @sRstatusold = N'R' AND @sRstatusnew = N'U'
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 8
							return -1
						end

					/*No updation is allowed approved status*/
					if @sRstatusold = N'A' AND @sRstatusold <> @sRstatusnew
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 7
							return -1
						end

					/*All lines should be approved*/
					if @sRstatusnew = N'A'
					begin
						SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
						FROM   r5docklines d
						WHERE  d.dkl_dckcode = @sDockid
						AND    d.dkl_linerstatus IN('U','R')
						if @nCountit > 0
							begin
								execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 9
								return -1
							end
					end

					if @sStatusnew IS NOT NULL
						set @sRstatusnew = @sX

					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatusnew OUTPUT, @sStatusnew OUTPUT, N'DKST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
					if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR 'O7PREDCK', N'PROC', 2
							return -1
						end


				end
		end
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PREDEB	@sInsupddel			nvarchar(3),
							@sOld_deb_code		nvarchar(30),
							@sOld_deb_org		nvarchar(15),
							@sOld_deb_class		nvarchar(8),
							@sOld_deb_clsorg	nvarchar(15),
							@sOld_deb_curr		nvarchar(3),
							@sOld_deb_desc		nvarchar(80),
							@sOld_deb_tax		nvarchar(8),
							@sNew_deb_code		nvarchar(30),
							@sNew_deb_org		nvarchar(15),
							@sNew_deb_class		nvarchar(8),
							@sNew_deb_clsorg	nvarchar(15),
							@sNew_deb_curr		nvarchar(3) OUTPUT,
							@sNew_deb_desc		nvarchar(80),
							@sNew_deb_tax		nvarchar(8)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nNcount		INT
    declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
    declare @nNFPA			INT
    declare @nNcev			INT
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn		int 

	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInsupddel IS NULL OR @sInsupddel NOT IN ('INS', 'UPD', 'DEL')
		BEGIN
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDEB', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		END

	/* If not deleting then check mandatory fields  */
	IF @sInsupddel IN (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		BEGIN
			IF @sNew_deb_code IS NULL  
				BEGIN
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDEB', N'PROC', 21
					return -1
				END
			IF @sNew_deb_desc IS NULL  
				BEGIN
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDEB', N'PROC', 22
					return -1
				END
		END

	/* If updateing, check non-updateable values */
	IF @sInsupddel = N'UPD'
		BEGIN
		  IF @sNew_deb_code <> @sOld_deb_code 
			BEGIN
			  execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDEB', N'PROC', 2
			  return -1
			END
		END 

	/*  If Class exists in r5classes    */
	IF @sNew_deb_class IS NOT NULL  
		BEGIN
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'DEB', @sNew_deb_class, @sNew_deb_clsorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nNcount OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			IF @nNcount  =  0   
				BEGIN
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDEB', N'PROC', 3
					return -1
				END
		END

	/* Set default currency, if null */
	IF @sNew_deb_curr IS NULL AND @sNew_deb_org IS NOT NULL  
		BEGIN
		  
			select	@nNcount = count(*)
			FROM  r5install  i
			WHERE  i.ins_code = @sCode

			if @nNcount = 0
				set @sNew_deb_curr = NULL
			else
				begin
					if @nNcount = 1
						BEGIN
						  SELECT @sNew_deb_curr = org_curr
						  FROM   r5organization
						  WHERE  org_code = @sNew_deb_org
						END
					else
						set @sNew_deb_curr = NULL
				end
		END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PREDKL
	@sInsupd				nvarchar(4),
	@sDockcode				nvarchar(30),
	@sStatusnew				nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT,
	@sRstatusold			nvarchar(4),
	@sRstatusnew			nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT,
	@sIstatusnew			nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT,
	@sIrstatusnew			nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT,
	@sOrder					nvarchar(15),
	@sOrdline				nvarchar(8),
	@sOrdorg				nvarchar(15),
	@sPart					nvarchar(30),
	@sPartorg				nvarchar(15),
	@nRecvqty				numeric(24,6),
	@nRetqty				numeric(24,6),
	@nCtqty					numeric(24,6),
	@sBin					nvarchar(15),
	@sObjcode				nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
	@sObjrtype				nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
	@sObjtype				nvarchar(4),
	@sObjorg				nvarchar(4),
	@sRejreason				nvarchar(4),
	@sMrc					nvarchar(4)

AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCheckresult			nvarchar(4)            
	declare @nCountit				integer 
	declare @sX						nvarchar(1) 
	declare @sAsstflg				nvarchar(1) 
	declare @nReturn				integer


	set @sX = null
	set @sAsstflg = null

	if @sInsupd NOT IN (N'INS',N'UPD') 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end


	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatusnew OUTPUT, @sStatusnew OUTPUT, N'DLST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin 
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 2
			return -1
		end


	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sIrstatusnew OUTPUT, @sIstatusnew OUTPUT, N'IPST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin 
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 2
			return -1
		end


	SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
	FROM     r5parts p
	WHERE    p.par_code = @sPart
	AND      p.par_org  = @sPartorg
	AND      p.par_byasset = N'+' 

	if @nCountit > 0 
		begin
			set @sAsstflg = N'Y'
			if @nRecvqty <> 1 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 3
					return -1
				end
		end

	if @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			if @sRstatusnew <> N'U' 
				begin
					set @sRstatusnew = N'U'
				end
			if @nRetqty > @nCtqty 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 6
					return -1
				end
			if @nRetqty > 0 AND @sRejreason IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 7
					return -1
				end
			if @sAsstflg = N'Y' 
				begin
					if @sObjcode IS NOT NULL AND @sObjrtype IS NULL 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 10
							return -1
						end
				end
		end

	if @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			if @sRstatusnew = N'R' AND @sRstatusold = N'U' 
				begin

					SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
					FROM   r5orderlines o, r5parts p
					WHERE  o.orl_order = @sOrder
					AND    o.orl_ordline = @sOrdline
					AND    o.orl_order_org = @sOrdorg
					AND      o.orl_rtype = N'PS'
					AND      p.par_code = @sPart
					AND      p.par_org  = @sPartorg
					AND      p.par_byasset = N'-'
					AND      p.par_bylot   = N'+' 


					if @nCountit > 0 AND @nRetqty <> @nCtqty 
						begin
						if @sBin IS NULL 
							begin
								execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 9
								return -1
							end
						end

					if @nRetqty > @nCtqty 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 6
							return -1
						end
					end
					if @nRetqty > 0 AND @sRejreason IS NULL 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREDKL', N'PROC', 7
							return -1
						end
				end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PREDOC(	@sInsUpd		NVARCHAR(3),
							@scType			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,  --:new.doc_type,
							@scRtype		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,  --:new.doc_rtype,
							@scDocClass		NVARCHAR(8),
							@scDocClsOrg	NVARCHAR(15),
							@sChk			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT)

AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	
	DECLARE @nCountit		INT
	DECLARE @sCheckResult	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sX				NVARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @nReturn		INT

	-- Initialize
	SET @sChk = N'0'
	SET @nCountit = 0
	SET @sCheckResult = N'0'
	SET @sX = NULL

	-- mandatory parameters missing 
	IF @sInsUpd IS NULL OR @sInsUpd NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )
	BEGIN
		SET @sChk = N'1'
		RETURN
	END

	-- type and rtype must exist 
	SET @scRtype  = NULL
	EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @scRtype OUTPUT, @scType, N'DOTP', @sCheckResult OUTPUT
	IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
		RETURN -1

	IF @sCheckResult <> '0'
	BEGIN
		SET @sChk = N'4'
		RETURN
	END

	-- (B21121 and B21221) Class must exist
	IF @scDocClass IS NOT NULL
	BEGIN
		EXECUTE @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'DOCU', @scDocClass, @scDocClsOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckResult OUTPUT
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
			RETURN -1

		IF @nCountit <= 0
			BEGIN
				IF @nCountit = 0   
					BEGIN
						SET @sChk = N'3'
						RETURN
					END
				ELSE
					BEGIN
						SET @sChk = @sCheckResult
						RETURN
					END
			END
	END
END

create PROCEDURE O7PREEIL
      @sInsupddel					nvarchar(4),
      @sOld_eil_eventcode			nvarchar(30),
      @sOld_eil_eventincrement		numeric(4),
      @sOld_eil_invoice				nvarchar(30),
      @sOld_eil_line				numeric(8),
      @sOld_eil_paymentagreement	nvarchar(30),
      @sOld_eil_paymentline			numeric(8),
      @sOld_eil_price				numeric(24,6),
      @sNew_eil_eventcode			nvarchar(30),
      @sNew_eil_eventincrement		numeric(4),
      @sNew_eil_invoice				nvarchar(30),
      @sNew_eil_line				numeric(8),
      @sNew_eil_paymentagreement	nvarchar(30),
      @sNew_eil_paymentline			numeric(8),
      @sNew_eil_price				numeric(24,6)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sEIVStatus			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nCount			int

BEGIN
	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInsupddel IS NULL OR @sInsupddel NOT IN (N'INS', N'UPD', N'DEL') 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	/* If not deleting  check mandatory fields  */
	IF @sInsupddel IN ('INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			/* Check mandatory fields  */
			IF @sNew_eil_invoice IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 21
					return -1
				end

			IF @sNew_eil_line IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 22
					return -1
				end

			IF @sNew_eil_price IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 23
					return -1
				end

			/* Event and fixed payment should not both be entered. */
			IF @sNew_eil_eventcode IS NOT NULL AND @sNew_eil_paymentagreement IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 71
					return -1
				end

			/* Payment key should be complete */
			IF @sNew_eil_paymentagreement IS NOT NULL AND @sNew_eil_paymentline IS NULL OR @sNew_eil_paymentagreement IS NULL AND @sNew_eil_paymentline IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 72
					return -1
				end

		end

	/* Update are not allowed */
	IF @sInsupddel = N'UPD' 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 2
			return -1
		end

	/* If inserting */
	IF @sInsupddel = N'INS' 
		begin
			/* Progress status of event or payment to be invoiced */
			IF @sNew_eil_eventcode IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					select @nCount = count(*)
					from r5calcevents
					WHERE  cev_event = @sNew_eil_eventcode
					AND    cev_increment = @sNew_eil_eventincrement
					AND    cev_rstatus IN (N'U', N'A')
					
					if @nCount = 1
						UPDATE r5calcevents
						SET    cev_rstatus = N'I', cev_status = NULL
						WHERE  cev_event = @sNew_eil_eventcode
						AND    cev_increment = @sNew_eil_eventincrement
						AND    cev_rstatus IN (N'U', N'A')
					else
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 61
							return -1
						end
				end

			IF @sNew_eil_paymentagreement IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					select @nCount = count(*)
					from r5fixedpayments
					WHERE  fpa_agreement = @sNew_eil_paymentagreement
						AND    fpa_line = @sNew_eil_paymentline
						AND    fpa_rstatus = N'A'
					
					if @nCount = 1
						UPDATE r5fixedpayments
						SET    fpa_rstatus = N'I', fpa_status = NULL
						WHERE  fpa_agreement = @sNew_eil_paymentagreement
						AND    fpa_line = @sNew_eil_paymentline
						AND    fpa_rstatus = N'A'
					else
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 62
							return -1
						end
				end
		end

	/* Delete not allowed */
	IF @sInsupddel = N'DEL' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7EIV_MORE_EIV_RSTATUS @sEIVStatus OUTPUT, @sNew_eil_invoice, NULL
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			
			IF @sEIVStatus <> N'C' 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIL', N'PROC', 8
					return -1
				end
		end
END

create procedure O7PREEIV
      @sInsupddel		nvarchar(4),
      @sOldCode			nvarchar(30),
      @sOldCurr			nvarchar(3),
      @dOlddate			DATETIME,
      @sOlddebtor		nvarchar(30),
      @nOldexch			numeric(24,12),
      @nOldexchanged	numeric(24,6),
      @sOldorigin		nvarchar(30),
      @nOldprice		numeric(24,6),
      @sOldrstatus		nvarchar(4),
      @sOldstatus		nvarchar(4),
      @nOldtax			numeric(24,6),
      @nOldtaxed		numeric(24,6),
      @nOldtaxperc		numeric(24,6),
      @sOldorg			nvarchar(15),
      @sNewcode			nvarchar(30),
      @sNewcurr			nvarchar(3)			OUTPUT,
      @dNewdate			DATETIME			OUTPUT,
      @sNewdebtor		nvarchar(30),
      @nNewexch			numeric(24,12)		OUTPUT,
      @nNewexchanged	numeric(24,6)		OUTPUT,
      @sNeworigin		nvarchar(30),
      @nNewprice		numeric(24,6)		OUTPUT,
      @sNewrstatus		nvarchar(4)			OUTPUT,
      @sNewstatus		nvarchar(4)			OUTPUT,
      @nNewtax			numeric(24,6)		OUTPUT,
      @nNewtaxed		numeric(24,6)		OUTPUT,
      @nNewtaxperc		numeric(24,6)		OUTPUT,
      @sNeworg			nvarchar(15)		OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sStatent		nvarchar(4)  --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE         /* Status entity */
	declare @sTypeent		nvarchar(4)  --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE         /* Type entity   */
	declare @nCount			integer
	declare @sChk			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(100)
	declare @nNumber        integer
	declare @sTempTax		nvarchar(20)
	declare @nReturn		integer

BEGIN
	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	if @sInsupddel IS NULL OR @sInsupddel NOT IN (N'INS', N'UPD', N'DEL')
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	if @sInsupddel in (N'INS', N'UPD')
		begin
			if @sNewcode IS NULL
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 22
					return -1
				end
			if @sNewdebtor IS NULL
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 23
					return -1
				end
			if @dNewdate IS NULL
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 24
					return -1
				end
			if @sNeworigin IS NULL
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 25
					return -1
				end
		end

	if @sInsupddel = N'UPD'
		begin
			if @sOldrstatus <> N'T' AND @nNewprice <> @nOldprice
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 31
					return -1
				end
			if @sNewcode <> @sOldCode
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 32
					return -1
				end
			if @sNewdebtor <> @sOlddebtor
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 33
					return -1
				end
			if @dNewdate <> @dOlddate
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 34
					return -1
				end
			if @sNeworigin <> @sOldorigin
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 35
					return -1
				end
			if @nNewtaxperc <> @nOldtaxperc
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 36
					return -1
				end
			ELSE
				set @nNewtaxperc = @nOldtaxperc /* in case not specified */

			if @sNewcurr <> @sOldCurr
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 37
					return -1
				end
			ELSE
				set @sNewcurr = @sOldCurr /* in case not specified */

			if @nNewexch <> @nOldexch
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 38
					return -1
				end
			ELSE
				set @nNewexch = @nOldexch /* in case not specified */

			if @sNeworg <> @sOldorg
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 39
					return -1
				end
			ELSE
				set @sNeworg = @sOldorg /* in case not specified */
		end



	/* if not deleting */
	if @sInsupddel in (N'INS', N'UPD')
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'EIV', @sStatent OUTPUT, @sTypeent OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1


			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 4
					return -1
				end

			if @sStatent IS NULL
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 41
					return -1
				end

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sNewrstatus OUTPUT, @sNewstatus OUTPUT, @sStatent, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1


			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 5
					return -1
				end
		end

	if @sInsupddel = N'INS'
		begin
			if @sNewrstatus <> N'T'
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 51
					return -1
				end
		end


	if @sInsupddel = N'UPD'
		begin
			if @sNewrstatus <> @sOldrstatus
				begin
					if @sNewrstatus = N'T'
					OR @sNewrstatus = N'R' AND
					@sOldrstatus NOT IN (N'T', N'I')
					OR @sNewrstatus = N'I' AND
					@sOldrstatus <> N'R'
					OR @sNewrstatus = N'C' AND
					@sOldrstatus NOT IN (N'R', N'I', N'T')
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 52
							return -1
						end
				end
		end

	if @sInsupddel = N'DEL'
		begin
			if @sOldrstatus <> N'C'
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 53
					return -1
				end
		end

   if @sInsupddel = N'INS'
	   begin
			set @nNewprice = 0

			execute @nReturn = o7deb_more_deb_curr @sNewcurr OUTPUT, @sNewdebtor, NULL
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = O7GTDUAL @sNewcurr, 1000, @nNumber OUTPUT, @nNumber OUTPUT, @nNewexch OUTPUT, @sNeworg, @dNewdate
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

			if @nNewexch IS NULL
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREEIV', N'PROC', 63
					return -1
				end

			execute  @nReturn = o7deb_more_deb_tax @sTempTax OUTPUT, @sNewdebtor, @sX
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

			set @nNewtaxperc = dbo.o7gettax( @sTempTax, @dNewdate )

	   end

	if @sInsupddel = N'UPD'
		begin
			if @sNewrstatus <> N'T' AND @sOldrstatus = N'T'
				begin
					SELECT @nNewprice = COALESCE (SUM (eil_price), 0)
					FROM   r5extinvlines
					WHERE  eil_invoice = @sNewcode
				end
			if @sNewrstatus = N'C' AND @sOldrstatus <> N'C'
				begin
					UPDATE r5calcevents
					SET    cev_rstatus = N'A', cev_status = NULL
					WHERE  (cev_event + N'#' +  cast(cev_increment as nvarchar(8))) IN (
					SELECT eil_eventcode + N'#' + cast(eil_eventincrement as nvarchar(8))
					FROM   r5extinvlines
					WHERE  eil_invoice = @sNewcode)
					AND    cev_rstatus = N'I'

					UPDATE r5fixedpayments
					SET    fpa_rstatus = N'A', fpa_status = NULL
					WHERE  (fpa_agreement + N'#' + cast(fpa_line as nvarchar(8))) IN (
					SELECT eil_paymentagreement + N'#' + cast(eil_paymentline as nvarchar(8))
					FROM   r5extinvlines
					WHERE  eil_invoice = @sNewcode)
					AND    fpa_rstatus = N'I'
				end
		end

	if @sInsupddel IN (N'INS', N'UPD')
		begin
			/*SQL server method to round to nearest minute - Google. */
			set @dNewdate = CAST (@dNewdate AS smalldatetime )
			/* SQL Server loses precision on statement below, so grouping percent / 100 will maintain needed precision */
			Set @nNewtax = @nNewprice * (@nNewtaxperc / 100.000000)
			Set @nNewtaxed = @nNewprice + @nNewtax
			Set @nNewexchanged = @nNewtaxed * @nNewexch
		end

END
