create procedure O7PREEPO 
   @sInsupd         nvarchar(4),
   @sWherefrom      nvarchar(1),
   @sEvent          nvarchar(30),
   @nLine           numeric(8),
   @sRsltype        nvarchar(4),
   @nValue          numeric(24,6),
   @sComment        nvarchar(70),
   @sFinding        nvarchar(4),
   @sPoint          nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sPointtyp       nvarchar(30),
   @sAspect         nvarchar(30),
   @sObject         nvarchar(30),
   @sObjectorg      nvarchar(15),
   @sResult         nvarchar(8) OUTPUT,
   @sRresult        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @dInsdate        DATETIME OUTPUT ,
   @sObtyp          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sEpocode        nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
   @sEpoclass       nvarchar(8),
   @sEpoclsorg      nvarchar(15),
   @sOldclass       nvarchar(8),
   @sOldclsorg      nvarchar(15),
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @nCount1			int
	declare @nCount2			int
	declare @dAprdate			DATETIME    /* Date of the last approved measurement */
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sEvtorg			nvarchar(15) --r5events.evt_org%TYPE
	declare @dTempdate			datetime
	declare @nCounter			int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sTempOrg			nvarchar(15)

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	set @nCount = 0
	set @sX       = NULL

	/* Check that all mandatory parameters are supplied */
	/* 08/07/2000- Amit- #6910 removed check for @sEvent being null*/
	IF @sInsupd  IS NULL OR @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR @sObject    IS NULL OR @sObjectorg IS NULL  OR @sObtyp     IS NULL 
	OR @sAspect    IS NULL OR @sInsupd   = N'UPD' AND @sEpocode IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	/* Get event org */
	IF @sEvent is not null 
		SELECT @sEvtorg = evt_org
		FROM   r5events  e
		WHERE  e.evt_code  = @sEvent

	/* Check attributes for insert */
	IF @sResult IS NOT NULL 
		begin
		/* I06121 : Result type must exist in r5ucodes  */
				execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRresult OUTPUT, @sResult OUTPUT, N'EPTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

				if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
					begin
						set @sChk = N'8'
						return
					end
		end

	/* Both point and pointtype should be entered or left blank. */
	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' AND @sWherefrom = N'F' 
		begin
			IF ( @sPoint IS     NULL AND @sPointtyp IS NOT NULL ) OR ( @sPoint IS NOT NULL AND @sPointtyp IS     NULL ) 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'9'
					RETURN
				end
		end

	/* Check attributes for insert */
	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		/* 05/15/2000- Amit- #6909 genaration of epo code if null */
		begin
			IF @sEpocode IS NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sEpocode OUTPUT, N'INRL', N'1', @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return
				end
	
			/* I06114 : Inspection date/time is mandatory if result type is not blank, */
			/*          less/eaqual SYSDATE   */
			IF @sResult IS NOT NULL 
				begin 
					IF @dInsdate IS NULL  
						begin
							set @sTempOrg = coalesce(@sEvtorg,@sObjectorg)
							execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dInsdate OUTPUT, @sTempOrg
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							set @sTempOrg = coalesce(@sEvtorg,@sObjectorg)
							execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sTempOrg
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1
							if @dInsdate > @dTempdate
								begin
									set @sChk = N'4'
									RETURN
								end
						end
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					IF @dInsdate IS NOT NULL 
						begin
							set @sTempOrg = coalesce(@sEvtorg,@sObjectorg)
							execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sTempOrg
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1
							if @dInsdate > @dTempdate
								begin
									set @sChk = N'4'
									RETURN
								end
						end
				end
	
			IF @dInsdate IS NOT NULL 
				/* I0612E : Inspection date must be between the date of last */
				/*          approved measurement and today                   */
				BEGIN
					SELECT @dAprdate = MAX( e.epo_date )
					FROM   r5eventpoints  e
					WHERE  e.epo_object     = @sObject
					AND    e.epo_object_org = @sObjectorg
					AND    e.epo_obtype     = @sObtyp
					AND    e.epo_point      = @sPoint
					AND    e.epo_pointtype  = @sPointtyp
					AND    e.epo_aspect     = @sAspect
					AND    e.epo_rresult    = N'V'
	
					set @sTempOrg = coalesce(@sEvtorg,@sObjectorg)
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sTempOrg
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					IF @dInsdate NOT BETWEEN  @dAprdate AND @dTempdate 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'6'
							RETURN
						end
				END
	
			/* I06112 : Event status (evt_rstatus) >= N'C' */
			/* 08/07/2000- Amit- #6910 Corrosion-2*/
			/* Verify that the events exist with status >= N'C' */
			/* only if @sEvent is not null*/
			IF @sEvent is not null 
				BEGIN
					SELECT @nCount = COUNT( * )
					FROM   r5events  e
					WHERE  e.evt_code  = @sEvent
					AND    evt_rstatus >= N'C'
	
					IF @nCount > 0 
						set  @sX = NULL
					ELSE
						begin
							set @sChk  = N'2'
							RETURN
						end
				END
		end
	/* Check attributes for updation  */
	ELSE
		begin
			IF @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
				begin
					/* I06215 : Inspection date/time is mandatory if measured value is not blank, */
					/*          less/eaqual o7gttime(coalesce(@sEvtorg,@sObjectorg))   */
					IF @nValue IS NOT NULL  
						begin
							IF @dInsdate IS NULL  
								begin
									set @sTempOrg = coalesce(@sEvtorg,@sObjectorg)
									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dInsdate OUTPUT, @sTempOrg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										return -1
								end
								
							ELSE
								begin
									set @sTempOrg = coalesce(@sEvtorg,@sObjectorg)
									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sTempOrg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										return -1
									if @dInsdate > @dTempdate
										begin
											set @sChk = N'4'
											RETURN
										end
								end
						end
					/* I06213 : Inspection date/time can not be later than SYSDATE/time */
					else
						begin
							IF @dInsdate IS NOT NULL 
								begin
									set @sTempOrg = coalesce(@sEvtorg,@sObjectorg)
									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sTempOrg
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										return -1
									if @dInsdate > @dTempdate
										begin
											set @sChk = N'4'
											RETURN
										end
								end
						end
				end
		end

	IF @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			IF coalesce(@sEpoclass,'%') <> coalesce(@sOldclass,'%') OR coalesce(@sEpoclsorg,'%') <> coalesce(@sOldclsorg,'%') 
				begin
					/* Check if technical details exists for the class */
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'PROM', N'INRL', @sEpocode, @sX, N'DET', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCount OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
						if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
							return -1
					if @nCount = 0
						set @sX = null
					else
						begin
							if @nCount > 0
								begin
									set @sChk = N'10'
									return
								end
							else
								begin
									set @sChk = @sCheckresult
									return
								end
						end
				end
		end

	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' OR @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			/* P07521/P07622 class must exist (r5classes, rentity = N'INRL') */
			IF @sEpoclass IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'INRL', @sEpoclass, @sEpoclsorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCount OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
					if @nCount > 0

					else

								begin

									return

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PREETA
      @sInsupddel			nvarchar(4),
      @sOld_eta_arrangement	nvarchar(12), 
      @sOld_eta_rtype		nvarchar(4), 
      @nOld_eta_rate		numeric(24,6), 
      @sOld_eta_trade		nvarchar(15), 
      @sOld_eta_org			nvarchar(15), 
      @sNew_eta_arrangement	nvarchar(12), 
      @sNew_eta_rtype		nvarchar(4), 
      @nNew_eta_rate		numeric(24,6), 
      @sNew_eta_trade		nvarchar(15),
      @sNew_eta_org		nvarchar(15) 
	   
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @nReturn	integer
declare @sChk       nvarchar(4)
declare @sType		nvarchar(8) 

BEGIN
	IF @sInsupddel IS NULL OR @sInsupddel NOT IN (N'INS', N'UPD', N'DEL') 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREETA', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	IF @sInsupddel IN (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			IF @sNew_eta_arrangement IS NULL 
			begin
				execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREETA', N'PROC', 21
				return -1
			end

			IF @sNew_eta_trade IS NULL 
			begin
				execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREETA', N'PROC', 22
				return -1
			end

			IF @sNew_eta_rtype IS NULL 
			begin
				execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREETA', N'PROC', 23
				return -1
			end

			IF @sNew_eta_org IS NULL 
			begin
				execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREETA', N'PROC', 25
				return -1
			end

			
		end

	IF @sInsupddel = N'UPD' 
		begin
			IF @sNew_eta_arrangement <> @sOld_eta_arrangement 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREETA', N'PROC', 2
					return -1
				end
		end

	IF @sInsupddel in (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sType OUTPUT, @sNew_eta_rtype, N'OCTP', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1


			  IF @sChk <> N'0' OR @sType IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREETA', N'PROC', 61
					return -1
				end
		end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PREEVA
	@sInsupd 		nvarchar(4),
	@sRentity		nvarchar(15),
	@sEno			nvarchar(30),
	@dEdate			datetime,
	@sEclass		nvarchar(40),
	@sEclsorg		nvarchar(15),
	@sErstatus 		nvarchar(4),
	@sEsupplier		nvarchar(30),
	@sEsupplierorg	nvarchar(15),
	@sEorder		nvarchar(30),
	@sEorderorg		nvarchar(15),
	@sEvent			nvarchar(30),
	@sEact			numeric(8),
	@sEreceipt		nvarchar(30),
	@sEcode			nvarchar(40),
	@sErate			numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sChk			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @nCount				integer
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @dTempDate		datetime

	set	@sChk      = N'0'
	set @nCount	   = 1
	set @sX        = null

/* Mandatory parameter missing    */
	if @sInsupd  NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
	begin
		set @sChk = N'1'
		return
	end

	if (@sEorder is null and (@sEvent is null or @sEact is null) and @sEreceipt is null) or 
		(@sEorder is not null and (@sEvent is not null or @sEact is not null))	or 
		(@sEorder is not null and @sEreceipt is not null) or 
		((@sEvent is not null or @sEact is not null) and @sEreceipt is not null) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'8'
			return
		end

	if @sEorder is not null 
		select @nCount = COUNT(*)
		from   r5orders
		where  ord_code         = @sEorder
		and    ord_org          = @sEorderorg
		and    ord_supplier     = @sEsupplier
		and    ord_supplier_org = @sEsupplierorg
		and    ord_rstatus IN (N'A', N'R')
	else
		begin
			if @sEvent is not null and @sEact is not null 
				select @nCount = COUNT(*)
				from   r5events e,
					r5activities a,
					r5orderlines o
				where  e.evt_code  = a.act_event
					and    e.evt_code  = @sEvent
					and    a.act_act   = @sEact
					and    a.act_event = o.orl_event
					and    a.act_act   = o.orl_act
					and    coalesce( o.orl_supplier, N'~!@#' ) = coalesce( @sEsupplier, N'~!@#' )
					and    coalesce( o.orl_supplier_org, N'~!@#' ) = coalesce( @sEsupplierorg, N'!@#$' )
					and    e.evt_rstatus IN ( N'C', N'R' )
			else
				begin
					if @sEreceipt is not null 
						select @nCount = COUNT(*)
						from   r5transactions
						where  tra_code     = @sEreceipt
						and    tra_fromcode = @sEsupplier
						and    tra_rstatus IN (N'A', N'R')

				end
		end

	if @nCount = 0 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end

	if @sErstatus in (N'A',N'R') 
		begin
			select COUNT(*)
			from   r5suppevalines
			where  evl_evaluation = @sEno

			if @nCount = 0 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'6'
					return
				end
	   end

	if @sEclass is not null
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'EVAL', @sEclass, @sEclsorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCount OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			if @nCount = 0
				begin
					set @sChk = N'2'
					return		
				end
		end


	execute @nReturn = o7gttime @dTempDate OUTPUT,@sEsupplierorg 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			return -1  


	if @sInsupd = N'INS' AND dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dEdate, N'DD' )  <> dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempDate, N'DD' )  
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3'
			return
		end

   /* If approved all responses should be given. */
	if @sErstatus = N'A' 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			from   r5suppevalines
			where  evl_evaluation = @sEno
			and    evl_weight     > 0
			and    evl_value is null

			if @nCount > 0 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'5'
					return
				end

			select @sErate = round( sum( evl_weight * evl_value ) / cast(coalesce( ins_desc, N'5' ) as numeric(24,6)), 2 )
			from   r5suppevalines,
			r5install
			where  evl_evaluation = @sEno
			and    evl_weight     > 0
			and    ins_code       = N'SUEVMAXR'
			group by ins_desc
		end
	else
		set @sErate = null

create PROCEDURE O7PREEVT	@sInsupd         nvarchar(4),
							@sCorg           nvarchar(15),
							@dReported       datetime,
							@dCompleted      datetime,
							@dEvtstart       datetime,
							@dDue            datetime,
							@dTarget         datetime,
							@sMeter          nvarchar(20),
							@nMeterdue       numeric(24,6),
							@sDependency     nvarchar(1),
							@sParent         nvarchar(30),
							@sObtype         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sObrtype        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sObject         nvarchar(30),
							@sObjectorg      nvarchar(15),
							@sLocation       nvarchar(30),
							@sLtype          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sProject        nvarchar(20) OUTPUT,
							@sProjbud        nvarchar(20) OUTPUT,
							@sReqm           nvarchar(8),
							@sAction         nvarchar(8),
							@sCause          nvarchar(8),
							@sFailure        nvarchar(8),
							@sJobtype        nvarchar(8),
							@sPriority       nvarchar(8),
							@sWarranty       nvarchar(1),
							@sStatus         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sRstatus        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sType           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sRtype          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
							@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
							
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sX				nvarchar(  1 )
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sCProject		nvarchar(20) --r5events.evt_project%TYPE /* Project Code */
	declare @sCProjbud      nvarchar(20) --r5events.evt_projbud%TYPE /* Project Budget Code */
	declare @sProjrstat     nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE    /* Project rStatus */
	declare @sObjrstat      nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE    /* Object rStatus */
	declare @sRqmgen        nvarchar(8) --r5events.evt_reqm%TYPE    /* Requirement Code */
	declare @sRqmclass      nvarchar(8) --r5classes.cls_code%TYPE   /* Object Class of reqm code */
	declare @sRqmclsorg     nvarchar(15) --r5classes.cls_org%TYPE    /* Object Class Organization of reqm code */
	declare @sObclass       nvarchar(8) --r5classes.cls_code%TYPE   /* Object Class */
	declare @sObclsorg      nvarchar(15) --r5classes.cls_org%TYPE    /* Object Class Organization*/
	declare @sMeterma@sX    int          /* Meter Ma@sXimum */
	declare @sMeterm		int          /* Meter Minimum */
	declare @sDeforg        nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE = o7dflt('DEFORG', @sChk)
	declare @dTempDate		datetime
	declare @dTempDueDate	datetime
	declare	@nReturn		int
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sBookdate		nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE := UPPER( NVL(o7dflt( 'BOOKDATE', chk ), 'ON') );

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sX   =  NULL

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	/* Check mandatory parameters */
	if ( @sStatus    IS NULL AND @sRstatus IS NULL ) OR ( @sType IS NULL AND @sRtype IS NULL ) OR @sInsupd  IS NULL OR @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	/* W10222 - Status must e@sXist                                  */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, N'EVST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end

	/* W10221 - Type Must E@sXist */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRtype OUTPUT, @sType OUTPUT, N'EVTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3'
			return
		end

	/* W1022N - Job Type must e@sXist  */
	if @sJobtype IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'JBTP', @sJobtype, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'4'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'999'
							return
						end
				end
		end

	/* W1022P - Job Priority must e@sXist                                  */
	if @sPriority IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'JBPR', @sPriority, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'5'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'999'
							return
						end
				end
		end

	/* W10321 : Object Type must e@sXist                           */
	if (@sObtype IS NOT NULL OR @sObrtype IS NOT NULL) AND @sObject IS NOT NULL 
		BEGIN
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sObtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					set @sChk = N'22'
					return
				end
		END

	/* W1021A - Date Reported should not be greater than system date */
	execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sCorg 
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1	
	
	if dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dReported,N'DD') > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dTempDate,N'DD')
		begin
			set @sChk = N'6'
			return
		end

	/* W1021B - Date Reported <= Date/Time Completed <= System Date/Time  */
	set @sBookdate = UPPER( coalesce(dbo.O7DFLT2( N'BOOKDATE'), N'ON') )
	if  @sBookdate = N'ON' AND @dCompleted IS NOT NULL  AND @dReported  IS NOT NULL and dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dCompleted, N'MI') < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(@dReported, N'MI')
		begin
			set @sChk = N'7'
			return
		end
	/* W1021C - Start Date must not be greater than system date */
	if @dEvtstart IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sCorg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1	

			if @dEvtstart > @dTempDate
				begin
					set @sChk = N'8'
					return
				end
		end

	/* W1021D - Due Date should be greater than system date */
	if @dDue IS NOT NULL    AND @sInsupd = N'INS'    AND @sRtype <> N'PPM' 
		begin
			set @dTempDueDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dDue, N'DD' )

			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sCorg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1	

			set @dTempDate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempDate, N'DD' )

			if @dTempDueDate < @dTempDate
				begin
					set @sChk = N'9'
					return
				end
		end

	/* W1021G - if Dependency = N'+'  Parent Event should be input */
	if  @sDependency = N'+' AND @sParent     IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'12'
			return
		end

	/* W1021H - if object code is input  object type must be available */
	if ( @sObject   IS NOT NULL  AND @sObtype IS NULL ) OR ( @sObject   IS NULL AND @sObtype IS NOT NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'13'
			return
		end
	/* W1021L - if Project  is given  Projec Budget Code must be given */
	if  ( @sProject   IS NOT  NULL AND @sProjbud IS NULL ) OR  ( @sProject   IS NULL AND @sProjbud IS NOT NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'14'
			return
		end
	/* W1021M - if Project IS NULL  Object should not be NULL */
	if  @sProject IS NULL AND @sObject  IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'15'
			return
		end

	/* W10228 - Project rStatus should not be N'B' or N'C'                    */
	if @sProject IS NOT NULL AND @sRstatus = 'R'
		begin
			SELECT  @nCount = count(*) --p.prj_rstatus
			FROM    r5projects p
			WHERE   p.prj_code = @sProject 
			if @nCount > 0 
				begin
					SELECT  @sProjrstat = p.prj_rstatus
					FROM    r5projects p
					WHERE   p.prj_code = @sProject 
	
					if @sProjrstat = N'C' OR ( @sProjrstat = N'B' AND @sInsupd = N'INS' )
						begin
							set @sChk = N'16'
							return
						end
				end
			else
				set @sX = Null
		end

	if @sObject IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			SELECT  @nCount = count(*) --p.prj_rstatus
			FROM    r5objects o
			WHERE   o.obj_obtype = @sObtype
			AND     o.obj_code   = @sObject
			AND     o.obj_org    = @sObjectorg
			if @nCount > 0

create PROCEDURE O7PREFPA
	@sInsupddel        	nvarchar(4),
	@sOld_fpa_agreement nvarchar(30),
	@sOld_fpa_class 	nvarchar(8),
	@sOld_fpa_clsorg 	nvarchar(15),
	@sOld_fpa_debtor 	nvarchar(30),
	@sOld_fpa_due 		DATETIME,
	@sOld_fpa_desc 		nvarchar(80),
	@sOld_fpa_line 		numeric(8) ,
	@sOld_fpa_price 	numeric(24,6), 
	@sOld_fpa_rstatus 	nvarchar(4),
	@sOld_fpa_status 	nvarchar(4),
	@sNew_fpa_agreement nvarchar(30),
	@sNew_fpa_class 	nvarchar(8),
	@sNew_fpa_clsorg 	nvarchar(15),
	@sNew_fpa_debtor 	nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sNew_fpa_due 		DATETIME,
	@sNew_fpa_desc 		nvarchar(80),
	@sNew_fpa_line 		numeric(8),
	@sNew_fpa_price 	numeric(24,6),
	@sNew_fpa_rstatus 	nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sNew_fpa_status 	nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sStatent	nvarchar( 4 ) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE /* Status entity */
	declare @sTypeent	nvarchar( 4 ) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE /* Type entity   */
	declare @sAgrorg	nvarchar( 15 ) --r5organization.org_code%TYPE /* Agreement org. */
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sChk       nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @sX         nvarchar( 1 )
	declare @nIvl		int
	declare @dTempDate	datetime
	declare @dStartDate	datetime
	declare @dEndDate	datetime
	declare @sDebtor	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nReturn	int

	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInsupddel IS NULL OR @sInsupddel NOT IN (N'INS', N'UPD', N'DEL') 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end
	
	/* If not deleting  check mandatory fields  */
	IF @sInsupddel IN (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			IF @sNew_fpa_agreement IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 21
					return -1
				end
			IF @sNew_fpa_line IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 22
					return -1
				end
			IF @sNew_fpa_desc IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 23
					return -1
				end
			IF @sNew_fpa_price IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 24
					return -1
				end
		end

	/* Get the agreement org */
	IF @sNew_fpa_agreement IS NOT NULL 
		SELECT @sAgrorg = agr_org
		FROM   r5agreements
		WHERE  agr_code = @sNew_fpa_agreement

	/* If updateing, check non-updateable values */
	IF @sInsupddel = N'UPD' 
		begin
			IF @sNew_fpa_agreement <> @sOld_fpa_agreement OR @sNew_fpa_line <> @sOld_fpa_line 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 2
					return -1
				end
		end

	/* If not deleting */
	IF @sInsupddel in (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin
			/*  If Class exists in r5classes    */
			IF @sNew_fpa_class IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'FPA', @sNew_fpa_class, @sNew_fpa_clsorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCount OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @nCount = 0
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 3
							return -1
						end
				end

			execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'FPA', @sStatent OUTPUT, @sTypeent OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			if @sChk <> N'0' 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 4
					return -1
				end
		
			IF @sStatent IS NULL 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 41
					return -1
				end

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sNew_fpa_rstatus OUTPUT, @sNew_fpa_status OUTPUT, @sStatent, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sChk <> N'0'
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 5
					return -1
				end
		end

	/* If not deleting */
	IF @sInsupddel IN (N'INS', N'UPD') 
		begin	
			/* Due date within agreed period. */
			execute @nReturn = O7AGR_MORE_AGR_END @dEndDate OUTPUT, @sNew_fpa_agreement, NULL
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = O7AGR_MORE_AGR_START @dStartDate OUTPUT, @sNew_fpa_agreement, NULL
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @sNew_fpa_due > @dEndDate OR @sNew_fpa_due < @dStartDate
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 6
					return -1
				end
			
			/* Validate or initialise derived field debtor from agreement */
			execute @nReturn = O7AGR_MORE_AGR_DEBTOR @sDebtor OUTPUT, @sNew_fpa_agreement, NULL
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @sNew_fpa_debtor IS NULL 
				set @sNew_fpa_debtor = @sDebtor
			
			IF @sNew_fpa_debtor <> @sDebtor
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 7
					return -1
				end
		end

	/* Update of price etc. only allowed for status U */
	IF @sInsupddel = N'UPD' 
		begin
			IF @sOld_fpa_rstatus <> N'U' AND @sNew_fpa_rstatus <> N'U'
				begin 
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sAgrorg 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1	

					IF coalesce (@sNew_fpa_due, @dTempDate) <> coalesce(@sOld_fpa_due, @dTempDate)
					OR @sNew_fpa_desc   <> @sOld_fpa_desc
					OR @sNew_fpa_class  <> @sOld_fpa_class
					OR @sNew_fpa_clsorg <> @sOld_fpa_clsorg
					OR @sNew_fpa_price  <> @sOld_fpa_price 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 91
							return -1
						end
				end
		end

	/* Check if delete is allowed  */
	IF @sInsupddel = N'DEL' 
		begin
			IF @sOld_fpa_rstatus IN (N'A', N'I') 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREFPA', N'PROC', 92
					return -1
				end
		end
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PREFUS

   @sUser          nvarchar(255),
   @sShort         nvarchar(30),
   @sFunction      nvarchar(6),
   @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @nCountit        integer
BEGIN
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @nCountit     = 0

	IF @sInsupd NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR @sInsupd IS NULL OR @sUser  IS NULL
		begin   
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	IF @sShort IS NULL 
		RETURN

	SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
	FROM   r5functions
	WHERE  fun_code = @sShort

	IF @nCountit > 0 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN

	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
			FROM   r5funcusers
			WHERE  fus_user      = @sUser
			AND    fus_shortn    = @sShort
			AND    fus_function <> coalesce( @sFunction, N'1234567' )
			IF @nCountit > 0 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'2'
					RETURN
				end
		end
END

create PROCEDURE O7PREINV
	@sInsupd			nvarchar(4),
	@sInvclass			nvarchar(8),
	@sInvclassorg		nvarchar(15),
	@sOldinvrstatus		nvarchar(4),
	@sInvparent			nvarchar(45),
	@sInvparentorg		nvarchar(15),
	@sInvsupplier		nvarchar(30),
	@sInvsupplierorg	nvarchar(15),
	@nInvtotal			numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sInvauth			nvarchar(30),
	@sInvrtype			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sInvtype			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sInvrstatus		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sInvstatus			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sInvcode			nvarchar(45) OUTPUT,
	@sInvorg			nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@dInvapprov			DATETIME OUTPUT,
	@dInvmatch			DATETIME OUTPUT,
	@dInvrecord			DATETIME OUTPUT,
	@dInvdate			DATETIME	OUTPUT,
	@dInvpaydate		DATETIME	OUTPUT,
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sInvsourcesystem	nvarchar(45),
	@sInvsourcecode		nvarchar(45)   

AS 
BEGIN
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @nCountit					int
	declare @sCheckresult				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX							nvarchar(1)
	declare @nTolerance					int                          /* tolerance allowable limit */
	declare @sRstat						nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE     /* rstatus entity   */
	declare @sRtype						nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE     /* rtype   entity   */
	declare @sPinvrstatus				nvarchar(4) --r5invoices.inv_rstatus%TYPE     /* invoice rstatus  */
	declare @sPinvrtype					nvarchar(4) --r5invoices.inv_rtype%TYPE       /* invoice rtype    */
	declare @sPinvsupplier				nvarchar(30) --r5invoices.inv_supplier%TYPE    /* invoice supplier */
	declare @sPinvsupplierorg			nvarchar(15) --r5invoices.inv_supplier_org%TYPE/* invoice supplier */
	declare @nDinvtotal					numeric(24,6) --r5invoices.inv_total%TYPE       /* invoice total    */
	declare @nCinvtotal					numeric(24,6) --r5invoices.inv_total%TYPE       /* invoice total    */
	declare @nPinvvalue					numeric(24,6) --r5invoices.inv_total%TYPE       /* invoice value    */
	declare @nPurvalue					numeric(24,6) --r5invoices.inv_total%TYPE       /* purchase value   */
	declare @nAbsolute					numeric(24,6) --r5invoices.inv_total%TYPE       /* absoluter value  */
	declare @sDeforg					nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE = o7dflt( N'DEFORG', @sChk )
	declare @sAutoapp					nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE = o7dflt( N'MATCHAPP' ,@sChk )
	declare @nReturn					int
	declare @nCount						int
	declare	@dTempdate					datetime


	set @sChk              = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult      = N'0'
	set @nCountit          =  0
	set @nTolerance       =  0
	set @sX                = NULL
	set @sPinvrstatus     = NULL
	set @sPinvrtype       = NULL
	set @sPinvsupplier    = NULL
	set @sPinvsupplierorg = NULL

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sAutoapp OUTPUT, N'MATCHAPP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF Coalesce( @sInsupd, N'XXX' )   NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )
	OR ( @sInvsupplier    IS NULL OR @sInvsupplierorg IS NULL ) 
		begin  
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sInvclass IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'INV', @sInvclass, @sInvclassorg,'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX,@nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							SET @sChk = N'3'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
							return
						end
				end
		end
	
	if @sInvrtype = N'I'
		execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'INV', @sRstat OUTPUT, @sRtype OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	else
		execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'NPOI', @sRstat OUTPUT, @sRtype OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT

	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

	IF dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dInvrecord, N'DD' )< dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dInvdate , N'DD' ) 
		begin
			set  @sChk = N'21'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sInvsourcesystem IS NULL 
		begin
			IF dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dInvrecord , N'DD' ) > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dInvpaydate , N'DD' ) 
				begin
					set  @sChk = N'22'
					RETURN
				end
		end

	IF @sInvrtype IN ( N'D', N'C' ) AND @sInvparent IS NULL 
		begin
			set  @sChk = N'23'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			IF @sInvsourcesystem IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sInvrstatus = N'U'
					set @sInvrstatus  = NULL
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sInvrstatus OUTPUT, @sInvstatus OUTPUT, @sRstat, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
	
					IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'4'
							RETURN
						end
				end
	
			set @sInvrtype = NULL
	
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sInvrtype OUTPUT, @sInvtype OUTPUT, @sRtype, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
	
			IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'5'
					RETURN
				end
	
			IF @sInvparent IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					IF @sInvrtype NOT IN ( N'D', N'C' ) 
						begin
							set  @sChk = N'6'
							RETURN
						end
					select @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5invoices i
					WHERE  i.inv_code = @sInvparent
					AND    i.inv_org  = @sInvparentorg
	
					if @nCount > 0 
						begin
							SELECT @sPinvrstatus = i.inv_rstatus,
							@sPinvrtype = i.inv_rtype,
							@sPinvsupplier = i.inv_supplier,
							@sPinvsupplierorg = i.inv_supplier_org
							FROM   r5invoices i
							WHERE  i.inv_code = @sInvparent
							AND    i.inv_org  = @sInvparentorg
								IF @sPinvrtype NOT IN ( N'I', N'N' )
									begin
										set  @sChk = N'8'
										RETURN
									end
							IF ( @sPinvsupplier    <> @sInvsupplier OR 	@sPinvsupplierorg <> @sInvsupplierorg ) 
								begin
									set  @sChk = N'9'
									RETURN
								end
						end
					else
						set @sX = NULL
				end
			IF @sInvcode IS NULL 
				begin
					IF @sInvorg = @sDeforg 
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7GETINV NULL, @sInvcode OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7GETINV @sInvorg, @sInvcode OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1
						end
				end
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			set @sInvrstatus = NULL
	
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sInvrstatus OUTPUT, @sInvstatus OUTPUT, @sRstat, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
	
			IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'4'
					RETURN
				end
	
			IF @sInvsourcesystem IS NULL 
				begin
					IF @sInvrstatus = N'A' 
						begin
							IF @sInvrtype = N'I' 
								begin
									IF ( @sOldinvrstatus = N'U'  AND UPPER(@sAutoapp) = N'YES' ) OR ( @sOldinvrstatus IN ( N'A', N'M', N'MHLD', N'PM', N'R' ) )
										set @sX = NULL
									ELSE
										begin
											set  @sChk = N'13'
											RETURN
										end
								end
	
							IF @sInvrtype IN ('D' ,'C') 
								begin
									IF @sOldinvrstatus IN ('A','M','MHLD','U')
										set @sX = NULL
									ELSE
										begin
											set  @sChk = N'13'
											RETURN
										end
								end
							IF @sInvauth IS NULL 
								begin
									set  @sChk = N'14'
									RETURN
								end
	
							execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sInvorg 
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								RETURN -1
							set @dInvapprov  = isnull( @dInvapprov, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD'))
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							IF @sInvrstatus = N'M' AND @sOldinvrstatus <> N'M'
								begin
	
									execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sInvorg 
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										RETURN -1
									set @dInvmatch  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')
								end
						end
				end
		end
END

	@Insupd         nvarchar(4),
	@sIvlinvoice    nvarchar(45),
	@sIvlinvoiceorg nvarchar(15),
	@sIvlorder      nvarchar(30),
	@sIvlorderorg   nvarchar(15),

	@nIvlinvvalue   numeric(24,6),
	@nIvldiscperc   numeric(24,6),
	@nIvlprice      numeric(24,6),
	@sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sIvlsourcesystem nvarchar(45) = null,
	@sIvlsourcecode   nvarchar(45) = null
   
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCheckresult              nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @sX                        nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @nCountit                  int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @nOrlprice                numeric(24,6) -- r5orderlines.orl_price%TYPE		/* order line price */
	declare @nOrlrecvqty              numeric(24,6) -- r5orderlines.orl_recvqty%TYPE  				/* order line receive quantity */
	declare @nOrldiscperc             numeric(24,6) --r5orderlines.orl_discperc%TYPE				/* order line discount percentage */
	declare @sOrlrtype                nvarchar( 4 ) --r5orderlines.orl_rtype%TYPE					/* order line type */

	/* initialise variables */
	set @sX            = NULL
	set @sChk          = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult  = N'0'
	set @nCountit      = 0
	set @nOrlprice    = 0
	set @nOrlrecvqty  = 0
	set @nOrldiscperc = 0

	/* check mandatory parameters */
	IF coalesce( @Insupd,N'XXX' ) NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR @sIvlinvoice IS NULL OR @sIvlinvoiceorg IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		END 


	IF @sIvlsourcesystem IS NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7EXISTP N'INV', N'4', @sIvlinvoice, N'U', @sIvlinvoiceorg, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

				if @nCountit > 0
						SET @sX = null
				else
					begin
						if @nCountit = 0
							begin
								SET @sChk = N'3'
								return
							end 
						else
							begin
								SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end
		end

	/* get fields from orderlines for further processing */
	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5orderlines
	WHERE  orl_order     = @sIvlorder
	AND    orl_order_org = @sIvlorderorg
	AND    orl_ordline   = @nIvlordline

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @nOrlprice = coalesce( orl_price, 0 ),
			@nOrlrecvqty = coalesce( orl_recvqty,0 ) / coalesce( orl_multiply, 1 ),
			@nOrldiscperc = orl_discperc,
			@sOrlrtype = orl_rtype
		FROM   r5orderlines
		WHERE  orl_order     = @sIvlorder
			AND    orl_order_org = @sIvlorderorg
			AND    orl_ordline   = @nIvlordline

	else
		begin
			SET @sX = null
			return
		end

create PROCEDURE O7PREOBJ
	@sInsupd		nvarchar(4),
	@sOrg			varchar(15),
	@dCommiss		datetime OUTPUT,
	@dWithdraw		datetime OUTPUT,
	@sRstatus		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sStatus		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sObrtype		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sClass			nvarchar(8) OUTPUT,
	@sClsorg		nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@sMrc			nvarchar(15),
	@sDepend		nvarchar(1),
	@sObtype		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sCategory		nvarchar(30),
	@sManufact		nvarchar(45),
	@sChk	    	nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT 
 AS

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	/* Initialize */
	declare @sObcat         nvarchar(30) --r5objects.obj_code%TYPE           /* Object category  */
	declare @sClass1        nvarchar(8) --r5objects.obj_class%TYPE          /* Object class     */
	declare @sClsorg1       nvarchar(15) --r5objects.obj_class_org%TYPE      /* Object class organization    */
	declare @sRstatobj      nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE       /* Object statent   */
	declare @sRtypeobj      nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE       /* Object typent    */
	declare @sRcode         nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE            /* R5 type          */
	declare @sUcode         nvarchar(8) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE            /* User type        */
	declare @nCountit		int
   	declare @sX				nvarchar(50)
   	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @dGtTime		datetime

	SET @sChk			=  N'0'
	SET @sX				=  NULL
	SET @sCheckresult	=  N'0'
	SET @nCountit		=  0
	set @sClass1		= @sClass
	set @sClsorg1		= @sClsorg

	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	if @sInsupd IS NULL OR @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )	
		begin
			SET @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end
	
	
	/* A0312B Object type must exist */
	/* Get rtype, if rtype is NULL  - OR - get type, if rtype is NULL */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sObrtype OUTPUT, @sObtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'15'
			return
		end

	/* Set defaults if rtype = 'C'/'L' : commision date and rstatus */
	if @sObrtype IN (N'C', N'L')
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
			/* A03123 - Commission Date = System Date if rType = 'C' or 'L' */
			/* AO3124 rstatus = 'I' if rtype = 'C' or 'L' */
			set @sRstatus = N'I'
			set @sStatus  = null
			set @dCommiss = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dGtTime, N'DD' )
		end
	else 
		begin
			if  @sRstatus is NULL OR @sStatus  = N'*'
					begin
						set @sRstatus = N'I'
						set @sStatus  = null

					end
		end

	/* A0312F - Status , rstatus must exist ( r5ucodes ) */
	/* Get rstatus or status, if one of them is null AND RETURN IT   */
	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, N'OBST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'14'
			return
		end
	/* A03114 - Commissioning Date is mandatory if rStatus <> 'A' */
	if @sRstatus <> N'A'
		begin
			if @dCommiss is NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1

					set @dCommiss = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dGtTime, N'DD' )
				end 
		end
	else
		set @dCommiss = NULL




	/* A0311C - Withdrawal Date <= System Date   */
	if @dWithdraw is NOT NULL
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
			
			if @dGtTime < @dWithdraw
				set @dWithdraw = @dGtTime
		end

	/* A03122 - Class is mandatory  if rtype = 'C' */
	if @sObrtype = N'C' 
		begin
			if @sClass IS NULL
				begin
					set @sChk = N'4'
					RETURN
				end
		end 
	else
		/* A0312E - MRC is mandatory if rType <> 'C' */
		begin
			if @sMrc IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'7'
					RETURN
				end 
		end

	/* A0312K - if Withdrawal Date <> NULL then */
	/*          rStatus = 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E' or 'F'  */
	if  @dWithdraw IS NOT NULL AND @sRstatus     NOT IN( N'B', N'C', N'D', N'E', N'F' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'8'
			RETURN
		end

	/* Manufacturer must exist */
	if @sManufact IS NOT NULL
		begin
			set @nCountit = 0
			select	@nCountit = count(*)
			FROM   r5manufacturers
			WHERE  mfg_code = @sManufact

			if @nCountit = 0
			begin
				set @sChk = '18'
				RETURN
			end
		end

create PROCEDURE O7PREORD
	@sInsupd         nvarchar(4),
	@sOrdclass       nvarchar(8),
	@sOrdclsorg      nvarchar(15),
	@sOrdrtype       nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
	@sOrdsupplier    nvarchar(30),
	@sOrdsupplierorg nvarchar(15),
	@sOrdcode        nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
	@sOrdorg         nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
	@sOrdcontract    nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
	@nOrdexch        numeric(24,12)	OUTPUT,
	@sOrdrstatus     nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
	@dOrddate        DATETIME	OUTPUT,
	@dOrdapprov      DATETIME	OUTPUT,
	@sOrdauth        nvarchar(255)	OUTPUT, 
	@nOrdprice       numeric(24,6)		OUTPUT,
	@nOrddiscount    numeric(24,6)		OUTPUT,
	@sOrdtype        nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
	@sOrdstatus      nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT,
	@sOrddesc        nvarchar(80)	OUTPUT,
	@dOrddue         datetime,
	@sOrdorigin      nvarchar(15),
	@sOrdstore       nvarchar(15),
	@sOrdcurr        nvarchar(3),
	@sOldclass       nvarchar(8),
	@sOldclsorg      nvarchar(15),
	@sOldrstatus     nvarchar(4),
	@sChk            nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT, 
	@sSourcesystem   nvarchar(45),
	@sSourcecode     nvarchar(45)

AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit					int
	declare @sCheckresult				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sResult					nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX							nvarchar(100)
	declare @sRstat						nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE  /* rstatus entity */
	declare @sRtype						nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE  /* rtype   entity */
	declare @sAssetass					nvarchar(200) --r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @sChk2						nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn					int
	declare @sTemp						nvarchar(50)
	declare @sTempvar					nvarchar(50)

BEGIN
	set @sChk          = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult  = N'0'
	set @nCountit      = 0
	set @sX            = NULL
	
	IF coalesce( @sInsupd, N'XXX' ) NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'PORD', @sRstat OUTPUT, @sRtype OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			set @nOrdprice    = 0
			set @nOrddiscount = 0
			IF @sSourcesystem IS NULL 
				set @sOrdrstatus = N'U'

			--set @sOrdrstatus  = NULL


			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sOrdrstatus OUTPUT, @sOrdstatus OUTPUT, @sRstat, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'4'
					RETURN
				end

			IF @sSourcesystem IS NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dOrddate OUTPUT, @sOrdorg 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1

					set @dOrddate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dOrddate,  N'DD')
				end

			IF @sSourcesystem IS NULL and @sOrdrstatus <> N'A'
				set @sOrdauth = NULL

			IF @sSourcesystem IS NULL and @sOrdrstatus <> N'A'
				set @dOrdapprov  = NULL

			IF @sOrdtype IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sOrdrtype  = N'P'
					set @sResult    = NULL

					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sResult OUTPUT, @sOrdrtype, N'POTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					IF @sCheckresult = N'0' 
						set @sOrdtype = @sResult
					ELSE
						begin
							set @sChk = N'5'
							RETURN
						end
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					set @sOrdrtype = NULL
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sOrdrtype OUTPUT, @sOrdtype OUTPUT, @sRtype, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'5'
							RETURN
						end
				end
			set @sTempvar = @sOrdsupplier + N'#' + @sOrdsupplierorg
			set @sOrdcontract = @sOrdstore
			execute @nReturn = o7gmorec N'CONT', 11, @sTempvar, @sOrdorg, @sOrdcurr, @sX,	@sOrdcontract OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
			
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CURR', N'*', @sOrdcurr, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX,  @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'6'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = @sCheckresult
							return
						end
				end
		end



	IF @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
	   begin
			-- for PO interface rstatus should not be made NULL
			-- set @sOrdrstatus = NULL
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sOrdrstatus OUTPUT, @sOrdstatus OUTPUT, @sRstat, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'4'
					RETURN
				end

			IF @sOrdrstatus <> N'U' AND @sOrdrstatus <> N'C' AND @sOrdrstatus <> @sOldrstatus 		
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sAssetass OUTPUT, N'ASSETASS', @sChk2 OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					IF @sAssetass <> N'R' 
					begin
						IF @sSourcesystem IS NULL 
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7GMOREP N'ORD', 11, @sOrdcode, @sOrdorg, @sX, @sX, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1

							IF @sCheckresult = N'0' 
								begin
									set @sChk = N'9'
									RETURN
								end	
						end
					end

					execute @nReturn = O7EXISTP N'ORD', N'3', @sOrdcode, N'C', @sOrdorg, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @nCountit = 0
							SET @sX = null
					else
						begin
							if @nCountit > 0
								begin
									SET @sChk = N'12'
									return
								end 
							else
								begin
									SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
									return
								end
						end


					execute @nReturn = O7EXISTP N'ORD', N'6', @sOrdcode, N'C', @sOrdorg, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @nCountit = 0
							SET @sX = null
					else
						begin
							if @nCountit > 0
								begin
									SET @sChk = N'7'
									return
								end 
							else
								begin
									SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
									return
								end
						end
				end

			IF @sOrdrstatus = N'A' 
				begin
					IF @sOrdauth IS NULL 
					begin
						set @sChk = N'13'
						RETURN
					end
					IF @sOldrstatus <> N'A' 
					begin
						execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dOrdapprov OUTPUT, @sOrdorg 
						if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							RETURN -1
						set @dOrdapprov  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dOrdapprov,  N'DD')
					end
				end
	   end

	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' OR @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			IF @sOrdclass IS NOT NULL 
			begin

				execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PORD', @sOrdclass,@sOrdclsorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

				if @nCountit > 0
					set @sX = null
				else
					begin
						if @nCountit = 0
							begin
								set @sChk = N'3'
								return
							end
						else
							begin
								set @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end
			end
			IF coalesce (@nOrdexch, 0 ) <= 0 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'16'
					RETURN
				end
		end
END

create PROCEDURE  O7PREORI
   @sInsupd        nvarchar(4),
   @sOriclass      nvarchar(8),
   @sOriclsorg     nvarchar(15),
   @sChk           nvarchar (4) OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sX              nvarchar( 1 )
	declare @sCheckresult    nvarchar( 3 )
	declare @nCountit        int
	declare @nReturn			int

/* Initialize */

create PROCEDURE O7PREORL 
	@sInsupd         nvarchar(4),
	@sOrlorder       nvarchar(30),
	@sOrlorderorg    nvarchar(15),
	@nOrlordline     int,
	@sOrlsupplier    nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sOrlsupplierorg nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@sOrlcontract    nvarchar(30),
	@sOrlevent       nvarchar(30),
	@nOrlact         numeric(8),
	@sOrlrelevent    nvarchar(30),
	@sOrlreq         nvarchar(30),
	@nOrlreqline     numeric(8),
	@nOrlprice       numeric(24,6),
	@nOrlordqty      numeric(24,6),
	@dOrldue         datetime,
	@sOrlpuruom      nvarchar(30),
	@nOrldiscperc    numeric(7,4) OUTPUT,
	@sOrlproject     nvarchar(20) OUTPUT,
	@sOrlprojbud     nvarchar(20) OUTPUT,
	@sOrlpart        nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sOrlpartorg     nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@sOrlrtype       nvarchar(4),
	@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sSourcesystem   nvarchar(45),
	@sSourcecode     nvarchar(45)

AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn					int
	declare	@nCountit                   int
	declare	@sX                         nvarchar(1)
	declare	@sCheckresult               nvarchar(4)
	declare	@sRstat						nvarchar(4)		--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE/* rstatus entity   */
	declare	@sRtype						nvarchar(4)		--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE/* rtype entity     */
	declare	@sExtpur					nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE    /* purchase price flag*/
	declare	@sDummy						nvarchar(8)		--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE     /* temporary variable*/
	declare	@dOrddate					datetime		--r5orders.ord_date%TYPE     /* order date       */
	declare	@sOrdsupplier				nvarchar(30)	--r5orders.ord_supplier%TYPE /* order supplier   */
	declare	@sOrdsupplierorg			nvarchar(15)	--r5orders.ord_supplier_org%TYPE /* supplier org  */
	declare	@sOrdstore					nvarchar(15)	--r5orders.ord_store%TYPE    /* order store      */
	declare	@sOrdrstatus				nvarchar(4)		--r5orders.ord_rstatus%TYPE  /* order rstatus    */
	declare	@nCdidisperc				numeric(7,4)	--r5condiscounts.cdi_disperc%TYPE /* contract discount percentage */
	declare	@sOrdrtype					nvarchar(4)		--r5orders.ord_rtype%TYPE    /* order rtype      */
	declare	@sGenpart					nvarchar(30)	--r5orderlines.orl_part%TYPE /* new part number  */
	declare	@sUtype						nvarchar(8)		--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE     /* U code value     */
BEGIN

	set @sChk             = N'0'
	set @sX               = NULL
	set @sCheckresult     = N'0'
	set @nCountit         = 0
	set @dOrddate        = NULL
	set	@sOrdsupplier    = NULL
	set	@sOrdsupplierorg = NULL
	set	@sOrdstore       = NULL
	set	@sOrdrstatus     = NULL
	set	@nCdidisperc     = 0
	set	@sOrdrtype       = NULL
	set	@sGenpart        = NULL
	set	@sExtpur         = NULL
	set	@sDummy          = NULL


	IF coalesce( @sInsupd, N'XXX' ) NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )
	OR @sOrlorder    IS NULL
	OR @nOrlordline  IS NULL
	OR @nOrlprice    IS NULL
	OR @dOrldue      IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	IF  @sOrlpart  IS NULL
	AND @sOrlrtype LIKE N'P%' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'13'
			RETURN
		end



/* Get order data */
	if exists (select '1' from 	r5orders   o WHERE  o.ord_code = @sOrlorder AND    o.ord_org  = @sOrlorderorg ) 
		SELECT @sOrdrstatus = o.ord_rstatus,
			 @sOrdrtype = o.ord_rtype,
			 @dOrddate = o.ord_date,
			 @sOrdsupplier = o.ord_supplier,
			 @sOrdsupplierorg = o.ord_supplier_org,
			 @sOrdstore = o.ord_store
		FROM   r5orders   o
		WHERE  o.ord_code = @sOrlorder
		AND    o.ord_org  = @sOrlorderorg
	else
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

	set @sOrlsupplier    = @sOrdsupplier
	set @sOrlsupplierorg = @sOrdsupplierorg


	IF @sOrlevent IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sOrlproject = NULL
			set @sOrlprojbud = NULL
		end

	IF (     @sOrlevent IS     NULL AND @nOrlact   IS NOT NULL )
	OR (     @sOrlevent IS NOT NULL AND @nOrlact   IS     NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'11'
			RETURN
		end

	IF (     @sOrlreq     IS     NULL AND @nOrlreqline IS NOT NULL )
	OR (     @sOrlreq     IS NOT NULL AND @nOrlreqline IS     NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'12'
			RETURN
		end




	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			IF @sOrlproject IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					SELECT @sDummy = p.prj_rstatus
					FROM   r5projects p
					WHERE  p.prj_code = @sOrlproject
					IF @sDummy = N'C'
						begin 
							set @sChk = N'6'
							RETURN
						end
				end

			IF @sOrlrtype IN ( N'PD', N'PS' ) 
			begin
				IF @sOrlpart IS NOT NULL 
					begin
						IF @nOrldiscperc IS NULL 
							begin
								if exists (select '1' FROM   r5condiscounts d,
											r5contracts    c
											WHERE  c.con_supplier     = @sOrdsupplier
											AND    c.con_supplier_org = @sOrdsupplierorg
											AND    c.con_rstatus      = N'A'
											AND    c.con_end         >= @dOrddate
											AND    c.con_start       <= @dOrddate
											AND    d.cdi_contract     = c.con_code
											AND    d.cdi_rtype        = N'L'
											AND    d.cdi_part         = @sOrlpart
											AND    d.cdi_part_org     = @sOrlpartorg ) 
									SELECT @nCdidisperc = d.cdi_disperc
									FROM   r5condiscounts d,
										r5contracts    c
									WHERE  c.con_supplier     = @sOrdsupplier
									AND    c.con_supplier_org = @sOrdsupplierorg
									AND    c.con_rstatus      = N'A'
									AND    c.con_end         >= @dOrddate
									AND    c.con_start       <= @dOrddate
									AND    d.cdi_contract     = c.con_code
									AND    d.cdi_rtype        = N'L'
									AND    d.cdi_part         = @sOrlpart
									AND    d.cdi_part_org     = @sOrlpartorg
								else
									set @sChk = N'0'
								
								set @nOrldiscperc = coalesce( @nCdidisperc, 0 )
							end
					end
				else
					set @nOrldiscperc = 0
				
			end

		 
		 
			IF @sOrlrtype IN ( N'SF', N'ST' ) 
				begin
					IF @sOrlevent IS NOT NULL 
						begin
							if exists (select '1' FROM   r5events   e WHERE  e.evt_code = @sOrlevent ) 
								begin
									SELECT @sDummy = e.evt_rstatus,
									@sOrlproject = e.evt_project,
									@sOrlprojbud = e.evt_projbud
									FROM   r5events   e
									WHERE  e.evt_code = @sOrlevent

									IF( @sDummy  = N'C' AND ( @sOrlrelevent IS NULL OR @sOrlrelevent = @sOrlevent ) )
										begin
											set @sChk = N'8'
											RETURN
										end
								end

							if ( @sOrlrelevent IS NOT NULL AND @sOrlrelevent <> @sOrlevent )
								begin
									if exists (select '1' from r5events   e WHERE  e.evt_code = @sOrlrelevent ) 
										begin
											SELECT @sDummy = e.evt_rstatus
											FROM   r5events   e
											WHERE  e.evt_code = @sOrlrelevent

											IF @sDummy = N'C' 
												begin
													set @sChk = N'8'
													RETURN
												end
										end
								end
						end
					
				end
      
				IF @sOrlrtype IN ( N'PD', N'PS' ) 
					begin
						IF @sOrlpart IS NULL 
							begin
								set @sGenpart = NULL
								execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sGenpart OUTPUT, N'PART', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									return -1

								IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
									begin
										set @sChk = N'9'
										RETURN
									end
								else
									begin
										set @sOrlpart    = N'N' + @sGenpart
										set @sOrlpartorg = @sOrlorderorg

										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sUtype OUTPUT, N'TRPQ', N'PTRK', @sChk OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											return -1

									
										INSERT INTO r5parts (
																par_code,
																par_org,
																par_desc,
																par_uom,
																par_class,
																par_class_org,
																par_byasset,
																par_tracktype,
																par_trackrtype )
										VALUES (
													@sOrlpart,
													@sOrlpartorg,
													N'T.B.D.',
													@sOrlpuruom,
													N'N',
													@sOrlpartorg,
													N'-',

create PROCEDURE O7PREPAR
	@sInsupd	    nvarchar(4),
	@sCode    		nvarchar(30),
	@sPartOrg    	nvarchar(15),
	@sOldCode    	nvarchar(30),
	@sClass 		nvarchar(8),
	@sClassOrg 		nvarchar(15),
	@sCategory 		nvarchar(30),
	@sPrefSup 		nvarchar(30),
	@sPrefSupOrg 	nvarchar(15),
	@sPrefUom 		nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT ,
	@sPrefSupprice	numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT ,
	@sChk	    	nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT 
 AS

	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sPurUom		nvarchar(30) -- r5uoms.uom_code%TYPE;      /* purchase UOM  */
   	declare @sRtype			nvarchar(8) -- r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;    /* Rapier type */
	declare @sUtype			nvarchar(8) -- r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE;    /* Rapier type */
	declare @nPurPrice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @nCountit		int
   	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
   	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int

	/* Initialize */
	SET @sChk			=  N'0'
	SET @sX				=  NULL
	SET @sCheckresult	=  N'0'
	SET @nCountit	=  0

	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInsupd    IS NULL    OR @sCode   IS NULL    OR @sInsupd    NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )	
		begin
			SET @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	/* S38116 - if type ( class ) = 'N' then code = 'N0'..'N9'    */
	IF @sClass = N'N' 
		begin
			IF SUBSTRING( @sCode, 1, 2 ) NOT BETWEEN  N'N0' AND  N'N9' 
				begin
					SET @sChk = N'3'
					return
				end
		end


   SET @sRtype = N'C'
   SET @sUtype = @sX

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRtype OUTPUT, @sUtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = null
			return
		end
	if @sCategory IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'OBJ', @sUtype, @sCategory, null, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
					set @sX = null
			else
					begin
						if @nCountit = 0
							begin
								set @sChk = N'5'
								return
							end
						else
							begin
								if @sCheckresult = N'2'
									set @sChk = N'6'
								else
									set @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end

		end

	if @sPrefSup IS NOT NULL AND @sInsupd = N'UPD'
		begin
			select	@nCountit = count(*)
			FROM   r5catalogue c
			WHERE  c.cat_part         = @sCode
			AND    c.cat_part_org     = @sPartOrg
			AND    c.cat_supplier     = @sPrefSup
			AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sPrefSupOrg

			if @nCountit = 0
				begin
					set @sPrefSupprice = NULL
					set @sPrefUom = NULL
					set @sX = NULL
				end
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 1
						BEGIN
							SELECT @sPurUom = c.cat_puruom, @nPurPrice = c.cat_purprice
							FROM   r5catalogue c
							WHERE  c.cat_part         = @sCode
							AND    c.cat_part_org     = @sPartOrg
							AND    c.cat_supplier     = @sPrefSup
							AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sPrefSupOrg


							set @sPrefUom = @sPurUom
							set @sPrefSupprice = @nPurPrice
						END
					else
						set @sPrefSupprice = NULL
						set @sPrefUom = NULL
						set @sX = NULL
				end
		end

	@nProjamt    numeric(24,6),
	@sChk        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sX					nvarchar( 50 )
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nPclamount			numeric(24,6)    /* Sub Project Amount          */
	declare @nTotpclamt			numeric(24,6)    /* Total of Sub Project Amount */
	declare @nPrjactbud			numeric(24,6)    /* Actual Project Budget       */

BEGIN
	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0' 
	set @nCountit     =  0  
	set @sCheckresult = NULL
	set @sX           = NULL
	set @nTotpclamt   = 0.00


	/* Check mandatory parameters */
   IF ( @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) )   OR @sInsupd    IS  NULL    OR @sProject  IS  NULL   OR @sProjbud  IS  NULL  
	   begin
		  set @sChk = N'1'
		  RETURN
	   end



	/* J01122 - Project rStatus <> N'C' */
	execute @nReturn = o7existj  N'PROJ', N'*', @sProject, N'POST', N'C', @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
		return -1


	if 	@nCountit >= 0 
		begin
			if @nCountit > 0 
				set @sX = NULL
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = N'2'
					return
				end
		end
	else
		if @nCountit = -1
		begin
			if @sCheckresult = N'2' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					return
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = N'7'
					return
				end
		end

END

							set @sChk = N'999'

create PROCEDURE O7PREPIC
	@sInsupd			nvarchar(4),
	@sCpicclass			nvarchar(8),

   declare @sRstat          nvarchar(4)		--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE  /* rstatus entity */

   declare @sPicobject      nvarchar(30)	--r5picklists.pic_object%type
   declare @sPicobject_org  nvarchar(30)	--r5picklists.pic_object_org%type
   declare @sPicobtype      nvarchar(4)		--r5picklists.pic_obtype%type
   declare @sPicobrtype     nvarchar(4)		--r5picklists.pic_obrtype%type
   declare @dPicrequired    datetime		--r5picklists.pic_required%type
   declare @sPicdesc        nvarchar(80)	--r5picklists.pic_desc%type
   declare @sTempOrg		nvarchar(15)
   declare @nReturn			int
   declare @nCount			int
   declare @dTempdate		datetime


BEGIN
	set @sChk          = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult  = N'0'
	set @nCountit      = 0
	set @sX            = NULL

	IF coalesce( @sInsupd, N'XXX' ) NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'PICK', @sRstat OUTPUT, @sRtype OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1
	if @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end



	if @sCpicclass IS NOT NULL  
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PICK', @sCpicclass,@sCpicclsorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'6'
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end




	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			set @sCpicrstatus = N'U'
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCpicrstatus OUTPUT, @sCpicstatus OUTPUT, @sRstat, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					return
				end
			IF @sEvent IS NULL 
				begin
					IF @sAct IS NULL 
					begin
						IF @sObjcode IS NULL 
							begin
								set @sChk = N'7'
								RETURN
							end
          end
					ELSE
					begin
						set @sChk = N'8'
						RETURN
				  end 
				end
			ELSE
				begin
					IF @sAct IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'9'
							RETURN
						end
					ELSE     /* Ensure that the event and act combination is valid */
						begin

							select @nCount = count(*)
							FROM   r5events, r5activities
							WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent
							AND    evt_code = act_event
							AND    act_act = @sAct

							if @nCount > 0 
								SELECT @sMatlist = act_matlist,
									@sMatlrev = act_matlrev, 
									@sPicdesc = evt_desc,
									@sPicobject = evt_object, 
									@sPicobject_org = evt_object_org,
									@sPicobtype = evt_obtype, 
									@sPicobrtype = evt_obrtype, 
									@dPicrequired = act_start, 
									@sEventorg = evt_org
								FROM   r5events, r5activities
								WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent
								AND    evt_code = act_event
								AND    act_act = @sAct
							else
								begin
									set @sChk = N'10'
									RETURN
								end

							IF @sObjcode is NULL
								begin 
									set @sObjcode = @sPicobject
									set @sObjorg  = @sPicobject_org
									set @sObtype  = @sPicobtype
									set @sObrtype = @sPicobrtype
									/*Use event description if picklist description is not supplied*/
									IF @sCpicdesc IS NULL 
										set @sCpicdesc = @sPicdesc
								end
						end
				 end 

			set @sTempOrg = coalesce(@sEventorg, @sObjorg)
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sTempOrg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
			set @dTempdate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')

			IF @dReqdate = NULL  
				begin
					if @dPicrequired > @dTempdate
						set @dReqdate = @dPicrequired
					else
						set @dReqdate = @dTempdate
				end 
			ELSE
				begin
					IF @dReqdate < @dTempdate
						begin
							set @sChk = N'11'
							RETURN
						end
				end

			IF @sCpiccode is NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCpiccode OUTPUT, N'PICK', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1
				end

		end 





	IF @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			set @sCpicrstatus = NULL

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sCpicrstatus OUTPUT, @sCpicstatus OUTPUT, @sRstat, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					RETURN
				end

			IF @sCpicrstatus = N'A' 
				begin
					IF @sCpicauth IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'5'
							RETURN
						end
					
					set @sTempOrg = coalesce(@sEventorg, @sObjorg)
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sTempOrg 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1
					IF @sOldRstatus  NOT IN (N'A', N'C')
						set @dPicapprov  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')
				
				end
		end
END

create PROCEDURE O7PREPPA
   @sInsupd       nvarchar(4),
   @sCppmcode     nvarchar(20),
   @nPpmrevision numeric(4),
   @nDuration    numeric(8),
   @nStart       numeric(3),
   @nChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nPpmduration numeric(8)               /* ppm-duration */
	declare @nCount		int
	declare @sX nvarchar(1)

/* Initialize */
	set @nChk = N'0'

	IF @sInsupd     NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
	OR @sInsupd       IS NULL
	OR @sCppmcode     IS NULL
	OR @nPpmrevision IS NULL
	OR @nDuration    IS NULL
	OR @nStart       IS NULL 
		begin
			set @nChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

/* Select ppm-duration from r5ppms for the given ppm-code  */
	SELECT @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5ppms p
	WHERE  p.ppm_code     = @sCppmcode
	AND    p.ppm_revision = @nPpmrevision

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @nPpmduration = coalesce( p.ppm_duration, 0 )
		FROM   r5ppms p
		WHERE  p.ppm_code     = @sCppmcode
		AND    p.ppm_revision = @nPpmrevision
	else
		begin
			set @nChk = N'3'
			RETURN
		end 


/* W16124, W16223 - START + DURATION <= PPM_DURATION + 1 */
	IF ( @nStart + @nDuration ) <= ( @nPpmduration + 1 )  
		set @sX = NULL
	ELSE
		begin
			set @nChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end

create PROCEDURE O7PREPRJ
	@Insupd          nvarchar(4),
	@sOrg            nvarchar(15),
	@sPrjcode        nvarchar(20),
	@sPrjrstatus     nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sPrjparent      nvarchar(20),
	@dPrjbuddate     datetime OUTPUT,
	@dPrjapprov      datetime OUTPUT,
	@dPrjeststart    datetime,
	@dPrjestend      datetime,
	@dPrjactstart    datetime OUTPUT,
	@dPrjactend      datetime OUTPUT,
	@nPrjactbud      numeric(24,6),
	@nPrjorigbud     numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sPrjstatus      nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sPrjclass       nvarchar(8),
	@sPrjclsorg      nvarchar(15),
	@sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@nOranum         int OUTPUT,
	@sOramsg         nvarchar(200) OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(3)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)		--r5projects.prj_class%TYPE   /*  Project Class           */
	declare @sRstatus			nvarchar(4)		--r5projects.prj_rstatus%TYPE /*  Parent Project rStatus  */
	declare @sParent			nvarchar(20)	--r5projects.prj_code%TYPE    /*  Project Parent          */
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @dTempdate			datetime
	declare @nCount				int

	set @sChk     = N'0'
	set @nOranum = 0
	set @sOramsg = null
	set @sX       = NULL
	set @sClass  = @sPrjclass
	set @nCountit = 0

	IF @Insupd   NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )
	OR @Insupd   IS NULL
	OR @sPrjcode IS NULL
	OR ( @sPrjstatus  IS NULL
	AND  @sPrjrstatus IS NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sPrjrstatus OUTPUT, @sPrjstatus OUTPUT, N'PRST', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'15'
			return
		end

	IF @sPrjrstatus = N'O'  
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
			set @dTempdate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')
			set @dPrjapprov = Coalesce( @dPrjapprov, @dTempdate )
		end

	IF @dPrjactend IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
			set @dTempdate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')

			If @dPrjactend > @dTempdate
				set	@dPrjactend =	@dTempdate
		end

	IF @sPrjrstatus = N'A' 
		begin
			set @nPrjorigbud = NULL
			set @dPrjapprov  = NULL
		end

/* J06217 - If rStatus = N'O' and original budget is NULL and */
/* Parent is NOT NULL  Parent rStatus must be N'O'        */
	IF  @sPrjrstatus = N'O'
	AND @nPrjorigbud IS NULL
	AND @sPrjparent  IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM   r5projects p
			WHERE  p.prj_code = @sPrjparent

			if @nCount > 0 
				begin
					SELECT @sRstatus = p.prj_rstatus
					FROM   r5projects p
					WHERE  p.prj_code = @sPrjparent

					IF @sRstatus <> N'O' 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'8'
							RETURN
						end
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = N'51'
					/*hard coded for now since SQL server will not throw this error.*/
					set @nOranum = 1403
					set @sOramsg = N'ORA-01403 no data found'
					RETURN
				end
		end






	IF @sPrjclass IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'PROJ', @sPrjclass,@sPrjclsorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX,@nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							SET @sChk = N'18'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
							return
						end
				end

		end


	IF @nPrjactbud IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
			set @dTempdate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')
			set @dPrjbuddate = Coalesce( @dPrjbuddate, @dTempdate )
		end


	IF @sPrjrstatus = N'O' 	AND @nPrjactbud IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk  = N'7'
			RETURN
		end




	IF @Insupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			IF @sPrjparent IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					select @nCount = count(*) 
					FROM   r5projects p
					WHERE  p.prj_code = @sPrjparent
					
					If @nCount > 0 begin
						SELECT @sParent = p.prj_parent,
						@sRstatus = p.prj_rstatus
						FROM   r5projects p
						WHERE  p.prj_code = @sPrjparent

						IF @sRstatus = N'C' 
							begin
								set @sChk = N'11'
								RETURN
							end
					end else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'51'
							/*hard coded for now since SQL server will not throw this error.*/
							set @nOranum = 1403
							set @sOramsg = N'ORA-01403 no data found'
							RETURN
						end
				end

			IF @sPrjrstatus = N'O' 
				set @nPrjorigbud = Coalesce( @nPrjorigbud, @nPrjactbud )
			

			IF @dPrjbuddate IS NOT NULL AND @dPrjapprov IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1

					set @dTempdate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')

					IF   dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dPrjbuddate ,  N'DD') <>  dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dPrjapprov,  N'DD')
					OR   dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dPrjapprov ,  N'DD')  <>  @dTempdate
						begin
							set @sChk = N'52'
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end 



	IF @Insupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			IF @sPrjrstatus = N'C' 
			begin

				execute @nReturn = o7existj N'EVNT', N'*', @sPrjcode, N'PROJ', N'C', @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

				if @nCountit = 0
					set @sX = null
				else
					begin
						if @nCountit > 0
							begin
								SET @sChk = N'19'
								return
							end
						else
							begin
								SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end


				execute @nReturn = o7existj N'PROJ', N'*', @sPrjcode, N'ORDL', N'Y', @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

				if @nCountit = 0
					set @sX = null
				else
					begin
						if @nCountit > 0
							begin
								SET @sChk = N'20'
								return
							end
						else
							begin
								SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end



			end 
			
			IF @sPrjrstatus = N'O' 
				set @nPrjorigbud = coalesce( @nPrjorigbud, @nPrjactbud )
			

			IF @dPrjbuddate IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1

					set @dTempdate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')


					IF dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  @dPrjbuddate ,  N'DD') >   @dTempdate   
						set @dPrjbuddate = @dTempdate
				end
		end

create procedure O7PREPRM	@sInsupd	nvarchar(3),
							@sPfunction	nvarchar(6),
							@sPselect	nvarchar(1),
							@sPupdate	nvarchar(1),
							@sPinsert	nvarchar(1),
							@sPdelete	nvarchar(1),
							@sChk		nvarchar(4)	OUTPUT
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sFselect	nvarchar(1)	--r5functions.fun_select%TYPE
	declare @sFupdate	nvarchar(1)	--r5functions.fun_update%TYPE
	declare @sFinsert	nvarchar(1)	--r5functions.fun_insert%TYPE
	declare @sFdelete	nvarchar(1)	--r5functions.fun_delete%TYPE
	declare @nCount		int

	set @sChk = N'0'

	if @sInsupd is null or @sInsupd not in ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR @sPfunction is null
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	select @nCount = count(*)
	  FROM  r5functions
	 WHERE  fun_code = @sPfunction

	if @nCount = 0
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3'
			return
		end
	else
		select	@sFselect = fun_select, 
				@sFupdate = fun_update,
				@sFinsert = fun_insert,
				@sFdelete = fun_delete
		  FROM  r5functions
		 WHERE  fun_code = @sPfunction

	if @sPselect is not null and @sFselect is null 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end

	if @sPupdate is not null and @sFupdate is null 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'5'
			return
		end

	if @sPinsert is not null and @sFinsert is null 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'6'
			return
		end

	if @sPdelete is not null and @sFdelete is null 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'7'
			return
		end

create PROCEDURE O7PREPSL
         @sInsupd            nvarchar(4),
         @sNewpslorder       nvarchar(30),
         @sNewpslordline     nvarchar(8),
         @sNewpslordorg      nvarchar(15),
         @sNewpsldock        nvarchar(30),
         @sNewpslline        nvarchar(8),
         @sNewpslpart        nvarchar(30),
         @sNewpslpartorg     nvarchar(15),
         @nNewpsldelqty      numeric(24,6),
         @nNewpslrecqty      numeric(24,6),
         @sOldpsldock        nvarchar(30)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit int

	set @nCountit = 0

	IF @sInsupd NOT IN (N'INS',N'UPD',N'DEL') 
		begin
			execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREPSL', N'PROC', 1
			return -1
		end

	IF @sInsupd IN (N'INS',N'UPD') 
		begin
			/*checking the mandatory parameters*/
			IF  @sNewpsldock IS NULL OR @sNewpslline IS NULL OR @sNewpslpart IS NULL OR
			@sNewpslpartorg IS NULL OR (@sNewpslorder IS NULL AND @nNewpsldelqty IS NULL)
			OR (@sNewpslorder IS NOT NULL AND @nNewpslrecqty IS NULL) 
				begin
					execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREPSL', N'PROC', 1
					return -1
				end

			/*part does not match with purchse order*/
			IF @sNewpslorder IS NOT NULL AND @sNewpslordline IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
					FROM   r5orderlines
					WHERE  orl_order = @sNewpslorder
					AND    orl_ordline = @sNewpslordline
					AND    orl_order_org = @sNewpslordorg

					if @nCountit = 0 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREPSL', N'PROC', 2
							return -1
						end


				END

			/*Dock receipt status should be Unfinished*/
			SELECT  @nCountit = count(*)
			FROM     r5dockreceipts
			WHERE    dck_code = @sNewpsldock
			AND      dck_rstatus <> N'U'

			IF @nCountit > 0 
				begin
					IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
						begin
							execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREPSL', N'PROC', 3
							return -1
						end

				END
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			IF @sInsupd = N'DEL' 
				begin
					SELECT  @nCountit = count(*)
					FROM     r5dockreceipts
					WHERE    dck_code = @sNewpsldock
					AND      dck_rstatus <> N'U'

					IF @nCountit > 0 
						begin
							IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
								begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7PREPSL', N'PROC', 5
									return -1
								end

						END
				end
		END
