create PROCEDURE O7PREQUL
	@Insupd         nvarchar(4),
	@sQuotation     nvarchar(30),
	@sSeqno         nvarchar(2),
	@sCatref        nvarchar(50),
	@sPuruom        nvarchar(30),
	@sEvent         nvarchar(30),
	@nAct           numeric(8),
	@sTrade         nvarchar(15),
	@nReqpers       numeric(8),
	@sType          nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sRtype         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sPart          nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sPartorg       nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@nPersons       numeric(8) OUTPUT,
	@nQuotqty       numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sQuotuom       nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@nLeadtime      numeric(4,1) OUTPUT,
	@nPrice         numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sTask          nvarchar(20) OUTPUT,
	@dExpir         datetime OUTPUT,
	@sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sTrdCode               nvarchar(15)  --r5trade.trd_code%TYPE    /* trade of activity     */
	declare @sQuotrstatus           nvarchar(8)  --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE    /* rstatus of Quotation  */
	declare @sEvtstatus             nvarchar(8)  --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE    /* status of event       */
	declare @sQuotorg               nvarchar(15)  --r5organization.org_code%TYPE /* quotation org      */
	declare @sCheckresult           nvarchar(4 )
	declare @sX                     nvarchar( 1 )
	declare @nCount					int
	declare @dTempDate				datetime
	declare @nReturn				int
BEGIN

	set @sChk          = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult  = N'0'
	set @sX            = NULL
	set @sQuotrstatus = NULL
	set @sEvtstatus   = NULL

	IF @Insupd      IS NULL
	OR @sQuotation  IS NULL
	OR @sSeqno      IS NULL
	OR @Insupd      NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

      SELECT @sQuotrstatus = q.quo_rstatus, @sQuotorg = q.quo_org
      FROM   r5quotations q
      WHERE  q.quo_code   =  @sQuotation
      AND    q.quo_seqno  =  @sSeqno


	IF @sQuotrstatus NOT IN ( N'U', N'Q', N'R' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sRtype LIKE N'P%' 
	begin
		IF @sPuruom IS NULL 
			begin
				set @sChk = N'7'
				RETURN
			end
	end


	IF @sRtype LIKE N'S%' 
		begin
			IF @nReqpers IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'8'
					RETURN
				end
			IF @Insupd = N'INS' 
			begin
				IF ( @sEvent IS     NULL AND @nAct IS NOT NULL ) OR  ( @sEvent IS NOT NULL AND @nAct IS     NULL ) 
					begin
						set @sChk = N'24'
						RETURN
					end
				IF @nAct IS NOT NULL 
					BEGIN
					Select @nCount = count(*)
					FROM   r5activities
					WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
					AND    act_act   = @nAct
					AND    act_hire  = N'+'
					AND    act_order IS NULL
					AND    coalesce( act_nt, 0 ) = 0
					AND    coalesce( act_ot, 0 ) = 0


					if @nCount > 0  
						SELECT @sTrdCode = act_trade
						FROM   r5activities
						WHERE  act_event = @sEvent
						AND    act_act   = @nAct
						AND    act_hire  = N'+'
						AND    act_order IS NULL
						AND    coalesce( act_nt, 0 ) = 0
						AND    coalesce( act_ot, 0 ) = 0
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'25'
							RETURN
						end

					IF @sTrade <> @sTrdCode 
					begin
						set @sChk = N'26'
						RETURN
					end
				end
			end
		end


	IF @sQuotrstatus = N'U' 
		begin
			IF @sQuotuom   IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					set @sQuotuom   = NULL 
					set @sChk = N'17'
					RETURN
				end


			IF @nPrice     IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					set @nPrice   = NULL 
					set @sChk = N'18'
					RETURN
				end

			IF @nLeadtime  IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					set @nLeadtime   = NULL 
					set @sChk = N'19'
					RETURN
				end

			IF @nPersons   IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					set @nPersons   = NULL 
					set @sChk = N'20'
					RETURN
				end


			IF @nQuotqty   IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					set @nQuotqty   = NULL 
					set @sChk = N'21'
					RETURN
				end

			IF @dExpir     IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					set @dExpir   = NULL 
					set @sChk = N'22'
					RETURN
				end


			IF @sChk <> N'0' 
				RETURN
		end


	IF @sQuotrstatus = N'A' 
		begin
			IF @nPrice IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'9'
					RETURN
				end
			IF @nQuotqty IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'11'
					RETURN
				end

			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sQuotorg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1	

			IF @dExpir <  dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  @dTempDate, N'DD' )   
				begin
					set @sChk = N'13'
					RETURN
				end
			IF @sRtype = N'P' 
				begin
					IF @sQuotuom IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'14'
							RETURN
						end
				end
			IF @sRtype = N'S'
				begin 
					IF @nPersons IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'15'
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end


		IF @sEvent IS NOT NULL 
			begin
				SELECT  @nCount = count(*)
				FROM    r5events    e
				WHERE   e.evt_code  =  @sEvent

				if @nCount = 1 
					SELECT  @sEvtstatus = e.evt_rstatus
					FROM    r5events    e
					WHERE   e.evt_code  =  @sEvent
				else
					begin
						set @sChk = N'998'
						RETURN
					end

				IF @sEvtstatus = N'C' 
					begin
						set @sChk  = N'16'
						RETURN
					end
			end


END

create PROCEDURE O7PREQUO
	@sInsupd			nvarchar(4),
	@sOrg				nvarchar(15),
	@sCode				nvarchar(30),
	@sSeqno				nvarchar(2),
	@dDuedate			datetime,
	@dQuotdate			datetime OUTPUT,
	@sLastorder			nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@sLastorderorg		nvarchar(15) OUTPUT,
	@sAuth				nvarchar(30) OUTPUT,
	@dRecv				datetime OUTPUT,
	@dExpir				datetime OUTPUT,
	@sClass				nvarchar(8),
	@sClassorg			nvarchar(15),
	@sRstatus			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sStatus			nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@Rtype				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sType				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@nQtotal			int OUTPUT,
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 

AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @dTempdate		datetime
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nCountit		 int
	declare @sX				 nvarchar(50)
	declare @sStat           nvarchar(4)   	 -- r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE /* Status entity variable */
	declare @sTyp            nvarchar(4)     -- r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE /* Type entity variable */

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	set @nCountit = 0
	set @sX       = NULL

	IF @sInsupd   IS NULL
	OR @sCode	   IS NULL
	OR @dDuedate IS NULL
	OR @sInsupd NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sClass IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'QUOT', @sClass, @sClassorg,'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'20'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							if @sChk <> N'999'
							begin
								set @sChk = N'2'
								return
							end
						end
				end
		end


	execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'QUOT', @sStat OUTPUT, @sTyp OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRstatus OUTPUT, @sStatus OUTPUT, @sStat, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'21'
			return
		end

	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			IF  @sRstatus <> N'U'
			AND @sRstatus <> N'A'
			AND @sRstatus <> N'R' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'12'
					RETURN
				end

			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1

			set @dTempdate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')

			IF dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dDuedate, N'DD' ) < @dTempdate
			OR dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dDuedate, N'DD' ) IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					RETURN
				end

			set @dQuotdate = @dTempdate
			set @sLastorder    = NULL
			set @sLastorderorg = NULL

			IF @sRstatus = N'U'
				begin 
					set @sAuth  = NULL
					set @dRecv  = NULL
					set @dExpir = NULL
				end

			IF @sRstatus = N'A' 
				begin
					IF @sAuth IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'9'
							RETURN
						end
					IF @dExpir < @dTempdate OR @dExpir IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'11'
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end

	IF @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sOrg 
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1

			set @dTempdate  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempdate,  N'DD')

			IF dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dRecv, N'DD' ) > @dTempdate
				begin
					set @sChk = N'13'
					RETURN
				end

			IF dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dExpir, N'DD' ) < @dTempdate
				begin
					set @sChk = N'11'
					RETURN
				end

			IF @sRstatus <> N'U' 
				begin
					execute @nReturn = o7existq N'QUOT', N'*', @sCode, N'QUL', @sSeqno, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						RETURN -1

					IF @nCountit > 0 
						set @sX = NULL
					ELSE
						begin
							if  @nCountit = 0 
							begin
								set @sChk = N'15'
								RETURN
							end
						end
				end

			IF @sRstatus = N'A' 
				begin
					IF @sAuth IS NULL 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'16'
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end

name: O7PREREA

create PROCEDURE O7PREREA 
	@Insupd           nvarchar(4),
	@dDatetime        DATETIME,
	@nReading         numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sMeter           nvarchar(20),
	@sUOM             nvarchar(30),
	@sObject          nvarchar(30),
	@sObjectorg       nvarchar(15),
	@nDiff            numeric(24,6) OUTPUT,
	@sChk              nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 

AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nMax				numeric(24,6)                 /* Max Meter reading        */
	declare @nMin				numeric(24,6)					/* Min Meter reading        */
	declare @nLast				numeric(24,6)                 /* Value of @nLast reading   */
	declare @dMaxDate			datetime                   /* Max Date/Time of reading */
	declare @dTempdate			datetime
	declare @nCount				int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sUpdown			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sMetuom			nvarchar(30)

	set @sChk     = N'0'

	IF @Insupd     NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR @dDatetime  IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @Insupd = N'UPD' 
	begin
		set @sChk = N'11'
		RETURN
	end

	IF ( @nReading IS     NULL AND @nDiff    IS     NULL ) OR ( @nReading IS NOT NULL AND @nDiff    IS NOT NULL ) 
	begin
		set @sChk = N'8'
		RETURN
	end

	IF ( @sMeter IS     NULL AND @sUOM IS     NULL ) OR ( @sMeter IS NOT NULL AND @sUOM IS NOT NULL ) 
	begin
		set @sChk = N'9'
		RETURN
	end

	IF @nReading IS NOT NULL AND @nDiff    IS NOT NULL 
		set @nDiff = NULL

	IF @Insupd = N'INS' 
	begin
		execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempdate OUTPUT, @sObjectorg 
		if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			RETURN -1

		IF  @dDatetime >= @dTempdate + 0.005 
			begin
				set @sChk = N'3'
				RETURN
			end


		IF @sMeter IS NOT NULL 
			begin
				/* If meter known,  use table r5meters ( physical meter ). */
				select @nCount = count(*)
				FROM   r5meters   m WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE  m.met_code = @sMeter
				If @nCount > 0
					begin 
						SELECT @nMax = m.met_max,
							   @nMin = m.met_min,
							   @nLast = coalesce( m.met_last, 0 ),
							   @sMetuom = m.met_uom
						FROM   r5meters   m WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE  m.met_code = @sMeter
						SELECT @sUpdown = oud_updownmeter
						FROM   r5objusagedefs o
						WHERE  o.oud_object     = @sObject
						AND    o.oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
						AND    o.oud_uom        = ISNULL( @sUOM, @sMetuom )
					end
				else
					begin
						set @sChk = N'2'
						RETURN
					end
			end
         ELSE
			 begin
				/* If meter not known ( uom known ),  use table            */
				/* r5objusagedefs ( logical meters ).                          */
				select @nCount = count(*)
				FROM   r5objusagedefs o WITH (NOLOCK)
				WHERE  o.oud_object     = @sObject
				AND    o.oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
				AND    o.oud_uom        = @sUOM

				If @nCount > 0
					begin 
						SELECT @nMax = 999999999999999999.999999,
							   @nMin = -1,
							   @nLast = coalesce( o.oud_totalusage, 0 ),
							   @sUpdown = oud_updownmeter
						FROM   r5objusagedefs o WITH (NOLOCK)
						WHERE  o.oud_object     = @sObject
						AND    o.oud_object_org = @sObjectorg
						AND    o.oud_uom        = @sUOM
					end
				else
					begin
						set @sChk = N'2'
						RETURN
					end
			 end

		IF @nReading > coalesce( @nMax, @nReading ) 
			begin
				set @sChk = N'11'
				RETURN
			end

		IF @nReading < coalesce( @nMin, @nReading ) 
			begin
				set @sChk = N'5'
				RETURN
			end

		IF @nReading IS NULL 
			begin
				IF @nMax IS NOT NULL 
					begin
						IF @nDiff + @nLast <= @nMax 
							set  @nReading = @nDiff + @nLast
						ELSE
							set @nReading = (CAST(@nDiff + @nLast as int) % cast(@nMax as BIGINT) ) - 1
					end
				ELSE
					begin
						If 	@nLast + @nDiff < 999999999999999999.999999 
							set @nReading =  @nLast + @nDiff
						else
							set @nReading =  999999999999999999.999999
					end
			end
	
	
		IF @nDiff IS NULL AND @sUpdown = N'-' 
		begin
			IF @nMax IS NOT NULL 
				begin
					IF @nReading >= @nLast 
						set  @nDiff = @nReading - @nLast
					ELSE
						set  @nDiff = @nReading + CAST( @nMax AS BIGINT ) + 1 - @nLast
				end
			ELSE
				set @nDiff = @nReading - @nLast
		end

		IF @sUpdown = N'+'
			SET @nDiff = NULL

	end

create PROCEDURE O7PRERED
   @sInsupd        nvarchar(4),
   @sSupplier      nvarchar(30),
   @sSupplierorg   nvarchar(15),
   @sPart          nvarchar(30),
   @sPartorg       nvarchar(15),
   @nRedline       numeric(8),
   @sType          nvarchar(4),
   @nDiscperc      numeric(24,6),
   @nDiscount      numeric(24,6),
   @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 

AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nGrossprice              numeric(24,6) /* Gross price              */
	declare @nNetprice                numeric(24,6)/* Net price                */
	declare @nTotdisc                 numeric(24,6) /* Total discount           */
	declare @nPrevline                numeric(24,6) /* Previous reduction line  */
	declare @sRtypeent                nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE  /* R5 entity type code      */
	declare @sRstatent                nvarchar(4) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE  /* R5 entity status code    */
	declare @sRtype                   nvarchar(4) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE       /* R5 type code of discount */
	declare @sRedtype                 nvarchar(4) --r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE       /* User's discount type     */
	declare @sCheckresult             nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCount					int
	declare @nLocalDiscount			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nLocalDiscperc			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nReturn					int

	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @nGrossprice =  0
	set @nNetprice   =  0
	set @nTotdisc    =  0
	set @nPrevline   =  0
	set @sRtype      = NULL
	set @sRstatent   = NULL
	set @sRtypeent   = NULL

	IF @sInsupd       IS NULL
	OR @sSupplier    IS NULL
	OR @sSupplierorg IS NULL
	OR @sPart        IS NULL
	OR @sPartorg     IS NULL
	OR @nRedline     IS NULL
	OR @sInsupd    NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
		  set @sChk  = N'1'
		  RETURN
		end

	IF  ( @nDiscperc     IS NULL 	AND   @nDiscount IS NULL )	OR  ( @nDiscperc     IS NOT NULL	AND   @nDiscount IS NOT NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'3'
			RETURN
		end


	select @nCount = Count(*)
	FROM   r5catalogue    c
	WHERE  c.cat_supplier     = @sSupplier
	AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
	AND    c.cat_part         = @sPart
	AND    c.cat_part_org     = @sPartorg

	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT @nGrossprice = coalesce( c.cat_gross,0 )
		FROM   r5catalogue    c
		WHERE  c.cat_supplier     = @sSupplier
		AND    c.cat_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
		AND    c.cat_part         = @sPart
		AND    c.cat_part_org     = @sPartorg
	else
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			RETURN
		end
	set @nNetprice = Coalesce ( @nGrossprice,0 )


	DECLARE cLocal1 CURSOR local FOR SELECT   Coalesce( r.red_discperc,0 ),
                  coalesce( r.red_discount,0 )
         FROM     r5reductions r
         WHERE    r.red_part         = @sPart
         AND      r.red_part_org     = @sPartorg
         AND      r.red_supplier     = @sSupplier
         AND      r.red_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
		 AND      r.red_line           < @nRedline
         ORDER BY r.red_line

	OPEN cLocal1
	FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal1 INTO @nLocalDiscperc, @nLocalDiscount

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF @nLocalDiscount <> 0 
				set @nNetprice = @nNetprice - @nLocalDiscount
			ELSE
				set @nNetprice = ROUND( @nNetprice * ( 1 - @nLocalDiscperc / 100 ), 2 )

			FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal1 INTO @nLocalDiscperc, @nLocalDiscount
		END
	CLOSE cLocal1
	DEALLOCATE cLocal1

	IF coalesce( @nDiscount, 0 ) <> 0 
		set @nNetprice = @nNetprice - coalesce( @nDiscount, 0 )
	ELSE
		set @nNetprice = ROUND( @nNetprice * ( 1 - coalesce( @nDiscperc, 0 ) / 100 ), 2 )

	DECLARE cLocal2 CURSOR local FOR SELECT   Coalesce( r.red_discperc,0 ),
                  coalesce( r.red_discount,0 )
         FROM     r5reductions r
         WHERE    r.red_part         = @sPart
         AND      r.red_part_org     = @sPartorg
         AND      r.red_supplier     = @sSupplier
         AND      r.red_supplier_org = @sSupplierorg
		 AND      r.red_line           > @nRedline
         ORDER BY r.red_line

	OPEN cLocal2
	FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal2 INTO @nLocalDiscperc, @nLocalDiscount

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF @nLocalDiscount <> 0 
				set @nNetprice = @nNetprice - @nLocalDiscount
			ELSE
				set @nNetprice = ROUND( @nNetprice * ( 1 - @nLocalDiscperc / 100 ), 2 )

			FETCH NEXT FROM cLocal2 INTO @nLocalDiscperc, @nLocalDiscount
		END
	CLOSE cLocal2
	DEALLOCATE cLocal2

	IF @nNetprice < 0 
		begin   
			set @sChk = N'5'
			RETURN
		end

	set @nTotdisc = @nGrossprice - coalesce( @nNetprice, 0 )

	IF @nTotdisc >= @nGrossprice 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'5'
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'REDC', @sRstatent OUTPUT, @sRtypeent OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
				begin
					set @sChk = @sCheckresult
					return
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sRtype   = NULL
					set @sRedtype = @sType

					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sRtype OUTPUT, @sRedtype OUTPUT, @sRtypeent, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					IF @sCheckresult <> N'0' 
						begin	
							IF @sCheckresult = N'3' 
								begin
									set @sChk = N'6'
									RETURN
								end
							ELSE
								begin
									set @sChk = @sCheckresult
									RETURN
								end
						end
				end
		end

create procedure O7PREREQ  @sInsupd    nvarchar(3),
                     @sOrg       nvarchar(15),
                     @sClass        nvarchar(8),
                     @dReqdate      datetime    OUTPUT,
                     @sStatus    nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sOldrstatus   nvarchar(4),
                     @sRstatus      nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sAuth         nvarchar(255)   OUTPUT,
                     @sFromentity   nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sFromrentity  nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sFromtype     nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sFromrtype    nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sFromcode     nvarchar(30),
                     @sFromcodeorg  nvarchar(15),
                     @sToentity     nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sTorentity    nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sTotype    nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sTortype      nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sTocode    nvarchar(30),
                     @sReqtype      nvarchar(4),
                     @sReqrtype     nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT,
                     @sEvent        nvarchar(61),
                     @nAct       int,
                     @sCostcode     nvarchar(30),
                     @sOrigin    nvarchar(15),
                     @sDesc         nvarchar(80),
                     @sCode         nvarchar(30),
                     @sChk       nvarchar(4)    OUTPUT
as
   SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @sType       nvarchar(4)    --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
   declare @sStat       nvarchar(4)    --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
   declare @nCountit    int
   declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
   declare @sResult     nvarchar(4)
   declare  @sX            nvarchar(50)
   declare @sEvt        nvarchar(30)   --r5events.evt_code%type
   declare @sOldEvt      nvarchar(30)
   declare @dGtTime     datetime
   declare @nReturn     int
   declare @nPound          int

   set @sChk = N'0'
   set @nCountit = 0
   set @sCheckresult = N'0'
   set @sX = null

   if @sInsupd    is null or
    @sFromentity  is null or
    @sFromtype    is null or
    @sToentity    is null or
    @sTotype      is null or
    @sTocode      is null or
    @sReqtype     is null or
    @sInsupd not in ( N'INS', N'UPD' )
      begin
         set @sChk = N'1'
         return
      end

    set @nPound = charindex('#', @sEvent)
    if  @nPound = 0
        begin
          set @sEvt = @sEvent
          set @sOldEvt = '#'
        end
    else
        begin
          set @sEvt = substring(@sEvent,1,@nPound-1)
          set @sOldEvt = substring(@sEvent,@nPound +1, len(@sEvent)- @nPound)
        end

   set @sReqrtype = null
   set @sResult = null
   execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sResult OUTPUT, @sReqtype, N'RQTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

   if @sCheckresult = N'0'
      set @sReqrtype = @sResult
   else
      begin
         set @sChk = N'30'
         return
      end

   set @sFromrentity = null
   set @sFromrtype = null
   execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sFromrentity OUTPUT, @sFromentity OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

   if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
      begin
         set @sChk = N'17'
         return
      end

   execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP @sFromrentity, @sStat OUTPUT, @sType OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

   if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
      begin
         set @sChk = N'18'
         return
      end
   else
      begin
         if @sType is null
            begin
               set @sChk = N'26'
               return
            end
         else
            begin
               if @sType = N'*'
                  set @sFromrtype = N'*'
               else
                  begin
                     execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sFromrtype OUTPUT, @sFromtype OUTPUT, @sType, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1

                     if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                        begin
                           set @sChk = N'19'
                           return
                        end
                  end
            end
      end

   set @sTorentity = null
   set @sTortype = null
   execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sTorentity OUTPUT, @sToentity OUTPUT, N'ENT', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

   if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
      begin
         set @sChk = N'20'
         return
      end

   execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP @sTorentity, @sStat OUTPUT, @sType OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

   if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
      begin
         set @sChk = N'21'
         return
      end
   else
      begin
         if @sType is null
            begin
               set @sChk = N'27'
               return
            end
         else
            begin
               if @sType = N'*'
                  set @sTortype = N'*'
               else
                  begin
                     execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sTortype OUTPUT, @sTotype OUTPUT, @sType, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
                     if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                        return -1

                     if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
                        begin
                           set @sChk = N'22'
                           return
                        end
                  end
            end
      end

    if coalesce(@sOldrstatus, N'U') <> N'A'
        begin
           if @sEvt is not null AND @sEvt <> ''
              begin
                 execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'EVNT', N'*', @sEvt, null, N'REQ', null, null, null, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
                 if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                    return -1

                 if @nCountit < 1 and @sEvt <> @sOldEvt
                    begin
                       set @sChk = N'5'
                       return
                    end


                 execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'EVNT', N'*', @sEvt, N'A', N'>', @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
                 if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                    return -1

                 if @nCountit > 0
                    begin
                       if @nAct is null
                          begin
                             set @sChk = N'25'
                             return
                          end
                    end
                 else
                    begin
                       if @nCountit = 0
                          begin
                             set @sChk = N'8'
                             return
                          end
                       else
                          begin
                             set @sChk = @sCheckresult
                             return
                          end
                    end
              end
           else
              begin
                 if @nAct is not null
                    begin
                       set @sChk = N'24'
                       return
                    end
              end
        end

   execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'REQ', @sStat OUTPUT, @sType OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
   if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
      return -1

   if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
      begin
         set @sChk = N'12'
         return
      end
   else
      begin
         if @sStat is null
            begin
               set @sChk = N'23'
               return
            end
      end

   if @sInsupd = N'INS'
      begin
         execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sOrg
         if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
            return -1

name: O7PRERES
body:
create PROCEDURE O7PRERES
	@sInsupd    nvarchar(4),
	@sEvent     nvarchar(30),
	@nAct       int,
	@sPart      nvarchar(30),
	@sPartorg   nvarchar(15),
	@sProject   nvarchar(20),
	@sStore     nvarchar(15),
	@nResqty    numeric(24,6),
	@nAllqty    numeric(24,6),
	@sChk       nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit				int
	declare @sCheckresult			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX						nvarchar(1)
	declare @sEventorg				nvarchar(15) --r5organization.org_code%TYPE /* Org. of the event               */
	declare @nAvailqty				numeric(24,6)                /* Available qty of r5stock        */
	declare @nLeadtime				int                /* Lead time of r5stock            */
	declare @dActstart				datetime                  /* Start date of r5activities      */
	declare @nTotforevent			numeric(32,6)                /* Total qty for event             */
	declare @nForotherevents		numeric(32,6)                /* Total qty for other events      */
	declare @nTotstqty				numeric(24,6)                /* Total store qty                 */
	declare @dTempDate				datetime
	declare @nCount					int
	declare	@nReturn				int

/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0' 
	set @sCheckresult = N'0' 
	set @sX           = NULL
	set @nAvailqty   = 0   
	set @nLeadtime   = 0   
	set @dActstart   = NULL
/*   OR  @sStore    IS NULL  */
/* Check that all mandatory parameters are supplied */
	if  @sInsupd    IS NULL   OR  @sEvent    IS NULL    OR  @nAct      IS NULL    OR  @sStore    IS NULL    OR  @sPart     IS NULL 
	OR  @nResqty   IS NULL    OR  @nAllqty   IS NULL    OR  @sInsupd    NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'    /* mandatory parameter missing */
			return
		end
	/* Gets available quantity and lead time from r5stock */
	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM     r5stock s
	WHERE    s.sto_part     = @sPart
	AND      s.sto_part_org = @sPartorg
	AND      s.sto_store    = @sStore
	
	if @nCount > 0 
		SELECT   @nTotstqty = s.sto_qty,
			   @nLeadtime= s.sto_leadtime
		FROM     r5stock s
		WHERE    s.sto_part     = @sPart
		AND      s.sto_part_org = @sPartorg
		AND      s.sto_store    = @sStore
	else
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'    /* No data found in r5stock */
			return
		end

	/* Get the event organization */
	SELECT @sEventorg = evt_org
	FROM   r5events
	WHERE  evt_code = @sEvent

	if @sInsupd <> N'UPD' AND @nAllqty > 0 
		begin
		   /* when updating this will have to be done in user interface */
			SELECT @nTotforevent = coalesce( SUM( r.res_allqty ), 0 )
			FROM   r5reservations r
			WHERE  r.res_part     = @sPart
			AND    r.res_part_org = @sPartorg
			AND    r.res_store    = @sStore
			AND    r.res_event    = @sEvent
			AND    r.res_act      <> @nAct

			SELECT @nForotherevents = coalesce( SUM( r.res_allqty ), 0 )
			FROM   r5reservations r
			WHERE  r.res_part     = @sPart
			AND    r.res_part_org = @sPartorg
			AND    r.res_store    = @sStore
			AND    r.res_event    <> @sEvent
			
			set @nAvailqty = @nTotstqty - @nTotforevent - @nForotherevents 


			if @nAllqty > @nAvailqty 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'5'          /* Quantity > Available Quantity */
					return
				end
		end

	/* S15224, S15323 : if allocated     */
	/* quantity must be <= available qty of r5stock */
	if  @nAllqty > 0 
		begin
			/* check conditions for pre-insert */
			if @sInsupd = N'INS' 
				begin
					/* S15225 : if allocated  Project rstatus > N'C' (r5projects)   */
					if @sProject IS NOT NULL 
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'PROJ', N'*', @sProject, N'C', N'>', @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1

							if @nCountit > 0
								set @sX = null
							else
								begin
									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											SET @sChk = N'6'
											return
										end
									else
										begin
											SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
											return
										end
								end
						end
				end    /* end of @sInsupd = N'INS' */

			/* check conditions for pre-update */
			if @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
				begin
					/* S15324 : if allocated  Project rstatus = N'O' (r5projects)   */
					if @sProject IS NOT NULL 
						begin

							execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'PROJ', N'*', @sProject, N'O', N'=', @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1

							if @nCountit > 0
								set @sX = null
							else
								begin
									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											SET @sChk = N'7'
											return
										end
									else
										begin
											SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
											return
										end
								end
						end
				end     /* end of @sInsupd = N'UPD' */

			/* S15226, S15325 : if allocated and leadtime (r5stock) <> NULL */
			/*   @nLeadtime > (date required - system date)                   */
			/* Getting act_start from r5activities */
			select @nCount = count(*)
			FROM     r5activities a
			WHERE    a.act_event = @sEvent
			AND      a.act_act   = @nAct

			if @nCount > 0 
				SELECT   @dActstart = a.act_start
				FROM     r5activities a
				WHERE    a.act_event = @sEvent
				AND      a.act_act   = @nAct

			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dTempDate OUTPUT, @sEventorg
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if  @nLeadtime IS NOT NULL AND @nLeadtime < ( @dActstart - dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dTempDate, N'DD' ) ) 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'8'  /* Leadtime not > Date Req. - SYSDATE */
					return
				end
		end   /* end of if allocated */



	/* S15227, S15326 : Event rstatus > N'C' */
	if  @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'EVNT', N'*', @sEvent, N'C', N'>', @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

				if @nCountit > 0
					set @sX = null
				else
					begin
						if @nCountit = 0
							begin
								SET @sChk = N'9'
								return
							end
						else
							begin
								SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end
		end
	/* if any other oracle error */

create PROCEDURE  O7PRERIS
   @sInsupd        nvarchar(4),
   @sRisclass      nvarchar(8),
   @sRisclsorg     nvarchar(15),
   @sChk           nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
   declare @sX              nvarchar(1)
   declare @sCheckresult    nvarchar(3)
   declare @nCountit        int
   declare @nReturn			int

BEGIN
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sX           = NULL
	set @nCountit     = 0
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'


	IF @sInsupd NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' )
	OR @sInsupd IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end


   IF @sRisclass IS NOT NULL 
	   begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'RISK', @sRisclass, @sRisclsorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							SET @sChk = N'2'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
							return
						end
				end
	   end
END

create procedure O7PREROT
   @sInsupd          nvarchar(4),
   @sReqm            nvarchar(8),
   @sSuggest         nvarchar(8),
   @sChk             nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit          int
	declare @sCheckresult      nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @sX                nvarchar( 1 )
	declare @nReturn	int

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0'
	set @sCheckresult = N'0'
	set @nCountit     = 0
	set @sX           = NULL
	/* Mandatory parameter missing    */
	IF @sInsupd  NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )    OR @sReqm    IS NULL    OR @sSuggest IS NULL 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	/* Invalid value N'UPD' passed in @sInsupd  */
	IF @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			RETURN
		end


	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			/* W07212 Suggested Code must not have been defined earlier in the    */
			/* given tree structure */
			execute @nReturn = o7existw N'RECO', N'*', N'*', N'1', @sReqm, @sSuggest, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @nCountit = 0 
				set @sX = NULL
			ELSE
				begin
					IF @nCountit > 0 
						begin
							set @sChk = N'2'
							RETURN
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							set @sChk = @sCheckresult
							RETURN
						end
				end


			/* W07223 Suggested code and requirement code must belong to the same    */
			/* Event Class (r5reqclasses)                                            */
			/* Check for only non-generic required and suggested codes         */
			execute @nReturn = o7existw N'RECO', N'*', N'*', N'2', @sReqm, @sSuggest, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @nCountit = 0 
				set @sX = NULL
			ELSE
				begin
					IF @nCountit > 0 
						begin
							execute @nReturn = o7existw N'RECO', N'*', N'*', N'3', @sReqm, @sSuggest, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								return -1

							IF @nCountit = 0 
								set @sX = NULL
							ELSE
								begin
									IF @nCountit > 0 
										begin
											set @sChk = N'3'
											RETURN
										end
									ELSE
										begin
											set @sChk = @sCheckresult
											RETURN
										end
								end
						end
					ELSE
						begin
							set @sChk = @sCheckresult
							RETURN
						end
				end
		end

create procedure O7PRERQL	@sInsupd		nvarchar(3),
							@sReq			nvarchar(30),
							@sPart			nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
							@sPartorg		nvarchar(15)	OUTPUT,
							@dDuedate		datetime		OUTPUT,
							@nQty			numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
							@nRecvqty		numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
							@nRecvvalue		numeric(24,6)	OUTPUT,
							@sCostcode		nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
							@sProject		nvarchar(20)	OUTPUT,
							@sProjbud		nvarchar(20)		OUTPUT,
							@sEvent			nvarchar(30)	OUTPUT,
							@nAct			int				OUTPUT,
							@sType			nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT,
							@sRtype			nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT,
							@sQuotflag		nvarchar(1)		OUTPUT,
							@sActive		nvarchar(1)		OUTPUT,
							@nReqline		int,
							@sChk			nvarchar(4)		OUTPUT,
							@sSourcesystem	nvarchar(45),
							@sSourcecode	nvarchar(45)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(100)
	declare @sReqfromrentity	nvarchar(4)		--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
	declare @sReqtorentity		nvarchar(4)		--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
	declare @sReqtocode			nvarchar(30)	--r5requisitions.req_tocode%TYPE
	declare @sReqorg			nvarchar(15)	--r5organization.org_code%TYPE
	declare @sStatent			nvarchar(4)		--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
	declare @sTypent			nvarchar(4)		--r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
	declare @sResult			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sAct				nvarchar(20)
	declare @sReqrstatus		nvarchar(8)		--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @sReqrtype			nvarchar(8)		--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @sEvtrstatus		nvarchar(8)		--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE
	declare @sEvt				nvarchar(30)	--r5events.evt_code%type
	declare @dGtTime			datetime
	declare @nReturn			int

	set @sSourcesystem = null
	set @sSourcecode = null
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @nCountit = 0
	set @sX = null
	set @sReqfromrentity = null
	set @sReqtorentity = null
	set @sReqtocode = null
	set @sReqrstatus = null
	set @sReqrtype = null
	set @sStatent = null
	set @sTypent = null

	if @sInsupd	is null or
	 @sReq		is null or
	 @nQty		is null or
	 @nReqline	is null or
	 @sActive	is null or
	 @sInsupd not in ( N'INS', N'UPD' )
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end
	if @sInsupd = N'UPD'
		begin
			if @sType		is null or
			 @nRecvqty		is null or
			 @nRecvvalue	is null
				begin
					set @sChk = N'1'
					return
				end
		end
	
	select @sReqorg = REQ_ORG
      FROM r5requisitions
     WHERE req_code = @sReq

	execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'REQL', @sStatent OUTPUT, @sTypent OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'23'
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sStatent is null
				begin
					set @sChk = N'24'
					return
				end
		end
	
	execute @nReturn = O7GMORES N'REQ', 1, @sReq, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sReqrstatus OUTPUT, @sReqrtype OUTPUT, @sReqfromrentity OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sReqtorentity OUTPUT, @sReqtocode OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'4'
			return
		end

	if @sInsupd = N'INS'
		begin
			if @sSourcesystem is null and @sReqrstatus <> N'U'
				begin
					set @sChk = N'7'
					return
				end

			set @nRecvqty = 0
			set @nRecvvalue = 0
			set @sActive = N'+'

			if @sType is null
				begin
					set @sRtype = N'PS'
					set @sResult = null
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sResult OUTPUT, @sRtype, N'PLTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @sCheckresult = N'0'
						set @sType = @sResult
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'9'
							return
						end
				end

			execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dGtTime OUTPUT, @sReqorg
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @sSourcesystem is null and (dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dDuedate, N'DD' ) < dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dGtTime, N'DD' ))
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					return
				end

			if @sReqfromrentity = N'STOR' and @sPart is null
				begin
					set @sChk = N'17'
					return
				end

			if @sEvent is not null
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'EVNT', N'*', @sEvent, null, N'REQ', null, null, null, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @nCountit < 1
						begin
							set @sChk = N'11'
							return
						end

					execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'EVNT', N'*', @sEvent, N'A', N'>', @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @nCountit > 0
						begin
							if @nAct is null
								begin
									set @sChk = N'13'
									return
								end
						end
					else
						begin
							if @nCountit = 0
								begin
									set @sChk = N'8'
									return
								end
							else
								begin
									set @sChk = @sCheckresult
									return
								end
						end
				end
		end

	if @sInsupd = N'INS' or @sInsupd = N'UPD'
		begin
			if @sReqrstatus = N'U'
				begin
					set @sRtype = null
					set @sResult = null
					execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7RCODE @sResult OUTPUT, @sType, N'PLTP', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @sCheckresult = N'0'
						set @sRtype = @sResult
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'24'
							return
						end
				end
			if @sEvent is not null
				begin
					execute @nReturn = O7GMORES N'EVNT', 1, @sEvent, @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX OUTPUT, @sEvtrstatus OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sProject OUTPUT, @sProjbud OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sX OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1

					if @sChk <> N'0'
						begin
							set @sChk = N'10'
							return
						end
				end
		end

		begin

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PRESTC  
	@sInsupd      nvarchar(4),
	@sChildrtype  nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sChildtype   nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sChild       nvarchar(30),
	@sChildorg    nvarchar(15),
	@sParentrtype nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sParenttype  nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
	@sParent      nvarchar(30),
	@sParentorg   nvarchar(15),
	@sRolldown    nvarchar(1),
	@sRollup      nvarchar(1),
	@sEquivalent  nvarchar(1),
	@sDowntime    nvarchar(1),
	@sChk         nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
								  
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sLchild               nvarchar(30)	--r5objects.obj_code%TYPE /* Object Code for Child   */
	declare @sLchildorg            nvarchar(15)	--r5objects.obj_org%TYPE  /* Child organization      */
	declare @sLparent              nvarchar(30)	--r5objects.obj_code%TYPE /* Object Code for Parent  */
	declare @sLparentorg           nvarchar(15)	--r5objects.obj_org%TYPE  /* Parent organization     */
	declare @sLchildstatus         nvarchar(30)	--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE  /* Status of Child Object  */
	declare @sLparentstatus        nvarchar(30)	--r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE  /* Status of Parent Object */
	declare @nCountlparents         integer
	declare @nCountit               integer
	declare @sCheckresult           nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX                     nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn				integer
	declare @nRowcount				int

	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sX   = N'x'

	if @sChild            IS NULL
	OR @sChildorg         IS NULL
	OR @sParent           IS NULL
	OR @sParentorg        IS NULL
	OR @sRolldown         IS NULL
	OR @sRollup           IS NULL
	OR @sEquivalent       IS NULL
	OR @sDowntime         IS NULL
	OR @sInsupd            IS NULL
	OR ( @sChildtype      IS NULL AND @sChildrtype   IS NULL )
	OR ( @sParenttype     IS NULL AND @sParentrtype  IS NULL ) 
		begin
			set @sChk =  N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	if @sInsupd NOT in ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7EXISTO N'OBJ', @sX, @sX, @sChild, @sChildtype, N'I', @sChildorg, null, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
		return - 1

	if @nCountit = 0 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'13'
			RETURN
		end

	execute @nReturn = O7EXISTO N'OBJ', @sX, @sX, @sParent, @sParenttype, N'I', @sParentorg, null, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
		return - 1

	if @nCountit = 0 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'14'
			RETURN
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sParentrtype OUTPUT, @sParenttype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @sChildrtype OUTPUT, @sChildtype OUTPUT, N'OBTP', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sChk <> N'0' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end


	if @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			if @sChildrtype   =  N'L' AND @sParentrtype <> N'L' 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					RETURN
				end

			if @sChildrtype     =  N'S' AND @sParentrtype NOT IN( N'L', N'S' ) 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'4'
					RETURN
				end

			if @sChildrtype      =  N'P' AND @sParentrtype NOT IN( N'A', N'L', N'S', N'P' ) 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'5'
					RETURN
				end

			if @sParentrtype = N'L' AND @sChildrtype <> N'L' 
				begin
					SELECT @nCountlparents = count(*)
					FROM   r5structures s
					WHERE  s.stc_child      = @sChild
					AND    s.stc_child_org  = @sChildorg
					AND    s.stc_childrtype = @sChildrtype
					AND    s.stc_rolldown   = N'+'
					if @nCountlparents > 0 
						begin
							set @sChk = 12
							RETURN
						end
				end

			/* going up */
			/* This appears to be a bug/typon in the original Oracle Code.  I have coded as the Oracle code works.  
			The query can only return 1 potential row and does not need to be a hierarchical query as it exist.  The code should have the Parent varables in 
			bottom section of the code.

				SELECT s.stc_child,
				s.stc_child_org
				INTO   clchild,
				clchildorg
				FROM   r5structures s
				WHERE  s.stc_parent      = cchild
				AND    s.stc_parent_org  = cchildorg
				AND    s.stc_parentrtype = cchildrtype
				CONNECT BY
				s.stc_child           = PRIOR s.stc_parent
				AND    s.stc_child_org       = PRIOR s.stc_parent_org
				AND    s.stc_childrtype      = PRIOR s.stc_parentrtype
				START WITH
				s.stc_child           = cchild  <--  !!!!!These paramaters are more than likely typos in the ORACLE code!!!
				AND    s.stc_child_org       = cchildorg
				AND    s.stc_childrtype      = cchildrtype;
				chk := '6';
				RETURN;


			If the code is corrected then make the following code change
			SELECT @sLchild = child,
					@sLchildorg = child_org
			FROM   dbo.o7prestc_get_hierarchy_1 (@sParent,@sParentorg,@sParentrtype,@sChild,@sChildorg,@sChildrtype ) 

			For now the code performs a simple select into....
			*/

			SELECT	@sLchild = s.stc_child,
					@sLchildorg = s.stc_child_org
			FROM   r5structures s
			WHERE  s.stc_parent      = @sChild
				AND    s.stc_parent_org  = @sChildorg
				AND	   s.stc_child           = @sChild  
				AND    s.stc_child_org       = @sChildorg

			set @nRowcount = @@ROWCOUNT

			If @nRowcount <> 1 
				begin
					if @nRowcount = 0
						begin
							SELECT @sLchild = child,
									@sLchildorg = child_org
							FROM   dbo.o7prestc_get_hierarchy_2 (@sChild,@sChildorg,@sChildrtype,@sParent,@sParentorg,@sParentrtype )
							if @@ROWCOUNT > 1 
								begin
									set @sChk = N'6'
									RETURN
								end
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = N'6'
							RETURN
						end
				end

			if ( @sParentrtype <> N'S' ) 
				begin
					SELECT @sLparent = s.stc_parent,
					@sLparentorg = s.stc_parent_org
					FROM   r5structures       s
					WHERE  s.stc_parentrtype  = @sParentrtype
					AND    s.stc_child        = @sChild
					AND    s.stc_child_org    = @sChildorg
					AND    s.stc_childtype    = @sChildtype
					AND    s.stc_childrtype   = @sChildrtype
					If @@ROWCOUNT > 1 
						begin	
							set @sChk = N'7'
							RETURN
						end
				end

		end --@sInsupd = N'INS' 


	if @sRolldown = N'+' 
		begin
			SELECT @nCountlparents = count(*)
			FROM   r5objects o1,
				r5objects o2
			WHERE  o2.obj_code = @sChild
			AND    o2.obj_org  = @sChildorg
			AND    o1.obj_code = @sParent
			AND    o1.obj_org  = @sParentorg
			AND    o2.obj_location IS NOT NULL
			AND  ( o1.obj_location     <> o2.obj_location OR
				o1.obj_location_org <> o2.obj_location_org )
			if @nCountlparents > 0 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'15'
					RETURN
				end
		end

	if @sRolldown = N'+' AND @sParentrtype <> N'L' 
		begin
			SELECT @nCountlparents = count(*)
			FROM   r5structures
			WHERE  stc_child     = @sChild
			AND    stc_child_org = @sChildorg
			AND  ( stc_parent     <> @sParent OR
				stc_parent_org <> @sParentorg )
			AND    stc_parentrtype <> N'L'
			AND    stc_rolldown = N'+'
			if @nCountlparents > 0 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'16'
					RETURN
				end
		end

	SELECT @sLparentstatus = o.obj_rstatus
	FROM   r5objects     o
	WHERE  o.obj_code    = @sParent
	AND    o.obj_org     = @sParentorg
	AND    o.obj_obtype  = @sParenttype

	SELECT @sLchildstatus = o.obj_rstatus
	FROM   r5objects     o
	WHERE  o.obj_code    = @sChild
	AND    o.obj_org     = @sChildorg
	AND    o.obj_obtype  = @sChildtype
	if @sLparentstatus    = N'D' OR @sLchildstatus     = N'D' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'8'
			RETURN
		end

	if ( @sLparentstatus = N'A' OR   @sLchildstatus  = N'A' ) AND @sInsupd          = N'INS' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'9'
			RETURN
		end

	if @sLparentstatus   = N'B' OR @sLparentstatus   = N'C' OR @sLchildstatus    = N'B' OR @sLchildstatus    = N'C' 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'10'
			RETURN
		end

   RETURN

create function O7PRESTC_GET_HIERARCHY_2 (	@sCode	nvarchar(30),
											@sOrg	nvarchar(15), 
											@sRtype	nvarchar(4),
											@sParent nvarchar(30), 
											@sParentorg	nvarchar(15),
											@sParentrtype	nvarchar(4)  )
returns @tReturn table( child		nvarchar(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						child_org	nvarchar(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	declare @nLevel			int
	declare @sCurrentType	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCurrentRtype	nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( stc_child		nvarchar(30), 
							stc_child_org	nvarchar(15), 
							stc_childrtype nvarchar(4),
							LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack 
		select	stc_child, 
				stc_child_org,
				stc_childrtype, 
				1 
		  from	r5structures
		 where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
				stc_parent_org	= @sOrg	 and
				stc_parentrtype	= @sRtype and
				stc_child       = @sParent and
				stc_child_org   = @sParentorg and
				stc_childrtype  = @sParentrtype	

	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select	@sCode	= stc_child,
							@sOrg	= stc_child_org,
							@sCurrentRtype = stc_childrtype
					  from	@tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCode, @sOrg )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND stc_child = @sCode and stc_child_org = @sOrg and stc_childrtype = @sCurrentRtype
					insert into @tStack	select	stc_child, 
												stc_child_org,
												stc_childrtype, 
												@nLevel + 1
											from	r5structures
											where	stc_parent		= @sCode	and 
													stc_parent_org	= @sOrg	 and
													stc_parentrtype	= @sRtype and
													stc_child       = @sParent and
													stc_child_org   = @sParentorg and
													stc_childrtype  = @sParentrtype	
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create procedure O7PRESTL
   @sInsupd     nvarchar(4),
   @sTrans      nvarchar(30),
   @sType       nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @Rtype		nvarchar(4) OUTPUT,
   @sPart       nvarchar(30),
   @sPartorg    nvarchar(15),
   @nExpQty     numeric(24,6),
   @nPhyQty     numeric(24,6),
   @sChk        nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar( 4 )
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sX					nvarchar( 50 )
	declare @sStatent			nvarchar( 4 ) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE  /* Status Entity of r5stocktakelines */
	declare @sTypent			nvarchar( 4 ) --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE  /* Type Entity of r5stocktakelines   */
	declare @nReturn			int

	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk         = N'0' 
	set @nCountit     =  0  
	set @sCheckresult = NULL
	set @sX           = NULL
	set @sStatent    = NULL


	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInsupd IS NULL
	OR @sTrans IS NULL
	OR @sType  IS NULL
	OR @sInsupd NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) 
		begin
			set @sChk = N'1'       /* Parameter is missing */
			RETURN
		end

	IF @sInsupd = N'UPD' 
		begin
			IF @sPart   IS NULL OR @nExpQty IS NULL 
				begin
					set @sChk = N'1'        /* Parameter is missing */
					RETURN
				end
		end


/* Check conditions common to pre-insert and pre-update */
/* Gets Status and Type Entity from r5entities for r5stocktakelines */
	execute @nReturn = O7CKSTTP N'TRAN', @sStatent OUTPUT, @sTypent OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			if @sTypent is null
				begin
					set @sChk = N'7'
					return
				end
		end


	/* Gets the rtype for type */
	set @Rtype = @sX

	execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7CKCODE @Rtype OUTPUT, @sType OUTPUT, @sTypent, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
		begin
			set @sChk = N'8'
			return
		end

	/* S21223 : Check if stocktake rstatus = N'U'(r5transactions) */
	execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'TRAN', @sType, @sTrans, N'TRST', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @nCountit > 0
		begin
			set @sX = NULL
		end
	else
		begin
			if @nCountit = 0
				begin
					set @sChk = N'3'
					return
				end
			else
				begin
					set @sChk = @sCheckresult
					return
				end
		end

create PROCEDURE O7PRESTO 
	@sInsupd	    nvarchar(4),
	@sCstoclass    	nvarchar(8),
	@sCstoclassorg 	nvarchar(15),
	@dDstodate	    datetime OUTPUT,
	@sCprefstore   	nvarchar(15),
	@sCprefsup	    nvarchar(30),
	@sCstcode	    nvarchar(15),
	@sChk	    	nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
 AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

   	declare @nCountit		int
   	declare @sCstrpar		nvarchar(15) --r5stores.str_code%TYPE /* Parent Store of r5stores  */
   	declare @sCstrorg		nvarchar(15) --r5stores.str_org%TYPE /* organization of store  */
   	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
   	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @dDate			datetime
	/* Initialize */
	SET @sChk			=  N'0'
	SET @sX				=  NULL
	SET @sCheckresult	=  N'0'

	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInsupd    IS NULL    OR @sCstcode   IS NULL    OR @sInsupd    NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )	
		begin
			SET @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end

	/* Checks common to both insert and update mode */
	/* S1922D - Class must exist (r5classes)                        */

	IF @sCstoclass IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'STOC', @sCstoclass, @sCstoclassorg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
					return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
					set @sX = null
			else
					begin
						if @nCountit = 0
							begin
								set @sChk = N'4'
								return
							end
						else
							begin
								set @sChk = @sCheckresult
								return
							end
					end

		end
	/* S19228, S19229 */
	/* If Preferred supplier not null,  preferred store = NULL */
	/* If preferred store not null,  preferred supplier = NULL */
	IF  @sCprefsup   IS NOT NULL  AND @sCprefstore IS NOT NULL	
		begin
			set @sChk = N'5'
			return
		end
/* S1922B - Preferred store <> sub store of the store itself */
	IF @sCprefstore  IS NOT NULL  
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'STOR', N'*', @sCstcode, N'STOR', @sCprefstore, @sX, @sX,@sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit = 0
					set @sX = null
			else
					begin
						if @nCountit > 0
							begin
								set @sChk = N'6'
								return
							end
						else
							begin
								set @sChk = N'999'
								return
							end
					end
		end
/* Get the store organization */
	SELECT @nCountit = count(*) 
	FROM   r5stores
	WHERE  str_code = @sCstcode

	If @nCountit = 1

					RETURN -1
				
			set @dDstodate = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dDate, N'DD' )
		end

create PROCEDURE O7PRESTR
	@sInsupd	    nvarchar(4),
	@sCode    		nvarchar(15),
	@sParent 		nvarchar(15),
	@sClass 		nvarchar(8),
	@sClassOrg 		nvarchar(15),
	@sType 			nvarchar(15),
	@sLocation 		nvarchar(30),
	@sLocationOrg 	nvarchar(15),
	@sChk	    	nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
 AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

   	declare @nCountit		int
   	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
   	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn		int

	/* Initialize */
	SET @sChk			=  N'0'
	SET @sX				=  NULL
	SET @sCheckresult	=  N'0'

	/* Check for mandatory parameters */
	IF @sInsupd    IS NULL    OR @sCode   IS NULL    OR @sInsupd    NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' )	
		begin
			SET @sChk = N'1'
			return
		end

	/* S20225, Class must exist (r5classes, rentity = 'STOR')        */
	IF @sClass IS NOT NULL 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'STOR', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				set @sX = null
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						begin
							set @sChk = N'3'
							return
						end
					else
						begin
							set @sChk = @sCheckresult
							return
						end
				end
		end

/* S20223, S20323 - lType, Location must exist (r5objects)                */
/* REMOVED                                                                */
/* S20222, - Parent Store <> Sub Store                              */
/* Make sure there is no loop by a tree walk                               */
	IF @sInsupd = N'INS' 
		begin
			execute @nReturn = O7EXISTS N'STOR', N'*', @sCode, N'STOR', @sParent, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			if @nCountit > 0
				begin
					SET @sChk = N'5'
					return
				end
			else
				begin
					if @nCountit = 0
						set @sX = null
					else
						begin
							if @sCheckresult = N'2'
								begin
									SET @sChk = N'6'
									return
								end 
							else
								begin
									SET @sChk = @sCheckresult
									return
								end
						end
				end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PRETOL
	@sTolpriority		nvarchar(8),
	@nTolmin				numeric(4),
	@sTolmax				numeric(4),
	@sTolrowid			nvarchar(255),
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT

AS 
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nTolrowid  as integer
	declare @nCount 	as integer

BEGIN
/* Initialize */
	set @sChk     = N'0'
	set @nTolrowid = cast(@sTolrowid as integer)

	Select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM r5tolerance
	WHERE tol_priority = @sTolpriority AND 
		TOL_SQLIDENTITY <> coalesce(@nTolrowid,0) AND
		(( coalesce(@nTolmin,0) BETWEEN  coalesce(tol_min,0) AND coalesce(tol_max,9999) ) OR
		( coalesce(@sTolmax,0) BETWEEN  coalesce(tol_min,0) AND coalesce(tol_max,9999) )OR
		( coalesce(@nTolmin,0)<=coalesce(tol_min,0) AND coalesce(@sTolmax,0)>=coalesce(tol_max,9999) ))

	if @nCount > 0 
		set @sChk = N'1'
		
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PRETRA (	@insupd			NVARCHAR(3),
							@corg			NVARCHAR(15),
							@ccode			NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT,
							@ctype			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@crtype			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@cclass			NVARCHAR(8),
							@cclassorg		NVARCHAR(15),
							@ddate			DATETIME OUTPUT,
							@creq			NVARCHAR(30),
							@corder			NVARCHAR(30),
							@corderorg		NVARCHAR(15),
							@cstatus		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@cnewrstatus	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@cfromentity	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@cfromrentity	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@cfromtype		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@cfromrtype		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@cfromcode		NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT,
							@cfromcodeorg	NVARCHAR(15) OUTPUT,
							@ctoentity		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@ctorentity		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@ctotype		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@ctortype		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@ctocode		NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT,
							@ctocodeorg		NVARCHAR(15) OUTPUT,
							@cauth			NVARCHAR(30),
							@cadvice		NVARCHAR(45),
							@cfrompricecode	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@ctopricecode	NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@chk			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT)

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	-- New Variables
	DECLARE @nReturn	INTEGER
	DECLARE @TempDate	DATETIME

	-- Oracle Variables
	DECLARE @countit		INTEGER
	DECLARE @checkresult	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @x				NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @dperiod		DATETIME											/* Closed period */
	DECLARE @csupplier		NVARCHAR(30)	/* r5companies.com_code%TYPE		 Supplier  */
	DECLARE @csupplierorg	NVARCHAR(15)	/* r5companies.com_org%TYPE			Supplier organization  */
	DECLARE @creqorg		NVARCHAR(15)	/* r5organization.org_code%TYPE		Requisition organization */
	DECLARE @clrstatus		NVARCHAR(8)		/* r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE			rStatus */
	DECLARE @ordrstatus		NVARCHAR(8)		/* r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE			PO rstatus  */
	DECLARE @dlcompleted	DATETIME
	DECLARE @clrtype		NVARCHAR(8)		/* r5ucodes.uco_code%TYPE			rType  */
	DECLARE @cftypeent		NVARCHAR(4)		/* r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE		From Type Entity */
	DECLARE @cfstatent		NVARCHAR(4)		/* r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE		From Status Entity */
	DECLARE @cttypeent		NVARCHAR(4)		/* r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE		To Type Entity */
	DECLARE @ctstatent		NVARCHAR(4)		/* r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE		To Status Entity */
	DECLARE @clorder		NVARCHAR(30)	/* r5orders.ord_code%TYPE			Existing order code in r5transactions */
	DECLARE @clpercent		NUMERIC(18,0)			/*							pricing percentage  */

	-- Initialize
	SET @chk = N'0'
	SET @checkresult = N'0'
	SET @x = NULL

	-- Check for mandatory parameters
	IF	@insupd IS NULL
		OR (@ctype IS NULL AND @crtype IS NULL)
		OR (((@cfromrentity IS NULL  AND @cfromentity IS NULL) OR @cfromcode IS NULL) AND @creq IS NULL)
		OR @insupd NOT IN (N'INS', N'UPD')
		BEGIN
			SET @chk = N'1'
			RETURN
		END

	-- =======================================================================
	-- When Inserting then fetch Rcodes from codes or vv, meanwhile checking
	-- existance
	-- =======================================================================
	IF @insupd = N'INS'
		BEGIN
			-- From and Toentity
			IF @cfromentity IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					SET @cfromrentity = @x
				END
			EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @cfromrentity OUTPUT, @cfromentity OUTPUT, N'ENT', @checkresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @checkresult <> N'0'
				BEGIN
					SET @chk = N'10'
					RETURN
				END
			IF @ctoentity IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					SET @ctorentity = @x
				END
			IF @ctoentity IS NOT NULL OR @ctorentity IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ckcode @ctorentity OUTPUT, @ctoentity OUTPUT, N'ENT', @checkresult OUTPUT
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						return -1
				END
			IF @checkresult <> N'0'
				BEGIN
					SET @chk = N'11'
					RETURN
				END

			-- From and ToType. No transactions from/to entities with type in PK anymore
			-- Type is set to '*'. This has to be removed later on
			SET @cfromtype = N'*'
			SET @cfromrtype = N'*'
			SET @ctotype = N'*'
			SET @ctortype = N'*'

			-- S25223 - Type must exist (r5ucodes)
			IF @ctype IS NOT NULL
				BEGIN
					SET @crtype = @x
				END
			EXECUTE @nReturn =r5o7_o7ckcode @crtype OUTPUT, @ctype OUTPUT, N'TRTP', @checkresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @checkresult <> N'0'
				BEGIN
					IF @checkresult = N'999'
						SET @chk = @checkresult
					ELSE
						SET @chk = N'12'
					RETURN
				END

			-- S2522F  Check consistancy of type with from and to Rentity.
			SELECT @chk = 	CASE
								WHEN @crtype = N'I' AND @cfromrentity <> N'STOR' THEN
									N'10'
								WHEN @crtype = N'I' AND @ctorentity = N'COMP' THEN
									N'11'
								WHEN @crtype = N'RECV' AND @cfromrentity NOT IN ('COMP', 'STOR', 'EVNT') THEN
										N'10'
								WHEN @crtype =  N'RETN' AND @ctorentity NOT IN ('COMP', 'STOR') THEN
										N'11'
								WHEN @crtype = N'STTK' AND @cfromrentity <> 'STOR' THEN
										N'10'
								ELSE
									N'0'
							END
			IF @chk <> N'0'
				RETURN
		END


	-- =======================================================================
	-- insupd is 'INS' or 'UPD'
	-- =======================================================================
	-- S25221, S25321 - Class must exist (r5classes), rentity = 'TRAN'
	IF @cclass IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7exist N'CLAS', N'TRAN', @cclass, @cclassorg, N'*', @x, @x, @x, @x, @countit OUTPUT, @checkresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			IF @countit <= 0
				BEGIN
					IF @countit = 0
						SET @chk = N'4'
					ELSE
						IF @checkresult = N'2'
							SET @chk = N'3'
						ELSE
							SET @chk = N'401'
					RETURN
				END
		END

	-- S25222, S25322 - Status must exist (r5ucodes)
	IF @cstatus IS NOT NULL
		SET @cnewrstatus = @x

	EXECUTE @nReturn =  r5o7_o7ckcode @cnewrstatus OUTPUT, @cstatus OUTPUT, N'DOST', @checkresult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	IF @checkresult <> N'0'
		BEGIN
			IF @checkresult <> N'999'
				SET @chk = N'5'
			ELSE
				SET @chk = @checkresult  /* chk = 999 */
			RETURN
		END

	-- S25216, S25316 - Authorization is mandatory if rStatus = 'A'
	IF @cnewrstatus = N'A' AND @cauth IS NULL
		BEGIN
			SET @chk = N'41'
			RETURN
		END

	-- S2522H, S25324 - Check if To rEntity = 'EVNT' then Event
	--                  rStatus <> 'B' (r5events)
	--  and if rstatus = 'C' then evt_completed < SYSDATE + NISSDAYS
	IF @ctorentity = N'EVNT'
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@countit = COUNT(*)
			FROM	r5events
			WHERE	evt_code = @ctocode
			IF @countit > 0
				BEGIN
	            	SELECT	@clrstatus = evt_rstatus,
							@dlcompleted = evt_completed
					FROM	r5events e
					WHERE	e.evt_code = @ctocode
					IF @clrstatus  = N'B'
						BEGIN
							SET @chk = N'6'
							RETURN
						END
				END
		END
	IF @corder IS NULL AND @creq IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@creqorg = req_org
			FROM	r5requisitions
			WHERE	req_code = @creq
		END

	-- =======================================================================
	-- insupd is 'INS'
	-- =======================================================================
	IF @insupd = N'INS'
		BEGIN
			-- S25217 - Date must be less than or equal to System date
			-- If date is Null then assign System date
			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7gttime @TempDate OUTPUT, @corg
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

			IF @ddate IS NULL OR dbo.f_trunc_date(@ddate, N'DD') > dbo.f_trunc_date(@TempDate, N'DD')

				end

					-- S25226 - If order specified then Re

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PRETRL (
							@insupd				NVARCHAR(3),
							@ctrlobjtype		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@ctrltrans			NVARCHAR(30),
							@ntrlline			NUMERIC(8,0),
							@ctrllot			NVARCHAR(12) OUTPUT,
							@ctrlbin			NVARCHAR(15),
							@ctrlpart			NVARCHAR(30),
							@ctrlissuedpart		NVARCHAR(30),
							@ctrlpartorg		NVARCHAR(15),
							@ntrlqty			NUMERIC(24,6),
							@ctrlobject			NVARCHAR(30),
							@ctrlobjectorg		NVARCHAR(15),
							@ctrlreqline		NUMERIC(8,0),
							@ctrlproject		NVARCHAR(20) OUTPUT,
							@ctrlprojbud		NVARCHAR(20) OUTPUT,
							@ctrlevent			NVARCHAR(30),
							@ctrlcostcd			NVARCHAR(30) OUTPUT,
							@ctrlordline		NUMERIC(8,0),
							@ctrlstore			NVARCHAR(15) OUTPUT,
							@ntrlact			NUMERIC(8,0),
							@ctrlobjrtype		NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@ctrltype			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@ctrlrtype			NVARCHAR(4) OUTPUT,
							@ntrlio				INTEGER OUTPUT,
							@dtrldate			DATETIME OUTPUT,
							@chk				NVARCHAR(3) OUTPUT,
							@ctrlsourcesystem	NVARCHAR(45) = NULL,
							@ctrlsourcecode		NVARCHAR(45) = NULL)

AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
declare @tempstr nvarchar(32)

	DECLARE @iRecCount			INTEGER
	DECLARE @nReturn			INTEGER

	DECLARE @countit			INTEGER
	DECLARE @checkresult		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @x					NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @ctorentity			NVARCHAR(4)		/* torentity of r5transactions*/
	DECLARE @cfromrentity		NVARCHAR(4)		/* fromrentity of r5transactions*/
	DECLARE @crstatus			NVARCHAR(8)		/* r5ucodes.rstatus */
	DECLARE @devtcompleted		DATETIME
	DECLARE @cevtcostcd			NVARCHAR(30)	/* event costcode */
	DECLARE @cevtproj			NVARCHAR(20)	/* event project*/
	DECLARE @cevtprojbud		NVARCHAR(20)		/* event projectbudget*/
	DECLARE @cevtobject			NVARCHAR(30)	/* event object*/
	DECLARE @cevtobjectorg		NVARCHAR(15)	/* event object organization*/
	DECLARE @cevtobjtype		NVARCHAR(4)		/* event objecttype*/
	DECLARE @cevtobjrtype		NVARCHAR(4)		/* event objectrtype*/
	DECLARE @cobjobrtyp			NVARCHAR(4)		/* object objectrtype*/
	DECLARE @cevtrouteparent    NVARCHAR(30)	    /* event route parent            */

	DECLARE @cobjstore			NVARCHAR(15)	/* object store*/
	DECLARE @cobjrstatus		NVARCHAR(4)		/* object rstatus*/
	DECLARE @corlpart			NVARCHAR(30)	/* part code of orderlines*/
	DECLARE @corlpartorg		NVARCHAR(15)	/* part org of orderlines*/
	DECLARE @crqlpart			NVARCHAR(30)	/* part code of r5requislines*/
	DECLARE @crqlpartorg		NVARCHAR(15)	/* part org of r5requislines*/
	DECLARE @dtradate			DATETIME
	DECLARE @ctraord			NVARCHAR(30)	/* transaction order*/
	DECLARE @ctraordorg			NVARCHAR(15)	/* transaction order organizaton*/
	DECLARE @ctracode			NVARCHAR(30)	/* transaction code*/
	DECLARE @ctraorg			NVARCHAR(15)	/* transaction org.*/
	DECLARE @ctratocode			NVARCHAR(30)	/* transaction tocode*/
	DECLARE @ctratocodeorg		NVARCHAR(15)	/* transaction tocode org.*/
	DECLARE @ctrafromcode		NVARCHAR(30)	/* transaction fromcode*/
	DECLARE @ctrafromcodeorg	NVARCHAR(15)	/* transaction fromcode org.*/
	DECLARE @ctrareq			NVARCHAR(30)	/* transaction requisition code*/
	DECLARE @cstatent			NVARCHAR(4)		/* Status entity*/
	DECLARE @ctypent			NVARCHAR(4)		/* Type entity*/
	DECLARE @nqty				NUMERIC(24,6)	/* quantity orderded*/
	DECLARE @nqtyavb			NUMERIC(24,6)	/* quantity available*/
	DECLARE @norlordqty			NUMERIC(24,6)	/* order quantity*/
	DECLARE @norlrecvqty		NUMERIC(24,6)	/* order received quantity*/
	DECLARE @ctraadvice			NVARCHAR(45)
	DECLARE @ctrartype			NVARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @ctratype			NVARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @ngracedays			INTEGER
	DECLARE @corlrtype			NVARCHAR(8)
	DECLARE @nstocksign			INTEGER
	DECLARE @ntrlrecvqty		NUMERIC(24,6)	/*  r5translines.trl_qty%TYPE Total order line qty  being received */
	DECLARE @cOVERRECV			NVARCHAR(2000)	/* R5ORGANIZATIONOPTIONS.OPA_DESC%TYPE */

	-- Initialize
	SET @countit        = 0
	SET @checkresult    = N'0'
	SET @chk            = N'0'
	SET @x              = NULL
	SET @nqty           = 0
	SET @nqtyavb        = 0
	SET @norlordqty     = 0
	SET @norlrecvqty    = 0
	SET @nstocksign     = SIGN(@ntrlqty) * @ntrlio

	-- Check that mandatory parameters are supplied
	IF @insupd    IS  NULL
	OR ( @ctrlpart  IS  NULL and coalesce( @ctrlrtype, 'a') <> 'MISC' )
	OR @ntrlqty   IS  NULL
	OR @ctrltrans IS  NULL
	OR @ntrlio    IS  NULL
	OR @insupd    NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' )
	BEGIN
		SET @chk = N'1'
		RETURN
	END

	-- Fetch relevant information from the corresponding transaction
	SELECT	@iRecCount = COUNT(*)
	FROM	r5transactions
	WHERE	tra_code = @ctrltrans
	IF @iRecCount > 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT	@cfromrentity = t.tra_fromrentity,
					@ctorentity = t.tra_torentity,
					@ctraord = t.tra_order,
					@ctraordorg = t.tra_order_org,
					@ctrareq = t.tra_req,
					@ctratocode = t.tra_tocode,
					@ctratocodeorg = t.tra_tocode_org,
					@ctrafromcode = t.tra_fromcode,
					@ctrafromcodeorg = t.tra_fromcode_org,
					@ctrartype = t.tra_rtype,
					@ctratype = t.tra_type,
					@ctraadvice = t.tra_advice,
					@dtradate = t.tra_date,
					@ctraorg = t.tra_org
			FROM	r5transactions t
			WHERE	t.tra_code = @ctrltrans
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @chk = N'31'
			RETURN
		END

	IF @ctrlrtype IS NULL AND @ctrltype IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
      		EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7rcode @ctrlrtype OUTPUT, @ctrltype, N'TRTP', @chk OUTPUT
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
		END

	IF @ctrlrtype NOT IN ( N'RR', N'RREC' )
		BEGIN
			SET @ctrlrtype = @ctrartype
			SET @ctrltype  = @ctratype
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @nReturn = r5o7_o7ucode @ctrltype OUTPUT, @ctrlrtype, N'TRTP', @chk OUTPUT
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1
		END

	IF @dtrldate IS NULL
		SET @dtrldate = @dtradate

-- Derive store on transaction line from header data.
   IF @ctrlrtype <> N'STTK'
	   BEGIN
		   IF @cfromrentity = N'STOR' AND @ctorentity = N'STOR'
				BEGIN
					IF @ctrartype = N'RECV' OR @ctrartype = N'HIR' OR ( @ctrartype = N'IHI' AND @ntrlqty < 0)
						SET @ctrlstore = @ctratocode
					ELSE
						SET @ctrlstore = @ctrafromcode
				END
		   ELSE
				BEGIN
					IF @cfromrentity = N'STOR'
						SET @ctrlstore = @ctrafromcode
					ELSE
						BEGIN
							IF @ctorentity = N'STOR'
								SET @ctrlstore = @ctratocode
						END
				END
		END

	-- Fetch the store of which stock is being transferred and
	-- the direction the material Goes into ctrlstore and ntrlio
	IF @ntrlio IS NULL
		BEGIN
			EXECUTE @nReturn = o7trans_get_store 	@checkresult OUTPUT, @ntrlio OUTPUT, @ctrlstore OUTPUT, @ctrartype,
													@cfromrentity, @ctrafromcode, @ctorentity, @ctratocode
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				RETURN -1

		END
	IF @checkresult <> N'0'
		BEGIN
			SET @chk = N'45'
     		RETURN
		END
		
	--Set the store for direct receipt to wordorder.EWS #29993
   	IF @ctrartype = N'RECV' AND @ctorentity = N'EVNT' AND @cfromrentity = N'COMP' AND @ntrlio=0 
   		BEGIN   
      			SELECT  @ctrlstore = ord_store  
      			FROM   r5orders o
       			WHERE  o.ord_code     = @ctraord
       			AND    o.ord_org      = @ctraordorg
   	END   
   	
	SET @nstocksign = SIGN(@ntrlqty) * @ntrlio


	-- S2422A  - If transaction involves order (r5transactions) then
	-- S2422A1 - Order, Order line must exist  (r5orderlines)
	IF @ctraord IS NOT NULL
		BEGIN
			-- Fetching data from r5orderlines
			SELECT @iRecCount = COUNT(*)
			FROM	r5orderlines
			WHERE	orl_order = @ctraord
				AND	orl_order_org = @ctraordorg
				AND	orl_ordline = @ctrlordline
			IF @iRecCount > 0
				BEGIN
					SELECT	@corlpart = o.orl_part,
							@corlpartorg = o.orl_part_org,
							@norlordqty = o.orl_ordqty,
							@norlrecvqty = coalesce(o.orl_recvqty,0),
							@corlrtype = o.orl_rtype
					FROM	r5orderlines  o
					WHERE	o.orl_order = @ctraord
						AND	o.orl_order_org = @ctraordorg
						AND	o.orl_ordline = @ctrlordline
						
					execute @nReturn = o7getorgoption @cOVERRECV OUTPUT, N'OVERRECV', @ctraorg, @

CREATE FUNCTION O7PRETRL_GET_HIERARCHY_1 (	@cobject		NVARCHAR(30),
											@cobjectorg		NVARCHAR(15),
											@cevtobject		NVARCHAR(30),
											@cevtobjectorg	NVARCHAR(15),
											@cevtobjtype		NVARCHAR(4))

RETURNS @tReturn TABLE (stc_child		NVARCHAR(30)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
						stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15)	COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN,
						stc_childtype	NVARCHAR(4)		COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @nLevel					INTEGER
	DECLARE @currentchild			NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @currentchildorg		NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @currentchildtype		NVARCHAR(4)

	DECLARE @tStack	TABLE ( stc_child		NVARCHAR(30), 
							stc_child_org	NVARCHAR(15),
							stc_childtype	NVARCHAR(4),
							LevelID 		INTEGER )

	SET @nLevel = 1

	INSERT INTO @tStack
		SELECT	stc_child,
				stc_child_org,
				stc_childtype,
				@nLevel
		FROM	r5structures
		WHERE	stc_child      = @cevtobject
			AND	stc_child_org  = @cevtobjectorg
			AND	stc_childtype  = @cevtobjtype
			AND	stc_parent     = @cobject
			AND	stc_parent_org = @cobjectorg
			AND	stc_parentrtype =  N'A'

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					IF @nLevel >= 1
						BEGIN
							SELECT	@currentchild		= stc_child,
									@currentchildorg	= stc_child_org,
									@currentchildtype	= stc_childtype
							FROM	@tStack
							WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
							INSERT INTO @tReturn
									VALUES ( @currentchild, @currentchildorg, @currentchildtype)
						END

					DELETE FROM @tStack
						WHERE	LevelID = @nLevel
							AND stc_child		= @currentchild
							AND stc_child_org	= @currentchildorg
							AND stc_childtype	= @currentchildtype

					INSERT INTO @tStack
					SELECT	stc_child,
							stc_child_org,
							stc_childtype,
							@nLevel
					FROM	r5structures
					WHERE	stc_child      = @cevtobject
						AND	stc_child_org  = @cevtobjectorg
						AND	stc_childtype  = @cevtobjtype
						AND	stc_parent     = @currentchild
						AND	stc_parent_org = @currentchildorg
						AND	stc_parenttype = @currentchildtype
						AND	stc_parentrtype =  N'A'

					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE 
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END
	RETURN 
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PRETRP
	@sInsupd			nvarchar(6),
	@sPfunction			nvarchar(6),
	@sTab				nvarchar(6),
	@sPselect			nvarchar(1),
	@sPupdate			nvarchar(1),
	@sPinsert			nvarchar(1),
	@sPdelete			nvarchar(1),
	@sChk				nvarchar(4) OUTPUT
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sFselect       nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFupdate       nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFinsert       nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFdelete       nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCount			integer
BEGIN
	set @sChk = N'0'

	if @sInsupd     IS NULL
	OR @sPfunction IS NULL
	OR @sInsupd     NOT IN( N'INS', N'UPD' )
	begin
		set	@sChk = N'1'
		return
	end

	select @nCount = count(*)
	from   r5functiontabs
	where  ftb_function = @sPfunction and
	ftb_tab      = @sTab

	if @nCount > 0
		select @sFselect = ftb_select,
			@sFupdate = ftb_update,
			@sFinsert = ftb_insert,
			@sFdelete = ftb_delete
		from   r5functiontabs
		where  ftb_function = @sPfunction and
		ftb_tab      = @sTab
	else
		begin
			set	@sChk = N'3'
			return
		end

	if  @sPselect  IS NOT NULL and @sFselect  IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk  =  N'4'
			return
		end

	if  @sPupdate  IS NOT NULL and @sFupdate  IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk  =  N'5'
			return
		end

	if  @sPinsert  IS NOT NULL and ( @sFinsert  IS NULL OR @sFinsert = N'-' )
		begin
			set @sChk  =  N'6'
			return
		end

	if  @sPdelete  IS NOT NULL and @sFdelete  IS NULL
		begin
			set @sChk  =  N'7'
			return
		end

END

create PROCEDURE O7PREWAC 
   @sInsupd         nvarchar(4),
   @sWacstandwork   nvarchar(20),
   @nWacduration    int,
   @nWacstart       int,
   @sChk            nvarchar(4) OUTPUT 
   
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nStwduration    int               /* Duration   */
	declare @nCount int
	declare @sX nvarchar(1)
	/* Initialize */
	set @sChk     = N'0'

	/* Check that all mandatory parameters are supplied */
	IF @sInsupd        NOT IN ( N'INS', N'UPD' ) OR @nWacstart     IS NULL  OR @nWacduration  IS NULL OR @sWacstandwork IS NULL 
		begin 
			set @sChk = N'1'
			RETURN
		end
	/* Select standard work order duration from r5standworks for given standard */
	/* work order code */

	select @nCount = count(*)
	FROM   r5standworks s
	WHERE  s.stw_code   = @sWacstandwork


	if @nCount = 1
		SELECT @nStwduration = coalesce( s.stw_duration, 0 )
		FROM   r5standworks s
		WHERE  s.stw_code   = @sWacstandwork
	else
		begin
			 set @sChk = N'3'
			 RETURN
		end

	/* W29124 offset + Duration <= Standard Workorder duration + 1 */
	/* (r5standworks) */
	IF ( @nWacstart + @nWacduration ) <= ( @nStwduration + 1 ) 
		set @sX = NULL
	ELSE
		begin
			set @sChk = N'2'
			RETURN
		end
