body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7PRMTCH(	
  					@ord NVARCHAR(30),
  					@org NVARCHAR(15),
  					@lin NUMERIC(8,0) )
 
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	-- New Variables
	DECLARE @sCheckresult	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sDeforg		NVARCHAR(200)
	DECLARE @nReturn		INTEGER
	DECLARE @sResult		NVARCHAR(8)

	-- Oracle Declared Variables		
	DECLARE @qtymatched      NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @matchlta        NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @matchltp        NUMERIC(5,2)
	DECLARE @invqtytol       NUMERIC(7,2)
	DECLARE @chkamount       NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @maxamount       NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @minamount       NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @orlmatch        NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @ivlmatch        NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @nowmatched      NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @status          NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @rstatus         NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @matchhold       NVARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @matchholdline   NVARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @chk             NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @x               NVARCHAR(100)
		
	-- c_ivl Cursor Variable
	DECLARE @civl_invoice		NVARCHAR(45)
	DECLARE @civl_invoice_org	NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @civl_invline		NUMERIC(8,0)
	DECLARE @cinv_supplier		NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @cinv_supplier_org	NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @cinv_prematchuser	NVARCHAR(255)
	DECLARE @cqtyopen			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @cqtyinv			NUMERIC(24,6)
			
	-- c_ivl3 Cursor Variable
	DECLARE @c3ivl_invvalue			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3ivl_order			NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @c3ivl_ordline			NUMERIC(8,0)
	DECLARE @c3ivl_order_org		NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @c3ivl_invqty			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3ivl_price			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3ivl_rtype			NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @c3ivl_tottaxamount		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3ivl_totextra			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3orl_recvqty			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3orl_recvvalue		NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3orl_price			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3orl_multiply			NUMERIC(10,4)
	DECLARE @c3orl_ordqty			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3orl_invqty			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3orl_invvalue			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3orl_disc				NUMERIC(18,0)
	DECLARE @c3orl_totextra			NUMERIC(24,6)
	DECLARE @c3ivl_invline			NUMERIC(8,0)
		
	DECLARE c_ivl CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR
			SELECT	l.ivl_invoice,
					l.ivl_invoice_org,
					l.ivl_invline,
					i.inv_supplier,
					i.inv_supplier_org,
					i.inv_prematchuser,
					CASE o.orl_rtype
						WHEN N'SF' THEN o.orl_recvvalue - ISNULL(o.orl_invvalue, 0)
						ELSE (o.orl_recvqty - ISNULL(o.orl_invqty, 0)) / ISNULL(o.orl_multiply, 1)
					END qtyopen,
					CASE o.orl_rtype
						WHEN N'SF' THEN l.ivl_price
						ELSE l.ivl_invqty
					END qtyinv
			FROM	r5invoices i,
					r5orderlines o,
					r5invoicelines l
			WHERE	i.inv_code      = l.ivl_invoice
				AND	i.inv_org       = l.ivl_invoice_org
				AND	l.ivl_order     = o.orl_order
				AND	l.ivl_order_org = o.orl_order_org
				AND	l.ivl_ordline   = o.orl_ordline
				AND	i.inv_rstatus   = N'PM'
				AND	l.ivl_order     = @ord
				AND	l.ivl_order_org = @org
				AND	l.ivl_ordline   = @lin
            ORDER  BY i.inv_date

	SET @matchhold = N'-'
	SET @nowmatched = 0
			
	OPEN c_ivl
			
	FETCH NEXT
	FROM 	c_ivl
	INTO 	@civl_invoice,
			@civl_invoice_org,
			@civl_invline,
			@cinv_supplier,
			@cinv_supplier_org,
			@cinv_prematchuser,
			@cqtyopen,
			@cqtyinv
			
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			IF @cqtyopen - @nowmatched >= @cqtyinv
				BEGIN
					-- Retrieve qty matched on other invoices 
					SELECT	@qtymatched = ISNULL(SUM(CASE l.ivl_rtype
														WHEN N'SF' THEN l.ivl_price
														ELSE l.ivl_invqty
													END), 0)
					FROM	r5invoices i,
							r5invoicelines l
					WHERE	i.inv_code      = l.ivl_invoice
						AND	i.inv_org       = l.ivl_invoice_org
						AND	i.inv_rstatus   = N'M'
						AND	l.ivl_order     = @ord
						AND	l.ivl_order_org = @org
						AND	l.ivl_ordline   = @lin
								
					IF @cqtyopen - ISNULL(@qtymatched , 0) - @nowmatched >= @cqtyinv
						BEGIN
							-- First retrieve tolerances 
							SELECT	@matchlta = org_matchlta,
									@matchltp = org_matchltp,
									@invqtytol = org_invqtytol
							FROM   r5organization
							WHERE  org_code = @civl_invoice_org
							
					        -- There is enough open to invoice, so 
					        -- check all other lines on the invoice. 
							DECLARE c_ivl3 CURSOR LOCAL FOR --ivl3 ( curinv VARCHAR2, curorg VARCHAR2 ) IS
										SELECT	i.ivl_invvalue,
												i.ivl_order,
												i.ivl_ordline,
												i.ivl_order_org,
												i.ivl_invqty,
												i.ivl_price,
												i.ivl_rtype,
												i.ivl_tottaxamount,
												i.ivl_totextra,
												o.orl_recvqty,
												o.orl_recvvalue,
												o.orl_price,
												o.orl_multiply,
												o.orl_ordqty,
												o.orl_invqty,
												o.orl_invvalue,
												(ISNULL(h.ord_discperc, 0) + ISNULL(o.orl_discperc, 0) -
														(ISNULL(h.ord_discperc, 0) * ISNULL(o.orl_discperc, 0) / 100)) orl_disc,
												o.orl_totextra,
												i.ivl_invline
										FROM	r5orderlines o,
												r5orders h,
												r5invoicelines i
										WHERE	o.orl_order       = i.ivl_order
											AND	o.orl_ordline     = i.ivl_ordline
											AND	o.orl_order_org   = i.ivl_order_org
											AND	h.ord_code        = i.ivl_order
											AND	h.ord_org         = i.ivl_order_org
											AND	i.ivl_invoice     = @civl_invoice
											AND	i.ivl_invoice_org = @civl_invoice_org
							
							OPEN c_ivl3
 							FETCH NEXT
							FROM	c_ivl3
							INTO	@c3ivl_invvalue,
									@c3ivl_order,
									@c3ivl_ordline,
									@c3ivl_order_org,
									@c3ivl_invqty,
									@c3ivl_price,
									@c3ivl_rtype,
									@c3ivl_tottaxamount,
									@c3ivl_totextra,
									@c3orl_recvqty,
									@c3orl_recvvalue,
									@c3orl_price,
									@c3orl_multiply,
									@c3orl_ordqty,
									@c3orl_invqty,
									@c3orl_invvalue,
									@c3orl_disc,
									@c3orl_totextra,
									@c3ivl_invline
	
							WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
								BEGIN
						        	SET @matchholdline = N'-'
						        	-- Check no more invoiced than received 
									SELECT	@qtymatched = ISNULL(SUM(CASE l.ivl_rtype
																		WHEN N'SF' THEN l.ivl_price
																		ELSE l.ivl_invqty
																	END), 0)
									FROM	r5invoices i,
											r5invoicelines l
									WHERE	i.inv_code      = l.ivl_invoice
										AND	i.inv_org       = l.ivl_invoice_org
										AND	i.inv_rstatus   = N'M'
										AND	l.ivl_order     = @c3ivl_order
										AND	l.ivl_order_org = @c3ivl_order_org
										AND	l.ivl_ordline   = @c3ivl_ordline
										
							        IF (((@c3ivl_invqty + ISNULL(@qtymatched, 0)) * ISNULL(@c3orl_multiply, 1)) + ISNULL(@c3orl_invqty, 0) > ISNULL(@c3orl_recvqty, 0)
											AND @c3ivl_rtype <> N'SF')
										OR	(@c3ivl_invvalue + ISNULL(@c3orl_invvalue, 0) + ISNULL(@qtymatched, 0) > ISNULL(@c3orl_recvvalue, 0)
											AND @c3ivl_rtype = N'SF') 
										BEGIN
											SET @matchhold = N'+'
											SET @matchholdline = N'O'
								        END
						   	    	SET @orlmatch = @c3orl_price * ( ( 100 - ISNULL( @c3orl_disc, 0 ) ) / 100 ) +
						 	                	( ISNULL( @c3orl_totextra, 0 ) / @c3orl_ordqty / ISNULL( @c3orl_multiply, 1 ) )
										
									SET @ivlmatch = @c3ivl_price + ( ISNULL( @c3ivl_totextra, 0 ) / @c3ivl_invqty )
										
									IF	@matchlta IS NOT NULL AND @c3ivl_rtype <> N'SF' AND @matchholdline = N'-'
										BEGIN
											-- Check absolute tolerance
											IF @orlmatch - @matchlta > 0
												SET @minamount = @orlmatch - @matchlta
											ELSE
												SET @minamount = 0
											SET @maxamount = @orlmatch + @matchlta
											
											IF @ivlmatch NOT BETWEEN @minamount AND @maxamount
												BEGIN
													-- Something wrong, set variables accordingly 
													SET @matchhold     = N'+'

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PROCESSSURVEYEVENTS
  @pk             NVARCHAR( 50 ),
  @email          NVARCHAR( 255 ) OUTPUT,
  @surveyurl      NVARCHAR( 2000 ) OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @entity       NVARCHAR(   4 )
  DECLARE @emailsource  NVARCHAR(   4 )
  DECLARE @code         NVARCHAR(  30 )
  DECLARE @org          NVARCHAR(  15 )
  DECLARE @assignedto   NVARCHAR(  15 )
  DECLARE @createdby    NVARCHAR(  255 )
  DECLARE @reportedby   NVARCHAR(  15 )
  DECLARE @supplier     NVARCHAR(  30 )
  DECLARE @supplierorg  NVARCHAR(  15 )
  DECLARE @guestemail   NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @email1       NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @email2       NVARCHAR( 255 )
  DECLARE @entbycaller  NVARCHAR(  255 )
  DECLARE @return       INT
  DECLARE @chk          NVARCHAR(   4 )
  
  SELECT @entity      = sev_entity,
         @emailsource = sev_emailsource,
         @code        = sev_code,
         @org         = sev_org
  FROM   r5customersurveyevents
  WHERE  sev_pk = @pk
  
  IF @entity = N'EVNT'
    SELECT @assignedto  = evt_person, 
           @createdby   = evt_enteredby,
           @reportedby  = evt_origin, 
           @supplier    = evt_supplier,
           @supplierorg = evt_supplier_org,
           @guestemail  = evt_guestemail
    FROM   r5events     
    WHERE  evt_code= @code
  ELSE IF @entity = N'COCT' 
    SELECT @assignedto  = ctr_assignedto, 
           @createdby   = ctr_createdby,
           @supplier    = ctr_supplier, 
           @supplierorg = ctr_supplier_org,
           @email1      = ctr_primaryemail, 
           @email2      = ctr_secondaryemail
    FROM   r5contactrecords
    WHERE  ctr_code = @code
    AND    ctr_org  = @org
  ELSE IF @entity = N'SERQ' 
    SELECT @assignedto  = srq_assignedto, 
           @createdby   = srq_enteredby, 
           @email1      = srq_callemail, 
           @email2      = srq_contemail, 
           @entbycaller = srq_enteredbycaller
    FROM   r5servicerequests
    WHERE  srq_code = @code
  ELSE
    RETURN
  
  IF @emailsource IN ( N'WOAT', N'CCAT', N'SRAT' ) 
    SELECT @email = per_emailaddress
    FROM   r5personnel
    WHERE  per_code = @assignedto
  ELSE IF @emailsource IN ( N'WOCB', N'CCRT', N'SREB' )
    SELECT @email = usr_emailaddress
    FROM   r5users
    WHERE  usr_code = @createdby
  ELSE IF @emailsource IN ( N'WOSP', N'CCSP' )
    SELECT @email = com_email
    FROM   r5companies
    WHERE  com_code = @supplier
    AND    com_org  = @supplierorg
  ELSE IF @emailsource = N'WORB'
    SELECT @email = per_emailaddress
    FROM   r5personnel
    WHERE  per_code = @reportedby
  ELSE IF @emailsource = N'SREC'
    SELECT @email = cll_email
    FROM   r5callers
    WHERE  cll_id = @entbycaller or cll_externcode = @entbycaller;  
  ELSE IF @emailsource = N'WOGE' 
    SET @email = @guestemail
  ELSE IF @emailsource IN ( N'CCPE', N'SRLE' )
    SET @email = @email1
  ELSE IF @emailsource IN ( N'CCSE', N'SRCE' )
    SET @email = @email2
  /* Get survey url. */
  EXECUTE @return = dbo.O7DFLT @surveyurl OUTPUT, N'SURVYURL', @chk OUTPUT
  IF @@ERROR != 0 OR @return = -1
    BEGIN
      RETURN
    END
  /* Do update of email column. */
  UPDATE r5customersurveyevents
  SET    sev_emailaddress = ISNULL( @email, N'<NULL>' ), 
         sev_surveyurl    = @surveyurl
  WHERE  sev_pk = @pk
END

create procedure O7PROMPT_APMDEL_TO_DELETE	 @sPrompt nvarchar(8), @sPtype nvarchar(4), @sAspect nvarchar(30)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sTable			nvarchar(32)
	declare @sSql			nvarchar(500)
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @nIdx			int

	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7PROMPT_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sTable = dbo.GET_O7PROMPT_FUNC_TEMP_TBLNAME()

	set @sSql = N'select @nCount = count(*) from ' + @sTable + N' where prompt_stack = @sPrompt and aspc_stack = @sAspect '
	execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nCount int OUTPUT, @sPrompt nvarchar(8), @sAspect nvarchar(30)', @nCount OUTPUT, @sPrompt, @sAspect
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	set @sSql = N'select @nIdx = isnull(max(nIndex), 0) + 1 from ' + @sTable
	execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nIdx int OUTPUT', @nIdx OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0
		return -1

	if @nCount = 0
		begin
			set @sSql = N'insert into ' + @sTable + N' values ( @nIdx, @sPrompt, @sPtype, @sAspect )'
			execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@nIdx int, @sPrompt nvarchar(8), @sPtype nvarchar(4), @sAspect nvarchar(30)', @nIdx, @sPrompt, @sPtype, @sAspect
			if @@ERROR <> 0
				return -1
		end

create procedure O7PROMPT_DELETE_LOVS	 @sPrompt nvarchar(8), @sPtype nvarchar(4), @sAspect nvarchar(30)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sTable			nvarchar(32)
	declare @sSql			nvarchar(500)
	declare @nTempId		int
	declare	@sTempAspc		nvarchar(30)
	declare	@sTempPtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sTempPrompt	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nRetVal		int
	declare @sErrorMsg		nvarchar(255)


	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7PROMPT_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7PROMPT', N'DeleteIsCascading', N'true'
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	set @sTable = dbo.GET_O7PROMPT_FUNC_TEMP_TBLNAME()

	CREATE TABLE #tPrompt (nId integer, 
						 prompt NVARCHAR(8) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,
						 ptype NVARCHAR(4) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL,
						 aspc NVARCHAR(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN NULL)


	set @sSql = N'insert into #tPrompt select nIndex, prompt_stack, ptype_stack, aspc_stack from ' + @sTable 

	execute (@sSql)
	IF @@ERROR <> 0
		begin
			drop table #tPrompt
			return -1
		end

	declare c_prompt cursor local for select nId, prompt, ptype, aspc from #tPrompt
		open c_prompt
		fetch next from c_prompt into @nTempId, @sTempPrompt, @sTempPtype, @sTempAspc
		while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
			begin
				execute @nReturn = O7PROMPT_LIST_EXISTS @nRetVal OUTPUT, @sTempPrompt, @sTempPtype, @sTempAspc
				if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
					begin
						close c_prompt
						deallocate c_prompt
						drop table #tPrompt
						return -1
					end

				if @nRetVal = 1
					begin
						DELETE FROM r5promptvalues 
						WHERE pmv_code IS NULL
						AND   pmv_prompt   = @sTempPrompt
						AND   pmv_aspect   = @sTempAspc
						if @@ERROR <> 0 
							begin
								close c_prompt
								deallocate c_prompt
								drop table #tPrompt

								execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7PROMPT', N'DeleteIsCascading', N'false'
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									return -1

								set @sErrorMsg = N'Error deleting LOV for property' + @sPrompt + @sAspect
								RAISERROR (@sErrorMsg, 16, 1) 
								return -1

							end
					end

				fetch next from c_prompt into @nTempId, @sTempPrompt, @sTempPtype, @sTempAspc
  			end
		close c_prompt
		deallocate c_prompt
		drop table #tPrompt


	execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7PROMPT', N'DeleteIsCascading', N'false'
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

create procedure O7PROMPT_PACKAGE_INIT
as
	--This procedure will be called from all procs and funcs within
	--this package.  This is to simulate package initialization scripts in Oracle
	SET NOCOUNT ON

	declare @sInitHasRun	nvarchar(8)
	declare @nReturn		int

	execute @nReturn = GET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7PROMPT', N'InitHasRun', @sInitHasRun OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	if @sInitHasRun = N'false'
		begin
			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7PROMPT', N'DeleteIsCascading', N'false'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7PROMPT', N'CallingApplication', N'PLUS'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			--create temporary package tables
			execute @nReturn = CREATE_O7PROMPT_FORM_TMP_TABLE
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1

			execute @nReturn = SET_PACKAGE_VARIABLE N'O7PROMPT', N'InitHasRun', N'true'
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end

create procedure O7PROMPT_STORE_VALUE	@sPrompt nvarchar(8), @sValue nvarchar(40),
										@sAspect nvarchar(30), @sCode nvarchar(40),
										@sDatatype nvarchar(255), @sDateFormat	nvarchar(255)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nReturn		integer
	declare @dValue			datetime
	declare @nValue			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sValue2		nvarchar(40)


	--run initialization code if necessary
	execute @nReturn = O7PROMPT_PACKAGE_INIT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	If @sDatatype = N'NUM' 
		set @nValue = convert(numeric(38,0), @sValue)
	else
		begin
			if @sDatatype = N'DATE' or @sDatatype = N'DATI' 
				set @dValue = convert( datetime, @sValue)
			Else
				set @sValue2 = @sValue
		end


	SELECT 1
	FROM r5promptvalues
	WHERE pmv_prompt  = @sPrompt
	AND   pmv_aspect    = @sAspect
	AND   pmv_code      = @sCode

	if @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
		begin
			IF @sValue IS NULL 
				RETURN
			ELSE
				INSERT INTO r5promptvalues(pmv_prompt,
					pmv_aspect,   pmv_code,   pmv_value,
					pmv_nvalue,   pmv_dvalue, pmv_seqno)
				VALUES (@sPrompt, @sAspect, @sCode,
					@sValue2, @nValue, @dValue, 1    )
		end
	ELSE
		begin
			IF @sValue IS NULL 
				DELETE FROM r5promptvalues
				WHERE pmv_prompt   = @sPrompt
				AND   pmv_aspect   = @sAspect
				AND   pmv_code     = @sCode
			ELSE
				UPDATE r5promptvalues
				SET pmv_value  = @sValue2,
				pmv_nvalue = @nValue,
				pmv_dvalue = @dValue
				WHERE pmv_prompt   = @sPrompt
				AND   pmv_aspect   = @sAspect
				AND   pmv_code     = @sCode
		end

create function O7PROP_LIST_EXISTS (  @sProp    nvarchar(8),
                    @sProtype nvarchar(8),
                    @sRentity nvarchar(4),
                    @sClass   nvarchar(8),
                    @sClsorg  nvarchar(15),
                    @sListtype  nvarchar(1) )
returns int
as
begin
  declare @nLists   int
  declare @nElements  int

  set @nLists = 0
  set @nElements = 0

  if @sListtype = N'-' or @sProtype = N'RENT'
    return 0

  SELECT @nElements = count(*)
    FROM r5propertyvalues v
   WHERE v.prv_code IS NULL
   AND   v.prv_property  = @sProp
   AND   v.prv_rentity   = CASE @sListtype WHEN N'P' THEN N'*' ELSE @sRentity END
   AND   v.prv_class     = CASE @sListtype WHEN N'C' THEN @sClass ELSE N'*' END
   AND   v.prv_class_org = @sClsorg

  if @nElements = 0
    return 0
  else
    begin
      if @sListtype = N'C'
        return 1
    end

  SELECT @nLists = count(*)
    FROM r5addproperties a
   WHERE a.apr_property  = @sProp
   AND   a.apr_rentity   = CASE @sListtype WHEN N'P' THEN a.apr_rentity ELSE @sRentity END
   AND   a.apr_class     = CASE @sListtype WHEN N'C' THEN @sClass ELSE a.apr_class END
   AND   a.apr_class_org = @sClsorg
   AND   a.apr_list      = @sListtype

  return @nLists + 1
end

as
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @sType    nvarchar(4)
  declare @nCountit int
  declare @nNcountit  int

  set @nCountit = 0
  set @nNcountit = 0

  if @sProp is null or @sRentity is null or @sList is null
    begin
      execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'PROC', 1
      return -1
    end

  SELECT @sType = p.pro_type
    FROM r5properties p
   WHERE p.pro_code = @sProp

  if @sType in ( N'RENT', N'CODE' ) and @sUom is not null
    begin
      execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREAPR', N'PROC', 1
      return -1
    end

  if @sType = N'RENT' and @sList <> N'P'
    begin
      execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREAPR', N'PROC', 2
      return -1
    end

  /* This code is a placeholder to match up w/ Oracle.  This code will not be executed
     for SQL Server.  It is there to support Oracle Forms and the way it handles
     custom fields. */
  if @sInsupd = N'INSF'
    begin
      if @sClass <> N'*'
        SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
          FROM r5addproperties p
         WHERE p.apr_property  = @sProp
          AND  p.apr_rentity   = @sRentity
          AND  p.apr_class     = N'*'
          AND  p.apr_class_org = @sClassorg
      else
        SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
          FROM r5addproperties p
         WHERE p.apr_property  = @sProp
          AND  p.apr_rentity   = @sRentity
          AND  p.apr_class    <> N'*'
          AND  p.apr_class_org = @sClassorg

      if @nCountit > 0
        begin
          execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREAPR', N'PROC', 3
          return -1
        end

      if @sRentity = N'CLVL'
        begin
          SELECT @nNcountit = count(*)
            FROM r5addproperties, r5classes
           WHERE apr_property = @sProp
            AND  apr_rentity  = N'CLVL'
            AND  cls_rentitycode = N'PART'

          if @nNcountit > 0
            begin
              execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREAPR', N'PROC', 3
              return -1
            end
        end
    end

create procedure O7PROP_PREPRO  @sInsupd  nvarchar(3),
                @sPrompt  nvarchar(8),
                @sType    nvarchar(4),
                @sMinval  nvarchar(40),
                @sMaxval  nvarchar(40)
as
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @dMin   datetime
  declare @dMax   datetime
  declare @nMin   numeric(24,6)
  declare @nMax   numeric(24,6)
  declare @sMin   nvarchar(40)  /*r5properties.pro_min%TYPE*/
  declare @sMax   nvarchar(40)  /*r5properties.pro_max%TYPE*/

   declare @sChardcodeddateformat     nvarchar(10)
   declare @schardcodeddatetimeformat nvarchar(18)


   set @sChardcodeddateformat     = N'MM/DD/RRRR'
   set @schardcodeddatetimeformat = N'MM/DD/RRRR HH24:MI'


  if @sMinval is null and @sMaxval is null
    return

  if @sPrompt is null or @sType is null
    begin
      execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREPRO', N'PROC', 1
      return -1
    end

  if @sMinval is not null and @sMaxval is not null
    begin
      if @sType = N'CHAR' and @sMinval > @sMaxval OR
          @sType = N'NUM' and cast( @sMinval as numeric(24,6)) > cast( @sMaxval as numeric(24,6)) OR
          @sType = N'DATE' and convert(datetime, @sMinval, 101) > convert(datetime, @sMaxval, 101) OR
          @sType = N'DATI' and convert(datetime, @sMinval, 101) > convert(datetime, @sMaxval, 101)
        begin
          execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREPRO', N'PROC', 2
          return -1
        end
    end

  if @sInsupd = N'INS'
    return

  SELECT  @sMin = MIN( prv_value ),
      @sMax = MAX( prv_value ),
      @nMin = MIN( prv_nvalue ),
      @nMax = MAX( prv_nvalue ),
      @dMin = MIN( prv_dvalue ),
      @dMax = MAX( prv_dvalue )
  FROM   r5propertyvalues
  WHERE  prv_property = @sPrompt

  if @sMinval is not null
    begin
      if @sType = N'NUM' and cast( @sMinval as numeric(24,6)) > @nMin     OR
          @sType = N'DATE' and convert(datetime, @sMinval, 101) > @dMin OR
          @sType = N'DATI' and convert(datetime, @sMinval, 101) > @dMin OR
          @sType = N'CHAR' and @sMinval > @sMin
        begin
          execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREPRO', N'PROC', 3
          return -1
        end
    end

  if @sMaxval is not null
    begin
      if @sType = N'NUM' and cast( @sMaxval as numeric(24,6)) < @nMax     OR
          @sType = N'DATE' and convert(datetime, @sMaxval, 101) < @dMax OR
          @sType = N'DATI' and convert(datetime, @sMaxval, 101) < @dMax OR
          @sType = N'CHAR' and @sMaxval > @sMax
        begin
          execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREPRO', N'PROC', 4
          return -1
        end
    end

create procedure O7PROP_PREPRV  @sInsupd  nvarchar(3),
                @sProp    nvarchar(8),
                @sRentity nvarchar(4),
                @sClass   nvarchar(8),
                @sCode    nvarchar(100),
                @sOldcode nvarchar(100),
                @nSeqno   int,
                @sValue   nvarchar(80),
                @sOldvalue  nvarchar(80),
                @nValue   numeric(24,6),
                @nOldvalue  numeric(24,6),
                @dValue   datetime,
                @dOldvalue  datetime
as
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @dDate    datetime
  declare @nReturn  int

  execute @nReturn = O7GTTIME @dDate OUTPUT, null
  if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
    return -1

  if @sInsupd not in ( N'INS', N'UPD' )  or @sProp is null or @sRentity is null or @sClass is null
    begin
      RAISERROR( N'R5/o7prop.preprv : Mandatory Parameter missing', 16, 1 )
      return -1
    end

  if @sOldcode is null and @sInsupd = N'UPD'
    begin
      if @sCode is not null
        begin
          execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREPRV', N'PROC', 1
          return -1
        end
    end

  if @sOldcode is null and @sInsupd = N'UPD'
    begin
      if coalesce( @sValue, N'NULL' ) <> coalesce( @sOldvalue, N'NULL' )  OR
        coalesce( @nValue, 0 )    <> coalesce( @nOldvalue, 0 )
        begin
          execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREPRV', N'PROC', 2
          return -1
        end
    end

create procedure O7PROP_STORE_DESC  @sProp  nvarchar(8),
                  @sValue nvarchar(80),
                  @sDesc  nvarchar(80)
as
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @nCountit int

  SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
    from r5pvdescriptions
   WHERE pvd_property = @sProp
   AND   pvd_value  = @sValue

  if @nCountit = 0
    INSERT INTO r5pvdescriptions( pvd_property, pvd_value,  pvd_desc)
               VALUES ( @sProp,   @sValue,  @sDesc )
  else
    begin
      if @sDesc is null
        BEGIN
          DELETE FROM r5pvdescriptions
          WHERE pvd_property  = @sProp
          AND   pvd_value   = @sValue
          AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 'x' 
                          FROM   r5properties
                          WHERE  pro_code = @sProp
                          AND    pro_type = N'CODE' )
          UPDATE r5pvdescriptions
          SET    pvd_desc = null
          WHERE  pvd_property = @sProp
          AND    pvd_value = @sValue
        END
      else
        UPDATE r5pvdescriptions
           SET pvd_desc = @sDesc
         WHERE pvd_property = @sProp
         AND   pvd_value  = @sValue
    end

create procedure O7PROP_STORE_VALUE @sProp      nvarchar(8),
                  @sRentity   nvarchar(4),
                  @sValue     nvarchar(80),
                  @sClass     nvarchar(8),
                  @sClsorg    nvarchar(15),
                  @sCode      nvarchar(100),
                  @sDatatype    nvarchar(16),
                  @sDate_format nvarchar(64)
as
  SET NOCOUNT ON
  declare @nCountit int
  declare @dValue   datetime
  declare @nValue   numeric(24,6)
  declare @sCvalue  nvarchar(80)  /*r5propertyvalues.prv_value%TYPE*/

  if @sDatatype = N'NUM'
    set @nValue = cast( @sValue as numeric(24,6) )
  else
    begin
      if @sDatatype = N'DATE' or @sDatatype = N'DATI'
        set @dValue = cast( @sValue as datetime )
      else
        set @sCvalue = @sValue
    end

  SELECT @nCountit = count(*)
    FROM r5propertyvalues
   WHERE prv_property  = @sProp
   AND   prv_rentity   = @sRentity
   AND   prv_class     = @sClass
   AND   prv_class_org = @sClsorg
   AND   prv_code      = @sCode

  if @nCountit = 0
    begin
      if @sValue is null
        return
      else
        INSERT INTO r5propertyvalues(
          prv_property, prv_rentity,
          prv_class,    prv_class_org, prv_code, prv_value,
          prv_nvalue,   prv_dvalue,    prv_seqno)
        VALUES (
          @sProp, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClsorg, @sCode,
          @sCvalue, @nValue, @dValue, 1    )
    end
  else
    begin
      if @sValue is null
        DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
        WHERE prv_property   = @sProp
        AND   prv_rentity    = @sRentity
        AND   prv_class      = @sClass
        AND   prv_class_org  = @sClsorg
        AND   prv_code       = @sCode
      else
        UPDATE r5propertyvalues
        SET prv_value  = @sCvalue,
            prv_nvalue = @nValue,
            prv_dvalue = @dValue
        WHERE prv_property   = @sProp
        AND   prv_rentity    = @sRentity
        AND   prv_class      = @sClass
        AND   prv_class_org  = @sClsorg
        AND   prv_code       = @sCode
    end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PROVIDERTOSUPPLIER
AS
BEGIN

  DECLARE @code         NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @org          NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @supplier     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @supplierorg  NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @line         NUMERIC

  /* Loop through all providers not yet converted. */
  DECLARE psc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT psc_code, psc_org, psc_supplier, psc_supplier_org
    FROM   r5pscategories 
    WHERE  psc_rtype = N'PD'
    AND    ISNULL( psc_providerconverted, N'-' ) = N'-'
    AND    psc_supplier IS NOT NULL
  OPEN psc
  FETCH NEXT FROM psc INTO @code, @org, @supplier, @supplierorg
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      UPDATE r5events 
      SET    evt_supplier     = @supplier,
             evt_supplier_org = @supplierorg
      WHERE  evt_provider     = @code
      AND    evt_provider_org = @org
      AND    evt_supplier IS NULL

      UPDATE r5contactrecords
      SET    ctr_supplier     = @supplier,
             ctr_supplier_org = @supplierorg
      WHERE  ctr_provider     = @code
      AND    ctr_provider_org = @org
      AND    ctr_supplier IS NULL

      UPDATE r5objectsdm
      SET    sdm_supplier       = @supplier,
             sdm_supplier_org   = @supplierorg,
             sdm_supplier_check = sdm_provider_check
      WHERE  sdm_provider       = @code
      AND    sdm_provider_org   = @org
      AND    sdm_supplier IS NULL

      UPDATE r5kbarticles
      SET    kba_supplier     = @supplier,
             kba_supplier_org = @supplierorg
      WHERE  kba_provider     = @code
      AND    kba_provider_org = @org
      AND    kba_supplier IS NULL

      UPDATE r5kbacrossreference
      SET    krf_supplier     = @supplier,
             krf_supplier_org = @supplierorg
      WHERE  krf_provider     = @code
      AND    krf_provider_org = @org
      AND    krf_supplier IS NULL

      UPDATE r5departmentstructure
      SET    dps_supplier     = @supplier,
             dps_supplier_org = @supplierorg
      WHERE  dps_provider     = @code
      AND    dps_provider_org = @org
      AND    dps_supplier IS NULL

      SET @line = NULL
      SELECT @line = MAX( cco_contline )
      FROM   r5compcontacts
      WHERE  cco_company     = @supplier
      AND    cco_company_org = @supplierorg
      SET @line = ISNULL( @line, 0 ) + 1
      IF @line < 100000000 
        INSERT INTO r5compcontacts( cco_company, cco_company_org, cco_contline, cco_name, cco_address1, cco_address2, 
               cco_city, cco_state, cco_zipcode, cco_email, cco_secondaryemail, 
               cco_phone, cco_secondaryphone, cco_tertiaryphone,
               cco_fax, cco_secondaryfax, cco_emailfax, cco_preferredcontactmethod, cco_outofservice )
        SELECT psc_supplier, psc_supplier_org, @line, SUBSTRING( psc_code + N' ' + psc_desc, 1, 80 ), psc_address1, psc_address2,
               psc_city, psc_state, psc_zip, SUBSTRING( psc_primaryemail, 1, 45 ), psc_secondaryemail, 
               SUBSTRING( psc_primaryphone, 1, 45 ), psc_secondaryphone, psc_tertiaryphone,
               SUBSTRING( psc_primaryfax, 1, 45 ), SUBSTRING( psc_secondaryfax, 1, 45 ), psc_emailfax, psc_pcmethod, psc_notused 
        FROM   r5pscategories 
        WHERE  psc_rtype = N'PD'  
        AND    psc_code  = @code
        AND    psc_org   = @org

      UPDATE r5pscategories 
      SET    psc_providerconverted = N'+'
      WHERE  psc_code  = @code
      AND    psc_org   = @org
      AND    psc_rtype = N'PD'

      FETCH NEXT FROM psc INTO @code, @org, @supplier, @supplierorg
    END 
  CLOSE psc
  DEALLOCATE psc
END

create PROCEDURE O7PRPRWO
    @sSessionId       nvarchar(38),
    @sDepartment      nvarchar(15),
    @sEquipment       nvarchar(30),
    @sStore           nvarchar(15),				
    @sLocation        nvarchar(30),
    @sOrg             nvarchar(30),
    @sUser            nvarchar(255),
    @sRole            nvarchar(30) = '*'
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @nTempJobLineNum        numeric(38,0)
    declare @sStatus                nvarchar(4)--r5events.evt_status%TYPE
    declare @sLastEquipmentCode     nvarchar(30)--r5objects.obj_code%TYPE = '_xx'
    declare @sLastEquipmentOrg      nvarchar(15)--r5objects.obj_org%TYPE = '_xx'
    declare @sLastDepartment        nvarchar(15)--r5mrcs.mrc_code%TYPE = '_xx'
    declare @sLastStore             nvarchar(15)--r5stores.str_code%TYPE = '_xx'
    declare @sLastStoreOrg          nvarchar(15)--r5stores.str_org%TYPE = '_xx'
	declare @sLastStandardWo        nvarchar(20)--r5standworks.stw_code%TYPE := '_xx';
    declare @nTempJobNum            numeric(38,0)
    declare @nQty                   numeric(24,6)
    declare @sChk                   nvarchar(3)

    declare @sUseStockMethod        nvarchar(1)
    declare @sGroup                 nvarchar(30)
    
    declare @sReq_store         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sFrom_rentity      nvarchar(4)
    declare @sSto_repprefsup    nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSto_repprefsup_org nvarchar(15)
    declare @sSto_repmrc        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sFromparty         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sFrompartyorg      nvarchar(15)
    declare @sCurr              nvarchar(4)
    declare @sExch              numeric(24,12)
    declare @sDefexch           numeric(24,12)
    declare @sRqlPart           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sRqlpartorg        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sPart_org          nvarchar(50)
    declare @sPar_uom           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sByasset           nvarchar(1)
    declare @nRqlreqqty         numeric(24,6)
    declare @nPrice             numeric(24,6)
    declare @nMultiply          integer
    declare @sUOM               nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSBuyer            nvarchar(255)
    declare @dRqldue            datetime
    declare @nSto_qty           numeric(24,6)
    declare @sCat_repref        nvarchar(50)
    declare @sStore_org         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sSTWO              nvarchar(20)
    declare @sObjectcode        nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOborg             nvarchar(15)
    declare @sObrtype           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sObtype            nvarchar(4)
    declare @sObloc             nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOblocorg          nvarchar(15)
    declare @nReturn            integer
    declare @nAssignedQty       numeric(24,6)
    declare @nAssignedOnWOQty       numeric(24,6)--r5repairbins.rpb_qty%TYPE;
    declare @nAssignedOnReqQty      numeric(24,6)--r5repairbins.rpb_qty%TYPE;

	declare @sSTWODesc			nvarchar(80)	--r5descriptions.des_text%TYPE := NULL;
	declare @sUserLang			nvarchar(2)	--r5users.usr_lang%TYPE;
        
    set @nAssignedQty = 0
    set @nTempJobLineNum = 0
    set @sLastEquipmentCode = N'_xx'
    set @sLastEquipmentOrg = N'_xx'
    set @sLastDepartment   = N'_xx'
    set @sLastStore   = N'_xx'
    set @sLastStoreOrg   = N'_xx'
    set @nTempJobNum = 0
    set @nQty = 0
    set @sUseStockMethod = N'-'
	set @sLastStandardWo   = N'_xx'


    set @sChk          = N'0'
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT  @sStatus OUTPUT, N'INSWOST', @sChk OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

    SELECT @sGroup = uog_group
    FROM   r5userorganization
    WHERE  uog_user = @sUser
    AND    uog_role = @sRole
    AND    uog_org  = @sOrg

    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        set @sGroup = N'R5'

    -- deleting the exiting temporary work orders
    DELETE FROM r5tempwmbwog WHERE tev_sessionid = @sSessionId
    -- deleting the existing lines
    DELETE FROM r5tempjoblines WHERE tjb_sessionid = @sSessionId

     -- create temp work order record

    DECLARE cPart CURSOR local FOR SELECT   DISTINCT  s.sto_store  REQ_STORE,
            case  s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then s.sto_repprefsup else s.sto_repmrc end   FROM_PARTY,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'-' then b.obj_code else null end  OBJECTCODE,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'-' then b.obj_org else null end     OBORG,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'-' then s.sto_repstandwork else null end STWO,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then N'COMP' else N'MRC' end   FROM_RENTITY,
            s.sto_repprefsup,
            s.sto_repprefsup_org,
            s.sto_repmrc,
            case  s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then s.sto_repprefsup_org else null end   FROM_PARTY_ORG,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then coalesce( a.cat_curr, c.com_curr ) else z.org_curr end  CURR,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then coalesce(dbo.o7gtexch2( coalesce( a.cat_curr, c.com_curr ), st2.str_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ), N'DD' )), 1) else
                                                       coalesce(dbo.o7gtexch2 ( z.org_curr, st2.str_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ), N'DD' ) ), 1)  end   EXCH,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then coalesce(dbo.o7gtexch2( coalesce( a.cat_curr, c.com_curr ), @sOrg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), N'DD' )), 1) else
                                                       coalesce(dbo.o7gtexch2 ( z.org_curr, @sOrg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), N'DD' ) ), 1)  end   DEF_EXCH,
            s.sto_part  RQL_PART,
            s.sto_part_org RQL_PART_ORG,
            case s.sto_part_org when @sOrg then s.sto_part else s.sto_part + N' (' + s.sto_part_org + N')' end  part_org,
            p.par_uom,
            coalesce(p.par_byasset, N'-') byasset,
            dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( s.sto_repairqty, 0 ) - coalesce( h.obj_qty, 0 ) - coalesce( j.ojl_qty, 0 ) + ISNULL( r.jrp_qty, 0 ), 0 ) RQL_REQQTY,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then coalesce( a.cat_repprice , dbo.o7getprc( s.sto_store, s.sto_part, s.sto_part_org, st2.str_org, N'B', null, null ) ) else
                                       coalesce( s.sto_repprice, 0 )  end  PRICE,
            1  MULTIPLY,
            p.par_uom   UOM,
            p.par_buyer  BUYER,
            dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ),'DD') + coalesce( s.sto_repleadtime, 0 ) RQL_DUE ,
            s.sto_qty,
            a.cat_repref,
            st2.str_org store_org,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'-' then b.obj_obrtype else null end  OBRTYPE,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'-' then b.obj_obtype else null end  OBTYPE,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'-' then b.obj_location else null end  OBLOC,
            case s.sto_repairtype when N'-' then b.obj_location_org else null end  OBLOCORG
    FROM    r5install i2,
            r5stock s left outer join r5catalogue a on (s.sto_part = a.cat_part AND s.sto_repprefsup = a.cat_supplier AND s.sto_part_org = a.cat_part_org AND s.sto_repprefsup_org = a.cat_supplier_org )
                        left outer join r5companies c on (s.sto_repprefsup = c.com_code AND s.sto_repprefsup_org = c.com_org )
                        left outer join r5parts p on (s.sto_part = p.par_code AND s.sto_part_org = p.par_org)
                        left outer join r5objects b on (s.sto_repobject = b.obj_code AND s.sto_repobject_org = b.obj_org )
                        left outer join r5stores st2 on (st2.str_code = s.sto_store)

create procedure O7PRREQS	@nSessionid			int	,		
							@sSupplier			nvarchar(30),
							@sSupplierorg   	nvarchar(15),
							@sStore				nvarchar(15),
							@sABCclass			nvarchar(1),
							@sOrg				nvarchar(15),
							@sCostcode			nvarchar(30),
							@sRequestedby		nvarchar(255),
							@sDefaultapprover	nvarchar(255),
							@sPartClass			nvarchar(30),
							@sConsignFlag		nvarchar(30),
							@sUser				nvarchar(255),
							@sPart              nvarchar(30),
							@sPartorg           nvarchar(15),
							@nOrderqty          numeric(24,6),
							@sRepairresult      nvarchar(1)     OUTPUT,
							@nPurchaseQty       numeric(24,6)   OUTPUT,
							@sAutoSelPrvRecs    nvarchar(1),
							@sRole              nvarchar(30) = '*'
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @nQty					numeric(24,6)
	declare @nQty2					numeric(24,6)
	declare @nExcludereservedqty	numeric(24,6)
	declare @nSequenceNumber        integer
    declare @dDuedate				datetime
	declare @sChk					nvarchar(4)
    declare @sUseStockMethod        nvarchar(1)

	declare @sConsignment			nvarchar(1)

    declare @sReq_store         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sFrom_rentity      nvarchar(4)
    declare @sSto_repprefsup    nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSto_repprefsup_org nvarchar(15)
    declare @sSto_repmrc        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sFromparty         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sFrompartyorg      nvarchar(15)
    declare @sCurr              nvarchar(4)
    declare @sExch              numeric(24,6)
    declare @sDefexch           numeric(24,6)
    declare @sRqlPart           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sRqlpartorg        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sPart_org          nvarchar(50)
    declare @sPar_uom           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sByasset           nvarchar(1)
    declare @nRqlreqqty         numeric(24,6)
    declare @nPrice             numeric(24,6)
    declare @nMultiply          integer
    declare @sUOM               nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSBuyer            nvarchar(255)
    declare @dRqldue            datetime
    declare @nSto_qty           numeric(24,6)
    declare @sCat_repref        nvarchar(50)
    declare @sStore_org         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sReqorg            nvarchar(15)
    declare @sParclass          nvarchar(8)
    declare @dReqcredate        datetime
    declare @nReturn            integer
    declare @nAssignedqty       numeric(24,6)
    declare @nTempqty           numeric(24,6)

    set @nSequenceNumber = 0
    set @nQty = 0 
	set @sUseStockMethod = N'-'
    set @sChk = N'0'
    set @nPurchaseQty = 0 
    set @sRepairresult = N'N'

	IF UPPER(@sConsignFlag) = N'C' 
		set @sConsignment  = N'+'
	ELSE
		begin
			IF UPPER(@sConsignFlag) = N'N' 
				set @sConsignment  = N'-'
			ELSE
				set @sConsignment  = N'%'
		end


    SELECT @nSequenceNumber = coalesce(MAX(lrq_sequence),0)
    FROM r5lowstockrequisitions
    WHERE lrq_sessionID = @nSessionid
    if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1 
        set @nSequenceNumber = 0 
            DECLARE cPart CURSOR local FOR  SELECT   DISTINCT    s.sto_store  REQ_STORE,
                    st2.str_org REQ_ORG,
                    CASE s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then N'COMP' else N'MRC' end   FROM_RENTITY,
                    s.sto_repprefsup,
                    s.sto_repprefsup_org,
                    s.sto_repmrc,
                    CASE  s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then s.sto_repprefsup else s.sto_repmrc end   FROM_PARTY,
                    CASE  s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then s.sto_repprefsup_org else null end   FROM_PARTY_ORG, 
                    CASE  s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then coalesce( a.cat_curr, c.com_curr ) else z.org_curr end  CURR,
                    CASE  s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then coalesce(dbo.o7gtexch2( coalesce( a.cat_curr, c.com_curr ), st2.str_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ), 'DD' )), 1) else
                                                               coalesce(dbo.o7gtexch2 ( z.org_curr, st2.str_org, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ), 'DD' ) ), 1)  end   EXCH,
                    CASE  s.sto_repairtype when N'+' then coalesce(dbo.o7gtexch2( coalesce( a.cat_curr, c.com_curr ), @sOrg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), 'DD' )), 1) else
                                                               coalesce(dbo.o7gtexch2 ( z.org_curr, @sOrg, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(  dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg ), 'DD' ) ), 1)  end   DEF_EXCH,
                    s.sto_part  RQL_PART,
                    s.sto_part_org RQL_PART_ORG,
                    CASE  s.sto_part_org when @sOrg then s.sto_part else s.sto_part + N' (' + s.sto_part_org + N')' end  part_org,
                    p.par_uom,
		            coalesce(p.par_byasset, N'-') byasset,
                    coalesce( s.sto_repairqty, 0 ) - coalesce( h.obj_qty, 0 ) RQL_REQQTY,
                    CASE s.sto_repairtype when
                                     N'+' then coalesce( a.cat_repprice ,dbo.o7getprc( s.sto_store, s.sto_part, s.sto_part_org, st2.str_org, N'B', null, null ) ) else
                                               coalesce( s.sto_repprice, 0 )  end  PRICE,
                    1  MULTIPLY,
                    p.par_uom   UOM,
                    p.par_buyer  BUYER,
                    p.par_class,
                    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org ),'DD') + coalesce( s.sto_repleadtime, 0 ) RQL_DUE ,
                    dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( st2.str_org) ,'DD') reqcre_date,
                    s.sto_qty,
                    a.cat_repref,
                    st2.str_org store_org
            FROM     r5stock s left outer join r5catalogue a on (s.sto_part = a.cat_part AND s.sto_repprefsup = a.cat_supplier AND s.sto_part_org = a.cat_part_org AND s.sto_repprefsup_org = a.cat_supplier_org )
                                left outer join r5companies c on (s.sto_repprefsup = c.com_code AND s.sto_repprefsup_org = c.com_org )
                                left outer join r5parts p on (s.sto_part = p.par_code AND s.sto_part_org = p.par_org)
                                left outer join r5stores st2 on (st2.str_code = s.sto_store)
                                left outer join r5organization z on (st2.str_org = z.org_code)
                                left outer join r5instorerepchildren h on ( s.sto_store = h.obj_store AND s.sto_part = h.obj_part AND s.sto_part_org = h.obj_part_org)
            WHERE     s.sto_part = coalesce( @sPart, s.sto_part )
            AND       s.sto_part_org = coalesce( @sPartorg, s.sto_part_org )
            AND       p.par_notused = N'-'
            AND       coalesce( p.par_trackrtype, 'x' ) <> 'NOST'
            AND       ( ( s.sto_repairtype = N'+' AND s.sto_repprefsup IS NOT NULL ) OR
                      ( s.sto_repairtype = N'-' AND s.sto_repmrc IS NOT NULL AND s.sto_repobject IS NOT NULL ) )
            AND       coalesce( s.sto_repairqty, 0 ) - coalesce( h.obj_qty, 0 ) >= coalesce( s.sto_repminqty, 0 )
            AND       coalesce( s.sto_repairqty, 0 ) - coalesce( h.obj_qty, 0 )> 0
            AND       s.sto_repairtype = N'+'
            AND       (  ( @sSupplier is null and @sSupplierorg is null )
                      OR ( s.sto_repprefsup = @sSupplier and s.sto_repprefsup_org = @sSupplierorg ) )
            AND       s.sto_store LIKE coalesce(@sStore , N'%')
            AND       coalesce(s.sto_abcclass, N'%') LIKE coalesce(@sABCclass , N'%')
			AND       coalesce(p.par_class, N'%') LIKE coalesce(@sPartClass, N'%')
			AND       coalesce(s.sto_consignment, N'-') LIKE @sConsignment
            AND       st2.str_org IN ( SELECT uog_org
                                   FROM   r5userorganization
                                   WHERE  uog_user = @sUser
                                   AND    uog_role = @sRole
                                   AND    uog_org LIKE coalesce(@sOrg, N'%') )
            ORDER BY  s.sto_store,
	            s.sto_repprefsup,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PSRTRL (
   @sCTransCode     nvarchar(30),
   @sChk            nvarchar(10) OUTPUT)
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nVsequenceNumber       numeric(8,0)
    declare @nVincrNum              numeric(30,0)
	declare @sVincrNum 				nvarchar(2000)
    declare @nVexistinglines        int
    declare @nVreservedQTY          numeric(24,6)
    declare @nVstockQTY             numeric(24,6)
    declare @nVbinStockQTY          numeric(24,6)
    declare @dToday                 datetime
    declare @sVorder  				nvarchar(30)       --    R5TRANSACTIONS.TRA_ORDER%TYPE
    declare @sVorderOrg 			nvarchar(15)       --    R5TRANSACTIONS.TRA_ORDER_ORG%TYPE
    declare @sVtransOrg  			nvarchar(15)       --    R5TRANSACTIONS.TRA_ORG%TYPE
    declare @sVfromREntity  		nvarchar(4)        --    R5TRANSACTIONS.TRA_FROMRENTITY%TYPE
    declare @sVFromCode     		nvarchar(30)       --    R5TRANSACTIONS.TRA_FROMCODE%TYPE
    declare @sVadvice       		nvarchar(45)       --    R5TRANSACTIONS.TRA_ADVICE%TYPE
    declare @sVstore        		nvarchar(15)       --    R5STORES.STR_CODE%TYPE
    declare @nNqty                  numeric(24,6)
    declare @sVEvent          		nvarchar(30)       --  R5EVENTS.EVT_CODE%TYPE
    declare @nVIO             		numeric(18, 0)     --  R5TRANSLINES.TRL_IO%TYPE
    declare @sVtrlRType       		nvarchar(4)        --  R5TRANSLINES.TRL_RTYPE%TYPE
	declare @sVRelatedWo            nvarchar(30)        --  R5TRANSACTIONS.TRA_RELATEDWO%TYPE;
	declare @sSplittrans			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFor			nvarchar(10)
    declare @sCheckResult     		nvarchar(3)
	declare @nReturn				int
	/* cursor variables */
	declare @sTrl_order 		nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTrl_order_org		nvarchar(15)
    declare @nTrl_ordline		numeric(8,0)
    declare @sTrl_part 			nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTrl_part_org		nvarchar(15)
    declare @nTrl_price			numeric(24,6)
    declare @sTrl_object		nvarchar(30)
    declare @nQty 				numeric(24,6)
    declare @sOrl_costcode 		nvarchar(30),
            @sOrl_project 		nvarchar(20),
            @sOrl_projbud 		nvarchar(20),
            @sOrl_event			nvarchar(30),
            @nOrl_act 			numeric(8,0),
            @sPar_uom			nvarchar(30),
		    @sTrl_bin 			nvarchar(15),
            @sTrl_lot 			nvarchar(12),
            @sOrl_rtype			nvarchar(4),
            @sPar_byasset		nvarchar(1),
            @sOrl_req			nvarchar(30),
            @nOrl_reqline		numeric(8,0),
            @sOrl_manufacturer	nvarchar(24),
            @sOrl_manufactpart	nvarchar(50),
			@sOrl_relatedwo		nvarchar(30),
			@sTemp				nvarchar(200)

    -- initialization
    	set @sFor = @sChk
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @sCheckResult = N'0'
	set @nVsequenceNumber = 0
    set @nVincrNum        = 10
    set @nVexistinglines  = 0
    set @nVreservedQTY    = 0
    set @nVstockQTY       = 0
    set @nVbinStockQTY    = 0
   /* get line increment */
	set @sVincrNum = cast(@nVincrNum as nvarchar(2000))
	execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sVincrNum OUTPUT, N'INCRLINO', @sCheckResult OUTPUT
	if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
		return -1

	SELECT @nVexistinglines = count(*)
	FROM  r5translines
	WHERE trl_trans = @sCTransCode

    IF isnull(@nVexistinglines , 0) > 0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
	    RETURN
    end

  /*  get transaction information */
	SELECT @sVtransOrg =  tra_org,
           @sVfromREntity = tra_fromrentity,
           @sVorder = tra_order,
           @sVorderOrg = tra_order_org,
           @sVFromCode = tra_fromcode,
           @sVadvice = tra_advice,
		   @sVRelatedWo = tra_relatedwo
    FROM    r5transactions
    WHERE   tra_code = @sCTransCode

	SELECT @sVFromCode = COALESCE(evt_routeparent,evt_code)
	FROM   r5events
	WHERE  evt_code      = @sVRelatedWo


    set @dToday = dbo.o7gttime2( @sVtransOrg )

	declare Crcv cursor local for
    SELECT trl_order,
           trl_order_org,
           trl_ordline,
           trl_part,
           trl_part_org,
           trl_price,
           trl_object,
           SUM( CASE trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * trl_qty ) qty,
           orl_costcode,
           orl_project,
           orl_projbud,
           orl_event,
		   orl_relatedwo,
           orl_act,
           par_uom,
		   isnull( trl_bin, CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'PS' THEN N'*' ELSE null END)  trl_bin,
           isnull( trl_lot, CASE orl_rtype WHEN N'PS' THEN N'*' ELSE null END)  trl_lot,
           orl_rtype,
           par_byasset,
           orl_req,
           orl_reqline,
           orl_manufacturer,
           orl_manufactpart
    FROM   r5orderlines,
           r5parts,
           r5transactions,
           r5translines LEFT OUTER JOIN r5objects ON trl_object = obj_code
    											 AND trl_object_org  = obj_org

    WHERE  orl_part        = par_code
    AND    orl_part_org    = par_org
    AND    orl_order       = trl_order
    AND    orl_order_org   = trl_order_org
    AND    orl_ordline     = trl_ordline
    AND    orl_order       = @sVorder
    AND    orl_order_org   = @sVorderOrg
    AND    orl_rtype       IN ( N'PD', N'PS', N'RE' )
    AND    tra_code        = trl_trans
    AND    tra_rstatus     = N'A'
    AND ( ( orl_event  = @sVFromCode
             AND @sVfromREntity =  N'EVNT' )
          OR ( @sVfromREntity <> N'EVNT' ) )
    AND   isnull( tra_advice, N'%' ) LIKE isnull( @sVadvice, N'%' )
    AND ( ( par_byasset = N'+' AND obj_rstatus =  N'B' AND obj_store = @sVFromCode )
         OR (par_byasset = N'+' AND obj_rstatus =  N'C' AND obj_store = @sVFromCode )
		 OR (par_byasset = N'+' AND obj_rstatus =  N'T' AND EXISTS
			  ( SELECT 'x' FROM r5transtock WHERE  tst_object = obj_code
                AND tst_object_org = obj_org AND tst_store = @sVFromCode AND tst_torentity  = N'EVNT' ) )
         OR ( par_byasset = N'+'
              AND obj_rstatus = N'I'
              AND obj_parent IS NULL
              AND obj_location IS NULL )
         OR par_byasset = N'-' )
    GROUP BY trl_order,
             trl_order_org,
             trl_ordline,
             trl_part,
             trl_part_org,
			 trl_bin,
             trl_lot,
             trl_price,
             trl_object,
             orl_costcode,
             orl_project,
             orl_projbud,
             orl_event,
			 orl_relatedwo,
             orl_act,
             par_uom,
             orl_rtype,
             par_byasset,
             orl_req,
             orl_reqline,
           	 orl_manufacturer,
           	 orl_manufactpart
    HAVING  SUM( CASE trl_rtype WHEN N'RECV' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END * trl_qty ) > 0
    open Crcv
	fetch next from Crcv into   @sTrl_order,
								@sTrl_order_org,
						        @nTrl_ordline,
						        @sTrl_part,
						        @sTrl_part_org,
						        @nTrl_price,
						        @sTrl_object,
                                @nQty,
						        @sOrl_costcode,
					            @sOrl_project,
					            @sOrl_projbud,
					            @sOrl_event,
								@sOrl_relatedwo,
					            @nOrl_act,
					            @sPar_uom,
							    @sTrl_bin,
					            @sTrl_lot,
					            @sOrl_rtype,
					            @sPar_byasset,
					            @sOrl_req,
					            @nOrl_reqline,
					            @sOrl_manufacturer,
					            @sOrl_manufactpart
    while @@fetch_status = 0
	begin
        set @sVEvent = @sOrl_event
        IF @sOrl_rtype = N'PD'
			begin
				IF @sVfromREntity = 'EVNT'
				    begin
				        set @sTemp = @sVorder + N'#' + @sTrl_order_org  + N'#' +  cast(@nTrl_ordline as nvarchar(8))
					    set @nNqty = dbo.O7MATRET( @sTemp, @sOrl_event, @sVfromREntity, @sTrl_part, @sTrl_part_org, @sTrl_lot, @sVRelatedWo, @sVadvice )
					end
				ELSE
					begin
						set @sTemp = @sVorder + N'#' + @sTrl_order_org  + N'#' +  cast(@nTrl_ordline as nvarchar(8))
						set @nNqty = dbo.O7MATRET( @sTemp, @sOrl_event, @sVfromREntity, @sTrl_part, @sTrl_part_org, @sTrl

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PTREQL  @sCorg          nvarchar(15),
						   @sCrequisition  nvarchar(30),
						   @sCsupplier     nvarchar(30),
						   @sCsupplierOrg  nvarchar(15),
						   @sCstore        nvarchar(30),
						   @sCorder        nvarchar(30),
						   @sCoriginator   nvarchar(15),
						   @sCbuyer        nvarchar(255),
						   @sCuser         nvarchar(255),
						   @nCsessionID    int 	OUTPUT
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
    declare @nVsessionID               int
    declare @nVmaxSessionID            int
    declare @nVsequenceNumber          int   -- = 0
    declare @sVselect                  nvarchar(1)
    declare @sVstore                   nvarchar(15)  --R5ORDERS.ORD_STORE%TYPE
    declare @sVorderOrg                nvarchar(15)  --R5ORDERS.ORD_ORG%TYPE
    declare @sVsupplier                nvarchar(30)  --R5ORDERS.ORD_SUPPLIER%TYPE
    declare @sVsupplierOrg             nvarchar(15)  --R5ORDERS.ORD_SUPPLIER_ORG%TYPE
    declare @dToday                    datetime  --  = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7GTTIME2( @sCorg ))

	declare @sRfo_req				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRfo_org				nvarchar(15)
	declare @nRfo_reqline			numeric(8,0)
	declare @sRfo_supplier			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRfo_supplier_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRfo_store				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRfo_origin			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRfo_part				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRfo_part_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRfo_task				nvarchar(20)
	declare @nRfo_taskrev			numeric(4,0)
	declare @sRfo_buyer				nvarchar(255)
	declare @dRfo_due				datetime
	declare @nRfo_qty				numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRfo_taskqty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRfo_price				numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRfo_curr				nvarchar(3)
	declare @nRfo_exch				numeric(24,12)
	declare @sRfo_type				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRfo_event				nvarchar(30)
	declare @nRfo_act				numeric(8,0)
	declare @sRfo_project			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sRfo_projbud			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sRfo_costcode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRfo_uom				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRfo_rtype				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nRfo_multiply			numeric(10,4)
	declare @sRfo_status			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRfo_blanketorder		nvarchar(30)
	declare @nRfo_blanketline		numeric(8,0)
	declare @sRfo_trade				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sRfo_deladdress		nvarchar(20)
	declare @sRfo_quotflag			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sRfo_inspect			nvarchar(1)
	declare @nRfo_repprice			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sRql_quotid			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRql_quotorg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nRql_quotline			numeric(8)
	declare @nRql_recvqty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRql_scrapqty			numeric(24,6)

	declare @sChk					nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn				int

	set @nVsequenceNumber = 0
	set @sChk = N'0'
	set @dToday = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE(dbo.O7GTTIME2( @sCorg ), N'dd')
    /*  check to see if the sessionid passed, if yes, delete first */
    IF @nCsessionID IS NOT NULL and @nCsessionID <> 0
		begin
		  DELETE FROM r5tempreqsfororder
		  WHERE  tro_sessionid = @nCsessionID

		  set @nVsessionID = @nCsessionID
		end
    ELSE
		begin
			DELETE FROM r5tempreqsfororder
			WHERE  tro_date < @dToday - 5

			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @nVsessionID OUTPUT, N'BREP', 1, @sChk OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				return -1
		end

    IF @sCorder IS NOT NULL
        set @sVorderOrg = @sCorg
    ELSE
        set @sVorderOrg =null

    IF @sCorder IS NOT NULL
	begin
	    SELECT @sVstore = ord_store, @sVsupplier = ord_supplier, @sVsupplierOrg = ord_supplier_org
	    FROM   r5orders
	    WHERE  ord_code = @sCorder
	    AND    ord_org  = @sCorg

		declare cCursor_reqlines2 cursor local for
			SELECT RQL_REQ, REQ_ORG, RQL_REQLINE, RQL_SUPPLIER, RQL_SUPPLIER_ORG,
          		REQ_TOCODE, REQ_ORIGIN, RQL_PART, RQL_PART_ORG, RQL_TASK,
          		RQL_TASKREV, RQL_BUYER, RQL_DUE, RQL_QTY, RQL_RECVQTY, RQL_SCRAPQTY, RQL_TASKQTY, 
          		RQL_PRICE, RQL_CURR, RQL_EXCH, RQL_TYPE, RQL_EVENT, 
          		RQL_ACT, RQL_PROJECT, RQL_PROJBUD, RQL_COSTCODE, RQL_UOM, 
         		RQL_RTYPE, RQL_MULTIPLY, RQL_STATUS, RQL_BLANKETORDER, RQL_BLANKETLINE, 
          		RQL_TRADE, RQL_DELADDRESS, RQL_QUOTFLAG, RQL_INSPECT, CAT_REPPRICE,
          		RQL_QUOTID, RQL_RFQ_ORG, RQL_QUOTLINE
			FROM   r5requisitions, r5requislines r left outer join r5catalogue on (  rql_part = cat_part
										AND   rql_part_org = cat_part_org
										AND   rql_supplier = cat_supplier
										AND   rql_supplier_org = cat_supplier_org  )
			WHERE req_code = rql_req
		    AND   ((rql_supplier = @sVsupplier AND rql_supplier_org = @sVsupplierOrg) OR (rql_supplier IS NULL))
		    AND   isnull(rql_buyer, N'%') LIKE isnull(@sCbuyer, N'%')
		    AND   isnull(req_origin, N'%') LIKE isnull(@sCoriginator, N'%')
		    AND   req_tocode = @sVstore
		    AND   isnull(rql_req, N'%') LIKE isnull(@sCrequisition, N'%')
		    AND   req_org  = @sCorg
		    AND   rql_quotflag  = N'0'
		    AND   rql_rtype  <> N'RI'
			AND   ((rql_project IS NOT NULL AND
						N'x' IN ( SELECT N'x' FROM  r5projauthuser
									WHERE  pau_project = rql_project
									AND    pau_user    = @sCuser
								  UNION
									SELECT N'x' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x' FROM r5projauthuser WHERE  pau_project = rql_project )))
			OR     rql_project IS NULL)
			AND      req_fromrentity = N'COMP'
			AND      req_rstatus     = N'A'
			AND      rql_rstatus     = N'A'
			AND      rql_active      = N'+'
			AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
			                 FROM   r5orderlines o
			                 WHERE  o.orl_req     = r.rql_req
			                 AND    o.orl_reqline = r.rql_reqline )
			AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
			                 FROM   r5quotlines q
			                 WHERE  q.qul_req     = r.rql_req
			                 AND    q.qul_reqline = r.rql_reqline )
			AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT N'x'
			                 FROM   r5orderlines o
			                 WHERE  o.orl_event = r.rql_event
			                 AND    o.orl_act   = r.rql_act
							 AND    o.orl_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'J' )
			                 AND    o.orl_rtype LIKE N'S%'
			                 AND    r.rql_rtype LIKE N'S%' )
			ORDER BY rql_req, rql_reqline			


		open cCursor_reqlines2
		fetch next from cCursor_reqlines2 into   @sRfo_req,
												 @sRfo_org,
												 @nRfo_reqline,
												 @sRfo_supplier,
												 @sRfo_supplier_org,
												 @sRfo_store,
												 @sRfo_origin,
												 @sRfo_part,
												 @sRfo_part_org,
												 @sRfo_task,
												 @nRfo_taskrev,
												 @sRfo_buyer,
												 @dRfo_due,
												 @nRfo_qty,
												 @nRql_recvqty,
												 @nRql_scrapqty,
												 @nRfo_taskqty,
												 @nRfo_price,
												 @sRfo_curr,
												 @nRfo_exch,
												 @sRfo_type,
												 @sRfo_event,
												 @nRfo_act,
												 @sRfo_project,
												 @sRfo_projbud,
												 @sRfo_costcode,
												 @sRfo_uom,
												 @sRfo_rtype,
												 @nRfo_multiply,
												 @sRfo_status,
												 @sRfo_blanketorder,
												 @nRfo_blanketline,
												 @sRfo_trade,
												 @sRfo_deladdress,
												 @sRfo_quotflag,
												 @sRfo_inspect,
												 @nRfo_repprice,
												 @sRql_quotid,
												 @sRql_quotorg,
												 @nRql_quotline
		while @@fetch_status = 0
		begin
			set @nVsequenceNumber = @nVsequenceNumber + 1
			IF (@sRfo_supplier IS NOT NULL)
	            set @sVselect = N'+'
	        ELSE
	            set @sVselect = N'-'

	        INSERT INTO r5tempreqsfororder
	                    (TRO_SESSIONID,
	                     TRO_SEQUENCE ,
	                     TRO_REQ,
	                     TRO_ORG ,
	                     TRO_REQLINE,
	                     TRO_SUPPLIER,
	                     TRO_SUPPLIER_ORG,
	                     TRO_STORE,
	                     TRO_ORIGIN,
	                     TRO_PART,
	                     TRO_PART_ORG,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7PTWDRV
AS
  DECLARE @status  NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @chk     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @return  INT
BEGIN  
  EXECUTE @return = r5o7_o7ucode @status OUTPUT, N'EXP', N'PWST', @chk OUTPUT
  UPDATE r5permittowork
  SET    ptw_status    = @status,
         ptw_rstatus   = N'EXP',
         ptw_updatedby = N'R5',
         ptw_updated   = dbo.o7gttime2( ptw_org )
  WHERE  ptw_rstatus   = CASE ( SELECT opa_desc FROM r5organizationoptions WHERE opa_code = N'PTWEXPIR' AND opa_org = ptw_org ) 
                           WHEN N'ACTIVE' THEN N'ACT'
                           ELSE ptw_rstatus
                         END 
  AND    ptw_rstatus NOT IN ( N'C', N'CAN' )
  AND    ptw_validuntil <= dbo.o7gttime2( ptw_org )
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.O7PURINT_ORDER_TERMS
               (@sUser     NVARCHAR(255)
               ,@sMultiOrg NVARCHAR(10)
               ,@sOrg      NVARCHAR(10)
               ,@sTermCode NVARCHAR(30)
               ,@sTermType NVARCHAR(4)) RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
DECLARE @nReturn BIT
SET @nReturn = 1

IF @sMultiOrg = N'YES'
	begin
	   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
						FROM r5orderterms
							,r5userorganization
					   WHERE ort_rtype = @sTermType
						 AND ort_code = @sTermCode
						 AND ort_org = uog_org
						 AND uog_user = @sUser
						 AND (uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @sOrg))
		  SET @nReturn = 0
	end
ELSE
	begin
	   IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
						FROM r5orderterms
					   WHERE ort_rtype = @sTermType
						 AND ort_code  = @sTermCode)
		  SET @nReturn = 0
	end

RETURN @nReturn
END

create procedure O7QUERYOUTPUT	@nReturn	float OUTPUT,
								@sSqlcode	nvarchar(8),
								@sErr		  nvarchar(255)	OUTPUT,
								@sUser		nvarchar(255) = null,
								@sGroup		nvarchar(12) = null,
								@sDfltorg	nvarchar(15) = null,
								@sOrg		  nvarchar(15) = null,
								@sRole    nvarchar(30) = '*'
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sSqlstatement	nvarchar(4000) --r5queries.que_text%type
	declare @nStartposition	int
	declare @nOutput		float
	declare @sX				nvarchar(2)

	declare @sSql			nvarchar(4000)
	declare @sTable			nvarchar(64)
	declare @sCursor		nvarchar(64)
	declare @cDescribed		cursor
	declare @nColumns		int
	declare @nI				int
    declare @sTest          nvarchar(64)

	set @sX = null

	select @sSqlstatement = que_text from r5queries where que_code = @sSqlcode
	if @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
		begin
			set @sErr = N'O7QUERYOUTPUT: Passed in SQL Code is not valid'
			set @nReturn = 0
			return
		end
	begin try
		set @sSqlstatement = replace( @sSqlstatement, N':MP5USER', N'@MP5USER' )
		set @sSqlstatement = replace( @sSqlstatement, N':MP5GROUP', N'@MP5GROUP' )
		set @sSqlstatement = replace( @sSqlstatement, N':MP5DFLTORG', N'@MP5DFLTORG' )
		set @sSqlstatement = replace( @sSqlstatement, N':MP5ORG', N'@MP5ORG' )
		set @sSqlstatement = replace( @sSqlstatement, N':MP5ROLE', N'@MP5ROLE' )

		set @sTable  = N'##queryoutput_temp_' + cast( @@SPID as nvarchar(38))
		set @sCursor = N'c_queryoutput_temp_' + cast( @@SPID as nvarchar(38))

		--We need to get a count of the number of columns in the expected result set
		--To do so we will declare a cursor for the SELECT statement and use
		--sp_describe_cursor_columns to get a result set that is the list of columns
		set @sSql = N'declare ' + @sCursor + N' cursor for ' + @sSqlstatement
		begin try
			execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@MP5USER nvarchar(255), @MP5GROUP nvarchar(12), @MP5DFLTORG nvarchar(15), @MP5ORG nvarchar(15), @MP5ROLE nvarchar(30)', @sUser, @sGroup, @sDfltorg, @sOrg, @sRole
		end try
		begin catch
			set @sErr = N'O7QUERYOUTPUT: Error declaring cursor: '+error_message()
			set @nOutput = 0
			return 0
		end catch

		execute sp_describe_cursor_columns @cDescribed OUTPUT, N'global', @sCursor
		if @@ERROR <> 0
			begin
				set @sErr = N'O7QUERYOUTPUT: Error describing result set'
				set @nOutput = 0
				return
			end

		--Here are the number of columns that will be returned from the SELECT
		set @nColumns = @@CURSOR_ROWS

		--cleanup
		set @sSql = N'deallocate ' + @sCursor
		exec(@sSql)	 --if there is an error on this call there is nothing we can do so continue

		if @nColumns > 0
			begin
				--Now we need to create a temp table that will hold the result set from the SELECT
				--We assume that the first column is a numeric and will fit into a float
				set @sSql = N'create table ' + @sTable + N' ( col1 nvarchar(64) '

				--Now add remaining columns to the table
				set @nI = 2
				while @nI <= @nColumns
					begin
						set @sSql = @sSql + N', col' + cast( @nI as nvarchar(38) ) + N' sql_variant '
						set @nI = @nI + 1
					end

				--add the identity column so that we can get the first row below
				set @sSql = @sSql + N', col_id int identity ) '

				--create the table
				exec(@sSql)
				if @@ERROR <> 0
					begin
						--cleanup
						set @sErr = N'O7QUERYOUTPUT: Error creating temp table'
						set @nOutput = 0
						return
					end

				--populate the table
				set @sSqlstatement = N'insert into ' + @sTable + N' ' + @sSqlstatement
				begin try
					execute sp_executesql @sSqlstatement, N'@MP5USER nvarchar(255), @MP5GROUP nvarchar(12), @MP5DFLTORG nvarchar(15), @MP5ORG nvarchar(15), @MP5ROLE nvarchar(30)', @sUser, @sGroup, @sDfltorg, @sOrg, @sRole
				end try
				begin catch
					set @nOutput = 0
					set @sErr = N'O7QUERYOUTPUT: Error generating result set: '+error_message()
					--cleanup
					set @sSql = N'drop table ' + @sTable
					exec(@sSql)	 --if there is an error on this call there is nothing we can do so continue
					return 0
				end catch

				--get the value
				set @sSql = N'select top 1 @sTest = col1 from ' + @sTable + N' order by col_id'
				execute sp_executesql @sSql, N'@sTest nvarchar(64) OUTPUT', @sTest OUTPUT
				if @@ERROR <> 0
					begin
						set @nOutput = 0
						set @sErr = N'O7QUERYOUTPUT: Error obtaining return value'
					end

				--Test to make sure selected value is a valid numeric
				if @sTest is null or (@sTest is not null and isnumeric( @sTest ) = 1)
					set @nOutput = convert( float, @sTest )
				else
					begin
						set @nOutput = 0
						set @sErr = 'Error converting return value to numeric data type.'
					end

				--cleanup
				set @sSql = N'drop table ' + @sTable
				exec(@sSql)	 --if there is an error on this call there is nothing we can do so continue
			end
		else
			begin
				set @sErr = N'O7QUERYOUTPUT: Column count is zero'
				set @nOutput = 0
			end
	end try
	begin catch
			set @sErr = N'O7QUERYOUTPUT: Query Error: '+error_message()
			set @nOutput = 0
	end catch
	set @nReturn = @nOutput

create procedure O7RAE	@sErmsource	nvarchar(100),
						@sErmtype	nvarchar(6),
						@nErmnumber	int,
						@sSqlcode	nvarchar(100)
as
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sErrcode		nvarchar(12)	--r5errsource.ers_code%TYPE
	declare @sOracode		nvarchar(512)
	declare @nCount			int
	declare @sPaddedCode	nvarchar(12)

	set @sOracode = N' S=' + @sErmsource + N' T=' + @sErmtype + N' N=' + convert( nvarchar, @nErmnumber ) + N' C=' + @sSqlcode
	set @sErrcode = null
	if @sErmsource is null or coalesce( @sErmtype, N'XXXXXX' ) not in ( N'PROC', N'FUNC', N'TRIG', N'FORM', N'PAC' ) OR @nErmnumber is null
		begin
			RAISERROR ( N'~9992        ~%s', 16, 1, @sOracode )
			return -1
		end

	if @nErmnumber <> 0 
		begin
			select	@nCount = count(*)
			  FROM  r5errsource e
			 WHERE  e.ers_source = @sErmsource
			 AND    e.ers_type   = @sErmtype
			 AND    e.ers_number = @nErmnumber

			if @nCount = 0
				RAISERROR ( N'~2964        ~%s', 16, 1, @sOracode )
			else
				begin
					select	@sErrcode = e.ers_code
					  FROM  r5errsource e
					 WHERE  e.ers_source = @sErmsource
					 AND    e.ers_type   = @sErmtype
					 AND    e.ers_number = @nErmnumber

					-- simulate RPAD function 
					set @sPaddedCode = LEFT( coalesce( @sErrcode, ' ' ) + SPACE(12), 12)
					RAISERROR ( N'~%s-%s', 16, 1, @sPaddedCode, @sOracode )
				end
		end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7RCMSTRUCTURE_INSERTRCM

    @nLevelSeq           NUMERIC( 6 ), 
    @sLevelType          NVARCHAR( 4 ),
    @nRPN                NUMERIC( 6 ), 
    @sIcon               NVARCHAR( 30 ),
    @sIconPath           NVARCHAR( 1000 ),
    @sLang               NVARCHAR( 2 ),
    @sFunctionFailure    NVARCHAR( 30 )
AS
BEGIN
    
    DECLARE @sRiskLevelCode       NVARCHAR(30);
    DECLARE @nRiskLevel           NUMERIC(6)
    DECLARE @sNodeIcon            NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @sNodeIconPath        NVARCHAR(1000)
    DECLARE @sRiskIcon            NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @sRiskIconPath        NVARCHAR(1000)
    DECLARE @sTheRiskLevelCode    NVARCHAR(30);
    DECLARE @nTheRiskLevel        NUMERIC(6)
    DECLARE @sTheNodeIcon         NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @sTheNodeIconPath     NVARCHAR(1000)
    DECLARE @sTheRiskIcon         NVARCHAR(30)
    DECLARE @sTheRiskIconPath     NVARCHAR(1000)
    DECLARE @sLevelDesc           NVARCHAR(80)
    DECLARE @sRiskLeveldesc       NVARCHAR(80)
    DECLARE @sProbabilityDesc     NVARCHAR(80)
    DECLARE @sConsequenceDesc     NVARCHAR(80)
    DECLARE @sNodeDesc            NVARCHAR(300)
    
    
    DECLARE cRiskLevel CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT  rms_code,rms_icon,rms_iconpath,rms_threshold
    FROM    r5riskmatrixsetup
    WHERE   rms_type = 'RISK'
    AND     rms_project = @sProject
    ORDER BY rms_threshold desc
    OPEN cRiskLevel
    FETCH NEXT FROM cRiskLevel INTO @sRiskLevelCode, @sRiskIcon, @sRiskIconPath, @nRiskLevel
    WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
            IF @nRiskLevel <= @nRPN
                BEGIN
                    SET  @sTheRiskLevelCode = @sRiskLevelCode;
                    SET  @sTheRiskIcon = @sRiskIcon
                    SET  @sTheRiskIconPath = @sRiskIconPath
                    SET  @nTheRiskLevel = @nRiskLevel
                    BREAK
                END
            FETCH NEXT FROM cRiskLevel INTO @sRiskLevelCode, @sRiskIcon, @sRiskIconPath, @nRiskLevel
        END
    CLOSE cRiskLevel
    DEALLOCATE cRiskLevel

    IF @sLevelType = 'F'
        BEGIN
            DECLARE cur_fun_desc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT bot_text FROM r5boilertexts 
            WHERE bot_function = N'OSOBJA' 
            AND BOT_FLD1= N'RCM_FUNCTIONNODE'
            AND BOT_lang = @sLang
            OPEN cur_fun_desc
            FETCH NEXT FROM cur_fun_desc INTO @sLevelDesc
            DEALLOCATE cur_fun_desc
        END
    ELSE 
        BEGIN 
            IF @sLevelType = 'M'
                BEGIN
                    DECLARE cur_fun_desc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
                    SELECT bot_text FROM r5boilertexts 
                    WHERE bot_function = N'OSOBJA' 
                    AND BOT_FLD1= N'RCM_FAILUREMODENODE'
                    AND BOT_lang = @sLang
                    OPEN cur_fun_desc
                    FETCH NEXT FROM cur_fun_desc INTO @sLevelDesc
                    DEALLOCATE cur_fun_desc
                END
            ELSE
                BEGIN
                    IF @sLevelType = 'FUNF' AND @sFunctionfailure IS NOT NULL
                        SET @sLevelDesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'EQFL', @sFunctionFailure, NULL, NULL )
                    ELSE
                    SET @sLevelDesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'EQFL', @sChild, NULL, NULL )
                END 
        END
    
    SET @sNodeDesc = @sLevelDesc
    
    IF @sProbability IS NOT NULL
        BEGIN
            SET @sProbabilityDesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'RMXS', @sProbability, NULL, NULL )
            SET @sNodeDesc = @sNodeDesc + '(' + @sProbabilityDesc + ')';
            SET @sNodeIcon = @sIcon
            SET @sNodeIconPath = @sIconPath
            SET @sLevelDesc= @sProbabilityDesc
        END
    ELSE
        BEGIN
            IF @sConsequence IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    SET @sConsequenceDesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'RMXC', @sConsequence+ '#'+ @sCategory, NULL, NULL )
                    SET @sNodeDesc = @sNodeDesc + '(' + @sConsequenceDesc+ ')'
                    SET @sNodeIcon= @sIcon
                    SET @sNodeIconPath = @sIconPath 
                    SET @sLevelDesc= @sConsequenceDesc;  
                END 
        END

    IF @sLevelType IN( 'FUNS','F','M')
        BEGIN
            IF @sTheRiskLevelCode IS NOT NULL
                BEGIN
                    SET @sRiskLeveldesc = dbo.r5o7_o7get_desc( @sLang, N'RMXS', @sTheRiskLevelCode, NULL, NULL )
                    SET @sNodeDesc = @sNodeDesc+ '(' + @sRiskLeveldesc + ')'
                    SET @sNodeIcon = @sTheRiskIcon
                    SET @sNodeIconPath = @sRiskIconPath
                END
        END
        
    INSERT INTO r5rcmstructure( rcm_object, rcm_object_org,rcm_project, rcm_code,rcm_parent,rcm_probability, rcm_consequencecat,rcm_consequence,rcm_sequence,rcm_leveltype,rcm_rpn, rcm_icon, rcm_iconpath, rcm_risklevel, rcm_desc,rcm_nodedesc)
    VALUES( @sObjectCode, @sObjectOrg, @sProject,@sChild , @sParent,@sProbability, @sCategory, @sConsequence,@nLevelSeq , @sLevelType, @nRPN, @sNodeIcon,@sNodeIconPath, @sTheRiskLevelCode,@sLevelDesc, @sNodeDesc)
    
END
