  @sObject     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sObject_org NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sPart       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sPartorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sPartloc    NVARCHAR( 80 ),
  @sReltype    NVARCHAR( 4 ),
  @sCode1      NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @sCode2      NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @pSeqno      INT,
  @pDays       NUMERIC( 20, 10 ),
  @sEvent      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sPfacode    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @pDate       DATETIME
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @nAvgdays         NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nMindays         NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nMaxdays         NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nStddevdays      NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nLastslope       NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nLastslope_c     NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nAvgslope        NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nAvgslope_c      NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nShape           NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nShape_c         NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nScale           NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nScale_c         NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nCorrelation     NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nCorrelation_c   NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nLaplace         NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nCumdays         NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nCaslope         NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nCaslope_c       NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nCaintercept     NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nCaintercept_c   NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nCaslope_iec     NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nCaintercept_iec NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nDayscum         NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nDummy           NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nExpsource       NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @nSqlidentity     INT
  DECLARE @nRank            INT
  DECLARE @nSeqno           INT
  DECLARE @nDays            NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @dDate            DATETIME
  DECLARE @nReturn          INT
  DECLARE @sWhereclause     NVARCHAR( 200 )
  
  IF @pDays IS NULL 
    SET @nSeqno = 0
  ELSE  
    SET @nSeqno = @pSeqno
  
  BEGIN TRY
    INSERT INTO r5reliabilitypf( 
            rpl_object, rpl_object_org, rpl_part, rpl_part_org, rpl_partlocation, rpl_type, 
            rpl_code1, rpl_code2, rpl_seqno, rpl_days, rpl_event, rpl_date, rpl_failurecode )
    VALUES( @sObject, @sObject_org, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc, @sReltype, 
            @sCode1, @sCode2, @nSeqno, @pDays, @sEvent, @pDate, @sPfacode )
    SET @nSqlidentity =  @@IDENTITY
  END TRY
  BEGIN CATCH
    SELECT @nSqlidentity = rpl_sqlidentity
    FROM   r5reliabilitypf
    WHERE  rpl_object       = @sObject
    AND    rpl_object_org   = @sObject_org
    AND    rpl_type         = @sReltype
    AND    rpl_part         = @sPart
    AND    rpl_part_org     = @sPartorg
    AND    rpl_partlocation = @sPartloc
    AND    rpl_failurecode  = @sPfacode
  END CATCH

  IF @pDays IS NULL
    RETURN

  CREATE TABLE #tweibull(
    wei_seqno  NUMERIC( 20, 10 ),
    wei_value  NUMERIC( 20, 10 ),
    wei_rank   NUMERIC( 10 ),
    wei_date   DATETIME,
    wei_x      NUMERIC( 20, 10 ),
    wei_y      NUMERIC( 20, 10 ) )

  SET @nRank = 0

  DECLARE c_rel CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT rpl_seqno, rpl_days, rpl_date
    FROM   r5reliabilitypf
    WHERE  rpl_object       = @sObject
    AND    rpl_object_org   = @sObject_org
    AND    rpl_part         = @sPart
    AND    rpl_part_org     = @sPartorg
    AND    rpl_partlocation = @sPartloc
    AND    rpl_type         = @sReltype
    AND    ISNULL( rpl_code1, 'x' ) LIKE ISNULL( @sCode1, 'x' )
    AND    ISNULL( rpl_code2, 'x' ) = ISNULL( @sCode2, 'x' )
    AND    rpl_days IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY rpl_days

  DECLARE c_rel_ca CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT rpl_seqno, rpl_days, rpl_date
    FROM   r5reliabilitypf
    WHERE  rpl_object       = @sObject
    AND    rpl_object_org   = @sObject_org
    AND    rpl_part         = @sPart
    AND    rpl_part_org     = @sPartorg
    AND    rpl_partlocation = @sPartloc
    AND    rpl_type         = @sReltype
    AND    ISNULL( rpl_code1, 'x' ) LIKE ISNULL( @sCode1, 'x' )
    AND    ISNULL( rpl_code2, 'x' ) = ISNULL( @sCode2, 'x' )
    AND    rpl_days IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY rpl_seqno

  /* First individual ... */ 
  OPEN c_rel
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @nRank = @nRank + 1
      INSERT INTO #tweibull( wei_seqno, wei_value, wei_rank, wei_date )
      VALUES( @nSeqno, @nDays, @nRank, @dDate )
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
    END
  CLOSE c_rel
  DEALLOCATE c_rel

  IF @nRank >= 2
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, '', @nAvgslope OUTPUT
      IF @nRank = 2
        SET @nLastslope = @nAvgslope
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          SET @sWhereclause = 'where wei_seqno >= ' + CAST( @nRank - 1 AS NVARCHAR )
          EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, @sWhereclause, @nLastslope OUTPUT
        END
    END

  SELECT @nAvgdays    = AVG( wei_value ), 
         @nMindays    = MIN( wei_value ), 
         @nMaxdays    = MAX( wei_value ), 
         @nStddevdays = STDEV( wei_value )
  FROM   #tweibull

  IF @nRank > 1 
    EXECUTE @nReturn = o7weibull @nShape OUTPUT, @nScale OUTPUT, @nCorrelation OUTPUT, @nLaplace OUTPUT

  IF @nRank > 1 
    BEGIN
      /* Crow AMSAA. */
      DELETE FROM #tweibull
      OPEN c_rel_ca
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO #tweibull( wei_seqno, wei_value )
          VALUES( LOG( @nSeqno ), LOG( @nDays ) )
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
        END
      CLOSE c_rel_ca
      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, '', @nCaslope OUTPUT
      SELECT @nExpsource = AVG( wei_seqno ) - ( AVG( wei_value ) * @nCaslope )
      FROM   #tweibull
      IF @nExpsource <= 45
        SET @nCaintercept = dbo.f_LEAST_NUMBER( EXP( @nExpsource ), 9999999999 )
      ELSE
        SET @nCaintercept = NULL
    END

  /* ... then cumulative. */ 
  DELETE FROM #tweibull
  SET @nRank = 0
  SET @nCumdays = 0
  OPEN c_rel_ca
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @nRank = @nRank + 1
      SET @nCumdays = @nCumdays + @nDays
      INSERT INTO #tweibull( wei_seqno, wei_value, wei_rank, wei_date )
      VALUES( @nSeqno, @nCumdays, @nRank, @dDate )
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
    END
  CLOSE c_rel_ca
  SET @nDayscum = @nCumdays

  IF @nRank >= 2
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, '', @nAvgslope_c OUTPUT
      IF @nRank = 2
        SET @nLastslope = @nAvgslope
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          SET @sWhereclause = 'where wei_seqno >= ' + CAST( @nRank - 1 AS NVARCHAR )
          EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, @sWhereclause, @nLastslope_c OUTPUT
        END
    END

  IF @nRank > 1 
    EXECUTE @nReturn = o7weibull @nShape_c OUTPUT, @nScale_c OUTPUT, @nCorrelation_c OUTPUT, @nDummy OUTPUT

  IF @nRank > 2
    BEGIN
      BEGIN TRY
        /* Crow AMSAA IEC. */
        SELECT @nCaslope_iec = ( @nRank - 2 ) / SUM( LOG( @nCumdays / wei_value ) )
        FROM   #tweibull
        SET @nCaintercept_iec = dbo.f_LEAST_NUMBER( @nRank / POWER( @nCumdays, @nCaslope_iec ), 9999999999 )
      END TRY
      BEGIN CATCH
      END CATCH
    END

  IF @nRank > 1 
    BEGIN
      /* Crow AMSAA. */
      DELETE FROM #tweibull
      SET @nCumdays = 0
      OPEN c_rel_ca
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @nCumdays = @nCumdays + @nDays
          INSERT INTO #tweibull( wei_seqno, wei_value )
          VALUES( LOG( @nSeqno ), LOG( @nCumdays ) )

CREATE PROCEDURE O7RCPF_PROCESS
  @sEvent      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sObject     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sObjectorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sPfacode    NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sPart       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sPartorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sPartloc    NVARCHAR( 80 ),
  @sPcode1     NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @sPcode2     NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @dStartdate  DATETIME,
  @dCommiss    DATETIME,
  @dCompleted  DATETIME,
  @sRdrvapcc   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sRdrvascc   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @dRdrvsdate  DATETIME,
  @sFull       NVARCHAR( 1 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @sCode1    NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sCode2    NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sPercode1 NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sPercode2 NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @nDeleted  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nI        INT
  DECLARE @sEvtcode2 NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sPfacode2 NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @dDate     DATETIME
  DECLARE @nSeqno    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nReturn   INT
  DECLARE @nDays     NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @dPrevdate DATETIME
  SET @nI = 1
  WHILE @nI <= 3 
    BEGIN
      IF @nI = 1 
        BEGIN
          /* Code1 n, Code2 n */
          SET @sCode1    = @sPcode1
          SET @sCode2    = @sPcode2
          SET @sPercode1 = @sPcode1
          SET @sPercode2 = @sPcode2
        END   
      ELSE IF @nI = 2
        BEGIN
          /* Code1 n, All Code2 */
          SET @sCode2     = NULL
          SET @sPercode2 = '%'
        END  
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* All Code1, All Code2 */
          SET @sCode1    = NULL
          SET @sPercode1 = '%'
        END  

      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rcpf_deleterel @sObject, @sObjectorg, @sPfacode, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc, 
                                          @nI, @sCode1, @sCode2, @dCompleted, @nDeleted OUTPUT
      IF @sFull <> N'-'
        SET @nDeleted = 0

      SELECT @nSeqno    = MAX( rpl_seqno ), 
             @dPrevdate = MAX( rpl_date )
      FROM   r5reliabilitypf
      WHERE  rpl_object       = @sObject
      AND    rpl_object_org   = @sObjectorg
      AND    rpl_part         = @sPart
      AND    rpl_part_org     = @sPartorg
      AND    rpl_partlocation = @sPartloc
      AND    rpl_type         = CAST( @nI AS NVARCHAR )
      AND    ISNULL( rpl_code1, 'x' ) LIKE ISNULL( @sCode1, 'x' )
      AND    ISNULL( rpl_code2, 'x' ) = ISNULL( @sCode2, 'x' )

      IF @dRdrvsdate IS NOT NULL
        SET @dPrevdate = ISNULL( @dPrevdate, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( @dCommiss, @dRdrvsdate ) )
      SET @nSeqno = ISNULL( @nSeqno, 0 )

      IF ISNULL( @nDeleted, 0 ) > 0
        BEGIN
          /* Cursor to retrieve work orders belonging to current object. */
          DECLARE c_evt2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT evt_code, pfa_code, pfa_date
            FROM   r5eventobjects, r5events, r5partfailures
            WHERE  eob_event        = evt_code
            AND    eob_object       = @sObject
            AND    eob_object_org   = @sObjectorg
            AND    evt_code         = pfa_event
            AND    pfa_part         = @sPart
            AND    pfa_part_org     = @sPartorg
            AND    pfa_partlocation = @sPartloc
            AND    evt_rstatus      = N'C'
            AND    pfa_date > ISNULL( @dPrevdate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'01-01-1900', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) )
            AND    CASE @sRdrvapcc 
                     WHEN N'P' THEN pfa_reqm 
                     WHEN N'C' THEN pfa_cause 
                     WHEN N'A' THEN pfa_action 
                               ELSE pfa_failure 
                   END LIKE @sPercode1
            AND    ISNULL( CASE @sRdrvascc 
                             WHEN N'P' THEN pfa_reqm 
                             WHEN N'C' THEN pfa_cause 
                             WHEN N'A' THEN pfa_action 
                                       ELSE pfa_failure 
                           END, '<null>' ) LIKE @sPercode2
            AND  ( ( eob_level = 0 AND eob_obrtype IN ( N'A', N'P', N'S', N'L' ) ) OR 
                   ( eob_level = 1 AND evt_obrtype = N'A' AND eob_obrtype = N'P' ) )
            ORDER BY 2
  
          OPEN c_evt2
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt2 INTO @sEvtcode2, @sPfacode2, @dDate
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SET @nSeqno = @nSeqno + 1
              IF @dPrevdate IS NOT NULL 
                SET @nDays = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( DATEDIFF( mi, @dPrevdate, @dDate ) / 1440.0, .000001 )
              ELSE
                SET @nDays = NULL
              EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rcpf_insertrel @sObject, @sObjectorg, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc, 
                                                  @nI, @sCode1, @sCode2, @nSeqno, @nDays, @sEvtcode2, @sPfacode2, @dDate
              SET @dPrevdate = @dDate
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt2 INTO @sEvtcode2, @sPfacode2, @dDate
            END
          CLOSE c_evt2
          DEALLOCATE c_evt2
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          SET @nSeqno = @nSeqno + 1
          IF @dPrevdate IS NOT NULL 
            SET @nDays = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( DATEDIFF( mi, @dPrevdate, @dCompleted ) / 1440.0, .000001 )
          ELSE
            SET @nDays = NULL
          EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rcpf_insertrel @sObject, @sObjectorg, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc, 
                                              @nI, @sCode1, @sCode2, @nSeqno, @nDays, @sEvent, @sPfacode, @dCompleted
        END

      SET @nI = @nI + 1
    END
END

    AND    ISNULL( rel_code2, 'x' ) = ISNULL( @sCode2, 'x' )

  /* First individual ... */

  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN

  IF @nRank >= 2

      IF @nRank = 2

          EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, @sWhereclause, @nLastslope OUTPUT
        END

  SELECT @nAvgdays    = AVG( wei_value ),

        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO #tweibull( wei_seqno, wei_value )
          VALUES( LOG( @nSeqno ), LOG( @nDays ) )
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
        END
      CLOSE c_rel_ca
      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, '', @nCaslope OUTPUT
      SELECT @nExpsource = AVG( wei_seqno ) - ( AVG( wei_value ) * @nCaslope )
      FROM   #tweibull
      IF @nExpsource <= 45
        SET @nCaintercept = dbo.f_LEAST_NUMBER( EXP( @nExpsource ), 9999999999 )
      ELSE
        SET @nCaintercept = NULL
    END

  /* ... then cumulative. */ 
  DELETE FROM #tweibull
  SET @nRank = 0
  SET @nCumdays = 0
  OPEN c_rel_ca
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      SET @nRank = @nRank + 1
      SET @nCumdays = @nCumdays + @nDays
      INSERT INTO #tweibull( wei_seqno, wei_value, wei_rank, wei_date )
      VALUES( @nSeqno, @nCumdays, @nRank, @dDate )
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
    END
  CLOSE c_rel_ca
  SET @nDayscum = @nCumdays

  IF @nRank >= 2
    BEGIN
      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, '', @nAvgslope_c OUTPUT
      IF @nRank = 2
        SET @nLastslope = @nAvgslope
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          SET @sWhereclause = 'where wei_seqno >= ' + CAST( @nRank - 1 AS NVARCHAR )
          EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, @sWhereclause, @nLastslope_c OUTPUT
        END
    END

  IF @nRank > 1 
    EXECUTE @nReturn = o7weibull @nShape_c OUTPUT, @nScale_c OUTPUT, @nCorrelation_c OUTPUT, @nDummy OUTPUT

  IF @nRank > 2
    BEGIN
      BEGIN TRY
        /* Crow AMSAA IEC. */
        SELECT @nCaslope_iec = ( @nRank - 2 ) / SUM( LOG( @nCumdays / wei_value ) )
        FROM   #tweibull
        SET @nCaintercept_iec = dbo.f_LEAST_NUMBER( @nRank / POWER( @nCumdays, @nCaslope_iec ), 9999999999 )
      END TRY
      BEGIN CATCH
      END CATCH
    END

  IF @nRank > 1 
    BEGIN
      /* Crow AMSAA. */
      DELETE FROM #tweibull
      SET @nCumdays = 0
      OPEN c_rel_ca
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @nCumdays = @nCumdays + @nDays
          INSERT INTO #tweibull( wei_seqno, wei_value )
          VALUES( LOG( @nSeqno ), LOG( @nCumdays ) )
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel_ca INTO @nSeqno, @nDays, @dDate
        END
      CLOSE c_rel_ca
      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7getslope '#tweibull', 'wei_seqno', 'wei_value', NULL, '', @nCaslope_c OUTPUT
      SELECT @nExpsource = AVG( wei_seqno ) - ( AVG( wei_value ) * @nCaslope_c )
      FROM   #tweibull
      IF @nExpsource <= 45
        SET @nCaintercept_c = dbo.f_LEAST_NUMBER( EXP( @nExpsource ), 9999999999 )
      ELSE
        SET @nCaintercept_c = NULL
    END
   
  UPDATE r5reliability
  SET    rel_days_cum            = @nDayscum,
         rel_mtbf                = @nAvgdays,
         rel_min                 = @nMindays, 
         rel_max                 = @nMaxdays, 
         rel_stdde

CREATE PROCEDURE O7RC_PROCESS
  @sEvent      NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sObject     NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sObjectorg  NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @sPcode1     NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @sPcode2     NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @dStartdate  DATETIME,
  @dCommiss    DATETIME,
  @dCompleted  DATETIME,
  @sRdrvapcc   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sRdrvascc   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @sRdrvacdt   NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @dRdrvsdate  DATETIME,
  @sFull       NVARCHAR( 1 )
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @sCode1    NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sCode2    NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sPercode1 NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sPercode2 NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @nDeleted  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nI        INT
  DECLARE @sEvtcode2 NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @dDate     DATETIME
  DECLARE @nSeqno    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nReturn   INT
  DECLARE @nDays     NUMERIC( 20, 10 )
  DECLARE @dPrevdate DATETIME
  SET @nI = 1
  WHILE @nI <= 3 
    BEGIN
      IF @nI = 1 
        BEGIN
          /* Code1 n, Code2 n */
          SET @sCode1    = @sPcode1
          SET @sCode2    = @sPcode2
          SET @sPercode1 = @sPcode1
          SET @sPercode2 = @sPcode2
        END   
      ELSE IF @nI = 2
        BEGIN
          /* Code1 n, All Code2 */
          SET @sCode2     = NULL
          SET @sPercode2 = '%'
        END  
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* All Code1, All Code2 */
          SET @sCode1    = NULL
          SET @sPercode1 = '%'
        END  

      EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rc_deleterel @sEvent, @sObject, @sObjectorg, @nI, @sCode1, @sCode2, @dCompleted, @nDeleted OUTPUT
      IF @sFull <> N'-'
        SET @nDeleted = 0
      
      SELECT @nSeqno    = MAX( rel_seqno ), 
             @dPrevdate = MAX( rel_date )
      FROM   r5reliability
      WHERE  rel_object     = @sObject
      AND    rel_object_org = @sObjectorg
      AND    rel_type       = CAST( @nI AS NVARCHAR )
      AND    ISNULL( rel_code1, 'x' ) LIKE ISNULL( @sCode1, 'x' )
      AND    ISNULL( rel_code2, 'x' ) = ISNULL( @sCode2, 'x' )

      IF @dRdrvsdate IS NOT NULL
        SET @dPrevdate = ISNULL( @dPrevdate, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( @dCommiss, @dRdrvsdate ) )
      SET @nSeqno = ISNULL( @nSeqno, 0 )

      IF ISNULL( @nDeleted, 0 ) > 0
        BEGIN
          /* Cursor to retrieve work orders belonging to current object. */
          DECLARE c_evt2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT evt_code, CASE WHEN @sRdrvacdt = N'R' THEN evt_reported ELSE evt_completed END
            FROM   r5eventobjects, r5events
            WHERE  eob_event      = evt_code
            AND    eob_object     = @sObject
            AND    eob_object_org = @sObjectorg
            AND    evt_rstatus    = N'C'
            AND    CASE WHEN @sRdrvacdt = N'R' THEN evt_reported ELSE evt_completed END > 
                   ISNULL( @dPrevdate, dbo.TO_DATE( N'01-01-1900', N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) )
            AND    CASE @sRdrvapcc 
                     WHEN N'P' THEN evt_reqm 
                     WHEN N'C' THEN evt_cause 
                     WHEN N'A' THEN evt_action 
                               ELSE evt_failure 
                   END LIKE @sPercode1
            AND    ISNULL( CASE @sRdrvascc 
                             WHEN N'P' THEN evt_reqm 
                             WHEN N'C' THEN evt_cause 
                             WHEN N'A' THEN evt_action 
                                       ELSE evt_failure 
                           END, '<null>' ) LIKE @sPercode2
            AND  ( ( eob_level = 0 AND eob_obrtype IN ( N'A', N'P' ) ) OR 
                   ( eob_level = 1 AND evt_obrtype = N'A' AND eob_obrtype = N'P' ) )
            ORDER BY 2
  
          OPEN c_evt2
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt2 INTO @sEvtcode2, @dDate
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              SET @nSeqno = @nSeqno + 1
              IF @dPrevdate IS NOT NULL 
                SET @nDays = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( DATEDIFF( mi, @dPrevdate, @dDate ) / 1440.0, .000001 )
              ELSE
                SET @nDays = NULL
              EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rc_insertrel @sObject, @sObjectorg, @nI, @sCode1, @sCode2, @nSeqno, @nDays, @sEvtcode2, @dDate
              SET @dPrevdate = @dDate
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt2 INTO @sEvtcode2, @dDate
            END
          CLOSE c_evt2
          DEALLOCATE c_evt2
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          SET @nSeqno = @nSeqno + 1
          IF @dPrevdate IS NOT NULL 
            SET @nDays = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( DATEDIFF( mi, @dPrevdate, @dCompleted ) / 1440.0, .000001 )
          ELSE
            SET @nDays = NULL
          EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rc_insertrel @sObject, @sObjectorg, @nI, @sCode1, @sCode2, @nSeqno, @nDays, @sEvent, @dCompleted
        END

      SET @nI = @nI + 1
    END
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REALLOC 			   @sCOrder       nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCOrderorg    nvarchar(15),
                                       @nCOrdline     numeric(8,0),
                                       @nNToqty       numeric(24,6),
                                       @nNOnhandqty   numeric(24,6),
                                       @nNIssueqty    numeric(24,6),
                                       @sCPart        nvarchar(30),
                                       @sCPartorg     nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCFromevtcode nvarchar(30),
                                       @nNFromact     numeric(8,0),
                                       @sCFromevtorg  nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCToevtcode   nvarchar(30),
                                       @nNToact       numeric(8,0),
                                       @sCToevtorg    nvarchar(15),
                                       @sCAuth        nvarchar(255),
                                       @sCLot         nvarchar(12),
                                       @sChk          nvarchar(5) OUTPUT
                                       
AS
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sCTracode        nvarchar(30)		/* r5transactions.tra_code%TYPE               --Transaction code  */
	declare @sCTradesc        nvarchar(80)		/* r5transactions.tra_desc%TYPE               --Transaction description */
	declare @sCTrartype       nvarchar(4)		/* r5transactions.tra_rtype%TYPE              --Transaction rtype */
	declare @sCTrarstatus     nvarchar(4)		/* r5transactions.tra_rstatus%TYPE            --Transaction rstatus */
	declare @sCFromrentity    nvarchar(4)		/* r5transactions.tra_fromrentity%TYPE        --From rentity */
	declare @sCTorentity      nvarchar(4)		/* r5transactions.tra_torentity%TYPE          --To rentity */
	declare @sCFromrtype      nvarchar(4)		/* r5transactions.tra_fromrtype%TYPE = '*'   --From rtype */
	declare @sCTortype        nvarchar(4)		/* r5transactions.tra_tortype%TYPE   = '*'   --To rtype */
	declare @sCTrafromcode    nvarchar(30)		/* r5transactions.tra_fromcode%TYPE           --From transaction code */
	declare @sCTrafromcodeorg nvarchar(15)		/* r5transactions.tra_fromcode_org%TYPE       --From transaction org */
	declare @sCTratocode      nvarchar(30)		/* r5transactions.tra_tocode%TYPE             --To transaction code */
	declare @sCTratocodeorg   nvarchar(15)		/* r5transactions.tra_tocode_org%TYPE         --To transaction org */
	declare @sCTraorg         nvarchar(15)		/* r5transactions.tra_org%TYPE                --Transaction org */

	declare @sCsuppcode       nvarchar(30)		/* r5companies.com_code%TYPE                  --Supplier code */
	declare @sCsupporg        nvarchar(15)		/* r5companies.com_org%TYPE                   --Supplier org */
	declare @sCstrcode        nvarchar(15)		/* r5stores.str_code%TYPE                     --Store code */
	declare @sCstrorg         nvarchar(15)		/* r5stores.str_org%TYPE                      --Store org */
	declare @sCevtcode        nvarchar(30)		/* r5events.evt_code%TYPE                     --Event code */
	declare @sCevtorg         nvarchar(15)		/* r5events.evt_org%TYPE                      --Event org */

	declare @nNTrlline        numeric(8,0)      /* --Transaction line number */
	declare @nNTrlprice       numeric(24,6)     /* --Transline price */
	declare @nNTrlqty         numeric(24,6)     /* --Transline quantity */
	declare @dDTrldate        datetime      	/* --Transaction Date */
	declare @sCTrltype        nvarchar(4)		/* r5translines.trl_type%TYPE                 --Transline type */
	declare @sCTrlallocate    nvarchar(1)		/* r5translines.trl_allocate%TYPE = '+'      --Transline allocate */
	declare @sCTrlevt         nvarchar(30)		/* r5translines.trl_event%TYPE                --Transline event */
	declare @nCTrlio          numeric(18,0)     /* --Transline Input/Output */
	declare @nNActivity       numeric(8,0)      /* --Activity */
	declare @sCTrlbin         nvarchar(15)		/* r5translines.trl_bin%TYPE                  --Transline bin */
	declare @sCTrllot         nvarchar(12)		/* r5translines.trl_lot%TYPE                  --Transline lot */

	declare @nNRmqty          numeric(24,6)     /* --Remaining quantity */
	declare @sCheckresult     nvarchar(4)       /* --Error flag */
	declare @sX               nvarchar(2)       /* --Null variable */
	declare @sCtrastatus      nvarchar(4)		/* r5transactions.tra_status%TYPE */
	declare @nReturn		  int

/*main procedure*/
BEGIN
	set @sCFromrtype = N'*'
	set @sCTortype = N'*'
	set @nNTrlline = 1
	set @nNTrlqty = 0
	set @nCTrlio = 0
	set @sX = null
    set @sChk=N'0'

    /*checking mandatory parameters are missing*/
    IF @sCToevtcode IS NULL OR @nNToqty IS NULL
	begin
        set @sChk = N'1'
        RETURN
	end

    ELSE IF @nNToqty = 0
	begin
        set @sChk = N'5'
        RETURN
	end

    /*checking the combination job, activity combination cannot be same*/
    ELSE IF ( @nNToact = @nNFromact AND @sCToevtcode = @sCFromevtcode )
	begin
        set @sChk = N'4'
        RETURN
	end

    /*checking the Transfered quantity should be aloway less than or equals to sum*/
    /*of Warehouse quantity and Issued quantity*/
    ELSE IF @nNToqty <= @nNOnhandqty + @nNIssueqty
	begin
        IF @nNOnhandqty > 0
		begin
			IF @nNToqty < @nNOnhandqty
           		set @nNTrlqty = @nNToqty
        	ELSE
           		set @nNTrlqty = @nNOnhandqty

       		/*Creating return transaction from store to supplier*/
       		/*calling procedure to get data*/
			SELECT @sCTradesc = ord_desc
		    FROM   r5orders
		    WHERE  ord_code =  @sCOrder
		    AND    ord_org  =  @sCOrderorg
		    
		    /*Get the supplier code, store code and event code against order, order
		    organization and*/
		    /*order line*/
		    SELECT @sCsuppcode = orl_supplier, @sCsupporg = orl_supplier_org,  @nNTrlprice = orl_price/orl_exch 
		    FROM   r5orderlines
		    WHERE  orl_order = @sCOrder
		    AND    orl_order_org = @sCOrderorg
		    AND    orl_ordline = @nCOrdline
		
			/*Get the transtock lot for order, order organization and order line*/
			SELECT @sCstrcode = tst_store
		    FROM   r5transtock
		    WHERE  tst_order = @sCOrder
		    AND    tst_order_org = @sCOrderorg
		    AND    tst_ordline = @nCOrdline
		    
			/*Get the store organization against store code*/
			SELECT @sCstrorg = str_org
		    FROM   r5stores
		    WHERE  str_code = @sCstrcode
		    
       		set @sCTrartype        = N'RETN'
       		set @sCFromrentity     = N'STOR'
       		set @sCTrafromcode     = @sCstrcode
       		set @sCTrafromcodeorg  = @sCstrorg	

       		set @sCTorentity       = N'COMP'
       		set @sCTratocode       = @sCsuppcode
       		set @sCTratocodeorg    = @sCsupporg
       		set @sCTraorg          = @sCstrorg

       		set @sCTrltype         = N'RETN'
       		set @sCTrlevt          = @sCFromevtcode
       		set @nNActivity        = @nNFromact
       		set @sCTrlbin          = @sX
       		set @sCTrllot          = isnull(@sCLot, N'*')

       		/*calling procedure to create transaction and translines*/
			execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7MAXSEQ @sCTracode OUTPUT, N'TRAN', N'1', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
			begin
				set @sChk = N'3'
				RETURN
			end

		    IF @sCheckresult <> 0 
			begin
		        set @sChk = @sCheckresult
		        RETURN
		    end
		    set @dDTrldate = dbo.o7gttime2(@sCTraorg)
		    /*creating transactions*/
		    set @sCTrarstatus = N'U'
		    INSERT INTO r5transactions(tra_code, tra_desc, tra_rtype, tra_date, tra_rstatus,
		              tra_fromrentity, tra_order, tra_order_org, tra_fromrtype,
		              tra_fromcode, tra_torentity, tra_tortype, tra_tocode, tra_org,
		              tra_tocode_org, tra_fromcode_org)
		    VALUES (@sCTracode, @sCTradesc, @sCTrartype, @dDTrldate, @sCTrarst

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.O7REALLOCEXT   @sPo            nvarchar(30),
                                    @sPoorg         nvarchar(15),
                                    @nPoline        numeric(8),
                                    @nTransferqty   numeric(24,6),
                                    @sFromworkorder nvarchar(30),
                                    @nFromactivity  numeric(8),
                                    @sToworkorder   nvarchar(30),
                                    @nToactivity    numeric(8),
                                    @sLotcode       nvarchar(12),
                                    @sEquipment     nvarchar(30),
                                    @sRelatedwo     nvarchar(30),
                                    @sDeferred      nvarchar(1),
                                    @sR5user        nvarchar(255),
                                    @sChk           nvarchar(4)  OUTPUT,
                                    @sR5role        nvarchar(30) = '*'
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON

    declare @sX                     nvarchar(1)
    declare @dMaxclosed             datetime
    declare @sIssdays               nvarchar(200)
    declare @sRtndays               nvarchar(200)
    declare @sAllequipmenttext      nvarchar(255)
    declare @sWoheaderequipmenttext nvarchar(255)

    declare @sFromrstatus           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sFromorg               nvarchar(15)
    declare @dFromcompleted         datetime
    declare @sFromobject            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sFromobjectorg         nvarchar(15)
    declare @sFrommultiequip        nvarchar(1)
    declare @sFromrouteparent       nvarchar(30)
    declare @sFromdeferredorigwo    nvarchar(30)
    declare @nFromdeferredorigact   numeric(8)

    declare @sTorstatus             nvarchar(4)
    declare @sToorg                 nvarchar(15)
    declare @dTocompleted           datetime
    declare @sToobject              nvarchar(30)
    declare @sToobjectorg           nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTomultiequip          nvarchar(1)
    declare @sTorouteparent         nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTodeferredorigwo      nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTodeferredorigact     numeric(8)
    
    declare @nReceived              numeric(24,6)
    declare @nInholding             numeric(24,6)
    declare @nPrice                 numeric(24,6)
    declare @sPart                  nvarchar(30)
    declare @sPartorg               nvarchar(15)
    declare @sLot                   nvarchar(12)
    declare @sStore                 nvarchar(15)
    declare @sSupplier              nvarchar(30)
    declare @sSupplierorg           nvarchar(15)
    declare @sOrddesc               nvarchar(80)
    declare @sOrlrelatedwo          nvarchar(30)
    declare @sActualrelatedwo       nvarchar(30)
    declare @sOrlreq                nvarchar(30)
    declare @nOrlreqline            numeric(8)
    declare @sTstbin                nvarchar(15)
    declare @nTstqty                numeric(24,6)
    declare @nQtytoissue            numeric(24,6)

    declare @sTradesc               nvarchar(80)
    declare @sTrartype              nvarchar(4)
    declare @sTrafromrentity        nvarchar(4)
    declare @sTratorentity          nvarchar(4)
    declare @sTrafromrtype          nvarchar(4)
    declare @sTratortype            nvarchar(4)
    declare @sTrafromcode           nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTrafromcodeorg        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTratocode             nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTratocodeorg          nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTraorder              nvarchar(30)
    declare @sTraorderorg           nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTraorg                nvarchar(15)
    
    declare @nTrlline               numeric(8)
    declare @nTrlprice              numeric(24,6)
    declare @nTrlqty                numeric(24,6)
    declare @sTrlrtype              nvarchar(4)
    declare @sTrlallocate           nvarchar(1)
    declare @nTrlio                 numeric(38)
    declare @sTrlbin                nvarchar(15)
    declare @sTrllot                nvarchar(12)
    declare @sTrlevent              nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTrlact                numeric(8)
    declare @sTrlstore              nvarchar(15)
    declare @nTrlordline            numeric(8)
    declare @sTrlsplittrans         nvarchar(1)

    declare @nReturn                int

    declare @sCTrstatus             nvarchar(4)
    declare @sCTstatus              nvarchar(4)
    declare @dCTdate                datetime
    declare @sCTcode                nvarchar(30)
    declare @sCheckresult           nvarchar(4)

    set @sIssdays = dbo.o7dflt2(N'ISSDAYS')
    set @sRtndays = dbo.o7dflt2(N'ISSDAYS')
    set @sTrafromrtype = N'*'
    set @sTratortype = N'*'
    set @nTrlline = 1
    set @nTrlqty = 0
    set @nTrlio = 0

    set @sChk = N'0'
    set @sActualrelatedwo = @sRelatedwo
    
    select @dMaxclosed = MAX( clp_closed ) FROM r5closedperiods

    if @sFromworkorder is null or @nFromactivity is null 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'1'
            return
        end

    if @sToworkorder is null or @nToactivity is null 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'2'
            return
        end

    if @sPo is null or @sPoorg is null or @nPoline is null
        begin
            set @sChk = N'3'
            return
        end

    if coalesce( @nTransferqty, 0) <= 0
        begin
            set @sChk = N'4'
            return
        end

    if @sR5user is null
        begin
            set @sChk = N'5'
            return
        end

    if @sFromworkorder = @sToworkorder and @nFromactivity = @nToactivity 
        begin
            set @sChk = N'6'
            return
        end

    SELECT @sFromrstatus    = evt_rstatus, 
           @dFromcompleted  = evt_completed, 
           @sFromorg        = evt_org, 
           @sFromobject     = evt_object, 
           @sFromobjectorg  = evt_object_org, 
           @sFrommultiequip = evt_multiequip, 
           @sFromrouteparent = evt_routeparent
    FROM   r5userorganization, r5events
    WHERE  evt_code = @sFromworkorder
    AND    evt_org = uog_org
    AND    uog_user = @sR5user
    AND    uog_role = @sR5role
    AND    evt_rstatus IN ( N'R', N'C' )

    if @sFromrstatus is null
        begin
            set @sChk = N'7'
            return
        end

    if @sFromrstatus = N'C' and ( dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( dbo.o7gttime2( @sFromorg ), N'DD' ) > dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dFromcompleted + coalesce( cast( @sRtndays as int), 0 ), N'DD' )
                                    OR
                                  dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dFromcompleted, N'DD' ) <= coalesce( @dMaxclosed, cast( N'01-01-1900' as datetime ) ) )
        begin
            set @sChk = N'8'
            return
        end

    SELECT @sTorstatus    = evt_rstatus,

CREATE PROCEDURE O7RECALCDEPWRAPPER
AS
  SET IMPLICIT_TRANSACTIONS ON
  DECLARE @chk     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @n       NUMERIC
  DECLARE @cnt     NUMERIC
  DECLARE @org     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @obj     NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objorg  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @deptype NVARCHAR( 4 )
BEGIN
  /* Loop through all organizations in need of recalc. */
  DECLARE org CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT org_code
    FROM   r5organization
    WHERE  org_requestrecalcdep = N'+'
  OPEN org
  FETCH NEXT FROM org INTO @org
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Reset recalc flag. */
      UPDATE r5organization
      SET    org_requestrecalcdep = N'-'
      WHERE  org_code = @org
      SET @cnt = 0
      /* Loop through all object depreciation types. */
      DECLARE obd CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT DISTINCT obd_object, obd_object_org, obd_deptype
        FROM   r5objdeptypes
        WHERE  obd_object_org = @org
      OPEN obd
      FETCH NEXT FROM obd INTO @obj, @objorg, @deptype
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          SET @cnt = @cnt + 1
          /* Calculate depreciation. */
          EXECUTE o7depobj @obj, @objorg, @deptype, N'F', N'NO', @n OUTPUT, @n OUTPUT, @n OUTPUT, @chk OUTPUT
          EXECUTE o7depobj @obj, @objorg, @deptype, N'M', N'NO', @n OUTPUT, @n OUTPUT, @n OUTPUT, @chk OUTPUT
          IF @cnt >= 100 
            BEGIN
              /* Commit every 100 records. */
              IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
                COMMIT;
              SET @cnt = 0
            END
          FETCH NEXT FROM obd INTO @obj, @objorg, @deptype
        END
      CLOSE obd
      DEALLOCATE obd
      FETCH NEXT FROM org INTO @org
    END
  CLOSE org
  DEALLOCATE org
  /* Do final commit. */
  IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
    COMMIT
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7RELIABILITYCALCULATIONS
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @dPrevdate   DATETIME
  DECLARE @nRank       NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nSeqno      NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sChk        NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @nReturn     INT
  DECLARE @sRdrv       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sRdrvapcc   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sRdrvascc   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sRdrvacdt   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sRdrvupcc   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sRdrvuscc   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sRdrvucdt   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sRdrvstdt   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sRdrvmaxm   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @nRdrvmaxm   NUMERIC( 5, 0 )

  DECLARE @sEobobject  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sEoborg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @dCommiss    DATETIME
  DECLARE @sObrtype    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @sEvtobject  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sEvtorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @dEvtcomp    DATETIME
  DECLARE @sCode1      NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sCode2      NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sEvtcode    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sEvtcode2   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @dDate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @dStartdate  DATETIME
  DECLARE @dSdatepf    DATETIME
  DECLARE @dRdrvsdate  DATETIME
  DECLARE @dMaxdate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @nDays       NUMERIC( 10, 1 )
  DECLARE @nDeleted    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nObjects    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @sFull       NVARCHAR( 1 )

  DECLARE @sOldobject  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sOldorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sOldcode1   NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sOldcode2   NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @dOlddate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @dOldcommiss DATETIME

  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrv     OUTPUT, N'RDRV',     @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvapcc OUTPUT, N'RDRVAPCC', @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvascc OUTPUT, N'RDRVASCC', @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvacdt OUTPUT, N'RDRVACDT', @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvupcc OUTPUT, N'RDRVUPCC', @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvuscc OUTPUT, N'RDRVUSCC', @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvucdt OUTPUT, N'RDRVUCDT', @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvstdt OUTPUT, N'RDRVSTDT', @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvmaxm OUTPUT, N'RDRVMAXM', @sChk OUTPUT

  SET @sFull     = N'-'
  SET @sRdrv     = COALESCE( UPPER( @sRdrv ), N'OFF' )
  SET @sRdrvupcc = COALESCE( UPPER( @sRdrvupcc ), N'F' )
  SET @sRdrvuscc = COALESCE( UPPER( @sRdrvuscc ), N'C' )
  SET @sRdrvucdt = COALESCE( UPPER( @sRdrvucdt ), N'C' )
  SET @nRdrvmaxm = COALESCE( CAST( @sRdrvmaxm AS NUMERIC ), 6 )

  IF @sRdrvapcc IS NULL OR @sRdrv = N'FULL'
    BEGIN
      /* reset actual install parameter values with user defined values, if necessary. */
      IF @sRdrvupcc <> ISNULL( @sRdrvapcc, N'x' )
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5install
          SET    ins_desc = @sRdrvupcc
          WHERE  ins_code = N'RDRVAPCC'
          SET @sRdrvapcc = @sRdrvupcc
        END  
      IF @sRdrvuscc <> ISNULL( @sRdrvascc, N'x' )
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5install
          SET    ins_desc = @sRdrvuscc
          WHERE  ins_code = N'RDRVASCC'
          SET @sRdrvascc = @sRdrvuscc
        END
      IF @sRdrvucdt <> ISNULL( @sRdrvacdt, N'x' )
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5install
          SET    ins_desc = @sRdrvucdt
          WHERE  ins_code = N'RDRVACDT'
          SET @sRdrvacdt = @sRdrvucdt
        END
    END

  IF @sRdrv = N'OFF'
    /* Return if the Reliability Driver install parameter is set to 'OFF'. */
    RETURN
  ELSE IF @sRdrv IN ( N'PURGE', N'FULL' )
    BEGIN
      /* Delete all records. */
      DELETE FROM r5reliability
      DELETE FROM r5reliabilitypf
      IF @sRdrv = N'PURGE'
        /* Return if only purge required. */
        RETURN
      ELSE
        /* Otherwise set the start date to long, long ago. */
        SET @dStartdate = dbo.TO_DATE( N'01-01-1900', N'MM-DD-YYYY' )
        SET @sFull = @sRdrvacdt
    END
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      /* The value of the install parameter should be a date. */
      /* Use it as the start date.                            */
      SET @dStartdate = dbo.TO_DATE( @sRdrv, N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) 
      IF @dStartdate < getdate() - 14
        SET @sFull = @sRdrvacdt
    END
     
  SET @dSdatepf = @dStartdate

  IF @sRdrvstdt IS NOT NULL
    SET @dRdrvsdate = dbo.TO_DATE( @sRdrvstdt, N'MM-DD-YYYY' ) 

  IF @nRdrvmaxm IS NULL
    /* Set new date, for the next run. */
    UPDATE r5install
    SET    ins_desc = dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( dbo.o7gttime2( NULL ), N'MM-DD-YYYY' )
    WHERE  ins_code = N'RDRV'
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @sRdrv = N'FULL' 
        BEGIN
          SELECT @dMaxdate = MIN( evt_created )
          FROM   r5events
          SET @dMaxdate = DATEADD( mm, @nRdrvmaxm, dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @dMaxdate, N'DD' ) )
        END
      ELSE
        SET @dMaxdate = dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( DATEADD( mm, @nRdrvmaxm, @dStartdate ), getdate() )
      /* Set new date, for the next run. */
      UPDATE r5install
      SET    ins_desc = dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR( @dMaxdate, N'MM-DD-YYYY' )
      WHERE  ins_code = N'RDRV'
    END

  /* Loop through all work orders with no primary code, but reliability data. */
  IF @sFull = N'-'
    BEGIN
      DECLARE c_evtrel CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT rel_event, rel_date, rel_object, rel_object_org, rel_code1, rel_code2, obj_commiss
        FROM   r5reliability, r5objects, r5events
        WHERE  rel_event = evt_code 
        AND    obj_code = rel_object
        AND    obj_org = rel_object_org
        AND    rel_type = 1
        AND    evt_rstatus = N'C'
        AND    evt_object IS NOT NULL
        AND    evt_rtype IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
        AND    ISNULL( evt_updated, evt_created ) >= @dStartdate
        AND    evt_obrtype IN ( N'A', N'P' )
        AND    CASE @sRdrvapcc 
                 WHEN N'C' THEN evt_cause
                 WHEN N'A' THEN evt_action
                 WHEN N'P' THEN evt_reqm 
                           ELSE evt_failure 
               END IS NULL
        ORDER BY 2
    
      OPEN c_evtrel
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_evtrel INTO @sEvtcode, @dOlddate, @sOldobject, @sOldorg, @sOldcode1, @sOldcode2, @dOldcommiss
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rc_process @sEvtcode, @sOldobject, @sOldorg, @sOldcode1, @sOldcode2, @dOlddate, @dOldcommiss, 
                                          @dOlddate, @sRdrvapcc, @sRdrvascc, @sRdrvacdt, @dRdrvsdate, @sFull                                      
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_evtrel INTO @sEvtcode, @dOlddate, @sOldobject, @sOldorg, @sOldcode1, @sOldcode2, @dOldcommiss
        END
      CLOSE c_evtrel
      DEALLOCATE c_evtrel
    END

  /* Cursor to retrieve work orders. */
  DECLARE c_evt CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT evt_code, CASE @sRdrvacdt WHEN N'R' THEN evt_reported ELSE evt_completed END, evt_object, evt_object_org
    FROM   r5events LEFT OUTER JOIN r5organizationoptions ON ( opa_code = N'RDRVPM' AND opa_org = evt_org )
    WHERE  ( ( ISNULL( opa_desc, N'NO' ) = N'NO' AND evt_rtype <> N'PPM' ) OR ISNULL( opa_desc, N'NO' ) = N'YES' ) 
    AND    evt_rstatus = N'C'
    AND    evt_object IS NOT NULL
    AND    evt_rtype IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
    AND    evt_obrtype IN ( N'A', N'P' )
    AND    ISNULL( evt_updated, evt_created ) <= COALESCE( @dMaxdate, ISNULL( evt_updated, evt_created ) )
    AND    ISNULL( evt_updated, evt_created ) >= @dStartdate
    AND    CASE @sRdrvapcc 
             WHEN N'C' THEN evt_cause
             WHEN N'A' THEN evt_action
             WHEN N'P' THEN evt_reqm 
                       ELSE evt_failure 
           END IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY 2 

  OPEN c_evt
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt INTO @sEvtcode, @dEvtcomp, @sEvtobject, @sEvtorg
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Cursor to retrieve current objects belonging to current work order. */
      DECLARE c_eob CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT eob_object, eob_object_org, obj_commiss, obj_obrtype,

  DECLARE @sRdrvascc   NVARCHAR( 30 )
 
  DECLARE @sEobobject  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sEoborg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @dCommiss    DATETIME
  DECLARE @sObrtype    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @sEvtobject  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sEvtorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sPfacode    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @dPfadate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @sPart       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sPartorg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sPartloc    NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @sCode1      NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sCode2      NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sEvtcode    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sEvtcode2   NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @dDate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @dStartdate  DATETIME
  DECLARE @nDays       NUMERIC( 10, 1 )
  DECLARE @nDeleted    NUMERIC
  DECLARE @nObjects    NUMERIC

  DECLARE @sOldobject  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sOldorg     NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @sOldcode1   NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @sOldcode2   NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @dOlddate    DATETIME
  DECLARE @dOldcommiss DATETIME

  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvapcc OUTPUT, N'RDRVAPCC', @sChk OUTPUT
  EXECUTE @nReturn = O7DFLT @sRdrvascc OUTPUT, N'RDRVASCC', @sChk OUTPUT

  SET @dStartdate = @dStartdatepf

  /* Cursor to retrieve work orders. */
  DECLARE c_evt CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT evt_code, evt_object, evt_object_org, pfa_code, pfa_date
    FROM   r5events, r5partfailures
    WHERE  evt_code = pfa_event
    AND    evt_rstatus = N'C'
    AND    evt_object IS NOT NULL
    AND    evt_rtype IN ( N'JOB', N'PPM' )
    AND    pfa_updated >= @dStartdate
    AND    pfa_updated <= COALESCE( @dMaxdate, pfa_updated )
    AND    pfa_partlocation IS NOT NULL
    AND    CASE @sRdrvapcc 
             WHEN N'C' THEN pfa_cause
             WHEN N'A' THEN pfa_action
             WHEN N'P' THEN pfa_reqm 
                       ELSE pfa_failure 
           END IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY pfa_date 

  OPEN c_evt
  FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt INTO @sEvtcode, @sEvtobject, @sEvtorg, @sPfacode, @dPfadate
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
    BEGIN
      /* Cursor to retrieve current objects belonging to current work order. */
      DECLARE c_eob CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
        SELECT eob_object, eob_object_org, obj_commiss, obj_obrtype, pfa_part, pfa_part_org, pfa_partlocation,
               CASE @sRdrvapcc 
                 WHEN N'C' THEN pfa_cause
                 WHEN N'A' THEN pfa_action
                 WHEN N'P' THEN pfa_reqm 
                           ELSE pfa_failure 
               END,
               ISNULL( CASE @sRdrvascc 
                         WHEN N'C' THEN pfa_cause
                         WHEN N'A' THEN pfa_action
                         WHEN N'P' THEN pfa_reqm 
                                   ELSE pfa_failure 
                       END, '<null>' ) 
        FROM   r5eventobjects, r5objects, r5events, r5partfailures
        WHERE  eob_event   = evt_code
        AND    obj_code    = eob_object
        AND    obj_org     = eob_object_org
        AND    evt_code    = pfa_event
        AND    pfa_code    = @sPfacode
        AND  ( ( eob_level = 0 AND eob_obrtype IN ( N'A', N'P', N'S', N'L' ) ) OR 
               ( eob_level = 1 AND evt_obrtype = N'A' AND eob_obrtype = N'P' ) )

      SET @nObjects = 0
      OPEN c_eob
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_eob INTO @sEobobject, @sEoborg, @dCommiss, @sObrtype, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc, @sCode1, @sCode2
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @sFull = N'-'
            BEGIN
              SET @nObjects = @nObjects + 1    
              /* Find out whether data changed. */
              SET @sOldobject  = NULL
              SET @sOldorg     = NULL
              SET @sOldcode1   = NULL
              SET @sOldcode2   = NULL
              SET @dOlddate    = NULL
              SET @dOldcommiss = NULL

              SELECT @sOldobject  = rpl_object, 
                     @sOldorg     = rpl_object_org, 
                     @sOldcode1   = rpl_code1, 
                     @sOldcode2   = rpl_code2, 
                     @dOlddate    = rpl_date, 
                     @dOldcommiss = obj_commiss
              FROM   r5objects, r5reliabilitypf
              WHERE  obj_code        = rpl_object
              AND    obj_org         = rpl_object_org
              AND    rpl_failurecode = @sPfacode
              AND    obj_obrtype     = @sObrtype
              AND    rpl_type        = 1

              /* If object, code1 or code2 changed, redo the old values first. */ 
              IF   @sEobobject <> @sOldobject 
                OR @sEoborg    <> @sOldorg 
                OR @sCode1     <> @sOldcode1
                OR @sCode1     <> @sOldcode2
                BEGIN
                  /* Set start date. */
                  SET @dStartdate = dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( ISNULL( @dOlddate, @dPfadate ), @dPfadate )
                  /* Process records. */ 
                  EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rcpf_process @sEvtcode, @sOldobject, @sOldorg, @sPfacode, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc,
                                                    @sOldcode1, @sOldcode2, @dStartdate, @dOldcommiss, 
                                                    @dPfadate, @sRdrvapcc, @sRdrvascc, @dRdrvsdate, @sFull
                END
            END
      
          /* Set start date. */
          SET @dStartdate = dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( ISNULL( @dOlddate, @dPfadate ), @dPfadate )
          /* Process records. */ 
          EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rcpf_process @sEvtcode, @sEobobject, @sEoborg, @sPfacode, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc,
                                            @sCode1, @sCode2, @dStartdate, @dCommiss, 
                                            @dPfadate, @sRdrvapcc, @sRdrvascc, @dRdrvsdate, @sFull

          FETCH NEXT FROM c_eob INTO @sEobobject, @sEoborg, @dCommiss, @sObrtype, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc, @sCode1, @sCode2
        END
      CLOSE c_eob
      DEALLOCATE c_eob
    
      IF @nObjects = 1 AND @sFull = N'-'
        BEGIN
          /* Check whether there are reliability records for an object no longer related to the current WO. */

          DECLARE c_rel2 CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT rpl_object, rpl_object_org, rpl_part, rpl_part_org, rpl_partlocation, 
                   rpl_code1, rpl_code2, rpl_date, obj_commiss
            FROM   r5objects, r5reliabilitypf
            WHERE  obj_code        = rpl_object
            AND    obj_org         = rpl_object_org
            AND    rpl_failurecode = @sPfacode
            AND    rpl_type        = 1
            AND  ( rpl_object <> @sEvtobject OR rpl_object_org <> @sEvtorg )

          OPEN c_rel2
          FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel2 INTO @sEobobject, @sEoborg, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc,
                                      @sCode1, @sCode2, @dStartdate, @dCommiss
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              /* Delete old records, and recalculate newer records. */ 
              EXECUTE @nReturn = o7rcpf_process @sEvtcode, @sEobobject, @sEoborg, @sPfacode, @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc,
                                                @sCode1, @sCode2, @dStartdate, @dCommiss, 
                                                @dPfadate, @sRdrvapcc, @sRdrvascc, @dRdrvsdate, @sFull
              FETCH NEXT FROM c_rel2 INTO @sEobobject, @sEoborg,  @sPart, @sPartorg, @sPartloc,
                                          @sCode1, @sCode2, @dStartdate, @dCommiss
            END
          CLOSE c_rel2
          DEALLOCATE c_rel2
        END 

      FETCH NEXT FROM c_evt INTO @sEvtcode, @sEvtobject, @sEvtorg, @sPfacode, @dPfadate
    E

CREATE PROCEDURE o7reliabilityrankingvalobj
  @rrvpk                  NVARCHAR( 30),
  @class                  NVARCHAR( 8 ),
  @classOrg               NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @org                    NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @category               NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @equipment              NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @equipmentOrg           NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @includeChild           NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @user                   NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @role                   NVARCHAR( 30 ) = '*' 
AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @deptsec        NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @cnt            NUMERIC
  DECLARE @brcclass       NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @brcclassorg    NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @brccategory    NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @brcobjectcode  NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @brcobjectorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @rvoobject      NVARCHAR( 30 ) 
  DECLARE @rvoobjectorg   NVARCHAR( 15 )

  SELECT @deptsec = ins_desc
  FROM   r5install
  WHERE  ins_code = N'DEPTSEC'
  SET @cnt = 0

  /* Delete existing records first. */
  DELETE FROM r5reliabilityrankingvalobj
  WHERE  rvo_rrvpk = @rrvpk

	DECLARE brc CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
    SELECT brc_class, brc_class_org, brc_category, brc_object_code, brc_object_org
    FROM   r5burankingvaluesclasses
    WHERE  brc_rrvpk = @rrvpk
    UNION
    SELECT @class, @classorg, @category, @equipment, @equipmentorg
    FROM   dual
    WHERE  ( @class IS NOT NULL OR @category IS NOT NULL OR @equipment IS NOT NULL )
	OPEN brc
  FETCH NEXT FROM brc INTO @brcclass, @brcclassorg, @brccategory, @brcobjectcode, @brcobjectorg
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
      /* Loop through all Classes/Categories/Equipment. */
      SET @cnt = @cnt + 1
      IF @brcobjectcode IS NOT NULL
        /* Equipment. */
        INSERT INTO r5reliabilityrankingvalobj( rvo_rrvpk, rvo_object, rvo_object_org )
        SELECT @rrvpk, @brcobjectcode, @brcobjectorg
        FROM   dual
        WHERE  NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5reliabilityrankingvalobj WHERE rvo_rrvpk = @rrvpk AND rvo_object = @brcobjectcode AND rvo_object_org = @brcobjectorg )
      ELSE IF @brccategory IS NOT NULL
        /* Category. */
        INSERT INTO r5reliabilityrankingvalobj( rvo_rrvpk, rvo_object, rvo_object_org )
        SELECT @rrvpk, obj_code, obj_org
        FROM   r5userorganization, r5objects
        WHERE  uog_org  = obj_org
        AND    uog_user = @user
        AND    uog_role = @role
        AND    ( uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @org )
        AND    COALESCE( obj_notused, N'-' ) <> N'+'
        AND    obj_rstatus IN ( N'B', N'C', N'CIR', N'CRR', N'I' ) 
        AND    obj_obrtype NOT IN ( N'C', N'I', N'L' )
        AND    obj_code <> N'*'
        AND    obj_category = @brccategory
        AND    (    @deptsec = N'OFF' 
                 OR obj_mrc IN ( SELECT dse_mrc 
                                 FROM   r5departmentsecurity 
                                 WHERE  dse_user = @user 
                                 AND    dse_mrc  = obj_mrc 
                                 AND    ISNULL( dse_readonly, '-' ) = '-' ) )
        AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5reliabilityrankingvalobj WHERE rvo_rrvpk = @rrvpk AND rvo_object = obj_code AND rvo_object_org = obj_org )
      ELSE
        /* Class. */
        INSERT INTO r5reliabilityrankingvalobj( rvo_rrvpk, rvo_object, rvo_object_org )
        SELECT @rrvpk, obj_code, obj_org
        FROM   r5userorganization, r5objects
        WHERE  uog_org  = obj_org
        AND    uog_user = @user
        AND    uog_role = @role
        AND    ( uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @org )
        AND    COALESCE( obj_notused, N'-' ) <> N'+'
        AND    obj_rstatus IN ( N'B', N'C', N'CIR', N'CRR', N'I' ) 
        AND    obj_obrtype NOT IN ( N'C', N'I', N'L' )
        AND    obj_code <> N'*'
        AND    obj_class     = @brcclass
        AND    obj_class_org = @brcclassorg
        AND    (    @deptsec = N'OFF' 
                 OR obj_mrc IN ( SELECT dse_mrc 
                                 FROM   r5departmentsecurity 
                                 WHERE  dse_user = @user 
                                 AND    dse_mrc  = obj_mrc 
                                 AND    ISNULL( dse_readonly, N'-' ) = N'-' ) )
        AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5reliabilityrankingvalobj WHERE rvo_rrvpk = @rrvpk AND rvo_object = obj_code AND rvo_object_org = obj_org )
      FETCH NEXT FROM brc INTO @brcclass, @brcclassorg, @brccategory, @brcobjectcode, @brcobjectorg
    END
  CLOSE brc
  DEALLOCATE brc
    
  IF @cnt = 0
    /* No special Class/Category/Equipment records used, so use all Equipment. */    
    INSERT INTO r5reliabilityrankingvalobj( rvo_rrvpk, rvo_object, rvo_object_org )
    SELECT @rrvpk, obj_code, obj_org
    FROM   r5userorganization, r5objects
    WHERE  uog_org  = obj_org
    AND    uog_user = @user
    AND    uog_role = @role
    AND    ( uog_common = N'+' OR uog_org = @org )
    AND    COALESCE( obj_notused, N'-' ) <> N'+'
    AND    obj_rstatus IN ( N'B', N'C', N'CIR', N'CRR', N'I' ) 
    AND    obj_obrtype NOT IN ( N'C', N'I', N'L' )
    AND    obj_code <> N'*'
    AND    (    @deptsec = N'OFF' 
             OR obj_mrc IN ( SELECT dse_mrc 
                             FROM   r5departmentsecurity 
                             WHERE  dse_user = @user 
                             AND    dse_mrc  = obj_mrc 
                             AND    ISNULL( dse_readonly, N'-' ) = N'-' ) )
  ELSE
    BEGIN
      IF @includechild = N'+'
        BEGIN
          DECLARE rvo CURSOR LOCAL STATIC FOR 
            SELECT rvo_object, rvo_object_org
            FROM   r5reliabilityrankingvalobj
            WHERE  rvo_rrvpk = @rrvpk
          OPEN rvo
          FETCH NEXT FROM rvo INTO @rvoobject, @rvoobjectorg
          WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            BEGIN
              INSERT INTO r5reliabilityrankingvalobj( rvo_rrvpk, rvo_object, rvo_object_org )
              SELECT DISTINCT @rrvpk, child, childorg
              FROM   r5objects, dbo.o7getequipchildrens( @rvoobject, @rvoobjectorg )
              WHERE  obj_code = child
              AND    obj_org  = childorg
              AND    obj_rstatus IN ( N'B', N'C', N'CIR', N'CRR', N'I' ) 
              AND    ISNULL( obj_notused, N'-' ) <> N'+' 
              AND    (    @deptsec = N'OFF' 
                       OR obj_mrc IN ( SELECT dse_mrc 
                                       FROM   r5departmentsecurity 
                                       WHERE  dse_user = @user 
                                       AND    dse_mrc  = obj_mrc 
                                       AND    ISNULL( dse_readonly, N'-' ) = N'-' ) )
              AND    NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM r5reliabilityrankingvalobj WHERE rvo_rrvpk = @rrvpk AND rvo_object = child AND rvo_object_org = childorg )
              FETCH NEXT FROM rvo INTO @rvoobject, @rvoobjectorg
            END
          CLOSE rvo
          DEALLOCATE rvo
        END
    END
END

name: O7REMDMA
body:
CREATE PROCEDURE O7REMDMA
						   @sSource    nvarchar(8),
                           @sCode      nvarchar(30),
                           @sClass     nvarchar(80),
                           @dDatefrom  datetime,
                           @dDateto    datetime,
                           @nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
                           @sStatement nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT  
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(1000)  /* @sExtracol part of select clause.          */
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(400)  /* from @sStatement                        */
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* select @sStatement it self              */
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(3000)  /* select @sStatement it self              */
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for events                 */
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for events (specially for report ORCSTL)   */
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for projects               */
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for budgets               */
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause to use ( evt, pro or bud ) */
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(400)  /* group by @sStatement                    */
	declare @nRemdma		numeric(30,6)            /* remaining direct material order cost  */
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)  /* date from in character                */
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)  /* date to in character                  */
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)  
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRecid			numeric(38,0)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost      numeric(30,6)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
    declare @sWoclpout      nvarchar(200)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''

	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

    set @sWoclpout = upper(dbo.o7dflt2( N'WOCLPOUT' ))

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER ( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) -
														 coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) -
														 coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0 ), 0 ) *
														  coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) /
														  coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) /
														  coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ) +
														( ( coalesce( l.orl_totextra, 0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) ) *
														  dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) - coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) -  coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0 ), 0 ) /
														  l.orl_ordqty ) ), 2 ) costs, 
										coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch,1 ) rate,
										round( sum( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) - coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) -  coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0 ) ,0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ), 2 ) qty,
										a.act_event,
										a.act_act,
										l.orl_sqlidentity recid 
								 from   r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5events e, r5activities a, r5ububat u 
								 where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
								 and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
								 and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
                                 and    l.orl_event   = e.evt_code
								 and    l.orl_ordqty  > 0
								 and    l.orl_active  = N''+''
								 and    l.orl_rtype   = N''PD''
								 and    u.bub_event = l.orl_event
								 and    a.act_event = l.orl_event
								 and    a.act_act   = l.orl_act
								 and    u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N'''
                                 and    u.bub_rstatus <> ''B''
                                 and  ( u.bub_rstatus <> ''C'' or ''' + @sWoclpout + N''' = ''YES'' )
                                 and    a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
								 group by coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch,1 ),
											a.act_event,
											a.act_act,
											l.orl_sqlidentity '
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			IF  @sSource = N'BUD'
				set @sFromstat = N'r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5events e, r5activities a, r5ububat u '
			ELSE
				set @sFromstat = N'r5orderlines l, r5events e, r5orders o '

		   /* Set select statement it self */
		   set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER ( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) -
														 coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) -
														 coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0 ), 0 ) *
											  coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) /
											  coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) /
											  coalesce( l.orl_multiply, 1 ) ) +
											( ( coalesce( l.orl_totextra, 0 ) / coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) ) *
											  dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( l.orl_ordqty, 0 ) - coalesce( l.orl_recvqty, 0 ) -  coalesce( l.orl_scrapqty, 0 ), 0 ) /
											  l.orl_ordqty ) ), 2 ) 
							   ' + @sExtracol + '
						 from  ' + @sFromstat +
					   ' where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
						 and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
						 and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
                         and    l.orl_event   = e.evt_code
						 and    l.orl_ordqty  > 0
						 and    l.orl_active  = N''+''
						 and    l.orl_rtype   = N''PD'''

	        set @sEvtclause = N'and l.orl_event = @sEvent and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '

			set @sPrjclause = N' and l.orl_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'') and l.orl_project in
						   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7REMXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) )'
 
			set @sBudclause = N' and   u.bub_event = l.orl_event
					  and   a.act_event = l.orl_event
					  and   a.act_act   = l.orl_act
					  and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
                      and    u.bub_rstatus <> ''B''
                      and  ( u.bub_rstatus <> ''C'' or ''' + @sWoclpout + N''' = ''YES'' )
					  and   a.act_start >=	CONVERT(DATETIME,@sCharfrom, 101)
					  and   a.act_start <=	CONVERT(DATETIME,@sCharto, 101) '

			if @sSource = N'EVT' 
			  set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			if  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			if  @sSource = N'BUD' 
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause

			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause

            if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
                begin
                    set @nCost = 0
                    declare c_remdma_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7REMXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY2( @sCode, @sWoclpout ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
                    open c_remdma_evt
                    fetch next from c_remdma_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sRouteParent is not null
                                set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7srmdma( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )
                            
			                EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			                if @@ERROR <> 0 
                                begin 
                                    close c_remdma_evt
                                    deallocate c_remdma_evt
				                    return -1
                                end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REMFIX
						   @sSource    nvarchar(8),
                           @sCode      nvarchar(30),

                           @dDatefrom  datetime,
                           @dDateto    datetime,
                           @nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
                           @sStatement nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT  
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(1000)  /* @sExtracol part of select clause.			*/
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(1000)  /* @sExtra part of select clause.				*/
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(400)  /* from @sStatement									*/
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* select @sStatement it self							*/
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(3000)  /* select @sStatement it self						*/
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for events							*/
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)  /* and clause for events (specially for report ORCSTL)   */
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for projects							*/
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause for budgets							*/
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(3000)  /* and clause to use ( evt, pro or bud )			*/
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(400)  /* group by @sStatement								*/
	declare @nRemdma		numeric(30,6)            /* remaining direct material order cost	*/
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)  /* date from in character								*/
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)  /* date to in character								*/
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)  
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRecid			numeric(38,0)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sRouteParent   nvarchar(30)
    declare @nTempCost      numeric(30,6)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)
    declare @sWoclpout      nvarchar(200)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
	set @sAndclause = N''
	set @sExtra = N''


	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

    set @sWoclpout = upper(dbo.o7dflt2( N'WOCLPOUT' ))

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select round( sum( ( ( ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER ( coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) - coalesce( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) ,0 ) +
													( coalesce( l.orl_invcalctaxamount, 0 ) * 
													( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) - coalesce( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ), 0 ) / 
													coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) ) ) ) ) * 
												( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) ),
												dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration )  ) / 
										coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) ), 2 ) costs,
										null  rate,
										null  qty,
										a.act_event,
										a.act_act,
										a.act_sqlidentity recid						 
								from	r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5events e, r5activities a, r5ububat u 
								 where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
								 and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                                 and    l.orl_event   = e.evt_code
								 and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
								 and    l.orl_active  = N''+''
								 and    l.orl_rtype   = N''SF''
								 and   l.orl_event = a.act_event
								  and   l.orl_act   = a.act_act
								  and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
								  and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
                                 and    u.bub_rstatus <> ''B''
                                 and  ( u.bub_rstatus <> ''C'' or ''' + @sWoclpout + N''' = ''YES'' )
								  and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101) 
								  and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101) 
								group by a.act_event,
										a.act_act,
										a.act_sqlidentity '
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			IF  @sSource = N'BUD'
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N'r5orderlines l, r5orders o, r5events e, r5activities a, r5ububat u '
					set @sExtra = N' * ( ( DATEDIFF(day, dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( a.act_start, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharfrom, 101) ), 
						dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( a.act_start + a.act_duration - 1, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sCharto, 101) ) ) + 1 ) / a.act_duration ) '	
				end
			ELSE
				set @sFromstat = N'r5orderlines l, r5events e, r5orders o '

		 /* Set select statement it self */
			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( ( ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER ( coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) - coalesce( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ) ,0 ) +														 
													( coalesce( l.orl_invcalctaxamount, 0 ) * 
													( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) - coalesce( l.orl_recvvalue, 0 ), 0 ) / 
													coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) ) ) )' + @sExtra + ' ) /
													coalesce( l.orl_exch, 1 ) ), 2 ) '
													+ @sExtracol + N'
						 from  ' + @sFromstat +
					   N' where  o.ord_code    = l.orl_order
						 and    o.ord_org     = l.orl_order_org
                         and    l.orl_event   = e.evt_code
						 and    o.ord_rstatus = N''A''
						 and    l.orl_active  = N''+''
						 and    l.orl_rtype   = N''SF''
						 and coalesce( l.orl_price, 0 ) <> 0'
     

	        set @sEvtclause = N'and l.orl_event = @sEvent and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '

			set @sPrjclause = N' and l.orl_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'') and l.orl_project in
						   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7REMXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) )'
 
			set @sBudclause = N' and   l.orl_event = a.act_event
					  and   l.orl_act   = a.act_act
					  and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
					  and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
                     and    u.bub_rstatus <> ''B''
                     and  ( u.bub_rstatus <> ''C'' or ''' + @sWoclpout + N''' = ''YES'' )
					  and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME,@sCharfrom, 101)
					  and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME,@sCharto, 101) '

			if @sSource = N'EVT' 
			  set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			if  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			if  @sSource = N'BUD' 
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause

			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
            if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
                begin
                    set @nCost = 0
                    declare c_remfix_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7REMXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY2( @sCode, @sWoclpout ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
                    open c_remfix_evt
                    fetch next from c_remfix_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sRouteParent is not null
                                set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7srmfix( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )
                            
			                EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			                if @@ERROR <> 0 
                                begin 
                                    close c_remfix_evt
                                    deallocate c_remfix_evt
				                    return -1
                                end

                            set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                            fetch next from c_remfix_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                        end

						 and    a.act_order is null '

			set @sEvtclause = N' and a.act_event = @sEvent
                                 and a.act_event = e.evt_code
						         and e.evt_rstatus <> N''C''
						         and e.evt_routeparent IS NULL '

			set @sPrjclause = N' and a.act_event = e.evt_code
								and e.evt_rstatus <> N''C''
								and a.act_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'') and a.act_project in
						   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7REMXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) )'

			set @sBudclause = N' and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
					  and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
					  and   u.bub_rstatus not in ( N''B'', N''C'' )
					  and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME,@sCharfrom, 101)
					  and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME,@sCharto, 101) '


			if @sSource = N'EVT' 
			  set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			if  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			if  @sSource = N'BUD' 
				set @sAndclause = @sBudclause

			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause

            if @sSource in ( N'EVT', N'EVT2')
                begin
                    set @nCost = 0
                    declare c_remlab_evt cursor local for select evt_code, evt_routeparent from dbo.O7REMXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) where ( evt_routeparent IS NULL OR evt_code = @sCode )
                    open c_remlab_evt
                    fetch next from c_remlab_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            if @sRouteParent is not null
                                set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( dbo.o7srmlab( @sRouteParent, @sEvent ), 0 )
                            
			                EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											                @nTempCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			                if @@ERROR <> 0 
                                begin 
                                    close c_remlab_evt
                                    deallocate c_remlab_evt
				                    return -1
                                end

                            set @nCost = @nCost + coalesce( @nTempCost, 0 )

                            fetch next from c_remlab_evt into @sEvent, @sRouteParent
                        end
                    close c_remlab_evt
                    deallocate c_remlab_evt
                end
            else
                begin
			        EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10), @sEvent nvarchar(30)', 
											        @nCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto, @sEvent
			        if @@ERROR <> 0 
				        return -1
                end
		end

	SELECT @sInsertClause = N''

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special cases and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and return.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sFromstat = N' r5parts      p,
								r5matlparts  m,
								r5activities a,
								r5mrcs       c,
								r5events     e left outer join r5objects o on ( o.obj_code = e.evt_object and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org ),
								r5ububat     u '

			set @sExtracol = N' , coalesce( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org,e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sPricelevel + N''', null ), 0 ) rate,
									dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( coalesce( m.mlp_qty, 0 ) - coalesce( dbo.o7getpartissued(A.ACT_EVENT , a.act_act , m.mlp_part , m.mlp_part_org),  0 ), 0 ) qty,
									a.act_event,

			set @sGroupby  = N' group by c.mrc_store,

			return 
		end
	else
		begin
			IF @sSource = N'BUD'
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N' r5parts      p,

				end
			ELSE 
				begin
					set @sFromstat = N' r5parts      p,

					r5events     e left outer join r5objects o on ( o.obj_code = e.evt_object and o.obj_org = e.evt_object_org )'
				end 

			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = round( sum( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER(coalesce( dbo.O7GETPRC( c.mrc_store, m.mlp_part, m.mlp_part_org,e.evt_org, N''B'', N''' + @sPricelevel + N''', null ), 0 ) *

								+ @sExtracol + N' from  ' + @sFromstat + N'
								where  a.act_event         = e.evt_code
								and    p.par_code          = m.mlp_part

								and    case when m.mlp_code is null then coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N'' '')

											when m.mlp_code = e.evt_object then e.evt_obrtype end = coalesce( m.mlp_obrtype, N'' '') '

			set @sEvtclause = N' and a.act_event = @sEvent
