CREATE PROCEDURE O7REMTOOL
						   @sSource    nvarchar(8),
                           @sCode      nvarchar(30),
                           @sClass     nvarchar(80),
                           @dDatefrom  datetime,
                           @dDateto    datetime,
                           @nCost      numeric(30,6) OUTPUT,
                           @sStatement nvarchar(4000) OUTPUT  
AS 
	SET NOCOUNT ON
	declare @sExtracol		nvarchar(1000)  /* @sExtracol part of select clause.		*/
	declare @sExtra			nvarchar(1000)  /* @sExtra part of select clause.			*/
	declare @sFromstat		nvarchar(400)		/* from @sStatement							*/
	declare @sSelclause		nvarchar(3000)			/* select @sStatement it self				*/
	declare @sSelclause2	nvarchar(3000)		/* select @sStatement it self				*/
	declare @sEvtclause		nvarchar(3000)		/* and clause for events					*/
	declare @sEvtclause1	nvarchar(2000)		/* and clause for events (specially for report ORCSTL)   */
	declare @sPrjclause		nvarchar(3000)		/* and clause for projects					*/
	declare @sBudclause		nvarchar(3000)		/* and clause for budgets					*/
	declare @sAndclause		nvarchar(3000)		/* and clause to use ( evt, pro or bud )	*/
	declare @sGroupby		nvarchar(400)		/* group by @sStatement						*/
	declare @sCharfrom		nvarchar(10)			/* date from in character					*/
	declare @sCharto		nvarchar(10)			/* date to in character						*/
	declare @sSQL			nvarchar(4000)  
	declare @nRate			numeric(24,6)
	declare @nRecid			numeric(38,0)
	declare @nAct			numeric(8)
	declare @sEvent			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty			numeric(24,6)

	set @sExtracol = N''
	set @sFromstat = N''
	set @sAndclause = N''
	set @sExtra = N''
	
	SELECT @sCharfrom = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDatefrom ,101), N'01/01/1900'), 
		   @sCharto   = coalesce(CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10), @dDateto  , 101), N'01/01/2100' )

	/* NOTE: BAN is a special case and its functionality has been split out from the main code 
	*			in Oracle to make the SQL Server conversion simpler.  BAN only builds a SQL
	*			statement string for the OUTPUT parameter and returns.  The rest should resemble 
	*			the Oracle code more closely.
	*/
	if @sSource = N'BAN'
		begin
			set @sStatement = N'select dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( sum( coalesce( t.tor_qty, 0 ) * coalesce( t.tor_hours, 0 ) *
																	coalesce( m.mrt_tariff, 0 ) ) - sum( coalesce( c.tlu_cost, 0 ) ),
																	0 ) costs,
										coalesce( m.mrt_tariff, 0 ) rate,
										dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER ( coalesce( t.tor_qty, 0 ) * coalesce( t.tor_hours, 0 )  -
																coalesce( c.tlu_qty, 0 ), 0 ) qty,
										a.act_event act_event, 
										a.act_act act_act,
										t.tor_tool recid
			 					from r5toolreq t left outer join r5toolsused c on (t.tor_event = c.tlu_event and   
																					t.tor_act   = c.tlu_act   and   
																					t.tor_tool  = c.tlu_tool), 
										r5activities a, 
										r5mrctools m, 
										r5events e, r5ububat u 
								where a.act_event = t.tor_event
								and   a.act_act   = t.tor_act
								and   m.mrt_mrc   = t.tor_mrc
								and   m.mrt_tool  = t.tor_tool
								and   m.mrt_org   = e.evt_org
								and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
								and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
								and   u.bub_code  = N''' + @sCode + N''' 
								and   u.bub_rstatus not in ( N''B'', N''C'' )
								and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharto + N''', 101)
								and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME, N''' + @sCharfrom + N''', 101)
								group by m.mrt_tariff, t.tor_qty, t.tor_hours, c.tlu_qty,
											a.act_event, a.act_act, t.tor_tool '
			return
		end
	else
		begin
			IF  @sSource = N'BUD'
				set @sFromstat = N', r5ububat u '

			set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( sum( coalesce( t.tor_qty, 0 ) * coalesce( t.tor_hours, 0 ) *
					coalesce( m.mrt_tariff, 0 ) ) - sum( coalesce( c.tlu_cost, 0 ) ),
					0 ) ' + @sExtracol + 
					'from r5toolreq t, r5activities a, r5mrctools m, r5toolsused c, r5events e '  + @sFromstat

			set @sEvtclause = N' where a.act_event = t.tor_event
						  and   a.act_act   = t.tor_act
						  and   m.mrt_mrc   = t.tor_mrc
						  and   m.mrt_tool  = t.tor_tool
						  and   m.mrt_org   = e.evt_org
						  and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
						  and   a.act_event = c.tlu_event
						  and   a.act_act   = c.tlu_act
						  and   c.tlu_tool  = t.tor_tool
						  and   a.act_event in ( select evt_code from dbo.O7REMXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY( @sCode ))'

			set @sPrjclause = N' where a.act_event = t.tor_event
						  and   a.act_act   = t.tor_act
						  and   m.mrt_mrc   = t.tor_mrc
						  and   m.mrt_tool  = t.tor_tool
						  and   m.mrt_org   = e.evt_org
						  and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
						  and   a.act_projbud like coalesce(@sClass, N''%'') 
						  and   r.prj_code  = a.act_project
						 and  a.act_project in
						   ( select prj_code from dbo.O7REMXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY( @sCode ) )'

			if @sSource = N'EVT' 
			  set @sAndclause = @sEvtclause
			if  @sSource = N'PRJ' 
				set @sAndclause = @sPrjclause
			if  @sSource = N'BUD'
				begin
					--select clause needs outerjoin syntax if source is bud or ban.
					set @sSelclause = N'select @nCost = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( sum( coalesce( t.tor_qty, 0 ) * coalesce( t.tor_hours, 0 ) *
					coalesce( m.mrt_tariff, 0 ) ) - sum( coalesce( c.tlu_cost, 0 ) ),
					0 ) ' + @sExtracol + 
					'from r5toolreq t left outer join r5toolsused c on (t.tor_event = c.tlu_event and   t.tor_act   = c.tlu_act   and   t.tor_tool  = c.tlu_tool), 
					r5activities a, 
					r5mrctools m, 
					r5events e '  + @sFromstat 

					set @sAndclause = ' where a.act_event = t.tor_event
						and   a.act_act   = t.tor_act
						and   m.mrt_mrc   = t.tor_mrc
						and   m.mrt_tool  = t.tor_tool
						and   m.mrt_org   = e.evt_org
						and   a.act_event = e.evt_code
						and   u.bub_event = a.act_event
						and   u.bub_code  = @sCode
						and   u.bub_rstatus not in ( N''B'', N''C'' )
						and   a.act_start <= CONVERT(DATETIME,@sCharto, 101)
						and   a.act_start + a.act_duration >= CONVERT(DATETIME,@sCharfrom, 101)'

				end

			set @sSQL = @sSelclause + @sAndclause
			EXECUTE sp_executesql @sSQL, N'@nCost numeric(30,6) OUTPUT, @sCode  nvarchar(30), @sClass nvarchar(80), @sCharfrom	nvarchar(10), @sCharto nvarchar(10)', @nCost OUTPUT, @sCode, @sClass, @sCharfrom, @sCharto
		end

name: O7REMXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY

create function O7REMXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(30))
returns @tReturn table( evt_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
                        evt_routeparent nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sParent    	nvarchar(30)
		
	declare @tStack table ( evt_code nvarchar(30), evt_routeparent nvarchar(30), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, 1 from r5events where evt_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = evt_code, @sParent = evt_routeparent from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode, @sParent )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND evt_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events
										 where evt_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7REMXXX_GET_EVT_HIERARCHY2 (@sCode nvarchar(30), @sWoclpout nvarchar(200))
returns @tReturn table( evt_code nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN, 
                        evt_routeparent nvarchar(30) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sParent    	nvarchar(30)
	DECLARE @sStatus    	nvarchar(4)
		
	declare @tStack table ( evt_code nvarchar(30), evt_routeparent nvarchar(30), evt_rstatus nvarchar(4), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, evt_rstatus, 1 from r5events where evt_code = @sCode and ( evt_rstatus <> N'C' OR @sWoclpout = N'YES' )
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = evt_code, @sParent = evt_routeparent, @sStatus = evt_rstatus from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
                    if @sStatus <> N'C'
					    insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode, @sParent )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND evt_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select evt_code, evt_routeparent, evt_rstatus, @nLevel + 1
										  from r5events
										 where evt_parent = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

create function O7REMXXX_GET_PRJ_HIERARCHY (@sCode nvarchar(20))
returns @tReturn table( prj_code nvarchar(20) COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN )
as
begin
	DECLARE @nLevel			int
	DECLARE @sCurrentCode	nvarchar(20)
		
	declare @tStack table ( prj_code nvarchar(20), LevelID int )
	
	INSERT INTO @tStack select prj_code, 1 from r5projects where prj_code = @sCode
	SET @nLevel = 1

	WHILE @nLevel > 0
		BEGIN
			IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM @tStack WHERE LevelID = @nLevel)
				BEGIN
					select @sCurrentCode = prj_code from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel
					insert into @tReturn values ( @sCurrentCode )
					delete from @tStack where LevelID = @nLevel AND prj_code = @sCurrentCode
					insert into @tStack select PRJ_CODE, @nLevel + 1
										  from R5PROJECTS
										 where PRJ_PARENT = @sCurrentCode
					IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0 
						SET @nLevel = @nLevel + 1
				END
			ELSE
				SET @nLevel = @nLevel - 1
		END

	return
end

CREATE PROCEDURE O7RENTALRETURNED
  @rental       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
  @rentalorg    NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @r5user       NVARCHAR( 255 )
AS 
BEGIN

  DECLARE @chk              NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @returndate       DATETIME
  DECLARE @issuedate        DATETIME
  DECLARE @returntime       NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @issuetime        NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @uom              NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @issuereading     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @returnreading    NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @meterreading     NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @object           NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @objectorg        NVARCHAR( 15 )
  DECLARE @calculatedusage  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @calculatedhours  NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @calculateddays   NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @issuefuellevel   NUMERIC
  DECLARE @returnfuellevel  NUMERIC
  DECLARE @minutes          NUMERIC
  DECLARE @roundinghours    NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @roundingdays     NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @roundhours       NUMERIC
  DECLARE @starttime        NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @endtime          NVARCHAR( 8 )
  DECLARE @status           NVARCHAR( 4 )
  DECLARE @meter            NVARCHAR( 20 )
  DECLARE @metermax         NUMERIC( 24, 6 )
  DECLARE @return           INT
  
  /* Get rental, template and equipment data. */
  SELECT @returndate      = crt_returndate, 
         @issuedate       = crt_issuedate,
         @uom             = ISNULL( crt_issuereadinguom, obj_primaryuom ), 
         @issuereading    = crt_issuereading, 
         @returnreading   = crt_returnreading,
         @object          = crt_object, 
         @objectorg       = crt_object_org, 
         @roundinghours   = ctp_roundinghours, 
         @roundingdays    = ctp_roundingdays, 
         @issuefuellevel  = crt_issuefuellevel, 
         @returnfuellevel = crt_returnfuellevel,
         @starttime       = ISNULL( ctp_starttimehours, N'00' ) + N':' + ISNULL( ctp_starttimeminutes, N'00' ), 
         @endtime         = ISNULL( ctp_endtimehours, N'23' ) + N':' +  ISNULL( ctp_endtimeminutes, N'59' ) 
  FROM   r5objects, r5contracttemplates right outer join r5customerrentals on (ctp_code = crt_contracttemplate AND ctp_org  = crt_contracttemplate_org )
  WHERE  obj_code = crt_object
  AND    obj_org  = crt_object_org
  AND    crt_code = @rental
  AND    crt_org  = @rentalorg

  IF @object IS NULL
    RETURN

  /* Set issue and return date. */
  SET @returndate = ISNULL( @returndate, dbo.o7gttime2( @rentalorg ) )
  SET @issuedate  = ISNULL( @issuedate, @returndate )

  SET @issuetime  = CONVERT( VARCHAR( 8 ), @issuedate, 108 )
  SET @returntime = CONVERT( VARCHAR( 8 ), @returndate, 108 )

  IF @uom IS NOT NULL
    /* Get meter data. */
    SELECT @meterreading = ISNULL( met_last, oud_totalusage ), 
           @meter        = met_code, 
           @metermax     = met_max
    FROM   r5objusagedefs LEFT OUTER JOIN r5meters ON ( met_code = oud_meter )
    WHERE  oud_object     = @object
    AND    oud_object_org = @objectorg
    AND    oud_uom        = @uom

  /* Set issue and return reading. */
  IF @uom IS NOT NULL AND @returnreading IS NULL
    BEGIN
      SET @returnreading = @meterreading
      IF @issuereading > @returnreading
        SET @returnreading = NULL
    END
  IF @issuereading IS NULL AND @returnreading IS NOT NULL
    SET @issuereading = @returnreading

  /* Calculate usage. */
  SET @calculatedusage = ISNULL( @returnreading - @issuereading, 0 )
  IF @calculatedusage < 0
    BEGIN
      IF @metermax IS NOT NULL
        SET @calculatedusage = ( @metermax + 1 - @issuereading ) + @returnreading
    END

  /* If the calculated usage unknown or smaller than 0, set it to 0. */
  SET @calculatedusage = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( ISNULL( @calculatedusage, 0 ), 0 )

  /* Calculate hours. */
  SET @calculatedhours = DATEDIFF( hh, @issuedate, @returndate )
  IF @starttime = N'00:00'
    SET @starttime = N'00:00:00'
  ELSE  
    SET @starttime = @starttime + N':00'  
  IF @endtime = N'23:59'
    SET @endtime = N'23:59:59'
  ELSE
    SET @endtime = @endtime + N':00'
  IF @starttime <> N'00:00:00' OR @endtime <> N'23:59:59'
    BEGIN
      IF dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @issuedate, 'DD' ) = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @returndate, 'DD' ) 
        BEGIN
          /* Special case when issue and return date are on the same day. */
          SET @calculatedhours = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( 
                                   0.00, 
                                   DATEDIFF( ss,    
                                             dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( CAST( @issuetime  AS DATETIME ), 
                                                                  CAST( @starttime  AS DATETIME ) ),
                                             dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( CAST( @returntime AS DATETIME ), 
                                                               CAST( @endtime    AS DATETIME ) ) ) / 3600.00 )
        END
      ELSE
        BEGIN
          /* Count real hours if start and/or end hours/minutes entered, start with first day. */ 
          SET @calculatedhours = dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( 
                                   0.00, 
                                   DATEDIFF( ss,    
                                             dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( CAST( @issuetime AS DATETIME ), 
                                                                  CAST( @starttime AS DATETIME ) ),
                                             dbo.F_GREATEST_DATE( CAST( @issuetime AS DATETIME ), 
                                                                  CAST( @endtime   AS DATETIME ) ) ) / 3600.00 )
          /* Days between first and last. */
          SET @calculatedhours = @calculatedhours + 
                                 ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( 0, DATEDIFF( dd, 
                                                                       dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @issuedate,  'DD' ),
                                                                       dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( @returndate, 'DD' ) ) - 1 ) *
                                   ( DATEDIFF( ss, CAST( @starttime AS DATETIME ), CAST( @endtime AS DATETIME ) ) / 3600.00 ) )                                         
          /* last day. */
          SET @calculatedhours = @calculatedhours + 
                                 ( dbo.F_GREATEST_NUMBER( 
                                     0.00, 
                                     DATEDIFF( ss,    
                                               dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( CAST( @returntime AS DATETIME ), 
                                                                 CAST( @starttime  AS DATETIME ) ),
                                               dbo.F_LEAST_DATE( CAST( @returntime AS DATETIME ), 
                                                                 CAST( @endtime    AS DATETIME ) ) ) / 3600.00 ) )
        END
    END
  IF ISNULL( @roundinghours, N'*' ) <> N'*'
    BEGIN
      SET @roundhours = SUBSTRING( @roundinghours, 3, 2 ) / 60.0 * 100 
      SET @minutes = ( @calculatedhours - FLOOR( @calculatedhours ) ) * 100
      /* Do rounding according to value in roundinghours. */
      IF @roundinghours LIKE 'UP%' 
        /* Round up. */  
        SET @calculatedhours = FLOOR( @calculatedhours ) + ( ( CEILING( @minutes / @roundhours ) * @roundhours ) / 100 )
      ELSE
        /* Round down. */
        SET @calculatedhours = FLOOR( @calculatedhours ) + ( ( FLOOR( @minutes / @roundhours ) * @roundhours ) / 100 )
    END
    /* Finally round to just two decimals. */
  SET @calculatedhours = ROUND( @calculatedhours, 2 )

  /* Calculate days. */
  SET @calculateddays = DATEDIFF( mi, @issuedate, @returndate ) / 1440.00
  IF ISNULL( @roundingdays, N'*' ) <> N'*'
    BEGIN
      IF @roundingdays = N'UP'
        SET @calculateddays = CEILING( @calculateddays )
      ELSE
        SET @calculateddays = FLOOR( @calculateddays )   
    END
  SET @calculateddays = ROUND( @calculateddays, 2 )

CREATE  FUNCTION O7REPBUDGET_Q_FIELDS
                          (  @sP_R5USER               NVARCHAR(255),
                             @sP_R5FUNC               NVARCHAR(6),
                             @sP_R5LANG               NVARCHAR(2),
                             @sP_R5ORG                NVARCHAR(15),
                             @sP_BUDGET               NVARCHAR(20),
                             @sP_TYPE                 NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_period           NVARCHAR(4),
                             @sV_bdt_mrc              NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_mrcgr            NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_jobtype          NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_jobtypegr        NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_costtype         NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_costtypegr       NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_object           NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_objectgr         NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_objectorg        NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_location         NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_locationgr       NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_locationorg      NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_costcode         NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_costcodegr       NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_project          NVARCHAR(30),
                             @sV_bdt_projectgr        NVARCHAR(30),
                             @nB_LEVEL                INTEGER )
                   

RETURNS nvarchar(1000)
AS

BEGIN
      declare @sRentity NVARCHAR(4)
      declare @sOrdfield  NVARCHAR(1000)
      declare @botnum INTEGER

      SELECT @sRentity = CASE  WHEN  @nB_LEVEL = bus_peri  THEN N'PERI'
                               WHEN  @nB_LEVEL = bus_loc   THEN N'LOC'
                               WHEN  @nB_LEVEL = bus_mrc   THEN N'MRC'
                               WHEN  @nB_LEVEL = bus_obj   THEN N'OBJ'
                               WHEN  @nB_LEVEL = bus_cstp  THEN N'CSTP'
                               WHEN  @nB_LEVEL = bus_jbtp  THEN N'JBTP'
                               WHEN  @nB_LEVEL = bus_cstc  THEN N'CSTC'
                               WHEN  @nB_LEVEL = Bus_proj  THEN N'PROJ' 
                               ELSE  NULL
                         END
       FROM   R5BUDGETSTRUCTURE
       WHERE  bus_code = @sP_BUDGET

        IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 SET @sRentity = NULL

       IF @sP_TYPE = N'FIELD' 
           BEGIN
              IF @sRentity = N'PERI' 
                  SET @sOrdfield = @sV_bdt_period

              IF @sRentity = N'MRC'  
                  SET @sOrdfield = CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_mrc IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_mrc 
                                        ELSE (CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_mrcgr IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_mrcgr + ' (' + DBO.repgettext(@sP_R5FUNC, @sP_R5LANG, 10 ) + ')' 
                                                   ELSE NULL 
                                              END ) 
                                        END

              IF @sRentity = N'JBTP' 
                  SET @sOrdfield = CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_jobtype IS NOT NULL THEN DBO.REPGETDESC(@sP_R5LANG, 'UCOD',@sV_bdt_jobtype, 'JBTP',NULL) 
                                        ELSE (CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_jobtypegr IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_jobtypegr + ' (' + DBO.repgettext(@sP_R5FUNC, @sP_R5LANG, 10 ) + ')' 
                                                   ELSE NULL 
                                              END ) 
                                        END

              IF @sRentity = N'CSTP' 
                  SET @sOrdfield = CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_costtype IS NOT NULL THEN DBO.REPGETDESC(@sP_R5LANG, 'UCOD',@sV_bdt_costtype, 'CSTP',NULL) 
                                        ELSE (CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_costtypegr IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_costtypegr + ' (' + DBO.repgettext(@sP_R5FUNC, @sP_R5LANG, 10 ) + ')' 
                                                   ELSE NULL 
                                              END ) 
                                        END

              IF @sRentity = N'OBJ'  
                 SET @sOrdfield = CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_object IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_object + (CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_objectorg = @sP_R5ORG THEN ' ' ELSE ' (' + @sV_bdt_objectorg + ')' END) 
                                       ELSE (CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_objectgr IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_objectgr + ' (' + DBO.repgettext(@sP_R5FUNC, @sP_R5LANG, 10 ) + ')' 
                                                  ELSE NULL 
                                             END ) 
                                       END

              IF @sRentity = N'LOC'  
                 SET @sOrdfield = CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_location IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_location + (CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_locationorg = @sP_R5ORG THEN ' ' ELSE ' (' + @sV_bdt_locationorg + ')' END) 
                                       ELSE (CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_locationgr IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_locationgr + ' (' + DBO.repgettext(@sP_R5FUNC, @sP_R5LANG, 10 ) + ')' 
                                                  ELSE NULL 
                                             END ) 
                                       END

              IF @sRentity = N'CSTC' 
                 SET @sOrdfield = CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_costcode IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_costcode 
                                       ELSE (CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_costcodegr IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_costcodegr + ' (' + DBO.repgettext(@sP_R5FUNC, @sP_R5LANG, 10 ) + ')' 
                                                  ELSE NULL 
                                             END ) 
                                       END

              IF @sRentity = N'PROJ' 
                 SET @sOrdfield = CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_project IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_project 
                                       ELSE (CASE WHEN @sV_bdt_projectgr IS NOT NULL THEN @sV_bdt_projectgr + ' (' + DBO.repgettext(@sP_R5FUNC, @sP_R5LANG, 10 ) + ')' 
                                                  ELSE NULL 
                                             END ) 
                                       END
               IF @sRentity IS NULL SET @sOrdfield = NULL
           END
       IF @sP_TYPE = N'LABEL' 
           BEGIN
               IF @sRentity = N'PERI' 
                  BEGIN
                       SELECT @botnum = bot_number FROM R5BOILERTEXTS 
                       WHERE bot_function = @sP_R5FUNC AND bot_lang = @sP_R5LANG 
                             AND bot_fld1 = N'BUD_PERIOD'                        
                       IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 SET @botnum = 0
                  END                                                   
                                     
                  
              
               IF @sRentity = N'MRC' 
                  BEGIN
                       SELECT @botnum = bot_number FROM R5BOILERTEXTS 
                       WHERE bot_function =@sP_R5FUNC AND bot_lang =@sP_R5LANG 
                             AND bot_fld1 = N'BUD_MRC'                                                  
                       IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 SET @botnum = 0
                  END         
                  

               IF @sRentity = N'JBTP' 
                   BEGIN
                       SELECT @botnum = bot_number FROM R5BOILERTEXTS 
                       WHERE bot_function =@sP_R5FUNC AND bot_lang =@sP_R5LANG 
                             AND bot_fld1 = N'BUD_JBTP'                                                  
                       IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 SET @botnum = 0
                  END         
                                    

               IF @sRentity = N'CSTP' 
                   BEGIN
                       SELECT @botnum = bot_number FROM R5BOILERTEXTS 
                       WHERE bot_function =@sP_R5FUNC

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPBZDLUD
  @R5_USER   NVARCHAR( 255 ),
  @R5_ORG    NVARCHAR( 15 ),
  @SEL_TABLE NVARCHAR( 256 ),
  @SEL_START NVARCHAR( 20 )
AS 
BEGIN
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
  
  DECLARE 
    @tsql           NVARCHAR( 4000 ),
    @columnlist     NVARCHAR( 4000 ),
    @collastsaved   NVARCHAR( 100 ),
    @tabledatalake  NVARCHAR( 256 ),
    @paramselstart  NVARCHAR( 10 );
    
  CREATE TABLE #r5repbzdlud_table (
    TABLENAME       NVARCHAR( 256 )  COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL1            NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL2            NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL3            NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL4            NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL5            NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL6            NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL7            NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL8            NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL9            NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL10           NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL11           NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL12           NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL13           NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    COL14           NVARCHAR( 4000 ) COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    LASTSAVED       NVARCHAR( 100 )  COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL,
    RTYPE           NVARCHAR( 1 )    COLLATE LATIN1_GENERAL_BIN NULL ) 
    
  BEGIN TRY   
    -- check if valid date format
    SET @paramselstart = CONVERT( NVARCHAR( 10 ), CONVERT( DATE, @SEL_START, 120 ),  120 );
    
    -- check if table exists; set table
    SELECT  @tabledatalake = c.tablename 
    FROM    (  SELECT  table_name tablename
               FROM    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES 
               WHERE   table_name = @SEL_TABLE
               UNION   ALL
               SELECT  table_name tablename
               FROM    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS
               WHERE   table_name = @SEL_TABLE ) c;
            
    -- set lastsavedcolumn string
    SELECT  @collastsaved = UPPER( t.column_name )
    FROM    information_schema.columns t
            INNER JOIN  datalake_table dt 
                    ON  dt.name =  t.table_name COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
    WHERE   t.table_name      =     @SEL_TABLE 
            AND t.column_name LIKE '%LASTSAVED'; 
  END TRY
  BEGIN CATCH
    RETURN;
  END CATCH;
  
  -- insert table column headers
  WITH    columnspkuk( tablename, columnname )
  AS
  (
  SELECT  con.table_name  tablename,
          col.column_name columnname
  FROM    INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS con 
          INNER JOIN  datalake_table dt 
                  ON  dt.name =  con.table_name COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
          LEFT  JOIN  INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE col 
                  ON  con.CONSTRAINT_NAME = col.CONSTRAINT_NAME 
                 AND  con.table_name      = col.table_name
  WHERE   con.constraint_type   IN  ( 'UNIQUE', 'PRIMARY KEY' )
          AND  con.table_name    =   @SEL_TABLE
          AND  col.column_name  NOT LIKE  '%SQLIDENTITY'
  ),
          columnsfirstn( tablename, columnname )
  AS 
  (
  SELECT  TOP 14
          t2.table_name   tablename,
          t2.column_name  columnname
  FROM    information_schema.columns t2
          INNER JOIN  datalake_table dt
                  ON  dt.name =  t2.table_name  COLLATE Latin1_General_BIN
  WHERE   t2.table_name = @SEL_TABLE 
          AND   NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM columnspkuk )
          AND   t2.column_name  NOT LIKE  '%LASTSAVED'
          AND   t2.column_name  NOT LIKE  '%SQLIDENTITY'
  ),
          columnstopivot( tcol, columnname, tablename )
  AS
  (
  SELECT  ROW_NUMBER ( ) OVER ( ORDER BY t.columnname ) tcol, 
          UPPER( t.columnname )                         columnname,  
          UPPER( t.tablename )                          tablename
  FROM    (  SELECT  tablename, 
                     columnname
             FROM    columnspkuk
             UNION   ALL
             SELECT  tablename, 
                     columnname
             FROM    columnsfirstn ) t
  )
  INSERT  INTO #r5repbzdlud_table
  SELECT  t2.tablename TABLENAME,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '1'  THEN t2.columnname END ) COL1,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '2'  THEN t2.columnname END ) COL2,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '3'  THEN t2.columnname END ) COL3,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '4'  THEN t2.columnname END ) COL4,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '5'  THEN t2.columnname END ) COL5,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '6'  THEN t2.columnname END ) COL6,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '7'  THEN t2.columnname END ) COL7,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '8'  THEN t2.columnname END ) COL8,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '9'  THEN t2.columnname END ) COL9,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '10' THEN t2.columnname END ) COL10,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '11' THEN t2.columnname END ) COL11,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '12' THEN t2.columnname END ) COL12,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '13' THEN t2.columnname END ) COL13,
          MAX( CASE WHEN t2.tcol = '14' THEN t2.columnname END ) COL14,
          @collastsaved LASTSAVED,
          'H' RTYPE
  FROM    columnstopivot t2
  GROUP   BY  t2.tablename;
  
  -- set string for column list
  SELECT  @columnlist = CASE WHEN col1  IS NOT NULL THEN col1  ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL1, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col2  IS NOT NULL THEN col2  ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL2, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col3  IS NOT NULL THEN col3  ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL3, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col4  IS NOT NULL THEN col4  ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL4, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col5  IS NOT NULL THEN col5  ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL5, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col6  IS NOT NULL THEN col6  ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL6, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col7  IS NOT NULL THEN col7  ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL7, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col8  IS NOT NULL THEN col8  ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL8, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col9  IS NOT NULL THEN col9  ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL9, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col10 IS NOT NULL THEN col10 ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL10, ' +
                        CASE WHEN col11 IS NOT NULL THEN col11 ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL11, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col12 IS NOT NULL THEN col12 ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL12, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col13 IS NOT NULL THEN col13 ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL13, '  +
                        CASE WHEN col14 IS NOT NULL THEN col14 ELSE 'NULL' END + ' COL14, '
  FROM    #r5repbzdlud_table;

  -- form final sql string; execute; return
  IF    @columnlist IS NOT NULL 
        AND @collastsaved IS NOT NULL 
        AND @tabledatalake IS NOT NULL 
        AND @paramselstart IS NOT NULL
  BEGIN
    SET @tsql =  ' INSERT INTO #r5repbzdlud_table ' +
                 ' SELECT ''' + @tabledatalake + ''' TABLENAME, ' + @columnlist + ' dbo.F_DATE_TO_CHAR(' + @collastsaved + ', ''YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'' ) LASTSAVED, ''R'' RTYPE ' + 
                 ' FROM   ' + @tabledatalake + ' ' + 
                 ' WHERE  COALESCE( ' + @collastsaved + ', GETDATE() ) >= CONVERT( DATETIME, ''' + @paramselstart + ''', 120 ) ' ;
    EXECUTE   sp_executesql @tsql;
  END;

  SELECT  TABLENAME,
          COL1,
          COL2,
          COL3,
          COL4,
          COL5,
          COL6,
          COL7,
          COL8,
          COL9,
          COL10,
          COL11,
          COL12,
          COL13,
          COL14,
          LASTSAVED,
          RTYPE
  FROM    #r5repbzdlud_table;
  DROP    TABLE #r5repbzdlud_table;
  
  RETURN

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPBZGREPTYPE_BZGREP(@R5_PARAM NVARCHAR(250), @R5_VISFLDS NVARCHAR(200), @R5_GRPFLDS NVARCHAR(20),
                                        @R5_SORTFLDS NVARCHAR(20), @SORTTYPE NVARCHAR(20), @SEL_PARAM1 NVARCHAR(3500))
as
BEGIN

AS

BEGIN

         SET @v_Return = 'DBO.REPFMTMONNUM(@R5_USER,' + @v_Return + ')'
      
      RETURN @v_Return
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPBZGREPTYPE_GETGREPPARAMDESC(@R5_FUNC NVARCHAR(6), @R5_LANG NVARCHAR(2), @R5_USER NVARCHAR(255), 
                                                  @R5_ORG NVARCHAR(15), @SEL_ORG NVARCHAR(15), @SEL_CODE NVARCHAR(1000), 
                                                  @LINENUM INT, @LABELVAL NVARCHAR(255) OUTPUT, @SUBTFROM NVARCHAR(80) OUTPUT, 
                                                  @SUBTTO NVARCHAR(80) OUTPUT, @RETURN_VAL NVARCHAR(500) OUTPUT) 
AS
BEGIN       
     DECLARE @v_desc             NVARCHAR(500)
     DECLARE @v_code             NVARCHAR(100)
     DECLARE @v_ParamRentity     NVARCHAR(4)
     DECLARE @v_ParamRtype       NVARCHAR(4)
     DECLARE @v_ParamDatatype    NVARCHAR(2)
     DECLARE @v_org              NVARCHAR(15)
     DECLARE @SUBTITLE           INT
     DECLARE @v_bottext          NVARCHAR(255)
     DECLARE @CNT                INT
     DECLARE @temp               NVARCHAR(255)

     SET @v_desc = ''
     SET @SUBTITLE = 0
     SET @CNT = 0

     DECLARE GET_PARAMLABEL CURSOR FOR
        SELECT BOT_TEXT
        FROM R5BOILERTEXTS
        WHERE BOT_FUNCTION = @R5_FUNC
        AND BOT_LANG = @R5_LANG
        AND BOT_DEST IN (N'F', N'DT', N'DF')
        AND BOT_NUMBER > 1
        ORDER BY BOT_NUMBER

     IF @SEL_ORG = N'%' 
       SET @v_org = @R5_ORG
     ELSE
       SET @v_org = @SEL_ORG

     SET @SUBTFROM = NULL
     SET @SUBTTO = NULL
                
     IF @SEL_CODE <> N'%' 
     BEGIN
          SELECT @v_ParamRentity = PMT_RENTITY, @v_ParamRtype = PMT_RTYPE, @v_ParamDatatype = PMT_DATATYPE 
          FROM R5REPPARMS
          WHERE PMT_FUNCTION = @R5_FUNC
          AND PMT_LINE = @LINENUM
          
          IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
          BEGIN
               SET @v_ParamRentity = ''
               SET @v_ParamRtype = ''
               SET @v_ParamDatatype = ''
          END

          SET @v_code = @SEL_CODE
          IF (DBO.O7getmos( @v_ParamRentity ) = N'+') AND (@v_ParamRentity <> N'TRAD') AND (@v_org <> N'*') 
             SET @v_code = @SEL_CODE + '#' + @v_org

          IF @v_ParamDatatype IN (N'DF', N'DT') 
          BEGIN
               SELECT @SUBTITLE = COUNT(BOT_TEXT) 
               FROM R5BOILERTEXTS
               WHERE BOT_FUNCTION = @R5_FUNC
               AND BOT_LANG = @R5_LANG
               AND BOT_FLD1 LIKE N'SUBTITLE%'
            
               IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0
                 SET @SUBTITLE = 0

               IF @SUBTITLE > 0 
               BEGIN
                    IF @v_ParamDatatype = N'DF' 
                       SET @SUBTFROM = DBO.REPGETFMTDATE(@R5_USER, DBO.TO_DATE(@v_code, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
                    ELSE IF @v_ParamDatatype = N'DT' 
                       SET @SUBTTO = DBO.REPGETFMTDATE(@R5_USER, DBO.TO_DATE(@v_code, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
                
                    SET @v_desc = NULL
               END
               ELSE
               BEGIN
                    SET @v_desc = DBO.REPGETFMTDATE(@R5_USER, DBO.TO_DATE(@v_code, 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
                    SET @RETURN_VAL = @v_desc
               END
          END
          ELSE
          BEGIN
               SET @v_desc = DBO.REPGETPARAMDESC(@R5_LANG, @v_ParamRentity, @v_code, @v_ParamRtype, NULL)
               SET @v_desc = @SEL_CODE + '  ' + ISNULL(@v_desc,' ')
               SET @RETURN_VAL = @v_desc
          END 
          
          IF @v_ParamDatatype = N'O' 
             SELECT @LABELVAL = BOT_TEXT 
             FROM R5BOILERTEXTS
             WHERE BOT_FUNCTION = @R5_FUNC
             AND BOT_LANG = @R5_LANG
             AND BOT_DEST = N'O'
        
          ELSE IF @SUBTITLE = 0 
          BEGIN
               OPEN GET_PARAMLABEL

               FETCH NEXT FROM GET_PARAMLABEL
               INTO @temp

               WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
               BEGIN
                    SET @CNT = @CNT + 1

                    IF @CNT = @LINENUM - 1
                       SET @LABELVAL = @temp

                    FETCH NEXT FROM GET_PARAMLABEL
                    INTO @temp
               END
               CLOSE GET_PARAMLABEL
          END
          ELSE 
              SET @LABELVAL = NULL

     END
     ELSE
     BEGIN
          SET @v_desc = NULL
          SET @LABELVAL = NULL
     END 

     DEALLOCATE GET_PARAMLABEL
                    
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPBZGREPTYPE_GETSELECTCLAUSE(@R5_USER NVARCHAR(255), @R5_FUNC NVARCHAR(6), @R5_DESTYPE NVARCHAR(20),
                                 @R5_LANG NVARCHAR(2), @R5_DEFORG NVARCHAR(15), @R5_ORG NVARCHAR(15),
                                 @R5_VISFLDS NVARCHAR(200), @R5_GRPFLDS NVARCHAR(20),
                                 @SelectFld1 NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT, @SelectFld2 NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT, @SelectFld3 NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT,
                                 @SelectFld4 NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT, @SelectFld5 NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT, @TextFld NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT,
                                 @LabelFld1 NVARCHAR(4000) OUTPUT, @LabelFld2 NVARCHAR(2000) OUTPUT, @TotalFld NVARCHAR(3000) OUTPUT)
AS
BEGIN
        DECLARE @CONST_MAX_TOTALS        INT
        DECLARE @CONST_MAX_SELECTFIELDS  INT
        DECLARE @CONST_MAX_TEXTFIELDS    INT
        SET @CONST_MAX_TOTALS = 10
        SET @CONST_MAX_SELECTFIELDS = 60
        SET @CONST_MAX_TEXTFIELDS = 3

        DECLARE @v_strFields          NVARCHAR(400) 
        DECLARE @v_LabelTextFld       NVARCHAR(500) 
        DECLARE @v_TextFld            NVARCHAR(1000) 
        DECLARE @v_TotalFld           NVARCHAR(3000) 
        DECLARE @v_TotLblFld          NVARCHAR(1000)
        DECLARE @v_TotalFmt           NVARCHAR(1000) 
        DECLARE @v_FieldCount         INT 
        DECLARE @v_SelectFldCount     INT 
        DECLARE @v_TextFldCount       INT 
        DECLARE @v_TotalFldCount      INT 
        DECLARE @v_TempFieldNum       NVARCHAR(3) 
        DECLARE @v_Tempfld            NVARCHAR(300)
        DECLARE @v_TempfldNum         NVARCHAR(300)
        DECLARE @v_TempType           NVARCHAR(2)
        DECLARE @v_TempBot            NUMERIC(5)

        SET @v_FieldCount = 0
        SET @v_SelectFldCount = 0
        SET @v_TextFldCount = 0
        SET @v_TotalFldCount = 0
        
        SET @SelectFld1  = ''
        SET @SelectFld2  = ''
        SET @SelectFld3  = ''
        SET @SelectFld4  = ''
        SET @SelectFld5  = ''
        SET @LabelFld1   = ''
        SET @LabelFld2   = ''
        SET @TextFld     = ''
        SET @v_LabelTextFld = ''
        SET @v_TotalFld = ''
        SET @v_TotLblFld = ''
        SET @v_TotalFmt = ''
        SET @v_TempFieldNum = ''
        SET @v_Tempfld = ''
        SET @v_TempfldNum = ''
        SET @v_TempType = ''
        SET @v_TextFld = ''
        SET @v_strFields = @R5_VISFLDS

        WHILE (LEN(@v_strFields) > 0)
        BEGIN
              IF (CHARINDEX(N'#', @v_strFields, 1) > 0) 
              BEGIN
                   SET @v_TempFieldNum = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@v_strFields, 1,CHARINDEX(N'#', @v_strFields, 1)-1)))
                   SET @v_strFields = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@v_strFields, CHARINDEX(N'#', @v_strFields, 1)+1,LEN(@v_strFields)-CHARINDEX(N'#', @v_strFields, 1)+1)))
              END
              ELSE
              BEGIN
                   SET @v_TempFieldNum = LTRIM(RTRIM(@v_strFields)) 
                   SET @v_strFields = ''
              END 

              BEGIN
                   SELECT @v_Tempfld = RFL_FIELD, @v_TempfldNum = RFL_FIELD, @v_TempBot = RFL_BOTNUMBER, @v_TempType = RFL_DATATYPE 
                   FROM R5REPORTFIELDS WHERE RFL_FUNCTION = @R5_FUNC AND CAST(RFL_LINE AS NVARCHAR(5)) = @v_TempFieldNum

                   IF @@ROWCOUNT = 0 
                   BEGIN
                        SET @v_Tempfld = N'NULL'
                        SET @v_TempfldNum = N'NULL'
                        SET @v_TempType = N'C'
                   END

                   SET @v_Tempfld = REPLACE(@v_Tempfld, '''', '''''')
                   SET @v_TempfldNum = REPLACE(@v_TempfldNum, '''', '''''')
                   SET @v_Tempfld = DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_HANDLEPARAM(@R5_USER, @R5_LANG, @R5_ORG, @v_Tempfld)
                   SET @v_TempfldNum = DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_HANDLEPARAM(@R5_USER, @R5_LANG, @R5_ORG, @v_TempfldNum)
              END
              
              IF @v_TempType <> N'T' 
              BEGIN
                   IF (SUBSTRING(@R5_FUNC,3,4)<> 'MSSS' OR (SUBSTRING(@R5_FUNC,3,4)='MSSS' AND @v_TempFieldNum<>'17'))
                   BEGIN
                   SET @v_SelectFldCount = @v_SelectFldCount + 1
                   SET @v_Tempfld = DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_FORMATFIELD(@R5_USER, @R5_LANG, @R5_ORG, @v_TempType , @v_Tempfld)
                   
--                   IF DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'Y'
--                      SET @v_Tempfld = 'NULL'

                   IF (@v_SelectFldCount <= 12 AND DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'N')
                       SET @SelectFld1 = @SelectFld1 + 'CAST(' + @v_Tempfld + ' AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS BZGREP_FIELD' + CAST(@v_SelectFldCount AS VARCHAR(3)) + ','
                   ELSE IF (@v_SelectFldCount > 12 AND @v_SelectFldCount <= 24 AND DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'N')
                       SET @SelectFld2 = @SelectFld2 + 'CAST(' + @v_Tempfld + ' AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS BZGREP_FIELD' + CAST(@v_SelectFldCount AS VARCHAR(3)) + ','
                   ELSE IF (@v_SelectFldCount > 24 AND @v_SelectFldCount <= 36 AND DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'N')
                       SET @SelectFld3 = @SelectFld3 + 'CAST(' + @v_Tempfld + ' AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS BZGREP_FIELD' + CAST(@v_SelectFldCount AS VARCHAR(3)) + ','
                   ELSE IF (@v_SelectFldCount > 36 AND @v_SelectFldCount <= 48 AND DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'N')
                       SET @SelectFld4 = @SelectFld4 + 'CAST(' + @v_Tempfld + ' AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS BZGREP_FIELD' + CAST(@v_SelectFldCount AS VARCHAR(3)) + ','
                   ELSE IF (DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'N')
                       SET @SelectFld5 = @SelectFld5 + 'CAST(' + @v_Tempfld + ' AS NVARCHAR(100)) AS BZGREP_FIELD' + CAST(@v_SelectFldCount AS VARCHAR(3)) + ','

                   IF (@v_SelectFldCount <= 40 AND DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'N')
                      SET @LabelFld1 = @LabelFld1 + 'CAST(' +
                       CASE WHEN DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'Y'
                        THEN 'NULL'
                        ELSE 'DBO.repgettext(@R5_FUNC, @R5_LANG, ' + CAST(@v_TempBot AS NVARCHAR(4)) + ')'
                                       END + ' AS NVARCHAR(80)) AS BZGREP_LABEL' + CAST(@v_SelectFldCount AS VARCHAR(3)) + ','
                   ELSE IF (DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'N')
                      SET @LabelFld2 = @LabelFld2 + 'CAST(' +
                       CASE WHEN DBO.O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@v_TempFieldNum, @R5_GRPFLDS) = 'Y'
                        THEN 'NULL'
                        ELSE 'DBO.repgettext(@R5_FUNC, @R5_LANG, ' + CAST(@v_TempBot AS NVARCHAR(4)) + ')'
                                       END + ' AS NVARCHAR(80)) AS BZGREP_LABEL' + CAST(@v_SelectFldCount AS VARCHAR(3)) + ','
                   END
                   IF @v_TempType IN (N'A', N'N') 
                   BEGIN
                        SET @v_TotalFldCount = @v_TotalFldCount + 1
                        IF @v_TotalFldCount <= @CONST_MAX_TOTALS 
                        BEGIN
                             SET @v_TotalFld = @v_TotalFld + 'CAST(' + @v_TempfldNum + ' AS NUMERIC(24,6))' + CASE WHEN @v_TempType = 'A' THEN ' AS TOTALAMT' ELSE ' AS BZGREP_TOTAL' END + CAST(@v_TotalFldCount AS VARCHAR(3)) + ','
                             SET @v_TotLblFld = @v_TotLblFld + 'CAST(DBO.repgettext(@R5_FUNC, @R5_LANG, ' + CAST(@v_TempBot AS VARCHAR(3)) + ') AS NVARCHAR(80)) AS BZGREP_TOTLABEL' + CAST(@v_TotalFldCount AS VARCHAR(3)) + ','
                             SET @v_TotalFmt = @v_TotalFmt + CASE WHEN @v_TempType = N'A' THEN 'CAST(''''A'''' AS NVARCHAR(100))' ELSE 'CAST(''''N'''' AS NVARCHAR(100))' END +

CREATE FUNCTION O7REPBZGREPTYPE_INGRPFLDS(@FIELDTOCHECK NVARCHAR(2), @R5_GRPFLDS NVARCHAR(20))

AS
BEGIN
     DECLARE @CONST_MAX_GROUPFIELDS INT
     SET @CONST_MAX_GROUPFIELDS = 3

     DECLARE @v_GroupFields        NVARCHAR(80)
     DECLARE @v_TempFieldNum       NVARCHAR(3)
     DECLARE @v_Return             CHAR(1)

     SET @v_GroupFields = @R5_GRPFLDS

     IF LEN(@v_GroupFields) <= 0 
        SET @v_Return = 'N'
     ELSE
     BEGIN
         WHILE (LEN(@v_GroupFields) > 0)
         BEGIN
              IF (CHARINDEX(N'#', @v_GroupFields, 1) > 0) 
              BEGIN
                   SET @v_TempFieldNum = LTRIM(RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@v_GroupFields, 1,CHARINDEX(N'#', @v_GroupFields, 1)-1)))

              END
              ELSE
              BEGIN
                   SET @v_TempFieldNum = LTRIM(RTRIM(@v_GroupFields)) 
                   SET @v_GroupFields = ''
              END 
    
              IF @v_TempFieldNum = @FIELDTOCHECK
              BEGIN
                       SET @v_Return = 'Y'
                       BREAK

         END
     END
     RETURN @v_Return
END

CREATE PROCEDURE O7REPBZSIGNRESVALID(  
    @elscode       NVARCHAR( 30 ),
    @elsentcode    NVARCHAR( 80 ),
    @elsorg        NVARCHAR( 15 ),
    @selent        NVARCHAR( 4 ), 
    @isvalid       INT OUTPUT )    
AS
    SET NOCOUNT ON
    DECLARE @Archhash  NVARCHAR( 100 )   --r5elecarchive.ela_acode%TYPE
    DECLARE @Chkhash   NVARCHAR( 20 )
    DECLARE @Pk1       NVARCHAR( 30 )
    DECLARE @Pk2       NVARCHAR( 30 )
    DECLARE @Pk3       NVARCHAR( 30 )
    DECLARE @Tablename NVARCHAR( 30 )
    DECLARE @Rent      NVARCHAR( 8 )     --r5entities.ent_rentity%TYPE
    DECLARE @Chk       NVARCHAR( 4 )
    DECLARE @Code      NVARCHAR( 50 )
    DECLARE @Seqno     NVARCHAR( 10 )
    DECLARE @Code2     NVARCHAR( 50 )
    DECLARE @Return    INT
    DECLARE @CHARINDEX INT
	DECLARE @Counter   INT

    SET @Archhash = NULL
    SET @Chkhash = NULL
    SET @Pk1 = N'x'
    SET @Pk2 = N'x'
    SET @Pk3 = N'x'
    SET @Tablename = N'x'

    EXECUTE @Return = dbo.REPX5GETPK @selent, @Pk1 OUTPUT, @Pk2 OUTPUT, @Tablename OUTPUT
    IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @Return <> 0
        RETURN -1

    SELECT @Archhash = ela_acode 
    FROM   r5elecarchive
    WHERE  ela_code = @elscode

    SET @Rent = @selent

    IF @Rent = N'TRAN'
        SET @Rent = N'RECV'

    SET @Code = @elsentcode

    IF @Rent = N'QUOT'
        BEGIN
            SET @Code = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) - 1  )
            SET @Pk3 = N'QUO_SEQNO'
            SET @Seqno = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) + 1, len( @elsentcode )  )
        END
    IF @Rent = N'INSP'
        BEGIN
            SET @Code = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) - 1  )
            SET @Pk3 = N'DKL_LINE'
            SET @Seqno = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) + 1, len( @elsentcode )  )
        END
    IF @Rent = N'PPM'
        BEGIN
            SET @Code = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) - 1  )
            SET @Pk3 = N'PPM_REVISION'
            SET @Seqno = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) + 1, len( @elsentcode )  )
        END
    IF @Rent = N'MATL'
        BEGIN
            SET @Code = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) - 1  )
            SET @Pk3 = N'MTL_REVISION'
            SET @Seqno = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) + 1, len( @elsentcode )  )
        END
    IF @Rent = N'TASK'
        BEGIN
            SET @Code = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, 1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) - 1  )
            SET @Pk3 = N'TSK_REVISION'
            SET @Seqno = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  ) + 1, len( @elsentcode )  )
        END
    IF @Rent = N'EAL'
        BEGIN
            SET @CHARINDEX = CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode  )
            SET @Code = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, 1, @CHARINDEX - 1  )
            SET @Code2 = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, @CHARINDEX + 1, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode, @CHARINDEX + 1  ) - @CHARINDEX - 1 )
            SET @Pk3 = N'EAL_REVISION'
            SET @Seqno = SUBSTRING(  @elsentcode, CHARINDEX(  N'#', @elsentcode, @CHARINDEX + 1  ) + 1, len(  @elsentcode )  )
        END
    
    IF @Rent <> N'EAL'
        SET @Code2 = @elsorg

	SET @Counter = 0
    WHILE @Counter <= 5
        BEGIN
			EXECUTE @Return = O7CHKERECORD @Chkhash OUTPUT, @Rent, @Tablename, @Pk1, @Pk2, @Pk3, @Code, @Code2, @Seqno, @Counter
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 or @Return <> 0
				RETURN -1
			IF @Chkhash = @Archhash 
				BREAK 

			SET @Counter = @Counter + 1
		END

    IF @Chkhash <> @Archhash
        SET @isvalid = 1
    ELSE
        SET @isvalid = 0

CREATE FUNCTION o7repbzusrlmenuhide( 
  @func       NVARCHAR( 6 ), 
  @usergroup  NVARCHAR( 12 ) )
RETURNS INTEGER AS
BEGIN
  DECLARE @emnhide INTEGER
  DECLARE @emncode NVARCHAR( 30 )
  
  -- cursor for all menu items for given function/group
  DECLARE menuitem CURSOR LOCAL FOR
  SELECT  emn_code
  FROM    r5extmenus
  WHERE   emn_function = @func
  AND     emn_group    = @usergroup
 
  SET @emnhide = 1
  
  OPEN menuitem
  FETCH NEXT FROM menuitem INTO @emncode
  WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
  BEGIN
    WITH menuitems( menucode, menuparent, menuhide ) AS ( 
      SELECT emn_code, emn_parent, emn_hide
      FROM   r5extmenus
      WHERE  emn_code = @emncode
      UNION  ALL
      SELECT parent.emn_code, parent.emn_parent, parent.emn_hide
      FROM   r5extmenus parent, menuitems
      WHERE  menuitems.menuparent = parent.emn_code )
     
    SELECT @emnhide = COUNT( * ) FROM menuitems WHERE COALESCE( menuhide, '-' ) = '+'
    
    -- exit loop if found at least one which needs showing else continue
    IF @emnhide = 0
      BREAK

    FETCH NEXT FROM menuitem INTO @emncode
  END
  
  CLOSE menuitem
  DEALLOCATE menuitem

  RETURN @emnhide

END
